tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gsung rtsom/_nor brang o rgyan

tei:div.tei:p: nge ——rī —mi7 — spre rki—khu d+ku'i sno tsho3ṇa— ༵tre dzā1— ༄dz+wak+ṣe d+nghadz+wargyuci2 kyai ༄4 lke ci d+kuskewa/ — dz+wat+yā phaci 2dzha ༷ —cisnye — d+dhamu4—rwa ts+tsha r+ṣa wī chishākhudzordo 'iXcho——chicho—/ /wa k+to wa—lge —rdo/ hūṃwa sda — — trīrdo watram̐/rmye r+shasdeXr+yā ji mo ༵wa— tram̐ dzo+o rga rdo/hūṃsdisdesherdzoposnaduci ོ—dū+o — r+yārngordzosduj-itrīciskrehūṃ / — ༷ trerngo rdzi2tsho— shā dzishi hūm̐dhesdespyo wachi
༄7/ /nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/krung go'i bod rig —pa dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagagleng gzhi/ (1)bod kyi skung yig gi rnam bzhag chung ngu / (1)〈 rde'u'i rtsis gzhung sarga brgyad la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/ (42)bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig rdel rtsis/ (72)nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcudaces bya ba bzhu/gas so// (91)thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yig ge'i byung tshul skor rags tsam dpyad pa/ (181)sde srid phag mo gru pa'i gnad don 'ga' zhig gi dpyad don bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang / da 〈tā la'i bla ma'i rnam thar 〉 dang 〈ming rgyal rabs skabs su bod ljongs phag gru'i srid dbang gi gnad don 'ga' shas 〉 zhes bya bar dpyad pa/ (210)sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs (233)tha mag gi gnod pa/ da bcos min dbang med du thal ba'i gtam/ (317)shes rig sbrang rtsi 'thung 'dod blo gsar bung ba'i rang sgra/ (325)chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po yab sras kyis mdzad pa snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri 1

shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab so so'i mjug bsdoms don bsdus tshigs bcad khol du byung ba/ (332)paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung skye mdo nas bkras lhun dgon du gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/ (358)〈 theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod 〉 ces bya ba'i skor/ (372)khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (382)snyan ngag gi bstan bcos bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i skor gleng ba/ (404)bod yig dpe skrun bya bzhag la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba/ (433)bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba'i 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/ (453)ming gi mngon brjod mdor bsdus pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig gi dpe skrun gsal bshad/ (484)bod kyi mkhas pa'imortsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/ (490)1 rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ (490)2 thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (521)3 bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ (535)4 gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang / (568)5 kun bzang lnga pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs/ (577)2

6 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus ngo mtshar da wa gzigs mo/ (585)7 rje btsun mi la ras pa (600)8 gtsang smyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can/ (602)9 shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ (604)10 dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ (610)11 bu ston rin chen grub/ (612)12 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ (616)13 karma rang byung rdo rje/ (623)14 klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer/ (627)15 spyan snga pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ (631)16 jo nang tā ra nā tha/ (637)17 mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang (649)18 zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/ (652)19 paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ (658)20 paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ (662)21 bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal/ (665)22 si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ (668)23 khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ (671)24 thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ (673)25 gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ (676)26 lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i char 'bebs (680)3

27 zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol/ (708)28 dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/ (712)29 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ (714)30 dngul chu rdarma bha dra/ (719)31 dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje/ (722)32 rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ (727)33 rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ (736)34 kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/ (741)35 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho/ (744)36 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ (753)37 a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar/ (757)38 zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/ (766)39 yongs 'dzin gu ge ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ (771)40 rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags/ (778)41 shel dkar gling pa mi 'gyur lhun grub/ (779)42 dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje/ (782)43 dge 'dun chos 'phel (784)44 tshe tan zhabs drung / (789)rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ (795)

gleng gzhi/de yang kho bos bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel rim nang gi gnad don 'ga'i skor bod kyi rgyal rabs deb ther dang / chos 'byung / mkhas grub du ma'i rnam thar/gsar du rnyed pa'i rig dngos sogs dpyad gzhi khungs ldan mang por gzhi bcol nas bod kyi lo rgyus dus skabs so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul la zhib mor dpyad/ lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis lo rgyus la zhib dpyad gnang ba'i dpyad don gyi nying khus kha brgyan te bod kyi spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas rang gi lta tshul gsong por smra ba'i dpyad rtsom de snga bod ljongs zhib 'jug dang / gangs ljongs rig gnas/ bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ bod ljongs nang bstan/ mtsho sngon gyi sbrang char sogs la spel ba'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs da lam krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas nas thugs 'khur chen pos dpe skrun 'grems spel gnang bar gus pas snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid rnam pa dang / las don 'dir thugs nus 'don gnang gi blo mthun yongs la sor mo'i 'dab ma spyi bor bkod de bka' drin che zhes zhu ba dang chabs cig ched rtsom 'di dag gi bstan bya'i nang don skor klog pa pos de bas thugs snang chen po yong ched gsal bshad zhu dgos pa'i gnad don re zung 'dug snyam pa 'di lta ste/dang po/ thon mi sa sto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang / bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul skor rags tsam dpyad pa zhes bya ba ni spyi lo 1983lo'i bod ljongs zhib 'jug1

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'don thengs gsum pa'i thog spel ba dang / de rjes bod rig pa'i gros tshogs kyi ched rtsom gces bsdus nang bkod pa bcas skabs der bltas na bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i gong bod la gna' rabs yi ge yod pa'i skor la dpyad mkhan nyung la rang ngos la bltas na'ang dpyad gzhi 'dzoms po zhig rag med kyang / de rjes gnad don 'di'i thad dpyad pa gnang mkhan je mang du song ba dang / sgrub byed kyi dpyad gzhi yang phun sum je tshogs su song bas deng skabs la bltas na bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i gong bod la gna' rabs yi ge yod pa'i lta ba de yongs khyab kyi khas len byed pa'i don zhig tu gyur yod/ 'on kyang de snga kho bos spel ba'i dpyad rtsom nang gi sgrub byed mang po dang dgos pa rgyu mtshan gang yin gleng ba de dag la da lta yang dpyad gzhi'i rin thang nges can ldan 'dug snyam pa/gnyis pa/ rang nyid de snga bod ljongs dpe rnying dpe skrun khang gi 'gan 'khur byed ring dpe rnying dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa bod yig dpe rnying la 'phros pa'i ched rtsom mang tsam dang / bya bzhag de dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa'i bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu bcas rim par spel rjes klog pa po'i nang tshur snang lan cha legs tsam thon pa dper na bod yig skung yig skor gyi tshig mdzod rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyi dpe deb dngos su thon pa bcas bod yig dpe rnying skor las 'phros pa'i ched rtsom de dag la da lta yang bod kyi spyi dang bye brag rig gnas 'phel rim lo rgyus zhib 'jug la sman pa'i dpyad gzhi mang po thon thub snyam pa/ gsum pa/ rde'u'i rtsis gzhung sarga brgyad la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long skor la dpyad pa'i rtsom yig le tshan de dag nang bod kyi thun 2

gling gzhi/mong ma yin pa'i dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rigs ba'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba de'i brtsi thabs deng skabs la bltas na bya ba dngos kyi nang phan 'bras mi thon pa lo rgyus kyi gnas tshal zhig tu nges kyang / bod la than mong ma yin pa'i dmi mi niri midapal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rig gzhung ma lag cha tshang ba yod pa de'i cha shas kyi brtsi stangs 'bru tsam gshor 'jal gyi phul man dang sha mar 'degs skabs spor man sogs cha phra ba'i gnas kyi brtsi tshul khyad par ba cha phran zhes pa'i re'u mig cha tshang ba yod pa'i cha shas skabs rdog ma zhes 'bru rdog la go dgos pa lta bu brgya dang nyi shu re nang dang phyi/ de'i phyi sogs gnas drug tu gsil ba'i cha shas kyi thob 'bor tha ma cha shas 2985985000000la gsil thub pa go bder bshad na 'bru rigs la ltos na phul cha dung phyur nyi khri dgu stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu nga dgu dang bye ba brgyad sa ya bzhi'i char gsil thub pa lag thog len rgyu yod pa'i bca' gang yang med mod/ 'on kyang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi ngo nas bshad na zhib cha che ba de lta bu 'dzam gling gi dpal 'byor rtsis rig nang de 'dra ba gnyis pa med ces gleng chog pa lta bu dang /hril grangs la bltas na'ang dung phyur yan ther 'bum nas grangs med bar bcu gnas drug cu'i bar brtsi rgyu yod pa/ de bas mang bar cha bzhag na bye ba nas brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar grangs gnas chen po re res bsgyur bas grangs gnas brgya dang sum cu'i bar bsgyur rgyu yod pa'i thob grangs brtsi dka' ba deng skabase 'dzam gling spyi 'gros kyi brtsi srol dung phyur yan dung phyur brgya stong khri zhes dung phyur de dag gnas gcig tu brtsis nas ji tsam yod pa gleng ba'i 'gros dang bsdur na bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i cha shas gsil grangs dang / bka' mdo rgyud nas byung ba'i hril grangs brtsi ṭ+wāṃl

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de dag shin tu ngo mtshar can zhig tu mngon pa 'di dag kyang bod rig pa'i nor bu 'od stong 'bar ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ krung hwa mi rigs hril po'i nor bu 'od stong 'bar ba zhig yin pa ra 'phrod thub pa 'di dag gi lo rgyus mi mngon pa'i dbyings su yal bar dor ba shin tu phangs pa'i gnas tsam ma zad/mi rigs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug skabs dpyad gzhi'i rin thang chen po thon thub snyam pa/bzhi pa/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba'i nang du lnga pa chen po'i gser gdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus cung zhib par bkod yod pa'i nang don nas mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi rin thang la zhib 'jug bya rgyur dpyad gzhi mang po thon thub pa dper na gser gdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag thar gling rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen nang gsal bar gzhigs na skabs de'i 'bru dngul gyi thang gzhi'i thad 'bru'i gong thang ni 'bru gshor khal gang la dngul srang med zho med skar phyed drug tsam yin pa skabs der dngul srang gang gis 'bru gshor khal bco brgyad dang bre dgu nyo thub pa deng skabs kyi brtsi srol la cha bzhag na mi dmangs shog sgor gcig la bod srang nyi shu re brtsi bas mi dmangs shog sgor gcig gis 'bru gshor khal sum brgya bdun cu don brgyad nyo thub pa lta bu'i dpyad gzhi dang / gzhan yang bzo rigs kyi rnam grangs dang / de dag si 'tsho ba'i thob stangs/ 'dzugs skrun gyi las yun sogs sgo gang cir zhib 'jug bya rgyur dpyad gzhi nges can thon thub pa/lnga pa/ nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ni bod ljongs sman rtsis khang nas 'don gnang mdzad pa rtsis rig kun btus deb lnga yod 4

gling gzhi/pa'i deb dang po'i nang gi nag rtsis lo rgyus kyi dum bu de yin pa 'di'i nang nag rtsis lo rgyus dang / kong jo snga rjes kyis bod kyi rtsis rig la mdzad rjes ji ltar thon pa/ nag rtsis gzhung ji ltar chags pa'i lo rgyus sogs la dpyad gzhi'i rin thang chen po ldan pa snyam/drug pa/ bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes gtso bor bzung ba'i sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs la sogs pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod mang che ba bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal bod yig dus deb thog spel ba/ bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal bod yig rtsom sgrig khang gi bzhed dgongs bzhin gtso bor rtsom rig gi mdzad pa mngon gsal du byas pa de'i nang mkhas pa so so'i rtsom gshis dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par la dmigs bkar gyi dpyad brjod dang 'brel bar bod kyi rtsom rig bya bzhag dngos nang de dag gi legs cha len mkhas po dgos pa'i gros 'char bton yod par dpyad gzhi'i rin thang nges can ldan 'dug snyam pa/bdun pa/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab so so'i mjug bsdom don bsdus tshigs bcad khol du byung ba 'di ni gus pas lo mang ngal ba khyad du bsad de bstan 'gyur nang bzhugs pa rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing pod gnyis kyi 'grel pa cha tshang zhig brtsams pa de ni sngar phan dpag bsam 'khri shing la mkhas pas mchan 'grel gnang ba las brgyud rim ldan pa'i 'grel pa rtsom gnang mdzad med pa'i stong cha kha skong zhus pa ste/ mi ring bar mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun 'grems spel gnang rgyu de'i yal 'dab so so'i mjug bsdoms su gus pas 5

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/don bsdus tshigs bcad re brtsams yod pa 'di ni dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab brgya dang brgyad so so'i nang don gyi snying po dang / yal 'dab de dag sbyin sogs phar phyin drug sogs chos 'khor gang la gtogs pa mtshon thub pa'i dpyad rtsom tshigs bcad ma yin pa 'di dag bltas pa tsam gyis yal 'dab so so'i bstan bya'i snying po rtogs pa'i dpyad gzhi legs po thon thub pa bcas da lam gus pa'i ched rtsom phyogs bsgrigs skabs sngar gyi ched rtsom khag la yang bskyar zhib mor dpyad pa'i lta tshul klog pa po rnams la mtshams sbyor gyi tshul du zhus pa 'dir ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkhas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bzod gsol zhu rgyu dang / cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dpyad don mkha' grur zhugs nas blo gsar rig pa'i khye'u chung shes bya'i rgyal khams bskor ba'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba'i re smon dang bcas/nor brang o rgyan gyis lha sa rang shag nor bu khang gsar nas/spyi lo 2003lo'i zla 6tshes la/

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /ka shi'i ras mtshungs kha ba'i ris bres ga pur ltar bzang nga tsho'i bod ljongs 'idzam gling rgyan/ /rtsi rer yid la cha tshing mdzad pa ja byeng las sim nya rgyas zla ba srong btsan rje/ ༷/ta tha'i mdun-i du tha tshig bor bizhin da lta'i bojo yig na rer bskrun mkhas sam dzha ṭa/ /pa ṭa lashu mjes pha mes shubla bzhag ba gam slas lhag ma lus don ston e ma rmad/༷ /tsa ri bskor ltar tsha grang khyadṛ bsad dza ya'i ṛg gnas wa ler gsal mdzad mkhasi rnams dang / 0 /zhwa bzang ltor bkur za zir min pas 'a cag kun gyis ya bral bshes gnyen 0 bstod byas nas/ 0/ra yig gnyis t+pas la lung brgalo min sha rtsam zas kyis sa 'dir 'tsho ba'i lag dzos tsam/ /ha rtsing mang min skung yig rnam gzhag waṃ mes mkhas pa'i legs bshad 'dren phyiram̐ spro ba la/ 0zhes shis pa brjod pa'i me tog sil ma 'thor ba sngon du btang nas de yang 'dir gling chen lnga las grub pa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i yang steng du mngon par 'phags pa/ rab dkar kha ba'i lhun po brjid chags pas kun nas bres pa'i zhing mchog gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs zhes snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung la 'god pa 'dir gnas shing rgyu ba'i mi rigs ni las la hur zhing / dpa' ngar ldan la/ blo gros shes bya'i nor gyis phyug pa ni rang cag gi mthong chod du grub pa zhig lags/ 'di lta bu'i mi rigs thog ma 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byung ba nas rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod mu 1

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mtha' med pa byas pa brgyud ngo mtshar can gyi byas rjes dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba'i shes rig rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs lang long 'phyur ba ji bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba rnams ri mo'i gzugs su 'phos pa lo rgyus kyi deb ther nang bod kyi sa khams chags tshul dang / sa khams 'di nas mi'i 'gro ba ji ltar byung ba/ de rnams kyi nang nas kun gyis bkur bar 'os pa'i rgyal po gang zhig byung ba/ rig pa'i gnas gang dang gang zhig gsar gtod byas pa sogs dus yun shin tu ring ba'i lo rgyus phra rags da lta'i bar du gleng du yod la tshan rig gi thog nas kyang gnad don de tsho'i bden dpang thub pa'i gna' rdzas rig gnas dang / ngo mtshar can gyi 'dzugs skrun ji snyed cig skye bo kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa/ lhag par rang cag rnams kyis rgyun du gleng ba'i btsan po'i nang nas ches bsngags par 'os pa mes dbon rnam gsum gyi thog ma srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus su gang gi bka' la gnas shing / rang cag rnams kyis rtag tu drin dran pa dang / drin gzo dgos pa'i 'phrul blon thon mi sasto ṭa la da lta nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i bod yig 'di nyid gsar gtod gnang du bcug pas mtshon rlabs po che'i bya gzhag mang po 'du 'god mdzad pa dang / dus mtshungs skabs de'i cha rkyen dang bstun nas mi rigs gzhan gyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas len par 'os pa mtha' dag blangs nas rang rigs kyi rigs gzhung phun sum je tshogs su btang ste bod kyi rig gnas dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor sgo kun nas 'phel rgyas kyi dus mtshams gsar pa zhig tu slebs par mdzad pas mtshon nga tsho'i mes po bka' drin can tsho'i blo gros las byung ba'i bod kyi rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi nang don rgya che tshad dang / gting zab tshad 2

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /la bod rigs rang nyid smos ci/ spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang / tha na phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs mang pos kyang yid smon dang / tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog byas te deng gi dus su zhib 'jug gi tshan pa mang po btsugs yod pa blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams kyi dgongs par mnga' gsal ltar yin/'o na de lta bu'i rigs gzhung khong du chud pa dang / zhib phra'i gnad don la tshan rig gi sgo nas zhib 'jug byed pa'i rmang gzhi gang nas 'dzugs dgos she na/ de ni bod yig 'bri klog nas 'go btsugs te bod kyi brda dag la byang cha dod pa dang / de nas rim bzhin rang nyid gang la mos pa'i rigs gzhung gi rnam grangs gang dang gang gi rtsa ba rang la 'bad pa chen pos don gnyer byas na gzhi nas rang la dgos pa'i rig pa de rnyed thub/ lhag par bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus dang / rig gnas la slob sbyong dang / zhib 'jug byed dgos na 'brel yod yig rigs gzhan dag la dpyad bsdur bya rgyu gal che yangaka ches gtso bor gyur pa ni gzhi rtsa'i bod yig dpe rnying la blta ba dang / de'i nang nas dka' gnad 'tshol ba/ gnad don thag gcod yong ba bya rgyu de bas gal che ba los yin/ rgyu mtshan der brten bod yig dpe rnying blta klog gis de tsho'i nang nas rang la dgos pa'i yon tan len dgos mod/ da lta'i dus kyi rang rigs gzhon nu tshor bltas na de ni stabs bde po'i las ka zhig ga la yin/ dpe rnying nang brda rnying mang ba dang / tshig sbyor gyi 'gros kyang deng dang mi mthun pa/ lhag par gal che ba'i dpe rnying bris ma de tsho'i nang skung yig mang po spyad yod pa de tsho rig gnas kyi chu tshad mtho tsam med na klog kyang mi thab pas go ba ji bzhin lon mi thab pa smos ci riris ra tsho dgos/ 3

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gna' rabs bod yig glegs bam thog nas don gang la yi ge che chung gang dang / yig gzugs gang 'bri dgos pa/ glegs bam gyi dbyibs dang / zhing khams ji ltar yin pa/ bam tshad dang / bam grangs ji ltar yin pa sogs gnad don rer zhib phra'i rgyu mtshan gleng du yod kyang re zhig btang snyoms byas te skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni/ nga tsho bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun las ka'i nang rtag tu 'phrad pa'i gnad don zhig ste skung yig skor da phan mkhas pa tshos thugs snang de tsam mi che mod/ gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus dang / rig gnas la dpyad pa gnang mkhan rang rigs gzhon nu tshor sman pa'i ched dang bcas bod yig dpe rnying nang gi skung yig gi gnad don thad 'byung 'gyur mkhas pa tsho'i rin thang bral ba'i slob ston dang / legs bshad kyi dga' ston spyan 'dren phyir thog ma'i dpyad pa zhig zhu ba la/don tshan dang po/ ci 'dra zhig la skung yig zer/de yang yul gru so so'i skad kyi dbang gis skung yig dang / sbas yigabasdus yig ces pa'i ming 'bod lugs gsum tsam byung ba ma zad/ mdo khams khul kaḥthog yig log ces bya bar yang 'bod/ don du ming tshig yi ge'i 'bru'am tshig cha tshang / yang na cha shas bsdus pa'i don la go ba gcig mtshungs red/ skabs 'dir skung dang / sbas gnyis don gcig dang /bsdus ni gzhan zhig yin pa lta bur go mi rung / skung dang / sbas kyang ngo bo'i thog nas bshad na bsdus pa'i don te skabs de'i ming dang bya tshig sogs yod pa yig tshogs nyung ba'i ched du bsdus te mngon par byas pa dang /4

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /bsdus pa yang brjod don der thob pa'i yi ge gang zhig skabs thob dgos pa'i dbang gis yig gzugs bsdus pa'i khongs su 'du ba dang / de bzhin yig log ces bya ba yang log skad kyi don dang mtshungs pa de la 'dris pa'i mis ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi shes pa'i don lags/ dper na/gcig 'bru cha shas skung pa'am/ bsdus pa/ yin pa'i phyir la skung yigo‘yiri’’lta bur mtshon na/ tshig dang po'i yin gyi rjes 'jug‘‘na’’bsdus/gnyis pa'i pa mtha' med dang 'brel sgra'i‘‘'i ’yi ming gzhi‘‘'a’’bsdus/dbyangs dang po phyogs mthun la zhugs/ gsum pa'i gzhi dang / 'dogs ya btags dang bcas pa‘‘phya’’bsdus/ dbyangs‘tshi’dang rjes 'jug‘‘ra’’dngos su bkod pas skung don mtshon pa lta bu/gnyis/ tshig cha tshang bsdus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lo‘de pa’’zhes bar gyi‘bzhin gshegs’tshig 'bru gnyis cha tshang bsdus pa lta bu/gsum/ 'bru cha shas bsdus pa/ lha tshogs lo‘lhoḍo’lta bu tshogs kyi‘‘tsho’tsha lag ste cha shas kyis tshab byas/ rjes yang 'jug ga ma sa skyog gis byas pa lta bu/bzhi/ tshig cha shas bsdus pa de yang 'bru bsdus pa las grub mod/ 'bru cha tshang bsdus pa las dgar ched tshig gi 'bru ma tshang ba der tshig cha shas bsdus pa'i tha snyad btags pa rten 'brel lo‘rtel’’lta bur mtshon na/ tshig dang po'i rjes 'jug‘‘na’ ma tshang ba/ gnyis pa'i 'phul gzhi 'dogs bcas‘‘'bra’’ma tshang ba'i skung yig de lta bu tshig cha shas bsdus par brtsis pa yin/yang / rkang pa skung pa'am/ tshig 'phro gong 'og 'dra mtshungs bsdus par bsdus rtags kur rtags kyis mtshon par byas pa yang skung yig gi khongs 5

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/su bzhag pa/ dper na/ rje tsong kha pas/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed/ /rje btsun bla mas nyams len de ltar mdzad/ /thar 'dod bdag kyang de bzhin bskyangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i gsham gyi tshig rkang gnyis po gsung rtsom de'i dum bu tshang mar yod pa re re bzhin ma bris pa/ rje btsun ྾ ྾ zhes kur rtags kyis bsdu ba/ skabs 'gar mgur ma'i nang sho lo ka yang kur rtags kyis bsdu rung la/ rkang pa'i 'go bton nas mjug rtags kyis bsdu rung ba/ dper na/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi mgur glu'i nang / rje 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /dpal ldan phag gru'i bka' rgyud la gsol ba rang 'debs so/ / mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes rang zungs dang / zhes lta bu phag gru sde srid kyi bya gzhag dum bu re slob ston gyi tshul du gdams pa'i mjug rje 'gro ba'i ྾dpal ldan phag gru'i྾ mos pa'i bu la ྾ lta bu'i tshig 'phro bsdu ba dang rigs bsgre'o/don tshan gnyis pa/ skung yig sus gsar gtod byas sam/bod yig dpe rnying lag bris ma'i nang skung yig tshad gzhi 'dra min ma gtogs phal cher med mi srid pa tsam yin/ de lta bu dpe rnying nang cung khyab gdal du spyod pa'i skung yig 'byung stangs la dpyad na/ da lta'i bod yig 6

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /'di gsar gtod gnang ba nas bzung rim bzhin spyi tshogs thog khyab gdal du song ba dang / 'bri klog nang byan chud pa'i mi 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi nges can zhig dang / slob dpon mkhas pa tsho'i gsung bshad gal che'i rigs slob mas zin bris 'god skabs gsung bshad tshim lus mi yong ched mgyogs 'bri dgos pa/ bka' bstan bcos glegs bam thog 'bri bshu bya rgyu cung khyab gdal song ba'i dgos mkho bcas dang bstun te bod yig 'bri klog byang cha thon pa'i mkhas pa tshos yig zor yang ba dang / dus tshod brtson len/glegs bam thog nang don shong tshad che ba sogs ngal gron gyi phan cha 'ga'i ngor rim bzhin gsar gtod dang / spyi tshogs thog khyab gdal song ba zhig las ched gnyer gyi mkhas pa che ge mo zhig gis mdzad pa nges bzung bya rgyu med snyam/don tshan gsum pa/ skung yig byung ba'i dus tshod/gnad don 'di'i thad kha tshon gcod thub pa'i sdom tshig gtsang ma zhig da lta zhu mi shes kyang / da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs la gzhigs na skung yig thog ma'i 'bri srol ni da lta'i bod yig gsar gtod gnang ba nas mi ring bar byung bar mngon/ btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus su srid gzhung gi gal che'i gzhung yig la skung yig bkod na yang lta klog byed mkhan tshos skung pa'i tshig don rgya khyab tu rtogs pa'i tshad la slebs te gal che'i gzhung yig rdo ring lta bu la'ang 'god pa'i srol byung 'dug dper na/ spyi lo 744lo tsam la btsugs par grags pa'i khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dmag don thog byas rjes bzhag pa'i blon po stag sgra klu khong la gzengs bstod pa'i rdo ring ste‘‘zhol 7

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rdo ring phyi ma’’yi byang ngos yig phreng 49par‘‘sde cha gudu mi spo' myi bsgyur ba gnang ngo’’zhes dang / shar ngos kyi yig phreng brgyad par‘‘nyamasu blangs’ zhes dang / lho ngos kyi phreng 38par‘‘chab srid chen po mdza’’ces dang / phreng 71par‘‘srid phugasu’’zhes gud du/ nyams su/ phugs su/ mdzad ces pa'i tshig bzhi por skung yig spyad pa bcas rdo ring gi ngos gsum gar skung yig mthong rgyu yod pa dang / de bzhin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun byas pa/ bgrang bya chig stong brgal ba'i gong bris par grags pa/ (tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus〉 yig cha yi don chen gnad bsdus lo tshigs kyi shog ngos dang po kho nar/ mgar stong btsan yul bzung gis spyan drangs te bod yul du gshegaso/ zhang zhung cad 'bangasu bkug ste mnga'o/ btsan po khri srong tsan dgung du gshegaso/ phagi lo la bab ste zhes drangs te/ gshegs so/'bangs su/ mnga' 'o/ phag gi zhes pa'i tshig dag skung yig spyad 'dug pa lta bu yig cha de'i nang ha cang mang ba bcas rdo ring dang / tun hong gi yig rnying de tsho'i skung yig gi thog nas mthong thub pa ni/ skabs de tsho'i skung yig ni/ chig skung dang / nyis skung lta bu yin la de la spyir btang rnam dbye dang / 'phrad sogs bltas pa tsam gyi don rtogs thub pa de tsho'i gras las/tsheg khyim gcig nang sum skung dang / bzhi skung lta bu yas mas kyi tshig grogs la bltas na gzhi nas shes thub pa'i skung yig dka' ba'i gras de 'dra min pa dang / 'ga' zhig steng 'og brtsegs pa lta bu'o/gzhan yang mi lo nyis stong brgal ba'i gong gi nga tsho'i mes po bka' drin can tsho'i gsar rnyed chen po skar rtsis rig par mtshon na'ang bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu pa pu de gung rgyal skabs zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / lcags 8

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /zangs dngul sogs kyi gter rdo bzhu sbyangs sogs zhing 'brog thon skyed dang /bzo las gong 'phel chen po byung ba de'i tshe lha sa'i lho rgyud yar lung sa khul du rgan mo bal ma'i zla rtsis zhes nyi zla'i bgrod pa dang / dus bzhi mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyi gnas lugs shes thub pa byung ba yig lam nang gsal por 'khod pa ma zad/ da dung de bas snga ba'i dus la dpyad na'ang gnya' khri btsan po'i dus byung ba'i shes pa can mi bcu gnyis su grags pa'i nang du yang rtsis la mkhas pa'i shes pa can yod par grags pas bod rang gi thun mong min pa'i gnam dpyad skar rtsis rig pa'i thog rgya gar nas dar ba'i dus 'khor dang /rgya nag nas dar ba'i rgya rtsis/ bal yul nas dar ba'i ka ra myong rtsis sogs yul gru du ma'i skar rtsis rig pa'i nying khu du ma gcig tu btus pa las grub pa rim bzhin bod rang gi thun mong min pa'i skar rtsis rig pa ma lag cha tshang can du gyur ba/ lag len dngos kyi nang nas mi'i lus po'i bde thang dang /zhing 'brog thon skyed gong 'phel la med du mi rung ba/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin ches che ba lag len mang po'i nang nas ra sprod thub pa bod kyi le thor yang ches snga ba'i dus nas skung yig 'god srol byung lugs mi lo lnga brgya'i gong gi le tho spyan lam du chub pa'i mkhas pa'i gsung las thos pa de'i thog nas mi lo lnga brgya'i gong skung yig 'phel rgyas chen por song ba rgya khyab zhing 'brog ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis kyang rtogs pa'i tshad la slebs pa dang le tho'i re'u mig chung chung nang blang dang dor bya'i nang don mang po 'bri dgos pa shong tshad che ba de'i lag len da lta yang rgyun mthud du spyod mus lags/de ltar skung yig ni da lta'i bod yig byung ba nas mi ring bar dar ba dang / de nas dus rabs bco lnga pa'i 'go bar rim bzhin khyab gdal dang /9

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dus rim yin 'dra ba/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dkyil bod la shing dpar dar ba nas rim bzhin skung yig nyams 'go tshugs pa'i dus la slebs pa ma zad/ deng dus la mtshon na khams khul sogs su chos spyod ngag 'don dgos rigs dbu med lag bris ma spyod khyab che bar skung yig 'bri srol nyams med gnas pa las dbus gtsang khul rgyun spyod yi ge'i nang de sngon 'bri srol yod pa'i stabs bde'i skung yig 'ga' zhig tsam ma gtogs/mang che ba ha lam 'bri rgyun chad pa'i tshad la slebs yod/ de yang dus rabs bco lnga pa ste rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag(1410)lor tā ming gong ma yung los nang blon tha'i hon shin bod la mngags te bod nas bka' bstan 'gyur gdan drangs nas nan cin du bka' 'gyur dpar skrun byas pa'i par phud ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de nas bod du mtshur phu karma pa dang / rje tsong kha par 'tshams rten du phul ba de ni bka' 'gyur shing par thog brko ba'i thog ma dang / de nas bod du shing par thog dpe cha mang po dpar skrun byed pa'i sgo phye thub pa/ shing par brko ba'i lag rtsal ha cang dar rgyas dang / gong mthor song bas bka' bstan bcos mang po shing par thog brkos te bod rigs sa khul rgya khyab lta bur 'grems spel byed thub pa des lag bris kho nar brten nas glegs bam bzheng rgyu'i dka' ngal dang dgos pa rang shugs su chung du song /dus rabs bco lnga pa'i spyi lo 1418rab byung bdun pa'i sa khyi lor rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde phyag btab pa dang / lcags phag(1431)lo nas bzung rgyal rtse dpal chos khongs su gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur dang / skya chos kyi bstan 'gyur lag 10

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /bris ma bzheng rgyu'i mchod rtsa rgyun 'dzugs gnang bar brten dmangs gtso'i bcos 'gyur ma byas bar bka' 'gyur skya chos bzheng rgyu bar ma chad pa dang /tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang / paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyis bka' bstan dang / de min gsung rab gser bris bzhengs gnang tsam ma gtogs bar skabs bka' bstan lag bris bya rgyu'i tshab de par mas byas pa dang / de min gyi gsung rab lag bris ma'i glegs bam bzheng rgyu yang sngar las nyung du song bar brten shugs ma thub kyis skung yig spyod sgo rim bzhin je nyung la song ba/ lhag par du deng dus 'phrul chas kyi dpe skrun lag rtsal khyab gdal song bas gsung rab lag bris ma'i glegs bam bzheng rgyu lta ci/ shing par gsar du brko rgyu yang de tsam dar mi che ba'i skabs 'di 'drar skung yig ni spyod sgo mi che bas da lta dbu can dbu med gcig mtshungs su spyod mus/ ‘‘r+ghaṃ ’ ‘‘soḍo’‘‘leḍo’lta bu dang / dbu med kho nar bkol ba/ ‘‘bkris’ ‘‘bkrin’’‘‘thed’’ ‘‘gaphrung ’ ‘‘lhab ’lta bu nyung shas las mang che ba rtsa ba'i cha nas 'bri rgyun nyams pa ma zad/ skung yig yod pa'i dpe rnying lag bris ma yang ha cang dkon pa bcas nus shugs yod tshad bton te da lta lhag yod pa'i dpe rnying lag bris ma nyung shas de dag myur skyob byed dgos pa'i tshad la slebs pa bcas skung yig dar ba dang / 'phel rgyas/ mthar nyams pa'i brgyud rim rags pa de tsam yin snyam/11

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/don tshan bzhi pa/ skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /skung yig la da phan rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yod med las 'phros te skabs 'di'i bstan bya gtso bo skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu'i skor/gnad don 'di'i thad/ kho bo lta bu mthong rgya dang / thos rgya chung bas da phan skung yig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dngos mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa lta ci/ de lta yod pa'ang rna ba'i lam du lhongs pa zhig ma byung mod/ 'on te/ ‘‘ma mthong phyir na med pa min rkegasungs pa ltar da phan rigs pa'i gzhung lugs byung myong rtsa ba nas med ces zhu mi 'tshal yang / sngar slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis skung yig klog thabs tshig bcad kyi lam du drangs pa‘‘yod la ḍa dang med la ṇa/ lta bu shog grangs mang po rang med pa brtsams myong yod pa de dag rang gi bu slob gzhon nu tshor ngag la 'dzin du 'jug pa'i srol byung lugs mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig gi gsung las thos shing / 'on kyang de ni skung yig grub zin pa ji ltar 'bri klog byed pa'i phyogs bsdoms shig las/skung yig sgrub lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig tu brtsi mi rung /dper na/ bka' rtsom de'i nang‘‘yod la ḍa dang med la ṇa lta bu sgra gzhung dang 'brel ba ma byas tshe bod rang gi skad la yod med dang 'brel ba med pa da na log pa‘‘ḍa ṇa ’gnyis kyis yod med mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin ma gleng ba'i phyir dang / mtshams re da log pa‘‘ḍo’yig bdag la 'jug pa'i skabs yod pa/ ming gzhi'i rjes la sbyar na ga sa rjes yang 'jug tu 'gro ba de yang 'bri rgyun lam byang bcas da phan skung yig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs ma byung ba'i 12

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /rgyu rkyen la dpyad na lam tsam 'di 'dra zhig mngon thub pa ste/ skung yig 'di yang rig pa'i gnas kyi 'phel rim spyi dang mtshungs pa thog mar lag len byung ba dang / de dag tshad gzhi nges can zhig tu slebs dus lag len de dag la brten nas rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba 'byung ba ltar bod kyi skung yig la mtshon na'ang lag len snga sa nas byung bas ma tshad/ de dag 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi mtho por son par gzhigs na skung yig la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig kyang nges par yong dgos mod/ 'on kyang da phan skung yig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba ma byung ba de ni gtso bor sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis nangs kyi dus skung yig gi yongs khyab rang bzhin dang / kun gyis rtogs thub par dgongs te skung yig la ched du rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig ma byung na mi 'grig pa'i gsang ba dang / dka' gnad ma mngon pa'i dbang gis rim pa rim par bag la zha ba zhig las skung yig la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bzo mi thub pa dang / bzo mi dgos pa ga la yin/ de yang gsal por bshad na gtso bor skung yig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi lag len cha tshang ba yod rung / rkyen de dag dka' ba'i gnas su ma mthong bas mkhas pa tsho'i dgongs pa'i gtad gzhir ma gyur pa der thug 'on kyang deng dus la cha mtshon na skung yig 'bri rgyun stongs la nye ba/ skung yig ni gsang ba'i nang gi yang gsang gi gnas skabs 'di lta bur nges par skung yig ji ltar 'bri ba dang / klog pa po'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dgos mkho ni sngar bas brgya 'gyur 'bum 'gyur gyis che ru song ba phyi rol yul gyis thag bcad pa zhig tu 'khums/rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod min/ /13

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te/ /de phyir gzhan don bsam pa'ang bdag la med/ /rang gi yid la bsgoms phyir ngas 'di brtsams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon chad ma byung ba'i gzhung lugs tshad mar 'dzin 'os pa zhig gsar du gleng ba'i spobs pa kho bor ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang 'di ni rang nyid kyi phrag par babs pa'i las 'gan bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob dpe skrun gyi bya gzhag nang rtag par 'phrad pa'i gnad don zhig yin stabs kha ba mgo thog tu babs dus sbad mgos dkrug dkrug mi gtong ka med kyi dpe bzhin skung yig sgrub stangs skor dpyad dgos pa de yang g.yol thabs gtan nas med pa'i 'os 'gan zhig tu mthong ba ma zad/ bod kyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas kyi rnam grangs su brtsi chog pa'i skung yig 'di chu lha'i phang par gzhol la nye ba phangs pa'i gnas bcas skabs 'dir kho bos mi shes shes mdog gis spyi brtol bskyed de skung yig gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya'am/ rnam gzhag chung ngu zhig gleng ba la zhugs so/ /de yang skung yig la dbye na drug skung yig gi mtshan nyid dang /dbye ba/ grub cha/ bsgrub gzhi/ thabs shes/ klog stangs bcas so/dang po/ mtshan nyid ni/ zur dang / rtags la brten nas brjod don shugs kyis ston nus pa skung yig gi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa/ rnam par dbye ba la gsum ste/ sla ba dang / dka' ba/dmigs bsal can bcas gsum so/ /de yang spyir btang nas bshad na/ gzhung chen po lnga'i gras ma yin pa'i bstan bcos nang bris pa ni rtogs sla ba'i skung yig dang / gzhung chen po lnga'i nang bris pa ni dka' ba'i skung yig yin/ dmigs bsal can ni/ lha 14

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /dang / mi'i bsdus ming skung yig gi khongs su bzhag pa de'i 'gros ni/ skung pa gang zhig brjod bde dang bstun dgos pa'i phyir de'i spyi 'gros ni skung yig gzhan dang mthun pa'i phyogs mang la mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyang gnas pa zhig ste/ de la dbye ba 'ga' yod pa gsham du mtshon dpe brjod pa'i skabs zhib cha gleng rgyur skabs 'dir dmigs bsal can gyi skung yig ces pa'i tha snyad btags/gsum pa/ skung yig gi grub cha la dbye na lnga ste/ nga ro rjes mthun/ dbyangs gsal rjes mthun/ dbyibs rjes mthun/ sgra'i bstan bcos nas rgyas bkab pa/ snga phyi'i 'gros kyis don de kho nar nges bzung chog pa bcas la nges pa'i grub cha de rnams skung yig nang dngos su mtshon tshul bsgrub gzhi'i skabs kyi dbye ba khag nas gsal por rtogs nus pas skabs 'dir rgyas bshad ma dgos pa byas/bzhi pa/ skung yig bskub gzhi'i skor/ bod kyi brda dag ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i khyad chos gzhir byas nas bsgrubs pa zhig yin/de la dbye na/ 'dra ba bzhi dang / tshab gsum/ brtsegs dbyung rigs bsgre gsum bcas dbye ba bcu yod/'dra ba bzhi ni/gcig dbyangs 'dra ba/ tsheg khyim gcig nang gi tshig dang po dang phyi ma'i dbyangs gcig mtshungs byas te phyi ma'i tshig nas 'bru 'ga' skung pa/‘‘dze+el’ rten 'brel lta bu/gnyis/ gsal byed 'dra ba la nang gses bzhi yod/ 1 tsheg khyim gcig gi tshig dang gnyis kyi ming gzhi 'dra ba‘‘saumi’so so lta bu/ 2 rjes 'jug dang 15

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phyi ma'i ming gzhi 'dra ba/ ‘‘gzhonu’ gzhon nu lta bu/ 3 dang po'i rjes 'jug dang phyi ma'i 'phul 'dra ba‘‘namakha'’’nam mkha' lta bu/ 4 dang po'i rjes 'jug dang phyi ma'i mgo can 'dra ba‘‘skaldan ’skal ldan lta bu'o/gsum/ nga ro 'dra ba/ ang yig gcig nas bzhi bar‘‘1 2 3 4’’ji ltar klog dgos pa'i nga ro dang rjes su mthun pa mtshon par byas pa dper na/ gcig cig zhig shig la‘‘1’’lta bu dang / gnyis nyis la‘‘2’’lta bu/gsum sum la‘‘3’’lta bu/ bzhi bzhi lo‘4 milta bu/bzhi/ dbyibs 'dra ba la nang gses bzhi yod/ 1 thugs lo‘rgya’’/lugs la‘‘l+yamimi/ gzugs lo‘gabu'i’lta bu la btags kyis zhabs kyu dang / ga sa rjes yang 'jug dang bcas pa'i mtshon don du byas pa'i skung yig ni/skad gdangs mtshon byed yi ge'i dbyibs la brten nas byung ba'i skung yig cig yin snyam/ dper na/ ya btags kyi rkang pa mar brkyang ba‘‘(’’'di dbu chung gi zhabs kyu dang ha cang mthun/ ya btags kyi rkang pa yar bskum pa ‘‘)mi’'di ga ma sa kyog‘‘ḍo’ga phyi slog pa dang ha lam 'dra ba de gnyis 'dus pas ya btags kyi dbyibaspu‘ mi’dang 'dra ba zhig chags pa de la brten nas thugs dang / lugs/ gzugs sogs rgyun gtan yi ge 'bri skabs mang po 'phrad pa de tsho zor yang du gtong ched zhabs kyu dang / ga sa rjes yang 'jug gi mtshon rtags ya btags ming gzhir btags par mngon/ 2 gsungs la ‘‘gsu’’lta bu ya btags spyad pa yang sngon ma'i 'gros ltar ga ma sa kyog gi‘‘ḍo’yig chung ngur byas pas‘‘nga’’yig tu 'gyur 'gro ba de zhabs kyu dang bcas pa'i rjes 'jug nga'i mtshon rtags su ming gzhir btags pa yang gong dang mtshungs/3 rtags la‘‘rtu’’gshegs la‘‘g.yī’’lta bu ya btags kyis ga ma sa kyog gi tshab 16

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /byas pa yang‘‘ḍomiyig ga phyi slog pa ming gzhi'i rkang par btags pas ya btags kyi dbyibs dang cha 'dra ba'i gnas lugs gong dang mtshungs/4 'phags lo‘'phya’’dang / tshogs la‘‘phyo lta bu yang ga ma sa kyog ga phyi slog pa ming gzhir 'doḍa skabs‘ḍo’yig gi dbyibs la 'gyur ba cung zad btang ste ga ma sa kyog gi skung yig tu byas pa gong dang mtshungs shing / 'o na 'di dang gong gi thugs sogs kyi skung yig gi mtshon tshul mi 'dra ba ste/ gsal por bshad na zhabs kyu mtshon mi mtshon gyi khyad par ci zhe na/ de ni bod kyi brda sprod nang 'jug pa yod med dang / rgyun gtan yi ge 'bri skabs de lta bu 'phrad che chung dbang gis khyad par byas par mngon/ dper na‘‘'phuḍo’zhes pa'i tshig 'di 'dra brda dag nang mthong rgyu med pa dang / tshugs lta bu yod rung / rgyun gtan yi ge'i nang 'phrad nyung rkyen gyis 'di lta'i rigs la ya btags kyis ga ma sa kyog kho na las/ zhabs kyu dang bcas pa'i ga ma sa kyog mi mtshon par byas pa yin snyam/da dung do snang byed dgos pa zhig ni gna' rabs dpe rnying nang gong du bshad zin pa 'di lta'i skung yig bris par yang 'jug thob dang mi thob kyi dbye ba byas med pa yang blo la gsal por nges dgos pa de yin/gong gsal dbyibs 'dra ba'i skung yig grub lugs skor/ nga tsho'i blo sgo 'byed nus pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig zhu na/ 1985lor krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi mtshan 'dzin yon krang / bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon chen mo mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis bod kyi dkar chag rig pa gsar gtod gnang ba de dag slob khrid mdzad pa'i dkar chag gi ka tho'am/ ang 17

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rim 'god lugs gsungs skabs bod kyi ang ki'i gzugs 'byung stangs thog ma mi'i mgo bor gnas pa'i dbang po lnga'i dbyibs sogs la brten nas bzos pa'i skor bod yig dpe rnying nang gsal por 'khod yod pa red ces khong sku ngo mas mngon par gsal ba'i re kha dang bcas pa'i dpe dbyibs 'di ltar/ 1 spyi gtsug mtshog ma/ 2 spyi gtsug de la dpral ba'i sgor dbyibs 'then pa/ 3 gong der mig gi dbyibs 'then pa/ 4 rna ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/5 sna khug gi dbyibs 'dra ba/ 6 mchu to'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ 7 ma le'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ 8 ske'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ 9 pho mtshan gyi dbyibs 'dra ba/0mgo bo hril po'i dbyibs 'dra ba bcas zer srol yod lugs slob ston gnang ba ltar bod kyi ang ki'i gzugs grub stangs dang / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal(bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud〉 kyi le'u gsum pa/ lus kyi 'dra dpe bstan pa'i nang / mi'i lus kyi sgrom gzhi sha pags rtsa rus chu rgyus sogs phyi nang snod kyi bkod pa rgyal po'i pho brang gi grub cha'i tshul du bstan pa dang / nang gi bcud don lnga snod drug ni rgyal po dang / de la bltas pa'i nang blon/ sras/ btsun mo/ bang mdzod sogs 'khor dang nang rdzas gal che chung gi dbye ba'i sgo nas bstan pa/ gzhung du/ snying ni rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ glo ba ma lnga nang gi blon po 'dra/ glo ba bu lnga rgyal po'i sras dang 'dra/ mchin mtsher gnyis ni btsun mo che chung 'dra/ mkhal ma phyi blon gyad pa gdung 'degs 'dra/ bsam se'u ni nor gyi bang mdzod 'dra/ pho ba g.yos bcu byed pa'i khog ma 'dra/ rgyu ma long kha btsun mo'i g.yog dang 'dra/mkhris pa sdor gyi rkyal pa bkal ba 'dra/ sgang phug chu yis rdza ma bkang ba 'dra/18

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /zhes mi'i tshe srog gi rag las sa don lnga'i nang gi snying de rgyal por cha bzhagargyal srid gcig la bltas na rgyal khams de'i mnga' thang dar gud rgyal po de'i rjes su 'gro bar rtsis pa dang / gzhan rnams ni de la brten pa'i 'khor dang /longs spyod kyi tshul du bstan pas nad kyi gnyen po brten skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gtso phal gyi rnam dbye ha cang gsal ba/ yang gzhung de nyid las/lag pa gnyis ni dar dpyang btags pa 'dra/ zhes tshe srog la bltas na lag pa gnyis ka med na'ang rgyal po'i pho brang gi dar btags chad pa lta bu mdzes cha'i gnad don tsam las don la srog gi nyes skyon chags mi thub pa sogs 'dra dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa/ lhag par bod yig rang la bltas na'ang dbu chung 'bri skabs sprul sku lta bu'i‘‘sprul’migyi yi ger bltas na sa mgo pa lag gis mtshon pa dang / ra btags dang zhabs kyu dkyus gcig tu sbrel bas zhabs kyu'i dbyibs ma zhig pa las ra btags kyi dbyibs mda' rtse‘‘〈 ’lta bu zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs‘‘)’mil gyur pa de dang mtshungs par ya btags kyis zhabs kyu ga sa'i rjes yang 'jug dang bcas pa mtshon skabs kyang zhabs kyu'i dbyibs ma zhig pa'i khar ga ma sa kyog ldog dang ma ldog gang ltar na'ang de'i mtshon don du zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs‘)’misam yang na thong pa'i dbyibs‘〉’’lta bu zhig sbyar te ya btags su grub pa gang zhig dbyibs 'dra ba'i skung yig gi mtshon don du byas pa red ces bshad kyang 'gal ba med snyam pa bcas nga tsho'i mes po tshos spyi dang bye brag gi rig gnas thog ma gsar skrun gnang skabs phyogs mang po'i dpe don gyis gnas lugs dngos gsal bar mdzad pa ni gson nyams dod la/ nang don gting zab pa/ go ba ji tsam blangs pa de tsam gyis gting dpag dka' ba bcas kyi don dngos de tsho yang dbyibs la brten 19

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nas skung yig byung bar bsam blo gtong rgyu'i dpyad gzhi rin thang dang bral ba zhig yin no//da lam kho bos mtshon byed yi ge'i dbyibs la brten nas grub 'dra ba skung yig 'di'i skor da dung legs par dpyad de sdom tshig bzo thub pa'i ched du da lam tshod bshad zhus pa zhig las/ da lta gtan la 'khel ba'i sdom tshig bzhag pa zhig min/ tshan rig zhib 'jug gi spyi'i 'gros la bltas na dngos po 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang / dngos po'i ngo bor dpyod skabs 'ga' zhig la 'di dang de'i sdom tshig stabs bde por 'jog thub pa dang / 'ga' zhig la sdom tshig bzo rgyu gnas skabs gdeng spobs med pa'i gnas tshul 'og thog mar 'char snang dang / tshod bshad byas pa brgyud gzhi nas lag len dngos kyi nang nas tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sdom tshig bzo dgos pa ni brgyud dgos nges kyi go rim yin/ gal srid de lta bu'i 'char snang dang / tshod bshad ma brgyud par smyug gu g.yugs thengs gcig la cha tshang ba'i sdom tshig bzo mi thub la/ de ltar bzo dgos pa'i re 'dun yang 'don rgyu med/ yang gnad don 'ga' zhig gi ngo bo yang snying ji ltar yin pa'i skor zhib 'jug dgos nges kyang / rang gis de'i gnas lugs gnas skabs kha tshon gcod dka' ba'i rigs blo rgya ma bskyed par ca sing la 'dzem ste song zhig song zhig rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song zhig ces bgegs bskrod byed pa dang 'dra ba skyur 'jog bya rgyu 'os su mi che bar mthong ba des na mtshon byed yi ge'i dbyibs la brten nas grub 'dra ba'i skung yig gi skor 'di yang 'byung 'gyur lag len dngos nang brtag dpyad kyis sdom tshig 'jog thub pa'i sa bon tsam du bris lags pa 'di la nges bzung gnang dgos pa ni ga la zhig20

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /tshab gsum ni/1 mgo 'dogs kyis phyi ma'i ming gzhi'i tshab byas pa ma rig la‘‘rmig’’yan lag 'as‘yag milta bu/2 cha shas kyis hril po'i tshab byas pa gang zag 'as‘gag’’ rgya mtsho la ‘‘rgyomi’lta bu/3 bsdus rtags kyis tshigs bcad skabs tshig dang / rkang pa'i tshab byas pa(lhug pa'ang 'tshud)bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ sangs rgyas la྾ chos la ྾ dge 'dun la྾ lta bu'o//brtsegs dbyung rigs bsgre gsum ni/1 yi ge brtsegs pa yon tan lo‘ston’’lta bu/2 dbyung ba ni/ bar tsheg kho na dbyung ba mya ngan lo‘myangan’’lta bu/3 rigs bsgre ni/ sgra'i bstan bcos nas byung ba'i rigs lam la rigs bsgre byas pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la bdago‘ṇa ’rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu ni/ sgra'i nadzo‘na’’dgag sgrar 'gro ba'i skabs yod par rigs bsgre byas pa lta bu/gong gsal gnad don gzhan rnams ni spyir btang rtogs sla bas skabs 'dir rgyas bshad ma dgos pa byas shing / gnad don mtha' ma sgra la rigs bsgre byas pa cung rtogs dka' bas de'i skor cung zad spro na/ de la dbye na khag gsum yod/1 skung yig nang yod la ḍa zhes da log pa‘‘ḍami’yig yod pa'i mtshon don du bzhag pa legs sbyar gyi skad don dang rigs bsgre byas pa'i skor/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags yos(1771)lor mdo khams 21

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zhu chen pa'i slob ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis sa skyar sbyar ba/ 〈legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad dang gangs can pa'i brda' shan sbyar ba dri bral nor bu'i me long〉 zhes bya ba'i sde tshan dang po/ bye brag rtog byed las byung ba nye bar mkho ba ci rigs par btud de bkod pa las/ yod pa la/ man+tu bskyo sogs ldan rkyen byin pas kyang 'ong ba/ yan lag yod pa la/ ig wa tī zhes pa dang /(sde dge shing dpar ma 51na3) yang khong gis zha lu lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i nyer bsgyur 'grel pa las skad dod nyer mkho zur du btus pa'i nang / pra tsi tra/ ldan pa'i don la 'jug ces(204na2)dang / mi zad pa'i sde tshan gzhung du ma nas btus pa'i nang yod pa la/ a sti tse tra smra smi zhes(214na1)'khod pa ltar/ ldan don dang / yod pa'i don ston pa'i tshig mtha'‘‘tra’rican de dang / bod rang gi skad la yod ces pa'i rjes 'jug‘‘da’’de gnyis ta sde'i khongs su 'du ba zhu ga la dgos/ sa bzang ma ti paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa〈sgra'i bstan bcos ka tā pa'i mdo'i rnam bshad legs sbyar rab gsal snang ba〉 zhes bya ba'i nang‘‘mtshams sbyor bzhi pa gsal byed phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur byung tshul la gnyis te/ sde pa lnga'i dang po tshig mthar gnas pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / sde pa bzhi'i tha ma tshig mthar gnas pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ dang po la'ang tshig mtha' dngos kyi rnam 'gyur dang / de la brten pa'i rnam 'gyur/ khyad par tra mtha'i rnam 'gyur gsum las/ dang po dbyangs dang sgra ldan rnams pha rol la rnam 'gyur byung tshul ni/sde pa'i dang po tshig mtha' rnams dbyangs dang sgra ldan rnams la gsum pa rnams so zhes pa/ sde pa lnga'i dang po/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa tshig tu grub pa'i mthar gnas pa dbyangs yig rnams dang / sgra ldan gyi yi ge rnams las gang 22

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /yang rung ba'i yi ge pha rol tu yod pa la rang rang gi sde pa'i gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba rnams su 'gyur ’zhes dang / ‘‘ta yig la tsa ṭa'i sde pa la pha rol gyi gzugs so ’zhes pa tshig mtha' tra yig ni/ pha rol du la yig dang / tsa sde dang / ṭa sde'i yi ge gang rung yod pa gang pha rol la yod pa de'i gzugs su 'gyur’’zhes(sde dge shing dpar ma 24ba3)'byung ba ltar tshig mtha'i tra pha rol gyi yi ge dmigs bsal can la mdo dmigs bsal gyi rnam 'gyur 'byung ba'i dbye ba zhib phra sgra'i ri mo sgrub skabs nges par dgos mod/ skung yig gi skabs de 'dra'i zhib phra dgos gal mi che ba dang / de bzhin bod kyi skung yig nang bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gnas lugs kyang skung yig re re'i thog ji bzhin thon mi nus pa stabs bde'i 'bri stangs khyad par can zhig yin la stabs bstun gyi rang bzhin che bar brten sgra'i skabs kyi tshig mtha'‘‘tra’’bod kyi rjes 'jug‘‘da’’gang rung yod pa'i mtshon don du bzhag na 'gal ba'i phyogs mang po thon srid pa dper na legs sbyar skabs yod pa dang ldan don tshig tu grub pa'i mthar‘‘tra’’yig gnas pa nyid kyi yod pa'i don mtshon par byas te zhal yod ces par skung yig lo‘zhal ta’ zhes 'bri dgos pa des brjod don dngos gzhi zhal yod ces pa mi mtshon pa de dang 'brel ba cher med pa slob ston gyi tshig‘‘zhal ta’mil go srid pa dang / yang ri dwags 'dzin pa'i rgya'am gal yod lta bur‘‘gal ta’’bris na des rnyi yod pa mtshon rgyu phar zhog de dang 'brel ba ye nas med pa rgyags chas blug snod kyi gal tar go srid pa lta bu dang /bod skad kyi yod ces pa'i tshig mtha'am rjes 'jug‘da’’nyid kyis yod don mtshon par byas na yang de dang mtshungs pa'i go ba log grub yong srid pa/dper na/ gangs yod pa gang zhig rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i don la skung 23

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yig tu‘‘gangs da byid’’ces shod dgos pa des brjod don dngos mi mtshon pa de las ldog pa gangs sbal la go srid pa bcas de lta bu'i go don 'khrul gzhi mi 'byung la rgyun gtan yi ge 'bri skabs yod med gnyis po shin tu mang ba 'bri dgos par gnyis kar gsal byed gnyis re dang / dbyangs re dgos pa zor yang du gtong ched de dag gi mtshon don nus la 'bri stabs bde ba dang /don gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi med pa zhig la dgongs te mkhas pas sgra'i sgros la dgongs pa bzhes te ta'am da'i tshig mtha' log pa'i yi ge ṭa la 'gyur/gsal byed ṭa de yang sgra mdo nas bstan pa mtshams sbyor ltar dang po'i tshig mthar pha rol dbyangs dang sgra ldan rnams la gsum par 'gyur zhes gsal por bshad na/ ṭa sde'i dang po ṭa yig sde pa de'i gsal byed gsum pa ḍa ru gyur ba de skung yig yod pa'i mtshon don du bzhag na 'bri stabs bde ba dang /bod kyi brda sprod la log pa'i yi ge 'jug pa'i skabs med pas don gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi med pa bcas la dgongs te skung yig la yod la ḍa zhes 'byung ba/sgra'i 'gros nas rigs bsgre byed lugs de 'dra zhig min nam snyam pa mkhas dbang rnam par dpyad gzhir 'bul rgyu de tsam lags/2 med la ṇa zhes na log pa‘‘ṇa ’yig med pa'i mtshon don du legs sbyar la rigs bsgre byas pa'i skor/ bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis/mi zad pa'i sde tshan gzhung du ma nas btus pa'i nang‘‘ma/ min/ med/mi lta bu'i dgag tshig la/ a/ nanya/ mā/ no/ tā rnams dang / na hing dang / na tu med dang / hai dang he/ na tse tra yod pa min nam med/a na ste med pa dang / mā smra/ zlog pa'i don te mi bya lta bu dang / la lam don med rnams kyang ngo’’(215na49)zhes 'byung bas na yig dgag tshig la 24

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /'jug pa mang /khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i nang du yang / gab tshig rgyan gyi rab bcom skabs‘dha3 ṇaḥmi brtan pa ste de'i ṇa yig ni dgag tshig ṇanya'i na nyid do ’zhes dang‘‘dha ri brten pa'i don la ṇa yig dgag pa ’zhes(317ba1)legs sbyar gyi dgag tshig nang ṇa dngos su 'byung ba skung yig gi med pa'i mtshon don du bzhag pa 'di la klan ka'i yul bral ba kha tshon bcad chog3 skung yig nang klad kor gyis rjes 'jug ma yig mtshon pa'i skor/ sa bzang sgra 'grel du‘i’’zhes pa rjes su nga ro'o zhes pa la a yig ni 'dir brjod pa'i don te/ de bzhin du ka yig la sogs pas kyang brjod du rung zhing thig le‘‘0’’tsam gyi yi ge 'di la rjes su nga ro zhes ming du btags te/yi ge'i mdor/ rjes su nga ro ni sna'o/ zhes pa ltar 'di sgra 'byung ba'i gnas gang dang sbyar ba'i yi ge de'i gdangs brjod pa'i rjes su sna las byung ba'i nga ro/ (nga nya ṇa na ma'i nga ro dang mtshungs pa)yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dgos pa ni ma gsal byed la rjes su nga ro'o zhes pa la sogs pa gang du rjes su nga ro'i ming byung ba der thig le‘0 ’tsam 'di dran par bya ba'i ched du'o’’(11ba1)zhes dang / yang / ma yig la rnam 'gyur 'byung tshul skabs‘ma gsal byed la rjes su nga ro'o zhes pa tshig mtha'i ma yig gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams gang rung pha rol du yod pa la snga mar sa rjes su nga ror 'gyur te dper na mi(30na4)zhes dang / ‘‘sde pa la sde pa'i lnga par yang na'o zhes pa la/dur sing du mtha'i(ma yig)rjes su nga ro ni zhes gsungs mod/ slob phan du/ma yig tshig mtha' can zhes gsungs pa nyid legs te/ yang na zhes pa'i rnam par brtag pa mdo snga ma las dmigs bsal du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/25

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/des na tshig mtha'i ma yig ni/ sde pa lnga pa'i yi ge rnams gang rung pha rol du yod pa la/ gang rang gi pha rol na yod pa'i sde pa de'i lnga par yang 'gyur zhing / yang na snga ma bzhin/ rjes su nga ror 'gyur te/ dper na ’’(30ba5)zhes gsungs pa tshig mtha'i ma yig mtshams sbyor skabs rjes su nga ro klad kor can la'ang 'gyur ba dang / a u ma gsum las oṃ yig grub tshul la rigs bsgre byas pa khungs ldan yin/ sgra'i skabs rjes su nga ro thig le'am klad kor de gsal byed la zhugs pa'i skabs sde pa dang ting gi yi ge rang rang gi gdangs brjod pa'i rjes su sna ldan gyi yi ge lnga'i gdangs sbyor dgos pa/dper na/ ‘‘sde pa la sde pa'i lnga par yang na'o’’zhes sam/ yang na‘‘rang rang gi sde pa'i mtha' mar bklag’’ces/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa yi sde tshan lnga la rang rang gi tha mar bklag pa ste ka kha ga gha nga lnga'i klad kor la nga sgra dang / tsa tsha dza dzhanya lnga la nya sgra/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa lnga la ṇa sgra/ ta tha da dha na lnga la na sgra/ pa pha ba bha ma lnga dang o la ma sgra/ ‘‘ya sogs dgu la nga ru bklag’’ces/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa dasu dang / ha a bcas par nga sgra 'don dgos/ 'on kyang skung yig la rags pa'i sgo nas klad kor de ma yig la brten nas grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis spyi khyab rang bzhin du rigs bsgres rjes 'jug ma tshab klad kor byas pa yang klan ka'i yul med/da dung grangs kyi bco lnga bco brgyad la bcwa lnga bcwa brgyad lta bu sogs wa zur gyis na ro'i tshab byas pa yang mi nyung tsam yod pa de dag kyang sgra la rigs bsgre byas pa'i gnad kyang shes dgos/'o na skung yig nang(ḍa)yig bdag la 'jug pa dang / ga sa'i rjes yang 'jug la'ang 'jug pa ci zhe na/ bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'i 26

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi sde tshan gnyis pa/ 'chi med mdzod las ji ltar byung ba 'ga' zhig bkod pa'i nang / ‘‘bdag la srurgyu dang / bdag 'dzin la skṛts+tsha ya/ bdag gam rang lo‘suḥ ’’(153na1)zhes 'byung bar gzhigs na legs sbyar nas rigs bsgre bya yul med 'dra ba dang / de bzhin ga sa rjes yang 'jug gi tshab sgra la rigs bsgre byas zhes de bas shod thabs bral rgyu mtshan ni sgra'i skabs/ gsal byed dbyangs med pa pha rol gyi yi ger drang ngo //rim pa las ma 'das par phral bar bya'o/ /zhes ming tshig gi yi ge mtshams sbyor skabs srog ldan gyi yi ge las srog dbyangs phral/ dbyangs dang dbyangs mtshams sbyor gyis dbyangs ring thung la sogs pa'i khyad par dang / gsal byed dang gsal byed mtshams sbyor gyis yi ge'i rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba'i khyad par 'byung / tshig mtha'i yi ge ha lan tas mtshon pa'i srog med pa pha rol te tshig phyi ma'i srog ldan yi ge'i mgo bor drangs pa ste brtsegs pa der brtsegs pa'i yi ge zhes bya ba las/ bod yig gi thun mong min pa'i sgra sbyor sngon rjes mgo 'dogs kyi tshul de 'dra sgra'i skabs rtsa ba nas med pas re zhig 'di'i rgyu mtshan yang mkhas dbang rnam par dpyad gzhir 'bul rgyu las kho bos 'ol tshod kyis sdom tshig gnas lugs zhu ma shes pa ma zad/ gong du yod med dang / ma'i skor sgra la rigs bsgre byas pa las byung ba'i gnas lugs rags pa tsam zhu thub pa 'di yang bod ljongs sman rtsis khang gi sman pa 'bum rams pa chen mo mkhas pa'i dbang po khro ru tshe rnam mchog gi zhal snga nas sa bzang ma ti paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa ka tā pa'i sgra 'grel gyi steng nas mtshams sbyor lnga pa gzhung khrid zhu thub pa'i bka' drin du 'khums shing / ming le dang /kun bshad sogs bzlog med dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzigs bskyangs ma thob pa'i 27

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rkyen gyis da dung zhu rgyur bsdad pas gong du rgyu mtshan zhus pa rnams kyang byings rkyen gyi gnas lugs dang 'brel bar dpyis phyin pa zhig zhu ma 'tshal ba mkhas dbang rnam pa'i thugs kyi bum bzang du bskyil nas slar yang legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ci dgar rtsol ba'i re ba 'chang bzhin lags/lnga pa/ tshig gi spyor ba sgrub stangs kyi thabs shes gsum ni/1 nyis skung yan la tshig dang po cha tshang mngon gsal du byas pas skung yig de'i don che ge mo'i skor red bsam pa'i 'char snang rags pa skye ba/2 nyis skung yan gyi tshig gcig gnyis gsum bzhi ji tsam skung pa'i mtshon don dbyangs mi 'dra ba ji tsam yod pa spyir btang tshang ba zhig nges par dgos la/ de min ming gzhi'am/ rjes 'jug mtshon pa tsam/ ming gzhi de yang yi ge dngos sam/ cha shas mtshon don gyis bstan pa/ 'phul btang snyoms/ mgo 'dogs skung ngam/ mngon pa gang rigs/3 tshig mtha' ma de'i dbyangs nges par gsal la rjes 'jug kyang rtsa ba'i cha nas tshang dgos/ gzhi 'phul mgo 'dogs la nges bzung ma dgos/dper na/ nyis skung / ‘‘rnamyor’’rnal 'byor lta bur mtshon na/ tshig dang po rnal mngon gsal du byas pa dang / phyi ma 'byor gyi 'phul gzhi skung pa 'dogs dang / rjes kyis skung don mtshon pa/ sum skung‘‘rmyortsis’’slob dpon gyis bka' stsal lta bur mtshon na/ tshig dang po‘‘slob’’kyi rjes 'jug skung rung slob dpon dang nye ba'i don yin pa 'char snang yong ba'i thog bar‘‘dpon’’gyi 'phul gzhi skung / dbyangs rjes dang por btags pas‘dpon ’mtshon/tshig mtha'‘‘gyis’’kyi gzhi skung 'dogs bar gyi rjes la btags/ dbyangs dang rjes bsnan pas‘gyis’’mtshon pa bcas tsheg khyim de hril por‘‘slob dpon 28

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /gyis’’zhes pa mas kyi tshigs grogs bka' 455 zhes pas bka' 4skor ba po slob dpon yin pa rtogs nus pa lta bu/ bzhi skung ni/ de'i dkyil du‘‘byino’’gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs zhes pa'i‘‘thugs rje chen po’ tsheg khyim gcig nang tshig bzhi yod pa lta bur mtshon na tshig dang po chig skung gi‘thugs ’cha tshang ba mngon gsal du thon pa'i khar/ gnyis pa‘‘rje’’yi gzhi dang / mgo can skung /dbyangs rang sor bkod/ gsum pa‘‘chen ’gyi gzhi skung / dbyangs dang rjes 'jug sor bzhag tshig bzhi pa ste tshig mtha'‘‘po ’gzhi skung / dbyangs gsum pa'i rjes la btags pa de'i yas kyi tshig‘‘de'i dkyil du ’zhes pa dang / mas kyi tshig‘‘gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs’’zhes pa'i tshig grogs de dag gis dkyil gyi skung yig de‘‘thugs rje chen po ’yin pa bde blag tu rtogs nus/ rgyu mtshan ni yas su de'i dkyil du zhes pa'i gzhi'am gnas/ brtan pa snod kyi yul bstan pa der bzhugs pa po'am/ rten pa bcud de su zhig yin pa'i 'char snang skye ba de ma thag thugs kyis bzhugs pa po'i ming gi brda gsal por bstan pas dbyangs dang rjes 'jug gi 'gros lam thugs rje chen po yin nam bsam pa'i 'char snang thog mas kyi tshig gtso 'khor dgu zhes pas gtso bo thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs 'khor tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhugs pa bcas dkyil gyi bzhi skung ni thugs rje chen po rang las gzhan la go log thebs mi srid pa kha tshon gcod nus pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa/ grub zin pa'i skung yig klog skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don gal che gsum dang / btang snyoms byed dgos pa gcig bcas dbye ba bzhi yod/ do snang byed dgos pa gsum ni/1 skung yig yod pa'i glegs bam de'i bstan bya spyi'i go ba dang / yang 29

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sgos skung yig de'i yas mas kyi tshig 'gros la blta zhib dgos la/ lhag par bzhi skung yan la de bas kyang do snang byed dgos pa/2 nyis skung yan gyi tshig dang po cha tshang ba'am/ cung tshang ba de'i 'gros nas rjes kyi tshig gang yin la do snang dgos pa/3 skung yig mtha' ma'i dbyangs dang rjes 'jug gi 'gros nas de'i gong gi tshig gang yin la do snang byed dgos pa bcas so/ /btang stoms gcig ni/ nyis skung yan gyi tshig dang po dang / nyis skung nang gi dmigs bsal can phud/ bar mtha'i 'phul ci yin la mnyam 'jog ma dgos pa de lags/don tshan lnga pa/ skung yig gi dge skyon/skung yig gi dge mtshan ni/ bka' bstan bcos 'bri skabs yig zor yang ba dang / dus tshod bsri tshags thub pa/ glegs bam gyi nang brjod don shong tshad che bas ngal rtsol gron chung dang / dus tshod sogs gang thad nas bshad kyang dge mtshan chen po ldan yod/ lhag par nangs kyi dus rang re'i ljongs 'dir shog bu thon 'bor chen po rang med pas yi ge 'bri skabs shog bur gron chung byed pa'i srol rgyun zhig yod pa ma zad/ lhag par glegs bam nang bstan bcos mang po 'bri skabs de bas shong tshad che ba dang / gnas nges med du bzhugs pa'i chos pa rnams kyis rgyun khyer blta dper stabs bde ba/ dus tshod thung ngu'i nang glegs bam thog bka' bstan bcos mang po 'bri thub pa byed ched thabs shes bton te yig zor yang du gtong rgyu de yang 30

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /gal che'i cha rkyen gyi gras yin stabs de'i thabs shes nyag gcig ni dus de shed du klog pa po rgya khyab kyis rtogs thub pa'i —skung yig rim bzhin gsar gtod dang / de dag skabs dang 'tshams par spyod rgyur bsam blo gtong dgosapa zhig rang shugs su byung ba dang / de bzhin de snga'i srid gzhung rim can nas spel ba'i bka' gtan tshigs lta bur mtshon na'ang / nye dus dang ye mi 'dra ba shog bu chung ngu'i thog yi ge zhib mo 'bri ba dang / glegs bam la yang yig phreng mang la('ga' zhig gi shog ngos rer phreng nyi shu la nye ba yod par snang)srub cha chung ba/ 'go gsham mtha' bcas la shog lhag cher med pa dngos su mthong rgyu 'dug pa bcas gna' rabs kyi cha rkyen la bltas na skung yig 'bri rgyur dge mtshan mi nyung ba yod pa ma zad/ phul du byung ba'i bod kyi rig gnas kyi rnam grangs shig tu brtsi chog pa dang / deng gi dus su yang skung yig rgyun 'dzin dang / 'phel rgyas/ gsar gtod bcas byas te skung yig byang cha dod po 'bri thub na slob khrid dang / tshogs 'du'i zin tho sogs yongs grags rgyun spyod ming tshig mang po bskungs nas bris pas brjod don tshim lus med par myur mor 'god thub pa bcas de'i dge mtshan ni deng sang yang sngar bzhin bed spyod byed chog pa'i skor kho bo'i lta stangs sam gros 'go 'ga' zhig gsham du zhu rgyu lags/skung yig gi zhan cha ni/ cha rgyus med na klog dka' ba dang / skung yig la las brda dag ji bzhin thon mi thub pas deng skabs la bltas na rig gnas kyi chu tshad nges can yod pa'i mis ma gtogs rgya khyab tu spyod mi rung ba de tsam mo/ /31

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/don tshan drug pa/ gna' bzang deng spyod/ji ltar byas nas skung yig byung ba dang / byung ba'i dus tshod sogs skung yig gi lo rgyus dang / rnam gzhag dge mtshan dang skyon cha bcas rags pa tsam zhig gong du zhus zin pas skung yig ni bod kyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas kyi ya gyal gtsigs cher 'dzin 'os pa 'di dag 'bri klog byed pa'i rgyun nyams na shin du phangs pa'i tshor snang rang shugs su skye srid/ nga tshos ci 'dra byas te skung yig myur skyob byed pa dang dus mtshungs 'phel rgyas yong ba byas te deng dus kyi bya gzhag la zhabs 'degs zhu thub pa byung na de ni dga' ba skye 'os pa'i las don yin pa gdon mi za bas kho bos gang bsam zol med kyi tshig gsum kha nas thal ba 'di ltar lags so/ /dang po/ bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin skor/bod kyi skung yig myur skyob byed dgos na/ bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin yang dag pa dang / ngos 'dzin gcig 'gyur yong ba bya rgyu de ni cha rkyen ang dang po yin/ rgya che'i bod rigs shes yon can dang / bod kyi rig gnas la dga' zhen yod pa'i blo mthun spyi dang / yang sgos bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i ched las mkhan dang / gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur rnam pas skung yig gi gal che'i rang bzhin la ngos 'dzin yang dag pa gnang ste bod yig dpe rnying lag bris ma spyi dang / bye brag skung yig mang po spyad yod pa'i glegs bam nang don ci yin la ma bltas par thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis btsal 'tshol byas thog gang rnyed pa'i glegs bam nang nas skung yig zur 'don dang 32

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /'brel bskungs pa rnams bkral ba gsog 'jog thog de dag gi sgra donartsogyi tshul rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas gnad ka 'tshol ba dang / dpyad gzhi de dag rmang gzhir byas te rim bzhin rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig chags pa byas te sngar grub zin pa'i skung yig 'bri klog shar mar thub pa dang /deng gi bya gzhag las byung ba'i tshig gsar gyi rigs la'ang spyi 'gros de dag gi thog nas skung yig kha skong dgos rigs gsar bzo thub par 'bad brtson byed rgyu gal cher brtsi ba ni bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin dang / kha phyogs yang dag pa yin/ gal srid gna' rabs yig cha'i nang yod pa'i skung yig de dag klog thub tsam dang / go ba khyar khyor lon thub tsam byung na de kas 'thus pa las/ des nus pa gang thon min ma rtogs par/ deng mkho gal mi che ba lta bur skung yig ni yod kyang chog la med kyang chog par brtsi ba dang / tha na skung yig ni gna' rabs kyi glegs bam dang / chos dpe kho nar spyad du yod pa las/ gzhan du min pa de yang klog mi bde ba dang / go ba lon dka' ba rnyog dra can de la dge mtshan gang yang med par brtsi ba lta bu'i lta tshul bzung na de ni rang gi shes tshad srang la bcal ba'i bsam tshul gu dog po zhig las don dngos dang mthun pa'i bsam tshul yang dag pa zhig ga la yin/ rgyu mtshan der brten nga tsho bod rigs spyi dang / lhag par rigs gzhung slob gso'i las ka gnang mkhan tshos skung yig myur skyob byed dgos pa'i gnad don 'di nyid nyin re'i gros rim nang nges par du 'jog dgos pa'i don chen zhig yin pa'i bsam blo gting zab 'dzugs pa dang / ngos 'dzin gcig 'gyur yong ba bya rgyu ni skung yig myur skyob las ka'i nang med du mi rung ba'i cha rkyen ang dang po yin/33

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnyis pa/ las ka 'di dam 'dzin dgos pa'i gros 'go/nga tsho dpe skrun las rigs khag dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag lhag par bod yig slob grwa che khag gis yag shos la so so'i tshan par mi sna 'os 'tshams zur 'then nam/ zhor lcog 'gan dkris mi snas rgyun gtan gyi las ka'am/ yang na ched mngags dpe rnying btsal te de dag gi nang nas skung yig ji tsam 'phrad pa de tsam gsog 'jog byed 'jug pa bcas thabs shes gang yod spyad de rim gsog byas pa'i skung yig rnams la gzhi byas te skung yig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang kun gyis khas len thub pa zhig grub par brtson len thog grub zin pa'i skung yig 'bri klog mi nub pa'i ched skung yig gi tshig mdzod dam/ yang na cung cha tshang ba'i slob deb lta bu bzo dgos la bzo yang thub pa zhig red/ 'on kyang gnad don 'di gnad ka zhig la brtsis te do snang ma byas na gang ltar rtogs dka' ba'i 'phrang las nam yang grol mi thub pa der brten gtso bor rigs gzhung las rigs khag gi 'go khrid nas mthong chen dang / rgyab skyor gnang dang mi gnang la rag las des na kho bos skabs 'di dang bstun nas ljongs rtsi rkamangs srid gzhung dang / lhag par rigs gzhung phyogs khag gi gtso bo'i dbu khrid rnam par skung yig 'dir yang bod kyi rig gnas gzhan dang 'dra bar mthong chen dang / shugs che'i rgyab skyor gyis gna' bzang deng spyod kyi mdzad phyogs dang yongs su mthun pa'i las don dmigs bkar dam 'dzin yong ba zhu rgyu'i gros 'go 'don rgyu yin/ bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang nas skung yig tshud pa'i bod kyi rig gnas shul rgyun myur skyob kyi las don mtha' dag la mthong chen dang dam 'dzin shugs chen gnang mus lags shing / nga tsho zhib phra'i las ka byed 34

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /mkhan tshos kyang dpe rnying khag gi nang nas skung yig zur 'don dang 'brel rang la nus pa phra mo tsam las med pa de yang rgya mtsho chu thigs kyi 'brel mtshon bya gzhag 'di'i nang 'bul rgyur sems thag bcad yod/gsum pa/ skung yig myur skyob kyi thabs zhes/bya thabs ci 'dra zhig spyad de skung yig rgyun 'dzin dang / 'phel rgyas/gsar gtod byed dgos sam zhe na/ skung yig gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya'am/rigs pa'i gzhung rmugs dang mtshon dpe'i yig cha(skung yig mang po yod pa'i dpe rnying dang / slob deb 'tshud)cha tshang ba byas te bod yig ched las slob grwa che khag gi lo rim cung mtho ba'i 'dzin grwar skung yig dang / hor yigayig gsar khag lta bu bod kyi yi ge'i rnam grangs khag gcig bsdus kyis slob tshan bzo ba'am/ yang na gzhung yig khrid pa dang dus mnyam du slob khrid byas na'ang 'grig skabs 'dir slob grwa che khag gi nang nas kyang lo rim cung mtho ba'i 'dzin grwa zhes dmigs su bkar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ ‘‘gang zhig gser gyi ri la sngas bcol ba/ /de yi 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir btang nas bshad na slob grwa che khag gi slob ma rnams slob grwa chung 'bring nas thon pa dang / dge rgan rnam pas gso skyong legs po gnang ba'i bka' drin las rigs gzhung gi chu tshad nges can ldan yod/ bltas bya stos byed kyi 'dzin grwa mtho ba dang bsdur na bar khyad yong srid par cha bzhag cing lo rim dma' ba'i slob ma da dung rigs gzhung gi chu tshad mtho po rang med pa ste bod kyi brda dag gi gnad don dpyis phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i slob phrug tshor skung yig gi gnad don u tshugs kyis bshad na/ ‘‘lcam sku zhabs kyi 'gro stangs ma shes par nga ra'i 'gro stangs shor 35

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ba'i’’dpe las ma 'das pas skung yig gi slob tshan 'khrid yul slob grwa che khag gi lo rim cung mtho ba'i slob ma dgos zhes dmigs su bkar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de lags/de bzhin rigs gzhung ched las mi sna dang / gsar 'gyur las rigs sogs 'brel yod sde tshan gyi mi sna so so'am/ yang na gcig 'gyur sgrig 'dzugs kyis dus thung sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa'am/ yang na tshan pa so so'i 'gan babs slob sbyong dang zung 'brel byed pa sogs nga tshos gang la gang 'os kyi thabs shes spyad de skung yig gi shes bya dang / sngar grub zin par rigs bsgre byas nas deng gi las don la mkho ba'i skung yig kha skong dgos rigs gsar gtod byed thub pa ma zad/ nges par gsar gtod byed dgos pa zhig kyang yin/ de ltar byung na gna' bzang deng spyod don la 'khyol ba'i mtshon tshul ngo ma zhig la brtsis chog gal srid da lta skung yig myur skyob kyi las ka dam 'dzin ma byas na skung yig 'bri klog thub pa'i mi spyir btang lo bzhi bcu lnga bcu la slebs pa dang / skung yig shes pa'i mi yang ha cang mi mang ba de nas lo sum bcu bzhi bcu song rjes skung yig 'bri klog gi rgyun yongs su nyams te skung yig yod pa'i glegs bam dang / klog pa po phan tshun zhal ma tshor bar ngo 'dzum bsdus nas sdod pa'i dus shig yong rgyur de'i skabs nang don ches phun sum tshogs pa dang / lhag par rang la med thabs med pa'i dpyad gzhi mang po rnyed thub pa'i da4 rnying rin thang can skung yig yod pa ji tsam mang rung / de dag ji bzhin klog mi thub pa dang / nang don rtogs mi thub pa bed med kyi shog ro lta bur thal rdul gyi khrod du gnas rgyu rang red/nga tshos da lta nas 'go btsugs te las ka 'di dam 'dzin byas na 'di'i mdun 36

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /lam ni sngar las rgya che la yangs pa zhig red ces tshig thag bcad nas bshad chog de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ da phan skung yig gi rmang gzhi'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bzo rgyu nga tsho'i mes po tshos ched gnyer ma mdzad par lus pa zhig las/ bzo mi thub pa dang / bzo mi dgos pa ga la yin/ nga tshos rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas skung yig gi spyi 'gros bzos te sngar grub zin pa'i tshig sgrub nang mthong dkon pa phyis 'tsho ba'i nang rgyun du spyod pa'i tshig sbyor mang po skung yig thog spyad na yig zor yang du gtong thub pas dus tshod bsri tshags thub pa dang / gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan dang / tshogs 'du'i zin tho 'god mkhan lta bu tshig ma lus pa myur mor 'god dgos pa'i rigs la skung yig gi phan nus de bas mngon gsal che/ lhag par deng dus ni gna' dus dang mi 'dra bar r+shatshang ma'i mthong rgya che ba dang / spyir btang nas bshad na shes yon sna 'dzoms pa sngar bsgrub ma myong ba'i bya ba mang po dngos thog bden 'tshol gyis sgrub dgos pa yin tsang / dus tshod ni dngos 'brel gser dang 'dra ba rin thang bral ba zhig yin pa de 'phro brlag tu mi 'gro ba bya rgyur nus pa ha cang chen po ldan pa ma zad/ sngar dus dang 'dra ba'i shog bu dkon pa'i gnad don med rung / gal che'i dus tshod mang po cung zad gron chung thub na'ang de ni g.yang rtse'i sgang gi yal sgron red snyam/'o na khyod kyis skung yig sngar med pa kha skong gsar gtod kyis deng gi bya gzhag la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes gleng ba yang snying ci 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos sam zhe na/ gleng bar bya ste/ sngar grub zin pa'i skung yig brgya cha'i brgya deng sang yang spyod 'os pa las/ dor 'os pa gcig kyang 37

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/med mod/ skung yig 'bri ba po'i ngos nas bshad na bstan bcos sam/legs bshad rtsom yig gi nang don ga re 'bri ba de rang la rag las/ ngas gsar gtod ces zhu ba ni skung yig gsar rnying gnyis lta bur phye ste rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyang gnyis bzo dgos pa'i don min par sngar grub zin pa'i skung yig rmang gzhir byas te de'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi 'gros nas deng dus kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'am/ deng gsar du byung ba'i tshig gsar dang / yongs grags rgyun spyod kyi ming tshig gi gras rnams 'bri bde la don go ba/ cung cha tshang ba'i skung yig gsar bzo bya rgyu de yin/ dper na rlangs 'khor lo‘rlor’’ gnam gru lo‘gcum’’ tshan rig lo‘tshanagi’’ spyi spyod rlangs 'khor lo‘spyid rlor’’lta bu sngar ma grags pa'i rigs 'bri ba sogs skabs dang sbyar nas ci bder bris pa des yas mas kyi tshig grogs dang bcas pas rang gi brjod gzhi tshang la ma nor ba yong ba bya rgyu lta bu lags/'on kyang skabs 'dir nan bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ skung yig gsar du bzos pa gang zhig gcig gyur gyi spyod thub pa'i tshad la slebs pa dgos zer ba min la/ skung yig gsar du gtod pa po tshos rang gi stabs bde'i zin tho lta bu stabs gang bde gsar gtod kyis 'bri ba las/ gzhan skung yig de rgya khyab kyis rtogs pa'i tshad la ma slebs par gtan la phab pa'i skung yig la rtsis te spyod mi rung la lhag par srid gzhung gi gtan 'bebs yig cha sogs gal che'i yig cha'am/ nyar 'jog dgos pa'i yig cha'i rigs la da phan yongs grags don gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi med pa'i skung yig lta bu nyung tsam spyod pa'am/ yang na ma spyad pa rang legs par mngon/ gnad don 'di'i thad de sngon srid gzhung la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu la skung yig 'bri mi chog pa'i 38

bod kyi skung yig gi rnam gzhag chung ngu /gtan 'bebs gsal po byas yod pa der nang don gnyis tshud yod/gcig ni gong rim la brtsi bkur med pa'i rtags dang / gnyis ni skung yig la la don gnyis sam mang por sbyar rung ba des don la 'khrul gzhi yong srid pa sngon 'gog byed pa'i ched bcas lags/ nga tshos lo rgyus kyi nyams myong nas phan cha blangs na dge mtshan las gnod pa ci la srid/bsdoms na/ nga tshos bod kyi rig gnas kyi rnam grangs mtha' dag nyams pa sor 'chud mi nyams gong 'phel gyis nga tsho'i ljongs 'di dpal yon gnyis dar yong ba'i phan yod kyi cha rkyen mchis so cog skong 'then bya rgyu ni gal che'i gnad don zhig yin zhing / skabs 'dir kho bos kyang dmigs yul 'di kho na'i ched gang bsam zol med kyi 'char snang 'ga' zhig zhu thal song bar mkhyen ldan rnam pas ma shes slob ston dang / nongs pa ci mchis bzod gsol zhu rgyus re zhig mtshams byas/mang mang ri mo'i rtsol ba ma dgos par/ /bsdus bsdus tshig gi sbyor ba khyad par ba/ /gsal gsal don tshang skung yigango mtshar can/ /yang yang blta la dbang pos mig stong bgrad/ /'on kyang lag len rgya mtsho srub pa las/ /'ong ba'i gzhung lugs zla ba ma mngon mur/ /lag len dbang gzhu'i mched du 'gyur dogs nas/ /g.yar khral tsam min kho bo'i sor rtses skrun/ /bsam bzang las gang ngan pa ma lags kyang / /ma dag pa dang 'gal cha gang 'tshal ba/ /39

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gangs can mkhas rnams spyan sngar 'chags byas nas/ /lam bzang dpal 'char sarba maṅga lam/dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gtso che ba'i dkar chagamakhas pa lde'u dang / lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung khag gnyis/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mdzad pa rlangs kyi po ti bse ru/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)rong ston smra ba'i seng ges mdzad pa rtog ge'i snang ba/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)mdzad pa po su yin ma shes pa bzo ris kha shas kyi pa tra lag len ma/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)btsun pa bde ba'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ sdeb sbyor pad ma rgyas pa'i dga' tshal (dpe rnying lag bris ma)sus mdzad ma shes pa/ rta dpyad mthong ba don ldan/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)sus mdzad ma shes pa/ mngon brjod blo gsal rab dga'/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)byang pa bkra shis dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa/ theg pa kun dang thun mong du byas pa gso ba rig pa'i rtsod spong / (dpe rnying lag bris ma)mkhas pa bon grong pa/ rtsis dpon dgos sleb pa/ kong po rtsis rams sogs kyis mdzad pa rdel rtsis kun gsal me long / (dpe rnying lag bris ma)mang thos klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)bo dong 'jigs med grags pa sogs kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar dngos grub char 'bebs/ (dpe rnying lag bris ma)40

mdo khams zhu chen pa'i slob ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad dang / gangs can pa'i brda shan sbyar ba dri bral nor bu'i me long /(sde dge shing dpar ma)sa bzang ma ti paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgra'i bstan bcos ka tā pa'i mdo'i rnam bshad legs sbyar rab gsal snang ba/(sde dge shing dpar ma)khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa/ khams sprul snyan 'grel che mo (shing dpar ma)bcas so/ /

( rde'u'i rtsis gzhung sarga brgyad la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long〉 skor la dpyad pa/'dzam gling yul gru so sor dpal 'byor gyi brtsi thang rtsi byed rtsis kyi rig pa dang / rtsi chas/ rtsi thabs mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang ches snga ba'i dus nas zhing 'brog thon skyed gong 'phel 'gro ba dang chabs cig dpal 'byor yar rgyas su phyin te spyi tshogs thog dngos zog brje tshong la mkho ba'i rtsis kyi rig pa dar 'go tshugs pa dang / de dag rim bzhin gong 'phel du phyin te bod kyi rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i‘‘rdel rtsis’’kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang zhig chags yod pa de skabs 'dir gleng bya'i nang don yin/ de yang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus su 'dus byung pa anan+tas de snga'i bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung sarga brgyad la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long〉 zhes bya bar dpyad pa dang 'brel gzhung don la 'grel bshad lam tsam byed par 'dod/nangs kyi dus su bod kyi rdel gyi rdel rtsis gtong stangs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thor bur gnas yod pa rnams kyi nang nas de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung rtsis dang 'brel ba che la rgyun gtan mkho che ba'i rdel rtsis kyi cha shas brgyad la dmigs bkar gyis dag ther dang 'brel go rim yod pa'i rtsirdo 2gzhung〈rab sbyangs gser gyi me long〉 zhes bya ba ni 'dus byung pa

〈de'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/anan+ta'am kun dgar 'bod pas gtsang ljongs nor 'dzin gyi bye brag 'dus byung spel mo che'i('dus byung rdzong)yang steng sgrol ma lha khang gi zhal ba'i thog shur rjes thon thon rdel rtsis la sbyangs pa gnang ba'i 'bras bur dpyad bya'i rtsis gzhung 'di nyid gsar rtsom gnang zhing / khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi drung rigs rtsis kyi rig par nang byan chud pa'i dran dbang zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang khong gi byung ba brjod pa'i yig lam da phan rang gi 'dren byed kyi yul du ma gyur pas zhib phra'i lo rgyus 'di dang 'di zhes zhu bar rngo mi thogs kyang rtsis gzhung gi mjug bsdu'i gtam du‘ces pa'i rdol rtsis zab gnad gsal byed pa/ /nor lha'i grangs ldan 'di dag 'dus byung pa/ /anan+ta yis lha ldan zhing mchog gi/ /pho brang chen po'i rtsis khang nang du sbyar/’’ ces bkod par gzhigs na khong ni lnga pa'i sku dus su rtsis khang gi 'gan 'khur ba zhig tu 'khums shing / del rtsis kyi gzhung 'di yang de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung rtsis nyer mkho'i ched du sbyar ba zhig tu mngon/gna' bo'i bod kyi lo rgyus thog zhing 'brog thon skyed sogs dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bas spyi tshogs kyi khongs mi rnams thon rdzas brje res kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i 'jal byed bre srang dang / de dag gi tshad gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa/ 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi'i khyad chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs byung ba'i dus ni shin tu snga ba zhig yin 'dug gnad don 'di'i thad dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa'i(chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉nang‘‘legs drug thog ma i sho legs zhes bya/ /de yi blon po lha bu mgo dkar zhe sa/ khu khu ru las skyes kyi bu yis 43
