nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/byas/ /'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ /mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha rtsis/ /'brog la thul rtsis phu chu yur du drangs/ /mda' ru chu ma rmo ba 'di nas byung / zhes dang / stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi skabs‘'di dus khri ngor snang btsun mong gis byas/ /bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal/ /dga' gnyis tshong byas mthun gnyis la lung sdebs/ /de gong bod na tshad dang bre srang med/ /de phyir mdzangs mi bdun gyi gsum par grags’’zhes dang / srong btsan sgam po'i skabs‘bre srang phul khyor zho nam se sran sogs/ /bka' la btags pa khrims yig(khrims yig drug gi nang gses)gnyis pa ste/ /'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes grags ’zhes dang /khri srong lde btsan skabs‘mchims phu'i sgom chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga re/ spod mar srang brgyad brgya re/ chibs pa re/ na za drug phrugs re ’zhes dang / khri ral pa'i skabs/ ‘‘bre srang dang zho cha tshun rgya gar gyi dbus 'gyur tshal dang mthun par bcosami zhes sogs 'khod pa'i gnad don 'di tshor zhib tu dpyod skabs bod kyi rgyal rabs legs drug gi thog ma i sho legs kyi dus su blon po lha bu mgo dkar gyis zhing la dor dang / 'brog la thul rtsis pa de ni bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dpal 'byor rtsis rig gi myu gu 'bus pa zhig dang / de rjes stag ri gnyan gzigs skabs blon po khri ngor snang btsan gyis‘bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis gzhalami’zhes pa des gnas tshul ji lta bu zhig gsal bshad byas yod dam zhe na/ de gong bre dang srang zhes tha snyad thogs pa'i 'degs gshor gyi tshad gzhi gtan la phab pa zhig med pa de cung cha tshang ba'i sgo nas tshad gzhi nges gtan yod pa'i bre srang gi tha snyad btags pa'i 'bru mar 'jal byed kyi bre srang gtan la phab par mngon 44

(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/cing / de rjes srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus khrims lugs thog nas 'jal byed de rnams bre srang phul khyor sogs tshad gzhi zhib phra can du gtan la phab/'on kyang de skabs rtsam 'bru 'jal byed la khal zhes 'bod kyang / mar sogs 'degs byed la nyag kha zhes pa'i tha snyad da dung thogs med pa mar 'degs byed la srang(spor dang ljid tshad mtshungs pa)zhes 'bod pa ni khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus mchod rgyun gtong sgo'i nang spod mar la srang zhes gsal por bkod pa nas mthong thub/ khri ral pa'i sku dus sam/ yang na dus skabs de'i yas mas su bre srang la bcos sgyur 'ga' zhig byung 'dra ba de gong 'degs byed srang kho nar brtsi ba de'i ljid tshad srang la spor zhes btags pa brgyad cu la khal gcig dang / bre'i dod du spor bzhi la nyag gcig dang /de nyi shur khal gcig tu brtsi ba'i srol dang / sha mar 'degs byed la srang zhes mi 'bod par gshor byed 'bo'i khal dang mtshungs pa'i ming btags pa/khal man la nyag dang spor zhes pa'i tha snyad gsar du byung 'dra ba bcas de ltar 'degs gshor 'jal gsum gyi tshad gzhi rim pas cha tshang ba dang /'thus tshang du gyur pa de ni 'bru rigs dang / rtsam pa/ tshwa bul/ phyur ba/snum sogs gshor byed khal rer bre nyi shu dang / bre rer phul drug phul gang la nang gi rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu(rdog ma zhes pa 'bru rdog la ngos 'dzin dgos 'dra yang / don du gna' dus bre srang gi tshad gzhi gtan la 'beb skabs phul brgya dang nyi shu la khal gcig tu brtsi ba'i spyi 'gros der gzhigs te phul man gyi cha shas kyang brgya dang nyi shu'i cha la gsil ba'i cha rer rdog ma zhes pa'i tha snyad byung 'dra ba'i gnad kyang shes dgos)nang gi rdog ma gcig la phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu/ phyi'i rdog ma gcig la de phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi 45

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/shu brtsi ba sogs shin tu phra ba'i cha la gsil rgyu yod kyang phyis gzhung rtsis sogs lag len skabs phyi'i rdog ma yan ma gtogs shin tu phra ba'i cha rnams dor ba red/sha dang / mar/ bal/ rnga ma sogs khal gcig la nyag nyi shu dang /nyag rer spor bzhi re/ spor(srang ngam spor gyi thog ma'i ljid tshad brtsi tshul ni/nas 'bru che 'bring chung gsum gnyis re bsdoms pa'i nas 'bru drug gi ljid tshad la se ba gang / se ba nyi shu la zho gang / zho bcu la srang gang / srang gcig gi ljid tshad ni spor gcig gi ljid tshad yin)yan gyi brtsi stangs gshor byed 'bo'i khal dang mtshungs shing / 'degs gshor khal gnyis dbar mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni bre la phul drug dang / nyag la spor bzhi'i grangs khyad de kho na yin/rtsa dang / shag pa/ lci ba sogs ni 'degs rgya gcig la chu bzhi/ chu gang la nang gi rdog ma ste cha shas brgya dang nyi shu man gyi brtsi stangs gong dang mtshungs/snam bu ni 'doms la 'jal bas 'doms gang la khru bzhi/ khru rer mtho do/ mtho rer sor bcu gnyis/ sor man gyi cha shas gong mtshungs thogs cha 'jal ba'i rgyugs 'doms snam bu 'jal byed las cung ring ba yod kyang /de'i spyi 'gros ni snam bu 'jal byed kyi 'doms dang mtshungs/dngul ni srang lnga bcu la ṭam rdo gcig srang rer zho bcu/ zho rer skar bcu/ skar man cha shas gong dang mtshungs/da dung rtsis gzhung der ma gsal ba'i gser dngul 'degs byed skor la thur srang dang / mgur zho/ byang zho sogs rnam grangs mang po zhig dang /46

〈rdo'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/rdel rtsis la'ang gser khyad dang / dngul khyad/ rmar zong gi khyad/ sa zhing son 'gro la gzhigs pa'i rkang 'don brtsi stangs/ phyugs rigs kyi mgo brtsi stangs la sogs pa ji snyed cig yod rung / skabs 'di'i dpyad bya dngos gzhi dang 'brel ba med pas yig tshogs kyi rgyur bsam nas btang snyoms su bzhag cing / skabs 'dir nges par du ston dgos pa gzhan zhig ni rtsis gzhi de dag dpal 'byor khyab khongs su rtsis rgyag byed skabs bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo'u gtong byed la dngos po gang dang gang spyod pa dang / de dag gi byed nus gang yin shes dgos pas rde'u gtong byed kyi rdel chas ni kham rtsig dang / de'u dkar nag rgya sran ma sogs dngos po spyir btang pa sha stag yin/ de yang kham rtsig gis bar du gcig mtshon pa dang /bcu shing gis bar du bcu mtshon pa/ rgya sran mas steng du brgya mtshon pa/phul rdos steng du stong mtshon pa/ dkar chag gis steng du khri mtshon pa/kham rtsig gis stengardzodu 'bum mtshon pa lta bu dang / khal gnas ma zin pa'i cha shas skabs mas su rgya sran mas bre dang / nyag mtshon pa/ dkar chag gis mas su bre lnga dang / nyag lnga mtshon pa/ kham rtsig phyed pas mas su bre bcu dang nyag bcu mtshon pa/ phul rdos mas su phul dang spor mtshon pa/dkar gong gis mas su phul phyed dang spor phyed mtshon pa/ rdog ma phyi nang gcig gyur bcu gnas su bcu shing gzhung slong / gcig tshab kham rtsig phyed tshab kham rtsig phyed pa bcas zur 'gros su 'jog pa yin/ phul dang spor yan gyi rde'u rnams rim pa rim par brtsegs pa dang / bcu kha longs na gnas gong du spor ba/ rdog ma'am cha shas kyi rde'u rnams phul dang spor gyi gsham g.yon nas g.yas su phyi nang rim par gyer ba/ rkyong sgril ni skar rtsis 47

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/skabs kyi rang rang 'khor lo dang mtshungs par nang gi rdog ma 120nas phul/phul 6nas bre/ bre20nas khal du sgril ba yin/ sgyur bgos ri mo'i cho gar brten tshe de'i rtsi chas ni rtsis gzhong dang / rtsis thur gyis ri mo 'bri ba bcas rdel rtsis kyi yo chas la bltas na ha cang stabs bde dang / rin thang med pa'i dngos po ha lam gdod ma'i rnam pa glen thag dod po zhig tu mngon yang / de rnams dpal 'byor gyi rtsis gzhi dngos la bkol skabs bed spyod kyi nus pa mtho ba dper na/ brtsi bya'i dngos po rnam grangs bcu phrag 'ga' zhig gam tha na brgya phrag brgal rung dngos po so so'i ming rtsis byang thog 'god pa'i thabs shes la brten nas sdebs gcig la rtsi thub pa'i dge mtshan ldan pa dang /lhag par sa ris kyi ri mo'i lag len ni de bas dge mtshan che ba/ dpal 'byor gyi rtsis rgyag smos ci/ skar rtsis gzhung lugs nas bstan pa'i rtsis rigs rnam grangs mang po rtsis gzhong chung ngu'i nang brtsis te nyi zla skar gsum gyi chos nyid khong du chud thub la bod kyi thun mong min pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba 'di ni gnam rig la 'jug pa yangs pa'i rtsis rams pa rnam pas da lta yang lag len spyod mus su mchis/rdel chas kyi skor dmigs su bkar nas gleng 'os pa zhig ni bar skabs srol rgyun gyi rdel chas gong du mtshams sbyor zhus pa ltar lags mod/ 'on kyang rdel chas de rnams gna' dus ji ltar spyod pa 'phel med rang sor gnas pa zhig ma yin snyam/ gna' rabs bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rtsi chas rde'u dkar nag mdog dang / dbyibs kyi dbye ba'i sgobyunas gtso bor spyod pa'i rkyen gyis de'i tha snyad la rde'u'i rtsis sam del rtsis su 'bod par snang /gna' rabs rtsi chas kyi nang nas 'ga' zhig rang sor gnas pa dang /48

〈de'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/'ga' zhig sngar gyi rtsi chas 'gyur ba byung ba rde'u nag po zur med kyi tshab kham rtsig gis byed pa gsal por mthong thub pa dper na/ bar skabs dmangs khrod kyi rdel chas nang kham rtsig ldang min gyi kha skong du rde'u nag po spyod pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin bcu shing la mtshon na'ang dang thog shing gi lcug phran bzo bcos ma byas pa gang 'byor ram/ yang na spen ma'i rkang sogs dum bur bcag pa bed spyod gtong ba de dag phar 'dril tshur 'dril gyis rde'ur nor 'khrul 'byung sla bas phyis bcu shing de zur bzhi ldan gang du bzhag pa de gar lhing por sdod thub pa ched mngags bzo ba'am khyad chos de ldan gyi shing bed spyod gtong ba/ gna' dus del chas la dang zhen de tsam mi byed na'ang /phyis rim bzhin dang dod dang spros pa je cher gyur te rdel chas blug sa'i khug ma yang dmigs bsal can nam/ shing gi rdel gzhong ched bzos nang 'jug pa sogs byed/ gzhan yang de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung la bltas na gzhog gru bzhi ming du thogs pa'i lcug phran gru bzhi bzo ma dgos pa'i rang byung shing de rigs kong po nas sgrig 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / de bzhin phul rdo zhes pa'i de'u nag po gru bzhi de rigs thon khungs sa cha nas 'bul dgos pa bcas phyis del chas 'ga' zhig thon khungs mi ser nas sgrub 'jal dgos pa'i khral rigs kyi gras su gyur pa'ang yod/dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag skabs bsdoms 'then sgyur bgod kyi rnam grangs bzhi po rdel rtsis skabs rtsi stangs ji ltar yin nam zhe na/ rkyang rdel skabs gtso bor bsdoms 'then gnyis spyod cing / zur 'gro khyad rtsis skabs gtso bor sgyur bgod dus mtshungs par byed pa bre khyad skabs zhor du zhu rtsis yod/grangs ka'i thad‘‘gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung 49

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phyur sogs/ /rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya/’’zhes gzhung der dngos su gsal ba dang / ma gsal ba‘ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang / /gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang / /spang rten ded 'dren mtha' sna dang / /rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs 'byin rtogs 'gro 'bying rdul dang / /rgya rtags stobs 'khor bar shes dang / /rnam byung stobs mig khyad 'byin dang / /byams pa snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms rnams ni chen por bcas/ /gnyis gnyis grangs med tha ma ste/ /bcu 'gyur rig pas bsgre ba yin/’’zhes gnas drug cu'i bar du brtsi rgyu yod pa yongs grags dang / bka' 'gyur nang 'jig rten gyi khams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i brjod du med pa zhes pa mang po thon pa'i grangs gnas ji lta bu yin snyam na/ (mdo phal po che'i〉 grangs la 'jug pa bstan pa'i le'u'i nang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi grangs bstan par/brgya stong phrag brgya na bye ba'o zhes pa nas brjod du med pa'i brjod du med pa bsgres pa'i bar grangs gnas chen po re res bsgyur ba'i grangs gnas brgya dang sum cu gsungs pa'i grangs gnas ni gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul dang mnyam pa lta bu'i grangs gnas rig pa mi 'dus pa yin pa yang nga tshos shes dgos pa'i don zhig yin pa skabs 'dir zhor la 'phros shing / grangs gnas zhib cha mkhyen 'dod na (phal chen〉 〈ga〉pa'i shog grangs 371par gsal/de snga'i bod kyi 'degs gshor 'jal gsum so so'i hril grangs nas cha shas su gsil ba'i tshad gzhi gcig gyur de ltar yang yul gru so so'i bre srang che chung gi bre khyad dang / srang khyad ni mi 'dra ba mang / dper na/ rtsam 'bru sogs gshor byed la bogs 'bo'i khal dang / gtan tshigs mkhar ru'i khal 50

(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/lta bu gcig tu ma nges rung dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur rjes tshad gzhi gcig gyur lta bur 'bru gtsang gtan ru'i khal gcig la rgya ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang /mar khal rer rgya ma bcu'am yang na lha khal gsum la rgya ma nyi shu brtsi srol chags pa/ 'degs gshor mang che ba srang bcu'i rgya ma'i thog nas byed pa/'jal byed spyi khre'i thog nas byed pa bcas de dag spyod stabs bde ba dang /rtsis rgyag bde ba sogs spyi tshogs gsar pa'i dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs dang mthun pa yin/ de snga'i bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs dang mthun pa'i 'degs gshor 'jal gsum dang / 'degs gshor 'jal gsum gyi tshad gzhi de dag dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams kyang lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul zhig tu gyur pa las deng skabs bed spyod kyi nus pa thon mi thub pa de ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang bstun dgos pa der rag las/lo rgyus smra ba po yin na lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul phra rags rtogs dgos pa dang / lhag par nga tsho'i mes po tshos mes rgyal gyi lo rgyus thog chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ 'dzugs skrun sogs gang sar byas rjes chen po bzhag pa ni ji ltar thigs pa bsags pa'i rgya mtsho ji bzhin khyim tshang gcig tu 'dzoms pa yin/ de snga'i bod kyi dpal 'byor rig pa'i khongs su 'du ba'i 'degs gshor 'jal gsum gyi tshad gzhi dang mthun pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rdel rtsis kyi rig pa'i tshan khag 'di yang nga tsho'i lo rgyus kyi khyon yongs la bltas na bod kyi rigs gzhung nor bu'i bang mdzod nang gi nor bu'i ya gyal mi rigs rig gnes kyi shul rgyun zhig yin pa ma zad/ mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug bya rgyur dpyad gzhi'i rin thang chen po ldan pa bcas 51

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/re zhig gleng gzhi'i gtam ni 'di tsam gyis 'thus par byas so//gzhung don dngos kyi skor/thog mar gzhung spyi'i lus mdor bsdus nas bstan pa ni/ gzhung las‘thog mar bre khyad la yang zur dang 'gro/ /sngon ma'i cha 'gros rtsi dang sgyur bgod byed/ /'bor nas spor gcog byed dang rnam pa lnga/ /de dag thams cad don la khyad med kyang / /bogs 'bo che chung rnam grangs mang ba yis /bre khyad yong lugs mi 'dra bsam las 'das/ /la lar zur mgyogs la lar 'gro mgyogs shing / /de bzhin cha 'gros rtsi dang sgyur bgod byed/ /spor gcog byed bcas so sor mgyogs pa yod/ /mgyogs na dag cing 'gor na sngon ma rnams/ /phyi ma gtong dus brjed pas cung mi dag /mgyogs par gtong la gtong lugs rnam pa lnga/ /gang 'gror gtong ba 'dus byung pa yi gnad/ /de yang gtong lugs lnga yi sde tshan las/ /thog mar zur rtsis rtsis kyi ka kha zhes/ /blo rmongs rig pa'i sgo 'byed 'di ltar ro/ ’’zhes 'khod pa 'chad 'gyur gyi gzhung bre khyad gtong ba'i lugs 'di la zur dang / 'gro/sngon ma sngon ma'i cha 'gros nas phyi ma'i phyi mar rtsi ba/ ri mo'i cho ga sgyur bgod byed pa/ mgyogs khyad rtsal du bton te 'bor nas spor gcog byed pa bcas rtsis 'go rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas ston la de dag thams cad don la khyad par med mod/ yul gru so so'i lugs su chags pa'i gshor byed kyi 'bo gcig tu ma nges pa de dag dbar gyi bre khyad yong lugs kyang mi 'dra ba ji snyed la brten skabs re zur mgyogs pa dang / skabs re 'gro mgyogs pa/ de 52

(de'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/bzhin sngon ma'i cha 'gros brtsi ba dang / sgyur bgod byed pa/ rtsa 'bor nas spor gcog byed pa bcas rtsis gzhi gang dang gang la rtsi thabs gang dang gang mgyogs pa'i gnad ka yod gshis/ ji tsam mgyogs pa de tsam gyis rde'u 'gor gzhi chung ba dang / ji tsam 'gor na rtsis gzhi de'i sngon ma'i tshig don rnams rde'u phyi ma gtong skabs brjed sla bas rtsis nor mi dag pa'i skyon du 'gyur 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rde'u mgyogs par gtong ba'i thabs la gong du bstan pa'i gtong lugs rnam pa lngas gang la gang bde stabs bstun mkhas pos gtong dgos pa ni 'dus byung pa bdag gi man ngag gi gnad dam pa yin no zhes sngon 'gro'i tshul du gdams pa'o/ /gcig zur rtsis ni/ gzhung las/ ‘‘thog mar zur rtsis rtsis kyi ka kha’’zhes bstan pa ltar rdel rtsis la 'jug pa'i thog mar zur rtsis 'di ni ji ltar yi ge slob pa la 'jug skabs thog mar ka kha nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa bzhin zur gyi gnad don 'di klad ma kho nar khong du chud dgos pa yin/ de yang‘‘zur ’zhes pa ni dper na brtsi bya'i 'bru 'bor gtan tshigs mkhar ru lta bur mtshon na dngos su gshor byed bogs 'bo yin pa'i dbang du btang zhing /spyir btang mkhar ru las bogs 'bo che ba yod stabs de'i dbar gyi bre khyad ji ltar thon pa dngos su gshor 'jal bogs 'bo'i grangs 'bor nas sbyangs dgos pa'i bar khyad der bza' 'am‘‘zur’’zhes grags/ brtsi bya'i 'bor gtan tshigase mkhar ru khal gcig la bre nyi shu yin kyang / dngos su gshor byed bogs 'bo la khal med bre bco brgyad las mi thon par cha bzhag brtsi bya'i 'bru 'bor khal gcig la bre nyi shu yin pa ldab bcag dum bur gsil na bre do pa bcu yong ba dang / dngos su gshor byed la bre bco brgyad las mi thon pa 53

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de yang ldab bcag dum bur gsil na bre do pa dgu yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhung lalo‘bre ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu’’zhes gsal ba ltar brtsi bya'i 'bor mkhar ru nas dngos su gshor byed bogs 'bo'i steng nas bcu cha gcig chag pas dngos su bcu cha dgu brtsi dgos pa'i gnas lugs gsal por rtogs dgos pa ni zur rtsis kyi 'gag rtsa'i gnad don yin/da ni zur rtsis ji ltar gtong ba'i skor gzhung las‘bre ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu/ /bcu bdun phul ni phyed lnga drug cha gcig /byung na khal gyi dgu cha brgyad yin la/ /bcu bdun phul gsum khal gyi brgyad cha bdun/ /bcu drug phul bzhi khal gyi drug cha lnga/ /bre ni bcu drug khal gyi lnga cha bzhi/ /bco lnga phul gsum sum cha dgu cha bdun/ /bco lnga khal gyi bzhi cha gsum yin la/ /bcu bzhi khal gyi bcu cha bdun du 'dod/ /bcu gsum phul do khal gyi sum cha gnyis/ /bcu gnyis phul gsum khal gyi brgyad cha lnga/ /bre ni bcu gnyis khal gyi lnga cha gsum/ /bcu gcig phul phyed drug cha dgu cha lnga/ /bre bcu phyed thob bre brgyad phul lnga dang / /sum cha gcig byung khal gyi dgu cha bzhi/ /bre brgyad khal gyi lnga cha gnyis yin te/ /bre bdun phul gsum khal gyi brgyad cha gsum/ /bre drug phul bzhi khal gyi sum zur yin/ /bre lnga bzhi zur bre bzhi lnga yi zur/ /bre gsum phul do khal gyi drug zur yin/ /bre do phul bzhi khal gyi phyed brgyad zur/ /bre do phul gsum khal gyi brgyad zur yin/ /bre do phul gang sum cha dgu yi zur/ /bre do khal gyi bcu zur go sla mod/ /bre gang phul bzhi khal gyi bcu gnyis zur/ /bre gang phul do khal gyi bco lnga zur/ /bre gang phul ni phyed do bcu drug zur/ /bre gang phul phyed drug cha bco brgyad zur/ /bre gang nyi shu tham pa'i zur yin cing / /phul lnga khal gyi nyi shu rtsa 54

(rdo'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/bzhi'i zur/ /phul bzhi byung na sum cu tham pa'i zur/ /phul gsum bzhi bcu tham pa'i zur yin cing / /phul ni phyed gsum bzhi bcu zhe brgyad zur/ /phul do lnga cha gnyis ni lnga bcu'i zur/ /phul do drug cu tham pa'i zur yin la/ /phul ni phyed do brgyad cu tham pa'i zur/ /phul gang sum cha dgu bcu tham pa'i zur/ /phul gang bzhi cha dgu bcu go drug zur/ /phul gang lnga cha khal gyi brgya zur yin/ /phul gang dgu cha brgya dang brgyad kyi zur/ /phul gang brgya dang nyi shu tham pa'i zur/ /phul phyed nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i zur yin no/ /de las phra ba'i zur khyad mang yod kyang / /ha cang phra zhing phra bas bkod mi lang //dper na phul gyi sum cha gcig byung na/ khal gyi sum brgya drug cu'i zur yin pas/ /de yi rigs 'gre ded pas rtogs par 'gyur/ /'bor gyi phyogs su zur khyad byung ba na/ /bre khyad phyogs su phar la btang bas 'grig’’ces dang‘‘gong du gcig 'phar bcur 'gyur te/ /brgya sogs rig pas shes par nus’’zhes gsal ba ltar gnas gong nas gong du spor rgyu dang / khal ma longs pa'i bre phul gyi cha phyi nang so so'i gnas rnams gong du gleng gzhi'i skabs zhib cha 'phros zin pa ltar de'u dngos su gtong skabs brtsi bya'i 'bor mkhar ru'i khal chig khri lta bur mtshon na de thad dkyil mdzub btsugs nas rdel skad ngag skyor ni‘‘bre ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu yin pas bcu byung na dgu/brgya byung na dgu bcu/ stong byung na dgu brgya/ khri byung na khal dgu stong gtong rgyu rang la yin’’(bod kyi del rtsis kyi khyad chos gzhan zhig ste sgyur bgod dus mtshungs par byed pa de ji lta bu yin nam zhe na/ khal gcig la bre nyi shu yin pa/ bre do pa gnyis la bgos pa'i thob nor ni bre do pa bcu yong ba dang /khal gcig la bre nyi shu yin pas rkyen gyis bre bco brgyad dam bre do pa dgu ni 55

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/khal gyi bcu dgu cha yin zhes pa ni bgos rtsis skabs dang / sgyur ni de lta bu'i bcu cha dgu yod pa gang zhig khal bcu sogs la sgyur na bcu byung na dgu dang / brgya byung na dgu bcu zhes rim par sgyur dgos pa ni sgyur rtsis kyi skabs yin pa shes dgos so)zhes khyad bcag dngos su gshor byed bogs 'bo'i thog khal dgu stong btang ste rtsa 'bor mkhar ru nas khal chig khri spyangs pas bogs 'bor dbar gyi bca' khyad khal chig stong rang shugs su chag 'gro bas bca' khyad khal chig stong bcag ces dmigs bsal brjod mi dgos pa de ni brtsi 'bor che chung dang / bca' khyad che chung ji ltar yin rung spyi 'gros 'dis bca' khyad brtsi stangs bde blag tu rtogs nus pa yin/gshor byed phyogs kyi zur khyad de ni gtan tshigs mkhar ru dang /mkhar 'bo'i bar/ de min gshor byed gang dang gang yin dbar bsgrub bya'i 'bo las gshor byed kyi 'bo che ba dngos su gshor skabs ci dgos zur rtsis kyi spyi 'gros 'di'i thog nas rtsi nus pa dang / rde'u'i cho gar 'jug skabs brtsi bya'i 'bor gtan ru lta bur mtshon na de'i 'bor ci yod kyi rde'u thog mar bkram pa'i thog nas bre khyad ji thon gyi zur khyad blo la nges pa byas thog de'i logs su ngo thog gshor dgos pa khyad bcag zin pa'i 'bor bkod de mthar bsgrub 'bor 'di la khyad thob khal 'di thon gyi kha dmar gsal por bstan mjug bsgrub 'bor gyi grangs ka go mi chod pa sbyangs te khyad 'bor gang yin dngos su 'jal byed kyi grangs 'bor la 'dzin dgos pa bcas zur khyad skor 'di tsam gyis 'thus par byas so/ /gnyis/ 'gro ni/ gzhung las‘de nas 'gro yi gtong lugs ma shes na//'ga' zhig bre bdun lta bu byung ba'i tshe/ /lnga la bzhi zur do la bcu zur 56

(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/gtong / /bre dgu byung na lnga la bzhi zur dang / /bzhi la lnga zur gtong ba de bzhin du/ /bcu bdun byung na bcu la phyed thob dang / /lnga la bzhi zur do la bcu zur sogs/ /dum bu dum bur gsil nas gtong ba yis/ /del gzhi re la gtong thengs mang dgos pas/ /rgyun ring ngal dub btang rjes dag pa dkon’’zhes 'byung ba ltar 'gro yi gtong lugs 'di ni gnad phig po dgos pa las/ gal srid zur gyi spyi 'gros nas rgyas bkab ste bre bdun lta bur mtshon na bre lnga la bzhi dang / yang bskyar bre do la bcu zur lta bu dum bur gsil nas btang na/ rdel gzhi gcig la gtong thengs mang po byed dgos pa'i rkyen gyis rdel 'gor che la btang rjes kyi grangs 'bor tshad ma zhig yong dka' bas de lta bu'i gtong stangs dgos par bstan thog dngos gzhi 'gro'i rtsis la rnam grangs gnyis te mnyam pa cha dang / mi mnyam pa ya'i sgo nas gtong dgos pa yin/'gro zhes pa ni gong gi zur rtsis dang ldog pa sa zhing gi sa bogs lta bur mtshon na sa bogs bsgrub dgos pa'i rtsa 'bor bogs 'bo'i grangs de mkhar ru'i thog nas 'jal ba yin na bogs 'bo che ba dang / gtan ru chung ba'i bar khyad ji thon 'jal byed mkhar ru'i thog snon pa'am 'gro dgos pa der 'gro bya ba yin/ de yang mnyam pa cha dang / mi mnyam pa ya zhes khag dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan yang bca' khyad de mgyogs par rtsi bde ba'i dbang du btang ba zhig red/ dper na/ bca' khyad bre gsum yin na bsnan bya'i yul gyi khal de bre nyi shu rang la rtsis te nyi shu byung na gsum 'gro zhes 'bor thog bsnan pas khyad bcas 'bor de khal gcig byung na spor bca' bre gsum la 'gro bas khal nyi shu byung na gsum/ nyis brgya byung na sum cu zhes rim 'gros kyis yang tig 57

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rtsa 'bor bogs khal nyis brgya lta bur mtshon na khyad khal sum cu bsnan pas dngos su sgrub 'bor mkhar ru'i khal nyis brgya sum cur 'gro ba de dang /mnyam pa cha la bltas na rtsi stangs de bas stabs bde yong ched bcu gnas rkyong sgril gyi thabs shes bar khyad bzhi thon pa lta bur mtshon na mnyam pa cha'i gtong lugs ni khal gcig la bre nyi shu yin pa ldab bcag gsil ba'i bre do pa bcu la brtsi ba dang / khyad thob bre bzhi yang ldab bcag gsil ba'i bre do la brtsis te bre do bcu nas gnyis la 'gro bas khal bcu byung na gnyis/ brgya byung na nyi shu 'gro ba ltar 'bor thog bsnan pas yang tig bsgrub bya bogs 'bor dngos su 'jal byed gtan ru'i steng du khal nyi shu bsnan pas 'jal 'bor khal nyis brgya nyi shur 'gro ba ltar cha dang ya gang yin rung 'gro'i rtsi stangs ltar byas te rdel gzhi de rtsi thengs gcig gis chog pas dum bu dum bur gsil ba'i ca sing mi dgos la nor gzhi yang chung / 'gro'i rtsis kyi spyi 'gros la mnyam dang mi mnyam gyi dbye ba yod pa las dang po mi mnyam pa ya gtong lugs gzhung las/‘‘de phyir 'gro yi gtong lugs 'di lta ste/ /bre gang nas bzung bcu dgu'i bar dag ni/ /ya rnams ma bcag nyi shu tham pa nas/ /mang rang grangs kyi thog tu nges par 'gro/ /de yi dper brjod bstan na 'di ltar yin/ /bre gsum byung na nyi shu gsum 'gro yin/ /bre bdun nyi shu bdun 'gro nyid du shes/ /bre dgu dag ni nyi shu dgu 'gro yin/ /bre ni bcu gcig nyi shu bcu gcig 'gro/ /bcu gsum nyi shu bcu gsum 'gro yin cing / /bcu bdun nyi shu bcu bdun 'gro ba dang / /bcu dgu nyi shu bcu dgu 'gro yin pas/ /de rnams ma bcag nyi shu tham pa nas/ /rang rang grangs kyi thog tu 'gro ba ni//mi mnyam pa yi 'gro yi dper brjod yin ’/ gnyis pa mnyam pa cha'i 58

(de'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/gtong lugs gzhung las‘mnyam pa'i cha rnams bcu nas rang rang gi /gyed bcag grangs kyi thog tu 'gro ba yin/ /de yang go sla'i dper brjod 'di ltar ro/ /bre drug bcu nas gsum la 'gro ba dang / /bre brgyad byung na bcu nas bzhi la 'gro /bcu gnyis bcu nas drug la 'gro ba yin/ /bcu bzhi bcu nas bdun 'gro dag tu 'dod/ /bre ni bcu drug bcu nas brgyad la 'gro /bco brgyad bcu nas dgu la 'gro ba sogs/ khal re'i thog tu 'phar ba'i bre phul la/ khyad des bsgyur bgod byas nas 'gro btsal bas/ 'gro la nye ring ma gtogs med pa med/ nye na gtong sla ring na cung zad 'gor ’zhes gsal ba ltar lags so/ /gsum/ cha 'gros ni/ gzhung las‘sngon ma'i cha 'gros bltas nas gtong ba ni/ /bye khyad de nas bre phul cha phran rnams/ /sngon ma'i phyed dam gsum zur bzhi zur sogs/ /gang nas gang du 'gro dgos legs brtag nas/ /de ga'i cha shas ded nas gtong ba yin ’zhes gsal ba gtso bor 'bo khyad de bre gang dang do'am yang na bre phyed gnyis lta bu cung hril grangs min pa bre phul dang rdog dzar mang bas zur dang 'gro rtsis lugs kyis go chod dka' ba'i rigs la dang po bre'i bca'/ gnyis pa phul gyi bca'/ gsum pa rdog ma'i bca' bcas skabs bstun rtsis gzhi dang bstun te zur khyad de snga ma'i 'gros la bltas nas phyi ma gtong ba'i lugs ni rdel 'gor chung bar brten cha 'gros brtsi ba'i thabs 'di bstan/gzhung las/ ‘‘de yi dper brjod bstan na 'di ltar yin/ /bogs 'bo'i khal gcig lta bur mkhar ru yi/ /bre gang phul gang gsum cha gcig byung na/ /gsum cha gsum la phul gang yong ba dang / /phul drug bre gang 59

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /bre gang thob btang de yi drug zur btang / /slar yang de yi gsum zur gtong ba yin/ /bre drug phul ni phyed do'i khyad yod na/ /bre lnga btang zhing de yi bzhi zur gtong / /bre gsum phul ni phyed lnga yod pa na//brgyad zur btang zhing de yi phyed cha gtong / /bre bdun phul gsum byung na bre lnga btang / /de yi phyed cha btang nas mgyogs pa sogs/ /de yi rigs 'gre sngon ma'i cha 'gros nas/ /phra ba phyi ma'i cha 'gros brtsis pa na/ /rde'u mgyogs pa'i rnam grangs mang yod kyang / /'gro ba btang zhing mi 'gro spang bar bya/’’zhes gsal ba ltar/ dper na bogs 'bo'i khal cig lta bur dngos su 'jal byed mkhar ru'i khal gcig dang bre gang phul gang sum cha gcig thon na bar khyad bre gang phul gang sum cha gcig byung ba'i cha 'gros rtsi stangs ni phul gyi sum cha gsum la phul gang dang phul drug la bre gang brtsi ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis thog mar bre gang gi bca' khyad thog nyi shu zur bstan pa dang de nas phul gang gi bcar bre'i drug zur gtong ba/ de nas sum cha'i bcar phul gyi sum zur btang ba rnams gcig tu dril na dngos su 'jal byed thog bca' khyad bsnan zin pa'i 'bor de grub pa sogs rags pa sngon ma'i cha 'gros nas phra ba phyi ma'i cha 'gros rtsis na mgyogs pa'i dge mtshan yod pa sogs rtsi thabs mgyogs pa gtong zhing / 'gor gzhi che ba'i rigs spang dgos par bstan pa'o /bzhi/ bre khyad sgyur bgod ni/ gzhung lalo‘de nas bre khyad sgyur bgod gtong lugs ni/ /ri mo'i cho ga dag dang cha mtshungs pas/ khal yan mgyogs shing nor 'khrul chung na yang / /bre phul rnams la rde'u tshogs che bas//rgyun ring ngal ba'i rgyu yin 'dir ma bshad ’ces gsungs pa bzhin sgyur bgod 60

(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/ni ri mo'i cho ga ste sa ris dang mtshungs pas brtsi bya'i 'bor gyi khal yan la mgyogs shing nor 'khrul chung bas dgos pa che yang / khal man gyi bre phul gyi cha rdel tshogs che la 'gor gzhi che ba'i rgyur dgongs nas gzhung 'dir dngos su bstan med pa ni/ khal man gyi bre phul rdog ma'i gnas gong mar spo ba'i grangs ka deng dus lta bu bcu la rkyong sgril mi byed pa skar rtsis skabs kyi rang rang 'khor lo lta bu brgya dang nyi shu dang / drug nyi shu lta bu'i bar khyad che bas sgyur bgod gcig gyur mi bde ba'i rgyu mtshan der thug cing / khal yan gyi gnas ni rkyong sgril bcu la nges pas sgyur bkod bya rgyu stabs bde ba'i rkyen gyis red/ khal man bre phul sogs la rim par khal steng nas bre thog phab pa nyi shus sgyur/ bre de phul thog phab pa drug gis sgyur bar bca' khyad rtsis te slar yang gong du sgril na 'grig pa gsar bu bar blo bskyed yong ched du smos pa las/ don du zur rtsis kyi skabs su bstan pa bzhin sgyur bgod chabs cig byed pa las 'di ltar rtsis na rdel tshogs lag 'gor che bas lag len nang du yang rtsi srol med/ gzhung las/ ‘‘'bor gyi khal yan bre khyad khal bre phul/ /rim gyis bsgyur zhing cha phran yod pa na/ /cha phran gnas der bsgyur ba mi dgos pas/ /gang yin cha yis bgos pa phul la bsre/ /phul de drug bgos bre yi steng du byin/ /bre de nyi shus bgos pa khal la bsre/ /go ba ster phyir dpe ru bstan pa yin/ /rde'u gtong dus sgyur bgod chabs cig las/ /sdebs bsgyur 'og rim bgod sgril byas pa na/ del tshogs lag 'gor gnyis ka cung zad tshe’zhes gsungs pas go nus so/ /lnga/ mgyogs rtsis ni/ gzhung las‘de nas mgyogs rtsis spor gcog byed 'dod na/ /spor gcog la yang rnam pa gnyis yod de/ /ngo thog gcog 61

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang 'bun gyi spor gcog byed/ /ngo bor spor gcog byed na bogs 'bo la/khal gcig yod med gang ltar khyad spar nas/ khal la ma longs tsam zhig yod pa na/ /bre khyad khal yongs khal la bslangs pa yi/ /bre phul cha la sogs pa gang byung ba'i/ /bar khyad gang byung de ga'i khyad btang nas/ khal gcig yod na 'bor de gnyis kyis bsgyur/ khal med 'bor yang de kha'i thog nas bzos/ /lag 'gor nor 'khrul gnyis ka chung ba yin/ /de yi dper brjod bstan na 'di ltar ro/ khyad la bre grangs bcu drug phul bzhi byung /khal longs bar khyad bre gsum phul do yin/ /drug zur btang ba 'bor steng bzos pas dag /bcu bdun phul gsum lta bu byung ba na/ khal longs bar khyad bre do phul gsum yin/ /brgyad zur btang ba 'bor steng bzos pas dag /bco brgyad phul do byung na bcu gnyis zur/ /bar khyad yin pa gong bzhin byas pas dag /de yi rigs 'gre khal la bre khyad kyis/ /sbyangs lhag bar khyad yin pas bar khyad kyi/ bre khyad gtong ba ngo thog spor gcog yin’’zhes gsal ba ltar mgyogs rtsis kyi spor gcog byed thabs la ngo thog spor gcog byed pa dang / 'bun gyi spor gcog byed pa khag gnyis yod/dang po ngo thog spor gcog byed stangs ni/ 'bor la 'khyer dgos pa bogs 'bo gtan ru'i khal ma longs tsam zhig yod na ma longs pa'i bre khyad snon dgos pa la khal longs bar khyad zer zhing / yang de lta bus khal la bslangs pa'i bar khyad rtsis te gtong ba nas khyad la khal gcig yod na 'bor de gnyis kyis sgyur ces bogs 'bo de gtan ru las ldab kyis che ba rtogs sla zhing /khal med 'bor yang zhes pa ni gtan ru las bogs 'bo chung ba'i dbang du btang ste khal ma longs pa'i bar khyad bogs 'bo'i thog nas bzos na lag 62

(de'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/'gor dang nor 'khrul gnyis ka chung / dper na khyad la bre bcu drug dang phul bzhi byung na khal longs bar khyad bre gsum phul do yin pas de ni zur gyi skabs bre gsum phul do khal gyi drug cha yin zhes pa'i spyi 'gros ltar drug zur rtsis pa'i thob de 'bor steng nas bzos na dngos su 'jal byed mkhar rur dag pa lta bu yin/khal longs bar khyad dang / khyad longs bar khyad ces rnam grangs gnyis mchis pa'i dang po'i skor gong du bshad zin cing / gnyis pa bar khyad ces pa bogs khal gcig la ru'i khal ma longs pa'i cha der ngos 'dzin dgos la khal longs bar khyad ni ma longs pa'i cha gsab dgos pa der ngos 'dzin dgos/ gnyis pa/ 'bun gyi spor gcog ces pa bogs 'bo'i khal dang mkhar ru'i khal dbar bar khyad 'bun 'gro ba ste bogs 'bo'i khal gcig la mkhar ru'i khal gcig dang bre brgyad phul lnga phul gyi sum cha gcig byung na 'bor gnas gnyis bzhag 'bor gcig thog nas 'bun gnyis te sum gnyis bcag 'phros 'bun gcig ste sum gcig 'bor gcig shos thog bsnan na mkhar ru'i grangs 'bor 'phar bas dngos su 'jal dgos pa'i mkhar ru'i grangs 'bor la nges pa yin/ de yang gzhung las/ ‘‘gnyis pa 'bun gyi spor gcog byed lugs ni/ /'bun gyi spor gcog byas nas gtong ba ni/ /dper brjod mdo tsam bstan na 'di ltar yin/ /bogs 'bo'i khal rer mkhar ru'i khal gcig dang / /bre brgyad phul lnga phul gyi sum cha gcig /byung na 'bor la sum gnyis bcag pa de/ /'bor gcig thog tu bsres na dag pa yin/ /'bo gzhan khal rer mkhar ru'i bre bco lnga/ /phul gsum phul gyi sum cha gcig byung na/ /'bor gyi sum zur gcig la 'bun bcag pa//63

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'bor nas bzos pa nyid kyis rtogs par 'gyur/ khal gcig bre bzhi phul ni phyed gsum dang / phul gyi drug cha gcig gi khyad yod na/ /sum zur steng nas 'bun gcig bcag pa de/ /'bor la bsres pas skad cig nyid la dag khyad la bre grangs bcu gcig phul phyed dang / /phul gyi drug cha byung na 'bor gnyis bzhag /gcig la 'bun gnyis bcag lhag gcig steng nas/ /bzos pas ma nor mkhar rur dag par 'gyur/ /bogs 'bo'i khal rer mkhar ru'i khal gcig dang / /bre brgyad phul ni phyed gsum brgyad cha gcig /byung na 'bor de gnyis bzhag gcig po la/ /gtsang 'bun thengs gsum bcag pa gcig la bsre/ /de bzhin de dang rigs 'gre'i rigs rnams la/ /spor gcog de bzhin byas pas dag cing mgyogs ’zhes bstan pa ltar lags/drug gzhis khag thon skor gyi sa bcad ni/ de snga'i rdel rtsis nang cung stabs bde ba'i lhu tshigs shig yin par brten skabs 'dir dpyad 'grel gyi ngal ba ma dgos pa btang snyoms su bzhagabadun/ cha phran ni/ gzhung las‘de nas cha phran sgril lugs bshad par bya/ /nye ba'i cha dang ring ba'i sgril lugs dang / /shin tu ring ba'i cha dang gsum du yod/ /nye ba'i cha la sum cha bzhi cha dang / /drug cha gsum 'dzoms bcu gnyis cha ru rkyong / /gong gi cha phran thog tu brgyad cha yod/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i cha ru 'dzoms par byed/ /bdun cha dgu cha rkyong bsgril rigs gyur la/ /cha phran phal cher brgya dang nyi shu'i char/ /rkyong sgril byas pas mi 'grig gang yang med’’ces cha phran ni bod kyi rdel rtsis nang med du mi rung ba'i cha shas brtsi stangs thun mong ma yin pa de'i gnad kyi gtso bo dpal 'byor gyi 64

〈rdo'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/rtsis gzhi gang dang gang gi cha shas dum bu brgya dang nyi shur gsil nas shin tu phra ba'i cha shas su rtsi thub pa brgya go gcig chod kyi rtsi thabs shig yin/ dper na sa khang zhing gsum dang / phyugs rigs dkar nag rin chen gyi rigs/ bza' bca'i rigs sogs dpal 'byor gyi dngos po mchis so cog zhib phra'i rtsis rgyag byed skabs cha phran ma spyad par cha shas rtsi thabs med pas cha phran ni del rtsis skabs shin tu gnad che ba'i dum bu zhig yin stabs 'di'i skor gyi gnas lugs cung zhib par gleng 'dod pa 'di lta ste/cha phran sgril lugs la nye ba'i cha dang / ring ba'i cha/ shin tu ring ba'i cha bcas khag gsum la dbye zhing / nye ba'i cha ni brtsi bya 'bru rigs lta bur mtshon na phul gang gi sum cha dang / bzhi cha/ drug cha'i bar dang ring ba'i cha la brgyad cha dang / bcu gnyis cha'i bar/ shin tu ring ba'i cha ni nyer bzhi'i cha'i bar ngos 'dzin pa ni rags pa'i dbang du yin/ zhib pa shin tu ring ba'i cha ni nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i bar rkyong rgyu yod/ ches nyung shas bdun cha dang / dgu cha lta bu 'dzar phran bu lus rigs ni phyi nang rdog ma bkral bas kyang shin tu phra ba'i 'dzar lus pa dor dgos pa bcas rdog ma rkyong stangs de ltar nyid la sgril stangs ni rdog ma drug cu longs na phul phyed dang /brgya dang nyi shu longs na phul gang btang bas 'thus/ cha phran gyi cha bkral stangs dpe mtshon tsam du yi ge'i thog nas mtshams sbyor zhu na(phul gyi)phyed gsum cha la(cha)zhe brgyad/ sum cha gcig la bzhi bcu/ bzhi cha gcig la sum cu/ bzhi cha phyed gnyis la bzhi bcuzhe lnga/ lnga cha gcig la nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ lnga cha phyed gnyis la sum cu so drug drug cha gcig la nyi shu tham pa brgya dang nyi shu'i cha la gcig nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i cha la phyed bar 65

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lugs 'byung lta bur mtshon na de ltar yin la lugs ldog tu zhe brgyad cha la phyed gsum/ bzhi bcu tham pa'i cha la gsum/ sum cu pa'i cha la bzhi/zhe lnga'i cha la drug nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i cha la lnga/ so drug cha la phyed brgyad/nyi shu tham pa'i cha la drug nas nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i bar gyi cha phran gyi re'u mig ngag skyor gtong thub pa byang ma byung na dngos gzhi rde'u'i rnam grangs ji ltar mang ba dang / grangs 'bor che chung gang yin la ma bltas pa de'u gtong skabs rde'u gtong mkhan la de'us tshur skul ba lta bu rkyong sgril lam lam du thub pa las/ sgyur bgod ji dgos la bsam blo zhib cha gtong ba'am yang na re re bzhin brtsi mi dgos pa'i dge mtshan mang po yod/cha phran rkyong tshul dang gnas gong mar sgril dgos pa'i skor/ gzhung lalo‘de las phra ba'i cha phran thams cad kyang / /shin tu ring ba'i cha la rkyong dgos pas/ /chig khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya'i cha la 'gro /sgril dus brgya dang nyi shu longs pa na/ /phul gang yin cing drug cu phul phyed yin/ /drug cu ma longs rang rang so so'i cha/ /thog tu longs na rang rang gong gi cha/ /de yis cha phran sgril lugs rtogs par 'gyur’’zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhung gi dngos bstan chig khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya'i cha la 'gro ba ni phul gang la nang gi rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul gyi cha shas brgya dang nyi shur 'gro ba/ nang gi rdog ma gcig la phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul cha chig khri bzhi stong bzhi brgyar(14400)'gro ba 'di ni gzhung bstan chig khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya'i cha la 'gro zhes pa del rtsis skabs spyir btang phyi'i rdog ma man dor ba der dmigs nas gsungs shing / shin tu ring ba'i cha la brkyang na phyi'i rdog ma gcig la de phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul cha sa ya gcig dang bdun 66

〈rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/'bum nyis khri brgyad stong(1728000)la 'gro ba/ de phyi'i rdog ma gcig la yang phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul cha dung phyur gnyis dang sa ya bdun dang sum 'bum drug khri'i(207360000)char 'gro ba/ yang phyi'i rdog ma gcig la mthil phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul cha ther 'bum chen po gnyis dang ther 'bum bzhi dang dung phyur brgyad dang bye ba brgyad sa ya gsum nyis 'bum tham pa'i(24883200000)char 'gro ba/ mthil phyi'i rdog ma gcig la ko phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang nyi shu ste phul cha khrag khrig chen po gnyis dang khrag khrig dgu ther 'bum chen po brgyad ther 'bum lnga dung phyur dgu bye ba brgyad sa ya bzhi'i(2985984000000)char 'gro ba de go bder bshad na phul cha dung phyur nyis khri dgu stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu nga dgu dang bye ba brgyad sa ya bzhi'i char gsil thub pa yin no/ /brgyad/ nyag khrad dang / dngul khyad ni/ gzhung las/ ‘‘de bzhin nyag khyad la yang nyag yan de/ /bre dang khyad med phul dang spor gnyis por/ /bzhi dang drug gi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ /bre khyad lugs bzhin btang bas phul gyi sar/ /'bun gcig bcag pas spor du legs par 'gro/ /nyag ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu /bcu bdun spor do khal gyi brgyad cha bdun/ /nyag ni bcu drug khal gyi lnga cha bzhi/ /nyag ni bco lnga khal gyi bzhi cha gsum/ /nyag ni bcu bzhi khal gyi bcu cha bdun/ bcu gsum spor gang sum cha sum cha gnyis/ /nyag ni bcu gnyis khal gyi lnga cha gsum/ /bcu gcig sum cha dgu cha dgu cha lnga/ /nyag bcu phyed thob nyag brgyad spor phyed bzhi/ /bco brgyad cha byung khal gyi dgu cha bzhi/ /nyag brgyad khal gyi lnga cha gnyis yin te/ /nyag bdun spor do khal gyi brgyad cha gsum/ /nyag drug 67

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/spor ni phyed gsum drug cha gcig /byung na khal gyi sum zur dag tu 'dod/ /nyag lnga khal gyi bzhi zur go sla mod/ /nyag bzhi khal gyi lnga zur yin pa dang / /nyag gsum spor gang sum cha drug zur yin/ /nyag do spor do khal gyi brgyad zur yin/ /nyag do spor phyed sum cha bco brgyad cha/ khal gyi dgu zur dag tu shes par bya/ /nyag do bcu zur nyag gang spor phyed gsum/ /drug cha byung na khal gyi bcu gnyis zur/ /nyag gang spor gang sum cha bco lnga zur/ /nyag gang spor gang khal gyi bcu drug zur/ /nyag gang sum cha dgu cha bco brgyad zur/ /nyag gang khal gyi nyi shu tham pa'i zur/ /spor gsum sum cha khal gyi nyer bzhi'i zur/ /spor gsum lnga cha khal gyi nyer lnga'i zur/ spor ni phyed gsum khal gyi so gnyis zur/ /spor do phyed lnga cha ni so drug zur/ /spor do khal gyi bzhi bcu tham pa'i zur/ /spor ni phyed do drug cha zhe brgyad zur/ /spor ni phyed do bcu cha lnga bcu'i zur/ /spor gang sum cha drug cu tham pa'i zur/ /spor gang bzhi cha drug cu re bzhi'i zur/ /spor gang dgu cha bdun cu don gnyis zur/ /spor gang khal gyi brgyad cu tham pa'i zur/ /spor phyed sum cha khal gyi go drug zur/ /spor phyed lnga cha phyed gnyis brgya yi zur/ /spor phyed drug cha brgya dang nyi shu'i zur/ /spor phyed khal gyi brgya dang drug cu'i zur/ /'gro ni nyag gsum nyi shu gsum 'gro yin/ /nyag drug dag ni nyi shu drug tu 'gro/ /nyag bdun byung na nyi shu bdun 'gro yin/ /nyag dgu byung na nyi shu dgu 'gro yin/ /nyag ni bcu gcig nyi shu bcu gcig 'gro/ /bcu gsum byung na nyi shu bcu gsum 'gro/ /bcu bdun byung na nyi shu bcu bdun 'gro/ /bcu dgu nyi shu bcu dgu 'gro yin no’’zhes bstan pa'i dang po/nyag khyad skor/ nyag yan chod rtsis gzhi bre dang khyad med cing / phul dang 68

(rde'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉 skor la dpyad pa/spor gnyis dbar bzhi dang drug ste 'bun khyad ltar phul gyi sa nas 'bun gcig bcag pas spor du 'gro ba de'i gnas lugs rtogs dgos pa gnad kyi dam par 'dzin dgos pa las gzhan zur khyad dang phal cher phyogs mthun pa nyag khyad skabs kyi spyi 'gros ltar rtsis na 'grig pa yin/dngul khyad skor/ gzhung las‘‘de nas dngul khyad gtong lugs 'di lta ste/ /zho dgu byung na srang gi bcu cha dgu /zho brgyad skar ma phyed dgu sum cha dang / /bco brgyad cha byung srang gi dgu cha brgyad/ /zho brgyad skar ma phyed brgyad byung ba na/ /srang gi brgyad cha bdun du 'gro ba yin/ /zho brgyad skar gsum sum cha drug cha lnga/ /zho brgyad srang gi lnga cha bzhi yin te/ /zho bdun skar ma phyed brgyad drug cha dang / /dgu cha byung na srang gi dgu cha bdun/ /zho bdun skar lnga srang gi bzhi cha gsum/ /zho bdun srang gi bcu cha bdun du 'gro /zho drug skar ma phyed bdun drug cha gcig /byung na srang gi sum cha gnyis su 'gro /zho drug skar ma phyed gsum brgyad cha lnga/ /zho drug srang gi lnga cha gsum yin cing / /zho lnga srang gi phyed thob go sla yod/ /zho bzhi srang gi phyed gsum zur yin cing / /zho gsum skar gsum sum cha sum zur yin/ /zho do skar lnga srang gi bzhi zur yin/ /zho do srang gi lnga zur nyid yin cing / zho gang skar ma phyed gsum brgyad zur yin/ /zho gang skar gang dgu cha dgu yi zur/ /zho gang bcu zur skar ma brgyad dang ni/ /sum cha byung na srang gi bcu gnyis zur/ /skar ni phyed bdun drug cha bco lnga zur/ /skar drug bzhi cha srang gi bcu drug zur/ /skar lnga srang gi nyi shu tham pa'i zur/ /skar bzhi srang gi nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zur/ /skar gsum sum cha sum cu tham pa'i zur/ /skar gsum brgyad cha srang gi so gnyis zur/ /skar ma 69

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phyed gsum bzhi bcu tham pa'i zur/ /skar ma do ni lnga bcu tham pa'i zur/ /skar ma phyed do drug cha drug cu'i zur/ /skar gang gsum cha srang gi don lnga'i zur/ /skar gang bzhi cha brgyad cu tham pa'i zur/ /skar gang dgu cha byung na dgu bcu'i zur/ /skar gang nyer bzhi'i cha ni go drug zur/ /skar gang srang gi brgya zur yin pa dang / /'gro ni zho gsum bcu nas gsum 'gro yin/ /zho bzhi bcu nas bzhi la 'gro byed cing / /zho drug byung na bcu nas drug la 'gro/ /zho bdun bcu nas bdun la 'gro ba ste/ /zho brgyad bcu nas brgyad la 'gro ba sogs/ /de yi rigs 'gre ded pas rtogs par 'gyur ’zhes gsal ba ltar rtsi thabs 'di ni deng dus dang 'dra bar bcu gnas rkyong sgril la brten rtsi stabs bde la skar ma yan gyi rtsi thabs deng skabs spyad na'ang phan nus yod pa zhig yin pa rtogs sla bas 'grel bshad dang / dpyad pa dgos don med pa bcas gzhung don sarga brgyad kyi dpyad 'grel re zhig zhu mtshams 'dir 'jog rgyu lags so/ /gsum pa/ bod kyi rdel rtsis kyi dge skyon/de snga'i bod kyi rdel rtsis ni deng dus khyab gdal du spyod la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor rig pa'i rtsis rig gi gzhung lugs cha tshang ba de 'dra dang bsdur na bkol spyod mi bde ba dang / rdel chas mig sngar mi mdzes pa sogs zhan cha yod pa smos ci/ bod kyi rig gnas tshan khag gzhan dang bsdur na'ang tshan khag 'di ni zhan cha che ba'i lhu tshigs shig yin snyam gyi yod/ gzhi rkang de snga'i bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis gzhi gang dang gang la de dang de'i rtsis 70

(rdo'u'i rtsis gzhung la dag ther byas pa rab sbyangs gser gyi me long 〉skor la dpyad pa/kyi rnam gzhag cha tshang ba yod kyang / de dag gi yig cha srid gzhung rnying pa'i yig tshang nang thor bur gnas pa las go rim yod pa'i sgo nas phyogs sgrig byas pa'i dpal 'byor rtsis rig gi yig lam rgya khyab tu mthong rgyu dkos tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus 'dus byung pa anan+tas rang gi las 'gan dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa'i rkyen gyis skabs 'dir kho bos dpyad bya rtsis gzhung ste zur rtsis rtsis kyi gnad don brgyad la dag ther dang 'brel phyogs sgrig gnang ba 'di dang / de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs bkras lhun drung zur ldan rje ngag dbang chos 'byor gyis kyang bkras lhun drung che'i las 'gan gnang myong ba'i rkyen gyis 'dus byung zur rtsis kyi gzhung don la 'grel bshad dang 'brel de skor gyi re'u mig dang bcas pa shing par thog brkos pa phyis tshang ma'i gzhi 'dzin sa lta bur gyur te de snga'i bod kyi slob grwa khag gi slob phrug rnams la yang 'dus byung zur rtsis re'u mig dang bcas pa bkram ste rde'u gtong stangs slob khrid byed pa tsam las de rjes rmang gzhi 'di'i thog gom gang mdun spos kyis dpyad pa'i 'bras bu yig lam nang bkod pa mthong rgyu med pa 'dis kyang rig pa'i tshan khag 'di dag bag la nyal ba mtshon thub/bod kyi rdel rtsis kyi dge mtshan skor/ dpal 'byor gyi rtsis rig ni dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs gang dang gang la de dang de'i rtsis kyi rig pa dang /de dang de'i khyad 'phags rang bzhin mngon thub pa zhig yin pa ltar de snga'i bod kyi lam lugs rnying pa'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi dang / bod kyi rdel rtsis kyi rig pa yongs su 'tshams pas skabs der del rtsis kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin gzhi nas mngon thub/ lam lugs dang dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi de 'dra'i 'og rtsis kyi gzhung lugs gsar pa dang / rtsis chas gsar pas 71

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/kyang de tsam go mi chod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de snga'i srid gzhung ngam/ rdzong gzhis/ tha na sger sogs gang yin rung deng rtsis pas nyin ltar rtsis tho khams dngas 'god pa dang dus mtshungs byung song kha 'thab gtong ba 'di 'dra min pa zla shas sam/ lo gcig yang na de las ring ba'i byung song rtsis rgyag nyin brgya dus gcig tu byed srol la brten rtsis kyi rnam grangs mang po phar 'thab tshur 'thab byung song kha 'thab so so'i kha dmar thig po gcig car 'don dgos pa ni zon ban nam glog 'gul rtsis chas 'phrul 'khor gyis kyang sgrub dka' ba'i nus pa thon thub pa ni gtso bo'i dge mtshan du mngon/gzhan yang cha shas rkyong sgril cha phran gyi re'u mig blo la chud pa de kho nas cha shas che chung ji ltar yin rung rtsis rgyag thub pa las rdel gzhi re re'i thog dmigs bkar gyi cha bkram ma dgos la rdel chas kyang gnad thang med pa shin tu stabs bde ba tha na rdel chas med pa'i gnas shig tu sleb na'ang skabs 'phral rin thang med pa'i dngos po kha shas rub bsdus byas pas rtsis gzhi che chung gang yin rung bde blag tu rtsi nus pa bcas mdor bsdus zhu na de tsam lags so/ /skyon cha ni/ ne+el chas de dag ltar snang du mi mdzes pa gdod ma'i rang bzhin lta bu glen rtags dod pa/ rtsis kyi rnam grangs mang po sdebs gcig tu rtsis rgyag skabs rtsis gzhi der gzhigs pa'i rtsib byang 'grems yul gyi sa cha yang 'os 'tshams dgos pa/ rdel tshogs che skabs rde'u'i rnam grangs gtong yul thag nye drags na de'u phar 'dril tshur 'dril gyis nor 'khrul yong sla ba dang / lhag par spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs la 'gyur ba yong skabs spyi tshogs gsar pa'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams mi thub pa bcas so /72

bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig rdel rtsis/bod kyi rdel rtsis ni 'dzam gling gi mi rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dpal 'byor gyi rtsis rig khyad par can zhig yin pa de'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi byung tshul dang / de'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos la thog ma'i dpyad gzhi rdel rtsis kyi gzhung las 'phros pa zhig kho bos 1984lo'i(bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉 bod yig dus deb thog spel ba dang chabs cig skabs der son pa'i dpyad gzhir gzhigs te re'u mig khag gcig kyang zhar du spel myong /'on kyang skabs der dpyad gzhi cha tshang ma rag pas re'u mig cha tshang min khar/re'u mig de rnams bklag thabs gsal bshad dgos rigs kyang bag la zha bas sngon chad rdel rtsis mthong thos ma myong ba'i blo mthun tshos re'u mig nang bkod pa'i ang kis gang dang gang bstan pa man ngag la ma brten na rtogs dka' bar brten rdel rtsis kyi gzhung la cung cha tshang ba'i dpyad pa dang / re'u mig cha tshang ba zhig 'byor na snyam pa sems la rgyun 'jags yod mus kyi skabs su mkhas dbang bon grong pa'am/ 'dus byung bas mdzad pa'i rdel rtsis gzhung re'u mig dang bcas pa shing dpar ma zhig lag tu son pa mdongs mtha' can la dbyar skyes rnga gsang ltar spro ba'i rtser 'dzegs te da lam dgu mtha' cha phul gyi re'u mig ngo ma sor bzhag bkod pa dang / rtsis gzhi sgyur bgod gang la tshul ji ltar dgos pa ci'i slad du 'jug pa bcas gsar bu bar gsal bshad smyug rtse'i zlos gar sgyur la blo ldan rnams gzigs mor spyon cig kye/73

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang po/ dgu mtha' ni/ rtsis rig kun la 'jug pa'i sgo chen yin pa deb khug 'khyer shes tsam gyi slob ma tshun chad kyis shes par gsal bshad kyi dgos pa ma mchis mod bod kyi rdel rtsis skabs kyi dgu mtha' dang / skar rtsis sngon 'gro'i skabs kyi dgu mtha' 'bri klog dbar bskyar ldab yod med kyi khyad par yod pa tsam blo la nges na 'grig khar/ dgu mtha'i re'u mig ma bkod kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang bod kyi rdel rtsis kyi re'u mig nang nas dgu mtha'i skor dbyung na re'u mig cha ma tshang bar gyur dogs re'u mig tu bstar ba lags/gsham gyi re'u mig dang por gzigs/gnyis pa/ cha phran ni/ thun mong min pa bod kyi bgod rtsis kyi gzhung lugs cha tshang ba de snga'i bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag la med thabs med pa'i rtsis shig yin/ de yang‘‘cha phran’’zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i go don gsal po rtogs dgos/ ‘‘cha’’zhes pa brtsi bya'i hril grangs te 'bru rigs 'jal gshor lta bur mtshon na phul yan rags pa'i dbang gis hril grangs su bzhag pa dang / de man cha shas su bgos pa'i thob nor cha shas lo‘cha ’'amapha‘rdog ma ’’zhes 'bod pa dang / ‘‘phran’’zhes pa phran tshegs sam chung ngu'i don te cha shas kyi cha shas su go na 'grig de yang gna' dus bre srang gi tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs('di skor zhib cha kho bos de snga spel ba'i rtsom yig der gzigs)skabs phul drug la bre gang dang / bre nyi shur khal gcig ste don du phul brgya dang nyi shur khal gcig brtsi ba'i 'gros de bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig kun la spyi khyab tu 'jug pa dngos zong thams cad kyi cha shas brgya dang nyi shu'i cha la rkyong sgril byed pa'i spyi 'gros 'di'i thog nas bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig gi thun mong min pa'i rang bzhin dang / rang tshugs kyi rang bzhin gsal por mtshon thub 74

bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig rdel rtsis/la bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig thog ma chags pa'i dus kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi gang yin pa dang / 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi mtshon yod/ de yang rtsis gzhi gang la tshul ji ltar dgos pa ci'i slad du zhe na/ rtsis gzhi 'bru rtsam lta bu cha shas su gsil dgos pa'i skabs khal yan bcu gnas rkyong sgril dang / bre gnas nyi shu/ phul gnas drug de man cha shas sam rdog ma'i gnas la nang gi rdog ma dang / phyi'i rdog ma/ de phyi'i rdog ma/ yang phyi'i rdog ma/ mthil phyi'i rdog ma/ rgu phyi'i rdog ma'am/ yang na nang gi cha dang / phyi'i cha lta bu ming gi rnam grangs ci rigs brjod pa cha shas nas cha shas grangs cha chung ngu gnas drug la gsil rgyu yod pa mtha' dag brgya dang nyi shu'i cha kho nar rim pa rim par rkyong sgril byed dgos pa ni rtsis gzhi gang la tshul de lta bus 'jug ci'i slad du zhe na/ cha shas nas hril grangs su rkyong sgril byed pa'i tshad gzhi gcig gyur dang / cha gang rung du bgos pa'i thob nor la phyug pa med pa/ thob nor de dag ji lta ba 'bri klog mi byed pa thob nor nyi shu/ sum cu/ bzhi bcu lta bur brgya dang nyi shu'i drug cha/ bzhi cha/ sum cha lta bu bgo gzhi de'i cha thob gang yin pa bgod byed grangs kyi spyi 'gros la bzhag pa re'u mig tu bkod nas ngag skyor byed pa'i byang tshad chu rgyugs pa lta bu byung dus rtsis kyi lag len nang cha thob brtsi skabs rtsis gzhi re re yang bskyar bgo thabs dang / thob nor gang yin la bsam blo gtong ma dgos pa rang gi myong bas kyang grub pa lta bu bcas cha phran ni bod kyi bgod rtsis ngo mtshar can zhig dang / bsdoms rtsis skabs spyi 'gros der gzhigs te phul thog bsgril dgos pas sgyur rtsis la'ang 'jug pa'i skabs yod do/ /cha phran gyi re'u mig gi thog ma kho nar(dpe mtshon 1)zhes ang ki 75

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/brtsegs pa 'dir phyed gsum cha la bzhi bcu zhe brgyad ces klog dgos/ de ni brgya dang nyi shu cha phyed gsum la bgos pa'i thob nor bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yin zhes pa lta bu dang / yang de las cung rdzob che ba(dpe mtshon 2)zhes par phyed bcu bzhi'i cha la phyed dgu sum cha bco brgyad cha zhes brgya dang nyi shu cha phyed bcu bzhir dgos pas thob nor nang gi rdog ma brgyad dang / phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang drug de phyi'i rdog ma brgyad cu thob pa'i grangs 'bor ji lta ba re'u mig tu 'god thabs bral ba ma zad/ klog kyang dka' bas sum cha bzhi cha'i spyi 'gros gong du gleng ba ltar skabs 'dir nang gi rdog ma brgyad sor bzhaganang gi rdog ma phyed phyi'i rdog mar phab pa'i cha drug cu'i khar/ sum char bzhi bcu bco brgyad cha la drug dang / de phyi'i rdog ma brgyad cu yin pa gcig tu sgril na nang gi rdog ma brgyad dang / phyi'i rdog ma brgya dang drug de phyi'i rdog ma brgyad cu thob pa lhag med rnam dag lta bu'o/ cha phran gyi re'u mig nang ang rdzob che shos(dpe mtshon 3)la nyis brgya zhe gsum cha la nang gi rdog med phyi'i drug cha phyed gsum/ nyi shu tham pa'i cha phyed gnyis de phyi'i bzhi cha brgya dang brgyad kyi cha zhes klog dgos pa ni brgya dang nyi shu cha nyis brgya zhe gsum la bgos pa'i thob nor phyi'i rdog ma nga dgu dang / de phyi'i rdog ma so gcigayang phyi'i rdog ma bcu gsum/ mthil phyi'i rdog ma bzhi bcu thob pa 'bri klog spyi 'gros gong bzhin gyis grub pa/ gsham gyi re'u mig gnyis par gzigs/gsum pa/ cha grangs khal sgril ni/ cha grangs ci tsam byung ba phul dang / bre/ khal thog sgril ba'i sgyur rtsis kyi rnam pa zhig yin/ cha grangs kyi re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon gruzhes par drug cu tham pa'i cha la khal med bre med phul phyed/ de yang phul brgya dang nyi shur gsil ba'i drug cu'i cha phul phyed yin 76

bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig del rtsis/pa shes sla/ cha grangs re'u mig mtha' ma (dpe mtshon 5)la drug khri tham pa'i cha la khal bzhi bre gsum phul do zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig gsum par gzigs/bzhi pa/ phul grangs khal sgril ni/ 'bru rtsam 'degs gshor skabs phul drug la bre gang / bre nyi shu la khal gcig yin pa dang / phul grangs ji tsam byung ba khal thog sgril ba cha grangs skabs kyi 'gros dang mtshungs/ re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 6)zhes par phul drug la khal med bre gang / re'u mig gi mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 7)zhes par phul chig 'bum tham pa la khal brgyad brgya sum cu so gsum dang bre drug phul bzhi zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig bzhi par gzigs/lnga pa/ spor grangs khal sgril ni/ mar dang zangs sogs 'degs byed nyag srang skabs spor bzhi la nyag gang / nyag nyi shu la khal gcig yin pa dang /spor grangs ji tsam byung ba khal thog sgril ba cha phul skabs kyi 'gros dang mtshungs/ re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 8)la spor bzhi la khal med nyag gang /re'u mig mtha' ma (dpe mtshon 9)la spor brgya tham pa la khal gcig nyag lnga zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig lnga par gzigs/drug pa/ sor grangs 'dom sgril ni/ ras snam sogs ring tshad 'jal byed skabs sor bcu gnyis la mtho gang / mtho do la khru gang / khru bzhi la 'dom gang yin pa dang / sor grangs ji tsam byung ba 'dom thog sgril ba gong dang mtshungs/ re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 10)la sor bcu gnyis la 'dom med khru med mtho gang / re'u mig mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 11)la sor brgya tham pa la 'dom gang khru med mtho med sor bzhi zhes klog dgos/ gsham 77

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gyi re'u mig drug par gzigs/bdun pa/ skar grangs srang sgril ni/ bcu gnas rkyong sgril deng dus kyi rtsis 'gros dang yongs su mthun pas rtogs sla/ de yang skar bcu la zho gang zho bcu la srang gang brtsi ba'i skar grangs srang sgril yang gong dang mtshungs/re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 12)la skar bcu la srang med zho gang / re'u mig mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 13)la skar brgya tham pa la srang gang zhes klog dgos/gsham gyi re'u mig bdun par gzigs/brgyad pa/ dbus 'bun spor gcog gam 'bun rtsis ni/ 'bru rtsam 'degs gshor skabs bogs 'bo'i khal gcig la mkhar 'bo'i khal gcig bre bcu yin pa de gnyis bar bre khyad 'bun gcig rgyugs pa de spor gcog byed skabs mkho ba'i sgyur rtsis gtsang ma zhig yin/ re'u mig dang po dang / gnyis par (dpe mtshon 14)gcig bskyed phyed gnyis gnyis bskyed gsum/ mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 15)la brgya la bskyed pa brgya dang lnga bcu zhes klog dgos pa 'bun bca' spyi la khyab pa/ gsham gyi re'u mig brgyad par gzigs/dgu pa/ ze khrad ni/ re'u mig nang mi gsal ba rtsis gzhung nang tshigs bcad du bkod pa zur khyad kyi spyi 'gros shig yin/ de yang bod kyi del rtsis la zur dang khyad ces pa'i brtsi bya dang / rtsi byed kyi grangs 'bor 'thab pas rtsi byed kyis brtsi bya'i grangs 'bor gyi zur ram cha shas ji tsam thob pa de la‘‘zur ’dang / khyad ces pa 'bo che chung bsdur tshad kyi bar khyad der‘‘khyad ’ces btags/ bre khyad kyi re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 16)la bre ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu zhes klog dgos pa ni bre bco brgyad khal gcig gi bcu cha 78

bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rig del rtsis/dgu'i zur yin pa'i don lags/ re'u mig khal nas lugs ldog tu bkod pa'i mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 17)la phul phyed nyis brgya bzhi bcu tham pa'i zur zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig dgu par gzigs/bcu pa/ nyag khyad ni/ spyi 'gros bre khyad dang mtshungs shing / re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 18)nyag ni bco brgyad khal gyi bcu cha dgu/ re'u mig mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 19)la spor phyed brgya dang drug cu tham pa'i zur zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig bcu par gzigs/bcu gcig pa/ dngul khyad kyang gong dang mtshungs/ re'u mig dang po(dpe mtshon 20)la zho dgu byung na srang gi bcu cha dgu zhes dang / re'u mig mtha' ma(dpe mtshon 21)skar gang srang gi brgya cha'i gcig gi zur zhes klog dgos/ gsham gyi re'u mig bcu gcig par gzigs/mjug bsdu ba/ gong du re'u mig ji lta bus klog dgos pa dang bcas pa'i gnas lugs rags pa tsam zhus zin/ mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor la zhib 'jug dpyis phyin pa byed bsam na thog mar mi rigs de'i dpal 'byor gyi grub cha dang / grub cha de dang 'tshams pa'i rtsis rig yod med/ yod na de'i phra zhib kyi tshad sogs shes pa gal che/ gal srid ma mthar shes dgos pa'i gnas lugs de tsho ma rtogs par mo ston phag mgo lta bus mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul la zhib 'jug byas khul gyi sdom tshig 'jog pa gnas ma yin/ bod mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gis da lta'i dpal 'byor spel ba'i chos nyid 'tshol 'dod na nges par du bod kyi lo rgyus spyi dang /bye brag yang sgos rang tshugs rang bzhin ldan pa'i bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rig pa 'di'i gnas la brtson zhib gnang rgyu yang gal che bar mthong /79
— ṭ+wāṃ
—rtetsho

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo maspru shrī ye/ /rab 'byams zhing du rgyal ba'i mdun sa ru/ /spros bral gtam gyi sgra chen sgrogs mkhas shing / /gang 'dul gzugs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya la/ /rten 'brel lam ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /smra ba'i seng ges gtsug lag ston pa'i tshe/ /gus pas zhu gsol 'phrul zhing len dang 'chang / /rgya cher spel mdzad lha mi'i drang srong che/ /kun la dang ba'i yid kyis bstod cing bsngags/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa'i 'gro tshogs la/ /phyi nang 'byung ba gso bskyed gcod 'dral gyis/ /byas pa'i bde sdug gsal ston 'byung rtsis gzhung / /rim gsum sgyur mdzad lo paṇa yongs la 'dud/ /khyad par 'jam dpal zhal lung gtsug lag 'di'i/ /dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs nas skal bzang la/ /dka' gnad gsal mdzad yongs 'dzin la btud nas/ /'di nyid dar tshul lo rgyus mdo tsam gleng / /de yang nag rtsis zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig pa 'di ni sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa zhes yongs su grags pa rig gnas chen po lnga'i nang bzo rig pa'i khongs su 'du ba dang / snyan dngags/ sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/skar rtsis/ zlos gar zhes rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal skar rtsis dang 'dra bar rtsis kyi rig pa 'di dag la nag rtsis zhes bya ba'i tha snyad sngar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du dngos su grags pa zhig byung med mod/ 'on kyang sto~X pa

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bcom ldan 'das kyis matā tsi na zhes bya ba'i yul chen po der lhun po rtse lnga pa zhes bya ba'i ri bo yod la nga nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i dam pa'i chos rab tu ston par 'gyur ro zhes bka' bstsal pa bzhin mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis shar phyogs matā tsi na'i yul gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag kun rdzob rtsis kyi bden pas 'dul bar dgongs nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar ṣ+ṭṛtā shing gi lba ba las byis pa'i tshul du brdzus te sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa bstan te gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo rgya cher phye bas tsi na'i yul gyi 'gro ba rnams 'phral yun phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal la bkod pa nas bzung rgya nag gi yul du rtsis kyi rig pa 'di dag shin tu dar rgyas byung ba yin la/ 'o skol bsil ldan sā la'i sman ljongs 'dir yang 'phags ma rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya bza' kong jo drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i khab tu byon pa'i dus kong jo'i rten skal du sangs rgyas dngos dang mi gnyis pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne gdan drangs pa dang dus mtshungs rten 'brel rtsis kyi gtsug lag rgya chen po spyan drangs pa de nas bod kyi yul 'dir rtsis dkar nag ces nag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs 'di dag kyang dus 'khor lugs kyi skar rtsis dang dus mnyam du rim bzhin dar ba dang / rgya cher 'phel ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin/ thog mar nag rtsis zhes bya ba'i gzhung lugs 'di dag don dam rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang rnam pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung ba rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rang gi gdul bya'i don du bstan pa'i gzhung tshad ma/ ston pa po rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' yin pa bka' mdo rgyud du ma nas lung gsal por bstan pa las skabs 92

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/'dir skye bo rnams kyis gzhung 'di dag ni shin tu yang dag pa yin par nges shes skye ba'i slad du cung zad spro bar bya ba de yang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/rgya dang rgya nag che nyid na/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'od chen po/ /mngon sum de yi yul dag na/ /byis pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa yin/grub pa'i zhing mchog dam pa la/ /mi ni yongs su sgrub par 'gyur/ /zhes bstan pa'i lung snga mas rgya nag gi yul 'di 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gtsug lag rtsis kyi 'dul zhing yin par bstan cing / rgya nag la yang rgya nag che ba dang /chung ba'i khyad par ni kwang kru'u la sogs pa'i rgya gar nag gi mtshams kyi yul grur rgya nag chung ngu dang / de tshun rgya nag gi yul gru rnams la rgya nag chen por sngon gyi yig rnying rnams su grags pa ltar rgya nag chen po'i yul grur gtogs pa'i rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga lung bstan pa dang / lung phyi mas yul gru der 'phags pa 'jam dpal byis pa'i gzugs kyis gnas par gsungs pa yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya nag gi yul du ma dar ba'i snga rol tu rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sprul pa'i khye'u zur phud lnga pa zhig yang yang rgyu ba gnyug mar gnas pa'i bon po sogs skye bo mchog dman du mas mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa rgya'i yig rnying las 'byung ba de nyid yin par gsungs shing / lhag par mdo sde phal po che las/ byang shar gyi mtshams ri bo dwangs bsil zhes bya ba bskal pa dang po'i dus byang chub sems dpa' tshogs yang dag par 'du ba'i gnas yin te/da ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ rang gi 'khor byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcu'i tshogs dang bcas pa gnas der rtag tu gnas shing / dam pa'i chos rgya cher bstan cing bzhugs so/ /zhes dang /93

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gzungs rin po che'i gter mdzod dam/ mtshan gzhan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzungs sngags yi ge brgyad pa'i cho ga zhib mo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sde snod gsum pa bo dhi ru tsis bsgyur ba las/ de nas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bka' bstsal pa/ byang shar gyi mtshams su matā tsi na zhes bya ba'i yul chen po yod pa der lhun po rtse lnga pa zhes bya ba'i ri bo yod la nga nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gnas der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas spyod lam ci bde ba'i tshul gyis gnas te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i dam pa'i chos rab tu ston cing rgya cher bstan par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang klu la sogs pa'i dregs pa sde brgyad dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor te mchod pa dang bkur sti rim gro byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud du ma nas rgya cher gsungs pa'i lung de dag gis 'gro ba rnams la phan dang bde ba'i sman yon du 'gyur ba ngo mtshar rtsis kyi rig pa 'di nyid kyi srol rgya cher gtod pa'i ston pa dang / gnas dang / dus dang / chos dang / 'khor bcas phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du 'gyur ba gsal por bstan pas skabs 'dir nag rtsis ji ltar dar ba'i tshul yang phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i go rim bzhin smra bar 'dod pa 'di lta ste/dang po/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/zhing mchog ri bo dwangs bsil lam ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bshad dad pa'i 94

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/pad+mo rgyas byed ngo mtshar nyi ma'i snang ba sogs gna' rabs kyi tshad ldan yig lam dag las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni sngon gyi dus na de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs mchog rgyal po zhes bya bar sangs rgyas zin pa dang / da lta'i dus su yang 'jig rten gyi khams gser mdog can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa g.yo ba med pa'i skyes bu chen po 'jam pa'i dpal zhes bya bas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'jig rten gyi khams rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya ba'i mdzad pa ston par 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang sngon gyi rgyal ba dpag tu med pa dang po'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa dang / bdag cag gi ston pa la sogs pa da lta'i rgyal ba dpag tu med pa'i spyan sngar sras kyi thu bo'i tshul bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rdzogs par mdzad pa sogs dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dpag tu med pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa yang phan yon che ba sangs rgyas phal po che dang / 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo dang / zhing bkod kyi mdo/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo sogs nas rgya cher gsungs pa shin tu legs kyang 'dir re re bzhin 'dren rgyu yi ge mang du dogs pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag la 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che zhib cha shes par 'dod na gong du smos pa'i mdo dang rgyud sde de dag dang / snying bsdus lta bur 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i nye sras brgyad kyi rtogs brjod las 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rtogs brjod rin po 95

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/che sogs mjal bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs thun mong gi snang ngor rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sku bltams nas gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo phye ba la sogs pa'i mdzad pa cha shas tsam gleng bar bya ba de yang / gtsug lag rtsis kyi ston pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku bltams pa'i tshul la yum gyi gtsug nas 'khrungs pa dang / mngal du zhugs nas 'khrungs pa sogs kyi bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod na'ang gtsug lag rnam par dag pa'i ring lugs tsho'i bzhed pa la dus khyad du 'phags pa lo'i dang po mig dmar shing pho byi ba dang /zla ba'i thog ma mgo zla ba dang / dpyid zla stag gi tshes bco lnga/ res gza' spen pa/ zla skar mgo dus tshod rdo'u dros tsam gyi dus de yang bdag cag gi ston pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe rgya nag yul gyi kra'u(ṣā)rgyal rabs stod kyi cha yin la de nas mi ring ba'i dus zhig na rgya nag chen por gtogs pa'i yul ri bo rtse lngar skye bo gzhan bas khyad par 'phags pa mtshon phyir trik+ṣa'i shing gi lba ba las brdzus te 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan nas dbus kyi ri la bzhugs pa dang / de nas gzhan bzhi yang spros te shar rir 'jam dbyangs rnon po/ lho rir 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ nub rir 'jam dpal smra seng / byang du 'jam dpal dri med du sprul te bzhugs par gsungs shing / de'i tshe ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas su 'ja'i gur khyim gyi nang du gzhon nu skra zur phud lngar bcings shing gos dkar po gyon pa zhig skye bo kun gyis yang yang mthong ba byung 'dug pas skye bo rnams kyis gzhon nu de'i mtshan rgya skad du u kye thung rtse ste gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa zhes bya bar gsol ba dang / yang la las pe yi than te drang srong gos dkar can du gsol ba de'i tshe rgya nag gi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 96

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/ma dar ba bon gyis bzung ba'i dus yin pas gnyug mar gnas pa'i bon po rnams kyis rang gi ston pa'i rnam 'phrul du ngos bzung ste shar phyogs rgya nag gi bstan pa'i bdag po nor bu'i pho brang gi dbang phyug gzhon nu zhes mtshan du gsol bar grags shing / de nas ṭi'u rgyal po mo'u wang gis lha khang bzhengs nas gzhon nu de nyid kyi sku brnyan sgrub te mchod pa byas so/ /zhes ri bo dwangs bsil gyi dkar chag tu gsal ba rags tsam zhig bkod pa lags so/ /gnyis pa/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/spyir 'dzam bu'i gling chen 'dir khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas chen lnga yod par grags pa dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ shar du 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhing mchog rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ lho ru spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing mchog ri bo po ta la/nub tu mkha' 'gro'i gnas kyi u rgyan/ byang du rigs ldan gyi gnas sham+bha la rnams so/ /bye brag tu matā tsi nar grags pa'i rgyal khams su byin rlabs can gyi gnas chen bzhi dang / ri gnyan chen po lnga/ chu klung rab med bzhi rnams yod par grags pa las byin rlabs can gyi gnas chen bzhi ni/ hran shi zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs 'jam dbyangs kyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga'am/ ri bo dwangs bsil/ kre cang zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas ri bo po ta la/ zi khron zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs kun tu bzang po'i gnas glang chen 'gying ri/ an hud zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs sa yi snying po'i gnas ci'u hwa hran te dpal ri rtse dgu rnams yin la de'i nang nas kyang khyad par 97

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'phags pa'i gnas/ mdo rgyud du ma nas lung gis bstan pa dang / rgya cher bsngags pa ri bo rtse lnga ni gtsug lag rtsis kyi ston pa mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs sku bltams pa dang / thun mong dang thun mong min pa gdul bya'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i zhing mchog khyad par 'phags pa yin no/ /gnas mchog de nyid thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor gnas kyi sgo phye ba'i tshul ni/ de yang han gur gyi rgyal po ming rnyi'i lo bdun pa'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i nub gcig rgyal po'i rmi lam du gser gyi mi chen po dpangs su 'dom gsum tsam yod pa nyi ma ltar gzi brjid che ba zhig dang pho brang du 'phrad par rmis/ phyi nyin de'i tshul mdun na 'don la bshad pas de na re/ sngon gyi kra'u'i yig tshang na nub phyogs su 'phags pa'i drang srong khyad par can zhig skyes/ lo stong na de'i bstan pa phyogs 'dir dar bar 'gyur zer ba zhig 'dug pa rgyal po'i mtshan lam de dang mthun par snang zhes zhus skad/ de nas rgyal pos wang zun zer ba'i blon po zhig zla bo bco brgyad dang bcas chos lugs de 'tshol bar rgya gar du brdzangs/ de'i tshe tsi na'i yul gyi skye bo rnams dkar po dge ba'i las kyi mthu yongs su smin pa'i dus la babs pas rgya gar gyi yul nas dgra bcom pa ma tang ki pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta bha ra na zhes pa gnyis kyis rgya nag gi yul der rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i gnas sgo 'byed pa'i dus la babs pa mngon par shes pas gzigs te bcom ldan 'das kyi bris sku gcig dang / theg pa che chung gi mdo sde du ma/ring bsrel bre gang bcas gdan drangs te phebs pa dang yu'i tsi zhes pa'i sa char rgyal po'i bang chen wang zun la sogs pa rnams kyis mjal ba de dag gis rim gyis gdan drangs te me mo yos lo'i dgun zla tha chung gi nang du pho brang 98

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/ chen por phyag phebs/ rten rnams rgyal por gzigs su phul bas ston pa'i 'dra thang de sngar rgyal po'i rmi lam du byung ba'i sku de dang mthun par byung bas rgyal po thugs shin tu dgyes shing / bris sku de ni sngar rmi lam du snang ba de mngon sum du mchis pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ dgra bcom pa ma tang ki pas gsungs pa/ 'di ni nges par de bzhin gshegs pas rang gi bstan pa rgyal po nyid la gtad pa'i rtags su cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par rigs so zhes zhus shing phan tshun chos kyi dris rmed mang du mdzad/ de nas rgyal pos dgra bcom par/ nged kyi rgyal khams 'di na rtag par 'tsho zhing gzhes te 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i skyes chen dam pa 'ga' zhig med dam zhus pas/de'i lan du dgra bcom pas/ ri bo rtse lnga 'di la 'phags pa 'jam dpal rtag tu bzhugs shing / chos ston la lha dang klu la sogs pa'i sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams 'dul bar mdzad mod/ 'on kyang las sgrib srab cing snang ba dag pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis ma gtogs skye bo phal pas mthong bar dka' 'o zhes zhus te phyi lo dgra bcom pa ri bo dwangs bsil du phebs nas/ lha'i mig gis sprul pa'i gnas kyi khyad par rnams gzigs shing chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten sogs ngos bzung ste phyir phebs/ gnas kyi snying po rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri dang mtshungs pas der lha khang bskrun nas ming yang bya rgod phung po'i lha khang du btags na legs tshul rgyal po la gsungs pas/ rgyal pos kyang dgra bcom pa'i gsung dang mthun pa'i lha khang gsar du bzhengs te rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yid ches kyi dad pa gsar du thob pa'i rten du dgongs nas dgra bcom pas btags pa'i mtshan gyi thog la dad pa thob ces pa'i tshig zur bsnan te dad thob bya rgod phung po'i 99

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lha khang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol ba de nas bzung ste sprul pa'i gnas sgo phye zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /de ltar ri bo rtse lnga ni tsi na'i yul du rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can zhig yin na de'i bkod pa'i khyad par ni/gnas mchog 'di la rgya nag gi skad du u tha'i hran te ri bo rtse lnga zhes pa dang /ching phyeng hran te ri bo dwangs bsil du yang grags pa yin/ spyir gnas 'di'i mtha' skor la rgya nag lugs kyi rgyang grags lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi rgya rten dang bcas pa de yang phyogs gang nas song yang gyen du bgrod dgos pas sa gzhi byings las ri bo rtse lnga'i rmang gzhi ches mtho zhing gzhan bas khyad par 'phags pa zhig yod pa de'i steng du ri bo rnams ni stabs sbrel zhing lhun brjid chags pa rtse mo lngar gyes pa'i tshul du yod la/ de yang nub dang dbus dang byang dang shar gyi rtse mo bzhi phreng bsgrigs dang lho ri ni g.yas logs kyi mdun ngos su cung zad rgyang tsam na yod do/ /sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi gsung sgros ltar na/rtse mo lnga ni 'jam dpal longs sku rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i phung po lnga rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i sku rigs lnga'i rnam par shar ba mtshon par gsungs pa la gzhigs na dbus ri sku dang / shar ri thugs/lho ri yon tan/ nub ri gsung / byang ri 'phrin las kyi gnas su snang ba de rnams rim pa bzhin du rnam snang dang / mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa'i sku'i gnas su nges so//rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi gnas de dag gi khyad par yang dbus ri rnam snang gi zhing gser gyi rang bzhin ri bo ghi'u de hran zhes bya ba seṅge 'gying ba 'dra ba'i dpangs le dbar bzhi bcu dang / rtse'i mtha' skor la le dbar drug yod par 100

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/lha khang bdud rtsi'i khron pa la sogs pa de dag gi nang rten gsum ngo mtshar can mang du bzhugs so/ /shar ri mi bskyod pa'i zhing shel gyi rang bzhin rdo rje brtsegs pa'i ri bo glang chen 'gying pa 'dra ba'i dpangs su le dbar sum cu rtsa gnyis/ rtse mo'i mtha' skor la le dbar gsum yod pa'i rtse mor sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i lha khang pa dang / chu mig dang / brag phug la sogs pa mang po mchis so/ /lho ri rin 'byung gi zhing la a gro las grub pa'i rin chen brtsegs pa'i ri bo rta mchog nyal 'dra ba'i dpangs su le dbar sum cu rtsa bdun dang / rtse mo'i mtha' la le dbar gnyis yod pa'i rtser 'jam dbyangs bzhugs pa'i lha khang dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi bzhugs khri/ khrus chu'i khron pa ngo mtshar can sogs mang du mchis so/ /nub ri snang mtha'i zhing pad+ma rā ga las grub pa pad+ma brtsegs pa'i ri rma bya gar byed pa dang 'dra ba'i dpangs su le dbar sum cu rtsa lnga dang / rtse mo'i mtha' skor la le dbar gnyis yod pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs klu rgyal gyi lha khang dang / g.yu 'brug bdud rtsi'i chu sogs ngo mtshar can gyi rten dang bkod pa mang du bzhugs so/ /byang ri don yod grub pa'i zhing mchog in+d+ra nī la las grub pa rgya gram brtsegs pa'i ri shang shang bsnol ba 'dra ba'i dpangs su le dbar sum cu rtsa brgyad dang / rtse mo'i mtha' skor la le dbar gsum yod pa'i nang du 'jam dbyangs klu rgyal yum sras bzhugs pa'i lha khang dang / chu mig dang mtsho sogs ngo mtshar can mang du mchis so/ /ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang ba'i ri bo rtse lnga'i ri bo so so'i grub cha yang mi 'dra ba rin po che'i rigs rnams spyir btang gis mthong ba dka' mod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i rigs rnams kyi kha dog rnam pa so skye tha mal ba'i mthun snang du 101

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/grub pa ltar dang ri bo so so'i dbyibs kyi rnam pa yang rang dga' ba ma yin pa khyad du 'phags pa'i chos sku'i mchod rten rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhin gsal por mthong thub pa de yang dbus su byang chub mchod rten/ shar ri bkra shis sgo mangs/ lho ri cho 'phrul mchod rten/ nub ri myang 'das mchod rten/ byang ri lha babs mchod rten gyi dbyibs su snang zhing / ri bo dwangs bsil gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar nyi ma'i snang ba'i nang ri bo rtse lnga'i khor yug khyon yongs la dkar chag rnying pa rnams la gsal por 'khod pa byin rlabs can gyi gnas lho rir nyi shu rtsa gcig shar rir bcu bzhi/ nub rir bcu bdun/ byang rir nyi shu rtsa bdun/ dbus rir nyi shu bsdoms pas gnas brgya rtsa bdun yod par bshad kyang de las deng 'ga' zhig rnying gogs kyis mi mngon par song ba'ang yod la/ yang phyis su skyes chen dam pa dang dad ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sku dang gsung gi snang ba bstsal ba'i gnas rnams su rgyal blon btsun pa khyim bdag du mas gsar du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang yang mang du mchis so zhes pa ltar ri bo rtse lnga ni byin rlabs can gyi gnas mang gcig tu 'du ba'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhing mchog bla na ma mchis pa'i ngo mtshar ni bsam brjod las 'das shing lhag par rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi snang ngor sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar bsam brjod las 'das pa smos ci dgos/ mdor na sa rdo ri brag dang / rtsi shing la sogs pa thams cad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag pa'i zhing mchog bla na med pa zhig yin/ dper na sngar su'i gur gyi dus su/ rgya nag hu nan sa cha'i ling shu bya ba'i mi zhig yod pa de rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs 102
