nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/dang mjal 'dod che bas byin rlabs can du grags pa'i gnas thams cad bskor nas mthar ri bo rtse lngar slebs so/ /slebs ma thag tu ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas nags gseb tu phyin pa dang / sngar mthong ma myong ba'i hwa shang khyad mtshar can zhig dang mjal nas phyag btsal te dris pa/ rje btsun 'jam dpal ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs so zhes kho bos thos te/ da lta kho ra khor yug tu btsal yang gtan nas ma mthong / slob dpon gyis bdag la bstan tu gsol byas pas/ hwa shang de na re/ ci phyir ma mthong / mthong bar bya snyam du bsam pas ma mthong ba yin mod/ khyod kyis gang ma mthong ba de nyid mthong ba yin no/ /gal te bden par mthong ba med gyur na/ /de ni don gyi 'jam dpal mthong ba yin/ khyod gom pa 'dor na yang 'jam dpal gyi dpral bar 'dor/ lag pa bteg na yang 'jam dpal gyi shangs la reg yong / gzhan du ma bzur cing ma sbas bzhin du ci'i phyir ma mthong byas so/ /ling shu na re/ de ltar na ri klung rtswa shing sogs thams cad 'jam dpal yin nam byas pas/ hwa shang na re/ ri klung sogs 'jam dpal yin zer na 'jam dpal gnyis su 'gyur la min zer na yang 'brel med du smra bar 'gyur bas 'di la yang dag par na yin min zhes pa'i rang bzhin gnyis med byas pa dang / ling shu cung zad 'khrig chud de phyag byas nas yang dris pa/kho bo la gcong nad rnying pa zhig kyang yod la/ rgyud la rtogs pa yang ma skyes pas/ skyes mchog nyid kyis bcos par rung ngam byas pas/ hwa shang na re/nang khong stong pa'i rtswa zhig yod de/ ming la ming ting zer/ khyod kyis rtswa de za bar 'os te/ zos nas ring du lon pa na ming ting yang khyod nyid la/ khyod nyid kyang ming ting du 'gyur zhing nad kyang sos par 'gyur ro byas so/ /ling shus 103

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ri klung thams cad nyul te rtswa btsal kyang ma rnyed do/ /skabs shig de'i sngar gyi tshig don la rtog cing 'dug pa dang / glo bur 'di snyam du shes te smras pa/ rtswa zo zhig zer ba min te/ rang sems stong par shes par byas te kun rtog spongs shig byas pa yin 'dug des na kho bo'i lus kyang rtswa ming ting yin la/ chos thams cad kyang rtswa ming ting 'ba' zhig rdzun pa bcos ma'i rnam pa yod yod 'dra ba'i phung po 'di gdod nas stong pa nyid do zhes so/ /de nas sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs nas kun rtog dang bral bar 'gyur ro zhes pa dang / yang thang gur gyi dus su blon po chen po chi'an shan gyi bu to'u phun zhes bya ba zhig bar skabs ri bo rtse lngar byon te dbus rir mtshan mo sgom la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ g.yas logs su sprul pa'i khye'u zhig 'greng ste 'dug pa dang / to'u phun gyis khyod su yin byas pas/ de na re/ nga'i ming la lha'i bu shun chang zer/ brgya byin gyi bkas rje btsun gyi gnas la rtog myul byed du yong ste/ slob dpon 'dir bzhugs par go nas mjal du 'ongs pa lags zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas mdo phal po che las ri 'di 'jam dpal gyi bzhugs gnas yin par gsung 'dug kyang / da lta bltas na ri brag rtswa shing sogs 'jig rten phal pa'i gnas dang 'dra bar snang na 'di ji ltar yin gsungs pa dang / lha'i bus/ phal pa rnams kyis rje btsun gyi gnas ji ltar shes/ nga ni so skye phal pa yin/ slob dpon nyid theg pa chung ngu'i 'phags pa yin par snang / gal te rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i sems kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la rtog dpyod byas na nor ba yin/ slob dpon lags/ tshul gcig la gnyis su dbye ba med/ mi gsum gyi bsam tshul tha dad yin zhes pa ma gsan nam/ spyir 'phen byed las kyi 'bras bu phal pa'i mig gi skyon gyis 104

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gnas tha mal du snang mod/ ngas bltas na ri bo dwangs bsil 'di baiḍūr+ya'i mdangs su gsal zhing / ri bo rnams kyi zhol du rin po che'i ljon shing sna tshogs kyis spras pa 'od 'tsher bas nyin mtshan khyad med du lhan ne lhang nger snang ste/ rje btsun gyi yul ni kho bo'i spyod yul min no zhes smras te mi snang bar gyur to zhes de lta bu ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas kyi ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba'i mtshon byed tsam gnas bshad ngo mtshar nyi snang du 'khod pa 'dir yang zur tsam drangs shing / gnas ri 'di nyid du rtogs pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa bgrang las 'das pa zhig byon yod pa dper na dbus ri'i shar lho'i ldebs na yod pa pad+ma dkar po'i gling du sngon dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas dbyar gnas mdzad pa la lha klu 'byung po rnams kyis 'tsho ba sbyar bas dre'u bcu phrag du ma khrid mkhan med par rang nyid kyis 'tshong 'dus nas zas gsos pa blangs te dge 'dun la 'grems pa byung skad dang / de skabs rdzing bu'i nang g.yang ṭi'i mdog lta bu'i pad+ma dkar po'i tshal khyad mtshar can byung ba mdun na kha bye bar gyur cing / de'i tshe'i lha khang bzhengs pa phyis ming gur gyi dus su nyams gso byas te tshe dpag gling(rgya skad du wan she'u ze)du btags par grags pa dang yang dbus ri'i shar ngos rgya gar drang srong gi ri(rgya skad la phan blan hran)la sngon drang srong lnga brgyas me tog ut+pala'i bcud len byas te grub pa thob skad dang / yang byang ri'i nub byang phyogs na dge slong lnga brgya'i sbas lung bya ba(rgya skad la chad dzeng gu)yod pa der sngon gyi dus su 'phags yul gyi btsun pa lnga brgya gnas 'dir sbas pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan bsgoms nas grub pa thob par gsungs pa sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas so sor bzhugs nas sgom sgrub bsam gtan gyi rim pa la gcig tu gzhol bar rtogs pa khyad 105

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/par can brnyes pa'i tshul ni mtha' yas pa yod kyang 'dir yig tshogs la 'dzems nas de tsam gyis mtshon par byas shing / gangs can ljongs kyi skyes bu dam pa ri bo rtse lngar phebs te dgon gnas btab pa dang / rten gsum bzhengs pa la sogs pa bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs pa yang shin tu mang ste/ dper na ming gur gyi yung lo'i dus su kun tu khyab pa'i lha khang(tā yon jo'u si)du grub thob gcig gdan drangs te bzhugs pa'i gnas der grub thob des rgyal po 'khor bcas la gsang sngags kyi chos kyang mang du gnang zhing / grub thob de sku gshegs pa'i sku gdung yang lha khang 'di nyid na bzhugs shing / rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes kyang lo du mar dbyar ka'i ring lha khang 'di nyid na bzhugs pa dang /yung lo rgyal po'i khri lo bcu gnyis par ri bo dwangs bsil gyi shen thung si'i dgon par bzhugs pa lo de'i dgun kha rgyal pos nyug rum pa mngags te pho brang du gdan drangs nas nying yin se'i dgon par bzhugs su gsol ba dang bkur sti rgya cher mdzad thog rgyal pos dri rmed mdzad pa'i zhus lan rnams kyis thugs dgyes nas de'i lo rjes mar 'bul ba spom mtho ba dang bcas gser gyi tham rgyas btab pa'i bka' shog gnang nas/ me'u kyu yīn thong ho'u tshe pu nying h+phu kwan shen kyu kwan ting hung shan shi shis the'an phu ze zhes bod skad du ngo mtshar rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi 'od zer mchog tu gsal zhing kun la khyab pa'i mkhyen brtses mtha' dag la shākya'i bstan pa snang bar mdzad pa nub phyogs kyi rgyal ba'i sras po spyi bo nas dbang bkur te dge tshogs spel bar byed pa'i rgyal srid kyi slob dpon zhes sam/ phur lcog ngag dbang byams pas mdzad pa'i grwa sa chen po bzhi dang / rgyud grwa stod smad kyi dkar chag pad dkar phreng bar/106

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/'phrin las sna tshogs la mkhas shing gsal ba chos nyid dam pa mchog tu rgyal ba/shes rab rnam dag snang ba chen po kun tu khyab cing rgyal khams skyob pa/ bstan pa rgyas mdzad rab tu dge ba/ byams chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes pas gzengs bstod/ de bzhin ming gur gyi dus su tha'i tsung rgyal pos bod nas karma pa'i slob dpon mkhyen rab che ba zhig gdan drangs te khu la'i tā po'u h+pha wang shi'i thi'an tā shan tsi tsi phu zhes bod skad du nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal dbang rin po che zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gzengs bstod/ nyin gcig rgyal po dang h+pha wang lhan du ling ko si'i dgon pa mjal du phebs pa na mchod rten gyi grib ma la 'od zer 'phro ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i khyad par mthong bas rgyal po shin tu mnyes so/ /bla ma nyid gnas dben par dgyes pas ri bo rtse lngar 'gro bar gsol ba bzhin rgyal pos kyang bkur sti chen pos ri bo rtse lngar gdan drangs te tā shen thung si'i dgon par bzhugs shing / rgyal pos nyug rum pa yang shing zhes bya bar bka' phab nas dgon pa zhig gso mdzad/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel mchod rten yang bcos te h+pha wang gi bzhugs sa mdzes par byas so/ /yang ming gur gyi yung lo rgyal pos/ ri bo rtse lnga'i che ba brjod pa'i yi ge brtsams pa dad bskul gyi ched du 'gyed par bka' babs te bskyal ba na/mngags mi phu sa ting du slebs ma thag ngo mtshar ba'i 'od kyi snang ba kha dog sna lnga gyen du 'phros te dgung la reg tsam byung zhing ri klung thams cad khyab/ yang sprin gyi khrod du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs seng ge chibs pa dang po cher mi gsal ba la sprin dang smug pa dwangs ma thag shin tu gsal bar gyur cing /107

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/seng ge yang ral pa gsig ste lce 'dril zhing mchongs pa'i gar stabs kyis phan tshun phyogs su mig bgrad nas blta ba ri bo'i steng na gnas pa thams cad kyis mthong ngo / /de'i phyi nyin yang hwa yen la nas dgra bcom pa brgya phrag du ma skabs 'gar bcu phrag tsam re dang / skabs la lar de las mang tsam pa dal bus byon pa'i nang na glegs bam khur ba dang / 'khar ba btsugs pa dang /lus ril por ston pa dang / phrag pa phud pa dang / zhabs rjen dang / zhabs 'theng po dang / rked pa sgur po'ang 'dug cing / skabs 'gar sum stong lhag tsam snang la/ skabs la lar mi snang ba dang / sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byed pa mthong bas tshogs pa thams cad ngo mtshar nas lo khri phrag tu yang 'di 'dra ba mjal bar dka' zhes zer ro/ /bod nas bka' 'gyur gdan drangs te par brkos nas par phud kyi bka' 'gyur zhig kyang phu sa ting du bzhugs su gsol/yum gyi dge rtsar dmigs nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku brnyan thog tshad longs pa bzhengs shing mchod/ dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur rgya cher mdzad pa/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje yang rdo rje'i phug gi sa'i stod kyi cha/bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rdzing bu'i 'gram dben dgon kun tu bde ba'i tshal du rgyun ring bzhugs pa dang / sgrub khang e waṃ dga' 'khyil du 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku dang / bde mchog lha lnga'i dngul sku sogs rten gsum mtha' yas pa bzhengs te bzhugs su gsol nas ri bo dwangs bsil gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar nyi ma'i snang ba 'di dag dbu brtsam par mdzad pa dang / de nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me phag(1717)lo dben gnas bde ba'i tshal du zla ngo drug tsam sku mtshams dam por bzhugs skabs ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bstod yongs shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma thun tshams su bka' rtsom mdzad pa la sogs pa gnas 'dir 108

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/zhabs bcag pa dang sgrub pa nyams bzhes kyi thugs dam 'phel ba'i lo rgyus mang po mchis pa bcas mdor na gnas ri 'di rnams su rigs so so la brten pa'i lha'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi myur khyad gzhan bas khyad par 'phags par gsungs pa ni don la gnas pa gor ma chag pa de dag ni ri bo rtse lnga'i dkar chag nang zhib par gsal ba las cung zad btus te mdor bsdus su bkod cing / gzhan yang gangs can ljongs su byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa la sogs pa'i gsung rnam nang gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rang gzhan gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs pa'i skor mtha' yas pa gsal ba'i nang nas skabs 'dir dpe mtshon 'ga' zhig drangs pa 'di lta ste/ de yang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa dngos grub 'od stong 'bar ba'i nyi ma'i nang pha dam pa sangs rgyas ri bo rtse lngar byon te mdzad pa bskyangs pa'i skor/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas la khyod 'dir ma 'dug par bod dang rgya nag sogs mtha' 'khob phyogs su 'gro don che bas der song zhig ces lung bstan pa bzhin bod du thengs bzhi pa phebs pa'i skabs mdo khams stod smad kyi 'gro ba rnams la gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos sna tshogs bstan nas smin grol la bkod de ma tā tsi na'i yul du byon pas rtse lnga'i ri la 'dzegs pa'i lam khar drang srong rgan po chu shing gi 'khar ba thogs pa gcig dang mjal te rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pas de na re/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan na rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs yod pas khyod kyis de ring longs la yul 'di na nad yams chen po mched skyin yod pa do nub chod par gyis zer bar/ /rdo rje gdan thag ring bas nyin gcig la de tsam ga la nus gsungs pas/ /brag phug ya gir phyin na 'grub yong zer 109

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nas bstan byung bar brag phug der byon pas rdo rje gdan skad cig la 'khor nas gzungs blangs te yul gyi nad rims kyang zhi bar mdzad/ /de nas ri bo rtse lnga'i zhing khams su rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs 'khor bcas dngos su mjal zhing gnas der sgrub pa yang mdzad/ /nyi ma stod la mnan pa sogs grub rtags kyang mang du bstan cing / /rgya nag gi rgyal blon thams cad kyis gus pas btud/ /rgya'i yul gyi skal ldan mang po yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ /tsi tsu sa ra zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang 'ga' zhig bzhengs/ /skabs shig zhal dbugs kyi rgyu ba yang med par 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring bzhugs pa'i tshe sku gshegs par bsams te rgya'i yul lugs kyi dpe ltar byas te rin po che'i za ma tog tu bcug ste mchod rdzas mang po dang bcas ri mthon por khyer nas sa la dong brus par rgyas btab nas bzhag go /re zhig na ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs pas sku lus sgrom du rgyas btab 'dug par gzigs pas sems can gti mug can rnams kyi byed lugs la rten 'brel nor bar 'dug dgongs nas na bza' la ber sku la gsol/ chag lham ya gcig bsnams rgya yul gyi bsod nams mi nyams pa'i phyir chag lham ya gcig shul du bzhag ste rten 'brel gyi rdzas su bzhag dam pa rang nyid sus kyang ma tshor bar byas te slar yang rgya gar du byon no/ /da lta zhen med du 'gro zhing bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho ba'i rgya'i bya bral 'ga' zhig 'dug pa yang dam pa'i slob rgyud kyi rnam thar skyong ba yin par grags shing / rgya nag lugs kyi dam pa'i sku brnyan gyi ras bris 'di na yang snang ba de yin la rgya yul na'ang ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dbyangs dang dam pa mjal ba'i bkod pa dang / dam pa'i sgrub phug brag khung rdo'i sgo glegs byas pa 110

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gcig yod pa der da lta mjal mi rnams kyis kyang mthong zhes gsal bar thos so zhes 'khod pa dang / thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar/ dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus bzang po'i rnam par thar pa kun gsal nor bu'i me long nang / rgya nag la byon pas ri bo rtse lngar phebs/ gnas de na bsam gtan pa mang po bzhugs pa dang mjal/ de rnams kyi nang nas dge slong 'be ho dharma na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyod bod kha ba can pa yin par 'dug gnas 'di ni ri ngo chad mtha' chus 'khor ba/ gcan gzan gdug pa can sogs lus srog la bar chad byed mkhan mang du yod/ lam bgrod dka' ba 'dir rogs med gcig pur sleb pa ngo mtshar che/ khyod kyi yul gang nas yin/ ming la ci skad zer/ bla ma ci 'dra bsten/ chos ci 'dra shes/ nyams len gang la byas/ gnas 'dir don ci la yong zer ba la/ grub thob chen pos lan gsungs pa/ nyin cig skal ldan 'dir tshogs rnams/ khyed sngon bsags bsod nams smon lam mthus/ /dal 'byor tshang zhing rab tu byung / /dam chos don gnyer dben pa bsten/ /dka' ba spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /ming zer 'di la rna bas nyon/ /nga bod kyi skyes bu lcags zam pa/ /skye ba 'bum phrag du ma ru/ /sems can don du smon lam btab/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bya ba byas/ /yang dag bla ma brgya phrag lnga/ /'bral med gus pas gtsug tu bsten/ /ma nor rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shes//mi shes ma rig mun pa sangs/ /yi dam lha yis lung yang bstan/ /rnam shes rlung la rab sbyangs pas/ /'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang thob/ /'du ba rnam bzhi yongs su 'dres/ /bgrod dka'i gnas rnams yud kyis 'khor/ /phyogs ris med par 'gro don byed/ /gnas 'dir sems can don la yong / /ri 'di ngo chad ma yin pa'i/ /rgyud 'grel bshad pa 'di 'dra yod/ /shel gyi mchod rten 111

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'dra ba'i ri/ /dgra bcom du ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sa/ /chu bo bzhi 'dus ti se'i gangs/ /de las brgyud pa'i ri rgyud de//dpal chen chu bo ri zhes grags/ /de la yon tan bsam mi khyab/ gnas der mkhas grub rgyun du 'byung / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bar chad sel/ /nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'byung khungs yod/ /sman rigs brgya dang sman chu yod/ /sa rdo'i rigs la ma tshang med/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ de las brgyud pa'i tsa rir sleb/ /de yi ri rgyud kong smad kyi/ /rgya la rtse ring zhes su grags/ /drang srong srin po ri zhes pa/ /'di la dbus phyogs sbus ri zer/ /g.yas na dpal gyi bsam yas yod/ /g.yon na chos 'khor lha sa yod/ /de yi ri brgyud ded pa yis/ /kong smad rgya la rtse sdum dang / /gshin rje'i dong kha bya bar sleb/ /de nas mdo khams zal mo'i sgang / /brgyud pas ri bo rtse lnga zhes/ /yongs su grags pa 'di la thug /dpe dang lung rnams gtso che yang / /nyams len lag pa longs pa gces/ /zhes gsungs pas bsam gtan pa rnams rab tu dga' ste/ /rnal 'byor pa khyed bzhugs dgos/ /zhabs tog nged rang rnams kyis byed zhus/ /lcags zam pa chen pos/ /nged gnas gcig tu bsdad pas mi chog rgyal khams bskor ba don che gsungs pas/ /'o na bdag cag rnams la chos kyi 'brel ba dgos zer/ /tshogs 'khor bshams ci 'byor pa'i yon phul bas mtshan brjod kyi lung dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod sems la phan pa zhig gnang ngo / /de nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dang phyag mtshan mi 'dra ba ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gzigs shing / /lung bstan 'di skad gsungs so/ /bod rmu rgod 'dul ba'i ched du 'byung bzhi'i kha gnon/ /sa'i me btsa' rim gyis thob 112

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/cig gsungs shing / /mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel dang khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo gsungs so zhes 'khod/de bzhin sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang / /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa ri bo rtse lngar byon pa'i skor yang sa skya'i gdung rabs('dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rin po che ji ltar byon tshul gyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i mdzod dgos 'dod kun 'byung〉 nang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i mdzad pa'i skabs/ /gzhan yang rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas/ /de na gnas pa'i rtogs ldan rgyan po zhes bya ba la/ /bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje ḍom+bi lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rje btsun bdag med ma'i sirtse ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /de'i rjes su rdzogs rim zab9 mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i man ngag byin te phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ngo sprod par byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo gnang nas rgyud grol bar mdzad cing / /skabs der rtogs ldan rgyan po la gdams pa phyag rgya chen po'i mig thur zhes bya ba chos rje pa'i gsung la yang yang nan chags byas nas bi jis ri bo rtse lngar bris zhes pa'i bstan bcos de mdzad pa dang / /gzhan yang ling chu rtse khab tu bzhugs te chos gsungs pa'i tshe mi mang po zhig ri bo rtse lnga la mchod pa la phyin pas thams cad kyi rmi lam du da lta ri bo rtse lnga na 'jam dpal mi bzhugs/ /ling chi rtse khab na chos gsung gin yod zer ba mthun par rmis te/ /sad pa na mi rnams kyis the tshom med par ling chur 'ong bas/ /chos rje nyid byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsungs pa dang mjal te chos thob bo zhes yongs su grags so zhes dang / /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i mdzad pa'i skabs 113

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dgung lo nyer gsum la ldong gis gdan drangs nas rtse lngar byon te gshin rje gshed brda bzhi/ /matā mā yā/ /rdor dbyings/ /dus 'khor sogs rgyud 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa(bsnyen rdzogs mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seng las)gsan/ /gzhan yang rigs tshogs/ /bstod tshogs mngon pa sogs mang du gsan no zhes 'khod pa dang ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs chos rje la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / /bla ma la bstod pa sogs bstod tshogs dang / /lhag par gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga'i ngo mtshar dang 'brel bar 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa mdzad pa cha tshang drangs pa 'di lta ste/ /'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ suste sir+ghaṃ/ /na mo mdzi nā thā ya//rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od gsal dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing / /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /bla ma rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rang bzhin rin chen las grub pa'i/ /'jam mgon lhun po ngang gis mdzes mod kyang / /bdag yid rab tu dad pas bstod pa'i tshig /nor bu'i phreng bas brgyan phyir bsdeb par bgyi/ /drang srong bla ma khyod kyis legs bsten pa'i/ /gnas mchog dam pa dge legs dpal gyis mtshan/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs bkod pas lhang nge ba/ /thog mar de yi rang bzhin bsngags par bgyi/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun la khyab mod kyang / /sprin bar khang pa'i mthongs na snang ba dang / /nyi ma nam mkha'i lam la rab rgyu yang / /shar gyi ri rtser 'char ba snang ba bzhin/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa yi/ /zhing khams kun na bzhugs mod de lta na'ang / /thugs rje'i shugs dang gdul bya'i mos pa yis/ /yul dus so sor snang bar gyur pa lags/ /de slad khyod kyi dag pa'i smon lam dag /skal ldan rnams kyi 114

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/bsod3mas las grub pa'i/ /lhun po'i rgyal po ri bo rtse lnga ni/ /rtsa ba gser gyi dbang chen lta bur brtan/ /rtse mo bkod legs yongs su bskor ba'i tshul/ /dbus kyi ri bo seng ge bsgyings pa bzhin/ /brag ri kun+da'i mdangs ltar rab tu dkar/ /shar ri'i rtse mo glang po'i gtsug 'dra ba/ /rtswa mchog kha dog nam mkha'i mdangs ltar sngo/ /lho yi ri bo rta mchog nyal ba bzhin/ /me tog gser mdog ldan pas rnam par bkram/ /nub ri rma bya gar byed lta bu'i tshul/ /sa gzhi pad+ma rā ga'i 'od chags 'bar/ /byang ri mkha' lding 'dab gshogs brkyang 'dra ba/ /margad mdog mtshungs ljon pas yongs su gang / /de slad 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang legs par 'khums/ /de 'dra'i lhun po 'phang dang rgyar yangs pa/ /sna tshogs shing dang lhug ma'i nags tshal bkram/ kha dog sna tshogs mdangs gsal me tog gi/ /tshom bu bkod legs ji bzhin rnam par bkra/ /'du ba'i nad sel 'dus pa mchog ldan pa'i/rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu sogs/ sman gyi tshogs kyis ngos rnams yongs su gang / /brag gi ri bo rin chen brtsegs 'dra dang / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i 'od 'byin pa'i/ /nor bu rdo yi snying pos rnam par spras/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' dang myang dang bsngags pa dang / /ma rmos lo tog la sogs du ma dang / /mu tig chun po rnam par 'thor 'dra ba'i/ /gzegs ma gnam du 'phro ba'i rba 'khrugs pa'i/ /dri za'i bu mo'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i sgra/ /kun tu sgrogs byed 'bab chu sna tshogs dang / /dri med dngul gyi me long bkod 'dra ba'i/ /lteng ka rdzing bu mtsho phran bkod ma rnams/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu yi gter/ /snying po rab rgyas ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan zhing / /lo 'dab mdangs bkra las 'phros dri bsung gis/ /nye 115

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bar bsdus pa'i bung ba sgra 'byin pa'i/ /pad+mo'i 'byung gnas dam pas nye bar bsten/ /ngang pa ngur pa khu byug la sogs pa/ /yid 'ong gzugs kyi dpal ldan na chung bzhin/ /dbyibs dang mdangs kyis sgeg chags las byung ba'i/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa kun tu sgrogs par byed/ /rlung ngad dal bus g.yo ba'i sil snyan sgras/ /nye bar bskul bas ljon shing ku sha'i tshogs/ /kun tu bskyod pa'i gar stabs legs byed cing / /ri dwags tshogs rnams rtse zhing dga' bar rol//gcan gzan lus rgyas rab tu dregs pa'i tshogs/ /bslab pas bsdams pa ji bzhin dul bar gnas/ /gdung ba skyob pa'i chu 'dzin bla rer bres/ /dri bsung gis bsgos bser bu'i bsil yab ldan/ /mi min gyis mchod mtshan mo sgron ma 'bar/ /'dod chags bral ba 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /sa bla'i lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang / /dka' thub mthar phyin dmod pa'i mtshon 'chang ba'i/ /lha dang mi yi drang srong tshogs rnams dang / /klu dang gnod sbyin ma mo 'byung po sogs/ /mthu stobs che ba che bar rab grags pa/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang bstan la mngon dga' bas/ /rtag par rgyun du bsten cing rim gror byed/ /klu yi bu rnams rang gi lus bstan nas/ /mi rnams kun dang rtse zhing rnam par rol/ /de lta'i legs tshogs du mas brgyan pa'i gnas/ /lhun po 'di ni lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /bste gnas dam pa dge legs kun 'byung ba'i/ /mchod rten chen po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas der rnam rol pa'i/ /'jam mgon de ni rgyal ba ji snyed kyis/ /legs par bsags pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /de snyed legs grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin thog ma med pa na/ /shin tu rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i bdag /ming dang tshan ma kun gyis ma spros pa/ /mnyam nyid 'jam pa'i 116

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dargongs bcud ces bya ba/ngang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi sprin la gnas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /chos kyis tshim mdzad chos rje bde chen gter/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor nges pa nyid/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smon lam grub pa dmigs med thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya ji snyed de snyed rnam 'phrul zhing / /srid pa ji srid de srid mi 'gag pa/ /'jam dpal rnam par rol la phyag 'tshal lo sku med ma lags bems po ma lags shing/ /mi gtsang rdzas las grub pa'i lus ma lags/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar gsal bar ston mdzad pa/ /dri med sku 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun po lta bur rab tu brjid pa'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis rnam par spras/ /nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i 'od 'gyed pa/ /dpag yas 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nor bu chu shel dwangs pa ni/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi rkyen gyis du mar snang / /de bzhin bcom ldan gdul bya'i dbang gis na/ /rnam pa du mar ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi mdangs dang zhal dang phyag dang zhabs/ /nyams dang cha lugs rgyan dang phyag mtshan gdan/ /mos pa tha dad 'gro ba kun 'dul zhing / /zab mo'i don mtshon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdutā bya'i khams dang mos pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed mgon po khyod kyi gsung gi dbyangs/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa mtha' yas pa/ /dam chos sgrogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med ston pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /mu stegs ri dwags gom pa 'khyor zhing 'bros/ /bdud sde'i wa tshogs snying rab 'gems byed pa/ /rgol ba tshar gcod gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/khyod gsung rig sngags sbyar bas zhi ba dang / /blo gros rgyas byed tshangs pa'i bu mo sogs/ /nye bar 'gugs byed drag po'i gsang sngags kyis/ /bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs zug rngu'i tshogs rnams 117

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/legs byang zhing / /las kyi 'ching grol skye ba'i gzeb las thar/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rab rib rnam dag pa/ /yang dag mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin sgrib med snang / /rten 'brel ma 'dres gzigs shing mnyam par dgongs/ /gzhan gyi don kun legs grub rtag par yang / /rtog pas mi bsgul thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen yangs pa can/ /thugs rje chen pos sems can kun skyob cing / /'phags mchog rnams kyi yul las rnam 'das pa/ /'jam dpal ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin dri med 'khor ba'i chos kyi gos/ /thabs kyi bdud bcas lam gyi rtsis bsgyur bas/ /grol ba'i yon tan sna tshogs tshon bkra ba/ /gnas yongs gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rten dang brten pa dang / /thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba dang / /zab dang rgya che'i yon tan rin chen gyis/ /rab tu brgyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad tshig gi gter brnyes rgyal bas kyang / /blo mchog khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gtos/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod kyang rdzogs bral ba/ /yon tan mi zad gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu rtog med par/ /skyes bu'i re ba yongs su rdzogs byed ltar/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /dbang gi rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshogs rnams re re la'ang / /bgrang yas rnam par 'phrul pas don mdzad cing / /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji srid phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor ba'i rgyal ba yis/ /yongs su bstan pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho yang / /ba spu'i bu gar 'phel 'grib rnam spangs nas/ /snang bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa yi rgya khyon zhabs kyi mthil gyis gnon/ /phyag 118

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gis nam mkha'i ngos kun yongs su khebs/ /'od kyis nyi ma bye ba mugs byed pa/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhad pa'i dbyangs kyis sa gsum g.yo byed cing / /ha ha zhes byas rgya mtsho'i klong rnams skems/ /hūṃ gis dus mtha'i me dpung 'jil byed pa/ /mdzad pa dpag yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gaṅgā'i rdul snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /bskal par mdzad pa phrin las rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /de snyed skad cig gcig gis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /dbus kyi ri rtser me long ye shes bdag 'khor lo'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /gzugs phung sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhe sdang gis gzir 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /shar gyi ri rtser chos dbyings ye shes bdag /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /rnam shes sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser snas bcings pa'i 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /lho yi ri rtser mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /tshor ba sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod chags kyis gzir 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nub kyi ri rtser kun rtog ye shes bdag /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /'du shes sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrag dog gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /byang gi ri rtser bya grub ye shes bdag /las kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /'du byed sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po phal cher gdul bya dag pa la/ /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa byu ru'i mdangs/ /yid bzhin shing rnams sna tshogs 'khor rnams kyis/ /yongs su bskor bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la la ni byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /rnam par rtse ba'i tshul gyis ston mdzad cing / /la lar dge sbyong 119

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/drang srong rgan po sogs/ /sna tshogs skur ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi ngo mtshar dpag yas rgya mtsho las/ /thigs pa tsam zhig brjod 'di rgyal ba yi/ /lung dang rtogs pa brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /rigs pa yis kyang dpyad de bsgrags pa las/ /sngon chad mig gi dbang pos ma mthong zhing / /ji bzhin rna bas kyang ni ma thos pa'i/ khyod kyi 'od zer shin tu phul byung ba/ /bdag gis mthong de mthong ba ji bzhin du/ /brjod par nus min ting 'dzin ro myang bzhin/ /'on kyang dran pa yis kyang dpal 'gyur bas/ /cha tsam tshigs su bcas pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /nye bar sgrogs la mngon par spro bar gyur/ /khyod kyi 'od kyis zhing brgya snang byed cing / /log blo'i ku mud tshal 'joms rtag par yang / /blo gros pad+mo rab tu rgyas byed pa/ /ye shes nyi ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi 'od zer skye dgu'i yid 'phrog pa'i/ /thad na nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar ba yang / /nyin mo'i zla ba tsam du'ang mi bzod na/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun zil gnon smos ci 'tshal/ /'od zer de yis nyon mongs gdung sel ba/ /bsil zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dra 'phro ba yis/ /ston zla rgyas pas dper yang mi bzod na/ /log dad rab rib 'phrog pa smos ci 'tshal/ /de yis gdul bya'i zhing la dge legs kyi/ /lo tog rab tu bskrun pas rnam kun tu/ /char sprin rab tu sgrogs pa'ang zil gnon na/ /dad pa'i chu klung 'phel bgyid smos ci 'tshal/ /mkha' dang sa dang bar snang thams cad du/ /gnas ma nges par 'od zer kun tu snang / /kha dog sna tshogs mdangs chags rab tu gsal/ /dbyibs ni rnam pa du mar ston par byed/ /na bun 'od zer phung por gyur pa 'ga'/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ /zad mi shes pa bar snang mtshams na rgyu/ /'od zer la la spel legs me tog gi/ /phreng ba ji bzhin phan 120

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/tshun brkyang pa dang / /la la nor bu spungs pa lta bu dang / /zla tshes 'dra dang tshes brgyad zla ba'i dbyibs/ /ka ba'i rnam pa lta bur snang ba dang / /'od zer chen po 'ga' zhig nam mkha' dang / /sa gzhi bar kun khyab par snang bas na/ /de mtha' tshad gzung bdag gis rngo ma thogs/ /margad pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i mdangs/ /'dres pa'i 'od kyi gong bu rab zlum pa/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil na snang ba ni/ /khyod kyi mdzod spu'i 'od ces rgyal rnams sgrogs/ /sa gzhi'i gtos kun rab dkar 'od kyis ni/ /snyoms par khebs pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bzhin/ /bar snang gser mdog 'od kyis gang ba dang / /res 'ga' pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'drar 'gyur/ /na bun nang na kha dog lngas bskor ba'i/ /'od 'khor 'khor lo lta bur snang ba ni/ /chu skyes chu gter dbus na rgyas pa bzhin/ /de mtha' rgyang nas 'od zer dkar pos bskor/ /de yi dbus na gzugs brnyan tshul gyis ni/ /nyid sku dang ldan dag gis gsal bar dmigs/ /grangs ni nyi ma gcig la'ang brgya phrag snyed/ /bdag cag rnams kyis legs mthong res 'ga' ni/ /snang dang mi snang gnas skabs du mar snang / /'od kyi bser bu de 'dra gdul bya'i yid/ /bag chags chu gter 'dus pas brtan pa yang / /rab tu bskyod pas bsngags pa'i sgra sgrogs shing / /spyi bos 'dud pa'i rba rlabs g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kyi/ /'od kyi mdzad pas zhing kun sbyong ba dang / /sems can smin par mdzad ces legs gsungs pas/ /'jam dbyangs 'od la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /skya rengs 'od kyis skar ma zil gnon pa/ /gang gis mthong des nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'tshal/ /de bzhin 'od zer rmad byung mthong ba des/ /'od mdzad yon tan dpag yas lags par 'khums/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs yon tan rgya mtsho mchog /dam 121

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chos rin chen mi zad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phags pa'i klu dbang tshogs kyis bsten pa la/ /srid pa kun tu nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /mgon po'i zla zhal dri med legs mthong zhing / /srid pa'i zug rngu rnam par sel ba yi/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bsil zer rab 'phro ba/ /rna ba'i snod du 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod rdzas rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /kun nas bkod legs yid 'ong bkram pa yis/ /kun tu nam mkha' khyab par blos sprul te/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas rtag tu mchod/ /tshul dang tshul min bdag gis ma 'tshal zhing / /las dang nyon mongs tshang tshing gis gzings pas//lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig /rgyal dang rgyatā sras rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /khams gsum gtogs pa'i skye bo ma lus dang / /lam gsum mthar phyin 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /sgo gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzhugs te bskul bar bgyi/ /nyid kyi nges pa'i sku ni rtag bzhugs kyang / /ma nges gdul bya bsod nams mi ldan pas/ /nges pa'i dbyings su zhi bar mthong rnams la/ /nges par rtag tu khyod sku snang bar mdzod/ /'gro kun rnam grol mchog la dgod bya'i phyir/ /blo mchog 'jam mgon rjes su bdag zhugs nas/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub spyod mchog rgya chen spyad par bgyi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mgon po 'jam dbyangs la/ /bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos gus pas mchod pa dang / /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /dge ba rgya mtsho bdag gis gang 122

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/bskrun dang / /dus rnams rgya mtshor skye bo thams cad dang / /'phags pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis legs bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho ji snyed yod pa kun/ /lhag bsam rgya mtshos gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /sems can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams ji snyed kyi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par byang gyur nas/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs nas rgyal ba yi/ /ye shes rgya mtshor myur du 'jug gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rigs gzugs dpal 'byor dbang phyug phun tshogs shing / /tshe ring nad med blo gros mchog gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /bdud kyi stobs dang mu stegs gzhung lugs dang / /chos ltar bcos pa'i mun sprul thams cad dang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nye bar 'tshe ba kun/ /bdag gi stobs kyis rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /skye dgu rnams kyi srid pa'i bde legs dang / /rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor gang yin pa/ /de kun 'bad pa med par bdag las ni/ /rang dbang nyid du ci bder 'byung gyur cig /'jam pa'i dpal gyi rnam 'phrul ji snyed pa/ /de snyed skad cig re la'ang bdag gis ni/ /ba spu'i bu ga re re sprul nas kyang / /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba'i don byed shog /gnas skabs su yang bstan la gang dga' zhing / /sems can rnams la byams pa'i blo dang ldan/ /de 'dra'i mi dbang rtag tu zhabs brten zhing / /de yi bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /'gro kun phan tshun brtse ba'i yid ldan zhing / /chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /e ma ngo mtshar zhes brjod gad mo'i sgras/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi bsam pa tshim gyur cig /de ltar brjod 'di gang gi mthus byung ba/ /shes bya kun mkhyen dmigs med thugs rje can/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs/ /'dren mchog de la slar 123

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /snyan pa'i 'od 'phro tshig gi nor bu'i tshogs/ /ngag gi srad bus tshar du dngar byas nas/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po legs mchod do/ /bstod tshig 'di ni nor bu'i phreng ba yin/ /'di yis gang gi mgrin par brgyan pa de'i/ /sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas/ /bsnyengs bral blo gros mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /tshul 'di ni shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i de kho na nyid ston pa la/ /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar rab tu brtse ba'i thugs rje mnga' ba sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid chen po/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul gyis spyi gtsug brgyan cing legs par bshad pa rin po che'i tshogs kyis blo gros kyi lus rnam par brgyan pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas ri bo rtse lnga de nyid du me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la rdzogs par sbyar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / /gzhan yang ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas kyi rang byung khams kyi khyad chos la mtshon na dbyar bsil la/ dgun dro ba/ tri sha ser skya dang / skye ba yod grub la sogs pa'i ljon shing sna tshogs pa/rtsa che'i sman rigs kyis ri klung kun dga' ba'i dri bsung mngar po phyogs bcur khyab pa/ nad dang sdig sgrib zhi ba'i dal gyis 'babs pa'i chu dang khrus kyi rdzing bu/ mtshe'u/ khron pa/ snyan pa'i skad snyan sgrog cing / spu sdug bkra ba'i 'dab chags kyi rigs mang ba/ ri dwags dang / gcan gzan gyi tshogs kyang phan tshun spun zla lta bu'i brtse sems kyis gnod sems spangs te 'khos babs par gnas pa sogs snod bcud kyi bkod pa dang / ngo mtshar mtha' klas pa/yang mi 'ga' zhig gis ri bo lnga po yang mi gcig lnga ru bzhed pa sogs sprul 124

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/pa'i zhing gi khyad chos mtha' yas pa'i mthong tshul sna tshogs 'byung ba sogs de lta bu'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa mthong na shes rab 'phel ba dang / der phyin na las sgrib sbyangs nus pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phags pa 'byung ba ni gnas der rgyal ba'i yab cig gzhon nu'i tshul bzung ba gtsug lag rtsis kyi ston pa mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs sku bltams pa dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i zhing gi mchog gyur yin pa'i rkyen gyis so/ /de lta bu'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa der gtsug lag rtsis kyi ston pa mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo phye ba'i tshul gsham du dus dang / chos dang / 'khor bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs su gleng rgyur gtogs shing / gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas kyi bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa dang / skyes chen dam pa du ma byon nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa dang / dad ldan rnams la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis snang ba khyad par can bstsal ba'i tshul dang / gong ma'i rgyal rabs rim gyis gnas mchog 'dir bkur sti dang rim gro ji ltar mdzad tshul sogs zhib cha gzigs par 'dod na lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me phag(spyi lo 1717)lor dbu brtsams pa'i〈zhing mchog ri bo dwangs bsil gyi gnas bshad dad pa'i pad+mo rgyas byed ngo mtshar nyi ma'i snang ba〉 dang / mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i be+e dkar sogs lo rgyus kyi yig cha ngo mtshar ldum rar spyan ras kyi bung ba yang yang g.yo bar 'tshal zhes gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i lo rgyus zhu mtshams 'dir byas so/ /125

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsum pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/spyir mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs ni rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yab dang /sngon gyi rgyal ba dpag tu med pa dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad par gsungs pa dang / yang sgos 'jig rten khams kyi snod bcud bkod pa yang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs bskyed las byung ba'i mdzad pa rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang bas 'u cag rnams kyis brjod par mi nus kyang thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo phye ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i dus ni sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa bskal pa bzang po'i dus dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus bzang po dang / mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rang gi gdul bya rnams sku dngos kyis 'dul ba'i dus la babs par dgongs nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sku bltams nas gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo phye ba'i dus bzang po bcas bzang po gsum 'dzoms pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dus ni/ de yang gzungs sngags rin po che'i gter mdzod dam/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gzungs sngags yi ge brgyad pa'i cho ga zhib mo zhes bya ba'i nang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag por byang shar gyi mtshams su matā tsi na zhes bya ba'i yul chen po yod pa der lhun po rtse lnga pa zhes bya ba'i ri bo yod la nga nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gnas der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas spyod lam ci bde ba'i tshul gyis gnas te/ sems can 126

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i dam pa'i chos rab tu ston cing rgya cher ston par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i lung gis gnas dang gang zag thun mong min pa'i chos bcas cig car du bstan pa dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs sku 'khrungs pa'i rjes rgya nag gi bon pos rang gi ston pa'i rnam 'phrul du bzung nas gzhon nu dbang phyug ces mtshan du gsol ba de nas kra'u yi rgyal po ma'o wang gis lha khang bzhengs nas gzhon nu de nyid kyi sku brnyan bsgrubs te mchod pa byas zhes gsungs pa dang / gnas chags srid sprul la sogs pa mtshon byed 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i rus sbal rtsis gzhir bkod nas gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs tshangs pa dang / lha mo rnam par rgyal ma/ klu rgyal 'jog po sogs la gsungs pa'i gnas lugs chos phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs zhib par gleng rgyur gtogs shing / mi yi yul du dar ba'i thog ma ni kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal pos mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs mjal ba tsam gyis dpyad brgyad khri bzhi stong sum brgya drug cu'i gto rang bzhin gyis thugs su chud pa dang / kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po dang / ji kong / ji nong / wang the'am lha 'phrul gyi rgyal ba'ang zer ba sogs 'phrul gyi mi bzhis snga rjes su rang rang gi 'byor pa'i skyes phul nas gsol ba btab pa las matā nag po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / 'jig rten sgron me snga rtags kyi rgyud sogs rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga gsungs pa 'di dag dus gang zhig la dar ba'i skor cung zad spro na/de yang / 1 deng dus yongs su grags pa gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs ltar na bcom ldan 'das spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 625me sprel lor sku bltams pa dang / spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 545me 'brug lor mya ngan las 'das pa/2 'jam dpal dbyangs 'khrungar+sā pa'i rjes su kra'u yi rgyal po ma'o wang 127

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gis gzhon nu'i sku brnyan bsgrubs te mchod pa byas zhes gsungs pas kra'u 'am khrun chi yi rgyal rabs kyi thog ma kung hwa(ṣār+ṣa)spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 841nas rgyal rabs tha ma cing wang(7cha)gis mjug sgril ba'i dus ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 476yin pa dang / de nas kran go'i rgyal rabs thog ma yon wang(rkerwa)spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 475lor mjug bsgril ba/3 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo phye ba'i mi'i 'khor gyi thog ma kong rtse 'phrul sogs 'phrul gyi mi bzhir rtsa ba'i rgyud dgu gsungs pa'i dus te kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 551lor 'khrungs pa dang / spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 479lor gshegs par brtsi ba bcas snga phyi'i lo 'gros de tshor brtags na spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo lnga brgya'i nang ste bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das rjes lo so dgu song ba'i shing pho byi ba spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 537tsam la phug lugs kyi ston pa'i 'das lo dang / gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs kyi ston pa'i 'das lo'i dbar lo grangs 343tsam phug lugs snga bar gsungs kyang / ston pa'i 'das lo dang ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dbyangs sku bltams pa'i dus tshod skor phug lugs kyi dgongs pa ni ston pa 'das nas lo 44song rjes 'dzam dbyangs sku bltams par bzhed pa dang / 'dir gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs brtsi gzhi bzungs stangs ni ston pa 'das nas lo so dgu song rjes 'jam dbyangs sku bltams par bshad pas brtsi sa de gnyis dbar lo khyad lnga las mi thon pas de ltar mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sku bltams pa dang / de nas rang gi gdul bya'i thog ma kong rtse 'phrul rgyal la rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga gsungs pa dang / de nas ji kong / ji nong /wang the 'phrul gyi mi gsum gyis rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams lag bstar gyis 'grel pa 128

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/mang po mdzad pas tsi na'i yul du gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig pa rgya cher dar ba yin zhing / rang cag kha ba'i ljongs su ni gnam ri srong btsan dus su gtsug lag 'di nyid phebs pa'i dbu brnyes kyang yi ge cha tshang ba med pas dar ba zhig ma byung zhing / bod du snga 'gyur thog ma ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i khab tu rgya bza' kong jo phebs rjes bod mi shes rab can ye shes rgyal ba/gtsang g.yu bzher/ 'gro gnyer brten pa/ ra bla mkhyen bzhi rgya nag tu phebs nas slob dpon 'bar ba tsham tshom la brten nas rgyud sde dgu dang / 'grel pa/gab tse bco lnga rnams bsgyur ba de nas rim pas dar ba bcas gtsug lag rtsis 'di dar ba'i dus phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar nas ring por ma lon pa dang / rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i dus skabs bzang po dang / bye brag rgya nag gi yul gru ru yang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ yang sgos rang cag kha ba'i ljongs la mtshon na yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i thugs bskyed las rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya bza' kong jo khab tu bzhes te sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pa'i rten bzang po jo bo shākya mu ne rang cag rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par spyan drangs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i dus la babs pa bcas 'dzam gling chen po'i spyi bye brag gi 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dus su smin pa'i bskal pa bzang po'i dus gang la bltas kyang dus de dag ni shin tu bzang po zhig yin par the tshom ma dgos lags so/ / 129

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzhi pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa/mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rlabs po che'i thugs bskyed las rang bzhin gzhi'i gtsug lag dang / ma rig 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag gnyis su phye ba'i rang bzhin gzhi'i gtsug lag ni snod bcud 'byung ba lnga'i chos ji snyed snang ba brtag na nam mkha' rang bzhin te gnas lugs stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba zhig yin pas mtha' dbus med pa rtsis las 'das pa dang / ma rig 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag la'ang rnam pa gnyis te brtsi ba'i gzhi dang / brtsi thabs gnyis so/ /dang po brtsi ba'i gzhi la yang bzhi re 'byung ba yi phyi nang bar gsum dbye ba las 'byung ba rang rgyud gtsug lag dang / dbang yul cir snang 'byung ba ru shes pa snang yul gyi gtsug lag de dag 'byung ba'i gsod pa dang bskyed pa sogs bsam pa yid kyi gtsug lag de yi skyon yon bde sdug khams 'dzin pa sems kyi gtsug lag go /gnyis pa brtsi thabs gnas pa'i rus sbal dang / chags pa'i rus sbal/srid pa'i rus sbal/ sprul pa'i rus sbal/ bshas pa'i rus sbal rtsis gzhir bkod nas lha srin sde brgyad dang / mi'i 'khor la gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo gsung bar gsungs pa'i gnas chags sogs mtshon byed rtsis gzhir gsungs pa'i skor cung zhib par spros na/dang po/ gnas pa'i rus sbal ni/ de yang sngon gyi mun pa'i bskal pa mngon par dga' ba'am mdzes par snang ba zhig cing stongs pa'i tshe phyi'i 130

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/'byung ba shin tu g.ya' dang bral ba lcags khams kyi nam mkha'/ mtha' dbus bral ba'i stong pa la mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'og min lha yi gnas su bzhugs nas 'og gi phyogs shangs kyi bug pa nas rlung bu phyung ba de las srid pa ye nas yod pa shing khams dang mthun pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams chags pa de la rlung las rlung gi rgya gram byung / de nas ljags kyi mchil ma 'thor ba las rlangs pa byung ba de'i ngad kyi rlangs pa rim bzhin zil par gyur pa de las chu yi rgya mtsho ji cher 'phel ba byung ngo / /de'i steng spyan gyis gzigs pa las 'byung ba sa yi dkyil 'khor chags so/ /de'i steng 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan ral gri'i 'od 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du las 'byung ba me yi dkyil 'khor grub pa de rnams gnas pa'i rus sbal dang sbyar na/ dang po ci yang med pa las ye nas yod pa'am gnas pa'i rus sbal zhes bya ba las dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyang de yi cha las srid pa'am byung ba de'i dpe ni nam mkha' stong pa la don ni kun bzang chos kyi dbyings yin pas dus gsum gang du yang 'du bral med par gnas pa de yang / mgo mjug 'dir blta med pa/yan lag 'dir bstan med pa/ dus kyang 'dir gnas med par gnas so/ /de la sangs rgyas dang sems can/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul pa'i sku/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bcas pa'i sprul pa dang / pho mo ma ning 'gro sdod la sogs pa mtha' gcig tu bzung du mi rung ba/ khyad du 'phags pa de la gnas pa'i rus sbal zhes bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa/ chags pa'i rus sbal ni/ gnas pa'i rus sbal gyi kha rlangs las 'byung ba chu yi dkyil 'khor bdun dang / rus sbal gyi kha las chu yi 131

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dkyil 'khor ljang khu grub cing / de'i steng rus sbal gyi sha las lhun po ri mtsho gling phran dang / gser gyi sa gzhi dang bcas pa chags pa/ rus sbal gyi ba spu rtsi shing gi tshul du chags pa de la chags pa'i rus sbal zhes bya bar brjod pa yin/gsum pa/ srid pa'i rus sbal ser po ni/ gnas pa dang / chags pa'i rus sbal phrad pa las srid pa'i rus sbal byung / srid pa'i rus sbal de yi mgo bo lhor bstan cing / mjug ma byang la bstan pa/ yan lag phyogs mtshams bzhir gnas pa de yi gdung rgyab dkar po las khen pa rgad bu gnam du srid pa de las lha yi 'jig rten ni/ skye mched mu bzhi gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha lha chen tshangs pa la sogs pa steng du lha yi rgyal khams byung / de 'og ri rab chen po'i steng sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams byung / ri rab chen po'i rked pa la rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams dang / nyi zla gza' skar thams cad byung ba yin no/ /rus sbal gyi mig las nyi zla dang / rkan gyi sgra las 'brug skad byung ba/ lce brkyang pa las glog 'od 'char ba bcas byung ba de las thog dang ser ba byung ba yin no/ /rus sbal gyi dbugs las rlung dang / don snying lngar phyi yi 'byung ba lnga yang byung / rus sbal gyi lus 'gul ba las sa gzhi g.yo ba yang byung ba yin no/ /rus sbal lto ba ser po las khon ma rgan mo sa ru srid pa'am byung ba dang / de las gtum po klu brgyad sogs klu yi 'jig rten 'og tu grub pa yin no/ /srid pa'i rus sbal de yang thabs shes sam pho mo gnyis su gyes pa las yid byed gser gyi rus sbal ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa thabs kyi rang bzhin kha bub tu gnas pa dang / chos bya dngul gyi rus sbal ni sa gzhi'i 132

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gtos dang mnyam pa shes rab kyi rang bzhin gan rkyal du gnas pa'i tshul sogs bshad tshul du ji snyed cig mchis so /de nas gnam sa rgan rgon ming dang ni/ ming sring rim pa khams grub pa'i tshul yang srid pa'i rus sbal de nyid kyi lus kyi mtshan ma'i ri mo rnam pa brgyad dang / zhal gyi rlangs 'od dang bcas pa 'thul ba las khen zhes bya ba'i yi ger snang ba'i 'byung ba'i dngas mar khon rgan byung / rus sbal gyi phyi sa thur du 'dzags pa las khon zhes bya ba'i ye ger snang ba 'byung ba'i snyigs ma khon ma rgan ming 'byung / khen rgan dang khon ma rgan mo klungs mal bsdebs pa dang / gnam dang sa'i ka ba ri yis byas pa la brten nas bu chen sngon ma gin ri byung ngo / /ri brag bar du rlung byung ba'i rkyen gyis bu mo chen mo zon rlung byung ngo / /rlung gis gtsubs te brdar ba la me 'bar bas bu mo 'bring mo li yang byung / rlung dang me gnyis 'khrugs te char babs pas bu chung ba kham chu sgur po mi gtsang byung / de dag rnams kyi bar du shing skyes pas bu mo chung ngu zin shing byung ngo / /me yis sa bzhu lcags byung ste bu 'bring gcod byed dwa lcags byung / kham zin gnyis po byung tshul ni/ bu che ba gin dang / bu mo che ba zon gnyis lang tsho dar la babs nas las kyis chags sems skyes par gyur nas ming po gin ris ri rab lan gsum dang / bu mo che ba zon gyis rgya mtsho bskor gyur kyang / khong tsho gnyis la bza' zla rnyed par ma gyur pa 'khyams pas srin mo gdug pa can gyi yul ye le dgung sngon bya ba der las kyi rlung 'tshub langs pa'i klong der ming sring ngo ma shes par 'dus nas phrad pas spun zla'i mnol nor kham dang zin gnyis mnol phrug tu btsas so/ /de yis srid pa'i lha klu 'khrugs nas lha dang klu rnams bshos pa las snang srid lha srin sde brgyad byung 133

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ba de yang lus po dang mgo'i dbyibs kyang sna tshogs pa grub bo/ /de bzhin lha dang srin du 'dus pa'am bshos pa las ri rab chen po'i khong gseng du lha ma yin gyi rgyal khams byung ba yin no/ /'og tu klu rnams kyang phan tshun bshos pa las zha grum mnol ba'i lha rnams grub pa yin no/ /de nas lha yi las zad pas sems can de dag mi yi yul du lhungs nas gling bzhi gling phran gyi mi rnams byung ba yin no/ /de nas mi yi las zad pas ngan 'gro rnam pa gsum yang grub cing / nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye shi byung bas 'gro ba rigs drug gi srid pa ni rim gyis byung bar grags pa de dag gis srid pa'i rus sbal las spar kha brgyad grub pa de dag gi 'byung ba dang khams kyis rang bzhin yang pha ma bu dang bu mo'i tshul du byung ba'i byed las las snod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar grub pa'i skabs bstan pa'o/ /de nas gnam sa gnyis po kha 'byar zhing / shar nub dang / phu mda' la sogs pa gdags sribs mun pas 'khrigs pa dang / sems can thams cad nad kyis zin pa de'i tshe khen pa rgan pos 'o dod kyi gnam bos kyang / phan pa ma byung ba 'di 'dra cis lan zhes steng gi lha la sgros shig brjod pas 'jam dpal dbyangs thugs phyung ste nam mkha'i khams nas 'di skad bsgrags so/ /'di lta bu'i rkyen ngan pa gzhan cis kyang ma nongs te srid pa'i nal gyis nongs so skad/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na spar kha brgyad po so sor bsdad na phan pa yin no zhes pa'i gsung byung ba dang / kha brgyad bza' mi tshogs pa de las so so'i nor rdzas dang bcas pa gser gyi rus sbal gyi sa ru 'tshogs nas bu tsha ming sring tshang ba yis 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gsung bzhin pha rgan mtsho'i gling la 'khyams nas sprul pa'i rus sbal dang phrad de rus sbal de yi rkang pa g.yon par 134

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/khen pa rgan po 'khril ba dang / khon ma yang khyo 'tshol bar 'khyams pa las khyo ma rnyed pa sprul pa'i rus sbal gyi lag g.yon 'khril nas bsdad/ de'i tshe bu mo 'bring ba li me yis pha la ming po gin ri dang / gcen mo zon gnyis phan tshun ngo ma shes pas mnol lugs de ltar 'byung srid pa de la pha khyed yid chad par ma mdzad ces smras par/ pha rgan tshig pa za nas li me'i gtam de log par go nas khyod kyis de ltar zer tshod kyis khyod kyang kho gnyis mnol ba'i gros la gtogs so zhes smras par bu mo li me pha la zhed nas me ri dgu 'bum gyi nang du bros te gnas so/ /de nas pha khen rgan bu mo de la gdung ba'i sems skyes te skyes pa mi bzad pa zhig tu sprul nas bu mo li me'i sa der phyin nas dgung gsum gru bzhir rtse zhing rol pa de'i tshe 'dre lnga yong ste dbugs rkyal bskyal bas li me zla zhag khrag nyil du song bas li la zla zhig dwar tshar 'dzin pa 'byung ba'i tshul yang de ltar srid pa yin no/ /de'i tshe bu mo li yi bsam pa la skyes pa 'di ni gzhan ma yin pa pha rgan khyod kyi sprul pa yin pas khyod nyid rgas kha ru pho yi bla shor ba'i sdug bsngal yong ba shog ces dmod pa bor ba pha yi thugs su chud pa de nas khon mar glo bur bshos pa'i bu mi dkar g.yu yi smin ma can zhig skyes pa de ni gnam gyi g.yas gral la song ba de'i ming la dur phag khra mor btags so/ /de 'og khen rgan gyis khon mar bshos pa'i bu mi lus sbrul mgo can zhig skyes pa pha khen rgan gyi bu skal byas pa de la li mes btsan gyi jag pa rkyal brgyad rbad de byung ba de dag gis bu skal gyi sbrul mgo bcad nas gnam brag gi rtsar gzhag pa de'i 'gram du pha phyin pas bu'i ro dang phrad pas lo gsum du mya ngan du khas non par gyur pa de yis li me snying tshim gyur pas li dang khen gcig bdud gcig tu song ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no//135

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de nas ma yis bu mo li me bkug nas rus sbal gyi mgo bo'i steng bzhag cing / bu 'bring ba dwa yis ni pha la spro ba bsring pa'i bya ba byas pas pha yis rus sbal snying gi steng bzhag pa de'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas bu mo mar nye ba dang / bu phar nye ba'i gtan tshigs dang po de nas byung ba yin no/ /kham chus mes po'i don byas nas gser gyi sor gdub 'phangs nas bu mo li yi mig bcar ba'am slong bas li yis kham la long chu pho bas long ba dgu brgyud de nas byung bar grags so/ /kham gyis khen pa'i bu ro bzung ste gnam sa'i mchan khung du bzhag pa de la gnam ther ming gsol lo/ /de 'og khen gyi bur mi yi lus la phag gi mgo can gcig byung ba gnam gyi g.yon gral du bzhag pa de la gnam gyi ro 'dzin du grags so/ /khon gyis kham la khyod kyis mi ro bzung 'dug pa 'dir ni 'dug pa'i gnas med kyi byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i nang du song zhig smras pas rgan mo khyod sha zad khrag skams gzhogs zad du song zhes kham gyis dmod pa bor bas rgan mo tshig pa za nas khyod nyid ro'i bdag po byas na ngas kyang de ltar byed 'jug go zhes sems can gyi mgo bcad pa zhig dar ser gyis gtums nas rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du bskyur ba de kham gyis chu glang sngon po zhig rgya mtsho'i nang du 'phyo ba mthong ba de pha yi nor skal lam ma'i phra ma gang yin blta snyam nas dar gtums de kha phye bas mi mgo mthong bas gnam sa'i ro 'dzin zhes pa de ltar byung ba yin no/ /khon mas kham la khyod nyid ni srid pa sna tshogs kyi bu khyod ces tho les btab nas rus sbal gyi rkang pa'i bar du bcug pa'i rkyen gyis khon kham de 136

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gnyis gcig bdud gcig tu song ba yin no/ /ming sring che ba gin zon rnam gnyis kyis bu mo chung ba zin shing rus sbal gyi mchan khung g.yas su bzhag pa las khyod lan ngas lan ma 'cham par mna' bor mna' za de nas byung ba yin no/ /bu 'bring ba dwa yis pha khen rgan la/ kham dang khon gnyis kyi srubs bar la zin shing rgan mos btus pa 'dir sel ma byas na rabs chad cing / bse mig bol bar 'ong zhes brjod pas de la zin shing tshig pa za nas ngar smra ba ngan pa byed pa dwa khyod bzhu bar bya'o zer nas mi'i rus pa spos dang sbyar ba dar sngon gyis gtums pa zhig khyer te bu mo li me'i gan du song nas khyod la nus pa dang rdzu 'phrul yod na dwa las brgal bar byed nus sam zer bar li mes de ni las sla ba yin zer te dar thums sngon po de khyer nas dwa yi drung du phyin nas bdud rtsi'i thums 'di nyo'am zer zhing byin pas dwa yis thums de kha phye bas mi rus yod pa mthong ste rang la ngan byas par go nas li bzung bas de'i tshe li yis rang nyid me yi dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pas dwa lcags bzhus pa mthong ste yid tshim par gyur nas dwa lcags bzhur ba'i dreg pa dar dkar nang gtums pa re nag mchan khung du bcug ste bu mo chung ba zin la rgol du 'ongs pa'i lam du bu chung kham phrad par kham gyis gar 'gro smras par zin la rgol bar 'gro zhes zer zhing / kham la re ba byin pa sbrar gsal kham gyis sel khas blangs pa de'i rkyen gyis kham la sbra nag bsdig pa dang / god kha 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no/ /kham gyis dar thums de khyer phyin pas zin phrad pa des khyod gar 'gro dris pa la nga pha rgan gnam gyi gan du 'gro byas pas zin gyis gnam brag dag 137

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/la mi thar ro smras par kham gyis zon la rlung 'khor bskor nas 'gro bar bya'o smras so/ /zin gyis kham la khyod kyis khur ba de ci red smras pas bdud rtsi yin gyi khyod la ster zhes byin pa kha phye bas lcags phye byung bas shing gi gshed lcags yin pas der lcags kyi sdong po grangs sum brgya drug cu skyes so/ /shing la bgrod pa'i sa med par gyur pas dwa zin 'khon pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar yin no/ /dwa zin 'khon pa'i rtsa ba gin zon gnyis la thug ces brjod pas zon gyis ngas ma lan nga la dbang med zer/ gin gyis kyang ngas ma lan zer zhing phan tshun 'thab pas zon gyis skra ral pa can du byas te bag phye'i ril bu'i nang sa bon bcug ste ri rab kyi bang rim dang por bcug go /gin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi sa bdag dang dmag dpon byas nas phyin te phyir log pa'i lam khar bag phye'i ril bu de rnyed nas pha skal ma 'phro yin par bsam ste 'ongs nas ming sring sngas su bcug ste ri rab gsum bskor 'ongs pa dang /ril bu de las me 'bar te ming sring mgo tshig nas 'das par gyur to/ /gin gyis ming sring gi ro khur nas zon la 'thab tu song bas kham phrad pas gin la khyod kyi khur ba de ci yin dris par sha yin 'tshong du 'gro zhes brjod par sha de nga nyo zer bar ma btsongs pas kham gyis gri brgyab pas ming sring gi ro de'i rked pa bcad par gin gyis nga yi ming sring bsad song zhes brjod par kham kha skyengs pas bu tsha'i ro bzung ste kham gyis gnam ro lan gsum bzung bar grags/ gin gyi phyir log pa'i lam kha ru rlung 'tshub cig dang phrad par gyur pa na de la sa spar gang la bsngags te brgyab pa rlung 'tshub pa'i nang bse ral bud med cig byung ba'i snying la gzer btab pas gnam la gnam the'i drung phyin te gnam ther khyod la gin la rgol nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul ci yod dris par/138

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/mnam thes nga la mthu med dur phag rtsa ru song zhes smras pa ltar dur phag la smras par dur phag de nyid kyis sa bdag gi bu che ni gin ri yin pas sa bdag gis ni mthu byin rlabs kyis lan cig rgyal yang gin ri ni mi thub brjod do/ /de nas gyin gyis zon la smras pa/ zon rlung ral khur bdag mo khyod pha gcig bu gcig shog ces smras pas de ltar 'khon 'gras gyur pa'i tshe li yi brda tshig log par smras pas pha yi bdud du song ba yin no/ /dwa yis zin la tho le btab ste mda' 'phangs zin gyi ya mchu dbral bas sho rer 'byung ba de ltar yin no/ /khon dang khen 'thab phas mda' 'phangs pas khon gyi gzhung ral ba dang khon ma yis mda' bkang bar dwa sgyugs pas dwa yis mde'u'i rtse nas bzung ba de la gnam sa'i mdel bar bya ba yin no/ /kham la li yis ljags thig btab pa dang / kham gyis li yi snying yang phyungs pas snying gi khong pa stong pa de ltar gyur pa yin no/ /li yis kham gyi ya mchu dang / ma mchu dbral bas grog rked song / zon gin lan ma lan la 'thabs te zon gyis gin gyi ma mchu dbral/ gin gyis zon gyi ya mchu dbral ba de lta bu yis nal 'khrugs dme bdud song ba yin no/ /spar kha brgyad po de ltar 'thab nas gyes pas spar kha brgyad ces zer ba rnams gser gyi rus sbal gyi mtha' nas bskor te gnas pa'i gnas lugs de dag gis spar kha'i gcig bdud gcig tu song ba lta bu mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang /yang na mthun pa'i phyogs dang / spar kha brgyad po rus sbal gyi phyogs gang la gnas pa dper na/ rus sbal gyi rkang pa g.yon par khen 'khril te gnas pa dang / lag g.yon par khon ma 'khril ba lta bu/ spar kha brgyad kyi phyag rgya'i yi ge grub stangs de bzhin nag rtsis kyi mtshan ma mang po'i thog ma'i 'byung stangs 139

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsal por bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar spar kha brgyad po de las bu tsha ming sring bcu gnyis byung ba ste/ de yang zin la stag yos ming sring gnyis byung ba/ zon la bu 'brug li me la rta sbrul ming sring gnyis/ khon la bu mo lug dwa la bya sprel ming sring gnyis/ khen la bu khyi/ kham la byi phag ming sring gnyis/ gin gyi bu mo glang bcas spar kha brgyad la brten nas lo 'gros sam lo rtags bcu gnyis de ltar byung bar grags so/ /lo 'gros de bzhin dus tshod la 'char ba ste/ dpyid zla ra ba stag dang /'bring po yos/ tha chung 'brug dbyar zla ra ba sbrul dang / dbyar 'bring rta/dbyar tha lug ston zla ra ba sprel/ ston 'bring bya/ ston tha khyi/ dgun zla ra ba phag dgun 'bring byi ba/ dgun tha glang las shar ba yin no/ /de nas bcud kyi sems can grub pa'i tshul yang / 'dod chags nga rgyal 'dod sred dang / gti mug ser sna zhe sdang drug las 'gro ba rigs drug byung ba 'dul ba'i ched du brgya byin dang / thags bzang ris dang / shākya thub pa dang / seng ge dam brtan dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / chos kyi rgyal po ste thub pa rigs drug tu sprul nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i don chen mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang ma rig rgyu dang / las nyon mongs rkyen gyis lha dang / lha min dang / mi dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dang / dmyal ba ste 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba bzo chun khyud mo ltar 'khor ba de yang bcud kyi 'gro ba dang / snod kyi chags tshul lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gling dang / yul gyi chags lugs sogs dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa dang / mngon pa gong 'og dang / 'jig rten gdags pa dang / dran pa nyer 140

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/bar bzhag pa/ mdo phal po che/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' yas par mi 'dra ba'i tshul ni mang du gsungs pa rnams kyang 'dul bya rang rang gi snang ngor chu phor lha yis bdud rtsi dang / mis chu dang / dmyal ba pas rnag khrag tu mthong ba lta bu rgyal bas gdul bya'i snang ngo las 'jig rten zhes pas ma gzigs phyir na gar yang mi gnas la 'gal ba yang med pa de dag rnams kyi dgongs pa ni gtsug lag 'dir dmigs bsal ma gsungs pa gong du dus kyi 'khor lo'i skabs gsungs pa 'dir bskyar bzlos kyi ngal ba ma bstan to/ /bzhi pa/ sprul pa'i rus sbal ni/ 'khor ba rgya mtsho lta bu mtha' med pa'i gdul bya'i 'gro ba 'dren pa dang / spyad cing zad mtha' med pa la dgos 'dod kyi re ba skong ba dang / nam mkhar cir snang rgya mtshor snang ba de'i phyir mtha' med gting zab pa'i rgya mtshor 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis ljags kyi mchil ma'i thigs pa bskyur bas de ni gser gyi sgo ngar gyur pa de las 'gro ba'i tshe dang bsod nams kyi yon tan gser ltar bskyed pa'i phyir kha dog ser po'i rus sbal zhig byung ba de yang dgos 'dod dam chos spyod pa'i gling 'dzam bu'i gling tshe lo brgya pa'i dus la yang tshe la nges pa med pa rkyen dbang gis skye bo shas che ba bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba'i phyir dang / gtsug lag 'di nyid gling 'dir dar ba dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku mchog lho gling 'dir 'byung bar dgongs nas sprul pa'i rus sbal gyi mgo bo lhor bstan cing /chags zhan skyon gyis ma gos pa'i phyir pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa dang / 'khor ba'i kha lo gyen du 'dren pa'i phyir kha ni gyen du blta ba ste nam mkha' bar snang bstan pa dang / 'khor bar rgyab kyis phyogs rtags su gan rkyal dag tu gnas 141

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa yin no/ /pho byung mchod rten mo byung pad+ma'i ris dang / sras byung ba kun thig le'i rigs dang ldan pa byol song gi rigs la rgyal ba'i mtshan ma mnga' ba matā gser gyi rus sbal zhes bya ba byung ba de'i mtshan gyi don yang / ma ni sems can kun gyi ma yin pa dang / tā ni spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba 'dus pa'i thugs rje che ba'i brda/ gser ni 'gyur ba med pa rin chen sna lnga'i gtso bo de mtshon la/ rus ni 'gro ba'i rus kyi rgyu yin pa/ sbal ni thabs dang shes rab sbal ba'i don nam yang na phyi la rus pa nang sbal par yod pas rus sbal zhes kyang grags so/ /rus sbal de la yang phyi nang gsang ba'i sprul pa gsum byung ste phyi ltar sprul pas 'go ba yi pho lha rnam pa bcu gnyis te mtshon byed lo rtags bcu gnyis byung ba de yang shing me sa lcags chu'i 'byung ba lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /rus sbal nang ltar sprul pa las/ phan gnod byed pa'i lha brgyad byung ba ste spar kha brgyad kyis lha 'dre sprul pa la las gnod pa'i ko long sdom pa yin no/ /rus sbal gsang ba ltar sprul par ko long sdom pa'i lha bco brgyad phan gnod sna tshogs byed par sprul pa steng 'og 'jig rten thams cad lha 'dre mi rnams kyis gang bas gsang ba ltar sprul ba'i rus sbal de sdod sa ma rnyed nas lo rta zhon nas 'khor rab tu sprul te phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre de rnams rang gi 'khor du bskor zhing ko long sdom pa yin no/ /ring bsrel lta bu'i rus sbal ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer spros pa de'i tshe gus pas mdun du 'dus pa'i 'khor ni bsod nams ldan pa lha/longs spyod can gyi klu rgyal/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba lha min/ gdug rtsub ldan pa 142

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/sde brgyad/ mi bcas rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lnga dang ldan par bzhugs pa la dus der sems can mos pa'am/ 'jug pa'i sgo dang bstun nas gso ba rig par gtogs pa yi rtsis sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong ngam bsdus pas 'gyur rtsis sum brgya drug cu gsungs pa'i thog mar spyi bo nas sprul pa sku yi rgyud snang gsal sgron me dang / zhal nas sprul pa gsung gi rgyud 'byams yig chen mo/ thugs nas sprul pa thugs rgyud sdong bu dgu 'dus/ lte ba nas sprul pa yon tan rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi/ phyag nas phrin las kyi rgyud rus sbal nag po rtsa rgyud sprul pa de ltar sprul pa'i rgyud rnam pa lnga gsungs par der 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams ngo mtshar rab tu skyes nas lha yi 'khor tshogs du ma'i nang nas tshangs pas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dang / lha mo rnam rgyal mas lha'i me tog tsam pa ka phul nas rang rang gis 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas te gsol ba'i ngor sems can gyi nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i don ting 'dzin snying po sha ri ram(sku)spyi bo'i gtsug nas tshangs pa dang / sprul pa'i rus sbal lha mo'i lag par bzhag ste dgongs pa'i thugs rje'i ring bsrel las grub pa'i rus sbal la gyur to/ /de yang yab ni stong nyid nam mkha' dang / yum ni theg chen gser gyi sa gzhi yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sras ni sprul pa ring bsrel gnyis te 'od zer sna lnga'i thig le can gyi sprul pa'i rus sbal mgo bo lhor bstan nas gnas pa la phyi nang gsang gsum bshas pa'i ched ting nge 'dzin gyi ral gri rnon po rtsibs logs g.yas nas bsnun pa'i gri rtse nub tu thon pa dang / so yi rus las nub phyogs lcags kyi khams su grub pa dang / yu ba shing shar du lus pa dang / ba spu shar phyogs 'byung ba shing khams su grub pa/kha nas dngas pa'i rlangs drod de lho phyogs 'byung bas me yi khams su grub pa/143

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dred pa'i dri chu bor bas byang phyogs chu yi 'byung ba grub pa/ pags pa dang yan lag mtshams bzhir bor bas sa yi khams su grub pa de dag ni phyi ltar rus sbal bshas pa'i 'byung ba'i grub tshul de ltar yin no/ /nang ltar bshas pa'i tshul yang / nang ltar rtsa rgyus shar phyogs 'byung ba shing / dbugs drod lho phyogs 'byung ba me/ rus pa nub phyogs 'byung ba lcags/ khrag dang chu ser byang phyogs su 'byung ba chu/ sha las mtshams bzhir 'byung ba sa ru grub pa yin no/ /gsang ba ltar bshas pa'i tshul yang don snying rnam pa lnga las mchin pa rtsibs g.yas su gnas pa dang / mchin pa shar du 'gro ba de yang yang zhing g.yo ba yin pas shar phyogs 'byung ba shing yin no/ /snying dang mgo klad lho ru bor ba de dag 'bar zhing dro ba yin pas lho phyogs me yi khams su grub pa/ glo ba rtsibs g.yon nub tu bor ba 'dar zhing gcod pa de yin pas nub phyogs lcags kyi khams su grub pa/ mkhal ma chu so byang du bor ba rlan zhing gsher ba yin pas byang phyogs chu yi khams su nges pa/ mcher pa yan lag phyogs mtshams bzhir bor ba sra zhing brtan pa yin pas mtshams bzhi sa yi khams su nges pa yin no/ /de yang zhib par bshad na/ rus sbal gyi mgo bo lho snying me yi gab tsher brjod na 'di lta ste/ spar kha li yin lo rtags rta sbrul/ gza' nyi ma/ lho skar mchu bre dbo me bzhi nag pa sa ri me skar drug ras sbal pad+ma phyag rgya dmar po/rus chen ji me/ dbang lo dbang gza' dbang skar dang pho rtsa mo rtsa drod g.yos pa'i khu ba dag tu gyur pa yin/ khu gnyis gso ba me yin pas rang dang bu tsha'i brtsi bya me yin no/ /144

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/rus sbal mjug ma byang la bstan pa mkhal ma chu yi gab tshe ste/ rus sbal pad+ma phyag rgya mthing gi mdog spar kha kham dang / byi ba dang phag pa'i lo/ res gza' zla ba dang lhag pa/ byang skar la mon dre mon gru khrums stod khrums smad/nam gru tha skar chu khams drug /rus chen 'u chu/ dbang lo dbang gza' dbang skar dang / rtsa ni khrag dang khu bas 'debs pa/ khrag dang khu ba chu yi khams/ gnyen lam la phyi'i brtsi bya chu yin no/ /rus sbal glo g.yas shar la bstan pas mchin pa shing gi gab tshe yin/rus sbal pad+ma phyag rgya ljang khu/ spar kha zin/ lo rtags stag yos/ res gza' phur bu/ shar skar smin drug dang / snar ma mgo lag nabs so rgyal shing skar drug yin/ de las rus chen keg shing khams/ dbang lo dbang gza' dbang skar dang / rtsa ni shing gi rang bzhin yin pas rtsa nas bdag skyed khu ba 'byung ba de phyir pha mes shing nas brtsi ba yin no/ /rus sbal glo g.yon nub la bstan pas glo ba lcags kyi gab tshe yin pas rus sbal pad+ma phyag rgya dkar po/ spar kha dwa/ lo rtags bya sprel/ res gza' pa sangs/ nub skar lha mtshams dang / snon/ snrubs/ chu stod/ chu smad/ gro bzhin te lcags khams kyi skar ma drug yin no/ /de las rus chen shing lcags khams/ dbang lo dang dbang gza' dbang skar dang / bkres pa dang dub par mi 'gyur bas mi 'gyur ba ni lcags kyi khams yin pas zhang nye lha srung brtsi bya lcags yin no/ /rus sbal yan lag mtshams bzhir brkyang pa mcher pa sa yi gab tshe ste rus sbal pad+ma phyag rgya ser po dang / khon khen gin zon bzhi/ lo rtags glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ res gza' spen pa/ skar ma bra nye/ skag sa ga byi 145

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzhin mtshams skar bzhi yin no/ /de las rus chen kungs sa khams/ dbang lo/ dbang gza'/ dbang skar dang / khu ba sha yi ma la brten par byed pa'i sa khams dang / yul dang mkhar khyim sa ru brtsi ba yin no/ /rus sbal gyi phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi la brten nas 'byung ba lnga grub pa de yang / shar shing / lho me/ nub lcags/ byang chu/ mtshams bzhi sa yi khams yin pa ma dang / bu dang / dgra dang / grogs lnga re byung ba dang / dar gud bcu gnyis 'byung ba lnga ni sgo yin no/ /rus sbal rnam shes tshogs brgyad las spar kha brgyad du shar ba de yang mig las li dang / rna ba zin/ sna las zon/ lce las kham/ lus las gin/yid las khen/ kun gzhi khon/ nyon mongs dwa bcas spar kha brgyad po rang rang rnam shes tshogs las grub pa yin no/ /pho mo'i dbye ba yang dwa dang / khen/ kham/ gin bzhi pho yin la/ khon/ li/zin/ zon/ bzhi ni mo yin pa de yang lho nas rim par bzung ba li/ khon/ dwa/khen/ kham/ gin/ zin/ zon te rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /spar kha rus pa'i tshul du gnas pa li/ kham/ dwa/ zin ni lta mig bzhi yin la/ khen/ khon/ gin/ zon brdung rwa bzhi/ phyogs bzhi se bzhi/mtshams bzhi ni sa yin no/ /de bzhin li/ kham/ gin/ zon bzhi ni ban bzhi yin la/ khen/ khon/zin/ dwa bzhi bon bzhi yin pa de dag re re la yang spar kha'i bzang bzhi dang /ngan bzhi la sogs par dbye ba byung ngo / /de la spar kha'i nges tshig ni/ khen rgan dang khon ma rgan mo rmongs pas spobs pa shor bas bu tsha ming sring rnam drug byung ba gnam du gnas spar ba 146

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/dang / de dag gcig tu mi 'dus pa kha brgyad du gyes pas gnas spar ba dang /kha gyes kyi tshig 'dzoms par spar kha zhes bya ba yin no/ /sme ba dgu ni/ rus sbal gyi bu ga dgu las smre ba gling dgu shar ba ste/ de yang zhib par bshad na 'di lta ste/mig g.yas sprin pa dkar po las/ lha ni gnam the dkar po dang / tho rengs dkar skya spun gcig byung ba lus kyi kha dog gcig pa dkar bas gcig dkar ro/ /mig g.yon 'bras bu nag po nas lha ni sbal nag dom dag dang / mya ngan sdug gi mtsho gnyis byung ba gnyis ka nag pas gnyis nag go /kha yi rlangs pa'i rlung las lha ni nag po spun gsum dang / bye bral gyod kyi rlung gsum byung ba gsum ga mthing bas gsum mthing ngo / /mtshan ma'i rlangs pa 'thul ba las lha ni gnyan chen sde bzhi dang / gyod kyi du ba spun bzhi byung ba bzhi ga ljang bas bzhi ljang ngo / /sna bug g.yas pa'i bu ga'i chu—ser thigs pa lnga po las dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i sa bdag dang /gser gyi me tog rtse lnga byung ba lnga ga ser bas lnga ser ro//rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas rje ni yab lha brdal drug dang / dpal gyi nyi ma spun drug shar ba drug ga dkar bas drug dkar ro/ /sna bug g.yon pa'i sna khrag las lha ni dmar po skya bdun dang / bshan pa lag dmar spun bdun byung ba bdun ga dmar bas bdun dmar ro/ /rna g.yon pa'i bu ga las lha ni bkra shis brgyad dang / me tog ha lo mched brgyad byung ba brgyad ka dkar bas brgyad dkar ro/ /'phongs kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad las/ lha ni dgu dang / sras dgu dang /147

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/g.yang gi g.yung drung spun dgu byung ba dgu ga dmar bas dgu dmar ro/ /de dag rigs kyi dbye ba yang gcig dkar lha dang / gnyis nag bdud/gsum mthing bse mo/ bzhi ljang klu/ lnga ser rgyal po/ drug dkar lha/ bdun dmar btsan dang / brgyad dkar bkra shis/ dgu dmar g.yang gi gab tse ste sme ba dgu po de rnams kyang de dang de 'dra'i rigs dgu dgur 'phel ba yin no/ /sme ba'i ming gi 'byung stangs ni lnga ser ni rus sbal gyi lto bar gab cing /sme ba bar du sha tshul gnas pa de la bu gar dme byas pa'i dme ba'i nges tshig tu grags kyang / lus la khra bo sme ba'i tshul gyis sme ba'am/ yang na mi zad smre bas sme bar grags so/ /gza' brgyad byung ba'i tshul ni/ rus sbal gyi mche ba brgyad las byung ba de yang nyi ma'i rjes su ni gza' gzhan 'brang bas nyi ma nyid dang por bzhag cing / gza' rnams kyi khams kyi dbye ba 'di lta ste/ nyi ma mig dmar me yi khams/ zla ba lhag pa chu yi khams/ phur shing spen pa pa sangs lcags/ rā hu spyi khyab gza' brgyad byung ba de yang rus sbal gyi lag pa las/ lhag pa dang / phur bu/ rkang pa las mig dmar dang / spen pa/ so las nyi ma/ zla ba/ pa sangs/yid las rā hu la chad cing / mche ba bzhi'i yas mcher las stag mgo me 'bar dang / du ba mjug ring / mas mcher las g.yag mgo rlung dang / srin mo sha thon bcas ltas ngan gyi gza' bzhi ni mche ba bzhi las chad pa'i gza' 'di rnams gdug rtsub che la 'char ba'i dus su 'jig rten la mi dge bar 'gyur ba yang bshad pa yin no/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad byung ba'i tshul ni/ rus sbal gyi sgal tshigs nyer brgyad 148

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/las cha 'dzin gyi nyer brgyad byung ba las mi la nad gtong lha 'dres byed pa/re ma ti yi sprul par grags pa skar ma smin drug ni rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi dang por bzhag pa yin/ smin snar mgo lag nabs so rgyal/ /skag mchu gre dbo me bzhi nag /sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snon/ /snrubs dang chu stod chu smad dang / /gro bzhin byi bzhin mon gre sgrog /khrums stod khrums smad nam gru dang / tha skar bra nye nyer brgyad do/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad sgal tshigs gang las byung ba'i tshul ni/ stod kyi shing tshigs drug las ni shar gyi skar ma drug ste/ smin drug snar ma/ mgo laganabs so/ rgyal bcas byung zhing / tshigs bdun pa rlung gi tshigs las shar lho'i skar ma skag byung / rgyab gung gi me tshigs drug las lho skar drug ste mchu/gre/ dbo/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri bcas byung zhing / tshigs bcu bzhi pa las lho nub kyi sa skar sa ga byung / rked pa lcags tshigs drug las ni nub skar lha mtshams/ snon/ snrubs/ chu stod/ chu smad/ gro bzhin bcas lcags skar drug byung / tshigs nyer gcig pa nam mkha'i tshigs las nub byang skar ma byi bzhin byung / smad kyi chu tshigs drug po las byang skar drug ste mon gre mon grukhrums stod/ khrums smad/ nam gru/ tha skar chu skar drug byung zhing / tshigs nyer brgyad pa ngan khungs kyi tshigs las byang shar gyi ri'i skar ma bra nye byung ba yin no/ /lo brnyan bcu gnyis byung ba'i tshul ni/ rus sbal gyi skye mched bcu gnyis las lo brnyan bcu gnyis byung ba yin te/ de yang 'gro ba mtha' dag pho mo yis skye ba'i las rnams byed pa ltar spar kha gin zon gyi bu ni chung ngu kham sgur dang / bu mo chung ngu zin shing byi shor nas skyes pas byi ba sogs ltas ngan gyi 149

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mgo brnyan bcu gnyis byung ba yin/ de dag mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs rjes ngan pa dpal gyi zas su bsgyur te ltas ngan dpal du lo bas na lo zhes bya ba'i nges tshig thog mar byung ba de yang drang srong chen pos gangs kyi byi ba zhon nas byung bas byi ba lo 'gor bzhag pa'i lo khyim dpags pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ shes pa 'thoms par gyur pa nub mo nyal bas glang du byung ngo/ /lus ni bcos pas rtsal dang ldan zhing shes pa bkra bas stag tu byung / g.yos pa byas pas yos su byung / 'byung ba rtsub pas dbyar dgun dbye ba la dga' nas skad bton pas 'brug tu byung / shing dang mi'i lus po sogs la kril le 'khril bas sbrul du byung / bag chags ltas ngan rgyu ba dang /steng du zhon pas rta ru byung / 'bras bu lug pas lug ces sam/ gzi ber lkugs pas lug tu byung / yang zhing zor bar spre'ur byung / dga' ste nam mkhar 'phur ba'am dga' nas ma bzod pa'i skad bton pas bya ru byung /skyin thang thems dkar byas pa'am/ spyod pa ngan pas khyi ru byung / phag tu bcug pas phag tu byung bar grags so/ /gzhan yang dar gud bcu gnyis dang sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ khung du 'dzul ba byi ba ste dbugs len byi ba dang sbyar/ mngal gnas pa'i dus na khyag stobs che bas mngal gnas glang dang sbyar/ lus rdzogs pa ni rtsa rgyas bkra bas lus rdzogs stag dang 'dra bar sbyar/ btsas ma thag pa na rkang pa khyol bas btsas pa yos dang 'dra bar sbyar/ ngan pa bkru ba khrus byed pa yin pas khrus byed 'brug dang sbyar/ gos ni phud pa dang gyon par byed pas gos gyon sbrul dang sbyar/las byas nas zas za bas las kyi byed pa rta 'dra bar sbyar/ dar ba sha khrag kun dang ldan pas dar ba lug dang 'dra bar sbyar/ gud pa ni gnyer ma mang 150
