nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/bas na gud pa sprel dang 'dra bar sbyar/ na ba ni 'khun sgra 'byin pas na bya phug ron bya dang 'dra bar sbyar/ shi ba'i ro thang la bor bas shi ba khyi dang 'dra bar sbyar/ dur du zhugs pas sa yang brko bas dur zhugs phag dang 'dra bar sbyar zhing dar gud kyi phyogs ni lo brnyan gyi phyogs de bzhin du gnas so/ /phyi lo drug cu 'char ba'i tshul ni/ byi ba glang stag yos 'brug sbrul/ rta lug sprel dang bya khyi phag /'byung lngas bsgyur bas drug cur gyur/ /ces gsungs pa lo rtags bcu gnyis po re rer 'byung ba lngas bsgyur bas lo rgan drug cu byung ba de la yang kha yan dang / khong nong dang / se zhig dang /'dun khur dang / kha ral te than skyel srin khyer klung ngan bcu gnyis pa rer bzhed pa dang / de bzhin skar chung drug dang / than pa mi bdun yang yod do/ /bdun zur lo dkar byung ba'i tshul ni/ rta yi bang btang nas byi ru bcag pa byi rta'i bdun zur/ glang gi rwa gong lug rdo bkal bas glang lug bdun zur/ stag gis sbar mor spre'u bcug pas stag sprel bdun zur/ yos kyi phru gu bya yis khyer bas bya yos bdun zur/ khyi yi rked pa 'brug gis bcag pas khyi 'brug bdun zur/ gdug pa sbrul phag gis zos pas phag sbrul bdun zur grags pas bdun zur drug ni de ltar yin no/ /bzhi gshed ni byi ba nas rtsis pas yar gyi bzhi gshed yos bu de phyi dkar tshul du bsdus pa dang / mar gyi bzhi gshed bya de ni nang dkar tshul du bsdus pa yin no/ /zla ba'i byung tshul ni dar gud rnam pa bcu gnyis las dpyid ra stag sogs zla ba bcu gnyis dang / phyi nang rtog pa brgya dang brgyad cu las ni/ zhag 151

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/grangs sum brgya drug cu byung ba/ sems bskyed bdun brgya nyi shu las za ma bdun brgya nyi shu byung ba/ lo khyim re re la rten 'brel 'khor lo drug cur rdzogs pa dang / rten 'brel 'khor lo drug cu la zla ba re re tshang ba ste rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i las byed pas zla ba zhes su brjod pa yin no/ /dus bzhi'i zla ba'i ra 'bring tha gsum byung ba'i tshul ni/ dpyid zla ra ba stag gis thob pa de yang gra 'don gcan gzan thams cad tshang du 'jug pa dang / lcags kyis gcod pa'i las rnams byed pas de phyir lcags dbugs stag dpyid nas len pa yin no/ /dpyid zla 'bring po yos bus thob pa de yang sgyid pa gyol zhing tshang drung yib pas so/ /dpyid zla tha chung 'brug gis thob pa de yang rang skad 'don cing dbyar dgun gyi mtshams 'byed pas so/ /dbyar zla ra ba sbrul gyis thob pa de yang shi ba langs nas pags pa brje ba dang / sa chu'i las rnams dbyar du 'grub pa/ chu ni dbyar nas g.yo ba de'i phyir sa chu dbyar dbugs sbrul nas len pa yin no/ /dbyar zla 'bring po rta yis thob pa de yang rta pos rgod ma rte'u gnon pas so/ /dbyar zla tha chung lug gis thob pa de yang lug po spang po'i logs na 'grangs bar gnas pas so/ /ston zla ra ba sprel gyis thob pa de yang shing tog smin pa spre'us tshor ba/shing gi 'bras bu ston nas smin pa de'i phyir shing dbugs ston ra sprel nas len pa yin no/ /152

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/ston zla 'bring po bya yis thob pa de yang bya gzan gyis ma bu gnyis ka 'grangs bas so /ston zla tha chung khyi yis thob pa de yang grol po byed cing srang stong 'chag pas so/ /dgun zla ra ba phag gis thob pa de yang lto 'grangs pa dang / phru gu tshar 'ong ba de'i phyir me dbugs dgun ra phag nas len pa yin no/ /dgun zla 'bring po byi bas thob pa de yang byi ba phyir mi 'byung ba khung du 'grangs bas so /dgun zla tha chung glang gis thob pa de yang rtswa za chu 'thung dal por sdod pas so/ /zhag grangs byung ba'i tshul ni/ zla ba de la zhag grangs sum cu byung ba de la nyin mtshan drug cu tham pa yod pa'i nyin mo pho la mtshan mo mo yin cing / pho la mo chags mo la pho chags pa'i sgra la zhag ces brjod pa yin no/ /de la nyin gyi thog ma stag dang / mtshan gyi thog ma sprel la bzhag pa'i nyin mtshan gnyis po lo de rnams la rgyu ba yin no/ /dus tshod byung ba'i tshul ni/ nyin mtshan gnyis po rgyu ba'i mtshams kyis dus kyi dbye ba gcod pa dang / tshod 'dzin pas dus tshod ces su grags shing /lo 'gros de dag kyang dus tshod la btub pas nam langs yos bu'i dus tshod de dus tshod kyi dang por bzhag pa yin no/ /dus bzhi'i gza' dang skar ma sbyar tshul ni/ dbyar dang ston dang /dgun dang / dpyid ka las res gza' phur bu dang / mig dmar/ pa sangs/lhag pa bzhi shar lho nub byang cha 'dzin du skar ma yang bdun bdun du grub pa 153

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yin no/ /tha chung gi dpyid ka las gza' rlung khams phur bu dang / dbyar las sa khams spen pa dang / ston las nyi ma nam mkha'i khams/ dgun las sgra gcan kun khyab pa yin no/ /sprul pa'i rus sbal sha dag las sa khams bco brgyad dang khrag las chu khams bco brgyad/ dbugs las rlung khams bco brgyad/ rus pa las lcags khams bco brgyad/ rtsa rgyus shing khams bco brgyad byung ba yin no/ /srog lus dbang klung byung ba'i tshul ni/ rus sbal kun gzhi de las ni bag chags ldan pa sbas pa'i srog byung zhing nyon mongs yid las lus byung ba/yid kyi rnam shes dbang thang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes klung rta yin no/ /de ltar gnam gyi gab tshe dang / bar sa'i gab tshe brgya dang brgyad cu re re las spros pas gab tshe'i grangs ni mtha' yas par bshad pa kun kyang 'byung ba lnga las grub pa yin no/ /'byung ba'i kha dog ni/ kha dog ljang khu shing dang / dmar po me/ dkar po lcags/ nag po chu/ ser po sa yin no/ / 'byung ba'i grangs ni/ gcig shing / gnyis sa/ gsum chu/ bzhi me/ lnga pa lcags su bzhed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang grangs ni shing la gcig dang gsum/me la bzhi drug sa la gnyis bzhi/ lcags la lnga dang gsum/ chu la bdun du bzhed pa sogs 'byung ba'i grangs 'dir bzhed pa du ma mchis so /'byung ba'i dbyibs ni/ 'jong ba shing dang / gru gsum me/ zla gam lcags/ gru bzhi sa/ zlam po chu yi dbyibs su bshad pa yin no/ /'byung ba'i gnas lugs ni/ ke rer langs pa shing / lhab lhub 'bar ba me/ ca rer bsdad pa sa/ rno zur reg pa lcags/ zhod de 'gro ba chu yin no/ /154

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/'byung ba'i mgo ni/ mgo dbyibs mgo sprug shing / ral pa me/ sbad mgo sa/ co breg lcags/ stag skra chu yin no/ /rigs kyi 'byung ba ni/ rgyal rigs sa/ rje rigs me/ dmangs rigs chu/bram ze shing / gdol pa lcags kyi khams yin no/ /mi rigs kyi 'byung ba ni/ rgyal po shing / bud med me/ btsun pa sa/byis pa lcags/ bon po chu yin no/ /nye du'i rigs kyi 'byung ba ni/ phu khu shing / bu tsha ma smad me/ ma phyi yul mkhar sa/ nor grogs lha srung lcags/ bu sring gnyen lam chu yin no/ /'dre'i 'byung ba ni/ gnyan the'u brang shing / btsan dang gre bo me/ sa bdag yul 'dre sa/ rgyal po dkor bdag lcags/ klu dang ma mo chu yin no/ /nad kyi 'byung ba ni/ shing gi rtsa rgyus rengs pa dang / me la tsha ba dang /mgo bo'i nad/ sa la lus lci zhing 'thibs pa'i nad/ lcags la gzer zug rgyag pa dang rus pa na ba/ chu la grang ba ro smad na bar bzhed do/ /brjod pa'i 'byung ba ni/ skad 'gags pa dang / gre 'dar shing / so yi bar nas sgra 'don me/ sna skad 'don pa sa/ kha gdangs pa lcags/ mchu rub pa chu/'byung ba'i mtshan ma ni/ shing la sba ba dang / me la ngo men can/ sa la sgur po sra can/ lcags la sme ba/ chu la sho rer bzhed do/ /'byung ba'i las ni/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung ngam shing / tsha zhing bsreg pa me/ lci zhing 'thibs pa sa/ rno zhing zur ba lcags/ rlan zhing gsher ba chu yi las yin no/ /155

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'byung ba'i zas ni/ shing tog sngo tshod shing / bsreg sha mgo sha khrag tshod me/ rkang lag sha dang 'khur ba sa/ dkar gsum rtsib ma'i sha rnams lcags/ chang dang / chu dar/ chu yi zas yin no/ /phyi yi snod kyi 'byung ba lnga'i tshul ni/ phyi yi snod kyang 'byung ba lnga las grub cing / nang gi phung khams 'byung ba lnga/ /don dang snod kyang 'byung ba lnga/ /spar kha brgyad kyang 'byung ba lnga/ /sme ba dgu yang 'byung ba lnga/ /lo skor bcu gnyis 'byung ba lnga/ /gza' chen brgyad kyang 'byung ba lnga/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'byung ba lnga/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad 'byung ba lnga la sogs pa 'byung ba lnga la ma 'dus pa med do/ /nang gi 'byung ba ni/ nam mkha' kun la khyab pa'i thog ma la grub pa'i 'byung ba ni dngas ma sems yin no/ /dngas ma sems de nyid rlung gi rtar zhon te 'gro ba'i mngal du 'jug par byed sko/ /rlung dang shing gi khams mthun pas rtsa rgyus gnyis kyi rtsa gzhi rnams chags shing / chu khams khrag dang chu ser yang rtsa rgyus la brten nas rim bzhin chags pa yin no/ /lcags kyi khams ni rus pa dang / sa yi khams ni sha yin no/ /me ni drod yin pa rtsa rgyus kun la khyab ste rtsa rgyus gang ba'am rdzogs nas yan lag dang / rim bzhin nying lag rdzogs par tshang bar bzhed do/ /gsang ba'i 'byung ba ni/ gsang ba'i 'byung ba don snod la grub pa de yang snying khams me yin/ glo ba lcags/ mchin pa shing / mkhal ma chu/ mcher pa sa khams/ sems nyid nam mkha' yin no/ /dgung la mnga' gyur rgyal po la sogs pa'i tshul ni/ dgung la mnga' gyur pa'i rgyal po gcig yod pa ni lo yin la blon po bcu gnyis yod pa ni lo gcig 156

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/la zla ba bcu gnyis yod pa de yin/ dmag mi sum brgya drug cu ni lo gcig la zhag ma sum brgya drug cu yod pa de yin/ khrom sa bdun brgya nyi shu ni zla ba gcig la za ma'am dus tshod bdun brgya nyi shu yod pa de yin/ ru dpon lnga ni lo zla zhag dang za ma re 'byung bas ru dpon lnga yin/ 'thab mo ba bco lnga ni 'byung ba de la 'thab byed phyi nang gsang ba'i 'byung ba lnga re rtsis pas bco lnga 'byung ba yin/ zhal lce gcod pa bcu gnyis ni dar gud bcu gnyis yin/sdig chen lnga ni skyon yon 'byung ba lnga yin/ mdzod pa bzhi ni spar kha rgya ma dang /spang rgyan/ rab zla/ do med bzhi dang / de bzhin kha brgyad stong 'tshol dang phyag shog 'brang ba/ lo yi gnam byang / rgya rje'i dar tshags bcas bzhi yis snang srid kyi don gtan la 'bebs pa byung ba yin no//de ltar grub pa'i sprul pa'i rus sbal ni/ nag nog gi dri ma med pa phyi nang kun gsal/ nyon mongar+sā pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par 'od dang kha dog lnga 'char ba'i shel gyi khang bzang la gnas nas wang the la sogs pa 'khor rnams la gtsug lag gi chos 'khor bskor bar yang bshad pa yin no/ /da ni 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gtsug lag chos kyi sgo mo ji ltar phye ba'i tshu la ni/ srid pa'i rus sbal ji bzhin du sprul pa'i rus sbal dang / ring bsrel gyi rus sbal grub pa'i tshul gong du bstan zin pa de la brten nas gtsug lag gi rgyud sde kun tshangs pa la sogs pa lha mi'i 'khor la gsungs pa yin cing /de gong brtsi thabs kyi gtsug lag ma grub par rang byung lhun grub kyi gtsug lag bya ba yin no/ /de yang gtsug lag gi rgyud sde thogatho ni tshangs pa gdong bzhi par rgyud lung 'grel pa man ngag dang / ṭīkasnang gsala'i bu lnga/ dmag dang ru mtshon 157

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gdab pa/ nyi zla gza' skar ji ltar brtsi ba'i tshul bcas gsungs par grags so/ /de nas lha mo rnam par rgyal la rus sbal rang 'dra'i rgyud dang gi gong bag ma'i rtsis kyang gsungs so/ /de nas klu rgyal 'jog pos klu'i rin chen dang / chu shing me tog la sogs pa'i skyes phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rus sbal gyi gtan tshigs rang dran skye gnas kyi rgyud dang / rten cing 'brel ba'i rgyud de'i phyi ma ljon shing lo tog 'tshol dang / khrus byang gi rgyud/ byis pa btsas klungs la sogs pa gsungs so/ /de nas bram ze ser skyas shing tog gi yon phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor 'byung ba mtshan don bstan pa'i mdo dang / phyi ma yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa/de'i phyi ma mtshan gyi don bstan pa'i mdo/ kha bskang bye brag 'byed pa'i rgyud la sogs pa du ma gsungs so/ /de nas kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal pos 'jam dpal dbyangs mjal ba tsam gyis dpyad brgyad khri bzhi stong sum brgya drug cu'i rang bzhin babs kyis thugs su chud pa dang / de nas rim pa bzhin ji kong dang / ji nong / wang the(lha 'dzil gyi rgyal ba'ang zer)sogs 'phrul mi bzhi yis rang rang gi 'byor pa'i skyes phul nas 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa las rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga ste matā nag po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / 'jig rten sgron me snga rtags kyi rgyud/ /rdo rje gdan phyi rtags kyi rgyud/ /'byung ba don bstan thugs kyi rgyud/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje gtsug lag rgyud bcas rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga dang / rgyud phyi ma lnga ni gyim shang dmigs sel gson gyi rgyud/ /zags kyam rin chen gshin gyi rgyud/ /158

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/a ru ta rin dmigs sel gyi rgyud/ /phung bshig nag po ngan thabs kyi rgyud/ /bzlog rgyud nag po gto yi rgyud bcas phyi ma'i rgyud lnga/ phyi ma'i phyi ma rgyud lnga ni//'byung ba lnga brtsegs dbang thang rgyud/ /'byams yig chen mo spyi yi rgyud/ /ka ba dgu sgril spar sme'i rgyud/ /sdong po dgu 'dus chad sob rgyud/ /gser gyi nyi ma gi gong rgyud/ /de sogs snga phyi bsdoms pa yi rgyud sde sum brgya drug cu 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dngos su gsungs pa dang / rgyud sde de dag nang ma tshang ba kha skong phyir 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyud ni/ lha rgyud che ba dang / lha rgyud chung ba wang thes gsungs shing / sa rgyud bong mgo 'phrul bam bdun ni kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po dang / 'byams yig chen mo'i 'grel pa ni ji nong 'phrul gyi rgyal pos gsungs/ gshin rgyud bi 'di ra chen ji kong 'phrul gyi rgyal po bcas kyis rim par gsungs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyud 'di rnams kyang mi yi yul du dar ba yin no/ /gtsug lag gi don ni/ gtsug ni mi 'gyur 'byung ba lnga'i don dang / lag rtog byed lo zla'am/ yang na lag ni g.yab mos btang gcod phyir du de ltar grags/ yang na gtsug ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gtsug nas bton pa'i gzhung zhu byed lag tu bzhag pas de ltar brjod pa yin/gab rtse'i don ni/ las dang bsod nams srog lus la gab pa'am gnas pa de dag rtogs pa'i rtse yin pas de phyir gab rtse zhes pa'am yang na/ man ngag dpe la gab pa dang / rno mthong dpe la gab pas gab/ tshe rabs las kyi rtsis byas nas tshe yi ring thung brtsi bas na tshe zhes de phyir gab tshe zhes su grags pa'o//gser gyi rus sbal grub tshul sogs la mkhas pa'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i skor/ sum cu rtsa gsum du rdo chen a ma ling gi steng rus sbal gnas pa la lha mo 159

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rnam par rgyal ma yis gser gyi ral gri rtse dgu pas phyi nang gsang gsum du bshas pa las bshas pa'i rus sbal grub tshul yang gsungs so/ /yang rgya nag gi gong ma rnams kyi thog ma spa hu sni dhī rgyal po la rgya mtsho'i mtha'i 'bangs shig gis rus sbal gser gyi kha dog can zhig phul ba la gzigs te brtags nas spar kha brgyad kyi phyag rgya thog mar thugs la shar/ de la brten nas spar me lo skor gyi rtsis rnams mdzad/ de la brten nas grub pa'i rgyal blon mkhas pa rnams kyis rim par mdzad pa dang / khyad par khong spu rtsi zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bod du kong tse 'phrul rgyal du grags pa des kyang rtsis dang gto gzhung mtha' yas pa'i srol gtod pa sogs phyis 'byung gi gzhung shin tu mang bar bzhed pa yang yod do/ /yang matā gser gyi rus sbal la brten nas spar kha brgyad byung ba'i tshul la yang mkhas pa 'ga'i bzhed par/ matā gser gyi rus sbal gyi rgyab las khen/mdun las khon byung ba de gnyis klungs mal bsdebs pa las bu tsha ming sring grub pa de yang khon ma sa lug ma lo nyis brgya nyer drug shing 'brug lor gum ste shing mo sbrul la dur sbas pa de dus gnam sa'i bcos med pas khen pa rgad po khyi lo pa lo nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa lcags pho khyi yi lo la gum pa lcags phag lo la dur sbas kyang / gnam sa'i sgo mo ma bcos pas bu tsha zin zon khams gsum yang gum/ de'i tshul dwa li gin gsum gleng mol byas te gnam sgo sa sgo gto yis bcos pas de nas shi 'phro chad par gyur to/ /zin zon kham gyi dur de ni byi glang gnyis la gso thub cing / stag yos la mya ngan byas/ 'brug sbrul sri ngan yin pas bzhag rta lug dbang thang so sor bgos/ bya sprel gson gshin bye bral te dur 'jug byas pa de nas bskal pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 160

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/bar mi rnams tshe ring ba dang phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ de nas mi rnams nyon mongs cher rgyas pas tshe thung zhing / nor gyis dbul bas lus kyi mdog dang / sa bcud nyams pa de'i tshe dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis drang srong yod po zhes byar sprul nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir byon te 'jig rten khams 'dir rus sbal las ji snyed chags shing / srid pa smin pa/ lo 'gros srid pa'i dgung lo bkod ces slar yang lha gnas gshegs/ de nas sa bdag nag po byung ba/de nas rgyal bu shi kha then tse byung ba/ de nas sa bdag rlung rgyal byung ba/ de nas ze'u kong 'phrul chung byung ba/ de nas kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po byung ba dang / de'i sras klu nad kyis zin pa las grol thabs 'phags pas lung bstan te klu rgyal 'jog po la zhus pa dang / klus lung bstan pa bzhin kong tse rgyal pos zhus pa de rjes shāka thub 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bltams nas lo brgyad cu'i bar du mdzad pa bskyangs shing / de nas gab tshe dang po'i shing stag brgyad dkar gtsug lag rtsis yang rtser gtad nas 'jam dpal dbyangs gzhon nu'i skur mdzad nas lo lnga par sangs rgyas nyid la chos gsan zhing / gab tshe bar pa sa sbrul la sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa de dus 'jam dbyangs kong tse ru sprul nas rgya nag yul du byon pa/ de nas ji gong byon pa/ de nas ji nong byon pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus zhib par mkhyen 'dod na bai dkar le'u nyi shu pa nag rtsis skabs bstan pa la gzigs par 'tshal lo/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor 'go'i skor ni/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor 'go'i rim pa la rgya bod mkhas pa yis mdzad pa rgya bod skor 'go bco lnga re yod pa las/ dang po rgya'i skor 'go bco lnga de la yang skor 'go lnga lnga bstan pa ste/skyes pa dar ma mda' 'gengs nas ma bu mthun sbyor rtsis dang gcig rma bya 161

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mjing bsnol la brten nas bag ma'i 'gro lam brtsi ba dang gnyis/ rgya yi bang so khra bo nas gnas dang khang pa'i rtsis dang gsum/ rin chen 'od 'bar la brten nas zhing sa bzang ngan brtsi ba dang bzhi/ nor bur bsten pa'i nor brtsi ba dang lnga/ sbal bu ser po'i kha nyid nas byis pa'i btsas klungs brtsi ba dang drug lha bu dmar po la bsten nas 'go ba'i lha ngos bzung dang bdun/dur byas 'dre ngos bzung ba dang brgyad/ dpag bsam shing gi sdong po nas tshe rabs las kyi rtsis brtag pa dang dgu/ skye shing keg rtsis brtsi ba dang bcu/g.yu shug 'bar ba'i steng nyid nas dar gud bzang ngan brtsi ba dang bcu gcig mi ro dmar pos ro bsreg sgrub pa brtsi ba dang bcu gnyis/ thod dgu brtsegs kha nas dur gshed brtag pa dang bcu gsum/ chad nag dur sa brtsi ba dang bcu bzhi/ sa bdag mgo gsum phan pa'i gto ste bco lnga'o/ /bod kyi skor 'go bco lnga ni/ rgyal po la shel gyi bya khyung dkar po la brten nas brtag bya'i rtsis 'go lnga dang gcig badhe sngags pa la gangs kyi seng ge dkar mo'i steng nas brtag bya'i rtsis 'go lnga dang gnyis/ bon po rnams la g.yu 'brug gi kha nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang gsum/ blon po la glang po'i kha nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang bzhi/ skyes dar ma la gdags kyi khyi dar mas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang lnga/ bza' mi bud med la sribs bya dmar po'i sgo nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang drug skyes pa gzhon nu la rgya stag dar ma'i kha nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang bdun/ dman chung bu mo la mthing gi rma bya'i kha nas skor 'go lnga dang brgyad/ byis pa la khu byug sngon po'i kha nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang dgu longs spyod la yid bzhin nor bu'i sgo nas brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga dang bcu/ gling bu'i kha nas 'os/ rta dang / sgo 162

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/khyi/ bran g.yog sogs la brtag bya'i skor 'go lnga re mchis pa lnga dang bcas skor 'go bco lnga'o/ /gces par brtsi ba'i tshul la yang / skyes par rdo rje rgya gram srog byis par 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lus/ bud med g.yung drung dbang thang mi chen pad+ma 'dab brgyad klung la gces par bzhed pa yin no/ /'di dag dang mi mthun pa rgyas pa yi rgya bod skor 'go brgyad ma gnyis re sngon byon mkhas pas mdzad par yang mngon no/ /skor 'go'i thad la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i tshul yang mang du mchis so/ /rtsis kyi sgo mo'i grangs 'dren skor/ rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri dang bzhi stong yod pa mdor bsdus na/ rgyud sde sum brgya drug cu dang / de bas nye bar bsdus pa lnga ni phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rgyud gsum dang / yang gsang thugs kyi rgyud/spyi ru longs pa'i rgyud dang lnga'o/ /'byung ba'i skor 'go'i grangs 'dren skor/ 'byung ba'i skor 'go'i grangs ni chig stong drug brgya rtsa bzhi yin/ de yang bsdus pa rnam pa drug ste/ spar kha/sme ba/ dar gud/ lo zla/ gza' skar/ zangs kyam drug yin pa de yang 'byung ba lnga la 'dus pa'i rtsis kyi sgo mo ma lus pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis kong tse 'phrul rgyal la gsungs par grags so/ /gab tshe'i grangs 'dren skor/ gnam gyi gab tshe brgya dang nyi shu/ bar gyi gab tshe brgya dang brgyad cu/ sa'i gab tshe brgya dang brgyad cur bzhed pa'am/yang na ni gnam sa bar gsum re re la gab tshe sum brgya drug cur bshad do/ /de yang bsdus pa sum brgya dang yang na gab tshe rnam pa brgyad du 'dus te/gnam sa rjes gcod skar khyim dang gcig sme ba gsang keg don rtogs 163

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsal ba dang gnyis/ yur chen yur chung lo tshad 'tshol ba dang gsum/ gsang keg sum 'gyur khra gto'i skor dang bzhi/ thang shing ring mo gnam khrom che ba dang lnga/ rgya mo dar tshags sbe ba'i mtshon dang drug gnam sa 'od 'bar 'byung tshad 'tshol ba dang bdun/ gab tshe srid pa'i 'dre slag dang brgyad do/ /de dag 'ub kyis bsdus na sku gsung thugs kyi gab tshe gsum yin pa de yang /ji ltar snang ba 'byung ba ni mtshan ma gzugs dang kha dog dbyibs 'di ni sku yi gab tshe yin no/ /'jam dpal zhal nas gsungs pa'i gtsug lag rtsis kyi rgyud ni gsung gi gab tshe dang / de rnams sems la shar ba ni thugs kyi gab tshe dang gsum mo/ /gtsug lag rtsis gzhung ji ltar byung ba'i skor/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gsungs pa bka' dang / zhu byed bzhi dang / 'phrul mi bzhi/ drang srong dang / paṇ+ḍi ta yis 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gsung la brten nas mdzad pa rnams ni gtsug lag gi bstan bcos yin no/ /de yang zhu ba po tshangs pa gdong bzhi dang / lha mo rnam par rgyal ma dang / klu rgyal 'jog po dang / bram ze ser skya rnam pa bzhi dang / kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po dang / ji nong /sni ji gong / wang the bcas 'phrul gyi mi bzhi/ drang srong bde bar len dang /(nye bar len dang / kun tu len dang / yang dag len pa drang srong bzhi rgyud/ 'chang ba po drang srong lce mur dang / phur bu dang / thor cog dang / drang srong nag po bzhir gtsug lag rim par brgyud de bshad pa bcas zhu ba po dang / 'phrul gyi mi bzhi/ len pa po/ 'chang ba po rnams kyis snod bcud thams cad gtsug lag la dgongs nas don rgyas la tshig rtogs sla ba bstan bcos sum brgya drug cu mdzad nas blang dor thams cad rtsis 'bras dang sgo bstun pas rgya nag ni 164

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gtsug lag yul du grags pa'o/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams rang cag bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dar ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi sku dus gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig pa phebs pa'i dbu brnyes kyang bod 'dir ji bzhin tshang ba'i yi ge med pas thams cad ma dar/ spyan ras gzigs dngos chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus rgya bza' kong jo phebs nas cha tsam dar/ mi ring bar ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la sa 'dul legs po ma byung bas brtsig ma thub par/ rgyal po yab yum bka' bgros te/ bod mi shes rab can bzhi zhes ye shes rgyal ba/ gtsang g.yu gzher/ 'bro gnyer brten pa/ ra bla mkhyen bzhi rgya nag gi yul du mngags nas/ rgya yi slob dpon mkhas pa 'bar ba tshom tshom la gtugs nas rtsis kyi rgyud/ gser ṭika g.yu phreng / thig bstod gsum dang / kam khra dang / za 'og gur khyim ste spar kha'i rgyud gnyis/spyi rgyud sdong po dgu 'dus/ sa dpyad kyi rgyud bya rgod blo rdol/ shad kha rdo re dang / rin chen phreng ba ste rgyud dgu gab tshe rgya che bkral ba dang / 'byung ba kun gsal/ rat+na sa le ste 'grel pa gsum/ spang rgyan lo ma rnam pa bzhi/ rgya mo dar tshags mi 'dra ba bzhi/ skye las gab tsher khyim nyi shu pa dang / bco lnga pa dang / bcu gnyis pa dang / brgyad pa dang / lnga pa dang / khra mo stong skor 'phrul gyi me long dang / phyi shog khra ma bu ste gab tshe bco lnga rnams bsgyur bar mdzad pa ni snga 'gyur thog ma'o/ /snga 'gyur bar pa ni/ gsang bdag rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mes ag tshom gyi btsun mo la rgya bza' ang tshung bzhes pa'i dus su/ rgyal mo de yis 'byung ba lnga 'gyur/ spar kha'i ser thig sme ba dmar nag gza' skar nyi ma me 165

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzhur/ de ri phyi ma gi gong dang / 'byung ba gto yi mdzod de brgyud bdun le lag brgyad dang bcas pa bsgyur/ snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur ni/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus su/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe/ yum gyis 'phrin yig bskur nas sa dgra ngan pa rnams bcos pa'i phyir/ rgya nag gi yul gyi slob dpon mkhas pa sems brtse zhes pa gdan 'dren pa'i don du/ gsang thub ras skyes gtsug na dang / li khri mgo skya zhes par/ gser la sogs pa'i skyes dang bcas mngags pas slob dpon sems brtse byon/ de yis shar sgo keg gi rtsis/ lho sgo gnyen gyi rtsis/ nub sgo khang pa'i rtsis/ byang sgo ro lam gyi rtsis te dpyad sgo bzhi dang / rmang po 'phan dar gtong ba dur gyi yon tan/ dbul po phyug por gtong ba khang sa'i yon tan/ ngan pa bzang por gtong ba zla grogs kyi yon tan/ gnyen dgra ru mi ldang ba gi gong rtsis kyi yon tan/ gshin mig gson la mi blta ba gshin rtsis kyi yon tan/ 'phral rkyen zlog pa keg rtsis kyi yon tan/dgra 'joms gyim shang rtsis kyi yon tan te yon tan bdun/ de yi dpyad sgo bzhi'i nang nas kyang nub sgo khang pa'i dpyad dang / yon tan bdun gyi nang nas khang pa'i rtsis la shin tu mkhas par grags pa des/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang / dge 'dun gyi dgon gnas gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten brtsig pa/ phal pa'i skye bos grong 'debs pa'i rtsis dang / ri 'bugs la sogs pa'i sa dpyad mang po gsungs/ rjes su rgya yi paṇa chen dar chen thig le'am ting tso zhes sam/ don du paṇa chen du har nag pos gtso bor mdzad pa'i/ matā yā na srutra/ ma tā ra dza de ba/ lo tsā ir+ghaṃ bha bho/ bi rje btsan po shi la rnams dang /gzhan yang khams khra dang po/ lang tsho ldong yags/ yug sgra bzher/ khu shog 166

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/mkhan/ rgya g.yu bzang dang bzhi yis rim par bsgyur ba la/ dpyad rgya las kyi drug cu skor gnam sa'i rjes gcod bya ba dang / 'byung ba se zhig kha ral gyi lo/glang btsan gi gong mthun sbyor/ bal mo ldeng skor nyi dmag bsdus pa/ karma chu non rgya mo'i dar tshags/ dmigs sel rnam bzhi/ 'byung ba mdo bshad/ yi ge'i mdo 'grel/ rgya yi zhib sher/ zangs kyam ma bu bco lnga/ gshin rdel bcu gnyis kyi dpyad i min/ gzhung lnga bam bdun 'phrul gyi dra ba che chung / dar gud 'phrul gyi me long / dar gud ge sher sgron me/ khu lu bdun pa/ gyim shang bdun pa/ rtsis kyi ma lnga bu lnga/ yan lag sum brgya drug cu pa/ bya yi bstan pa bco brgyad/ kong jo'i spang rgyan lo ma'i 'gyur 'phros/ rtsub rdel dgu pa la sogs pa rnams bsgyur/ gzhan yang khams khra dang pos zhus nas bsgyur ba'i gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung / be+e ḍūr+ya yi glegs bu dang / gzhung don snying po/'grel ba nyi ma'i 'od zer/ lhan thabs dpag bsam 'khri shing / drang srong pra sgrub/ lha mo sgrub pa'i man ngag gto phran chung sri mnan thabs la sogs pa bsgyur/ thang yig sogs las 'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i gtsug lagathams cad dus 'dir bsgyur bar bshad pa yang yod do/ /de dag rnams las phal che ba stag gi sgro bar bcug ste re zhig gter du sbas nas bzhag la bai ro tsā nas zhus te bsgyur ba'ang yod par gsungs so/ /snga 'gyur bzhi yi tha ma'i 'gyur tshul ni/ rgya nag gi lo ma shi ma lar/ khyung po rdor 'bar gyis zhus nas khyung po'i me long bcu gnyis zhes pa/ rtsa ba/ gi gong / spar kha/ sme ba/ dar gud/ gza'/ skar ma/ gegs sel/ ro bkra dang / dong tse 'phrul gyi me long /zangs kyam gyi rgyud dang / man ngag 'phrul gyi me long dang bcu gnyis bsgyur/bar 'gyur thog ma ni/ rgya yi mkhan po shes rab bla ma la/ mkhas pa ber 167

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sngon can gyis zhus nas/ spar kha'i gsal 'grel/ phung gyod le lan/ sdom tshig gi rgyud/ 'bru 'grel mdo gcod/ btang gcod/ 'byams yig mdo 'grel/'byung ba sde brgyad/ 'phrul yig rtsa ba'i rgyud de spar kha'i rgyud brgyad/ sme ba'i dgu li gsang/ ha lo 'bar ba/ rgya yi dar tshags/ khra bo 'chol pa/ dmar nag khrom/ dkar po spyi gcod/ ser nag 'bar ba/ khra bo ma 'bar me long khra mo ste sme ba'i rgyud dgu gtsug lag 'phrul me/ glog gi phreng ba/ mkha' 'gro'i gtsug lag 'byung ba dpa' tshad sum brgya drug cu/ srog rgyud rtsa ba'i de lo rgyus kyi rgyud lnga/ le zhur bcu gnyis la so so la yang rgyud re re dang bcas pa/ dar gud 'phrul gyi go byed/ btang gcod nag po/ me long gsal ba ste dar gud gyi rgyud gsum/ gto rtsis la gto rgyud nag po/ gshin rtsis la drwa ba glog 'gyu dang gzer bu nag po/ sa rtsis la drwa ba 'grel chen dang / 'phru le brtag pa/ thugs kyi ga'u gza' rtsis la sgro ra 'dod pa sogs brgyad/ skar ma la 'phrul gyi snang ba sogs brgyad/ 'byung ba lnga la phyag rdor gyi zhu lan lnga 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ spar kha la gter 'dzin brgyad 'gyur/ gser 'grel chen mo/ gser thig gsal ba/ gzhung bshad se zhig che chung dang / dpyad mdo gsang ba gser gyi phye leb/ gser dang rmu yi sgrom rin chen gyi 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi 'grel pa dang / sme 'grel gsal ba/ skyes tshang gsal ba babs tshang gsal ba rnams dang / lo la srog gi 'grel pa lnga/ drug cu'i lus 'grel/ dbang thang ma bu lnga skor/ klung rta 'byung ba bzhi 'gyur/ dar gud 'grel pa 'phrul gyi gong phur/ srid pa'i rdel nag 'phrul gyi mig tshags/ 'phrul gyi lde mig me long lnga/ me long dgu skor/ 'byung ba gzhung bdun/ gab tshe thang shing ring mo/ ka ba can dang / snang gsal me long / bsam ka gsum 'gyur 168

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/'byung ba spun/ pho brang brgyad cu rtsa 'grel rnamasabasgyurabaramadzadado/ /da bar 'gyur dbus ma ni rgya yi paṇa chen khri ma ha ya na la/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa ling tse dang / rgya nag gi bhan tsa nag po la/ bod kyi lo tsā bran kha pad+mas zhus nas/ dpyad bya'i bstan bcos brgyad dang / rus sbal khra bo'i skye rgyud/ stod 'grel 'byung ba kun gsal/ bar 'grel kun gsal/ smad kyi 'grel pa kun rdzogs/ par nag khra bo'i mdo/ khra bo gzi mig che chung / sgos 'grel mi khyi khrid/ gri mtshang nag po/ sa dpyad zhib pa gser gzhung /dmangs dar tshags/ sme ba'i 'phrul dpe gong phur 'phrul gyi lde mig sogs bsgyur/bar 'gyur phyi ma rgya nag mkhas pa/ shrī ma tā ya na yis dngos su bod du byon nas bshad par mdzod pa la/ dpyad bya'i bstan bcos brgyad/ klung rtsis ra ru bse ru 'chol ba zhes bya ba rin chen mdud pa/ phra men dgu nag 'thus dang / lcags bzhi/ me brgyad/ las rtsis mngal phugs brgyad pa/ sri'u la spyi don bcu gnyis pa/ spar kha'i gzhung bshad che chung / bum nag dran pa'i gsang rgyud/ gsang 'grel mtshang bzhi/ gza' bzhi'i 'grel ba/ gza' gsum srog gi mchan bu/ gza' rtsis nyi ma dgu zhur/ phyi nang gza' rtsis 'phar ba gong rgyug gung phur sde dang skar ma mchu gnon/ dgu mig khros pa/ dur mig khang bu brgyad cu/ man ngag gsang ba'i mdo bzhi/ 'byung ba kun gsal/bstan pa khri mon/ pra rtags gser le/ bsam ka gsum/ sa dpyad kai ka bi sha/gshin rtsis sde chen sde chung la sogs pa bsgyur nas/ sbal grags pa seṅge dang /snyan pa ye shes seṅge la la bshad nas spel bar mdzad do// bar 'gyur tha ma ni/ rgya yi paṇa chen rā hu dmar po la/ lo tsā ba she'u hūṃ 169

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chen gyis zhus te gzhung rin chen snang gsal me long / rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ 'phrul gyi dum bu/ rin chen spros pa brgyad pa dang / brgyad cu'i mdud pa/ man ngag gi gegs sel/ dra bse se che chung gser gyi gzer bu sogs rin chen rtsis skor du ma dang / rin chen snang brtsegs kyi rgyud dang /'byung ba lnga 'dus mdo brtsegs kyi rgyud bskal pa phra mo sogs kyang bsgyur ba yin no/ /phyi 'gyur thog ma rgya yi paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'dzing kang nge la/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mi nyag 'dzin dar ka long gis zhus te/ rgyud drug lung tshes bco lnga/ man ngag bco brgyad/ yang 'grel lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ them 'grel brgya dang bzhi bcu/'byung chen bco lnga/ 'byung chung nyi shu rtsa lnga/ spyi yi sdom tshig klung gi 'gyur rtsis chen mo/ spar kha sprul pa'i gser 'grel/ dgu mig bzhi/ zangs kyam ma bu bco brgyad/ klung rtsis 'bum nag chen mo/ smra mtsho khra bo/ srid pa'i 'dre dgu gnam sa'i 'khrul 'khor skar khyim rjes gcod/ gto chung dgu skor/ me long bcu gnyis/ brgya yi mdun babs bco brgyad/ pra 'bab rnam gsum/spang rgyan lo ma'i gser 'grel gsum/ ka ba skye shi'i klung rtsis/ gza' bzhi las khog sa gzhung bye ma lag khrid/ pad+ma brtsegs pa'i rgyud/ 'grel pa dri med rnams bsgyur bar mdzad do/ /phyi 'gyur bar pa ni/ rgya nag gi paṇa chen byams chen grags pa la/ lo tsā ba khams pa bha yu chos rgyal gyis zhus pa/ rgyud/ man ngag lung/ 'grel pa tā ka snang gsal te snang gsal ma lnga/ lo rgyus mdo byang gi dum bu/ gegs sel gyi dum bu/ rin chen nam ngag gi dum bu ste bu gsum/ keg dang gi gong sa dpyad kyi mchong dang / zangs kyam ro bkra dur gyi mchong gsum ste mchong drug bcas 170

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/snang gsal ma bu bco lnga/ zla ba brten pa'i lo yi dar gud/ bag rtsis gsal sgron/ gung phur chen mo/ gza' bzhi'i skor zlog ltag sprod/ khog sel dang /gyor gyi grangs dang las bstan pa/ phyi nang gza' yi ngo sprod sogs gza' bzhi'i skor dang / spang le shod kyi man ngag gza' yi shi mig man ngag dug dbyung khams phyi rog po rnams bsgyur to/ /phyi 'gyur phyi ma ni/ tsa ma li la/ lo tsā ba khams pa zhwa ser gyis/ smra ba'i seṅge che chung / bong bu stag bcas mchong 'gyur dang / rgya mon gyi rtsis dang /gto rgyud che ba/ ka ba dgu 'gril/ gsal ba'i phreng ba/ rin po che yi mdud pa/smra mchu che chung / gzi mchong gi rgyud/ dmar nag brgyad cu skor gyi rgyud/ gyim shang rin chen spungs pa/ rgya yi brten chu skor sogs mang po bsgyur/phyi 'gyur tha ma ni/ rgya nag gi dpon chen kun 'byung a lo la she'u hūṃ chen gnyis pa dang / lo tsā ba khams pa gtsug ston gyis/ snang gsal ma bu bco lnga pa/ matā nag po rtsa ba'i rgyud yig sna ma bu bco lnga dang / gshin rtsis byi to ta na dang / klung rtsis rus sbal zla ba'i rtsis/ gsang 'grel brgyad pa/ 'byung chung skor/ sa dpyad rin chen phreng ba/ dgra gshed kyi rtse mdung / sel gyi ga'u skor 'go sel gyi gsang 'grel la sogs pa bsgyur ba yin/ de yang 'byung ba rin chen kun 'dus zhes pa 'di/ klu rgyal gab pas gsungs pa'i tshul gzhung de rang du gsal yang / klu rgyal gab pas gsungs pa la sogs pa rnams kun 'byung a los bsdus te glegs bam gcig tu bkod par mdzad par snang zhes sde srid rin po ches gsungs/ rtsis gzhung gter gyi rim pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gtsu ga lag gsungs nas mi ring ba'i dus na/ dgos pa'i dbang 171

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gis ri bo rtse lnga'i shar phyogs su gter du sbas par mdzad pa las gru 'dzin bdag pos thugs rgyud bskul te/ au ḍi ya na'i slob dpon chen pos tshangs pa gdong bzhi par sprul nas/ lha mo rnam rgyal/ klu rgyal 'jog po la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pas zhus te gter nas bton par bshad pa'i tshul ltar na gtsug lag rtsis rig mtha' dag gter du ma gyur pa med par gsungs/gzhan yang rgya gter gnyis pa ni/ dong tse'i sgo nas phyis su gter gyi rgya them dkar po la sogs pa gter ma dang / de phyin chad byung ba bka' mar 'dod do/ /gzhan yang bram ze ser skyas/ ri bo rtse lnga'i shar phyogs shing gi khog par bse sgrom smug po'i nang du gtsug lag gter du sbas pa'i tshul/ spug ston sogs kyi bzhed pa du ma yod par gsungs/ bod yul 'dir gtsug lag bka' gter gnyis kyi gter ma ni/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag brtsig pa'i dus/ 'phags yul nas mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyis gdan drangs/ rgya nag gi rtsis mkhan dar chen thig le phebs/de'i dus su rtsis rnams stag gi sgrom du bcug dam pa'i chos rnams gzig gi sgrom du bcug mthu gtad kyi skor rnams dom gyi sgrom du bcug ste dbu rtse bar khang du gter du sbas/ phyis 'gos kyi rgan dang zhang / 'brog pa thugs rgyal/ shangs pa mdze sngon rnams kyis gter nas gdan drangs/ bgod pa la ma 'chams nas hab shas blangs pa las/ shangs pa mdze sngon la stag sgrom thob pa'i nang nas spu gri drug skor la sogs pa byung ba dang / sham po cal du sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dngos su bstsal ba'i dmag rtsis rnams gangs kyi bye mar gter du bzhugs pa rnams/bram ze ser skya'i sprul pa/ jo sras kyis gter nas bton pa dang / rgya nag gi 172

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/mkhas pa hwa shang chen po ne le'i mi pa bha lo dang / dar chen dpal gyi thig le dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gi la shong kun la mnga' bdag rgyal pos gsol ba'i gyim shang shog dril dgu pa zhes dum pa rgya yi gter ma dang / rgya bza'i zab chos ngan chen gyi rim pa bcu drug srung 'khor sogs bsam yas mchod rten sngon po la gter du sbas pa/ khyung nag shāka dar gyis bton pa sogs gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor mang po gter kha khag nas byung ba rnams ni gter mar grags so/ /de dag rnams las ches khyad par 'phags pa ni/ slob dpon du har nag po zhes phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / drang srong gi bka' lung zab mo ma lus pa thob pa/ gto dkar nag khra gsum la mkhas pa de nyid/ sngon gyi dus chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku'i ring la bod du byon nas/ gtsug lag rtsis gzhung thun mong ba rnams bsgyur cing bshad par mdzad/ slar yang rgya nag che chung dang / mon dang / byang khams yul gzhir byon nas sa bdag gdug pa can bzhi btul bar mdzad de/ gnod sbyin drang rkun nag po dang / klu mo kha spyin mi sdug gnyis klungs mal gcig tu bsdebs pa las/ bu tsha ming sring bdud bzhi btsas te/ de yang che ba lha bdud gnam khyi nag po srid la 'khren pa'i sa bdag dang / 'bring po 'chi bdag bdud hal khyi nag po ro la 'khren pa'i sa bdag dang / tha chung nyon mongs bdud/ se shar dmar po ro la 'khren pa'i sa bdag dang / sring mo phung po 'dod chags kyi bdud the khyim bag ma la 'khren pa'i sa bdag bzhi mthu stobs nus pas gzir te/ yon tan 'byung ba'i lha bzhi zhes shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho yi g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang gi rus sbal rgya bo ste phyogs kyi phan pa'i lha bzhi btsal bar 173

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mdzad pa de nyid kyis/ rtsis gzhung rgyud sde kun zho las mar dkrogs pa bzhin/snying po bsdus pa/ rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me mdzad/ gzhung de bsdus don rnam pa drug gis bsdus par gsungs te/ keg rtsis dang / bag rtsis/ gson gyi las rtsis byis pa btsas klungs brtsi ba dang / gshin gyi zangs kyam rtsis/ sa dpyad kyi rtsis/ dgra gshed kyi rtsis dang drug mdo don rgya nag gi skor 'go bco lnga mdzad cing slob dpon du har nyid kyis drang srong phur bu dang / bram ze ma mu tig zur phud lnga ma dang / g.yu shar/ stag tshal sogs mngon par shes pa'i mi bzhi la bshad/ de bzhi po rang rang rgyud kyi don/ gson rtsis/ keg rtsis/ gshin rtsis/ ngan thabs kyi rtsis bzhi la mkhas par grags/ de dag gis rgya yi paṇa chen rā hu dmar po dang / paṇa chen zla ba nag po gnyis la bshad/bod kyi lo tsā ba khams khra gnyis pa zhes/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi phyogs la dka' ba dpag med spyad cing / brtul zhugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa des bod skad du bsgyur nas dar bar mdzad do/ /da dung rus sbal rang 'dra'i rgyud dang /gnam khyi'i gto chog rgyas pa sogs rgya nag nas bod du ma 'gyur ba'i rtsis gto'i rim pa du ma yod par gsungs so/ /de las rtsis gzhung khyad du 'phags pa/ yang 'gyur gsal ba'i sgron me zhes grags pa la/ spros pa gzhung gi skor dang / bsdus pa man ngag gi skor/ gsang ba lde mig gi skor/ sbas pa mdzub tshugs kyi skor/ nying khu shog khra'i skor dang lnga yod cing / spros pa gzhung gi skor la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su yod pa'i bka' la rgyud chen po lnga bzhugs te/ 'byung ba gsal ba'i sgron ma'i rgyud rtsa bshad/ gson po'i rtsis kyi rgyud dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ gshin rtsis kyi rgyud dur mdzod gsang ba/ sa dpyad kyi rgyud rin chen spungs pa/ dgra gshed kyi rgyud gyim shang nag po dang 174

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/lnga'o/ /bstan bcos ni rgyud chen po de dag la brten nas slob dpon du har nag pos bstan bcos rnam pa drug yod de/ rtsa ba skabs don lnga pa/ 'grel pa rtsa 'grel nyi shu pa/ man ngag gnad bsdus gsang tig bcu gcig skabs kyi gegs sel rin po che'i mchong gsum/ gto rgyab skyi yi cho ga gsum/ srog dpal srid gsum 'dzugs pa'i dgos phur gsum rnams so/ /de nyid las/ rtsa ba lnga ni/ skor 'go spyi yi rtsa ba/ dar gud rtsi ba'i rtsa ba/dur mdzod rtsis kyi rtsa ba/ sa dpyad bzang ngan gyi rtsa ba/ ngan thabs dgra gshed rtsis kyi rtsa ba dang lnga'o/ /gnyis pa 'grel pa nyi shu la/ spyi tshang 'grel pa mdo don bdun pa/ skyes sme'i 'grel pa 'byung ba rin chen skye gnas tshang gsal zhes bya ba dang / btang gcod 'phrul gyi sgron me dang / gnyen sbyor 'grel pa mthun sbyor bcu pa dang /bag rtsis kyi 'grel pa 'gro lam bkra shis dang / rtsub pa'i 'grel pa dang / rtsa ba'i rdel bzhi'i 'grel pa/ phyi skor 'grel pa dri med sgron gsal/ sme ba'i 'grel pa khra mo gling gsal/ spar kha'i rang 'grel brgyad pa/ gsang skor dar gud kyi 'grel pa 'phrul gyi me long / nad 'dre'i 'grel pa mthong ba'i me long /bu klungs kyi 'grel pa 'byung ba 'dus pa/ bla rdel 'grel pa zangs kyam gsal ba/ ro 'grel nag po/ chung dur gyi 'grel pa gsang ba yang 'khol/ ro lam 'grel pa lha rgyud gsal ba/ gto chog gso gcod sna ba'i 'grel pa/ sa dpyad 'grel pa mthong sgo dbye ba/ ngan thabs kyi 'grel pa gsang ba'i dgra gshed dang nyi shu tham pa'o/ /gsum pa gsang tig bcu gcig ni/ gtan tshigs dang / gnyen sbyor dang / bag ma dang / spar kha dang / gto thabs dang / bu klungs dang / gshin 175

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang / chung dur dang / sa dpyad dang / dgra gshed dang / spyi la gces pa'i gal gyi mig tshags rnams so/ /bzhi pa mchong gsum ni/ gsad pa las kyi mchong dang / ra la brten nas zlog pa'i mchong / gshin la phan gdags pa las kyi mchong dang gsum mo/ /lnga pa gto rgyab spyi yi cho ga gsum ni/ mkha' 'gro las kyi mtha' brgyad dang / srid pa sa bdag dong tse dang / 'byung ba'i gyer gto dang rnam pa gsum yin la/de yang las kyi mtha' brgyad ni/ bla srog yid kyi ga'us mngon shes gtan la 'beb pa dang / ma tram̐ la brten nas dgra bo bsgral ba dang / sa bon la brten nas mod pa btsal ba/ srid dpal la brten nas lte ba bsgyur ba/dpal mda' dpal 'phang la brten nas shi 'phro gcod pa/ tshe bshos la brten nas tshe 'gugs pa/ g.yang rdzas la brten nas g.yang gta' sdom pa/dug khrag la brten nas gnod pa zlog pa dang brgyad do/ /sa bdag dong tse la stong rgyas spyi yi gnod zlog dgu skor bye brag gi gnod zlog keg gi zlog bcos rnams so/ /'byung ba'i gyer gto ni/ ri rab kyi gzugs la brten nas dgra zlog pa/rus sbal gyi lus bkod kyis 'phral gyi keg bcos pa/ dkyil 'khor pho brang la bkod nas chag che zlog pa'o/ / ji drug pa dgos phur gsum ni/ srog phur bzung ba/ dpal phur gdab pa/srid phur bca' ba rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa bsdus pa man ngag gi skor la drug ste/ don skor bzhi brgya zhe gnyis kyis spros pa'i mtha' gcod/ lnga gsum bco lngas khog phub/ ngan klung 176

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/gis skyon ngos gzung / rtsub keg gnas spros kyis brjod pa'i sgang gril/ dar tshags rnam pa lnga yis dgos pa'i don bsdu/ sna tshogs pa'i thabs kyi nyes skyon bsal ba'o /de la spros pa'i mtha' gcod kyi grangs ni/ nam gzhag gtan gyi mtha' rtsis la rde'u brgya so drug keg rtsis la zhe bdun/ gnyen sbyor la bcu gsum/nad pa dang sri'u la bcu dgu gson khongs nas gshin 'don pa la nyi shu tham pa/ bla rdel bcu gnyis/ gshin 'dur shid gnyis la nyis brgya bco lnga'o//lnga gsum bco lngas khog 'bubs pa ni/ kig shing dang / ji me la sogs pa rnam pa lnga la rab 'bring tha gsum bco lnga'o/ /ngan klung gi skyon ngos gzung ba ni/ nag 'thus lo bcu gnyis/ lcags bzhi me brgyad/ dkar chung lo drug la sogs pa'o/ /rtsub keg gi spros pa chag chen bzhi/ dgu mig dur mig gnyis/ ro 'dod gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /dar tshags bzhi ni/ rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /nyes skyon bsal ba ni/ rab 'bring tha mar dbye ba de dag la bcos thabs sna tshogs bsten pa'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i lde mig ni/ rtsa ba/ gtan rtsis dang /gshin rtsis dang / gto chog rnams la lhan thabs re re yod pa'o/ /bzhi pa sbas pa mdzub tshugs kyi skor ni/ skor 'go rdel bor/ kha smrang la sogs pa man ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes dgos pa rnams so/ /lnga pa nying khu shog khra'i skor la spyir gson gshin/ sa dpyad kyi skor dang gsum yod la/ de las gson rtsis la gtan rtsis tshe dang / keg rtsis/ bag rtsis/ nad rtsis/ sri'u'i rtsis rnams dang /gshin rtsis la/ ro rigs skye gnas/ lo zla zhag dus sa bdag gi khra ma dang /gza' skar/ chung dur bkra ro dang / sa dpyad kyi khra ma bcas nang gses bzhi 177

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bcu zhe gnyis yod par gsungs la/ de la sogs pa shin tu gces pa'i man ngag gi tshogs ma bu cha lag tshang bar/ lo tsā ba khams pa khra mos/ 'phan yul gyi mkhas pa ral bhe ra badz+ra la gsungs/ des ru tshams shongs pa ba smon lam bshad/ de nyid kyis kun la khyab gdal du spel bar ma bzod nas/ rgyud chen lnga bton te sbas/rtsa ba skabs don lnga pa'i gal che'i skor 'go gcig dor nas/ skabs gsum bzhi ru bgos/ sa dpyad kyi rtsa ba gnyis gcig tu bsgril/ spar kha sa bdag 'grel ba gsum bgos/ nad 'dre gshin gsum dang / gto yi 'grel ba sbas shing rtsa 'grel dkrugs pa dang / shog khra gal che ba dang / 'byung ba'i gyer gto/ sa bdag dong tse/ lhan thabs lnga/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad me long gcig bcad pa sogs drug cu skor ba'am/ gsal sgron sbas bcad can gyi rtsis brgyud de nyid/ ya tsa ba dang / lho brag pa mar pa sbrul mgo la sogs pas kun la spel zhing dar rgyas mdzad/gsal sgron sbas bcad med pa yang dag pa'i lugs ni/ 'phan yul gyi ral bhe ra badz+ra/ mal ze glan dang / se ston khri pa/ smyos ston rgyang yod/ rgya ston dang / zhang dang / de slob mkhas pa'i khyu mchog khyung nag shag dar la gsungs/ de nas rim par/ mi nyag rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / sngags pa lhun grub dpa' bo dang / de yi bla ma mkhas grub pa/ mkhas mchog ār+ya de wa/mtshungs med sangs rgyas blo gros/ phug pa dpal mgon phrin las/ bde legs gar dbang phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin gzhon nu gdong drug zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho nas rim par brgyud pa dang/ yang na dpal mgon phrin las nas/ phug pa dpal gyi seṅge 178

nag rtsis kyi lo rgyus 'jam mgon dgongs bcud ces bya ba/dang / g.yu lo/ gnyags ban na ra ba/ de nas zur chen nas rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la brgyud pa dang / yang na ār+ya de ba nas/ dus rams pa don grub kun dga'/ dge bsnyen bsod nams tshe 'dzin/ slob dpon bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje phun tshogs dge dbang / mkhas grub dpal gyi seng ge/ mkhas dbang bkra shis/ ldum po don grub dbang rgyal/ 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs la'am/ lu 'go bla mkhyen ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ sde srid mi yi dbang po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la rim par brgyud cing / nges pa don gyi mkhas pa'i dbang po 'di nyid kyis/ grong sngags ma da'i zlos gar gyis/ /don dang yi ge'i rnyog phran rnams/ /sā ra'i shes rab ke ta kas/ /grungs pas gtsug lag gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spobs pa brnyes pas brgyud pa rnam dag las 'ongs pa'i gtsug lag gi legs bshad rnams la/ gzhan gyis bslad pa'i tshig don gyi 'khrul pa rnams sun phyung zhing rnam par dag par gtanaphro phab/ gyim shang la brten pa'i gto thabs rno myur can du ma dang / rtsa ba'i sa gcod me long la sogs pa snying dang 'dra bar shin tu gces pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams/ zog po gtad khrom mkhas gyi lag tu shor dwogs kyis gud du sbas shing dam gtsang snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams kyis zur du 'chang ba'i yig cha logs su bstan cing / nag rtsis la brten pa'i khog 'bubs rnams kyi nang nas/ khams pa khra mos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rin chen rtsa phreng dang / khyung nag shāka dar gyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rin chen rtsa phreng / phug pa mi nyag rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i stong thun chen mo/ phug pa chos rje bsod nams tshe 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i khog 'bubs 'chi med dga' ba/ zhang gi khog don gsal sgron rnams la gzhi bcol/ kun gzigs lnga pa 179

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chen pos gtsor gyur mkhas mang gi zhal rgyun rnam par dag pas brgyan/ lhad zhugs dang / 'gangs chung tshig ro'i rigs rnams rnam dpyod kyis dpyad pa nan tan du mdzad nas/ khog 'bubs legs bshad kyi snying po be+e dkar le'u nyi shu par bkod par mdzad yod pa ltar gtsug lag gi chos phun sum tshogs pa ni de ltar lags so/ /lnga pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gong du chos phun sum tshogs pa'i nang zhib par bstan pa bzhin bsod nams ldan pa lha/ longs spyod can gyi klu rgyal/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba lha min/ gdug rtsub ldan pa sde brgyad mi bcas rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lnga dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i dus der tshangs pa la sogs pa'i zhu ba po rnam pa bzhi dang / kong rtse sogs 'phrul gyi mi bzhi/ drang srong bde len sogs len pa po bzhi/ drang srong lce mur sogs 'chang ba po bzhi bcas las rim par brgyud de gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig pa mi'i yul du dar zhing / lhag par bod la cha bzhag na'ang rgya yi slob dpon 'bar ba tshom tshom la sogs pa rgya yi mkhas pa du mar brten nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus rgya yi yul du mngags pa ye shes rgyal bas gtsos pa'i bod mi shes rab can la sogs pa chos phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs gtsug lag rtsis kyi brgyud pa rim byon cung zhib par gleng ba de dag thams cad ni 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi kun rdzob rtsis kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lnga las rim par brgyud pa yin no/ /'dir 'bad dge bas 'jam mgon dgongs pa'i bcud/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho las 'khrungs zla 'od kyis/ /skye rgu'i ma rig mun pa rab bsal nas/ /phan bde'i kun da bzhad pa'i rgyur gyur cig /180

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul skor rags tsam dpyad pa/dkar dkar gangs ris bskor ba'i zhing mchog 'dir/ /nyung nyung mtsho yon dbyangs gsal pir ris kyis/ /zab zab don kun gsal ba'i shing rta che/ /mang mang mkhas pa'i tog gyur sasto ṭa/ /zhes shis brjod kyi tshig sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rang cag kha ba'i ljongs kyi skye 'gro rnams la bka' drin can thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang sprags kha ba'i ljongs 'dir snga rjes su dar ba'i yi ge'i skor dpyad pa'i thog ma'i lta tshul tsam zhig spro bar 'dod pa 'di lta ste/dang po/ thon mi sasto ṭa'i byung ba brjod pa/thon mi sasto ṭa zhes grags pa'i ba dan bla na 'bar ba de ni‘‘btsan po lde spru po gnam gzhung btsan ring slan chad blon chen bgyis pa'i rabs la de 'i 'og tu mthon mi 'bring po rgyal btsan nus byas’ ①zhes lo rgyus kyi yig lam nang 'khod pa ltar na thon mi'i gdung rgyud ni bod rje'i bka' blon gyi rgyud pa rnying gras lho kha'i gnyal gyi thon mi snang grags kyi sras su dus rabs bdun pa'i nang bltams shing / khong gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mtshan la a nu zhes gsol 181

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ba rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka'i mdun na 'don rnams kyi nang nas mkhyen rab rmad du byung ba ches bsngags par 'os pa rgyal thabs kyi chen po'i gros la dbang ba zhig yin la bod kyi lo rgyus thog snyan pa 'bar ba'i 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi pa yang smren/ srong btsan sgam po'i bka' ltar rgyal po'i btsun mor bal bza' dang / rgya bza' snga rjes su bsu ba'i chen po'i mdun gros kyi skabs su yangapha‘mgar stong btsan yul srung dang / thon mi sasto ṭa mi chung gnyis kyis nged rnams kyis khab tu bsu'o’ ② zhes khas 'ches pa ltar rgyal po'i bka' ltar btsun mo bsu bar yul gru so sor gshegs nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas rgyal po mnyes par byas/ lhag par‘‘rgyal po srong btsan gyis/ mgar yul bzang dang 'khor mang po rgyu nor dngos po'i rjong brda rgya chen po byas te rgya gar du mngags mod/ 'khor phal cher tshad pas shi/ mgar yul bzang kho rang yang shi la khad byas/ nor rnams kyang zad de phyir log pas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs ma 'grub/ de nas thon mi sasto ṭa de dus lo brgyad lon zhing rig pa gsal la brtson 'grus che bar shes nas de la grogs ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa'i(stag lo de phrong sogs)lo gzhon bcu drug dang bcas pa la gser dang rta drel sogs dngos skyes phun sum tshogs pa gnang nas rgya gar du mngags ’① zhes sgyu gu'i bstan bcos 'phrul gyi me long nang gsal ba ltar rgya gar la phebs te yig rigs sbyangs pa dang /de rjes da lta'i bod yig 'di dag gsar gtod gnang /thon mi'i mtshan dang 'khrungs yul skor/ tā la'i sku phreng lnga pas‘gnyal nas thon mi a nu'i bu‘sasto ṭa ’’rjo zhes gsungs pa dang / skyogs ston rin chen bkra shis kyis‘thu mi sa 'bo(lho gnyal gyi thu mi snang grags kyi bu a nu ste 182

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/sam bo ḍomidangapha‘sam ba dra sogs rgya skad du bzhed pa byung yang / 'di gnyal na yod pa sa 'bur po zhig 'dug pas sa 'bor yin pa 'dra/ gang ltar na'ang bod skad du snang )ra’’du zhes mchan 'grel du de ltar snang ba sogs‘a nu ’zhes bya ba yang snying yab sras sur zhu ba'i gnad don thad mkhas pa so so'i bzhed dgongs mthun min skor kho bos rmongs pa'i 'char sgo tsam zhu na/ thon mi sam bo ṭa ni gnyal gyi thu mi snang grags kyi bu a nu yin pa las thon mi a nu'i bu sasto ḍa min par 'dod/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sum rtags rtsa ba'i mdzad byang du byā ka ra na lung ston pa rtsa ba sum cu pa dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a nus mdzad pa rdzogs so me zhes dang /gser tog sku phreng lnga pas‘bka' blon a nu'i bka' drin mi dran su’’⑦ zhes dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos‘'khrungs yul 'ga' zhig thon lug ra kha par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gnyal snang grags kyi bur bzhed cing sa 'bur po yod pas sa 'bo ra yin zhes dang / a nu yang mtshan dngos sam yab kyi mtshan sogs bzhed tshul mi 'dra zhing legs sbyar du'ang sa man+ta ta bha dra ste kun tu bzang por 'bod pa dang / sasto ṭa rang la bod yang dag par bzhed pa sogs ji snyed cig mchis kyang smon 'gro paṇa chen gyi bzhed par don g.yor po yul dgu'i nang thu zhes pa'i rigs su 'khrungs pa mtshan‘ sam bsngags pa dang / 6bho ḍa’bod de bod bsngags par bzhed’’nices gsungs pa'i bzhed pa de rnams don la gnas/ sum rtags kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung mdzad mkhan ni slob dpon a nu ste thon mi sasto ṭa las gzhan ma dmigs pas thon mi sardzo ṭa ni lho kha'i gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi sras a nu yin pa las/ a nu'i bu sasto ṭa min par kha tshon bcad na mi 'grig pa med snyam/ 'o na6‘sasto 183

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ṭa’’dang / ‘‘sam bha dra’’sogs rgya gar gyi skad min pa gnyal nas sa 'bur po zhig 'dug pas sa 'bo ra yin par bzhed pa 'di ji lta bu yin zhe na/ de ni dpyad pa bya dgos pa'i gnad don zhig yin/ gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs pa‘‘sa skya pa’’lta bu dang / gang zag gi ming gnas la thogs pa‘‘pa rnamami’lta bu ji snyed yod pa khas len dgos mod/ 'on kyang sa 'bur po yod pa'i gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs na‘‘sa 'bur ba mizhes su grub dgos pa lasaltes 'bo ra’’zhes pa ci la grub/ der ma zad sa 'bur po'i dag char‘‘'bo ’zhes pa rtsa ba nas med pa'i phyir‘‘'bo’’zhes pa'i tshig ni rtsam 'bru 'jal byed kyi‘‘'bo’’dang / 'khus chu 'dor bar‘‘chu 'bo’zhes pa las sa 'bur po'i don ston mi nus pa dang / de gang zag la sbyor skabs bdag sgra dgos pa de'i tshab /ma‘ra ’zhes pas bdag sgra mtshon mi nus pa des na thon mi'i mtshan 'atsu‘sa 'bo ra ’zhes bod skad du snang lugs de 'thad par ma mthong / 'o na don dngos ji lta bu red ce na/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung las 'di skad thos te/thon mis rgya gar du rigs pa'i gnas la 'dris par byas/ byang bar byed pa de'i tshe de'i dus khong gi rtag 'grus dang mkhyen pa'i rtsal la 'phags yul gyi slob dpon rnams kyang thugs yid shin tu 'phrog ste sam skṛ ta'i skad las‘sasto ṭa’’ste‘‘bod pa bzang po miyang na smon 'gro paṇa chen gyis bod bsngags par bzhed pa gang ltar bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba phyis thon mi bod du phebs nas kyang de lta bu'i mtshan rgyun 'jags su song ba yin/ dper na/‘‘sa paṇ+ḍi ta ’zhes pa'i don yang‘‘sa ’zhes pas sa skya ba'i don mtshon pa dang /‘‘paṇ+ḍi ta’’zhes pa ni sam skṛ ta'i skad las rig pa'i gnas lngar byang chub pa'i mkhas pa chen por de ltar gsol ba ltar sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan 184

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/gyis phyi nang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag rang dbang du mdzad de mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo'i lta ba ngan pa rig pas tshar bcad pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i snyan pa brjod pa rgyun 'jags su gyur te phyis sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam/ yang na sa paṇa zhu ba las sa skya pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhus na khong mtshon mi nus pa sa skya'i gdung rabs gzhan dang 'khrul 'gro ba ltar thon mir sasto ṭa 'am/ yang na thon mi‘sasto ṭa mizhu ba yang de dang mtshungs pa yin/gzhan yang‘‘thu mi sasto ṭa’’dang‘‘thon mi sasto ṭa ’zhes thu dang / thon zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs gnyis byung ba gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs pas thon mi'am rus khungs nas 'bod pas thu mi/ yang na gnas dang rus rgyud gang rung nas thon mi 'am/ thu mi zhes ci bder 'bod chog pa gdams nga can las gzhan rgyu mtshan med snyam/ 'on kyang da dung dpyad pa dgos pa'i dogs gzhi gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ (mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 nang‘‘thon gyi lug ra kha nas thon mi a nu ra ka ta'i bu thon mi sasto ṭami’⑨zhes 'khod pa dang 'dra bar gzhan yig lam 'gar yang de ltar 'khod pa ma zad/ thon lug ra'i brgyud kyi mang tshogs khrod thon mi byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi sgrung dum bu 'dra yang shod rgyun yod pa bcas gtsang gi snye mo thon pa thon mi'i gdung rgyud yin no skad pa don la gnas dang mi gnas skor 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod pa'i thad bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad cig yod pa ste bod kyi rgyal blon gdung rabs sdong po gcig las yal ga mang por gyes pa dang / bste gnas gcig nas gcig tu 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i gnas tshul ji snyed mthong chos su gyur pa ltar thon mi gang du bltams pa'i yul ni lho kha'i gnyal kho nar nges pa gong du 185

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gleng ba ltar lags kyang / de rjes thon mi'i gdung rgyud las gyes pa'i gdung rabs snye mor gzhis chags pa'am/ yang na thon mi'i mdzad rjes kyi bkur bzos su snye mor sgos gzhis 'jags gnas nas bzung snye mo thon zhes pa'i ming dang / thon mi'i lo rgyus kyi sgrung yang khong la bsngags pa brjod pa'i slad du de ltar 'byung srid pa gang ltar 'di ni rjes su byung ba'i gnad don zhig la rtsis te bsam blo btang na lo rgyus dngos dang 'tshams pa bcas thon mi'i mtshan dang 'khrungs yul skor re zhig zhu mtshams 'dir 'jog rgyu lags so/ /gnyis pa/ bod la gna' rabs kyi yi ge yod dam med/srong btsan sgam po ma byon gong bod la gna' rabs kyi yi ge yod med kyi gnad don thad lo rgyus deb ther dang / 'das dang da lta'i mkhas pa so so'i bzhed pa ci rigs rang sor gnas pa las da phan gna' bo'i lo rgyus dngos dang 'tshams pa'i sdom tshig rnal ma zhig byung med pa de ni long bas glang mjug gi ngang tshul lhur len pa'am/ yang na smra ba spangs nas sdod dgos pa'i gnad don zhig tu tshor ba slan chad kyang 'di mur mi lus pa 'brel yod sde tshan dang / mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad pa mdzad de lo rgyus dngos dang mthun pa'i sdom tshig gnad 'phigs po zhig byung na lo rgyus shin tu ring ba'i gangs can ljongs kyi rig gnas spyi dang bye brag la zhib 'jug bya rgyur phan pa ha cang che ba yong nges 'dug ces snyim pa spyi bor zum ste gsol bar 'os pa las/ rang la de lta'i skal ba ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang lhag bsam bzang po'i kun slong gi brtsis zin pa'i rtsol bar nongs pa med par ngos 'dzin gyis 186

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/kho bos sngon byung gi lo rgyus la phyi mig lta ba dang / lo rgyus deb ther dang /gna' bo'i rig gnas bcas la dpyad pa byas pa brgyud rang gi lta tshul tsam zhig nyi gzhon 'dren pa'i rta bdun gyi tshul du cung zad zhu na/ srong btsan gong bod du gna' bo'i yi ge ste zhang zhung gi yi ge yod par bzhed pa de gna' rabs lo rgyus dang 'tshams par mthong la bzhed pa gcig shos de yang gna' bo'i bod kyi yi ge de zhang zhung gi yi ger ngos 'dzin dgos la de yang bod kyi sa khul bye brag pa'i yi ger brtsi ba las bod spyi'i yi ger mi brtsi ba lta bur go ba blangs na der 'gal ba cher mi 'dug snyam pa bcas de skor lo rgyus yig lam nang ji ltar gsal ba dang / lo rgyus thog bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi bya dngos/ 'dzugs skrun dngos po la sogs pa'i gnas tshul dngos nas srong btsan gong bod la zhang zhung gi yi ge yod pa'i skor zhu rgyu gsham gsal/gcig srong btsan gong bod la gna' bo'i yi ge yod pa'i skor/bon gyi yig lam nang / ‘‘ston pa gshen rab kyis bstan pa spel ba'i dus 'ol mo lung ring du yi ge gtan la phab/ 'ol mo lung ring gi yig bzo ni 'ol mo lung ring stag gzigs kyi spungs so che chung gnyis yin/ de rjes zhang zhung gi yi ge rmar chen dang / rmar chung gnyis la bsgyur ’ces dang / yang‘‘li shu stag ring sogs rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'ol mo lung ring nas bon gyi bka' bstan bcos rnams rim bzhin dbor nas stod kyi bye ma g.yung drung du zhang zhung la mkhas pa stong rgyud mthu chen dang / bod la mkhas pa sha ri dbu chen gnyis sogs kyis zhang zhung skad kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams bod kyi skad la lo tsā byas nas bsgyurami’⑩ces dang / ‘‘de dag(rgyan drug)la gtugs pa'i zhang bod kyi lo tsā bzhi byon pas kyang rang rang gi yul la sogs 187

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa'i phyogs thams cad du bsgyur nas spel zhing bstan pa rgya cher 'phel lo lo tsā ba bzhi ni mdo bsdus las‘bod du rgyal phran bcu gnyis ring la mkhas pa bzhi la brgyud de sde bon gyim tsha rma chung / me nyag lce tsha mkhar bu/ sum pa mu spungs gsal tang / zhang zhung stong rgyud mthu chen nomi’’⑪ zhes dang btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis‘bye brag tu bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yongs su dar ba'i yi ge ni/ 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i mdor bsdus bzhi pa las/de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa 'phags pa'i yul 'dir bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa na/ sdud par byed pa po dag gis theg pa gsum glegs bam la bris te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nges pas sde snod gsum ni ma gadha'i skad kyis bris so/ mdo sde ni sin rtse'i skad kyis so/ pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul dang sngags kyi tshul ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis so/ /rgyud dang rgyud gzhan dag ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang /tha mal ba'i skad dang / zur chag gi skad dang / legs par sbyar ba ma yin par ri khrod la sogs pa kla klo'i skad kyis te/ de lta bu la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pas bstan pa'i chos rnams sdud par byed pa po dag gis bris so/de bzhin du bod kyi yul du theg pa gsum bod kyi skad kyis bris te/ rgya nag tu rgya nag gi skad kyis so/ rgya nag chen por rgya nag chen po'i skad kyis so/par pi ka'i yul du par pi ka'i skad kyis so/ chu bo si ta'i byang du tsam pa ka'i yul gyi skad dang / spre'u'i yul gyi skad dang / gser zhes bya ba'i yul gyi skad kyis so zhes 'byung ba'i tshig la brtags na bka' bsdu ba byed pa'i dus nas bod la yi ge grub pa ltar snang’’⑫zhes dang / mkhas dbang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos‘bod kyi yi ge ni/ lha mo dri ma med pa sogs du ma dang / dus 188

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/'khor 'grel chen du/ 6bod kyi yul du theg pa gsum bod kyi skad kyis bris te zhes lung bstan pa ’⑫ zhes dang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis‘bon rnams ltar na/ srong btsan gyi gong du bon chos de tsam dar bas yi ge med zer ba mi bden zhing / de yang stag gzig gi spungs yig bya ba zhang zhung gi yig rgan du bsgyur/ de sman brag tu bsgyur/ de rim gyis dbu can dang / 'bru mar bsgyur sogs zer ’④ zhes dang / mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gis/ ‘‘tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su bon po rang la yi ge yod dam med ces 'dri na/ bon po rang gi chos phyogs la spyod pa'i yi ge re yod pa'ang srid/ de ni chos phyogs kho nar bkol thub tsam zhig las chos srid gnyis kar bkol ba'i yi ge khyab gdal du yod par mi 'dod de'i dus bon po la yi ge yod kyang chos srid gnyis kar spyod mi thub pa'i dpe mtshon la za lar gyi yi ge'i skor 'di ngas dper bkod pa yin/ de'i phyir lo rgyus kyi dbye ba gnyis po(da lta'i bod yig dang / bon po'i yi ger gsungs)'di so sor bkar nas dpyad pa gtong dgos pa red’ ⑫ces dang / dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed nang‘‘de yang spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod yig gsar gtod mdzad po thon mi sasto ṭas bod yig gi khyad chos dang mthun par ’’zhes gsungs pa bcas 'das dang da lta'i mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bshad pa'i don la brtag na gna' rabs bod la zhang zhung gi yi ge yod pa dngos sam shugs nas bstan pa'i nang lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang / dus skabs so so'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis lha sgrung lta bu dang / ‘‘lung bstan’’par grags pa 189

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sogs mkhas pa'i chos lugs kyi gsung tshul 'ga' zhig byung ba de dag dor dgos pa smos ci dgos/ gna' bo'i dus su rgya gar du gleng ba'i yig rigs skor(mdo rgya cher rol pa'i〉 nang yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes bya ba'i nang gses su'angapha‘bru sha'i yi ge’’⑩zhes 'khod pa de ni gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi yi ger de lta'i ming thogs par ngos 'dzin na mi 'grig pa med snyam/ de yang bod kyi yul gru'i dbye bar‘‘spu rangs dang / mang yul/ zangs dkar gsum skor gcig go li dang / bru sha dang / sbal te gsum skor gcig gozhang zhung dang / khri te/ stod smad skor gcig ste stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum’’⑩ du brtsi srol yod pas bru sha dang / zhang zhung ni mnga' ris skor gsum gyi tshan pa gcig gi khongs las mi 'da' ba des na zhang zhung gi yi ge der‘‘bru sha'i yi ge zhes thogs srid pa'i rang bzhin shin tu che ba dang / yang yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang gses su gsung tshul gzhan zhig lo‘mon gyi yi ge’ tsozhes 'byung bar yang dpyad pa bya rin yod snyam/ gna' bo'i dus su lho mon zhes bod kyi lho brgyud sa khul mang che bar de ltar grags pa las mtsho sna'i brgyud kyi khyab khongs chung ngu'i mon pa tsam la ngos 'dzin mi byed/ de yang gna' bo'i dus su kong po bon rir ston pa gshen rabs phebs nas bon gyi bstan pa spel ba la sogs pa'i lo rgyus gleng du yod pas de'i dus bon gyi chos lugs la spyod pa'i zhang zhung gi yi ge khul de tshor dar bar‘‘mon gyi yi gemi zhes pa'i tha snyad thogs 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan yang deng skabs 'brug yul du spyod bzhin pa'i lho yig tu grags pa de las gzhan‘‘mon gyi yi ge’ ngos 'dzin yul med khar/ lho yig gi gzugs kyang dbu chen dbu chung mnyam 'dres su 'bri ba lta bu dang / tshig sbyor gyi 'gro stangs kyang da lta'i bod yig dang mthun pa 190

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/zhig yod pa de yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang 'dren pa'i mon gyi yi ger ngos 'dzin yul med khar/ lho yig gi gzugs kyang dbu chen dbu chung mnyam 'dres su 'bri ba lta bu dang / tshig sbyor gyi 'gro stangs kyang da lta'i bod yig dang mthun pa zhig yod pa de yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang 'dren pa'i mon gyi yi ger ngos 'dzin na mi 'grig pa los yin/ ma gzhi 'brug yul du gna' rabs zhang zhung gi yi ge spyod myong ba cung zad mngon gsal che yang thon mis da lta'i bod yig yar thon can 'di 'dra ba gsar gtod gnang rjes gna' rabs kyi yi ge de 'bri rgyun rim nyams song bas lho yig 'di yang da lta'i bod yig gi khongs su gtogs mod/ 'on kyang lho yig gi gzugs dang /brjod pa'i thad thun mong min pa'i khyad chos re zung yod 'dra ba skad kyi khyad par ram/ yang na gna' rabs yi ge dang 'brel ba yod pa gang yin la dpyad pa bya rgyu yang dgos nges red snyam/bsdoms na bka' dang bstan bcos sogs gna' rabs lo rgyus kyi yig lam khag nang nas drangs pa de tsho gna' bo'i bod kyi rig gnas 'phel tshul gyi bya ba dngos dang zung 'brel byas na da gzod lo rgyus dngos dang 'tshams pa'i sdom tshig rnyed thub pa ni bod la gna' rabs kyi yi ge yod ces bshad nus pa de yin/gnyis/ bod rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i gong bod la bon po'i chos dar ba ni rtsod med yin/ de yang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas/gnya' khri btsan po‘‘lha ri rol po'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te/btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pas bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis phyugs skyong bas mthong ste gnyal ba khri byas 191

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bteg nas 'ongs pas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags ’⑪zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang lo rgyus deb ther mang che bar gnya' khri btsan po nas lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan bar rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun ring bod kyi chab srid sgrung /lde'u/ bon gsum gyis bskya ngas zhes byung ba'i skor la dpyad na'ang / bon chos kyi gzhung lugs yig lam la brten dgos pa smos ci dgos/ sgrung dang lde'ur mtshon na'ang deng dus dang mi 'dra ba srid kyi bya gzhag la shugs rkyen ster nus pa'i rig gnas shig tu 'khums pa de dag yig lam gang la'ang ma brten par skye bo'i ngag rgyun kho nar byung zhes smras na yid ches mi btub pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur grang / gzhan yang ches snga ba'i dus su bod kyi rgyal rabs rim par bon gyi sku gshen re yod lugs bcas gang ltar gna' bo'i dus bod kyi chab srid dang / bsam blo'i 'thab sa ni bon gyis bzung ba des na yi ge ni de bas kyang dgos gal che bar mthong bas ma tshad/ da dung bon chos dar ba'i gnas te zhang zhung gi rgyal po khri yer la rje gu lang gser gyi bya ru can nas lig mi rgya'i bar zhang zhung rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / gnya' khri btsan po nas bod rje na rim gyi lo rgyus phra rags gleng rgyu yod pa 'di dag yi ger ma brten par mi lo stong phrag 'ga'i gnas tshul skye bo'i ngag rgyun kho na las thos zhes smras na de la blo dang ldan pas yid ches mi btub pa kho nar zad/(rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉 las‘‘rje gnya' khri btsan po nas lha tho tho ri snyan shal yan la gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun la lo lnga brgya song 'dug par nges zer na'ang chos dang 'brel ba'i rgyal por mi 'dug pas lo rgyus rgyas par ma bkod ’⑥ ces gsungs par gzhigs na/ deb ther de ni rab byung bdun pa'i sa 'brug(1388)lo brtsams pa yin stabs de'i dus phyis tun hong nas 192

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha lta bu'i gzhi 'dzin sa mang po yod pa gzhir grub pa'i yig lam de tsho yang gna' bo'i bod kyi yi ge ste zhang zhung gi yi ge dang 'brel ba med ces sus shod nus sam/ lhag par lo rgyus deb ther mang che ba'i bzhed pa dang mthun par(rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉 las‘‘pu de gung rgyal du grags so/ rgyal po 'dis rgyal sa bzung ste blon po ni ru la skyes kyis so/ rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyi dus su g.yung drung gi bon byung ste ston pa gshen rab mi bo bya ba stag gzig 'ol mo'i lung ring du sku 'khrungs/ khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa bon po'i chos thams cad zhang zhung gi yul nas bsgyur te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad ’⑪ ces dang / tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes/ ‘‘rje gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags te/ bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba yin no/ /des las thabs su sku mkhar 'un bu bla sgang brtsigs/ 'tshe mi gshen gyi dmu gyel gyis bon bsgyur/ sum pa'i bon po a yongs rgyal ba btul lo’’⑤zhes gsungs pa bcas bon po'i yig lam nang 'khod pa dang lta bsdur skabs dus kyi khyad par dang / sgyur ba po su yin gyi gnad don 'dra min tsam ma gtogs rtsa don zhang zhung skad nas bod skad du bon po'i chos bsgyur ba ni gcig mthun ma zad/ gnya' khri btsan po dang / pu de gung rgyal ni srong btsan sgam po'i gong du byung ba bsnyon med yin/ bon po'i chos dper yang sangs rgyas chos lugs pas yul gyi che ba 'don pa'i phyir‘‘rgya gar skad du’’zhes pa dang 'dra bar‘‘zhang zhung skad du zhes byung ba(phyis dar bon chos su zhang zhung skad de legs sbyar gyi skad dang 'dra ba zhig 'bri srol 'dug pa de ni dgos mkho'i dbang gis stabs bstun byas ba zhig tu mngon)gal srid skabs der bod la yi ge zhig med na zhang zhung gi skad de bod skad du sgyur mi nus/193

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/tun hong gi bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha'i nang du gri gum btsan po'i lo rgyus dang /lde sprin btsan tshun chad bod kyi blon chen gyi go rim la sogs pa srong btsan sgam po ma byon gong gi lo rgyus phra rags mthong rgyu yod pa de dag dang 'dra bar lo rgyus deb ther gzhan du yang de lta bu'i gnas tshul mang po drangs yod pas kyang bod la gna' bo'i yi ge yod pa rigs pas sgrub nus/gsum/ kha ba'i ljongs 'di'i yul dang / mi'i 'gro ba byung ba'i lo rgyus ni ches snga ba yin/ de yangapha‘stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs kyis kyang rgya bal sogs yul gru gzhan dang 'dra bar thog ma nas mi'i 'gro ba chags par bzhed’’⑫cing / ‘‘lung rnam 'byed dang dus kyi 'khor lo sogs su'ang bod ces mang du 'byung bas ngo bo bdag cag gi ston pa byon pa'i dus las yul dang / mi gnyis ka ches snga bar chags(rgya gar dang dus mnyam du chags par byas na'ang 'gal ba med)pa zhig tu snang ’④zhes sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung las byung ba de tshor dpyad gzhi'i rin thang chen po yod pa los yin/ lhag par du nye ba'i lo shas gong chab mdo'i kha rub tu gna' bo'i gnas shul dang /rdza chas/ rus chas sogs rig dngos mang po thon pa de tsho mi lo bzhi stong lnga brgya'i gong gi gna' bo'i bod mi'i rjes shul yin pa tshan rig zhib 'jug thog nas dngos ra 'phrod yod/ de lta bu'i lo rgyus shin tu ring ba'i nang nga tsho'i mes po tshos kha ba'i ljongs kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir rlabs po che'i bya gzhag mang po gsar gtod gnang ba'i gzhi ma yang yi ge dang 'brel ba shin tu dam pa go bas chod gsal bzhin bod kyi gna' bo'i yi ge ste zhang zhung gi yi ge des bod kyi gna' rabs rig gzhung 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon yod pa khas mi len pa'am/ yang na yi ge rtsa ba nas med par ngos 'dzin pa ni lo rgyus 194

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/dngos dang mi 'tshams/ deper na/ bod kyi gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun dngos po'i thog nas kyang mthong thub pa ste mi lo nyis stong brgal ba'i dus su bskrun pa'i yum bu gla sgang dang / da lta nga tsho'i 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du rol bzhin pa'i lha ldan gtsug lag khang srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus da lta'i bod yig(spyi lo 653)phy-igasar gtod gnang grub ma thag spyi lo 454lo gsar skrun gnang ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang yi ge gsar gtod gnang ba nas khyon yongs khyab gdal 'gro ba'i brgyud rim la cha bzhag na dus yun nges can zhig dgos pa smos ci dgos/ gtsug lag khang gi 'dzugs skrun da lta'i bod yig da dung khyab gdal chen po byung med pa'i gnas tshul 'og thog ma'i skrun dngos gzhi rgya che la bkod pa mdzes pa mig gi bdud rtsi lta bu 'di 'dra ba de gong yi ge sogs rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi nges can zhig med na yong thabs med/gtsug lag khang 'dzugs skrun skabs kyi lo rgyus la gzhigs na yang skabs der rgya bal bzo bo'i rogs ram tsam ma gtogs gtso bo bod rigs rang nyid kyis bskrun pa tshang mas shes gsal bcas de lta'i lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i kha ba'i ljongs 'dir dus rabs bdun pa phan la gna' rabs kyi yi ge rtsa ba nas med ces bshad na lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang ci la mthun/bzhi/ gna' bo'i bod kyi yi ge ste zhang zhung gi yi ge dus ji tsam la byung ba dang sa gnas gang du byung ba'i skor/ bon gyi chos lugs kyi ngos nas bshad na ston pa gshen rab ma byung gong gi lo brgya phrag kha shas nang bdud bon dang / btsan bon sogs 'ga' zhig byung bar grags pa dang /de rjes bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che ni zhang zhung rgyal po thog ma khri yer gyi skabs su zhang zhung rang du byung bar grags/ khri yer nas rtsis pa'i zhang 195

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zhung gi rgyal rabs grags che ba bco brgyad la lo lnga brgya brgal ba song rjes gzhi nas bod rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po byung ba dang / de nas zhang zhung gi rgyal rabs rim pa brgyud mtha' mjug zhang zhung gi rgyal po lig mi rgya srong btsan sgam pos pham par mdzad nas zhang zhung rgyal rabs kyi dbang sgyur mjug sgril te slar yang zhang bod gcig gyur byung bar grags/ 'on kyang phyi rabs kyi lo rgyus yig cha'i nang pu de gung rgyal dus ston pa gshen rab byung bar grags pa de 'thad ldan du khas blangs na ston pa med pa'i bstan pa khungs gtugs sa med pa'i bon po'i chos shig zhang zhung du byung bar khas len dgos/ston pa gshen rab 'khrungs yul rtag gzigs('di'i don ni bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis 'gro don la byon skabs sku 'khrungs sa'i yul dus rtag tu gzigs pa'i yul la rtag gzigs zhes bya bar 'bod ces bon rnams gleng )'ol mo lung ring bya ba yang zhang zhung ste deng mnga' ris sa khul gyi gu ger yin par 'dod pa ni don la gnas par mngon/ yang bzhed tshul 'ga' zhig tu bon po'i chos de sa khul gzhan nas byung ba la sogs pa mi rigs rang nyid kyi lo rgyus la zhib mor ma dpyad pa gzhan brten kho na khyad par 'phags par brtsi ba ji skad du‘‘'gro mgon sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhin du/ /ston pa gzhan la gus byed pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho 'gram du/ /ba tsha'i khron pa brko ba yin/’’zhes gsungs pa ltar de la dgos pa lhag po gang yang ma mchis pa bcas bsdoms na bod kyi gna' bo'i yi ge'i khungs de bon por ma brten rang brten yong 'gro ba gzhir bcas pa des na bon gyi yig lam nang 'khod pa ltar gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi yi ge gsar gtod gnang mkhan ston pa gshen rab mi bo che yin zer ba der rgyu mtshan chen po yod par mngon/ de ltar na 196

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/zhang zhung gi rgyal po khri yer nas gnya' khri btsan po'i bar la lo lnga brgya lhag tsam dang / de nas da bar lo ngo nyis stong lhag tsam song ba/ yang bka' bsdu ba'i dus la mtshon na/ bka' bsdu ba dang po ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo yin pa dang / bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu song ba/ bka' bsdu ba gsum pa'i dus kyi skor mkhas pa'i bzhed pa cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i thad/ ‘ rtog ge 'bar ba las bshad pa ltar na de ltar lo drug cu rtsa gsum gyi bar du dge 'dun rnams 'khrugs long gis gnas so zhes pa'i rjes thogs su de nas lo brgya phrag gnyis 'das pa'i rjes la gnas brtan gnas ma'i bus bstan pa yang dag par bsdus zhes so/ des na ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang sum cu rtsa bdun nas sde pa so sor gyes pa dang / de'i khar lo drug cu rtsa gsum gyi bar 'khrugs long byung bar gsungs pa'i lo 'di bsnan pas brgya phrag gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ de bzhin du kun mkhyen bu ston gyis kyang sde pa so sor gyes nas lo drug cu rtsa gsum na gnas brtan ma'i bus bsdus so zhes lugs so sor smos pas kyang gsal ba'i phyir ro/ yang lugs tha dad pa gcig la dus ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya na(tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje yang lo sum brgyar bzhed/ rtsom pa pos)bsdu ba byas par bshad pa'ang yod ’a+yoces 'byung ba bcas don rdor dril na/ bod kyi gna' rabs yi ge ste zhang zhung gi yi ge ni dma' mthar lo ngo nyis stong drug brgya'i gong du bod kyi zhang zhung rang du byung ba dang / de nas rim gyis bod kyi sa khul gzhan la'ang khyab gdal byung ba red ces bshad na mi 'grig pa med par sems/ 'on kyang yi ge'i gzugs dang / tshul bzhin sbyor ba'i brda dag gi gzhung ji ltar yod pa'i 197

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnad don thad ngal ba mang po spyad de don dngos 'tshol zhib byed dgos pa las stabs bde'i sgo nas da lta 'di dang de'i sdom tshig 'jog mi thub la 'jog kyang mi rung ba zhig yin/ de yang thon mis gsar gtod mdzad pa'i da lta'i bod yig gi dbyangs gsal dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs bcas ni rgya gar yi ge'i khyad chos dang mthun shas shin tu che ba'i skor rjes su zhib cha gleng rgyu ltar/ thon mis da lta'i bod yig gsar gtod gnang skabs gna' rabs bod kyi yi ge'i legs cha 'ga' zhig bed spyod gnang ba'i rang bzhin chen po yod pa dper na/ gsar snon yi ge drug gi gnas skabs su zhang zhung la 'gro zhes pa'i nyer len las‘zha ’yig grub pa lta bu cha shas skabs bsam blo gtong gzhi yod pa tsam las de min gna' rabs yi ge rtsa bar bzung ste bod kyi yig gsar gzhan ma bzos pa lta bu gtan nas min pa des na gna' bo'i bod kyi yi ge'i khungs gtugs sa zhang zhung gi gna' bo'i skad kyi khyad chos dang / de min rig dngos sogs 'brel yod kyi bya ba dang / dngos po tshar du dngar bar zhib 'jug byed dgos pa'i las 'gan 'di ni gzi brjid che la dka' tshegs che ba zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan der brten kho bos go skabs 'di dang bstun te bod kyi rig gnas bya gzhag gi rtsol bar zhugs pa'i blo mthun rnam pa dang / ched las mkhas pa rnams la de lta'i gzi brjid kyi las 'gan legs sgrub yong ba'i ched du 'bad brtson lhod med mdzod cig ces lhag bsam bzang pos bskul bar bya ba yang de ltar lags so/ /lnga/ spong btsan sgam po ma byon gong bod du yi ge'i srol med ces bya ba 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug gam/ da phan lo rgyus deb ther rtsom pa po mang che ba bstan pa phyi dar rjes kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mkhas 198

thon mi sasto ṭa'i lo rgyus dang bod kyi yi ge'i byung tshul/pa sha stag la brten khong tshos bon po'i chos la dag snang mi mdzad pa'i dbang gis gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi yi ge la sogs pa bod kyi rig gnas 'byung khungs bon por brten na sangs rgyas chos lugs pa'i lar rgya shor dogs lta bus snang med mdzad pas rang re'i mes po tshos gsar gtod gnang ba'i yi ge la sogs pa'i lo rgyus thog gi rlabs po che'i bya ba mang po bag la nyal ba dang gcigasangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs dbar 'thab rtsod thengs mang byung ba'i nang nas khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus bon rnams pham/ ‘‘rgyal pos bon po rnams stod mnga' ris zhang zhung gi yul du mthar bskyod btang zhing /bon po'i chos dpe yongs rdzogs bsdus nas khag gcig chu la g.yugs/ khag gcig bsam yas su mchod rten nag po gcig bzhengs pa de'i 'og tu mnan’ ⑦zhes lo rgyus deb ther nang gsal ba ltar skabs der bon po'i chos lugs ming gi lhag mar gyur pa dang chabs cig gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi yi ge sogs rig gnas gtso che ba 'ga' zhig kyang thag zhor 'breng 'drud song ba'i rang bzhin chen po yod pa ma zad/ thon mi'i bka' drin las da lta'i bod yig yar thon ldan pa 'di 'dra ba legs grub byung rjes gna' bo'i zhang zhung gi yi ge rjes lus can nam/ yang na yag po rang med 'dra ba de rang bzhin du go mi chod par gyur te de dag 'bri rgyun rim nyams mi rabs mang po zhig song rjes mi tshang ma'i dran lam du ma gyur pa glang dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs skabs thon mis mdzad pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs khag brgyad yod pa nas da lta bzhugs pa sum rtags gnyis dang / yod par grags pa thu mi mdo rdzi'i sgra mdo ming tsam las gzhan ma lnga ni gzhung lugs dngos su mjal rgyu ltar bzhag tha na ming tsam yang deng skabs 'dren du med pa dang mtshungs par 199
