nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lta mi phal che bas mthong ba ni srid gsum bdag mo dgyes pa'i mtshan ma dang /de 'phror nub nas rlung dang thal 'tshub kyis nam mkha' 'gyur ba ni nag phyogs 'byung po'i 'tshub lhongs dang 'di la brten nas kong phyogs nas gzir bun gyi rnam pa 'byung bar blta'am snyam/ 'di nyin bal po/ zangs mgar/khro lugs pa/ tshags pa/ lcags mgar rnams kyi bzo grwa bar khang dang mdzo mo ra ba/ dga' ldan khang gsar du shing gi bzo rigs/ bla brang bzo khang du gos dar gyi bzo cha/ rgya ri khang gsar du tshon 'dul rnams kyi las grwa btsugs/ 'go mi dang 'u lag byings bcas kyi sgar chu smad gling khar phab/skam po yung / dog sde/ gdol ba/ lha lung / sdig rag rnams nas rdo/pha bong kha nas sa dmar/ yer pa nas ar kha/ grib nas g.yam pa/ rdzong gi shar 'ong kha nas zhing dud 'bul dang bcas pa'i sa rnams 'dren 'khos bgyis par/ skam yung nas rdo gdung ma lta bu gru bzhi nar stabs kyi dkyus 'dom do tsam glegs bam gyi shog bu brtsegs pa ltar don pa tshal sde pa grags pas sgroms kyi zur bzhir g.yag rkyal btags te 'phrul lhongs kyi chur 'dren pa mdzad cing / dkyus ma rnams skyid chur ko bas drangs/ sdig rag gi rdo g.yam skyid gtsang du sngar med kyi 'phrul zam btsugs nas blangs/ dogs sde nas gser rdo/ dngul rdo/ lcags rdo/ cong rdo sogs ya mtshan don pas mtshon sa rdo gang yang thogs med du byung zhing / bde yang nub dang grwa khang gi lho nas rtsig rmang bting ste rim par brtsig4 ((dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs238)zhes gsal ba ltar lags/de'i lo phyi ma ste lcags lug(1691)lo nas ar po'i las grwa grwa khang nub brgyud dang / ka spungs phyi ma'i mas thog rnams nas rim par brtsigs 250

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/shing / lo 'di'i 'ul mi'i yong khungs ni gong dkar dang / sne gdong sogs kyi rdzong gzhis khag nas mi grangs lnga stong bdun brgya sum cu so bdun 'dugalcags lug hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga bdag cag gi ston pa lhums su zhugs pa'i dus chen khyad par can gza' skar dge ba'i nyin gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gsar bzhengs kyi bzo grwa thog mar btsugs/ chu bya (1693)lo'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin ar po'i grol ston mdzad pa de'i tshe thog ma'i las grwa bde yangs shar nub dang / grwa khang skor legs par grub cing / lte ba tshoms chen steng thog 'gel ba'i byang brgyud g.yab skor dang / nub nas ka gcig bkal ba/ gser sdong lha khang ni rtsig pa tshoms chen thog nas miphagang 'phags pa rnams nas 'go bzung ste brtsigs pa'i phyi rgya mjug skyong tsam ma gtogs byings che lo gsum la gegs med legs grub byung zhing / skabs der ar po'i rdo bzo ba sogs log par thugashing phag(1695)lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin lnga pa'i sku gdung yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po shing gi za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol ba'i zhal kha phye nas gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig nang bzhugs su gsol ba dang /de nas dga' ldan khri rin po che co ne tshul khrims dar rgyas la sogs pas rab gnas mdzad pa'i skor〈dkar chag thar gru〉las/ ‘‘phyogs phyi ma'i bzang po dang por gdan sa'i gtso bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi khri rin po che co ne tshul khrims dar rgyas zhes khri thog lan gnyis sogs phyis kyi gser khrir phebs pa rnams kyi mchog gyur gyis dbus rgyud stod smad 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dge 'dun dkon cog dang bcas pa/ dga' ba gnyis par bsil ldan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon 251

nor brang zho rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gdan zur 'dus tshogs de mo sprul sku la sogs dang / bzang po gnyis par se ra theg pa chen po'i gling gi slob dpon 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren khrus gsol brtan bzhugs shis brjod la sogs bden tshig gi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa/ tshogs su nged rang gi rab tu gnas pa'i thugs 'dun dgos pa las spros rten gyi dgos pa sogs tshig gi mchod sgrin nyin ltar don 'dra la tshig mi 'dra ba phul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus lugs la sogs rab gnas kyi dus brjod pa ltar((dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs257)zhes gsal ba de ltar gser sdong chen po lcags rta(1690)lor rten bzhengs dang rtsig rmang 'ding ba'i dbu tshugs pa nas shing phag(1695)lo gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sde'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pas mtha' brten pa ste lo ngo drug dang hril po lam pa bzhir gegs med du 'byongs pa'i shing phag bod zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi nyin rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs su rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshor gtang rag nyin lnga gtong gnang mdzad pa bcas so/ /bzhi pa/ gang bzhengs pa'i brngo pa dang / de dag mnyes pa la sogs pas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ ar po'i spyi khyab pa 'bog gong mon pa blo gros rgyal po/ klu spug tu 'u lag gi ja thug do dam sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po dang / spyan g.yas em che bstan 'dzin nor bu/ shing bzo'i do dam rags ma mdung pa dgos pa dang / gong dkar bde chen rab brtan pa tshe dbang rab brtan/ rdo bzo'i do dam shun grong chung ba ye shes rgya mtsho/ stag lung gnya' ri khug pa bkra shis bsam grub/ lcags bzo'i do dam gzhis rtse sgo bzhi ba bkra shis/ rta mgo'i rdo khungs do dam mnga' ris rtse chen pa mgon po/252

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/'tsho byed sngon ma sgo rab pa blo gros rgyal po/ phyis gong dkar nang chen pa kun dga' don grub/ gdol pa'i rdo khungs kyi do dam lhas blun po shag pa rta mgrin rdo rje dang / 'phyongs rgyas bkra shis kha pa o rgyan phun tshogs/ sna mo kha'i rdo khungs do dam dga' mdong gu ru dang / lha khang blo bzang / cab la gsog pa'i do dam bzang rad pa bsod nams tshe brtan/ skam g.yung du rdo gsog do dam pa rog tsha lding dpon rig 'dzin dang / rgyal gling khang gsar ba dgos skyes/ bon lung pa bsod nams rab brtan/ 'tsho byed nor rgyas pa nor bu/ ko ba'i do dam lho pa dar rgyas/ sa khungs rdo rgyab lho pa mi srid chos rje/ ge re dkyil khang pa gri gug thel rgyag dang las rgyab sogs gar dgos su dpal gshongs pad+ma/ snye mo zangs ri shar pa bsod nams tshe ring/mdo mkhar ba rnam rgyal sgrol ma/ lhas nang ma mo ba blo bzang / ra mo che lcang ra bsod nams/ grib spus grong pa bsod nams rin chen/ yul lnga steng kha ba blo bzang / g.yam gsog do dam 'phyongs rgyas sangs rgyas/ rong mkhar tsho ba dbang 'dus/ gdang mkhar ba sogs dang / rdzong gzhis gzhan rnams nas ngo tshab re/ rten bzhengs skor shas che ba'i spyi khyab do dam gzhis ka snying snying / gong ma rgyal pos mngags pa'i dim chi bsod nams bzang po dang g.yog sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ bzo pa blo dbas/ blo byang /blo dbyangs/ blo mkhas/ blo byin/ khog pe khed/ blo ba thing bcas mi bdun/ khyon 'go dmangs mi dgu/ bal po phra pa'i 'go pa dga' chags rta mgrin rdo rje/ brgyud 'phul 'go pa mkhar nag rdo rje tshe brtan/ nai pa la bal bur grags pa'i dbu chen in+d+ra sam/ 'phul pa'i dbu chung pa ma las/byings gras tā ṇi dang / rda na 'de'u sogs mi bco lnga / brdung ba'i gras 253

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dbu chung skyil na las/ spa ma/ dha na kra/ mdzes las/ byings gras par bha/ 'gur sna sogs lnga bcu nga gnyis/ phra pa'i gras dbu chung wang dz+nyā na tsan dar/ dha rma 'de'u/ byings gras spa ma/ dha na 'de'u sogs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ brdar gad byed mi sarba dang / dha na tshe ring sogs mi lnga /bal po lcags gzi rgyab mi bkra shis dang la na mu ni sogs mi so dgu/ bal po'i gos bzo ba'i dbu chung ram̐ ca ram̐ sogs mi nyer gcig bcas khyon bsdoms lag rtsal mkhan mi grangs brgya dang dgu bcu go gnyis/ lha bris sman lugs dbu chen lho brag bstan 'dzin nor bu/ dbu chung rong pa bsod nams rgyal po dang / snye mo karma/ snye mo lhas byin bdud btsan/ byings gras rgyal rtse rgyal po sogs mi grangs brgya tham pa/ dkyus gras tshe ring dar rgyas sogs mi grangs lnga bcu nga brgyad/ mkhyen lugs dbu chen gsang sngags mkhar tshe 'phel/ dbu 'bring spus khyim ngag grol/ dbu chung ngag dbang bsod brtan dang / byams pa rgyal mtshan/ byings gras bsod nams chos 'dzin sogs mi grangs drug cu re gsum/ dkyus gras kun dga' bde legs sogs mi lnga bcas khyon bsdoms lha bris pa mi nyis brgya so bzhi/ gzungs par rko mi byings gras nor bu tshe brtan sogs mi lnga/ 'jim bzo dbu chen chos 'phel/ dbu chung 'jam dbyangs dang dpal 'dzin sogs dbu chung mi bzhi/ byings gras btsun chung sogs mi sum cu/ zangs mgar dbu mdzad lho pa lhas nang pa sogs mi bzhi/ byings gras byang pa khri tshang ngag dbang sogs mi bzhi bcu zhe gnyis khyon bsdoms mi bzhi cu zhe drug khro lugs dbu mdzad sbyor don grub dang / rin chen bsam grub/ byings gras bsam grub dgos pa sogs mi nyi shu rtsa bdun khyon mi rtsa dgu/ gser bzo ba dbang phyug sogs mi gsum/254

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/pad 'dab bzo mi grwa pa tshe dbang sogs mi gnyis/ shing bzo dbu chen dol gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ dbu chung rtse kha chos skyong sogs mi bco lnga/ ang dang gras rgyal sa glang grong sa sogs mi dgu bcu go lnga/ rkos pa'i gras rgya ri ba'i tsan+dan sogs mi bcu/ shing bzo dkyus zhel dang / lag 'bras ang gnyis pa'i gras dor gcig pa sogs mi brgyad cu gya dgu/ shing bzo slob ma'i gras grong chung pa'i bu bstan 'dzin sogs mi drug shing rkos tshags pa dbu mdzad pa rnam mgon po/ byings gras lhun rtse nor bu sogs mi bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dkyus zhel stag rtse mthong dga' bcas shing bzo ba khyon bsdoms mi nyis brgya drug cu tham pa/rdo bzo dbu chen rgya mon dar rgyas/ dbu chung gras dol rnam li lo sogs mi bdun/ rdo bzo byings sdebs gras za dam dgos 'dod sogs mi brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug rdo bzo dkyus zhel gras dge 'phel gu ru skyabs sogs mi nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis bcas khyon rdo bzo ba mi sum brgya bdun cu don drugazhal mkhan dbu mdzad rgya ri tsan+dan/ byings gras za dam bsam grub sogs mi dgu/ zhal mkhan dkyus gras snye mo chos 'phel sogs mi dgu bcu go bdun bcas khyon mi brgya dang bdun/ tshags pa dbu mdzad dngos grub/byings gras ra sgang nor bu sogs mi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad bcas khyon bsdoms brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu/ lcags bzo dbu mdzad dbo tshang pa sogs mi gsum/ byings gras gra phyi thod dkar ba sogs mi bdun cu don lnga khyon bdun cu don brgyad/ gos bzo dbu chen lha sa ra rtse shag bsod nams/dbu chung gzhis rtse dge bsnyen rdo rje sogs mi brgyad/ byings gras gzhis rtse blo bzang sogs mi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas khyon mi brgya dang sum cu so bzhi/255

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gos yol gyi rtsabs par dang 'go ris rgyag mi lha bris pa lha sa grags pa sogs mi drug tshon 'dul dbu mdzad 'jam dbyangs don grub dang / byings dben chung sogs mi bdun/ gos zu dang yol thang gi kha 'bur sogs bzo mi sngo bzo ba phag skyag sogs mi nyi shu rtsa dgu/ skud pa bzo mi sog mo nam kher sogs mi dgu/ bzo rigs de dag rnams kyi phogs thob skor dkar chag thar gru las spyi khyab do dam 'bog gong pa sogs che khar zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu nas khal drug sha gcig gi dod khal gsum dang / ngo sprod sha lug gang rung re/ thug sdor lug mgo gnyis/ tsha snum bre do re/ tā tshang nyag gsum/'u zi nyag bzhi/ mar khal gcig nyag gang / rdo shing bzo bo'i do dam sogs drung 'khor dang sde dpon gyi ngo tshab gras la zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu nas khal bdun/ rgyar lug phog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gcig tshwa snum bre re/ tā tshang nyag gsum/ mar nyag dgu/ de 'og sgam po ba'i ngo tshab sogs la zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu nas khal drug rgya chung khog gcig tshwa phyur snum bcas bre re/ ja mar gong mtshungs/ rdzong gzhis chung kha nas btang ba'i ngo tshab sogs la zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu nas khal lnga/ rgyar chung khog phyed/tshwa phyur snum bcas bre re/ ja nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/ nang gzan sogs do dam chung khar zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu nas khal phyed lnga dang gzhan ma gong 'dra/ lha bris dbu chen la nas khal brgyad/ rgyar lug khog gnyis/ phyur ba bre phyed gsum/ ja sbyor bzhi/ dbu chung dang / 'jim bzo ba sogs la gong nas cha shas/ byings la zla phogs nas khal bdun bre bcu/ tshwa snum bre re/ rgyar lug khog ja sbyor bzhi nar gtong / shing bzo dbu chen gnas gsar bar zla phogs rtsam chang rgyu sha dod dang bcas nas 256

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/khal bcu/ rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gnyis/ tshwa snum bre re/ ja nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/ dbu chung la nas khal brgyad/rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gnyis/ tshwa snum bre re/ ja spor do/ mar nyag gang spor gang / byings gras la nas khal bdun/ rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gcig tshwa snum bre re/ ja mar gong mtshungs/ dkyus zhal la nas khal phyed drug lug khog phyed/ thug sdor lug mgo gcig tshwa snum ja mar bcas gong mtshungs/ rdo bzo dbu chen la zla phogs nas khal dgu rgyar lug khog gcig tshwa snum bre re/ ja spor do/mar nyag gang spor gang / rdo bzo dbu chung dang zhal mkhan byings gras dkyus zhel bcas par shing bzo ba dang 'dra mnyam/ mgar ba dang tshags pa dbu chen la nas khal brgyad/ rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gcig tshwa snum bre re/ ja nyag do/ mar nyag lnga/ byings la nas khal bdun/ rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gcig tshwa snum bre re/ja nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/ dkyus zhel la nas khal drug rgyar lug khog phyed dang / gzhan ma gong mtshungs/ ko pa rnams la zla phogs nas khal phyed gnyis/ rtsam khal bzhi/ ja nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/tshwa phyur snum bcas bre re/ ko tshil mar nyag re/ rgyar chung sha phyed/ bal po phra phul brdung gsum la zla phogs nas khal bdun/ tshwa snum bre re/ 'u zi nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/ lug gson re dang / lug mgo gnyis/zangs bzo dbu chung la nas khal brgyad/ ja nyag gang / mar nyag do spor gsum/ tshwa snum bre re/ rgyar chung khog phyed gnyis/ thug sdor lug mgo gnyis/ byings gras mgar ba dang 'dra ba/ gser dngul mgar bar rtsam 257

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/khal gsum bre drug phul bzhi/ nas khal phyed gnyis/ tshwa snum bre re/ lug mgo gcig ja nyag gang / mar nyag phyed gsum/ rgyar chung sha bzhi gling /khro lugs dbu mdzad pa nas khal dgu/ rgyar lug khog gcig thug sdor lug mgo gnyis/ tshwa snum bre re/ ja nyag do/ mar nyag lnga/ byings gras la gong steng nas nas khal gnyis chag pa sogs gang 'tsham dang / lam chas gong nas cha shas/ so sor 'dzugs chas bzang bstod/ lo rer ngos 'gro'i blta rtog dang bstun zur chas zab pa lan gsum res mtha' brten pa rnams kyi so so'i las ka'i babs yul dang gzugs gzhis rkyen ma theg pa sogs re gnyis yun thung nges 'dug cing / la la thog ma nas zhabs su ma chud bar bsdad pa'i rgyun ha cang ring ba/ byings lo ngo gsum gyi dbyar ston ring thogs pa bcas las rgyun nges krig ma thub kyang khongs nas zhib rtsis ngos’mizhes(dkar chag thar gru'i〉shog grangs 282par gsal ba ltar skabs de'i bzo rigs khag gi phogs thob zas rigs sogs dngos po gang song zhib phra bkod pa'i mjug bsdoms su rin gong dngul thob bsdoms srang chig khri lnga stong bdun cu don lnga zho dgu skar brgyad de gla thob 'char can gyi che tshad dang /sngar bsil ldan kha bas bskor ba'i rgyal khams 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa/drung chen ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan/ gtsang stod zhing shag bsam grub rtse pa sogs dang / lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs 'du khang chen mo/ kun dga' ra ba/ pho brang dmar po ri/ lha sa jo bo'i rgya phubs/ ra mo ches — mtshon rten bzhengs ar po ji snyed cig gnang ba rnams la yang de lta bu'i thob thang gzigs skyong byung med lugs sde srid rin po ches dkar chag nang gsal por 'god gnang mdzad cing / skabs de'i ar po ba'i phogs thob dngul 258

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/bsgyur gnang ba gong gsal dngul srang chig khri lnga stong brgya med bdun cu don lnga dang zho dgu skar brgyad zin pa de skabs de'i bskal bzang thang gzhi gong du dngul 'bor 'brur bkug pa'i rtsis gzhi ltar na 'bru gshor khal gcig la dngul srang med zho med skar phyed drug tsam rtsis gzhi bzung gnang ltar gong dngul 'brur phab na 'bru gshor khal nyis 'bum bdun khri bzhi stong brgya dang bcu med dgu thob pa'i 'bru'i 'bor grangs shin tu che ba de'i thog nas skabs de'i bzo rigs pa'i 'tsho ba'i thob thang ni sde srid rin po ches gsungs pa ltar sngon gyi dus skabs gang 'dra zhig las mtho ba yod pa mtshon pa ma be+ed/ bzo rigs 'go dmangs dang bcas par so so'i las gnas la gzhigs pa'i gzigs bzos kyang spam mi chung ba bstsal ba yang ha cang zhib phra dkar chag tu 'god gnang mdzad pa/ bzo rigs pa'i phogs thob che chung gi tshad gzhi de'i thog nas bzo rigs khag gi lag rtsal gyi rin thang ar las de'i dgos mkho dang / so so'i phan nus la gzhigs pa rtsol mthun thob sprod kyi mdzad phyogs phyag bzhes gnang ba yang khyad par 'phags par bsngags 'os pa bcas so /lnga ni bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i skor/ de yang dkar chag thar gru las/ bsil ldan kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir rje bla ma'i yang srid gong ma mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi thugs bskyed btsan pos chos 'khor du 'phags pa zhig bzhengs par bzhed de/ za hor gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs nas sa btul gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa zhus pa na/ rgya gar du o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag las bkod pa legs pa med pas der dpe byed gsungs nas/ ri rab kyi tshul du dbu rtse/ gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i tshul du shar phyogs su rnam dag khrims khang gling / mkhyen rab 'jam 259

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dpal gling / brda'i sbyor tshang mang gling / lhor bdud 'dul sngags pa gling /ar+ya pa lo gling / rgya gar gling / nub tu be+e ro tsa na'i gling / byams pa gling / bsam gtan gling / byang na rin chen sna tshogs gling / sems bskyed gling / dkor mdzod pe har gling ste gling bcu gnyis/ nyi zla'i tshul du yak+ṣa gong 'og mthar lcags ri/ zur bzhir mchod rten/ sgo bzhir rdo ring / jo mo'i gling gsum dang bcas bzhengs par zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes rlung ltar grags shing / rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje chen po bsams bzhin du rgyal po'i srid pa bzung ba lha btsan po khri lde srong btsan ral pa can gyi phyag ris su 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang 'og thog gsum rdo/ bar thog gsum sa phag steng thog gsum shing las grub pa/ thog re re bzhin bya 'dabs sgo pha gu dra phyed sogs kyis rnam par mdzes shing / steng gi rgya phibs rlung gis bskyod tshe gdugs ltar 'khor ba sogs bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa du ma byung ba las kyang 'gongs pa snga na med pa'i mchod sdong chen po 'dzam gling rgyan gcig las rten phyi'i gaskud la'ang 'phags pa lag na pad+mo'i ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i sprul zhing ri bo gru 'dzin gyi bkod pa dang mtshungs par rgya phubs gsum brtsegs can dus 'khor sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi ras bris rdul tshon sogs dang mtshungs pa'i dbang lha rnam phyi ma'i tshab tu gtsug lag khang dngos gzhi rnams dang / gsung dkyil lha snam la tshoms chen/blos bslang lugs kyi steng du thugs dkyil gyi lha snam la lha khang dang gzims chung spel mas mtshon pas tshoms chen steng gi 'khor thags seng g.yabs kyi steng du thugs lta bu'i lha khang bcas 4dang / rten yang chos longs sprul 260

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gsum gyi dbang du btang ba'i chos sku'i rten dang sprul pa'i sku'i rten byings da lam la ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad sprul sku'i gtso bor bzhugs pa/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rdo rje 'chang la rigs lngas bskor ba/ thugs rten mtshon byed de dag gi dbus su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i blos bslang rnams dang / rje bla ma mchog gi bzhugs gnas bcas yod pa'i khyad mtshar shig rang byung na bsams pa lag gcig ma yin par shar na'ang / ri mgor song ba'i ha cang las gron che gshis mnga' 'bangs 'gro ba rnams mi ngal ba'i khyad btang snyoms su lus/ chos 'byung lo rgyus rnams su rnam pa gcig la 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon po'i bla ri las pad+ma skyes kyi bla ri glang chen bres nyal lta bu zhes sa dpyad legs pas der 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i rgyal pos bzhugs na bod la bde skyid shugs kyis 'byung bar bstan pa dang / rnam pa gcig tu bod srin mo gan rkyal gyi dbyibs su yod pa'i lte ba 'o thang gi mtsho snying khrag dmar lcags snying rus kyi rnam par yod pa mtsho steng jo bo shākya mu ne bzhugs pas non cing / snying rus kyi rtse mor rang byung 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bsti gnas dang / chos rgyal nyid kyi sku phyag nas ma bzhugs pas sa dpyad ngan pa thams cad rnam par 'joms te legs pa'i cha 'ba' zhig tu gyur tshul khungs ma mang po nas bshad pa'i bod gangs can gyi phan bde spel bar ri bo 'di nyid kyi steng du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la sogs pa dgos pa kho nar go zhing / de yang ri bo'i snying gar gtsug lag khang gi lte ba bcol te brtsigs na phugs sa khong la brten pa'i 'bab zhol sogs mi yong ba dang /'phral bkod bshoms kyang gang 'dod du byed bde bar go na'ang / chos rgyal 261

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lha khang chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa dang /'phags pa lha khang yang rje bla ma srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan chen pos sku mtshams la sogs pa gnang ba sogs rnying pa byin can la song bas bshig na rung min som nyir gyur pa rje bla ma'i sku gdung rin po che'i sku zhabs su lha mo gsung byon ma'i thang ka byin can bcas brtag bsgril lan gnyis phul ba sngar gyi rnying pa rang sor g.yo 'gul med par bzhag pa 'gab pa phebs pa bcas/ dngos gzhi ri rtser song bar ma zad rnying pa bshig ma thub pa sogs nas 'dod par gang yod cig ma byung na'ang / lung dang mthun par byang brgyud kyi lte ba rma med du bzhag cing mchod khang bde yangs shar nub sogs byings sngar las ldab kyis che bar rgya bskyed ngo mtshar gsar bskrun gyi lte ba'am dbus su tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs ((dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs2༷2)zhes tshoms chen skor sogs rgyas bshad gnang ba ltar lags shing / skabs der gsar du bskrun gnang mdzad pa'i lha khang gzhan dag skor (dkar chag thar gru〉las/‘‘'khrungs rabs lha khang du rin po che tra su ste mtsho mo steng ngam rgya gar 'phral skad du rang ka lir 'bod par mā shā'i 'dab mas kha bsgyur pa'i mar gad kyi mdangs 'phrog pa/ byang chub lam rim lha khang gi ka ba brgyad gdung bcas rin po che gnyis pa dngul las grub pas shel dkar ri bo tshar dngar du byas pa'i mdangs 'phrog pa/ rig 'dzin lha khang 'degs byed klu grangs ka ba gdung bcas rin po che bzhi pa piṇ+ḍam gyis drag po'i las 'byor zhing gzi 'od 'bar ba be+eḍūr+ya mthing ga'i mdangs la 'khu ba/ lha khang de dag bzhi'i phyam rnams kyang rang rang phyogs mdog spyi ltar dang mtshungs pa/ steng seng g.yabs kyi steng du mar me bdug spos la sogs pa stong gsum mam 'jig rten 262

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gyi khams kun gsal zhing rab mngar dri bsung gis rdzogs pa las rten dang brten pa'i mchod rdzas rnams thag nye dri mas nogs par mi 'gyur zhing ha cang ring ba yang min pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i smrin phung khang lcags khras phyi nang gsal bar byas shing de'i steng du rgya phubs rus sbal gzugs rin po che ka thi la'am mtsho mo steng du grags pa'i kha dog shel ltar dkar ba dkyus rgyug mtho brgyad cu gya gsum/ zheng sum cu so dgu mtshon gsum/ dpangs bcu dgu yod pa'i zur bzhir 'od kyis snang ba kun la 'gyed pa'i gser sbyangs kyi tog re dang / gnas gdung dbus su bum gzugs gardzir dpangs rgyug mtho bzhi de'i mthar 'bar ba pad+ma dang bcas mdzes pa'i mdangs kyis mtshan yang nyin mo'i snang ba 'dzin pa/ steng du rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma'i pho brang sngon chad ma grags pa dpyad pa gsum gyis rtsal du bton pa ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mtshon pa'i phyi gsal nang gsal dang bcas pa/ khungs ldan yongs 'dzin bla ma khang zung / rgya nag lha khang / sras bcas rgyal ba'i li sku khang zung / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rten dang brten pa'i bkod pa cha phra mo yan chad bshad khungs dang mtshungs pa sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i blos bslang khang ste phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu tshogs la bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i lha khang bdun/ rje bla ma srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan mchog gi bzhugs gnas sogs gzims chung gi gras su ka ba grang gser byi ba byugs dang sdebs bris su bka' gdams bu chos rags bsdus bkod pa/ 'char nub med par rta bdun gyi gzi 'od 'khyil bar sdod pa'i bka' gdams 'khyil ba dang /hor thags su grags pa'i ka gdung khyad mtshar zhing dbang mdog gi zhal ba khyad par ba dang bcas pa'i ngo mtshar 'khyil ba/ bser bu'i rlung sogs kyis 263

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ring du byas pa bde chen 'od gsal khang / kun bzang rjes 'gro khang / sa gsum zil gnon/ 'dod dgu 'khyil ba/ nor rgyas dpal 'byor/ bde ldan 'khyil ba/ phun tshogs bde legs/ bkra shis bkod pa/ phun tshogs bkod pa/ sa gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa gzhal med khang tha gru yangs shing bkod pas mdzes pa bgrang ba las 'das pa rgyab mdun gyi rta lam/ mu ran zla ba byugs 'dras mdzes la ring por khyog cing / bde yangs shar nub mkha' la tshad pa/ lugs brgya'i phun tshogs 'du lam/ byang chen bgrod pa'i thar lam/ bde skyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te ka spungs shar nub steng gsum/ gzhan yang dbang phyug steng shod/ ngo mtshar bde ldan steng shod/rmad byung bkod pa/ bde legs/ mchod sprin steng / grwa khang gsang sngags dga' tshal/ dpal 'byong khang / zhi khro dgyes skong spyan gzigs khang la sogs pa/ dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma'i kun dga' ra ba dang bla chen sde dpon sogs che dgu bste bar 'os pa'i khang bzang brgya phrag brgal ba/de dag gi shing cha'ang 'og khang sogs gal chung sa 'ga' zhig las phal che ba nyang kong dang byar rong gi nags tshal stug po'i khrod nas 'dems sgrugs kyi sbom zhing drang la sra mnyen 'dzom pa'i rgya shing dang thang ma'i ka gdung / phyam shas che ba gyad las mi'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i rigs rnams kyi shing rta dang 'khor lo'i rim pa sogs 'phrul bkod du mas drangs pa'i sngon med kyi shing cha ches mang ba/ lha lung / sdig rag skam g.yung / dog sde bcas phan tshun gyi ri rnams nas lcags rdo/ gser rdo/ dngul rdo sogs sna mi gcig pa'i rdo rigs mtshar ba du ma dang / khyad par skam g.yung nas rdo gdung ma gru gzhogs kyi rnam pa 'dom do tsam glegs bam gyi shog bu brtsegs pa ltar don pa 264

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/dang / sa dmar ar kha la sogs 'bad med lta bur byung ba'i skyid chu pha ri rnams 'phrul zam khyad mtshar sngon med tshugs pa dang / skam g.yung la sogs nas g.yag gi glegs bu bzhi bsgrigs kyis bteg pa'i sgrom dang ko ba la sogs phur bu'i blor mi 'char ba'i bkod pa du mas drangs/ shing cha la sngar brtsegs bcu gsum zhes legs rgyas kyi cha tshad du 'jog kyang da lam ka spungs tshoms chen sogs gal che sar ka ba'i stod bab le dang pa tra/ brer pad spungs dang 'khyil pa shun bcas/ 'ben log ci par dang sna tshogs ri mo/gzhu bab gzugs mthongs sgo khyim phan tshun 'brug gyen langs sogs nam mkha' mdzod/ gdung stan rdo rje'i phreng ba/ glang sna chu srin ma/ gdung ma gru nar kyong dod dbus phyag na pad+mo'i snying po sogs gzungs sngags kyi lañja sha chen dang tshigs rgyan pa tra/ gdung khebs mi shigs pa rtse lnga pa'i ra ba/rin po che grol ba can nas mu tig dkar po'i phreng bar 'khu ba 'bur ma/ ge sar pad+ma'i 'dab ma/ pad khebs spos rgya ma/ chu 'dzin gsar pa'i rang gzugs sprin chung / mchod brtsegs 'bur kyong gnyis las snga ma/ babs brkyang ma'i gdong sna tshogs rdo rje babs les brgyan pa/ babs khebs pa tra me tog ma/ babs bskum ma'i gdong nor bu dbang gi rgyal po me ri ma/babs khebs sa gzhi mdzod kyi gtso bo 'dab ma brgya pa/ shing brtsegs la mi the ba lcam ske/ kha shing / byin rtse/ babs brkyang bskum bar gyi gab spang me tog lcam bkag la sprin pa sogs sngon chad phal cher ri mo kho na las mchod brtsegs bre 'ben tsam ma gtogs rkos ma byed srol mi 'dug kyang /da lam rnam pa de dang de dag thams cad 'bur rkos dang sbyar rkos sha stag gi 'phrul lhongs che ba sogs brtsegs bcu bdun nas bcu gsum gyi bar dong /265

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'byed tsam ma gtogs shing rtsi byings gser shog de la'ang rgya shog dang bod shog gnyis nas tshoms chen sogs gal che ba rnams bod shog kho na nyid shin tu phyug pas nyi mdangs kyang zil gyis gnon nus shing / ri mo'i rigs shes bya'i yul yangs por srid do cog smos su mi lang ba dag gis dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba/ spen bad kyi rgyan la gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan du grags pa/ rlung me chu sa ri rab ste brten pa'i rnam pa lnga / 'dod gzugs cig tu byas pa dang / lha mthong ba mi bskyed pa gzugs med dang / bar snang gi zla nyi gnyis te g.yo ba'i rnam pa bzhi/ kun khyab sgra gcan gyi ming can nam mkha' dang bcu ste nges don 'jig rten gyi khams dang / brtan pa lnga rang ming ltar dang / g.yo ba ri rab steng gi pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan te gzhan dkyil dang / ma'i dpral ba rlung sogs mngal skyes kyi lus dang sbyor ba sogs mdor na snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can gyis mtshon phyi nang dag pa mtha' dag dang sbyar rung ba/yi ge bcu phrag rim gyis 'grub pas g.yon skor du thig le/ tsheg drag a yiga.i yig ri/ u/ le/ mu/ k+ṣa/ hu rnams dgos par byas te dbyangs can ma ltar na i ya'o zhes pa'i i yig ya dang sogs kyis bsdu ba byas pas h+phu zhes 'grub pa sogs rgyas pa gzhan du bshad pa bzhin phan yon dang smṛdagos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i 'byon dmar gser zhun gyi r+yarnam bcu dbang ldan dpangs rgyug mtho bcu dang zheng mtho brgyad yod zung /bdag cag gi ston pa shākya seng ge mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te yul wa ra ḍā si drang srong ltung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su 'khor lnga sde bzang por bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhed pa'i tshe/ 'jig 266

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/rten gyi byed po tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan phul te gsol ba btab pa ltar bkra shis pa'i yan lag dang 'dren pa rang rgyal bse ru'i tshul/zhes chos bskul ba po dang zhu ba po mtshon byed bcas 'khor lo rtsibs stong lte bar ldan pa ri dwags bse ru kha sprod kyis bteg pa dpangs rgyug mtho bcu gnyis zheng mtho brgyad pa gnyis/ gzhan yang sa dgra sogs mi mthun mun pa za zhing srid zhi dge legs kyi snang ba khab len rdo dang lcags kyi ngang tshul ltar shugs kyis 'du ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung gi gzugs 'gros/ gser zangs kyi khyung sbrul gzugs bzung ba brgyad/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ chu srin/ 'brug g.yung drung / tshogs bdag sogs gzugs ngo bor sor bcu drug gi mtha' me long sor mo nyer gnyis kyi dpangs zheng bskor ba bcu phrag gsum dang nyag ma gsum rnams lhun po la nyi zla sogs gza' dang rgyu skar gyis ra ba lta bu mtshan mo yang nyin mo'i snang ba 'dzin pa/ zur rnams su gser sbyangs kyi sidha'am 'jigs rung gdong lnga'i dbang po ba lang tsam pa ngar mchong gi rnam pa/ kri ya sa mu rtso'i sa dpyad re gcig pa las/ gsum gyi lha rnams gnas pa'i phyir/ /rgya phubs 'ga' yang blta bya ste/ /ba ren dra'am ḍa bi ḍa'i/ /nye bar brtan pa ji bzhin bya/ /lnga yi cha'am drug gi cha/ /rgya phubs yang dag gnas par 'dod/ /'degs pa'i cha dang mnyam pa'i dpangs/ /ba ren ḍa gnas steng du 'o/ /rgya phubs dbus kyi lus la ni/ /ḍā bi ḍa ba dum bu gnyis/ /dum bu gcig pa'i rgya phubs ni/ /ba ran ḍa dang go ḍa'i lugs/ /rgyab kyi rtse mo yang dag bsdus/ /ngos rnams rnam rgyas mkhas pa yis/ /dbus su gzhung shing rnam bu snams/ /mthong na mjes par 'gyur bar bya/ /rnga zlum mtshungs pa dbus kyi steng / /ngos gnyis 267

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gzhung shing mtho ba ste/ /ḍā bi ḍa ba gzhung phyed kyis/ /bum pa seng ge rab mdzes 'dod/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i tshad rnams dang ldan pa byar med kyang / khungs der brten nas gru bzhi zur bcag rus sbal ma sogs sngon gtsug lag khang du gyo thog la sogs pa'i rgya phubs su grags pa dang / rje bla ma chen po'i chos srid gdugs dkar gyis dgung khebs pa nas gser zangs kyi nang du mar dar 'dug rung / de dag kun las 'gyogs zur khug gi chu srin rtser tog zung gi shang shang sogs khyad mtshan du ma dang bcas pa'i bre 'degs glang sna sum 'khor/ de steng bre spungs sum skor dang / glang sna lnga skor/ de steng glang sna bdun skor/ de steng phag sna brgyad skor/ de steng bra stegs bya 'dabs gdung ma/ shar nub tu bre spungs glang sna sum brtsegs steng phag sna re bcas bre spungs lnga re/ lho byang bre spungs gsum la glang sna sum brtsegs steng phag sna re bcas kyi lho byang dkyus rgyug mtho lnga bcu nga bdun dang mtshon bzhi/ shar nub tu rgyug mtho zhe drug mtshon bzhi/ ze tog nas gnam gdung bar gyi dpangs la rgyug mtho nyi shu rtsa bdun dang mtshon bzhi/ ze tog dang chu 'dzar gyi dpangs la mtho gang mtshon lnga skar do/ rtse rgyan dbus ma dril gzugs gardzir babs le pad bcas kyi dpangs la rgyug mtho bco lnga dang mtshon lnga/ de mtha' phan tshun lcags thag bzung byed kyi shang shang gnyis so sor dpangs rgyug mtho bzhi re/ mtha' phan tshun bum gzugs gardzi ra'i dpangs rgyug mtho bcu gcig dang mtshon do/ de 'og zur thung gi khugs rer chu srin re/ sgo bkag phan tshun nor 'bar pad bcas kyi dpangs la mtho lnga/rlung dril nyer bzhi dang bcas pa/ kri ya'i sa dpyad nyer brgyad pa las/tshod+ngha legs par grub pa'i gnas dang spos khang dang / /gtsug lag khang dang khang 268

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/bzang khang mig 'dun khang rnams/ /mnyam par bltas nas dam pa'i sgo yi rtser/ /rgyal mtshan rnams ni nges par rab tu gzug par bya/ /gser dang nor bu nyi ma'i shel dang dngul dang ni/ /'jim pa mchog dang shing las byas pa nyid kyang ste/ /legs par gnas pa drang zhing brtan pa rab 'bar ba/ /cha gsum mnyam pa legs par yang dag dgod par bya/ /’’zhes dang / ‘‘ye shes me long chen po rab 'bar shing / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid mdzes pa'i yu bar gnas/ /ri rab pad+ma'i gdan dang seng ge la/ /sogs pa'i rgyal mtshan chen po dga' ba che/ /a ga ma ga si yi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gzhan gyis mi thub bum pa mkha' lding chu srin sogs/ /nya dang rma bya ri dwags nor bu seng ges mtshan/ /zla ba'i thig le dam pa'i gzugs dang ldan pa nyid/ /’’ces dang / 'jam mgon btsong kha pa chen pos/ ‘‘drang zhing ldem pa'i rin chen yu ba ni/ /zla phyed rdo rje rin chen rtse mo can/ /dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa na/ /sil sil 'khrol ba'i dril chung sgra sgrog cing / /sum khugs 'khyog gi 'gying dang rab tu ldan/ /mdzes pa'i srog chags mtshan ma yod med kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / / ’zhes gsungs pas bshad khungs dang mthun pa kho bos tshogs mchod mchod par bzos shing deng sang 'phags pa rin po che'i dus tsam nas bkra shis dgu brtsegs su grags pa sogs mdzes gtsor bton gyis dar ba'i phyi dbyibs yongs grags la bsgyur bkod med pa'i rgyal mtshan sham bu sum brtsegs/ dra phyed pad+ma 'phul ma/ ze tog nor bu pa tra'i rnam pa can drug rtse rgyan nor bu bcas yod pa dpangs rgyugs mtho bcu gnyis mtshon do ba gnyis dang / rgyug mtho bcu gcig mtshon gsum pa gnyis/ legs sbyar la gardzir ste mdzod ldan du bshad 269

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa zur chag par gardzi rar grags pa srog shing gzungs 'bul sogs mchod rten dang mtshungs shing gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi gzungatā dmigs bsal du gzhug par gsungs pas rgyal mtshan gyi bye brag tu yang gtogs sam snyam pa khang bzang gi rtse mo rnam par mdzes byed kyi rgyan bye brag pa/ de la yang dril gzugs dang bum gzugs gnyis su yod pa'i snga ma ltar dpangs rgyug mtho bcu gnyis mtshon gsum yod pa gnyis dang / mtho bcu mtshon gang pa gnyis rnams kyi nang gi gzungs sogs gang ci rgyud sde'i dgongs pa 'khrul med rnam par dag pa'i lag len dang ldan cing / mtha' dag kyang 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs kyi zhun mas lan brgyar byugs pas rta ljang gzi byin kyang dgung du song ba/ ba dan dang rnga yab zung du 'jug pa bod snga rabs pa rnams kyis phyag len du bstar ba deng sang rnga thug tu 'bod pa rtse brgyad ma mnyen lcags las grub pa spubs bcas kyi dpangs la rgyug mtho lnga dang / zheng mtho gsum mtshon drug a lung brgyad re yod pa bzhi dang / rtse gsum ma mtho bzhi mtshon do/ zheng mtho do mtshon lnga skar gsum a lung bzhi re yod pa lnga/ mdor na rje bla ma mchog gi bka' las/ ‘‘mdzes sdug lha dbang khang bzang rjes 'gro zhing / /rngam brjid laṅka'i grong gi spun zlar byas/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'phel bas lcang lo can/ /bde skyid dga' ston spel phyir gru 'dzin dngos/ / ’(〈dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs 3༷7— 312bar)zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / pho brang gi rten gsum rnams ni rgyu dang bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa ni smos ci dgos/ lha khang khag gi mchod rdzas rnams kyang rgyu spus dag la lag len rnam par dag pa ngo mtshar can sha stag bskrun gnang mdzad pa'i dpe mtshon tsam du tshoms chen srid zhi phun tshogs kyi nub brgyud skya'i dkyus zheng 270

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/dang mtshungs pa'i gos yol bskrun gnang skor dkar chag thar gru las/ rje btsun brtan pa'i snyesprukhor lo bsam bzhin stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i tshul bzung ba rgya nag gong ma rgyal po hong de khang shi rgyal por tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs kyi nub brgyud skya'i dkyus zheng dang mtshungs pa'i gos yol srid pa gsum na zla bral zhig thags su gsar bskrun dgos tshul ras gzhir rang nyid kyi blo thog nas bkod pa bgyis pa'i dpe dang bcas gser yig pa ye shes dge slong la rgyu mtshan zhib par byas/ 'di kha nas mtsho smad rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dharma dang lha sa stag tshang nub pa bsam grub tshe brtan gnyis chu bya brdzangs par/ nam yang mi phyed mdza' bas thugs gcugs pa'i rnam dkar gyi las la bag chags bzang po sad pas dgyes bzhin du bkas 'ches/ snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po ma smad par bzhes nas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la 'jug pa'i lung bzang po phab pa ltar/ las su bya ba po rnams kyi dka' ba ring du dor te thags ra'i khang pa'ang gsar du rgyag dgos byung 'dug kyang brtson pa chen pos nye bar bsgrubs par bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs rgyal po sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul 'chang ba rje bla ma gang gi thugs rje'i 'jug pa yol med du shar ba'i snang bas mi mthun pa'i smag rum mtha' dag pha mthar bskrad de ma dpe ji lta ba bzhin thags ra dngos su zla ba'i phung po bse ru'i khongs gegs med du zin/ bya sag bla ma bstan pa gsal byed can che de gnyer gdan 'dren du bed bdar gnang ba lam du 'tshe ba dang bral te me byi son(〈dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs 312— 313)zhes 'khod pa 'di'i rgyu song rgyus khyad par 'phags pa'i skabs gsungs pa ltar na dngul srang chig khri drug stong brgya dang zhe dgu 'brur 271

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phab gshor khal nyis 'bum dgu khri drug brgya gnyis zin pa dang / lha khang khag la mchod rdzas bskrun gnang skor dkar chag thar gru las/ lha khang khag bcu gnyis la rang rang gi phyam gling dang 'tsham par thog yongs su khebs pa'i gnam rgyan/ gdung khebs/ ka 'phan/ phye 'phur/ rgyal mtshan/'phan chung sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa dang / tshoms chen du gnam rgyan/dra ba dra phyed/ phye 'phur/ 'phan/ ka 'thums dang bcas pa rnams sngon shar phyogs sam tong khun gyi rgyal khab chen pos grub pa'i dbang phyug we ru pa dang gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs skabs na bzar ched du btags par grags pa ding phon/ de'i rjes tsam dang dus mnyam du byung ba kha zi/ 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan se chen gnas gyis spyan drangs kye rdo rje la sogs pa gsang ba sngags kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhus pa'i dus bum gdan la sogs par mngags btags byas pa'i hor gos dngom che ba skye bo phal mo che'i mig lam du yang ma gyur pa'i za 'og du ma las bskrun pa gzims chung 'gangs chen gyi sgo 'bor 'theg thag dar rnying sna lnga lhas ma dang lcags skor gyi gdan ma'ang kha thi rnying mas mtshon pa sogs mdor na phyi'i brtsig pa/ nang gi shing cha/ tshon rtsi/ ldebs ris/ yol ba chu khebs/ 'phan bla bre/ lda ldi/ gnam rgyan/ phye phur/ nang yol la sogs dang / rtse mor btso sbyangs gser gyi rgya phubs sogs kyis nye bar mdzes pa'i khang bzang rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i pho brang yid dga' chos 'dzin nas spos ldan gyi grong sa la 'phos pa 'di lta sngon chad dzasbu'i gling khongs 'dir dngos su grub pa lta zhogalo rgyus kyi gtam tsam yang rna ba'i yol gor ma lhungs shing / phyin chad mi 'byung bar nges par rtogs pas na khyad par du 'phags pa dang / de'i nang 272

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/du bzhugs pa/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs gsung sku'i rten rnams kyang / bongs dang kha grangs snying la 'dod cing rgyu 'gros la ha cang sred pa'i phyin ci log lta bu ma yin par gser dngul ljang brdungs la sogs pa g.yo zol med pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa las grub pa dang / de dag kyang rang rang mos blo tsam gyis rjes su 'brangs nas bzhengs pa dang rig bzo dang skye bo rmongs pa dag gi mig lam du mdzes so zhes pa'i na yam tshig gi rjes su ma 'brangs par/ gong bzhengs thams cad dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba nyag gcig dang cha tshad kyang mdo rgyud bstan bcos la sogs tshad ldan gyi gzhung las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin cha tshad kyi lam du legs par bcur te skyon spangs yon tan dang ldan par bzhengs pa/((dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs 313— 314)zhes gsungs pa ni don la gnas pa pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa ngo mtshar khyad chos 'bum dang ldan pa 'di 'dra ba 'dzam bu'i gling chen 'dir pho brang 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan ni ri bong rwa yi spun zlar gyur pa mngon sum tshad mas grub par rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang smra ma dgos so/ /drug ni rten gyi ngo bos khrad par 'phags pa/ de yang gser gdung khang gi rten gtso/ rin po che dang po las grub pa'i gser gdung rin po che byang chub chen po'i mchod rten dpe zla thams cad dang bral ba 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sa 'dzin nas tog gi bar rgyug mtho bcu phrag mtshams kyi bdag nyid can thog tshad lnga pa bzang po'i dris phyogs kun 'geng pa dpal gyi dum bu dkar po'i srog gi shing dang ldan pa lha mi'i rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyi spros pa mtha' yas pas mig rgyas par byed pa/ de'i 'khor ram phan tshun du rin po 273

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/che gnyis pa'am dngul dkar las grub pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad thog tshad gsum pa rgyug mtho nyer lnga'i bdag nyid gtso phal ma gtogs rin po che'i rgyan gser gdung dang 'dra ba dang / gzhan yang 'khrungs rabs lha khang sogs lha khang byings rnams kyi rten gtso gang yin pa dang / de dag gi sku rgyu gang las grub pa la sogs zhib cha khyad par 'phags pa bdun pa'i skabs 'phros pa dag gis rtogs par nus so/ /bdun ni gang la bzhengs pa'i rgyu yis khrad par 'phags pa/ de yang rten mchog bzhengs pa'i rgyu khyad du 'phags pa ni slob dpon dpa' bos/‘‘pad+ma'i 'dab mar chu bzhin du/ /gser gyi yan lag la mi chags/ /tshe yang ring du 'phel bar 'gyur/ / zhes dngos gyur sbyar gsum gyi dug rigs mtha' dag gi nus pa lus la mi 'dzin par 'dzoms pa dang / dus min gyi 'chi ba bzlog cing tshe ring du 'phel ba la sogs pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa su war+ṇa ste/ 'di la mtsho chen po ma dros pa'i 'gram shing 'dzam bu tri shar 'bras bu dmar po rdza ma tsam 'byung ba mtshor lhungs pa klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis nyar sprul te 'bras bu myong ba'i lhag rnams ma dros pa'i chu'i nus pas gser du gyur pa 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser/ dus gsum du mdog mi 'dra ba so sor ston cing yon tan mtha' yas pa laṅka'i gser/ shar phyogs tong khun gyi yul du gnyis skyes me zan gyi brun las byung ba gser dmar/ gzhan yang rgya mtsho bye gser dang / stod gser/ khams gser/ rdo bzhu ba las byung ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba las / srang re tsam yang nor gyi snying por bzung ste gces spras gnangs chen du rlom na/ skye bo phal che bas sngon chad mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du lta zhog snying stobs dang 'byor pas bskrun par dka' ba gser gdung 274

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/rin po che 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ljang brdungs thog tshad lnga pa dpe zla thams cad dang bral zhing nyi ma brgya'i snang ba gcig car du 'gog pa gtso bo gang 'di'i sku rgyur/ rje bla ma mchog ma hā tsi na'i yul du ngos phebs skabs dad pa dang gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis phul ba'i dbus gser mdong brgya dang gsum/ tha sbag sum cu so gcig malcol sum cu so bdun/ gser bre chen mang ba/ dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis yer khin sogs blangs pa'i nom phud dang khral du phul ba'i gser lhag sa lug tshun dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi las sgo/ khrims shugs yong 'bab rnams dang / 'bul bar byung ba sogs kyi thig hrug bcas gser rgya thur gyi srang 'bum phrag gcig dang chig khri dgu stong gya gnyis zho gsum skar bdun/ zla ba dang phra gdan rgyur dngul spur ma srang go brgyad zho gang / gdugs nang dang sgrog gzer la mnyen zangs mkhar rgya'i khal drug nyag gang spor gang / rag khal gsum nyag phyed gsum rnams las grub pa ste mchod sdong chen po 'dis ni sngon chad gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i phreng bas bskor ba'i rgyal khams 'dir zangs la tsha gser gsol ba'i gser gdung dang / dngul las grub pa la'ang 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag sogs su rlom pa rnams ming tsam du 'gyur ram snyam mo zhes dkar chag nang gsungs pa ltar lags shing / gser gdung gi gron dngul skor dkar chag thar gru las/phra rgyan nor rigs 'gangs che ba rnams la ri gong sgra ji bzhin par phab na tshad las 'das kyang / rmongs btul rnams kyi snang ngo dang bstun lha sa ba'i gnas tshad kyis lam tshod byas pa ltar na dngul srang bzhi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya nga dgu zho dgu dang / sku rgyan la srang sum khri lnga stong chig brgya zhe bzhi zho lnga ste 275

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phra rgyan rang la srang brgyad khri chig brgya zho bzhi/ sku rgyu'i gser sogs dngul du phab srang dgu 'bum lnga khri nyis stong bdun brgya re brgyad zho do skar lnga/nang bzhugs byin rten sogs gong gcod mi 'os pa phud/ de phyin na bza' sogs dang gnod sbyin bang mdzod kyi dngos po bcas zhib cha le'u brgyad par gsal ba ltar gyi ri gong khyon dngul srang brgyad stong dgu brgya nga lnga zho bzhi skar phyed bzhi ste gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi sku rgyu phra rgyan nang bzhugs sogs rin thang du 'bebs 'os khyon gcig tu dril bar dngul srang sa ya gcig dang bzhi khri chig stong brgyad brgya nyer brgyad skar phyed dgu 'brur bkug gshor khal bye ba gcig dang sa ya brgyad bdun 'bum lnga khri nyis stong dgu brgya lnga bre bcu phul phyed bzhi/((dkar ga thar spru〉shog grangs 448)zhes 'khod pa ltar dang / gser gdung khang gi mchod rdzas kyang lha klu mi la sogs pa'i yul gling chen po rnams nas nye bar 'ongs pa'i rin po che la sogs pa'i rin thang bral ba 'ba' zhig sgrub par mdzad cing / gser gdung khang nang bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung brgyad po'i sku rgyu/ phra rgyan/ nang bzhugs dang bcas pa'i rin gong khyon srang lnga khri bdun stong drug brgya go bzhi zho dgu skar dgu lnga cha gnyis/ 'brur bkug khal sa ya gcig sum khri brgyad stong lnga brgya dgu bre bcu drug phul do lhag bcas so/ /'khrungs rabs lha khang gi rten gtso gser ljang brdungs kyi bdag cag gi ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang / rigs kun khyab bdag rje bla ma mchog gi snang brnyan dngul dkar las grub pa gser zangs kyi khri rgyab can dang / bde gshegs brgyad 'khrungs rabs bcas pa'i rgyur gser spur ma dbus zho chig khri sum stong bzhi brgya so gnyis se ba lnga/ gser btso ma srang 276

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/brgya dang gya gsum zho drug dngul spus legs srang stong dang nyis brgya zhe drug zho lnga/ mnyen zangs mkhar rgya'i 'degs khal drug brgya gya gnyis nyag drug spor gsum bzhi cha gcig lugs ma 'degs khal lnga bcu nga bdun nyag bcu dgu spor gsum/ 'jol khal bzhi nyag drug spor gang bcas kyi gser gsol rgyur gser btso ma srang brgya dang go lnga zho drug dngul chu mkhar 'degs khal nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang nyag brgyad rnams kyi rgyu 'gro gang ci ri gong dngul du phab par thur srang nyis khri bzhi brgya zhe brgyad zho do skar bzhi/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra rgyan gyis sba ba bcas 'khrungs rabs lha khang gi 'gro song khyon bsdoms dngul srang nyis khri dgu stong sum brgya don bzhi zho brgyad zin pa 'brur bkug khal lnga 'bum nyis khri brgyad stong bdun brgya zhe drug bre bzhi phul gsum lnga cha gnyis thob pa lags so/ /rig 'dzin lha khang gi gtso bo slob dpon chen po za hor ma'i sku brnyan dngul dkar ljang brdungs gser zangs kyi khri rgyab yol dang / 'khor 'phags yul gyi rig 'dzin brgyad/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ gzungs ma gnyis bcas pa'i sku rgyur dngul srang dgu brgya bdun cu zho gsum/ mnyen zangs mkhar rgya'i khal drug brgya gya brgyad nyag bcu gnyis spor phyed gsum bcu cha phyed gnyis/ lugs ma khal re gnyis nyag lnga/ 'jol nyag bzhi spor do bcas kyi gser gsol rgyur gser btso ma thur srang sum brgya dang nyer dgu zho drug skar phyed gsum/ dngul chu mkhar 'degs khal sum cu nyag gsum spor do lnga cha gnyis rnams kyi rin gong dngul srang lnga stong brgyad cu gya brgyad zho drug skar phyed do/ /phra rgyan rnams kyang rin po che rin thang bral ba 'ba' zhig las grub pa 277

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bcas rig 'dzin lha khang gi sku rgyu sngar smos ltar gyi thog phra rgyan le tshan la srang nyis stong drug brgya dgu bcu zho dgu/ na bza' dang sku rgyan la srang gya drug zho lnga/ nang bzhugs skor ri gong du 'bebs 'os bsdoms par srang nyis stong sum brgya bdun zho bzhi/ mchod chas rnying pa'i ri gong srang bzhi brgya bdun cu zho bzhi/ khyon dngul srang khri tsho gcig dang drug brgya zhe gsum zho brgyad skar phyed do 'brur phab khal chig 'bum dgu khri chig stong lnga brgya gya brgyad bre bcu gsum phul gang /lam rim lha khang gi rten gtso 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i sku dngul ljang brdungs dang gser zangs kyi khri rgyab lcog tse/ g.yas su rgya chen spyod pa dang g.yon du zab lam lta ba'i bla brgyud rnams gtsor ston drug cu re brgyad/bstan srung gnyis bcas pa'i sku rgyur dngul spus legs srang brgyad brgya so drug zho gsum skar brgyad/ mnyen zangs mkhar rgya'i khal bzhi brgya bcu drug nyag bcu gcig spor gyi bcu cha gcig lugs ma khal sum cu so drug nyag brgyad spor phyed bzhi/ 'jol khal gsum nyag bdun spor phyed gsum rnams kyi gser gsol la gser btso ma srang brgya dang go brgyad zho dgu/ dngul chu mkhar 'degs khal nyi shu nyag dgu spor phyed do bcu gnyis cha gcig rnams kyi ri gong dngul srang nyis stong lnga brgya zhe gsum zho drug skar bdun/ 'od skor rgyab yol phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rnams kyi phra rgyan yang rin chen 'ba' zhig 'bul gnang bcas kyi 'gro song khyon dngul srang brgyad stong sum brgya brgyad cu gya gsum zho do skar phyed bzhi song ba 'brur phab khal chig 'bum lnga khri brgyad brgya dgu bcu go brgyad bre bzhi phul phyed bzhi dang bcu cha gcig thob/sman bla khang du/ gser zangs las sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i 278

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gzhal med khang rten dang brten par bcas pa dang / sman 'dam las grub pa'i sman bla dang gso rig gnyis kyiwā brgyud sku brnyan che chung khyon sum brgya bcu bcas pa'i sku rgyur gser btso ma thur srang zhe gcig zho drug skar phyed gsum/ dngul chu mkhar rgya'i khal bzhi nyag bzhi spor do/ mnyen zangs khal so gcig nyag brgyad/ lugs ma khal zhe drug nyag do spor do rnams kyi bla brgyud khag gnyis po'i rgyu song zur du 'khod cingaka pho brang rgyu 'gro ri gong dngul du phab par thur srang bzhi brgya go bdun zho dgu skar phyed bzhi cha gcig dang / mchod rdzas dang / phra rgyan skor bcas par khyon ri gong khyon bsdoms dngul srang stongadang re gcig zho bdun skar lnga ste khyon be+eḍūr+ya gzhal med khang gi bla brgyud sman 'dam mi the ba'i sku rgyu mchod rdzas bsdoms par dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya nga dgu zho drug skar phyed drug bzhi cha gcig 'brur phab khal nyis khri brgyad stong don gsum bre bcu drug phul bzhi lnga cha gcigadus 'khor lha khang du dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs bde chen gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa bdun brgya so bzhi dang bcas gser zangs las bskrun pa dang / sman 'dam las dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'jam dbyangs bla brgyud kyi sku brnyan khyon brgya dang re gnyis rnams kyi sku rgyur gser btso ma thur srang brgya dang nyer bzhi zho brgyad skar phyed brgyad/dngul chu mkhar 'degs khal bcu gnyis nyag bcu gsum spor do/ mnyen zangs khal brgya dang so bzhi nyag brgyad/ lugs ma khal go drug nyag drug spor do/ rin po che'i rigs kyi phra rgyan dang mchod rdzas bcas pa'i rgyu song skor dkar chag thar gru las dus 'khor khang gi sman 'dam las grub pa'i sku brnyan dang rten rnying phud/ de phyin sku rgyu/ phra rgyan/ mchod chas/ dngul 279

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bum bcas khyon dngul srang drug stong drug brgya go bzhi zho lnga skar do bzhi cha gcig 'brur bkug khal chig 'bum nyis khri lnga brgya gcig bre brgyad phul phyed bcu cha gcigasman sku rnams kyi grang gser sogs kyi rgyu song dngul gang du phab par srang bzhi brgya go lnga zho bdun skar brgyad/ gzungs par gyi shog bu/ gser/mtshal/ snag tsha/ sman sna sogs khyon gyi ri gong dngul srang chig stong nyis brgya go gsum zho bdun skar bdun gong du rim par gsal ba'i mchod chas 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang po'i phyogs tung khun gyi yul gru chen po nas ched du mngags te 'ongs pa'i rig gnas dang po'i tshul la blo mig kun gsal gyi khyon ltar yangs pas gtsos/ rna pa la/ lho gnyal lo ro'i phyogs kyi rgyu 'gro ri gong dngul srang chig khri sum stong nyer gcig zho bzhi skar dgu/kun bzang mchod sprin khang gi rgya phubs kyi rgyur mnyen zangs mkhar rgya'i khal drug brgya bcu nyag bco lnga spor gang / bsha' dkar khal bcu gcig nyag bcu bdun spor gang sum cha gcig rgya tsha khal bcu gcig nyag bcu bdun spor gang sum cha gcig srin bal khal gnyis nyag bcu dgu spor gang sum cha gcig li ting kha zheng gzhung tshad la mtshon bzhi skar phyed do yod pa gra mtshungs bzhi brgya/ khro dkar gyi mchod kong gzhong gzugs gru bzhi dkyus rgyug mtho gsum re yod pa bcu gsum/ mtho do sor drug yod pa gnyis/mtho do dang sor gsum yod pa gnyis/ mtho do yod pa gcig rnams kyi rgyu 'gro srang chig stong re gsum zho bzhi skar gang ste sman sku man le tshan bzhi gcig tu dril bar srang chig khri lnga stong brgyad brgya don bzhi zho phyed lnga 'brur phab gshor khal nyis 'bum brgyad khri lnga stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu bre do thob 280

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/pa'i skor dkar chag thar gru'i shog ngos 485—486bar gsal por 'god gnang mdzad 'dugagazhan yang li ma lha khang dang / bla ma lha khang gnyis kyi rten rnying phyogs bsgrigs sku brnyan rnams kyi rin thang gzhal bar dka' ba bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das shing / skabs der mchod rdzas gsar bskrun gnang bar dngul srang lnga stong sum brgya dang dgu song ba 'brur phab gshor khal dgu khri drug stong bzhi brgya drug cu re gnyis zin/chu khyi(1682)lo nas lcags rta(1690)phan gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i lha khang skor dang / gos sku gsar bzhengs skor (dkar chag thar gru〉las/ chu khyi nas lcags rta phan gsar bzhengs kyi gras/ 'bras spungs kun dga' ra ba/ lha sa bar khang dang / bar skor/ bsam yas/ rwa sgreng /ra mo che/ phun tshogs gling sogs su bzhugs pa'i sku thugs kyi rten rnams rnam thar du gsal ba ltar las 'dir ma bkod/ de 'phro nas mchod sdong chen po'i rten gras su yod pa/ gos sku khang du snying rje pad dkar lugs ltar na/ bskal pa 'dzin par byang chub tu thugs bskyed skabs kyi yab 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang / rgyal po bka' 'bum las bskal pa 'dzin par thugs bskyed tshogs bsag sngon du mdzad de 'od zer kun 'phags rgyal por sangs rgyas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'od mdzad tog da lta bde ba can zhing du rgyal sras kyi tshul mdzad pa'i ston pa bcas yang srid du mar yab sras sogs 'bras med du smon lam gyis zin pa'i 'od dpag med/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ rje bla ma/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma/ hwa 281

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/shang / rgyal chen bzhi/ sbyin bdag bstan srung rdo rje grags ldan bcas pa'i gos sku dpangs sor mo nyis stong lnga brgya go brgyad gsar bzhengs kyi rgyur/ding phon gzhi dmar leb rgan gcig hor gos gzhi skyes chon khra leb rgan bzhi/ rgya bya ma kha bcu gnyis yug gzhi skyer gsar ma leb gnyis/ nya jus kha nyi shu rtsa dgu rta jus kha bcu drug bzhi dmar kha dgu rgya ser gyi gos kha bzhi brgya nyi shu tham pa/ kha thi thon thi rgya yig ma sogs gos rnying legs pa kha stong dang bdun brgya drug cu re dgu gos phrug sngon po kha brgya dang sum cu so bzhi/ gser ma kha stong dang nyis brgya sum cu so drug gan gos tshos gcig ma kha lnga stong sum brgya dgu bcu tham pa/ hor gos gzhi dmar gser ma'i snam pa phyed brgyad/ jus dmar gyi yol ba snam pa so bzhi/bla bres mthongs se'u ma gcig zhal khebs sman tse rnying ma kha bzhi stong drug cu re brgyad/ lcags chab sum cu tham pa/ thes ma 'dom brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug rgyab sha lho ras yug bzhi brgya drug cu re drug skud rgyu sogs gos tshos kha sna tshogs kha brgya dang sum cu tham pa/ 'jug snod sgam rtsi ma lcags shan cha 'grig ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma dang brtsan gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can/ lha mgon/ 'jam mgon bla ma btsong kha pa/ rje bla ma/ tā ro mkha' spyod/ rgyal ba rigs bzhi/ sman bla mched brgyad/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs/ sbyin bdag 'dod khams dbang phyug ma bcas pa'i gos sku dpangs sor stong dang nyis brgya dgu bcu go dgu gsar bzhengs kyi sku rgyur/ ding phon gzhi dmar spus legs leb rgan gcig bum stan ma gsum/ hor jus kha drug cu re brgyad/ hor gos tshon khra kha nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gan gos tshos kha sna tshogs kha lnga brgya dang bcu/282

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/kha thi rnying ma tshos kha mi gcig pa kha brgya dang drug cu re gnyis/ thon thi kha brgya tham pa/ gos phrug kha sum cu so dgu/ gser yig ma kha brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ bzang gos sna tshogs kha nyis stong lnga brgya zhe bdun/ rgya ser gyi gos kha nyis brgya dang drug zhal khebs la sman rnying kha stong dang bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa drug skud rgyu gos tshos kha sna tshogs kha nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe lnga/rgyab sha lho ras yug nyis brgya drug cu re drug thes ma 'dom dgu bcu go lnga/sag ri bubs gsum/ so hrug bubs gnyis/ lcags chab nyi shu/ ljang ser gyi a lung brgyad cu gya lnga/ span bubs nyi shu tham pa rnams dang / do dam bzo bo bcas pa'i phogs/ ston mo/ yon/ zur gsos bcas gos sku gnyis khyon dril dngul srang chig khri sum stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis zho drug skar bdun/sku thang skor la/ gos ta hung thog grang gser gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga/'od dpag med/ mar me mdzad/ byams pa/ shāka thub/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs rnams stong sku re/ sor 'brang rnam rgyal ma gnyis stong thang gnyis re/ sman bla stong thang brgyad bcas khyon gser thang so brgyad dang / lnga pa chen po bar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga sogs tshon thang zhe brgyad gsar bzhengs gnang ba gong gsal gos sku gnyis dang gser thang /tshon thang bcas pa'i rgyu song le tshan gcig tu bsgril bar dngul srang chig khri dgu stong drug brgya drug cu zho gang skar gang skar drug cha phyed gsum song ba 'brur phab gshor khal sum 'bum lnga khri sum stong brgyad brgya gya gnyis bre gang phul phyed bcu cha gcigagasung rten gyi skor la tshal pa bka' 'gyur pod brgya dang gcig yod par 283

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ma phyi mdzad de gan shog thog bka' 'gyur gser bris ma dang / rgyal rtse them spangs ma'i bka' 'gyur mdo sgyu sems gsum bsnan pa pod brgya dang bcu bzhi thing shog steng gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur dang / gzhan yang dngul dang / zangs dang / lcags bzhu btul mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur sogs bka' dang bstan bcos gsar bskrun mdzad pa rnams 'gro song gcig tu bsgril bar dngul srang lnga khri bdun stong bzhi brgya gya dgu zho brgyad skar phyed bcu dang bco brgyad cha gcig 'brur phab khal sa ya gcig dang sum khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya bco brgyad bre do phul do lnga cha gnyis/ de ltar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol bskyed rim la 'jug pa'i sgo zab mo dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams su rten dang brten pa zhes snga ma gzhal yas khang la sogs pa dang /phyi ma nang gi lha tshogs rnams su bzhed pa las/ brten pa nang gi skor rnams kyi rgyu 'gro ri gong khyen gcig tu dril bar dngul srang sa ya gcig nyis 'bum lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya sum cu so gsum zho lnga skar bdun bzhi cha gcig 'brur phab gshor khal bye ba gnyis sa ya gnyis 'bum tsho lnga dgu khri dgu stong drug brgya bzhi dang bre lnga phul phyed lnga song((dkar ga thar spru〉zhog grangs 566)zhes 'khod pa ltar lags shing / rten phyi'i gtsug lag khang gi rgyu song khyon bsdoms dngul srang sum 'bum chig stong sum brgya dang gsum zho bdun skar gsum lnga cha gnyis shog grangs 513par gsal ba skabs de'i dngul skar phyed drug rer gshor khal re rtsis gzhi gnang 'dug pa ltar 'brur phab gshor khal sa ya lnga bzhi 'bum nyis khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya gnyis thob/gong gsal rten skor yongs su bsgril bar dngul srang sum 'bum bdun khri chig brgya go gcig skar gyi bzhi cha gcig thang rgan skar 'brur phab gshor 284

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/khal sa ya drug 'bum drug khri sum stong bzhi brgya so brgyad phul gang dang lnga cha gcig rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling rdor smin bkras chos sogs cho ga dang / gdan sa chen po se 'bras dge gsum gyi bden tshig shis pa brjod pas dbus rab gnas skor gyi yon bsnyen bkur rab ston sogs bsdoms par dngul srang drug khri dgu stong brgya dang bcu gcig zho dgu skar phyed 'brur phab khal sa ya gcig nyis 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong bcu bzhi bre lnga phul phyed bzhi cha gcig gong du brjod pa'i rten phyi'i gtsug lag khang gi skor dang brten pa nang gi chos longs sprul lam sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab gnas skor rnams khyon gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rin thang gi yul las 'das pa ji snyed kyang bsdom 'os gang yin blo rmongs skye bo'i da lta'i thang ltar dngul du phab par srang sa ya gcig 'bum tsho drug dgu khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya so drug zho bzhi skar brgyad 'brur phab khal bye ba gsum lnga 'bum bdun stong nga drug bre bcu gnyis phul phyed drug lnga cha phyed gnyis te tshogs mchod chen mo mi the ba'i 'di ga yang sngon chad gangs can gling dgu'i rgyal khams 'dir mi thog gcig tu gtong ba'i dngos po 'di tsam byung ba rgyal rabs yig tshang gang la'ang ma gsal zhing sgra 'dzin gyi yul du ma gyur pa ste snga na med pa'i mchod sdong chen po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos sa lam gyi 'gros dang mthun pa bcu dang gsum gyis khyad du 'phags pa'i (dkar chag thar gling rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i gru rdzings byin rlabs kyi bang mdzod〉ces pa las rgyus khyad par 'phags pa'i sarga ste bdun pa'o/ /zhes dkar chag thar gru'i shog grangs 518bar gsal ba ltar lags so/ /brgyad ni gzungs kyi khyad par 'phags pa/ de yang gser gdung 285

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chen mo'i gzungs zhugs su sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa sku gsung thugs dang / skyes chen dam pa bgrangs kyi mi langs pa'i gdung rten gyi cha shas dang / ring bsrel la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten khyad par 'phags pa du ma zhugs pa dang / lhag par gser gdung chen mo'i nang srid na rnyed par dka' ba'i ring bsrel bzhi ste/ sna dkar rtse nas brgyud pa'i 'phel gdung yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen gyi phyag g.yas kyi mtheb tshigs steng ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gdung skal la o rgyan du spyan drangs/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la phul ba slob dpon bod du phebs dus 'di dang ma bral bar phebs te gangs gter sgor gter du bzhugs/ de grub chen o rgyan pas yul so sor spyod pa la gshegs dus gter nas spyan drangs te 'phags pa rin po cher phul/ des gangs can kun dga' dpal la gnang / des 'brog khri dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan la phul ba rim par son pa'i sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i phan bde'i 'byung gnas chen po/ rtse la sgang brgyud nas byung ba'i 'phel gdung 'di nyid/ ji skad du/ thub dbang chos rje'i sku gdung rin po che/ /'bad pa med par mchod pa'i rten du byon/ /zhes 'o skol gyi ston pa'i ring bsrel nyer gnyis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi phyag na yod pa ma ga dha'i rgyal por byung / de nas ti ra hu dang dza ye pur gyi rgyal po gnyis kyis ma ga dha bcom skabs dza ye pur gyi rgyal por byung ba de'i brgyud rgyal po burtse se na la/rje grub chen gyis gser dngul gos dar gyi skyes bzang po dang bcas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung zhig dgos gsungs pa'i lan du/ burtse nang na bzhugs pa'i dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta dpal o rgyan gla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la zhes 286

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/sogs kyi zhu yig dang bcas ring bsrel gyi mchog bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang / de'i na bzar ka ci gur gum tshos kyis bsgyur ba yug dang pa co ba ra yug rnams bsrings pa phyis rtse la sgang du bzhugs/ de nas pho brang chen po 'dir phebs pa'i byin rlabs kyi phung po chen po/ 'byung khungs kyi dbang las spos khang tshogs pa'i ring bsrel du grags pa sngon lo chen be+e ro tsa nas spyan drangs pa phyis 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i phyag tu byon/ des nye gnas stag lung thang pa la gnang / des stag lung gi thub chen thugs kar bzhugs pa slar mes tshig pa'i rkyen gyis stag lung nas sprul sku ber nag brgyud tshogs par byung ba pho brang chen po 'dir son pa'i mthong thos dran pas don kun 'grub pa/ drung chen smon lam pa brgyud rim par son pa'i 'phel gdung 'di nyid mgon po gser gling pa'i nang rten du ma skyes dgra'i rten skal gyi nang tshan de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung brgya lnga bcu tsam bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung zhig yod pa jo bo chen po la stsal te jo bo'i rten gtso dngul gdugs can zhes grags pa rgyal ba 'brom la gnang ba'i rwa greng du bzhugs skabs dus bde dog la brten stag lung gling gseb tu phebs pa gnas pos de nang nas ring bsrel kha shas spyan drangs te chos rje byang chub rgya mtsho'i gcung la phul/des kun spangs thang 'brog pa la gnang / deng drung chen smon lam pa la byung ba nas 'dir phebs pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen po/ gzhan yang bzhugs sa'i dbab gis lha pa'i ring bsrel du grags pa 'di nyid mkhan bosnyi satwa'i bka' bzhin rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mdun mchod rten dha ru rtse do'i nang na ma skyes dgra'i gdung skal ring bsrel maṅga dha'i bre'i khal gcig bzhugs pa nas bod kyi rta rngog chags sogs dang rgyal po —khri srong ldewātsan gyi sprul pa'i dmag 287

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bye ba bzhi bcu chu bo gaṅgā brgal nas ma ga dhar btang ste ring bsrel bre drug spyan drangs pa'i phyir lam gaṅgā'i 'gram lcags kyi ka ba btsugs nas 'di tshun chad bod kyi sa bcad yin zhes grags pa'i ring bsrel byings bsam yas mchod rten lnga dang dkar po'i tog rnams su bzhugs pa'i ya gyal chos rgyal gyi sras mu ni btsan pos lha ri brag la gter du sbas pa gu ru jo rtses spyan drangs lha par byung ba rim par son pa'i phun tshogs dngos kun 'bad med 'du ba'i byin rlabs kyi phung po chen po gter 'don pa po'i mtshan las chos dbang gis 'phel gdung zhes pa/ gter byang las/ bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyisaḥ/ rgya gar yul du lan bdun phyinaḥ/ lan drug chos bslabs lan gcig niḥ/ zhus dag nan tan dag par byasaḥ/ bka' rgya can rnams gter du sbasaḥ/ zhes pa nas/ rdo sgrom nang na bse sgrom yodaḥ/ de nang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdungaḥ/ 'od srung gdung bcas rten gyi mchogaḥ dha ces bshad pa bzhin gtsang rong gi brag lhang lhang mo nas gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis shing dzasbu tri sha'i tshi gu'i nang zangs ma'i ga'u nas rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i gdung lnga dang / 'od srungs kyi gdung bdun spyan drangs pa'i ya gyal bstan pa'i bdag po'i ring bsrel pho brang chen po 'dir phebs pa 'dod don 'grub pa'i bsam 'phel dbang rgyal/ gzhan yang sne'u sdong rtse/ dga' ldan ma mo/rong byams chen/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal po rnams nas byung ba'i 'phel gdung / mkhas grub khyung pos gdan drangs pa'i 'phel gdung sogs de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdung sha ri ram 'khrul med khungs ldan bla na med pa du mas til gyi gang bu bzhin du byur bur gtams pa'i bstan 'gro 'i mchod sdongawen po de yang gab 288

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/par 'bru dgu ma zhu ba dgos zhes pa brag ral bar shing gla ba 'dzugs pa sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyi bkod pa thams cad la chad lhag med par bgyis pa'i blo'i ra ba las 'das pa'i 'dzam gling sogs 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas skabs gru 'dzin gzhal med khang 'dis dbus gangs can gyi ljongs su srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang mthar thug 'gro rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chen thob pa sogs mdor na chos nor 'dod thar gyi don mtha' dag lhun gyis 'grub pa la gces pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa mdo rgyud sngags gsar rnying gtsug lag dang bcas pa nas gsungs pa lus pa med cing de dag rnams kyi dgongs pa'i phyag len rnam par dag pa'i ring bsrel rnam bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i gzungs sam nang bzhugs kyis byur bur gtams pa ste snga na med pa'i mchod sdong chen po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par grub pa lags so/ /dgu ni rab tu gnas pas khrad par 'phags pa/ de yang spyir rab tu gnas pa'i ngo bo ni dam tshig sems dpa'i rten de la sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i byin rlabs bsdus te ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs su gsol ba'i dge shis kyi cho ga yan lag rdzogs pa'i khyad par can du gyur pa ste/ lnga pa chen po'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu gser gdung chen mo'i nang zhal lho nub phyogs su gtad de bzhugs su gsol ba'i nyin te shing phag(1695)lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin rin chog bsdus pa'i sgo nas rab gnas mdzad pa dang / de nas zla de'i tshes nyi shu nyin dga' ldan khri rin po che co ne tshul khrims dar rgyas sogs nas rab tu gnas pa'i skor dus khyad par can gyi skabs su gsungs pa ltar dang / de nasarab gnas shin tu rgyas pa'i cho ga 289

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsnyen grub la sogs pa sta gon gyi rim pa legs par grub pa'i rjes bod zla dgu pa'i tshes bzhi nyin o rgyan smin grol gling gi rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa dang / lo chen dha rma shrī la sogs pas rab gnas rgyas pa gnang ba/ tshes bcu gsum nyin rab ston rgyas par gnang ba'i skor dkar chag thar gru las/gung yol bum pa'i taṅkal du babs dus yon skor kho bos tshogs su phyin zhing gter chen nyid kyis tshan grangs gnang zhing / smin gling grwa tshang gi'ang de mtshungs bstar/ gzhan yang ma sgrig lhun grub kyi rten 'brel lta bur chab mdo ba'i gser gos dar rta ja sogs 'bul ba dang / nged du ster cha bsdoms brgya 'bul gyis dbus mchod sdong chen po'i legs bya'i bdog pa bstar mi sogs sprul sku dang mkhan po ge re lha pa sogs sde dpon gyis dbus bod kyi phyi mgron mang ba grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i sne mo ba/ drung 'khor ser skya dang bcas pa'i mi tshogs shin tu che ba'i dga' ston thog gter chen nyid kyis dpal gyi mgur las gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bus yon bsgo'i tshig dang de las brtsams pa'i yab rje kun mkhyen bla ma nyid lung du ma nas bstan tshul la sogs pa dang / kho bo cag kyang bong ba gser du gzigs pa'i lung 'dren la sogs pa'i yas gtam gyi gsung bshad/ mdo sde rgyan las/ /ngag tshig shin tu rigs pa dang / /bstan dang rnam 'byed the tshom gcod/ /lan mang byed dang ldan pa ni/ /'go smos rnams spros go rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ston pa 'di/ /'khor gsum gyis ni dag pa ste/ /'di ni nyes pa brgyad dag dang / /bral ba nyid du shes par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar chos sbyin tshig snyan cing don bzang ba lung khungs dang ldan cing rig pa dri ma med pa'i skya bar nas ston pas gang nas gsungs kyang 'brel ba/ ji tsam 290

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gsungs kyang ran pa/ ji ltar gsungs kyang 'thad pa ste yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ gsung dpangs mtho zhing 'jebs par ja gsum ring stsal grub mtshams nyer spyod kyi mchod pa lnga zhal gso'i tshul du yon bdag gi lag bdar tshogs pas sngags dang rgyag rgya'i sgo nas tshig gsung ba dang bcas rten la 'bul ba dang / yon bdag tshe dpag med du bskyed cing dge shes sgrub pa'i bar gcod kyi bgegs bskrad tshe dpal 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ched sngon de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas brgyad po rang rang gi phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po thams cad sgrub pa'i mthu ldan du byin gyis brlabs te gter chen nyid kyi stong thun gsung bshad dang tshogs pas tshigs bcad dang bcas kho bor stsal de gsham du tsa ru'i bza' ba'ang gsung tshig dang bcas stsal ba'i rjes kho bos yon bdag gi mas gtam gyi sa bcad rab tu gnas pa'i bsgo'i rtsa ba mchod sdong chen po 'di dang bzhengs pa'i dgos pa rab gnas dang bcas pa'i dgag bya gter chen nyid gdung sras gcung mkhan po lo tsā ba yang gcung 'dus grwa dang bcas pa cho ga bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi 'byung khungs nges tshig la sogs dang / lhag tu yon bsgo khas blangs kyi tshul dang bcas zhu mus su rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyi mchod pa'i dga' ston nam deng rab ston du grags par 'bras sil/ ja thug sogs kyi thog rje bla ma mchog gi gsol rkang gi tshul dang / nged rang du sder bcas phan bde legs bshad gling gi rab ston ltar dang / gter chen rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang por gsol sder bzhi bcu/ tha sbag gsum/ gdung brgyud dang mkhan lo tsā ba so sor sder nyer dgu tha sbag zung / gcung kun dga' lags la sder nyer lnga/ tha sbag gnyis/ rdor 'dzin/ dbu chos/291

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mchod gnyer bcas smin gling gi sne mo ba lnga la sder nyer gsum tha sbag gnyis tshogs bzhugs grwa pa brgya dang go gcig la sder nyi shu/ tha sbag do/ rtse shod kyi drung 'khor nang rnam dgu/ phyi mgron ras chung phug sprul sku/ ge re lha pa/gter ston rin po che'i zhabs phyi drag pa lnga bcas par bcu bdun sder/drung drag gya bdun la bcu gsum sder/ drung 'bring dgu bcur dgu sder/drung dkyus brgya go lngar bdun sder/ ging chen tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku rten dbang 'dus rgyal por bcu gsum sder/ dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi slob dpon/ mnga' ris grwa tshang bla ma/ nges gsar rdor gling sprul sku bcas par bcu gcig sder/ rgyang ro gser sdings dang / nyang po ri kha'i bla ma/de mo chos sgo ba/ la mo dge slong / chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i mgron gnyer zung / zur ri bla ma gdan zur/ sems dpa' sprul sku'i skya rtsa bcas par dgu sder/ rwa sgrong mkhan po'i dpon po/ spyi gnyer gnyis/ skyid grong kun dga' rnams la bdun sder gong gsal sder thob dang bstun pa'i 'dzugs dpangs mtho ba/ grwa pa dang sger g.yog sogs brgyad cur lnga sder te khyon mi grangs lnga brgyar nye bar ston mo bzhugs gral rgyas par bshams thog rab yon 'bul ba gter ston rin po cher mchod sdong khyad 'phags bcu gsum gyi grangs dang mtshungs pa'i bzang sgrigs bcu gsum tshan ha lam zhi rgyas so so nas gsum re ((dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs 757—758)zhes 'khod pa bcas rab gnas skor gyi yon 'bul zhabs tog rnams la khyon bsdoms dngul srang drug khri dgu stong brgya bcu gcig zho dgu skar phyed song ba 'brur phab gshor khal sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong bcu bzhi bre drug song zhing / da dung tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya 292

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'be+ebs/mtsho dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes rnam pa gnyis kyis phyag nas bden brjod gnang ba'i skor dkar chag thar gru las/ bdag gi bla ma lnga pa chen po bsam bzhin rang cag 'gro ba'i mgon du phebs pa thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho chen pos me glang chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ma khad phyag nas zhib par stsal/ de mtshungs 'phags pa rab 'byor sogs kyi yang srid yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi'ang phyag nas bden brjod kyis dam ye dbyer med du nyin gang byin gyis brlabs shing bsnyen bkur rten 'byung gi 'bul ba yang na bza' zhal dkar zhal stegs sogs sku'i nyer dpyad cha tshang gis dbus rgyu bzang spus dag rin thang can gyi tshan grangs khyad 'phags kyi grangs bstun bcu gsum tshan bcu gsum/phyag mdzod par dgu tshan gnyis kyis mtshon phyag phyi'i sngags pa slob dpon gangs can rje drung sku skye sogs la rnam gzhag bcas bstar ba la sogs pa gsal por 'khod pa ltar lags so/ /bcu ni mchod pas khyad par 'phags pa/ gser gdung rin po ches mtshon lha khang khag tu mchod sgrin rgya che bstar ba'i skor dkar chag thar gru las/ ‘‘lam sgron las/ /kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa bzhin/ /mchod pa rnam pa bdun dag kyang / /byang chub snying po'i thar thug bar/ /mi ldog pa yi sems dag gis/ /dkon cog gsum rab la dad cing / /pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs nas/ /thal mo sbyar bar byas nas ni/ ’zhes dang / ‘‘rdzogs sangs bris sku la sogs dang / /mchod rten dam chos mngon phyogs nas/ /me tog bdug spos dngos po dag /ci 'byor ba yi mchod par bya/’’zhes sogs rgyas pa le'u bcu gsum par spros te bshad pa ltar gyi mchod pa de la yang /293

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'am/ bla na yod pa dang bla na med pa'i mchod pa zhes dbye ba gnyis su yod pa las mchod yul zhing gi sgo nas dbye na dkon cog gsum mchod pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'am bla na med pa'i mchod pa/ lha drag po dbang phyug mchod pa la sogs pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i mchod pa'am bla na yod pa'i mchod pa/ yang bsam pa'i khyad par gyi sgo nas dbye na mtho ris kyi rgyur dmigs su 'bul ba 'jig rten pa'i mchod pa dang / thar pa'i rgyur dmigs su 'bul ba brten las 'das pa'i mchod pa/ dngos po'i sgo nas dbye na/ yo byad kyi dngos pos mchod pa 'jig rten las ma 'das pa dang / thos bsam sgom gsum sogs rgyal ba mnyes pa'i thabs las bsgrubs nas mchod pa 'das pa'i mchod pa/ rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye na rang bzhin med stobs kyi shes rab zab mos zin pa'i sgo nas 'bul ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod pa ste thar pa cha mthun pa dang / des ma zin na bsod nams cha mthun zhes 'jig rten pa'i mchod par gyur pa ste phyir dbye ba dang bye brag mtha' yas shing / de nyid 'bul ba'i zhing dam pa mtshon bya don gyi dkon cog gsum ni thar 'dod rnams kyi skyabs su brten pa skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum dang / de nyid mtshon byed brdar btags pa'i dkon cog gsum ni chos longs sprul lam bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten du grags pa rnams yin pas de dag rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa gser gdung rin po che 'dzam gling mchod sdong chen po gtsor gyur du lha khang so so'i nang nyer spyod mtshon byed re las ha cang rgyas pa gu yul gyi ma thub par ma zad 'phral lta snang du nogs skyen pa'i skyon dang / yang 'phral mjes khyad gtsor bton gyi la lar mchod mjal ba'i dus 294

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/bdug spos mar me phran bu las rgyun du mchod pa ye med par snang ba de rigs yang ma yin par tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs kyi gnam g.yeng steng kun bzang mchod khrin khang du rgyun gtan nyin star mchod pa sna lnga brgya phrag re 'bul bar ting rer nas gshor bre re'i me tog gtsang spos reng bu re'i bdug spos/ mar nyag do re'i mar me/ chu gtsang ting re'i yon chab/rtsam bre re rgyan bcas kyi zhal zas te mchod pa sna lnga brgya phrag re/ dgong star mchod me mtshan 'khyongs sdong rkang drug re/ mchod 'bul yer pa grwa tshang dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse ba bzhi grwas skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal tshar lnga/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pa bzhi gras zhogs pa thugs sgrub las byang gis gzhung bsrangs dri ma med pa bshags pa'i rgyud kyi yang snying ye shes sku mchog ma tshar brgya re chos skyong gi bskang gso dang bcas khor yug tu btsugs pa'i lo gcig gi mchod chas phogs ja thug sogs gtong sgo khyon dngul srang drug brgya don dgu zho bdun skar brgyad 'brur phab khal chig khri nyis stong nyis brgya so lnga bre bcu dgu phul bzhi/((dkar ga thar gru〉shog grangs 796 )zhes gsal ba dang de bzhin sman bla lha khang dang / dus 'khor lha khang sogs lha khang khag tu dkrig car 'bul gshom dgos pa'i mchod sprin dang dus bzang so sor dmigs bsal sna lnga'i mchod sprin dang / mchod 'bul ba phebs khungs gtan 'khel gyis cho ga ji ltar gtong dgos pa yang gtan 'bebs kha gsal mdzad/lhag par lnga pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs kyi ched lha sar tshogs mchod chen mo gsar 'dzugs gnang skor/ dkar chag thar gru lag 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos 'phags yul mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston 295

nor brang mo rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang mtshungs par cho 'phrul smon lam mdzad pas mtshon 'phags bod tshang mar srol dar ba tshogs mchod chen mo'i dus ston btsugs pa ltar sangs rgyas dkon cog dang dam chos dkon cog gi rten mchod sdong chen por zhol nas khang steng dang 'phrul snang / dkyil 'khor sdings su gdugs bdun star chags par chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod 'bru mkhar bre re'i ting / rtsam gshor bre re'i zhal zas/ mar me nyin mtshan khor yug bdug spos bcas nyer spyod lnga'i stong mchod/ dge 'dun dkon cog gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dge gsum gtsor gyur gyi shar 'ol dga' the ba tshun lho e rong mi the ba'i sne'u gdong 'phyong rgyas gong dkar dang bcas pa'i 'brog mtshams kyi de'u nang 'gril/ nub gan pa la chos 'khor yang rtse nas yangs mtshur tshun byang rwa sgrong klung shod 'bri khung tshun gyi mi 'du ba dmigs bsal re gnyis ma gtogs rang gzhan ris su ma chad pa'i dud khag bzhi brgya dang zhe gcig gi dge 'dun khri phrag rig byed kyi grangs skor tshogs shing / nyin ltar zhogs pa ja gnyis dang tshogs 'don thog mar skyabs 'gro rgyas pa/ gdugs sher tshar gsum re/skabs gsum pa/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ rmad byung bskal pa ma rgyas pa tshar gcig dang bsdus pa 'dod gsol smon lam bdud bzhi rab bcom ma dang bcas pa gnyis tshar gsum 'dzab yig drug dang dmigs brtse ma tshar bcu bskor/ smon lam rnam gsum/ lam rim gsol 'debs/ tshe gzungs dang bcas pa/ dgung tshigs kyi tshogs la ja thug gnyis re'i thog sa gsum ma/ rmad rgyung bskal pa ma 'dod gsol smon lam zhogs ltar tshar gsum/yig drug dang dmigs brtse ma tshar sum cu re/ smon lam rnam gsum/ thog mtha' ma/ sher snying tshar gsum/ seng gdong ma'i sngags 'phreng 'khor 296
