sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gcig gtor 'bul gzhi bdag gtor ma/ smon lam cho 'phrul ji lta ba bzhin la legs bris ma/ rmad byung bskal pa ma 'dod gsol bcas tshar rgyas bsdus gnyis/ mdzad bcu dpag bsam yongs 'du dang / byings blo dang bstun thog med bskal ba ma gnyis nyin re mos/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol mchod dbyangs kyi bar cho 'phrul bzhin gsang ba'i rnam thar/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ bsngo ba/ bde ba can smon lam mthun 'gyur dang bcas pa/bstan 'bar ma/ shis brjod/ dgong jar rmad byung bskal pa ma rgyas bsdus gnyis 'dod gsol dang bsngo ba ste yan lag bdun pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod 'bul smon lam star chags/ nyer dgur sngon rgyal blon snga dar gyi dus rje bla ma chen po tshangs pa lha'i me tog tu gyur pa'i tshe dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma ka ras rgyal po pe har mthu che bas 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe srog la 'tshe ba sogs kyi don mdos yas ji snyed gsungs pa'i nang sras mu ne btsan po snyun gyis btab pa'i dus gsungs pa'i rgyal po rtse mdos btang bas grol ba'i tshul bstan pa ltar lcags sprel rje bla mas kho bo'i rim gror 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i rgyal po rtse mdos 'di dang dus 'grig pas mi tshogs dang bstun 'byung po yang mang bas king ka ra sogs spros pa dang bcas nged rang gi rim gro'i tshul du bstar/(〈dkar chag thar gru〉shog grangs 8༷༷—8༷1)zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de bzhin gos sku zhal 'byed dang / tshogs mchod ser phreng gi skor dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang ser sgrong gi mchod rdzos rnam grangs ji ltar yod pa gsal por gsungs pa tshogs mchod chen mo sbyor dngos rjes gsum rim pa ngo mtshar dang ldan pa 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ gnas chen khag mang por mchod 'bul sogs rnam dkar gyi rgyun ji srid bar mi nub par 'dzugs 297

nor brang zho rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnang mdzad pa bcas skabs de'i lha mchod kyi 'gro song khyon bsdoms dngul srang 'bum tsho bzhi dang chig khri chig stong dgu brgya don bdun zho bdun skar phyed bcu 'brur phab gshor khal sa ya bdun dang bzhi 'bum chig khri lnga stong drug brgya bre bdun phul phyed/ mnga' 'bangs dud grangs chig 'bum brgyad stong bzhi brgya nga bdun la yul 'gyed mu lto bar sbyin pa sogs mi mchod bsdoms dngul srang bdun khri dgu stong bdun brgya go gsum zho do skar phyed brgyad 'brur phab gshor khal sa ya gcig dang bzhi 'bum sum khri drug stong nyis brgya don dgu rnams tshugs lo dang rjes su 'ang 'gyed sogs spar chag phran bu las lar babs de bzhin gyi rgyun ji srid bar tshugs zhes (dkar chag thar gru〉yi nang gsal por 'khod pa ltar ro/ /bcu gcig ni yon bdag gis khyad par 'phags pa/ gser sdong rten dang brten par bcas gsar du bsgrun pa'i rlabs po che'i bya ba 'di'i bdag rkyen ni sde srid rin po che yin pas skabs 'di'i yon bdag gis khyad par 'phags pa yang sde srid rin po che gang du sku bltams pa dang / rigs rus kyi che ba/ chung ngu'i skabs kyi mdzad spyod/ lnga pa chen pos spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar bskyangs pa sogs mi'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa sgro skur spangs te dkar chag thar gru'i nang gsungs pa ltar lags so/ /bcu gnyis ne 'azin las kyi khrad par 'phags pa/ de yang 〈dkar chag thar gru〉las/ snga na med pa'i btso sbyangs gser gyi chos sku'i rten thog tshad lnga pas dbus 'dzam gling mchod sdong chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten chos khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs pa'i legs byas kyi rgyu gzings yangs por mthong thos dran 298

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/reg gi skye dgu mtha' dag lhan cig tu bzhugs te/ yab rje kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po nges don sangs rgyas sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul bathung ba gang gi thugs rje'i ded dpon dang / smon lam gyi dar chen rnam par g.yo bas rnam byang thar pa'i gling du sgrol bar mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'dis mtshon byed du byas te 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar rgyun mi chad pas 'gro ba rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor te gdul bya rnams rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par smin grol la bkri bar mdzad pa sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i 'phrin las mkha' ltar rgya che zhing yangs la de nyid kyi sku'i drang don dang bstun pa'i bsag sbyangs su bzhengs pa'i mchod sdong 'di nyid kyang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la mngon par phyogs pa nas bzung ste pad mtshor ngang pa 'du ba chos nyid bzhin du rang nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i dad pa dang gtong ba phun sum tshogs shing las dang skal ba ldan pa'i skye bo mtha' yas pas mchod sdong chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa'i sku rgyu mchod rdzas sogs su blos blangs kyi zhal 'debs rim par 'bul mi byung ba rnams rnam par dag pa'i bsam pas phul ba'i zas kham gcig tsam yang chu'i thigs pa rgya mtshor lhungs pa ltar byang chub chen po'i klong nas nam yang 'dor ba med pa gor ma chag pas 'di snang gi gtam grags sogs la ma bltas kyang gser dang bong ba mnyam pa sogs 'phags pa'i bden pa ma mthong ba rnams kyi blta snang du ngo so 'dod pa phal che ba'i phyir/ 'bul dpangs dang bstun pa'i go rim bsgrig pa dang /'bul ba po'i lag nas len pa/ de dag phra rgyan du 'os rigs gzhis snying can gyi gzhung khrar 'god pa dang de phyin do dam bzo rigs bcas pa'i phogs gun du sprod pa sogs thog ma phun tshogs lcang lo can pa tshe dbang rab brtan 299

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang / gtan 'jags su mda' dpon dar byung pa dge 'dul rab brtan/stag smad pa grags pa rnam rgyal dang / phun rab pa sogs ci rigs/ cha dkar ba pad+ma bsod nams/ gong rgyag gnas tshang ka thog nor nor/ ka brgyad mdo a chog rags kha smon lam bzang mo/ mgron khang dbang mo/kak+ṇi kun dga'/ rjes su la khar yar 'phel/ sle ma nor 'dzom rnams bgyid bcug par dngos po'i rigs gong rgyab kyis dngul srang sum stong yan zin pa ang dang / chig stong nas sum stong bar ang gnyis/ stong nas bdun brgya yan ang gsum/ bdun brgya nas bzhi brgya'i bar ang bzhi/bzhi brgya nas brgya'i bar ang lnga/ brgya nas lnga bcu bar ang drug lnga bcu man rnams ang bdun du brtsis pa'i go rim dkar chag bkod par/ ang ki dang po grong smad nas sa lug phan sger chas kyi kong sna pad 'dab/ gtsug g.yu/ spos shel/ nor rigs/ shel/ gser thig tug sogs dngul srang lnga stong bzhi bcu zho bzhi/ ma rgan bu khrid rgyal mo'i dpral g.yu/ spos shel/ gtsug g.yu sogs dngul srang drug brgya dang gnyis zho lnga/ gsum chog gi spos shel la dngul srang nyi shu/ ang ki gnyis pa bkra shis lhun po bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po nas mu tig gi 'phreng ba gser dngul bcas srang nyis stong lnga brgya go gsum zho gsum/ bstan 'dzin bā dur hung tha'i jis gser dngul srang chig stong drug brgya so drug zho gsum/ rin spungs ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi mu men rdog la dngul skar phyed gsum rnams kyi khrod nas nang rten dang gsang ba gsum gyi rten rnams la gong gcod ma 'os pas phud/ de phyin khyon gcig tu bsdoms par dngul srang lnga khri sum stong bdun brgya lnga bcu nga dgu zho bzhi skar phyed bzhi/ dkar me'i thebs su phul gras/300

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/rtse sdong zhabs drung yab kyi 'bri g.yag brgya dang lnga bcu nga lnga/ thon pa bu khrid dbang 'dus kyi rjes grub tu 'bri g.yag brgya dang nyi shu/ bla ma dung dkar bas 'bri g.yag brgya dang gcig shangs bkra shis rtse pas 'bri g.yag brgya tham pa/ bde chen srong btsan tshangs pa'i rjes sgrub 'bri g.yag dgu bcu go dgu 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku'i 'bri g.yag lnga bcu tham pa/ ba logs nor bu'i 'bri ma sum cu tham pa/ dpon po shes rab kyi shul mas 'bri g.yag bco brgyad rnams/ de yang sngon gyi rgyal rabs yig tshang rnams su/ bkra shis nyams su dga' ba brag lha'i tshal/ /smon shing star kha sdong po'i bsil grib la/ /zhes byung ba'i skyed mos tshal deng sang klu sbugs gling khar 'bod pa'i sar bste ba spyi khyab do dam dang las rgyab pa 'u lag gi sgar bcas gtso bor bton par bza' btung la sogs pa'i dga' ston bstar mi byung ba do dam bzo rigs la sba dar dang tshan grangs sder kha/ 'u lag la rtsam pa dngos dod gang rigs/ja chang thug pa bcas yod pa'i ri gong dngul du phab srang chig stong sum brgya skor zin pa aṅgi dang po/ 'u lag la rtsam pa dang dod po gang rung yod cing gzhan rnams ji bzhin med pa ri gong dngul srang drug brgyar longs pa ang gnyis/ do dam bzo rigs la sba dar tshan grangs gang rigs nas 'u lag la ja thug re yod pa ri gong dngul srang sum brgya zin pa ang gsum/ ja thug chang bcas las med pa ri gang dngul srang bcu gsum yan ang ki bzhi par byas/ lo khongs gcig cing ang gnas 'dra phyin yi babs dang gzabs gud med par snga phyi go rim du bkod par/ lcags lug lo ang dang gi thog ma dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas/ rten phyi'i garnyo la chen po'i skor gyi spyi khyab 'go pa 'bog gong mon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ brten pa nang gi rten gsum 301

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtso bor gyur pa'i spyi khyab 'go pa zhol gzhis ka ba snying snying / bal po phra pa'i 'go pa sga chags pa rta mgrin rdo rje/ brdungs 'phul 'go pa 'atā kha mkhar nag pa tshe brtan rdo rje/ rna pa la'i dbu chen u 'du sim/ lha bris sman lugs pa'i dbu chen lho brag pa bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mkhyen lugs dbu chen gsang sngags mkhar pa tshe 'phel/ shing bzo dbu chen gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ rdo bzo dbu chen e pa rgya mon dar rgyas te che kha dgu so sor gos khas mtshon pa'i bdun tshan re/ sder dod spu ja nyag do 'dzugs bcas/ bal shing rdo bcas kyi dbu chung rnams la kha btags che ba re dang dril yug re/ ja nyag phyed do/ sman kha re/ the cha'i gras/ phra rgyan gra bsgrig dang zhal 'debs len mi tshe dbang rab brtan/ mda' dpon dar byung pa dgra 'dul rab brtan/ stag smad pa grags pa rnam rgyal/ cha dkar ba pad+ma bsod nams/ gtsug lag gi gto bcos pa bla mkhyen ngag dbang /sman sbyin drung rams pa tshogs gnyis rgya byumatsho/ ring bsrel rnam pa bzhis gtsos gzungs 'bul do dam dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa bcas par gong mtshungs zhes bkod pa'i dum bu 'di'i nang nas gser sdong chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs la dad ldan khag nas phul ba'i zhal 'debs che ba ang rim dang gnyis ma slebs pa nas chung ba skar phyed gsum yan gcig kyang chad lus med pa gsal por 'god gnang dang / de bzhin dkar me'i thebs su zhal 'debs 'bri g.yag gang phul/ bzo rigs do dam pa dang bcas par sger nas legs so'i sba dar bstar rigs kyang ang rim 'god gnang dang 'brel bar gcig kyang tshems lus med par 'god gnang mdzad pa 'dis dad rdzas rnams chud mi 'dza' ba byang chen thar pa'i 302

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/rgyurabasngobadang—/ skabasader mchod sdong chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs kyi las grwar rang rang gi sgo gsum 'bad 'bungs kyi rtsol bar zhugs pa rnams kyi byas rjes kyang ji srid bar mi nub pa rang gi ming dang / skabs der las 'khur gang khyer gyi thog nas mtshon pa bcas so/ /bcu gsum ne phan yon gyis khyad par 'phags pa/ skabs gsum pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gang bsti stang dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / rjed pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang /mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bsngags pa brjod pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa dang / skor ba byed pa la sogs pa'i rten ni/ (chos thams cad kyi rgyal po〉las/ ‘‘lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa/ /yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin/ / ’zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag mchod bkur bsti rim gror 'bad pa rnams smos ci/ tha na ris su ma chad pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam pa 'di dag mig gi mthong ngam tha na mchod rten 'di dag gi mtshan rna bar thos sam yid la dran te sems dang ba tsam gyis kyang gnas skabs nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi ste tshe dang dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad yar zla bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang mthar thug bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa yid gnyis dang the tshom med pa dkar chag nang gsal por gsungs pa ltar lags so/ /de ltar po ta la'i pho brang dmar po rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag mi'i dbang po sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me glang(1698)lo'i zla drug par brtsams gnang ba〈mchod sdong 303

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'dzam gling rgyan gcig rten gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i dkar chag thar gling rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i gru rdzings byin rlabs kyi bang mdzod〉nang rgyas par gsal ba las snying po btus te bris pas rtsa ba'i dpyad gzhi shin tu khungs btsun pa de ltar yang / skabs 'dir kho bos snying po btus te phyogs sgrig skabs don gyi snying po 'dzin ma thub pa sogs pa'i 'gal 'dzol 'dra mchis na gzigs pa po rnams la bzod gsol zhu rgyu ma zad/ lo rgyus dngos rtsa ba'i dkar chag rang la gzigs rogs gnang zhu rgyu dang / pho brang chen po'i rgya khyon dang mtho tshad skor deng skabs tshad len byas pa ltar na pho brang chen po'i spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi khre gru bzhi ma dgu khri skor dang / phyi ngos thog rtseg bcu gsum gyi mtho tshad spyi khre brgya dang bcu bdun tshags bcu dgu/ rtseg zheng che shos sar spyi khre lnga lhag tsam yod par bshad 'dug pa yang dpyad gzhi tsam du bkod pa bcas bsdoms na lhun brjid chags pa'i pho brang rten dang brten par bcas ngo mtshar bsam brjod las 'das pa 'dzam bu'i gling chen 'di'i nang 'dzugs skrun ngo mtshar can ang dang po'i gras su brtsi bar the tshom ma dgos pa 'di lta bu grub pa ni mi'i dbang po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i mdzad rjes bsub thabs med pa zhig yin no/ /gsum pa/ dgon gnas rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba/gtsug lag khang gi bar khang dang / rtse thog gi lha khang phal mo che/skor lam gyi byang shar 'chi med lha khang dang / bde thabs lha khang sogs 304

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/gsar bskrun gnang ba/ lnga pa chen po'i sku dus su btab pa'i dgon sde khag phud/ sde srid nyid kyi sku dus su phyag btab pa'i dgon gnas kyang rgyal tam dga' ldan sum rtsen gling / bar khams zur mang nges legs gling / mon mtshams dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse/ sgom sde'am nang chen khul ka mda' dga' ldan theg mchog gling ma lag gsum/ go 'jor dga' ldan gsang sngags 'gro 'dren gling / khyung po ser tsha khog bon dgon ser khyim pa dge lugs su bsgyur gras 'brong rdzong dang / dga' ldan bkra shis gling sogs ma lag bzhi/ gnas chung lcog sgra dbyangs gling / lcags po ri be+eḍūr+ya 'gro phan lta na ngo mtshar rig byed gling bcas phyag btab pa dang / dgon gnas de dag la mchod rgyun ja tshul gyi gtong thebs mchod gzhis sbyor 'jags gnang ba ma zad/ gzhan yang dgon gnas shin tu mang por mchod gzhis rgya che sbyor 'jags gnang ba/ lhag par lnga pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te lo ltar zla ba gnyis pa'i nang lha sa smon lam che mo'i lam ltar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la nyin bcu'i ring tshogs mchod chen mo gsar 'dzugs dang / tshogs mchod ser steng gi mchod rdzas rin thang can stong phrag brgal ba bzo bskrun bshams sbyor gnang ba de kho na'i 'gro gron 'bru thog tu phab par 'bru ru'i khal sa ya brgyad dang brgyad 'bum lnga khri bzhi stong lnga brgya gsum song du ba bcas gsar 'dzugs dang 'brel tshogs mchod kyi bca' khrims(byang chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor〉zhes bya ba yang mdzad yod/305

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzhi pa/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs gsar rtsom dang dar spel mdzad pa/bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung phyi mo rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa〈gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos sman bla'i dgongs rgyan rgyud bzhi'i gsal byed baiḍūr+ya sngon po ma li ka〉dang / de'i〈lhan thabs dus min 'chi zhag gcod pa'i ral gri〉bod kyi gso rig skor gyi lo rgyus(khog 'bub drang song dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉bod kyi skar rtsis rig pa'i legs bshad kun btus sngon med kyi bstan bcos(baiḍūr+ya dkar po'i phreng ba dpyod ldan snying nor〉dang / de'i(bu dpe〉lu 'go bla mkhyen ngag dbang gi dris lan(be+eḍūr+ya g.ya' sel〉sogs sman rtsis kyi bstan bcos khag rim par bka' rtsom gnang ba dang chabs cig de dag gi phyag len dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir me byi(1696)lor lcags ri be+eḍūr+ya 'gro phan lta na ngo mtshar rig byed gling btab pa dang / sman thang gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa brgyad cu gsar bzhengs da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ khong sku ngo mas chab srid 'du 'god rgya chen po'i bar seng ngam dgos nges rigs la sman rtsis kyi phyag len yang dngos su gnang ba bcas gzhung 'di gnyis kyi thad la'ang mdzad rjes rlabs po che gzengs su thon pa zhig 'jog gnang mdzad par deng gi dus su yang rgyal khab phyi nang du snyan pa 'bar ba bod ljongs sman rtsis khang 'di'i phyag bzhes 'chad nyan rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa'i chu 'go gangs la thug pa'i dpe bzhin mthar gtugs na mi'i 306

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/dbang po 'di'i rlabs po che'i mdzad rjes dang kha bral thabs med la/ phyis kha ba'i ljongs 'di'i sman rtsis kyi gzhung la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i sman rtsis rab 'byams pa dang / 'bum rams pa mang po thon pa yang gzhung chen 'di tshor 'chad nyan gnang ba dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ gzhan yang (dga' ldan chos 'byung be+eḍūr+ya ser po/〉 bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos〈dpyod ldan yid gsos/〉 (gar dbyangs kyi bstan bcos mig yid rna ba'i bcud len〉sogs tshad ldan gyi gzhung dang / bstan bcos du ma/ lnga pa chen po'i rnam thar du ku la'i gos bzang 'phro 'thud pod gsum/ sku phreng drug pa'i rnam thar(rab gsal gser gyi snye ma〉sogs mang po mchis rung / mtha' gcig tu grangs 'bor 'di dang 'di zhes zhu mi spobs/ sku tshe'i mjug der bar chad ngan pa de lta bu byung bas gsung rtsom khrod nas baiḍūr+ya sngo ser dkar gsum dang g.ya' sel lta bu nyung shas shig par la 'khod pa deng skabs nga tsho'i 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du gyur pa 'di dag las mang che ba par la brko rgyu ltar bzhag phyogs sgrig cha tshang ba zhig kyang byung tshod mi snang / dper na sku phreng drug pa khri 'don skabs sde srid rang gi brtsams chos phul bar rig pa'i gnas chen lnga'i gsung rtsom pod nyi shur nye ba yod lugs rab gsal gser gyi snye ma'i nang gsal por 'khod pa de ltar na de nas sku tshe'i 'phen pa ma btang bar du da dung lo brgyad tsam gyi dus tshod yod pa de'i ring la bka' rtsom mu mthud gnang srid pa ni mkhyen rab dang mdzad pa mang po'i thog nas mtshon thub pa bcas nga tshos gsal por mthong thub pa ni sde srid 'di nyid kyis srid skyong gnang ring chos srid gnyis ka'i 'khur bzhes brel che la sku tshe yang de tsam gyitā ring ba ma brtan rung / bod rig pa'i skor sngon med kyi bka' rtsom grags 307

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/can mang po gnang thub pa 'di kho na'ang spyir btang gi mi'i blo yul las 'das pa zhig lags so/ /lnga pa/ lnga pa chen po sku gshegs pa de yun ring gsang rgya gnang ba/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos srid 'gan bzhes pa'i lo gsum pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi(1682)lor lnga pa chen po zhi bar gshegs/ de yang lnga pa chen po snyun bzhes sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa mtha' mar nye ba'i tshe sde srid mchog la lugs zung gi bslab bya khyad par ba du ma dang / bod rgya sog gsum gyi lar rgya skyong lugs/ sku 'das pa re zhig gsang rgya'i ngos bya ba che phra thugs blos ma chod pa mtha' dag lha mor brtag bsgril gyis zhes zhal chems gnang ba sogs skyo ba tshad med pa dgongs gzhi bsgrubs pa'i stobs shugs su 'gyur nas sku gshegs pa'i mtshan mo de rang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa sogs der yod sku bcar tshang mas gsang rgya dus ji tsam dgos pa'i skor lha mor brtag bsgril zhus par yang srid phebs nas gdan 'dren bar gsang dgos phebs don bzhin sde srid sku ngo mas dbus/ sku bcar/ bla sprul gal che/ zhabs 'bring gsang khog tu dgos pa tshang mas gsang sgrog mi byed pa'i gna' gan mthu mo che 'jog gnang gis phyi rgyar lnga pa chen po bcad rgya dam por bzhugs pa'i tshul byas/ man ju gong ma khang shi la lnga pa chen po gshegs pa'i tshul dngos su ma zhus kyang shugs nas ston pa'i ched lnga pa sku ngo mas gnang khul gyi phyag bris dang / lnga pa chen pos rnam kun 'bral med bzhes pa'i chos gos rnam gsum/ 'jim pa las grub pa'i lnga pa'i 'dra sku zhig 308

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/bcas mi sna ched du mngags te phul ba/ lnga pa chen po'i sku'i rim gro dang /bstan srid bde rim la kha g.yar te dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs pa/mtshams re gong mas mngags pa'i mi sna dang / sog po'i sbyin bdag gal che ba lnga pa chen po sku ngo mas mjal kha ma gnang thabs med kyi rigs la lnga pa chen po'i zhal dbyibs dang 'dra ba rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi sde pa bkras rab pas sku brdzus te mjal kha gtong ba/ chab shog sogs bka' rtsom dgos rigs sde srid rang gi 'gan bzhes pa/ gsang rgya'i skabs da dung sku'i yang srid mngon chung gis rtsad gcod dgos pa sogs thabs rnam du mas phyag len bstar ba ni gtso bor lnga pa chen po'i dgongs gzhi dgos pa dang / yang sgos skabs de'i bstan srid dgos mkhor dgongs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa 'gangs chen zhig yin te skye bo thams cad lnga pa chen po 'tsho zhing gzhes par bzhugs yod snyam pa'i mur yun ring po de tsam gsang rgya gnang thub pa de ni dngos 'brel hang sangs dgos pa zhig los yin/ 'on kyang gnad don de dag gi thad sde srid mchog la gnang ma bde dang / gsang ba phyi gyar yong gzhi'i sku ngal dang nyen kha mang po 'phrad yod/ dper na sku rdzus byed mkhan sde pa bkras rab pas skabs re nga btson la sdod dgos pa'i bya ba gang yang ma byas/ nga phyi la thon gyi yin zhes shor ba dang / rdzig gtam gtong ba sogs la 'phral yun dang spyi sger gyi gnas lugs bab gses 'jam mkhas kyis blo 'gug thabs gnang dgos pa dang / gsang rgya yun ring bas gzhung zhabs nang khul du dogs pa skye bar gang la de 'tsham gyis gsang sgo mi 'chol ba'i thabs shes mdzad dgos pa/ lhag par gsang brtol ma mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis 'byung 'gyur gong ma chen po dgongs phyogs gtad de ma nges pa'i gnad don ji yong 309

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang 'di'i skor yā han krang gi brtsams deb nang‘‘1696lor(ching rgyal rabs kyi khang shi'i khri lo 35pa)gong ma khang shis dpung chen khrid de rang nyid ngo mas jun gar 'dul skabs phyi sog gi khe lu'u lun ho chu bo'i rgyud du jun gar gyi dmag dpung pham par byas nas dga' ldan gyis dug btung nas rang shi brgyab cing dmag yongs rdzogs rtsa med du phyin pa red/ de nas gong ma khang shis gson bzung du tshud pa'i bod pa'i kha nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa gshegs nas lo mang po phyin pa'i gnas tshul go rjes sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor yi ge zhig btang ba de'i nang du bkyon 'dri btsan po byas pa gsham gsal/‘nged kyis mgo btags pa'i bod par 'dri dus tshang mas tā la'i bla ma sku gshegs nas yun ring po phyin 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug kyang / khyod kyis da lta'ang gsang rgya bsdams nas bsdad de snyan seng zhus ma byung / des ma tshad tā la'i bla ma zhal bzhugs dus lcags ri ring po'i phyi rol du lo drug cu lhag tsam ring dus bde zhi 'jags byung yod rung / khyod kyis dga' ldan pa dmag zing slong rgyu'i ngan skul yang yang byas nas gzhan sdug snying tshim byed kyi 'dug pas dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa gang du yod/ tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyis mnyam du chos lugs kyi gtso 'gan bzhes te sngar nas gcig tshab gcig byed kyis bdag skyong gnang gi yod pas gal srid tā la'i bla ma sku gshegs yod na chos skyong rnams la zhus te paṇa chen la tsong kha pa'i chos lugs kyi gtso bzhes su gsol dgos kyang / khyod kyis mang tshogs rnams paṇa chen la gong bkur zhu ru ma 'jug par rang la gong bkur zhu ru bcug pa ma 310

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/zad/ paṇa chen pe cin du phebs rgyu bkag 'gog kyang byas 'dug nged kyis khal kha tsho pa dang jun gar tsho pa gnyis bar 'dum byed bsams kyang /khyod kyis spyod pa ngan pa'i rje drung btang nas wu'u lan pu'u thung yul du g.yul 'gyed byed skabs rkun dmag gi ched du mo btab ste tshes cha dang bstun nas rim gro bsgrubs thog krang ka'e hran ri bo'i sgang nas dmag 'thab byed tshul bltas nas rkun dmag la rgyal kha thob pa mthong na kha btags g.yog cing /rkun dmag la pham kha 'khel ba mthong na de'i tshab byas nas zhi mthun yong thabs byed kyi yod pas nged kyi rjes snyeg dmag dpung la 'gor gzhi thebs pa red/ de dag tshang ma khyod dga' ldan gyi phyogs su langs pa las byung ba sha stag red/ da lta jun gar mi bsrun pa tshar bcad nas rgyal kha thob pa'i rten du dga' ldan gyi glo gri gcig dang / kho'i skye dman a nu'i sku brnyan gcig dang ga'u gcig bcas bskur nas btang yod pas kho tā la'i bla ma dang thugs 'phrad byas chog pa dang paṇa chen pe cing du phebs chog pa byed dgos shing /rje drung 'dzin bzung byas nged kyi rtsar skyel dgos/ gal te de ltar ma byas na nged kyis yun nan dang / si khron/ hra'an zhi bcas kyi dmag dpung btang nas mkhar gyi 'khris su khyod dang 'phrad rgyu yin pas khyod kyis o rod tsho pa bzhi'i mi rnams mnyam rub byas nas sgug bsdad chog mjug 'bras ji ltar byung yang 'gyod pa ma byed cig’ces bris yod pa red/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i lag tu yi ge de 'byor rjes ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gi zil shugs la skrag nas dngangs 'tshab ha cang chen po skyes te spyi lo 1697lor pe cing du mi btang nas gong ma khang shir gsang ba'i yi ge zhig phul ba de'i nang du/311

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/‘'gro ba rnams skal ba dman pas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa chu khyi lor sku gshegs shing / khong gi yang srid phebs nas dgung lo bco lngar phebs yod pa red/ de sngon bod rigs mi ser gyis zing cha bslangs dogs kyis sku gshegs pa gsang rgya sdom dgos byung / da lta glang lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin khri 'don byed rgyu thag bcad yod/ gong ma chen po gang nyid la de don phyir bsgrags ma gnang ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ paṇa chen lha 'brum bsnyun ma myong bas rgyal sar phebs mi nus/ rje drung gang thub ci thub kyis rgyal sar skyel rgyu yin pa smos med red/ yin na'ang khor srog thog gi khrims gcod mi mdzad pa zhu zhes bshad yod pa red/ skabs der ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis bod ljongs la dbang sgyur byed shugs de don dngos thog ha cang zhan po yin pas gong ma khang shis 'byor yig nang du bton pa'i re 'dun de dag khas mi len thabs med byung ba redamimi⑧ces gsal 'dug cing / bod kyi yig cha'i nang bod me byi(1696)lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu nyin thog mar yang srid rin po che'i yab yum gnyis la gsang brtol de da cha rgyal ba'i mchog sprul du thugs gtan 'khel tshul gsed bkrol zhus pa dang /lo de ga'i nang nyi ma thang pa'i zhabs drung ngag dbang gzhon nu rgyal nang du ched gtong gis ching gong ma khang shi mchog la gsang rgya gsal zhu dang / yang srid mchog sprul yang sku nar son tshul dang sprags 'gyangs min po ta lar gdan zhus kyi khri 'don zhu rgyu'i skor snyan seng zhu gnang ltar gong ma chen po'i dgongs par 'byor ba'i skor ⑨tsam las gsal cha ma 'khod stabs 'dir kha skong du drangs pa lags shing / bod khul du gzhung zhabs spyi dang / se 'bras dga' gsum/ lha sa'i mi dmangs bcas khag so sor gsang rgya bkrol 312

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/ba'i khyab bsgrags ni bod me glang (1697)zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin dus cig la byas par grags/ de ltar na gong mar gung seng lo gcig gi sngon la zhus par mngon/ gsang rgya de la gzhung zhabs sogs kyi khongs nas ma 'dod pa byed mkhan khag gcig kyang byung tshul gsal 'dug pa bcas mdor na bya ba 'di khams che ba zhig yin stabs lta stangs dang brjod tshul 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig lags so/ /drug pa/ lnga pa chen po'i yang srid rtsad gcod dang /khrir 'don pa'i skor/lnga pa chen po sku gshegs pa'i lo gsum pa shing glang (1685)lor yang srid rtsad gcod zhu bar khong sku ngo ma phebs rgyu go sa'i babs kyis skabs su ma che bas chos rje mkha' reg pa zil gnon rdo rje dang / rdo pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis la nang don mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gyi phyag phreng sogs sku'i nyer dpyad dang 'brel bar phyi rgyar gnas chen rnams su bod khams bde thabs kyi sgrub pa byed du 'gro bar dril bsgrags ngos/ sa gnas gang du mchog sprul rin po che sku 'khrungs pa'i dogs rigs yod pa byung na sdings po che ngag dbang snyan grags dang / shar khang no mon khang gi sku skye rtsad gcod yin khul gyi bka' shog dang 'brel bar mngags rdzongs gnang / de'i dus mtsho sna rdzong sdod shun rgya yags pa dang / 'phyongs rgyas pa pu shud gnyis kyis snyan zhu phul bar/ 'di khul la 'go yul gsum o rgyan gling na gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i gdung yin pa bla ma bkra shis bstan 'dzin gyi bu chung phag lor skyes pa zhig 313

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gis dbus gtsang thams cad nga'i yin/ po ta lar 'gro/ nga la sde pa yod sogs zer gyi yod lugs 'khod pa'i 'byor lan lnga pa chen por dgongs skor gyi phebs gsal yin pa'i zol gyis‘nged rang la tshe 'phrang bar chad yod par shi sgra bkye ba lta bu'i rim gror 'gro shas kha zhing / de gong zha lu mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub rgya gar rtswa mchog grong dang nye bar sku skye yod tshul byung bas lung pa'i babs dang dogs pa 'dug pas dam rdzos 'di rnams byin zhes bka' drin bskyangs byung’’⑩zhes 'khod pa'i thog sde srid rang gi bka' lan du‘‘de lta'i sgra sbir che ba'i brten 'brug pas gsang dmag 'dra mi byed pa'i nges pa med pas phyi lhod nang grims dgos pa/ gong zhabs rin po che'i sku che'i 'phreng ba la brten pa'i bcad rgya mdzad pa las 'tsho gzhes yod mus la pha ma nye rigs kyis gtam 'chal bzo lugs la gzhigs na khrims gcod dgos tshul bden shas kha yang / pad gling dpon rgyud la spyan bskyangs che zhing zhwa lu mkhan po dbu blar song ba bcas da lam brjod med ngos/ slar sgra sbir gang chung dgos pa'i bkod 'doms khrims gtam lta bu ma yin par 'jam gang chag dgos pa ’⑪sogs phyi rgyar gsang sgo'i babs la mi gnod tsam las nang don yab yum sras bcas la bkur bzos yong re gnang mod/ rdzong sdod gnyis po rgyu brngan gyi dbang du song ba dang / bka' rgyar go ba log bsgrubs kyis o rgyan nas mtsho snar gdan zhus kyis yab yum sras bcas la bzang btson lta bu'i dam sbrags gang che byas pa dang / sku'i 'tsho chas kyang shin tu dman par bzhugs dgos pa byung / de rjes zha lu mkhan chen gyi sku skyer kha g.yar te rtse shod kyi mtshan thog nas 'tshams zhu dang / phyag g.yog tu chos rdor gnyis rgyun 'jog thog gsol chas dang na bza' sogs rtse nas 'bul mi 314

sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor gleng ba dad pa'i char 'bebs/na mar mngags/ de jes sku yon 'bul bar drung 'tsho nam mkha' chos ldan dang / grub rgyal gling blo bzang dngos grub gnyis snga rjes su gtong gnang mdzad/ de nas yang srid dgung lo bcu gsum la phebs pa'i lo'i thog mar yab yum gnyis la gsang brtol ba de nas rim bzhin gsang ba brtol gnang gis me glang(1697)lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin mtsho sna nas sna dkar rtser phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas spyan drangs/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes sna dkar rtser spyan drangs te rab byung gi sdom pa 'bul bzhes thog mtshan la blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gsol zhing / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin po ta lar gser khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/de ltar lnga pa chen po dgongs pa gzhan don la phebs pa'i gsang rgya brtol te sku phreng lnga pa sku phreng drug par 'phos pa'i gtam rna ba'i bcud len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsar rtsom gnang ba dril bsgrags gnang yul gyi bab la gzhigs pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ci rigs pa'i thog nas gsang brtol bar‘‘lha sa'i rgan pa kha cig nas/ sku drin che/ lo de tsam gyi bar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ma bzhugs pa'i sa steng mi'i sdug bsngal dang /chos 'jig rten gyi thugs 'gan thams cad sde srid sku zhabs gcig pus bzhes/ nged tshos sa rub pa ma shes par nyi ma shar ba mthong byung ’’⑫zhes gleng ba 'di ni mang tshogs kun gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i mdzad rjes rlabs po cher bcos ma ma yin pa'i gdeng 'jog tshad mtho po zhus pa de mtshon pa bcas so/ /de ltar mi'i dbang po 'di nyid kyis chos srid lugs zung gi mdzad pa 315

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bskyangs dang skyong bzhin pa'i mur lha bzang khang dang thugs snang mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba'i khrod du lha bzang khang gi btsun mo tshe dbang rgyal mos sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung gis dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum la phebs pa shing bya(1705)lor stod lung snang rtser mgul bcad de dkrongs pa'i gnas tshul bsam yul las 'das pa'i skyo gnas de 'dra zhig byung ba bcas re zhig sgyu gu 'gul ba'i mtshams 'dir byas so// /lung 'dren dpyad gzhi khag①rab gsal gser snye shing par shog grangs 24pa/②pho brang chen po po ta la'i lo rgyus phyogs bsgrigs lcags par ma deb ngos shog grangs 85pa/① rab gsal gser snye lcags par gyi deb ngos shog grangs 394pa/rjo pho brang po ta la'i lo rgyus phyogs bsgrigs lcags par deb ngos shog grangs 21pa/rjo pho brang po ta la'i lo rgyus phyogs bsgrigs lcags par deb ngos shog grangs 21pa/dupho brang po ta la'i lo rgyus phyogs bsgrigs lcags par deb ngos shog grangs 2'ang 25pa/⑦mchod sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag thar gling rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i gru rdzings/⑧tā la'i bla ma'i rnam thar bod yig deb ngos shog grangs 93—94bar/⑨rab gsal gser snye lcags par gyi deb ngos shog grangs 287pa/⑩ rab gsal gser snye lcags par gyi deb ngos shog grangs 184pa/⑪rab gsal gser snye lcags par gyi deb ngos shog grangs 184pa/⑫rab gsal gser snye lcags par gyi deb ngos/316

tha mag gi gnod pa/da bcos min dbang med du thal ba'i gtam/kho ra khor yug rab mdzes in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs la 'khu ba'i ngo mtshar kun gsal bu mo'i bla bre'i grib ma snum por spyod pa'i sa mchog 'dzam bu'i gling zhes snyan pa'i dril chen gyi sgras sa gsum khongs pa 'geng ba'i ngo mtshar du ma'i 'jug ngogs 'dir khams dang / bsam pa dang / skad dang / rigs sogs mtha' yas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis rang rang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i rtsol ba zlos gar mkhan po'i yan lag gi stangs stabs gcig tu ma nges pa ci dang cir yang sgyur ba dang mtshungs par rang rang gi rgyal po'i khab kyi lugs bzhin chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas la sogs pa kun nas 'phel bar byed pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi byas rjes 'jog par 'gran pa bzhin du gnas shing / skye bo'i tshogs de rnams 'tsho zhing gnas par bya ba'i longs su spyod bya'i dngos po ni mtha' dang mu med pas skye bo susnga kyang grangs dang rnam par dbye ba'i tshad ni 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes smra ba'i 'bab stegs g.yo ba ni lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa'i ngal ba dang / ri bong rwa'i ngang tshul ltar zad kyang / sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis thun mong gi snang ngor rags pa tsam gtan la phab pa ni shes pa'i longs spyod dbang po lnga'i spyod byar gyur pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya zhes 'dod yon lnga yin par ma bstan nam/ 'o na dbang po lnga dang / 'dod yon lnga zhes bya ba ci 'dra yin zhe na gleng bar bya ste/ dbang po lnga ni/ mig dang /317

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus bcas yin zhing / 'dod yon lnga ni gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya bcas so/ /de yang zlos gar lta bu lta bas ngom pa med pa mtshar sdug ldan pa mig gi dga' ston dang /glu dang / pi wang lta bu snyan 'jebs rna ba'i dga' ston/ tsan dan dang / pad+ma las 'thul ba'i dri mchog bsung zhim ldan pa sna'i dga' ston/ a ma'i 'bras bu lta bu ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa lce'i dga' ston/ dar gos lta bu srab 'jam yang ba lus kyi dga' ston du gyur pa de rnams ni yid du 'ong ba'i cha nas bshad cing / yid du mi 'ong ba rnams kyang gong las ldog pa yin/ de lta bu'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar gtogs pa'i dngos po gang la ci 'os spyad pas skye bo'i lus stobs rgyas shing / tshe yun ring du bsring ba/ shes rig 'phel rgyas byung bas 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya ba tha gru shin tu yangs pa'i sa chen po 'di'i steng du thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi bya ba gang yang sgrub pa nga tsho'i 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du gyur pa de lta mod/ 'on kyang 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs su spyod par yang gnas dang gnas min gyi rtog dpyod yod dgos pa las rtog dpyod med par gya tshom du spyod pa ni gnas ma yin par sems so/ /'o na gang zhig spyod pa dang / gang zhig 'dor dgos pa'i blang dor ma 'dzol ba bya dgos pa ni dngos po gang dang gang gis rang gi lus khams la ltar snang tsam min pa'i don dam phan nges pa rnams gang la ci 'os su spyod pa dang / dngos po gang dang gang gis rang gi lus khams la ltar snang phan pa tsam du brlams kyang don dam gnod nges pa rnams spyod mi rung ba'i blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par 'jug pa ni gnad dam pa yin/skabs 'dir kho bos gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi ni skye bo rnams kyi lus khams la 318

tha mag gi gnod pa/gnod pa shin tu chen po yod pa'i tha mag ces bya ba de'i gnod 'tshe'i rang bzhin la ngos 'dzin dang 'brel de gcod thub par 'bad brtson dgos pa'i skor yin te/ de yang sa paṇa gyis‘gzhan gyis brnyas par 'gyur ba yi/ /nor dang zas kyis ci zhig bya/ khyi phag mi gtsang za ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig yid smon byed/ ces spyod du mi rung ba'i nor dang zas la spyod pa ni khyi phag dud 'gro'i spyod pa zhig las mkhas pa ste rtog dpyod ldan pa'i dam pa'i skye bo'i spyod bya ma yin pa gsal por bstan yod/ 'on kyang deng dus kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rdo tha zhes bya ba'i skye dngos las grub pa'i tha mag dang / gang zag sna tha sogs rdzas sbyor 'dra min du mar brten nas du ba dang / phye ma 'then spyod byed mkhan skye bo'i khrod du mi nyung tsam yod pa tshos tshad gzhi 'dra min gyis de dag la spyod par byed/ dga' bar byed/ mgu bar byed cing / tha mag sogs 'then rgyur goms gshis cung zab pa'i mi tsho'i snang ngor des sems rnal du phab pa dang / lus kyi rtsol ba mkhan yin na ngal gso ba dang / bsam blo'i rtsol ba mkhan yin na mno bsam mthong mgyogs pa/ dga' dus dga' rogs dang / sdug dus skyo rogs/ rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang med thabs med pa brgya go gcig chod lta bulhar snang de'i bde ba'i dbyings la tshud pas skad cig kyang de dang kha 'bral thabs med pa lta bu zhig chags 'gro ba de ni mkhas pas/‘‘rmongs pa bde ba 'dod bzhin du/ /bya ba sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig sgrub/ /gdon gyi btab pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ / sdug bsngal spang phyir lcebs pa mthong ’zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ tha mag la mi'i dbang rtsa sbrid pa'i nus pa chen po ldan pa'i rkyen gyis ltar snang bde ba lta bur tshor rung / des rang gi lus srog longs spyod la shog bu snum zos kyi chag sgo yong ba dang / tha na skyob thabs med 319

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa'i gnas su lhung srid pa mgo rul rna bas mi tshor ba bcas mi ches mang ba zhig ni tha mag gi nyes skyon la rtog zhib gang yang med par spyod pa dang /'ga' shas kyis de'i nyes skyon rtogs bzhin du ji mi snyam par spyod pa bcas so/tha mag 'then pa'i nyes skyon skor kha ba'i ljongs kyi sngon byon mkhas pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bus dpyad par zhugs te dug rdzas de rigs longs su spyod mi rung ba'i slob ston dang gdams pa ji snyed gnang ba ni sgra 'dzin dbang po'i bdud rtsi dang 'dra ba'i legs bshad 'ba' zhig tu 'khums/ 'on kyang mkhas pa gang dang gang gis ji ltar gsungs pa cha tshang ba zhig kho bos zhu bar rngo mi thogs kyang dpe mtshon lta bur zhus na/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes( 1762—1833)‘‘bag med kyi spyod pa sna tshogs yod kyang shin tu smad pa ni tha ma kha khyim pa ya rabs rnams kyang 'dzem pa'i gnas su byed ’ces dang /‘‘dam pa rnams thugs khrel dang / glo nad grib dang cham pa gdon bgegs kyi sna 'dren’ zhes dngapha‘bkres skom tsha grang gang gi nyams la'ang phan rgyu med pa smyon pa'i spyod pa lta bumi’zhes sogs tha mag gi nyes skyon bton gnang gis skye bo rnams de spyod du mi rung bar bstan pa dang / lhag par khong gis dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rang sgrar 'phos pa dbyangs bzhi pa'i cod pan can gyi ka phreng thog mar sbyar ba snyan dngags kyi nyams gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i bka' rtsom gnang ste nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas ni tha mag yin pa dang / des nga tshor bslad skyon ji ltar gtong ba/ de nges par du spong dgos pa bcas kyi skor gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ ‘‘ko tam bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren tha mag kha/ kho thag chos la sa/cod byed tha ma kha/ /go rigs dran pa slad byed tha ma kha/ /ngo tsha khrel 'ardzam 320

tha mag gi gnod pa/'dor byed tha ma kha/ /co 'dri bslu brid sna 'dren tha ma kha/ /cho rigs bzang po slad byed tha ma kha/ /jo bzang min pa'i ngan rtags tha ma kha/ /nyo le dge sbyor 'chag byed tha ma kha/ /to ger tshun chad dri mnams tha ma kha/ /tho co'i spyod pa'i mthar zad tha ma kha/ /do gal ci yang med bzhin 'di la spyod/ /mno bsam ci yang ma thongs 'di la dga'/ /po ti lnga la mkhas pa'ang 'di yis bslad/ /pho rab snying stobs can yang 'di yis bslad/ /bo dhisgrub brtson 'ga' yang 'di yis bslad/ /mo btsun gtsang sbra can yang 'di yis bslad/ /tso ras tsam yang tsha grang skyob mi nus/ /tsho snum zas bzhin lus zungs skyed mi nus/ /dzo ki'i spyod bzhin grogs su 'khyer mi nus/ /wo brgyal don med mig chu 'dzag par zad/ /zho sogs zhim rgyu bsten kyang bro ba bslad/ /zo mdog mi bde gdon dang nad rims slong / /'o dod bos kyang lha srung 'khor mi nus/ /yo dong g.yang sa lta bu 'di spongs shig /ro langs gdon gyi sna 'dren 'di spongs shig /lo thog sa bcud nyams byed 'di spongs shig /sho dang khram la 'debs byed 'di spongs shig /so dang sems rgyud nag byed 'di spongs shig /ho ho bsam zhing bsam zhing 'gyod dgos pa/ /o chu'i ngan lam ma thal zab cig ang / ’zhes gsungs pas sems thag bcad de tha mag rtsa ba nas 'then mi rung bar bstan pa dang / phyogs mtshungs dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'gor tha mag 'then spyod byas na skye bo'i lus srog longs spyod dang bcas par skyon las dge mtshan med pa'i dpe mtshon tshar du dngar ba bgrangs te kha ba'i ljongs 'di'i skye bo sus kyang de dag longs spyod mi chog pa dang / lhag par phyi'i rgyal khab nas tha mag nang 'dren rtsa ba nas mi chog pa sogs kyi bya thabs snga phyir spel myong ba red/deng dus tshan rig gi shes yon yar rgyas phyin pa'i dbang gis rgyal khab 321

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phyi nang du tshan rig la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas pa mang pos kyang tha mag 'then na skye bo'i tshe srog la 'gal rkyen shin tu che ba yod pa'i skor la rtog 'jug byas pa'i 'bras bu rna bar gzhol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mang po yod pa'i nang nas mtshon byed tsam du gnad don 'ga' shas thur bstan leb chod lta bur 'gyur 'gro ba dper na/ deng rabs tshan rig la brten nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug nan tan byas pa brgyud ra 'phrod byung ba ltar na tha mag gi nang du mi'i phung khams la gnod pa'i dug rigs mi 'dra ba sum cur nye ba yod pa'i khongs su nyi gu ting dang / ching tā chin/ ben ping bi 3 4ar cwa ci ya sha'o ci an/ yi tā than la sogs pa yod pa de dag 'ga' zhig gis glo ba'i skran nad dang / kha nang 'byar skyi'i dkar thig can gyi nad (skran nad la 'gyur sla ba)'byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis klon shin ping zhes pa'i snying nad tshabs che ba dang / klad rtsar khrag rgyugs kyi nad/ glo yu'i tsha nad/ de bzhin glo snying gi nad bcas 'byung ba/ 'ga' zhig gis rgyu ma'i rul nad dang /mig shed shor ba bcas yong zhing / tha mag nang yod pa'i dngos po 'ga' zhig gis mi'i lus kyi bu ga phra mo dang / skyed mched dbang po'i bu ga phra mo bcas rgyud spel gyi ngo bor 'gyur ldog thebs nas mi rabs rjes ma'i phung po'i grub char gnod pa yong ba dang / mngal nang chags pa'i phru gu ya mtshan can du 'gyur ba bcas yong ba dang / tha na tha mag gi du bas gang ba'i khang pa'i nang klon shin ping zer ba'i snying nad tshabs chen yod mkhan zhugs na de'i dug gi nus pas rang gi don snying sgrim pa lta bu'i gzer zug yong sla ba dang / de bzhin nu thung khye'u'i dbugs lam la gnyan kha rgyas pa'i tshad gzhi ldab 'phar 'gro ba sogs tha mag ni mi'i lus khams la shin tu gnod pa'i dug rigs kun 322

tha mag gi gnod pa/bsdus kyi dngos po'am nad gzhi'i 'byung khungs yin pa bcas mdor na mi'i rigs kyi longs spyod du gyur pa'i dngos po'i nang dug rigs sne mang la gnod tshabs che ba'i tha mag la 'gran nus pa'i dngos po gang yang ma 'tshal ba der brten 'dzam gling gi 'phrod bsten sgrig 'dzugs dang / rgyal khab mi nyung ba zhig gis rgya khyab tu tha mag gcod dgos pa'i gnas lugs shugs chen gleng ba ma zad/ tha na khrims lugs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas kyang tha mag 'then mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs bzo bzhin pa bcas 'das dang da lta'i mkhas pas zhib mor dpyad pa'i snying po'i gtam dang / tshan rig gi sdom tshig srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs bcas ni mi'i tshe srog la thug pa'i gnad don chen po 'di 'dra bar bsam gzhigs byas pa zhig las/ khungs lung dang dgos pa med pa ni ci la yin/ nga tshos gnas lugs de tshor shin tu yid rton rung ba dang / ha cang gal 'gangs che bar brtsis te som nyi nem nur gyi 'ching rgya dum bur byas nas 'phral ma nyid du tha mag 'then rgyu rtsa ba nas gcod dgos la de ni bsgrub mi thub pa'i dka' tshegs can gyi bya ba gang yang min pa gtso bor rang la de lta'i chod sems yod med kho nar rag las yin/ de yangapha‘blo dang brtson 'grus yod gyur pa/ /de yis bsgrub par mi nus gang / /dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /skya bseng bu yis bcom zhes thos/ /’’zhes mkhas pas gdams pa ltar ro/ de ltar sems thag chod po dang / 'phral thag chod po'i bya thabs la brten nas tha mag 'then rgyu gtsang mar gcod thub na rang nyid kyi mdun du lhags pa'i dgra bo gtum po las rnam par rgyal ba bzhin gzugs po thang zhing nad med la tshe ring ba dang / blo rig dang dbang po gsal ba/ rang dang khor yug gi gtsang sbra legs pa/ sger gyi dpal 'byor thad kyang gtong mi 'os pa'i 323

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gron dngul cha shas shig bsri tshags thub pa sogs mdor na rang gi lus srog longs spyod gang gi thad la'ang phan 'bras mngon gsal can bgrangs kyis mi langs pa thob rgyu gdon mi za bar brten de rtsis mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs nyes blang dor gyi 'jug sgo ma log pa cis kyang gnang bar 'tshal zhes bcos min dbang med du thal ba'i gtam ni re zhig de tsam lags so/ /smras pa/ka shi'i ras dang kha ba'i lhun po ga pur ltar dkar nga tsho'i lus kyi zla ba '-idir/ / ༷ 0 0ca sing tha mag cha ga'i 'bu yis ja shing la gnod nya gang zla ba gzas 'odzin bzhin/ /0 0 0t+pā ler gnod pa shā ma kha de du dung mi gcod spya mar lus las blun pa ci//pa pir dbyings zhugs pha wang btsog spyod ba ber ngang gnas ma 'ongs '-igyod pa skye ba'i rgyu/ / 0 0 0rtsa bzang spang la tsha ba'i me stag dza drag 'bar mtshungs wa mo rngon 'ded bye thabs dben/ ༷/ ༷ 0zha nye'i bzhin mdangs za ma mi 'gro 'a rdzi de 'dra'i ya ma skran sogs nad skun skye/ / 0 0 0ra gan gser brdzus lar nas spongs shig sha za srin mos sa steng btang baṃ'i rdzas ngan 'di/ /0 ༷ 0ha cang gnod las a cang phan med dug gi sdong po 'bad brtson sta res rgocod par rigs/ ༷/324

shes rig sbrang rtsi 'thung 'dod blo gsar bung ba'i rang sgra/yi ge ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa yin la phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo yang yin/ gangs can yi ge'i byed po mkhas mchog thon mi sasto ṭas/ ‘‘bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/’’zhes rig byed smra ba kun gyi gzhi de yi ge'i sbyor ba la thug pa gsal por bstan pa dang / yang 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtshos/ ‘‘shes rab rgya cher 'phel ba'i sgo/ /thos pa yin pa de yi phyir/ /'bad de thos pa mi 'tshol bar/ /mnog chung bya bas ci zhig bya/’’zhes gsungs pa ltar shes rab rgya cher 'phel ba'i sgo ni thos pa yin na thos pa'i sgo yang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la lta ba'i mig ste yi ge'i sbyor bar rag las/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rang nyid rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing / 'phral yun blang dor gyi 'jug sgo ma log par bya ba mtha' dag bde blag tu bsgrub thub pa'i nus pa ldan pa zhig byed snyam na thog mar yi ge'i sbyor bar don gnyer byed dgos/'jig rten thog gi skye bos 'phral yun gyi phan dang bde ba'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'chi ba med pa'i 'dod yon ji lta ba yong bar 'bad brtson byed/ de lta bu'i 'dod rgu'i longs spyod dbyar gyi chu gter dang / dkar phyogs kyi zla ba'i rjes su 'gro bar deng dus dang mthun pa'i thon skyed dang /325

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dpal 'byor gyi rtsol bar gzhol dgos par shes rig(tshan rig tshud)ni 'gag rtsar thug pa'i gnad don yin pa 'o skol tshang ma'i mthong chos myong gyur ltar 'das pa'i bya ba'i 'gro phyogs kyang de ltar yin la 'byung 'gyur gyi 'gro phyogs kyang de ltar yin no/ /'o na bod kyi rig gnas kyi nang nas gang dang ci zhig la don gnyer byed dgos sam zhe na/ sgra tshad bzo gso nang don ste rig gnas che ba lnga ni shes bya'i khyab khongs shin tu rgya che la gting dpog par dka' ba rgya mtsho dang mtshungs par rnam dpyod shes rab kyi gru chen la brten cing / rtag sbyor brtson 'grus kyi skya bas rgyun mi chad du bskul te yangs pa'i klong chen nang zhugs na rang re'i re ba'i nor bu ci dgar len thub pa ni bsngags 'os pa'i gnas yin pa gor ma chagabacu phrag gnas lnga rig pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi rnam grangs brjod kyi mi langs pas srid pa'i khyon 'dir brtan g.yo'i sri zhur sman pa'i rlabs po che'i dngos po thogs med du skrun par thog mar 'phrul 'khor de dag bar med du bskor ba'i sgul shugs shig dgos pa shig ni yi ge'i sbyor ba brda sprod pa'i rig pa de yin/ de yang gzur gnas skye bo sus kyang bsnyon du med pa mkhan po bka' drin can thon mi'i mkhyen rlabs 'ba' zhig las 'khrungs pa'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad yod par grags pa nas da lta nga tsho'i 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du gyur pa sum rtags kyi gzhung 'di gnyis yod/sum rtags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mthar son pa byas na/ pho mo ma ning gi yi ge'i rtags tshul bzhin dbye ba dang / rnam dbye dang tshig phrad tshul bzhin sbyor ba bdag gzhan dus gsum dang / bya byed las gsum gyi 'jug pa tshul bzhin yong thub pas ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa'i brjod don gsal 326

shes rig sbrang rtsi 'thung 'dod blo gsar bung ba'i rang sgra/por 'bri ba dang / klog pa/ rtogs thub pas dmus long gi skyes bur 'dren byed gsar du thob pa dang gnyis su med/ gal srid rig pa'i gnas der byang cha ma thon par rig pa'i gnas gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ ‘‘chu 'thag glang gi mig de yol bas bsgribs/ nyin gang song yang dgong mo sa der lus/ ’zhes pa'i brtul zhugs ltar du 'gyur nges pas na rang dang rang 'dra'i skye bo rnams dang / lhag par gzhon nu rnams kyis gnad don 'di thog mar nges par du dam 'dzin dgos pa yin snyam/brda sprod pa'i rig pa'i gnas rang dbang du byas pa'i rjes su mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la zhugs te rang rang gang la mos pa'i brtsam bya'i brjod don shin tu 'jebs pa rang mgu ba dang gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du brjod don lus phra ma lta bur mtshon na de la rnam par bkra ba'i gos bzang po dang / rin po che'i rigs kyi rnam mang rgyan gyis spud ma thag de bas mdzes phul che bar gyur te sred ldan gzhon nu'i yid dbang cig car du phrogs nus pa dang / de min brjod don shin tu zab pa sgeg mo'i lang tsho'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs rung / snyan ngag tshig sbyor gyi rnam bkra'i gos dang rgyan gyis dben pa rang bzhin sgren mo'i ngang tshul dag gis skye bo'i yid dbang 'gug mi nus pas yi ge'i tshig sbyor snyan pa'i ngag tu grub pa de la snyan ngag ces su grags pa de'i gzhung lugs la yang nan tan chen pos slob sbyong byed dgos/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos la ni lus rgyan skyon sel gsum ste lus la bcad lhug spel ma gsum dang / rgyan la don rgyan/ sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan dang gsum/ skyon sel dgos pa bcu/ sbyor tshul la grol ba/ rigs mdzod/ 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i dbye ba bzhi bcas yod la nang gses kyi dbye 327

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ba shin tu mang ba yod/ 'di lta bu'i snyan ngag gi rig pa ni shin tu gal 'gangs che ba'i thad dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ ‘‘mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min/ /mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/ ’zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang snyan ngag ni bcad lhug spel ma'i rtsom tsam la go bar byas na da dung khyab chung drags pas rtsod skabs dang / zur za shags 'debs/ phan tshun mol mchid/ tha na rnam kun gleng mol tshun chad la tshig snga phyi 'brel chags shing / tshig dang don la skyon med pa sus kyang go sla ba snyan pa'i ngag gi nyams rtsol med du thon par 'gyur ba de yang snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor 'ba' zhig la rag las pa bcas mkhas pas gdams pa de tshor yid ches skye ba byas te snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs la 'bad brtson chen pos don gnyer bya rgyu ni blo ldan gyi skye bo spyi dang bye brag gzhon nu tshos de bas do snang chen po byed dgos/gzhan yang mngon brjod dang / sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar skar rtsis la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas gzhan la'ang rang rang skabs su gang babs kyi sbyong brdar byed dgos pa mang po yod pa re zhig zhu rgyu de tsam lags so/ /mtshams 'dir/ ci 'di 'phrul 'khor sgul shugs glog rlabs sam/ /yang na rnam dpyod rtsal 'byed rig pa'i gnas/ /'dod rgu'i dpal yon ci bsam skrun pa'i phyir/ /rdzas sbyor bem po'i glog min nges pa rnyed/ /brtan g.yo'i rlangs 'khor khyu mchog stobs po che/ /bkol la ches bsngags gnas lnga rig pa yi/ kha lo pa dang glang rdzi rgan po 'dis/ /ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs la shis pa bsgrubs/ /328

shes rig sprang rtsi 'thung 'dod blo gsar bung ba'i rang sgra/tshul ji lta bus yon tan kun gyi gzhi yi ge'i sbyor ba nas 'go brtsams te rig pa'i gnas la sbyong brdar byed dgos sam zhe na/ ji skad du/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes‘rtag gus brtson pa ma btang na/ /mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ /chu thigs rtag tu 'bab pa yis/ /brag gi ri bo 'big la ltos/’’zhes dang / 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtshos/ ‘‘brtson pa dag dang bral gyur na/ /don chung yin yang 'grub par dka'/ /brtson 'grus ldan na yon tan kun/ /rang gi lag na gnas dang mtshungs/’ zhes dang / 'jig rten gyi gtam dper yang / ‘‘snal mas lcags gcod ’zer ba bcas don rdor dril na srid pa'i bya ba spyi dang lhag par shes bya'i gnas la don gnyer bya rgyur 'gag rtsar thug pa'i gnad don ni rang nyid la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gyi brtson 'grus yod med de yin/ gal te rang nyid la dus tshod skar cha tsam yang 'phro brlag mi gtong ba'i chod sems yod pa dang / rtag sbyor brtson 'grus dang ldan na srid pa'i bya ba gang zhig yin rung nges par du 'grub pa ji ltar chu thigs phra la 'jam pa des kyang dus ji zhig na ri bo 'bigs nus pa dang mtshungs shing /de las ldog ste sgyid lug le lo'i dbang du song na phra mo'i don yang 'grub dka' bar gdams pa de ni nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas kyang nyin re bzhin ra sprod byed bzhin yod do/ mtshams 'dir/ zab yangs rig gzhung rgya mtsho cher/ /bshes gnyen ded dpon la brten cing / /brtson 'grus skya ba dang 'grogs na/ /dgos 'dod nor bu cis mi lon/ /'on tang sgyid lug dbang song skye bo la/ /yon tan rdul tsam gos pa cang srid dam/ /byang bstan phug par srid pa'i sgron me yi/ /snang ba mi 'jug dngos po'i gshis su grub/ /329

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lhag par skabs 'di dang bstun nas gleng 'os pa zhig ni/ deng dus gzhon nu mang che ba yon tan slob sbyong la dang zhen che ba dang / ya rabs gus zhabs dang ldan la spyod pa bzang ba/ blo gros shes bya'i nor gyis phyug pa/tshan rig lag rtsal khong du chud pa bcas 'thab phyogs khag so so'i mig rgyan du gyur la bod rigs mi dmangs kyi phugs re bcol yul ngo gnong mi dgos pa khri stong mang po char rjes kyi sgyug rtsa ji bzhin 'tshar longs yong dang yong bzhin yod/ 'on kyang gzhon nu'i khrod kyi nyung shas shig ni tshul de las yongs su ldog ste shes yon sbyong brdar la dang zhen rtsa ba nas med par bag med pa'i rtsed 'jos dus 'da' ba dang / lhag par dus dang dus ma yin pa'i dbye ba dang mtshams tshig med par myos 'gyur spyod cing / ci dgar rol nas dus 'da' ba bcas gzhon nu'i dus su rig gzhung slob gnyer byed pa'i du sa skabs bzang po slar yong rgyu med pa gser dang 'dra ba don med chud zos su gtong ba de ni snying la na tsha gtong dgos pa'i don gnad cig ma red dam/nga tsho'i mes po tshos bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel slad du rang nyid kyi gces pa'i srog dang / gser sogs rin po che bgrangs kyi mi langs bar brten te dka' ba khri stong spyad nas bsgrubs pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bus kyang cha tsam bsgrun du med pa'i rig gzhung phun sum tshogs pa su la'ang smon mi dgos pa nga tsho'i phyi rabs pa tshor 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i bka' drin ci 'dra byas te bsab thub bam/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu dang yongs su gcig mthun yin pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi nang don gtso che ba'i rig gnas 'dzugs skrun dang mthun phyug shes rig ldan pa'i bod gsar 'dzugs skrun bcas ni gtam stong pa zhig tu mi 330

shes rig sbrang rtsi 'thung 'dod blo gsar bung ba'i rang sgra/'gyur grang / da dung de bas gal che ba zhig ni spun zla mi rigs dang phyi rgyal ba mang pos kyang bod kyi rig par spro ba chen pos slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa bcas 'di lta'i gnas skabs su kha ba'i ljongs kyi dbyig 'dzin gyi lte bar 'khod pa'i bod rigs rang nyid kyis slob sbyong bya rgyur 'bad brtson mi byed pa go med tshor med du dus 'da' ba ni shin tu ngo tsha ba'i gnas bcas bsam pa'i 'char sgo ci byung gi tshig 'ga' zhu thal song bar nongs pa mchis na mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar bzod gsol zhu rgyu las ma 'das so/ /mtshams 'dir/ thos pa'i grwa ru ma zhugs gtsug lag gi /dgongs don ma bsam yang dag rig pa'i gnas/ /goms par ma byas deng dus gzhon nu 'ga'/ /kye hud mi tshe stong zad 'gro bar gzigs/ /khyed rnams bsgo ba rnar gzon rig gnas la/ /rgyab phyogs bag yangs bzhed na shis gyur cig /bdag cag mkhas pa'i rjes su 'jug 'dod rnams//phyi phyag btsal te thos pa sgrub par smon/ /'di ni dam pa'i zhabs sen spyi bo ru/ /'degs pa'i skal thob kho bo'i mchu sgros kyi/ /mya ngan med pa'i me tog 'dzum dbar nas/ /'thul ba'i bcos min gtam gyi bsung zhim tsam/ /331

chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po yab sras kyis mdzad pa snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab so so'i mjug bsdoms don bsdus tshigs bcad khol du byung ba/༵༵ sdo/dab dang po/ rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i don bsdus tshigs gang zhig dul ba'i glang po glang mo'i dris/ /rgod pa glang rdzis ma yin rgyud 'dul la/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces glang rdzi'i tshig gis ni/ /dang por thugs bskyed sa skyong rab gsal lo/ /yal 'dab gnyis pa/ dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa/brtse ldan dga' ma rang gi lus smad dag /slong ba'i re skong rlabs chen gtong phod kyis/ /ma bskul lha dbang bdud rtsis lus gsos nas/ /332

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/ma 'bod btsun mor reg thob dpal gyi sde/ /yal 'dab gsum pa/ gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa/gang zhig lus dang dga' ma sras dang bcas/ /btang zhing dben pa bsten kyang dgra zla yis/ /lhan skyes gtsug nor blangs pa bden pa'i mthus/ /slar gsos rgyal srid legs skyong gtsug na nor/ /yal 'dab bzhi pa/ nga las nu yi rtogs pa brjod pa/gang zhig dag pa'i mchod pa sran ma'i grangs/ /gling bzhi lha gnas la dbang dpal ldan pa/ /ma dag sems kyi 'gyu ba phra mo'i mdas/ /dbang po'i stan phab dpal ldan nga las nu/ /yal 'dab lnga pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/bsod nams rgya mtsho las byung sa bdag gi/ /gtong ba'i 'od dkar ma bzod drag po'i mig /sgrub pa'i rdzas su sgro btags yan lag mchog /slong ba'i re ba bsgrub brtson zla ba'i 'od/ /yal 'dab drug pa/ ba da ra'i gling du 'gro ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/skye rgu'i phongs pa sel ba'i dam bca'i khur/ /ri dbang ltar lci phrag par rab bkod nas/ /dka' spyad du mas yid bzhin nor blangs te/ /'dod rgu'i char 'bebs ded dpon shin tu dga'/ /yal 'dab bdun pa/ mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa/333

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dang sku'i snang brnyan/ /skal bar thob pas bran mo mi bdag gi /bu mor gyur dang lhan cig rgyun zhugs 'bras/ /bde blag thob pa mu tig 'khri shing ngo / /yal 'dab brgyad pa/ dpal sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/zad byed grogs su bsten las mtshams med pa/ /me dug sbyor bas ston pa'i skur bsdo ba/ /brtse bas rjes bzung rkyen ngan grogs su khugs/ /chos kyi mig thob khyim bdag dpal sbas so/ /yal 'dab dgu pa/ me skyes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rgyal bas lung bstan dor nas bhu ri ka'i/ /bab col bden 'dzin rab bzang rmongs pa'i blos/ /gtses pa'i me dpung las grol rang gi bu/ /gtan bde'i dpal la spyod pa me skyes so/ /yal 'dab bcu pa/ mngal nas 'byung ba bstan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/dkar nag las kyis phangs pa'i sa bon las/ /skye ba nas bzung phyi ma'i lam bar gyi/ /mi bzad nyon mongs bstan dang lhan cig tu/ /thar pa'i lam 'jug rgyal bas mngal 'byung bstan/ /yal 'dab bcu gcig pa/ mdzes dga' bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ma bskul yang yang tshangs par spyod cig ces/ /ma byas brtse bas gdams kyang dga' ma'i ro/ /334

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/ma phod dmyal me'i tsha rlabs ma bzod pa//ma bris bslab pa'i ris bkra mdzes dga' bo/ /yal 'dab bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'bangs mo'i bu zhes smod pa'i tshig phra mo/ /ma bzod shākya bdun khri bu mor bcas/ /bcom pa'i yam shing la 'bar me'i klong du/ /sbyin sreg rdzas su gyur pa 'phags skyes po/ /yal 'dab bcu gsum pa/ 'phrog ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa/lnga brgya'i nang nas bu gcig mi snang ba'i/ /smre ngag stong gsum sgrogs kyang grong khyer gyi/ /bu kun bza' la ji mi snyam pa'i sems/ /'dren pas bslab gzhi'i rgyar btsud 'phrog byed ma/ /yal 'dab bcu bzhi pa/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/me khyer snang bas 'jig rten kun khyab kyi/ /nyi mar 'gran 'dod mu stegs ston pa drug /rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul gzi brjid ma bzod pa/ /khung bu skyabs su 'cha' ba ga zha'i gnas/ /yal 'dab bco lnga pa/ lha las babs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/nyan thos skal ldan shing rtas rin chen gyi/ /lam gsum skas las spyan drangs 'gro ba yi/ /skom pa'i gdung sel 'dren mchog gser ldan ma/ /lha las babs pa'i ngo mtshar brjod mi lang / /335

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yal 'dab bcu drug pa/ brag nges par 'phangs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/stobs chen gyad kyis cha tsam sgul min rdo/ /zhabs sor yang mor g.yo bas srid rtse'i bar/ /'phangs shing slar bsdus ngo mtshar 'gyed dang lhan/ /gyad rnams smin pa'i mdzad pa brag nges 'phangs/ /yal 'dab bcu bdun pa/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/dpya la 'khren pa mang bkur rgyal po des/ /rin chen mchod sdong lha chur 'phangs pa yi/ /ngo mtshar gzigs mo slar yang 'gyed dang lhan/ /ma 'ongs rnam 'dren byams pa lung yang bstan/ /yal 'dab bco brgyad pa/ me long bzhin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mdze mo'i sbyin 'bras brnag pa gsal rgyal la/ /byang chub spyod par ma gzhol sbyin pa yis/ /zhi ba'i bdud rtsi rnyed par mi 'gyur zhes/ /me long bzhin gyi gsung gis gsal bar gdams/ /yal 'dab bcu dgu pa/ shā ri'i bu rab tu byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/tshangs par spyod phyir chen po'i rigs btang ste/ /khab ltar rno ba'i shes rab dang ldan par/ /'gyur ba'i smon lam de de bzhin gyur pa/ /shes rab mchog gyur 'phags pa shā ri'i bu/ /yal 'dab nyi shu pa/ gro bzhin bye ba rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'od srungs rin chen gyis mchod de yis ni/ /336

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/rna rgyan bye ba rir gyur des kyang ni/ /rgya mtshor nges 'byung nor bu lon pa des/ /mchog gi nor bu brnyes pa bye ba rna/ /yal 'dab nyer gcig pa/ a mra skyong ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ma 'grogs a mra'i sdong po las skyes shing / /ma 'bod gzugs can snying po'i ror chags pa/ /ma bslab mkhas pa 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i yum/ /ma bskul bsngags 'os a mra skyong ma'o//yal 'dab nyer gnyis pa/ rgyal byed tshal bzung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/mardzas mdzes rgyal ba'i mtshan thos sngar goms mthu/ /mang mang mgon med zas byin gyis sad nas/ /mang mang skyabs gnas bsti ba'i gtsug lag khang / /mdzes mdzes bskrun pa rgyal byed tshal bzung mdzad//yal 'dab nyer gsum pa/ yab sras mjal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'char ka'i pho nyas drangs pa 'gro ba'i sgron/ /n+yagro dhar phebs yab sogs lha mi'i tshogs/ /rab dga'i skal bzang pad mo bzhad dang lhan/ /ngo mtshar 'bras bu'i bsung 'gyed yab sras mjal/ /yal 'dab nyer bzhi pa/ thams cad sgrol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/srid la zhen pa bla mas bskrad gyur kyang / /gtong sems ri dbang ltar brtan dga' ma bu/ /thams cad gzhan gdung sgrol slad btang ba yi/ /337

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ngo mtshar lta la dbang pos mig stong bgrad/ /yal 'dab nyer lnga pa/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/skye rga na 'chi'i lcag gis nges 'byung rta/ /zhi ba'i lam zhugs sgo srung mdzes mar bcas/ /sus kyang ma zlog rlabs chen mdzad pa gang / /bsam gyin dad pas mig nas mchi ma 'chor/ /yal 'dab nyer drug pa/ bdud bcom pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/mdzes mdzes sgeg mo'i bslu brid rab rno'i mtshon/ /mang mang deg sogs lus med cho 'phrul kun/ /gang gang sgyu mar gzigs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'jigs 'jigs bdud bzhi bcom pa'i mdzad pa rmad/ /yal 'dab nyer bdun pa/ shākya byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rigs rgyud rgyu skar dbus na mngon 'phags zla/ /shākya'i rigs kyi byung ba mong gal bus/ /gsung gi byin rlabs 'od dkar 'gyed pa des/ /'gro kun rab dga'i sa mos tshal kun bzhad/ /yal 'dab nyer brgyad pa/ gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu'i rtogs pa brjod pa/hrul po'i gos bcas rnam gzigs mchod pa'i mthur/ /lha bas lhag pa'i longs spyod lus rin chen/ /rkang brten lha yi gos g.yogs gro bzhin skyes/ /rnam grol 'bras mthong sbyin la mi spro su//yal 'dab nyer dgu pa/ nor skyong gi rtogs pa brjod pa/338

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/lhas byin dug myos rbad pa'i nor skyong glang / /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin lhar skyes lhas byin ni/ /ngo tsha'i mtshor lhungs dga' bo rgyal ba dang/ /'bral med 'grogs pa'i ngo mtshar cig car bstan/ /yal 'dab sum cu pa/ kā shi mjes pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/gang dag dug dang bdud rtsi lhan skyes ltar/ /gang yang dben par spyod la dus kyi sa/ /gang dag zhe sdang dug ni bzod pa'i blos/ /gang yang bdud rtsir 'gyur ba kā shi mdzes/ /yal 'dab so gcig pa/ gser gyi logs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rin chen sems kyi rang bzhin rang lus dang / /zla 'od rmi lam du yang 'gog med du/ /'char zhing mi yi skad du chos smra ba/ /bsam bzhin ri dwags srid bzung gser gyi logs/ /yal 'dab so gnyis pa/ dge byed kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/dge byed tshogs mchog mig dag mi dge byed/ /gdong drug gya gyus phyung yang khro med pa/ /u mas ma bskul bden pas mig dga' ma/ /rang gir mdzad pa phyag 'os rdo rje'i mchu/ /yal 'dab so gsum pa/ khyad par lo ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa/srog la thug pa'i chung ma yan lag nyams/ /srog las gces par bskyangs mod ma rungs blos/ /339

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/srog la rgol phyir 'phangs kyang khyad par lo/ /srog las gces par pu skar bdag por bkur/ /yal 'dab so bzhi pa/ dga' bo nyer dga'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ma zhig lhun po lus kyi thag pas bcings/ /ma bud dug rlung stong gsum spro ba'i klu/ /ma nyal bskal par gnyid 'byams ma rig bcas/ /ma bskul brtse bas sangs pa dga' nyer dga'/ /yal 'dab so lnga pa/ khyim bdag legs sbyin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/sngon du ma bkur khro ba'i myu gu 'bus/ /rdo char 'od kyis zil mnan rgyal po'i gtsug /khyim bdag rkang bkod bsod nams khyad par can/ /rgyal bas rjes bzung legs sbyin rab tu byung / /yal 'dab so drug pa/ gdangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rang bzhin bzang po sa 'og gnas na yang / /nga ro'i 'od kyis rtogs pa sa le sbram/ /sred pa'i g.ya' yis ma gos gtong ba che/ /rab zhi'i mchod stong rgyur grub gdangs can no/ /yal 'dab so bdun pa/ gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa/gang zhig bu dang chung mas rab spangs rje/ /gang yang sri zhus gnyen gyur 'bangs mo'i bu/ /gang dag don mthun gdengs can skyobs pa'i gnyen/ /gang po tshur shog dbugs dbyung rgyal ba'i sras/ /340

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/yal 'dab so brgyad pa/ lkugs pa 'phye bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rgyal srid lan tshwas ma bslad rab zhi'i chu/ /spyod pa'i dam bca' yab kyis lhur bzhes na/ /ci 'dod smra ba dka' ba yod min zhes/ /thabs kyis dben par zhugs pa lkugs phye'o/ /yal 'dab so dgu pa/ bzod pa la dga' ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/chung ma'i gus btud bdag pos dgrar mthong ste/ /yan lag dum bur bcad kyang khro med pa/ /bzod dga' bden pas lus gsos rtsod ldan lus/ /chu bur gyis gtses dmyal bar skad cig lhungs/ /yal 'dab bzhi bcu pa/ ser skya'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rgyal ba'i sras la ngan smras lce brgya pa/ /mi sdug mgo yi dri mar bcas pa'i gshis/ /rgyal gsung ke tas grungs byas dwangs gtsang gi /zhi ba'i bdud rtsir 'gyur thob ser skya'o/ /yal 'dab zhe gcig pa/ u tra ya na'i rtogs pa brjod pa/mdza' 'phrin don zhags kyis drangs rgyal ba'i sku'i/ /pir ris yid 'phrog khab thob dga' ba 'bum/ /ma bzod pha bsad ha ri btsun mor bcas/ /mi bzad rdul gyis tshar bcad u tra na/ /yal 'dab zhe gnyis pa/ mkhas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'jig rten rgud pa'i nyam ngar lhung yang sngon/ /341

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dbul min dbul po'i rtsa lag nyid gyur ces/ /bden pa'i smon lam sa las brtol ba'i 'bras/ /kun la ci dgar 'gyed pa mkhas pa gzhon/ /yal 'dab zhe gsum pa/ gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa/mi'u thung sgyu mas slong ba'i gom gang pas/ /sa gsum dbang du byas par snyems mi 'tshal/ /'di na gser mdog dad pas kham gang zas/ /phul bas stong gsum rin chen bkang la ltos/ /yal 'dab zhe bzhi pa/ gser gyi lag pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'od srungs zhing la kan+das gser brnyan son/ /mngon btab bsod nams drod gsher gyis rgyas pa/ /gser lag snye mar nyi ma re rer yang / /dngul dkar 'bras bu 'bum zags skye rgu'i gsos/ /yal 'dab zhe lnga pa/ ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/lhas byin nag po brtsegs pa dang 'grogs pas/ /rang gzhan dge ba'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i gzis/ /pha bsad ma skyes dgra yang rgyal ba yis/ /'gyod bsal mdo yis thar pa'i sman du mdzad/ /yal 'dab zhe drug pa/ byas shes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/yid bzang 'o mtshor dug dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lhan skyes byas shes bdud rtsi'i mdzes pa'i spyan/ /gcig shos dug gis bcom pa mthong ma thag /342

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/ma bzod mnar med drag pos hub kyis drangs/ /yal 'dab zhe bdun pa/ sā la'i sdong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa/chos kyi grogs la dregs pas khro min te/ /khyod kyang zhing sa rang rgyal mchod pa'i mthur/ /'di ltar gyur ces sā la'i sdong po'i khong / /bur shing mngar bas 'dzum dkar ston min nam/ /yal 'dab zhe brgyad pa/ don kun grub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/dmigs med 'gro la brtse ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /mtha' med rgya mtshor gcig pus stobs bskyed nas/ /'gran med yid bzhin nor bu blangs pa des/ /'dzad med nor gyis dbul sel don kun grub/ /yal 'dab zhe dgu pa/ glang po can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rtsed chas shing glang rgyal bar phul ba'i mthu/ /dus su bdo ba khyo shug ba ku la'i/ /mdza' ba'i me tog gser glang mche ba yi/ /bu mo'i 'gram chang gis bzhad glang po can/ /yal 'dab lnga bcu pa/ las bcu spyad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ci byas las kyi 'bras bu rang lus dang / /grib ma bzhin 'breng zhi la 'bad cig ces/ /thub mchog mi yi seng ges las lhag ma'i/ /'jug pa bcu yi mdzad pa gsal bar bstan/ /yal 'dab nga gcig pa/ gser ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/343

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gser ldan nu mas bkres mo tshim min zhes/ /snying stobs mchog dang bden pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /bya dang stag mor lus sbyin bsod nams lcid/ /gser ldan dga' mas 'degs bzod e ma mtshar /yal 'dab nga gnyis pa/ bsod nams mi dman pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'jig rten 'khon gyi gzhi ma 'di 'o zhes/ /rgyal srid btang nas shing shun rtswa'i spyil bur/ /gnas kyang dgra zla'i gtso bos phyag dang bcas/ /srid la dbang bskur bsod nams mi dman pa/ /yal 'dab nga gsum pa/ legs bshad 'tshol ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/legs bshad 'tshol la lhag bsam dkar ba'i blos/ /legs bshad ster gyi re ba yongs bkang ste/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi ci dgar gsol ba'i mthu/ /legs bshad 'tshol gyis bla med byang chub thob//yal 'dab nga bzhi pa/ sems can sman gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/gang zhig mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis kyang / /'gro ba'i zug rdu sel la nga 'o zhes/ /srog bral lus kyi gzi brjid ma nyams par/ /gzhan don skyo med sgrub mkhas sems can sman/ /yal 'dab nga lnga pa/ thams cad ster ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/phug ron mi'u thung sgyu ma'i bslu thabs kyis/ /'phrul gyi srang la sa gsum lus song yang / /344

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/ma zhum snying stobs dbang po skyengs byed pa/ /sngon med stobs ldan mi bdag thams cad ster/ /yal 'dab nga drug pa/ klu ba lang skyong btul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/skye 'gro'i lus srog nyam chung tri tri'i 'bras/ /ma rungs blo yis spyod la goms pa dag /rnam 'dren thugs rje'i mkha' lding gshog rtse'i rlabs/ /skad cig g.yo bas dul ba ba glang skyong / /yal 'dab nga bdun pa/ mchod rten gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ci 'di mkha' la rgyu skar 'char ba'am/ /yang na rgyal ba'i mchod rten bsam mi khyab/ /sil sil dril bu'i sgra las dam pa'i chos /phyogs kun rna bar sgrogs 'dis skar tshogs min/ /yal 'dab nga brgyad pa/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/bsod nams dman pa'i nad par phan btags pa'i/ /bsod nams brtag pa dbang po'i mig long bar/ /bsod nams stobs kyi brtse bas mig byin pas/ /bsod nams mig gi bdud rtsi kun la 'o/ /yal 'dab nga dgu pa/ ku tā la'i rtogs pa brjod pa/me tog mda' mtshon snying khar phog pa'i zug /ma bzod spring yig snyung bus 'big pa'i spyan/ /khro med bden pa'i bdud rtsis khyad par bcas/ /spyan zung thob pa rgyal sras ku tā la/ /345

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yal 'dab drug cu pa/ klu gzhon nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rgya mtshor gnas kyang bye tshan rta gdong mes/ /rgyun mar gtses pa'i gdengs can rgyal ba'i zlar/ /skyabs song thugs rje'i 'od dkar 'bum bkye bas/ /gtan bde'i bsil ba thob pa klu gzhon nu/ /yal 'dab re gcig pa/ zhing pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rtsol bcas gang btab zhing la de de'i 'bras/ /thob pa'ang dka' mod rtsol med bsod nams zhing / /bkur las gser dang dgra bcom 'bras bzang po/ /cig car thob pa'i zhing pa bkra shis tsam/ /yal 'dab re gnyis pa/ grags sbyin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rab sad khro bas blangs pa ngo mtshar bu/ /mdzes mar ma chags rab byung la zhen pa/ /bkag kyang yangs por rgyu ba rgyal ba'i mthur/ / tshur shog dgra mngon bcom pa grags sbyin no/ /yal 'dab re gsum pa/ 'od srungs chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ci ste mngon par 'byung las bzlog ce na/ /rab mdzes gser gyi bu mo 'di lta stsol/ /'on kyang 'dod pa las lhag bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /tshangs spyod khrims las 'da' min 'od srungs che/ /yal 'dab re bzhi pa/ nor bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa/skye mang mdza' ba goms pa'i don zhags kyis/ /346

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/drangs pa'i yid 'phrog rtse dgar rol dang lhan/ /ma lus skye rgu chos bzhin skyong ba'i mthus/ /rdzogs ldan khengs pa bsnyil ba nor bu bzang //yal 'dab re lnga pa/ rwa gcig pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rwa gcig gser mdog rab mdzes thub pa'i bu/ /yid gnyis 'ching thag mdza' ba'i gris bcad nas/ /sgo gsum rtsal sprugs mdzes ma'i sgyu thabs kyis/ /sde bzhi'i bdag por dbang bskur srid pa'i gar/ /yal 'dab re drug pa/ snyan dngags mkhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mtshan mkhan gtam mda' snying la bsnun pa'i zug /ma bzod srog la rgol ba'i mtshan mo rgyu/ /dpa' ba'i dpung dang rno ba'i mtshon med pa/ /ha nu'i sgyu mas gzhom nus snyan dngags mkhan/ /yal 'dab re bdun pa/ dge 'dun srungs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/thar lam rgya mtshor bgrod thengs gcig kho nar/ /srog sbyin nor dang chos ston nges 'byung nor/ /lam ston nor bu rang nyid dgra mngon bcom/ /rmad byung nor bu kun thob dge 'dun srungs/ /yal 'dab re brgyad pa/ pad+ma ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mdzes ma'i rkang pas mya ngan med bzhin du/ /gang bkod rkang pa'i pad+mo tshangs byin gyi/ /sems nyid bcud 'dzin mya ngan med bsgrubs pa/ /347

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mi bsrun glang pos ma bcom pad+ma ldan/ /yal 'dab re dgu pa/ chos rgyal rab gnas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/legs byas rta bdun gyis drangs stobs bcu pa'i/ /mchod sdong srid pa'i mig rab 'byed dang lhan/ /dge sbyong rgan po'i zhi ba'i pad+mo yang / /bzhad pa'i bsung 'gyed chos rgyal rab gnas so/ /yal 'dab bdun cu pa/ nyi ma gung pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/mi'u thung gom gcig slong bas sa gsum ni/ /shor bas stobs ldan gdungs dang mi 'dra ba/ /khyod kyi skyil krung kha che'i sa chen po/ /klu bcas bsod nams zhing bsgrubs nyi ma gung / /yal 'dab don gcig pa/ shā na'i gos can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/phyag sor reg pas bro nad drungs phyung ba'i/ /rang rgyal sri zhur 'jug tshe tha mal gos/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog dag pa'i smon lam mthus/ /shā na'i gos can 'gro ba'i sman pa mchog /yal 'dab don gnyis pa/ nyer sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/tshogs gnyis rgya che bzang po'i sman gyi spos/ /khams gsum 'gro la ci dgar 'gyed mdzad pas/ /sgeg mo dran pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /rab zhi'i bsung 'gyed 'phags pa nyer sbas so/ /yal 'dab don gsum pa/ klu la spring yig btang ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/348

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/gdengs can bsod nams bya sgro ltar yang bas/ /dpag med mchod sbyin bsod nams lhun po la/ /'gran min srang gi gzhal mthar rgyal po'i bka'/ /klu la spring nus mya ngan med kho na/ /yal 'dab don bzhi pa/ sa gzhi phul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/bye ba phrag brgya'i gser mchod dge 'dun la/ /byed pa'i dam bca' phun tshogs ser sna'i mdud/ /ma grol sa gzhi'i mchod pa slar spro bas/ /sbyin pa'i mthar son mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ /yal 'dab don lnga pa/ rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rtogs pa brjod pa/srid pa'i 'khor lo bar med 'khor ba yi/ /rtsa ba ma rig pa la rag las phyir/ /snga ma snga ma'i rgyu ni phyi ma yis/ /rim gyis 'gag pas grol ba rten 'brel chos/ /yal 'dab don drug pa/ bi du ra'i rtogs pa brjod pa/'di lta'i bya bar gzhar yang mi 'jug ces/ /mchog min ston bzhin bi du ra yi lus/ /mi sdug grangs med srin bu'i mchu rnon gyis/ /gtses pa'i sdug bsngal bsams tshe snying yang 'gas/ /yal 'dab don bdun pa/ ke ne ya ka'i rtogs pa brjod pa/rgyal ba nyi mas thub pa ke ne ya/ /rjes su bzung slad thogo mar rgyal chen bzhir/ / 349

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dam chos snang ba'i dga' ston 'gyed ma thag /thub pa rab zhi'i pad+mo lhug por grol/ /yal 'dab don brgyad pa/ brgya byin lhung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/log par dad sel mchod las skabs gsum gtso'i/ /dpal la longs spyod dus mtha' 'di 'o zhes/ /'chi ltas lngas 'doms mya ngan ston pa yis/ /legs par bsal ba brgya byin lhung las skyabs/ /yal 'dab don dgu pa/ dbang chen sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa/gzhan phyir longs spyod rgyal srid rang lus bcas/ /gang gang thabs kyis skye rgu'i rgud pa'i mtha' /sel ba'i mdzad pas dgra zla'ang yid phrogs te/ /slar yang rgyal srid la bkur dbang chen sde/ /yal 'dab brgyad cu pa/ rab bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa/rab mang 'gro rnams smin par mdzad pa'i lhag /rab bzang rab dga'i thos 'dzin yol go ni/ /rab snyan gsung gi bdud rtsis 'geng ba de/ /rab mdzes gzugs sku tha ma'i mdzad pa'o/ /yal 'dab gya gcig pa/ rgyu'i mchog gi rtogs pa brjod pa/'di yis mi dmigs ting 'dzin zhi rig gi /gzugs sku'i zug rngur bsung 'thul byug phul rgyus/ /des der bde gshegs ye shes nges rnyed ces/ /bzod sgrogs mchog thob bstod 'os tshong dpon bsod/ /350

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/yal 'dab gya gnyis pa/ dmyal ba mngon ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/za zir bya ba 'gog pa'i ma'i mgo bo/ /'a 'ur chags pas ral gri'i sor bkod de/ /tshab tshub bstan la zhugs kyang dmyal ba'i mes/ /tsham tshom med par srid pa'i go cha bsregs/ /yal 'dab gya gsum pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/grags 'dzin mngal gyi brtse bas ma btang min/ /sgra gcan 'dzin yang mngal la 'khyud min te/ /lo drug dku nang gnas pa'i sngon gyi las/ /rang rang bkra ba'i ri mo rgyal bas gsungs/ /yal 'dab gya bzhi pa/ sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/dpag med bsod nams mngal gyis bskrun pa'i lus/ /rin chen rgyan dang sbrang rtsi'i char bcas pas/ /dge slong srog skyabs lhan cig chom rkun yang / /rjes bzung bdud rtsi mnga' brnyes sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs/ /yal 'dab gya lnga pa/ phan pa 'tshol ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa/gang dag nad mnar rnams la sman dang zas/ /gang la gang 'tshams lhag par rang khrag dang / /rang la 'bad brgyas rab sbyar sman bzang yang / /rang dgar btang la phangs bral gzhan phan mtshan/ /yal 'dab gya drug pa/ ba men gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/gser rir gnas bcas 'dab chags gser 'gyur bzhin/ /351

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/byang sems mched bzhis rgan rim brtags nas bkur/ /bslab par gnas pa'i brtul zhugs der brtson pa'i/ /yon tan skye bos gleng sgra'ang sa gsum khyab/ /yal 'dab gya bdun pa/ pad+ma can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mdza' smra rtags can ma dang drag sngags mas/ /chags par 'bad sgra gang la'ang ma rag par/ /bcas las ma btang chags bral bslab pa dang / /rgyal bar rang gzhan dad pa pad ma can/ /yal 'dab gya brgyad pa/ nag pa glang po stan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/'dod chags gzeb nang tshud pa'i nyon mongs kyis/ /yid 'byung mkha' la gshog sgyur bye'u chung / /slar yang mdzes ma'i mig rgyas bcings pa las/ /grol te zhi ba'i mkhar 'phags nag pa glang / /yal 'dab gya dgu pa/ chos sred kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/lus rten 'gyur yang rang bzhin ma 'gyur ba/ /chu srin lto can zas kyis mi tshims par/ /ston pas sngon gyi rus phung bstan ma thag /'khor bar yid 'byung dgra bcom chos sred do/ /yal 'dab dgu bcu pa/ nor can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/nor gyis dbul yang gtong phod snying stobs che/ /nor dang ldan yang chags pa kun nas spangs/ /nor gyi mchod pas rgyal ba mnyes byas pa/ /352

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/nor can rgyun zhugs 'bras bu'ang khyim mir bgos/ /yal 'dab go gcig pa/ shi bi'i legs bshad kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/yongs rdzogs longs spyod nyon mongs spong blos mchod/ /legs legs nges ster ched des dge legs byed/ /lus kun zungs bcud mun rub rgyur phul mthu/ /srid 'dir mi dmigs zhi nyid phyir shi bis/ /yal 'dab go gnyis pa/ mdza' bo'i bu mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ma yi mgo bor rkang bsnun mya ngan gyi/ /me tog rab bzhad smre ngag bung ba'i sgra/ /bar med sgrogs las slar 'gyod gzhan phan blos/ /mtho ris skas 'dzegs 'dza' bo'i bu mo 'o/ /yal 'dab go gsum pa/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/bzang mo'i rta bdun gyis drangs shing 'phel mkhar/ /sngon med rgyal ba'i nyi ma shar ba yis/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams pad+mo bzhad dang lhan/ /zad byed ku mud zum pa mna' ma'i drin/ /yal 'dab go bzhi pa/ grags pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mdzes pas 'od srungs dus su dge 'dun la/ /gtsang ma'i chab bskyis zas bcud skyed dang bcas/ /mche ba las 'bab phal pa'i zas nor la/ /chags bral dgra bcom grags pa'i bshes gnyen no/ /yal 'dab go lnga pa/ stag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/353
