nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sems can re re'i skye ba gang gang gi /gdung ba ji bzhin gzigs la mi g.yel ba/ /'jigs rung stag mo chom rkun ma bu la/ /srog gi skyabs byin ston pa'i mdzad pa rmad/ /yal 'dab go drug pa/ glang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa/bkur 'os rgyal por gyur kyang rang gi 'bangs/ /rtswa ltar dor mod byang sems glang po ches/ /gzhan phyir rang lus gtong ba'i khyad par 'dis/ /mchog dman spyod mtha' gnam sas mtshon mi nus/ /yal 'dab go bdun pa/ rus sbal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/brtse chen rang lus gru yis rgya mtsho las/ /srog la nyen pa'i tshong pa bsgral ba'i lan/ /srog la brngams par khro med lus btang ste/ /brtse bas rjes bzung byang sems rus sbal lo/ /yal 'dab go brgyad pa/ dka' thub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/thub rgyud lcags khams yang yang rgyal gsung rtsis/ /sbyangs pa rang bzhin dag pa'i gser gyi 'od/ /gling gzhan 'phro bas yid gzhos skye rgu yi/ /phyag 'os gyur pa'i ngo mtshar lha mis gleng / /yal 'dab go dgu pa/ pad+ma can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/rtse gcig skye rgu'i nad rnams drungs phyung phyir/ /lus gnyis btang nas lus can srog blu ba/ / 354

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/sgo gsum gzhan phan la gzhol snying stobs can/ /sde bzhi'i dpal gyis phyug pa pad+ma can/ /yal 'dab brgya tham pa/ bsod nams rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/'dod chags srin po'i mgo dbus ma bcad par/ /rab zhi'i sī ta grogs su khug min zhes/ /glang rdzi ha nu'i gtam bzhin dga' byed mda'/ /byang chub ched 'phen thog ma rab gsal lo/ /yal 'dab brgya dang gcig sngo bsangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/pha ma'i chab len ri dwags la 'khrul te/ /tshangs byin ma brtags mda' yis snying phug rma/ /'gyod pa'i chab kyis legs bkrus bden pa'i mthus/ /sngar bzhin lus gsos drang srong sngo bsangs can/ /yal 'dab brgya dang gnyis/ seng ge'i rto gas pa brjod pa/mi sdug gzugs kyis 'bum phrag lus bcings shing / /mi tshogs srog la brngams pa'i sbrul pham pa/ /mi min seng ge'i sder mos bcom byas pas/ /mi rnams tshe thar skyabs bzung grags pa'i ral/ /yal 'dab brgya dang gsum/ dga' ba'i gong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ma byas rin chen gdugs mchog lhan skyes kyi/ /ma bris mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal rdzogs shing / /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i mdza' bshes chen po der/ /ma bskul dgras kyang phyag 'tshal dga' ba'i gong / /355

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yal 'dab brgya dang bzhi pa/ ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa/thub pa zas phyir grong 'jug ma 'dod blos/ /ri bong dga' ma me lhar 'khyud rtsom pa/ /ma bzod chu lhas char chen dpung 'gyed par/ /rtsi shing 'bras bcas ngo mtshar mig rab g.yo/ /yal 'dab brgya dang lnga pa/ ri ba ta'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ku thas rang rgyal nyes sbyor las kyi bun/ /chos gos tshos khrur rtsis phra be'u'i ro/ /mthong bas nyin rer lo re'i skyed dang bcas/ /ri ba ta yi btson rar myang bas gtsang / /yal 'dab brgya dang drug pa/ gser gyi go cha'i rtogs pa brjod pa/bla ma'i bka' bcag re zhig nags 'khyam mthar/ /sring mo'i re ba don gnyer dga' byed mdas/ /gnod sbyin tshogs bcom grong khyer slar gsos nas/ /gling bzhir dbang sgyur gser gyi go cha nyid/ /yal 'dab brgya dang bdun pa/ zas gtsang ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa/mang mang ngal bas bsags bang ka ca rnams/ /zab zab ngag slad dbyangs can mar btang nas/ /mang mang gang zag chags bral lam gang la/ /gshar gshar chas la dga' ba zas gtsang ma/ /yal 'dab brgya dang brgyad pa/ sprin bzhon gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/mang mang rgyal srid sprin gyi tog gyur mang mang phun tshogs dpal ldan 356

dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa ngo mtshar snye ma'i yal 'dab/sras/ /mdzes mdzes lang tsho dran pa'i spun zla mdzes mdzes ma la ya can gnyen/ /gces gces rang lus mkha' lding zas su gces gces klu'i bu'i ched btang ba/ /mtshar mtshar gi ri'i bdud rtsis lus gsos mtshar mtshar srid thob sprin gyi bzhon/ /smras pa/ ma rig man sel srid pa'i sgron me 'khor ba'i tsha gdung bcil ༄ba'i zla/ /lus med srog phrogs nag po brtsegs pa rab tu zhi ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ci 'dod 'bras ster dpag bsam snye ma'i ngo mtshar snying po rgyal ba yi/ /rtogs brjod mtsho chen nor brang o rgyan sug rtse'i srub shing g.yo bas bskrun/ / 357

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung skye mdo nas bkras lhun dgon du gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/paṇa chen sku phyeng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po rgya sog yul grur bgrang bya bco lnga brgal ba gsang gsum 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa bskyangs te mthar bod la phebs bzhed mur stabs ma legs par skye mdor bsnyun bzhes kyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang(1937)lo'i bod zla 10tshes 18nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnal tshul gyi bkra ma shis pa'i rlung 'phrin skye mdo nang sgang nas lha sa brgyud bkra shis lhun por btang 'byor byung 'dug pas/ skabs der bkra shis lhun po'i zhabs 'bring lha mi'i sde dang bcas pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhungs te srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches gtsos dbus gtsang gtso bor gyur pa'i bla sprul khag la skyabs mgon chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa dang /mchog gi sprul sku'i yang srid myur du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs yong ba bcas kyi skyabs 'jug dang / gdan sa chen po bzhis dbus ris med dge 'dun gyi sder bsnyen bkur dang rten gsum khag gi spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin/ zang zing gi sbyin pas phongs pa rnams kyi re ba yongs su gang ba bya rgyus mtshon rnam dkar gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig lhur blangs pa sogs spyi sgos tshang mas dgongs 358

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/rdzogs rgya che smin sgrub zhus 'dugade skabs phran gyi dge rgan mkhan drung tā bla ma nor brang pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan(gsham du dam pa de nyid ces 'bri rgyu)de nyid nas gtso 'gan bzhes te lha reg dang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum gyi thog drangs 'bul rten dang bcas skyabs rje zhal bzang rin po che bkra shis lhun por gdan zhus kyis mchog gi sprul sku'i yang srid myur ba nyid du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs bka' rtsom yong ba'i skul ma zhus pa ltar myur 'byon gsol 'debs bka' rtsom grub ma thag shing par thog brkos te gdan sa bkras lhun gyi dbus lha mi'i sde bcas nas de dag 'don skyor dgos pa'i skor gzhung gi bka' rgya dang 'brel par 'debs byas pa'i dpe cha rgya che 'grems spel gnang 'dug lhag par dam pa de nyid kyis sku gong ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin rgya che bstar 'bul thog spyi sgos bstan 'gro'i bde thabs dang / khyad par dgongs rdzogs la dmigs te nor brang shag nas 'dzin skyong byed pa gdong dkar mdangs chen dgon du bzang gos zhe gcig las grub pa'i rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i gos sku srid la thog tshad bzhi brgal ba ldem dang bcas pa/gos sku spe 'ur bzang gos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs/ bkra shis khra ring bcas gsar bzhengs kyis sbyor 'bul dang / sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa sku gong ma'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma na bza' dang bcas pa 'phral mar gsar bzhengs kyi sku gong ma'i dbu lo bubs tshang gis mtshon byin rten khyad 'phags can gzungs zhugs su phul te gnas skabs nor brang shag tu bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyis dngul gdung chen mo'i bum gter gyi mdun du bzhugs pa de'i rab gnas zhu bar dam pa de nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs rje mdzes pa 359

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rin po che lha rtse nas bkras lhun nor brang shag tu ched mngags gdan zhu gnang 'dugade dus bkra shis lhun po'i 'dzin skyong gnang mkhan gzhung bskos dza sag bla ma 'brug rgyal blo bzang rin chen la dam pa de nyid nas gdan sa lha mi'i sde bcas kyi tshab gnang ste sku gdung rin po che bod du 'phral la gdan zhu dang /gdung rten gsar bzhengs/ lhag par mchod khang 'dzugs skrun gnang yul gyi sa gnas 'phral la gtan 'khel dang 'brel ar las gang myur 'dzugs gnang yong ba bcas kyi skor snyan lcag rim par zhus pa'i don bzhin mchod khang gsar skrun gyi sa yul skor mchod khang shar gyi nye 'dabs sa stong dang / phyi chen brang khang / khal kha mi tshan dang legs bstod mi tshan dbar gyi sa stong bcas sa yul khag gsum po gang 'os mchod khang shar du skyabs mgon blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gdung rten mdun zan brtag zhus par khal kha mi tshan dang legs bstod mi tshan dbar gyi sa stong bzang phebs la brten legs bstod mi tshan bkra shis rtse brang khang gi mdun du spos te sku gdung rin po che'i mchod khang bskrun gtan 'khel zhing / gdung 'bul mchod sprin las khungs gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i 'gan 'khur du gzhung bskos dza las mkhan chen phun tshogs rgya mtsho lags dang / dam pa de nyid/ gzhung bskos dza las mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal/ rim bzhi bde rab pa rdo rje g.yul rgyal bcas bsko bzhag gnang /mchod khang las grwa tshugs nyer skyabs rje zhal bzang rin po che nas las grwa tshugs yul du sa chog dang 'brel las grwa dngos su dbu tshugs te mchod khang gi phyi skya thog tshad gang tsam longs skabs zhabs 'bring ser skya yongs dang zur 360

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/bzhi bla sprul bcas tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyis sku gdung rin po che 'phral myur bod du gdan zhu byed phyogs kyi gros la zhugs don/ de skor gzhung gnas su dgongs skor snyan zhu dang 'brel sku gdung gdan zhu'i mi snar dam pa de nyid dang / tre hor gzigs skyabs sprul sku/ rtse mgron byams pa/ las tshan sle phu ba/zhabs sdod don dkyil bsod stobs bcas ngo las gdan sa bkras lhun nas 'phral la thon gtan 'khel ba ltar sa yos(1939)lo'i bod zla 12nang gzhis rtse nas rdog thon gyis mar lam lha sar phebs te rtse shod du rgyun gtan ltar 'byor phyag zhus pa dang / lcags 'brug(1940)bod zla dang po'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgor sngar lam bkra shis lhun po'i legs 'bul zhu bar dza sag bla ma blo bzang rin chen ngo las lha sar phebs pa'i khar/ dam pa de nyid dang rim bzhi bde rab pa sogs kyang khri phebs mdzad sgo'i nang zhugs 'dugaskabs der sku gdung gdan zhu'i skor gzhung gnas su 'brel gtugs zhu 'os spyi dang / lhag par lha sa skyid stod par bzhugs pa go min tang bod sdod don gcod khru'i phung khru'u krang dang / khri phebs mdzad sgor phebs pa bod sog las khungs kyi u yon krang 'u krung shin bcas dang mjal 'phrad zhus thog sku gdung gdan zhu'i skor rgyab bskyor rogs ram yong ba'i re ba yang zhus 'dugadus skabs de'i gong tsam la skye mdor yod mus nang sgang gis sku gdung rin po che gdan zhu dang 'brel dkar mdzes su 'byor skabs zhabs 'bring re 'ga'i byed las kyi rkyen pas zi khron ar zi cun dang nang sgang dbar 'gal ba chags pa je cher 'phel te mthar 'byung mi 'os pa'i don rkyen byung stabs sku gdung rin po che bzhugs sgar zhabs 'bring hrag bsdus dang bcas pa gsang 361

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/thabs kyis dkar mdzes nas ra nyag dgon du phebs 'byor byung lugs skye mdo nang sgang nas sku gdung gdan zhu bar lha sar gsang tar btang 'byor byung 'dugade skabs sku gdung rin po che gsang ba'i thabs lam la brten nas ra nyag tu gdan zhu byed stangs ni/ dkar mjos su don rkyen byung ba des nang sgang gi 'gan 'khur gtso bo'i mdun 'byung 'gyur lhags srid pa'i gnad don mang por bsam gzhigs nan tan gnang dgos yong 'gro ba ldog tu med pa'i chos nyid ltar skye mdo nang sgang gi dbu 'dzin gzim che bde brang pa phur bu tshe ring lags sogs nas de skor dgongs pa zab bzhes kyis gsang rgya shin tu che ba'i sgo nas 'byung 'gyur sku gdung rin po che bod la gdan zhu bya rgyur 'gal rkyen yong gzhi'i gnas tshul las g.yol ched mchod dpon pa sangs lags dang / 'chams dpon zla phun lags gnyis la sku gdung rin po che'i 'dra sku zhig gsang ba gang che'i sgo nas gsar bzhengs dgos rgyu'i bkod mngags gnang yod pa red/ khong gnyis ni de snga mchod bzhengs mar rgyan bzo rgyur byang cha thon nges tsam las 'dra sku gsar bzhengs kyi 'jim bzo gnang myong ye nas med pa zhig yin kyang / skabs der khong tshos thabs dang blo gros du mas snyug ma'i sgrom la gru'u tsi rgya smug dkris pa'i sku'i gzugs brnyan thog zhal skyin sku gong ma dang gnyis su med pa 'jim par bzhengs te 'dra sku de nyid ches gsang ba'i sgo nas sku gdung gi bzhugs sgrom nang du gdan zhus kyis sku gdung ngo ma bzhugs pa'i rdzu la brten pa de ni nang sgang khongs min pa'i skye bo gzhan lta ci/ bzhugs sgar zhabs 'bring byings kyi dag snang la'ang sku gdung rin po che sngar bzhin dkar mdzes su bzhugs par snang ba'i blo la g.yo ba spu tsam mi 362

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/yong ba byas te sku gdung ngo ma dkar mdzes su mu mthud bzhugs rgyu ma 'gab par ches gsang ba'i sgo nas bzhugs sgrom shel bcas sgril tshad dang bar tshang sogs la dang dod ci ches na bza' phebs sgam gyi dos yar 'jo drel thog zhabs 'bring hrag gras 'ga' zhig gis ra nyag dgon rong zla bla brang du gdan zhu byed thub pa byung 'dug de rjes nang sgang dang / ar zi cun gyi don rkyen mthar nang sgang la pham kha 'khel te bzhugs sgar dkar mdzes nas phyir 'then skabs sku gdung gishadra sku dkar mdzes dgon du yod pas sku gdung ngo ma rang 'jags bzhugs pa ltar las/ gsang rgya ma shor ba bcas kyis ar zi cun dpon dmag tsho'i bsam par sku gdung rin po che dkar mdzes nas gzhan du gdan zhu ma thub pa rang 'jags lus par ngos 'dzin byed pa'i mgo bo mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor bas bzhugs sgar dkar mdzes nas phyir 'then skabs ar zi cun gyis rjes ded gang yang byas bzo mi 'dugade rjes sku gdung rin po che ra nyag tu zhabs sor 'khod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po bkras lhun nas gdan zhur phebs mkhan tshos gsan thos byung stabs gdan zhu ba'i gras nas tre hor gzigs skyabs rin po che gdan zhu ba'i khongs su phebs rgyu'i dgos pa sngon ma ltar med pas bshol ba phud/ de byings ngo las rnams lcags 'brug bod zla 5nang lha sa nas rdog thon gyis mal gro gung dkar dang / 'bri ru/ sog tsan+dan dgon/ khyung po steng chen bcas brgyud lcags zam khar 'byor skabs de gong dkar mdzes bzhugs sgar nas sku gdung rin po che bod la gdan zhu'i skor chab mdo bka' shag la snyan seng zhu ba'i don gcod du phebs mkhan mgron che sa lung pa dang / dus 'khor slob dpon lags/ zhabs sdod gnas chos lags bcas ngo las dang / chab mdo bka' shag nas sku 363

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gdung bod la gdan zhu'i sne shan du bskos mngags gnang ba rtse drung go bo bla gnyer dang / mda' tshab dkyil mkhar lcog spe ba/ ga dang dmag brgya shog gcig bcas kyis gdan zhu ba ngo las phebs sgug gnang 'dug pa rnams dang mjal 'dzoms byung 'dug de nas gdan zhu ba rnams 'dam thog dang /khang gsar dgon brgyud skye mdor 'byor skabs skye mdo nang sgang gi dbu 'dzin gzim che bde brang pa phur bu tshe ring lags dang / li'u rim bzhi/ rim bzhi srang smad pa dbang 'dus nor bu sogs kyi phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang 'brel skye mdor phebs 'byor byung zhing / sa gnas der bca' sdod zi ling mā pu'u h+phang gi tshab mi dang / skye mdo bra'u be'u dpon bcas mjal 'phrad gnang ste ra nyag dgon du 'byor skabs bzhugs sgar zhabs 'bring rnams nas phebs bsu rgya chen po dang bcas gdan zhu ba ngo las rnams kyis sku gdung rin po cher 'byor phyag zhus thog gdan sa nas 'bul rgyur bskur ba'i rten rdzas bzang drug sman dang / dri bzang sha kha ma bcas sku gdung za ma tog la sgron 'bul dang / sna lnga'i mchod sprin rgya che bstar 'bul yang zhus shing/ de skabs sku gdung za ma tog nas byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha 'bar ba'i ring bsrel mang po byon pa dang bcas sku gdung rin po che'i gser zhal 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du thob skabs dga' ba dang skyo ba 'gran pa ltar smra mi shes pa dang / mig nang mchi ma'i chab rgyun bar med du zags pa/ mgrin pa brnangs pa'i sgo nalo‘bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs dang / mgon dang / dpung gnyen skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mchog gis bdag cag skyabs med mgon med bye'u phrug thang bskyur btang snyoms mdzad de mgon po gang nyid zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa de lta na phyin chad gdan sa chen po lha mi'i sde 364

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/bcas bdag cag rnams kyi re bltas su la 'cha' ba ’’sogs 'o dod dang /tshe rabs kun tu skyabs mgon chen pos 'bral ba med pa rjes su bzung ba'i smon lam shugs drag btab pa yin zhes pa'i skor dam pa de nyid nas dus phyis mtshams re nga tshor gsung skabs spyan chab nyil le ba dang / tshig mjug ngu ma lab tu 'gyur ba des nga tsho drung na gnas pa rnams kyang mid pa 'chud pa dang /yud tsam pa re phan tshun gcig mig gcig la ce rer blta ba las gzhan gyi rtsol ba bral ba ri mo'i mi dang mtshungs pa zhig yong gi yod/gdan zhu ba rnams ra nyag dgon du phebs 'phral ra nyag dgon gyi 'dus pa'i sder bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed stobs 'bul dang / ra nyag rong mda' bla brang gi sprul sku rnam pa gnyis dang / gzim che bde brang pa dang rim bzhi srang smad pa sogs kyis rlung shod dgon bar phebs skyel du bcar 'dug de nas sa gnas rim pa brgyud sku gdung rin po che lcags zam dgon du phebs skabs chab mdo bka' shag nas mngags pa'i sne shan pa go bo bla gnyer sogs ngo las rnams kyi phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang / de nas khyung po steng chen brgyud ser rtsa bkra shis gling dgon du phebs 'byor skabs chab mdo bka' shag nas phebs bsu dang sbrags thugs mkho 'bul bar phogs dpon mkhan chung mngags phebs/ de nas sog g.yag la brgyud nag chur phebs skabs byang spyi mkhan rim dang / zhabs brtan dgon pa'i las sne bla khag bcas kyi phebs bsu ser dz+reng gi bkod pa rgya che dang bcas sku gdung rin po che nag chu sgrub khang bla brang du gdan drangs par gzhung gnas nas 'tshams zhur mngags pa dza sag zur khang pa dang / g.yung dgon tā bla ma gnyis phebs nas sku gdung rin po cher mjal phyag dang / mchod sprin rgya che bstar 'bul zhus shing de skabs kyang sku 365

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gdung rin po che nas ring bsrel mang po phebs pa der 'dus skye bo tshang ma'i dad pa'i sa bon du gyur cing / de skabs 'tshams zhu gdung 'bul du phebs mi ngo las la'ang ring bsrel rdog re phul 'dugade nas rim bzhin phebs te 'dam sbad tshal snyan grong du bcags bzhugs la mjal phyag dang 'brel gtugs zhus shing/ de gong gdan sar dza sag bla ma dang / gzhung gnas bcas su yang gdan zhu ba rnams skyid mdor 'byor zin pa la sogs pa'i snyan zhu glog 'phrin brgyud 'bul gnang thoganang sgang dang / gdan zhu ba thun mong gi ming thog nas go min tang nan cing srid gzhung gi bod sog las khungs la sku gdung gdan zhu'i skor glog 'phrin yang phul ba'i lan du/ sku gdung rin po che bod la 'phral du gdan zhu chog pa dang / phebs skyel sku srung du skye mdor bca' sdod zi ling dpon dmag nas 'os 'tshams lcags zam dgon bar mngags rgyu/ rta khal phebs sgrig skul gtong skor yang khungs so sor brda khyab zin lugs bcas 'khod pa btang 'byor yod tshod 'dugar nyag tu sku gdung rin po che bod la gdan zhu'i gra sgrig 'thus tshang zin te lcags 'brug bod zla 9pa'i nang ra nyag nas phebs thon skabs chibs zhabs su gdan zhu ba ngo las khar/ mgron che sa lung pa dang / paṇa chen sku srung dmag gi sba cha'i ru khag sum brgya ba zhes pa'i khongs nas lag do gang mtshams/ phebs skyel zhu mi zi ling dpon dmag bcas sku 'khor gtos che yod 'dug cing / thab skyel sar bzhugs sgar zhabs 'bring yongs rdzogs nas sku gdung rin po cher mjal phyag zhus thog gdan zhu ba'i khongs nas las tshan sle phu ba lha sar rwa sgreng srid skyong rin po ches sku gdung gdan zhu'i skor sogs 366

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/la skyabs 'jug gnang ba'i bka' drin legs gsol du sku gong ma'i chibs chen phis ci'i(gnam gru)bra bo zer ba'i 'gros ma gcig sogs 'bul bar ched mngags gnang 'dugade nas sku gdung rin po che 'od yug 'dzoms thang du phebs skabs gdan sa bkras lhun nas 'tshams zhur tha'i ji yab gzhis nor khang pa phun tshogs g.yul rgyal sogs phebs te mjal phyag dang mchod sprin bstar 'bul zhus/de nas shangs bde chen rab rgyas su chibs sgyur skabs bde chen rab rgyas dgon pa'i bla grwa nas ser sbreng gzab rgyas dang bcas dgon par spyan 'dren gyis grwa dmangs sogs der 'dus skye bo'i tshogs la gdung mjal dang /dgon pa'i bla spyi nas sku gdung rin po che'i spyan sngar mchod sprin rgya che gshoms 'bul zhus 'dugade nas spen du bzhugs zhag sar gdan sa nas phebs bsu ba khag gcig 'byor/de'i sang nyin sku gdung rin po che gdan sa bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor 'khod rgyu yin gshis/ sku gdung rin po che bod la chibs zhal sgyur gtan 'khel ba nas bzung bkras lhun gdan sar bzhugs pa'i zhabs 'bring lha mi'i sde bcas kyis sngon tshud nas phebs bsu dang mdzad sgo sogs kyi sta gon gyi rim pa tshags tshud bgyis khar/ gdan sar 'phral myur zhabs sor 'god rgyu'i skor gzhung gnas nas bstsal ba'i bka' rgya bkra shis lhun po lha mi'i sde bcas la 'grems spel gyis gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod nyin gyi mdzad sgos mtshon zhu sgo mtha' dag 'thus tshang dgos pa'i bka' dgongs ltar sku gdung rin po che gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod nye'i mtshams rdzong gzhis lha mi'i sde bcas kyi 3shaṃ7

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'thus mi dang/ dad 'dus skye bo pho mo phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nas bar ma chad pa gzhis rtser 'dus shing / pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po sogs pho brang yas mas dang / gdan sa'i gtsug lag khang khag grwa tshang dang / mi tshan khag de bzhin spyi sger gyi khang pa mtha' dag la sngon tshud nas btsag dang dkar rtsi gtong lam gang yod sngar srol ltar btang thog sgo dang sge'u khung tshang mar gsham bu dang / yol ba/ yang steng so so'i thug dang rgyal mtshan bcas gsar du brjes shing / dar gos spus legs zhe gcig gi bkra shis khra ring dang / 'phyar dar rlung gis lhab lhab tu g.yo ba/ phebs lam gang 'khel 'dzin ma'i ngos phyag bdar gtsang mar byas thog g.yas g.yon gnyis su dkar rtags dang / rdo bstar ya yo med pa srong por bsgrigs pa'i bar bar du dri bsung 'thal ba'i phebs bsangs kyi dud sprin 'khrigs pa sogs de lta bu'i ༄tshar du dngar ba'i phebs bsu'i bgyid sgo rim pa zhus zin te lcags 'brug (1940)bod zla 12tshes 20nyin sku gdung rin po che chu shar thab bsu'i sar chibs sgyur gnang nye'i skabs phebs bsu snga rting sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dbu gur du zhabs sor 'khod 'phral phebs ston dkar spro gzab rgyas bstar 'bul thog zhabs 'bring ser skya yongs dang / zur bzhi bla sprul/ lha sde mi sde'i 'thus mi sogs der 'dus skye bo rnams la gdung mjal bstsal/ de nas chibs hrag che mo bstar sgrig gi thog mar srid pa ho dang / lha beka jo bo gsum zhes dmag zor ma dang / beka tse ste chos skyong lcam sring / jo bo phying dkar ba bcas kyi rten thug man ju gong ma chan lung nas paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes la phul ba'i chibs dar thig mtsho'i grangs ldan/ chibs rol/ spyan rgya sogs snga phyi'i sarga mi 'chol bas mdun bdar te ser skya zhabs 36shaṃ

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/'bring rnams rang rang gi chas gos kyang yig tshang las khungs nas spel ba'i chibs hrag chen mo'i brda tho'i dgos 'dun ltar tog dang go gnas kyi khyad par gang dang gang dag gzab mchor gyis phebs rol dang bstun chibs hrag chen mo'i gral tho'i rim pa bzhin gyi dbus su sku gdung rin po che 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mdangs dang ldan pa'i phebs byams nang bzhugs su gsol thog phebs byams pa rnams kyis gdan drangs shing / phebs lam g.yas g.yon gnyis su gdan sa'i dge 'dun gyis gtsos dgon khag nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun pa'i ser sbreng dang / grong dang grong gseb nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bcas gral bstar sgrig pos lag tu bdug spos dang / me togagadugs/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bgrangs yas pa thogs pa dang / dung 'bud pa dang rol mo dgrol ba/ sil snyan gsir ba/ rnga dang 'khar rnga brdung ba sogs phebs bsu'i bkod pa tshar du dngar ba'i rnam grangs ji snyed mchis pa mtha' dag 'di dang 'di zhes gleng bar mi spobs pas re zhig de tsam du bzhag de skabs skye bo rnams kyi nang gi bsam pa'i 'du shes ni gcig lta bur nges pa ste sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i gser zhal gyi dga' ston thob la nye ba'i dga' ba tshad med skyes pa dang dus mtshungs 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sku dang gsung gi dga' ston la spyod du med pa'i skyo ba'ang tshad med skye ba bcas dga' skyo'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston bzhin dang / chibs hrag che mo phyi chen rgyal sgor phebs nye'i mtshams ser skya zhabs 'bring rnams rang rang gi bzhon pa las bshol te sku gdung rin po che phebs byams spyan rgya dang bcas phebs ras thog gdan 'dren pa'i phebs zhabs su bcar nas sku gdung rin po che kun gzigs rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nyi 'od tshoms chen gyi khri 369

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'phang mthon por zhabs sor 'khod ma thag phebs ston dkar spro rgyas pa dang /sku gdung rin po che'i spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin rgya che gshom 'bul bcas de nas bzung rim pa bzhin gzhung gnas dang bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po/gdan sa'i bkras lhun gyi grwa tshang khag lha ngam phun sum gyis mtshon phyogs mtha'i dgon khag rdzong gzhis khag gzhan yang dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs bcas nas gdung 'bul mchod sprin rgya che bstar 'bul zhus pa dang /dus mtshungs sku gdung rin po che'i gdan zhu ba ngo las sku srung dmag dang bcas par bla brang gis gtsos spyi sger gang thad nas 'tshams 'dri gnang skabs gsung rigs gcig mthun lta bur/ ‘‘khyed tsho 'o brgyal song / da bsam don grub song ’zhes tshig nyung la don gting zab pa'i gtam gyis dbugs dbyung bar de dang de'i lan glan te rang rang bste ba'i gnas su dengs pa bcas chibs sgyur dngos gzhi'i bya rim de tsam gyis mjug bsdus/sku gdung bzhugs yul gyi mchod khang ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag (1938—194grushing sprel bar lo ngo bdun ring gdan sa bkras lhun lha mi'i sde bcas nas 'bad brtson lhod med gnang ba brgyud phyi'i gtsug lag khang gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang bcas pa/ nang gi dngul gdung rin chen khra tshoms kyi spa ba legs par bskrun thog dngul gdung gi bum gter 'ja' 'od dkrig pa'i nang sku gong ma'i gzim rten dang / mchod gshoms sku'i nyer spyad bcas cha tshang yid du 'ong bar sgrig gshoms zhus pa'i bzhugs khri'i thog sku gdung rin po che bzhugs su gsol ba dang / bum gter mdun du nor brang shag nas dgongs rdzogs su de sngon bskrun pa'i sku gong ma'i snang brnyan la rab gnas shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol/370

paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu byas pa'i skor/mchod khang nang gi ka 'phan dang / thog yol/ bla bre sogs mchod rdzas skor hang kru'u ru de snga sku gong mas dus 'khor dbang chen gnang skabs dad ldan 'byor phyug khag nas phul ba'i bzang gos tshos tshogs khyon che sngags drung bod la rjes ma phebs skabs bsnams phebs pa rnams kun gzigs zangs khang zhes bya ba'i gan mdzod du zur 'jog gnang yod pa'i do dam pa dam pa de nyid dang / mgron che sa lung pa gnyis kyis gnang mus khongs nas gang la gang 'os spus legs zhe gcig btang 'thus zhes dam pa de nyid nas skyabs rten rgya dngul rta rmig ma dang sbrags dza bla blo bzang rin chen la zhu gnang don thob ltar mchod rdzas rnams kyang bzang gos spus legs zhe cig gis bskrun pa bcas mchod sdong rin po che phyi nang snod bcud skye rgu'i yid dbang 'gugs pa'i dad rten du legs par grub cing / de'i mtshan‘‘mchod sdong srid gsum mdzes rgyan’’zhes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog nas ched du 'dogs gnang mdzad pa bcas so/ /da lam rtsom yig 'di dag 'bri skabs dam pa de nyid kyi sku dang grib ma bzhin 'bral med bcar ba'i gzim dpon dang sger gyi drung yig ngag dbang don yod lags dang / phran gyi shag rogs nor brang blo bzang bsam gtan lags gnyis nas don dngos kyi rgyu cha 'ga' zhig mkho 'don yang gnang byung ba bcas/371

〈 theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉ces bya ba'i skor/mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di ni mdo smad reb gong gi phyogs su sku bltams pa klong chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje ma pham phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa pho khyi (spyi lo 1838)lor rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang / bstan bcos 'dir rtsa ba dang /bsdus don/ 'bru 'grel/ rgyas 'grel/ dpe ris bcas rnam grangs lnga'i sgo nas theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa 'di'i skor cung zad gleng bar 'dod pa 'di lta ste/dang po/ bstan bcos 'ji'i 'byung rkyen/mkhas pa'i dbang po klong chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rjer mtsho sngon chang hu tā wang phyogs las rnam rgyal bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po tshe ring don kun yongs su grub pa dpal bzang pos gser gyi ga'u/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍatā gyis mtshon gya nom pa'i dngos po'i 'bul ba dang bcas mdzod rtsa 'grel rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos po ti bcu gsum tshang bar sgrig dgos zhes gsung ba dang /smad sog phyogs kyi sa'i tshangs pa chen po cung so nyid tā wang tshe dbang skyabs 372

(mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉 ces bya ba'i skor/rin po ches bstan bcos 'di nyid par la bskrun rgyu'i dngos po'i mthun rkyen rgya che ba sogs gang la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i mi dpon che rgu dang / bya bral rnal 'byor du ma sogs slob ma dang yon bdag pho mo mang pos yang yang bskul ngor mdzad pa ni 'phral gyi rkyen dang / gtso bo'i dgos pa ni rig lam don du gnyer ba'i skye bo mchog dman yongs la phan zhing / 'phral yun gyi 'dod don 'grub pa/ thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs chod de mkhas pa'i go sa thob pa/ sgom pas nang gi sgro 'dogs chod de rang rang re ba'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du mdzad pa zhig lags/gnyis pa/ mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung tshad skor/brjod bya don gyi tshad ni 'go bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas mjug grub pa mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rim pa gtan la phab pa bar theg pa'i rim pa skabs nyi shu rtsa lngas phye bar spyi don brgya tham pa dang / sgos don nyis stong brgya dang don dgu yod/ rjod byed tshig gi tshad ni/ bstan bcos kyi thog mar dge ba klad kyi don dang / mtha' mar dge ba mjug gi skabs sho lo ka'i rkang pa rtsa ba'i cha nas bcu gsum ma las grub pa/ bar du dge ba gzhung dngos gzhi'i skabs sho lo ka'i rkang pa dgu mar grub pa'i gzhung tshad sho lo ka dgu brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi de bam po gsum du nges pa mdzad cing / de min bsdus don dang / 'bru 'grel/ rgyas 'grel/ dpe ris bcas brjod bya tshig lhug gi lam nas drangs pa zhig yin/ 373

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsum pa/ gzhung don gyi sa bcad skor/skabs dang po/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing / sdig pa'i grogs po spong ba'i skor la spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don so bdun yod/spyi don dang po/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ gsum pa bshes gnyen ji ltar bsten pa'i rim pa/ bzhi pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po spong ba bcas so/ /skabs gnyis pa/ chos 'chad nyan byed tshul dang / gzhi dad pa'i rnam gzhag la spyi don gsum dang / sgos don nyi shu rtsa drugaspyi don dang po/ chos ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul/ gnyis pa/ chos ji bzhin nyan pa'i tshul/ gsum pa/ dge ba'i las la dad pa bya tshul bcas so/ /skabs gsum pa/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i tshul la spyi don bzhi dang /sgos don bcu dgu/spyi don dang po/ dal 'byor gyi ngo bo/ gnyis pa/ dpe dang grangs kyis rnyed dka' ba bstan pa/ gsum pa/ dal 'byor gyi rang bzhin ngos gzung ba/bzhi pa/ rnyed dus snying po rnam dag len dgos pa bcas so /skabs bzhi pa/ tshe mi rtag par bsam dgos par spyi don lnga dang / sgos don bdun cu don dgu/spyi don dang po dang / gnyis pa mi rtag pa mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa/ gsum pa/ dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa/ bzhi pa dang / lnga pa chos la brtson par gdams pa dang / 'chi ba sgom pa'i rtags tshad dang / phan yon 374

(mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉 ces bya ba'i skor/gnyis kyi skor bcas so/ /skabs lnga pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam dgos pa'i skor la spyi don bzhi dang /sgos don bcu gnyis/spyi don dang po/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rang bzhin mdor bstan pa/ gnyis pa/mi dge ba'i las dang / 'bras bu rgyas par bshad pa/ gsum pa/ bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i las 'bras bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba'i las 'bras bshad pa bcas so//skabs drug pa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du bsam par spyi don drug dang sgos don nyi shu rtsa brgyad/spyi don dang po/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ gsum pa/ dud 'gro bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ bzhi pa/ mi'i sdug bsngal/ lnga pa/ lha min gyi sdug bsngal/ drug pa/lha'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang / thar pa bsgrub dgos par bstan pa bcas so/skabs bdun pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / tshul khrims/ nyan rang gi gzhi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i skor la spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don sum cu so drugaspyi don dang po/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ gnyis pa/ so thar rigs bdun gyi sdom pa bsrung ba/ gsum pa/ nyan thos kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu/ bzhi pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu bcas so/ /skabs brgyad pa/ gzhi dbu ma bden gnyis dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i skor la spyi don gsum dang / sgos don bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/spyi don dang po/ ji ltar bstan pa dang / don dam gyi bden pa dang kun 375

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rdzob kyi bden pa'i skor/ gnyis pa/ 'khor lo bar pa bskor zhing bsdus pa'i tshul/ gsum pa/ rigs can gyis sems ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul bcas so/ /skabs dgu pa/ lam dbu ma tshogs gnyis bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i le'ur spyi don gsum dang / sgos don brgyad cu gya drugaspyi don dang po/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya tshul khrims gsum spyir bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ phar phyin drug bye brag tu bshad pa/ gsum pa/ slob lam bzhir byang phyogs so bdun dang / sa bcu khyad par du bshad pa bcas so/ /skabs bcu pa/ 'bras bu dbu ma sku gnyis mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i le'ur spyi don gsum dang / sgos don bcu dgu/spyi don dang po dang / gnyis pa/ rten rang bzhin mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa/ gsum pa/ mi slob pa'i lam gyi khyad chos bcas so/ /skabs bcu gcig pa/ zhing khams kyi bkod pa rgya cher bshad par spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/spyi don dang po/ chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi'i bskal pa'i skor/ gnyis pa/ gangs chen mtsho sde lnga'i bkod pa bshad pa/ gsum pa/ don la bden par ma grub pa phra rags dang / dus yun bkod pa sna tshogs/ bzhi pa/ 'jig rten du grags pa'i chos lugs du ma bshad pa bcas so/ /skabs bcu gnyis pa/ rig pa'i gnas chen lnga dang / gnas chung lnga'i tshul rgya cher bshad par spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don brgya dang bcu dguspyi don dang po/ tshad ma dang / sgra rig pa'i skor/ gnyis pa/ bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa'i skor/ gsum pa/ nang don rig pa mdo dang / rgyud 376

(mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉 ces bya ba'i skor/don bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga bshad pa bcas so /skabs bcu gsum pa/ theg pa'i rim pa thams cad kyi grub mtha' rgya cher bshad pa la spyi don drug dang / sgos don brgyad cu gya gsum/spyi don dang po/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la ma gtogs pa sor bzhag lha min theg pa dang / log par rtog pa mu stegs rtag chad kyi theg pa'i skor/gnyis pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa bshad pa/ gsum pa/ chen po byang sems kyi grub mtha' bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ rdo rje'i theg pa bshad pa/ lnga pa/bod gangs can du grub pa'i mtha' bye brag tu ji ltar dar tshul/ drug pa/mngon pa mdzod ltar rtsod tshig thal phreng du bkod pa bcas so /skabs bcu bzhi pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag par spyi don brgyad dang / sgos don brgya dang bco lnga/spyi don dang po/ rgyud ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul mdor bstan pa/ gnyis pa/ bya ba'i rgyud bshad pa/ gsum pa/ spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud bshad pa/ lnga pa/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud bshad pa/ drug pa/ gzhi dbang dang srog dam tshig skor/ bdun pa/ grol byed lam gyi rim pa/ brgyad pa/ 'bras bu rnam dag zung 'jug gi go 'phang brnyes tshul bcas so/ /skabs bco lnga pa/ gsang ba snying po'i mtshan bshad dbye ba 'char tshul las gleng gzhi gleng slong gtan phab kyi skabs la spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don brgyad cu gya dguspyi don dang po/ lo rgyus/ gnyis pa/ mtshan don/ gsum pa/ don dang tshig gi rnam grangs dbye ba/ bzhi pa/ 'bru 'grel gyi tshul du rgyud don rgyas par bshad pa bcas so /377

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/skabs bcu drug pa/ zhi ba'i 'phros tshul gyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i skabs bstan par spyi don gsum dang / sgos don sum brgya zhe lnga/spyi don dang po/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang /dbang bskur ba'i thabs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ zhi ba'i lam bskyed pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa/ gsum pa/ zhi ba'i 'bras bu rgyu dang /ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bstod pa'i tshul bcas so/ /skabs bcu bdun pa/ khro bo'i 'phros tshul las gzhi lam 'bras bu dang / yongs gtad 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi le'u rkang grangs dang bcas pa'i skor laspyo don lnga dang / sgos don nyis brgya bcu gcigaspyi don dang po/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin khro bo'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'i tshul/ gnyis pa/ lam ji ltar sgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag rgya cher bshad pa/ gsum pa/ khro bo'i 'bras bu sku dang / ye shes la bstod pa'i tshul/bzhi pa/ rgyud dam par gdams nas rjes 'jug la gtad pa'i tshul dang /mthar phyin pa 'jug gi don dang bcas pa'i skor/ lnga pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'bru 'grel bcas so/ /skabs bco brgyad pa/ rdzogs rim lung chen a nu yo ga'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag par spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don sum cu so lnga/spyi don dang po/ lo rgyus dngos/ rgyud kyi rnam grangs/ gang zag gang la dgos pa'i skor/ gnyis pa/ gzhi dbang dang / srog dam tshig gi rim pa/gsum pa/ lam lta sgom spyod gsum rgyas par bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu mchog gi rim pa bcas so /skabs bcu dgu pa/ gzhi chos dbyings tshad med pa'i don gtan la 378

〈mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉 ces bya ba'i skor/phab par spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don lnga bcu nga dgu/spyi don dang po/ lo rgyus dang / rgyud grangs/ gang la dgos pa'i skor/gnyis pa/ gzhi dbang dang srog dam tshig gi rim pa mdor bstan pa/ gsum pa/ gzhi rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa gsang sngags rdo rje gnas dka' ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo dang / gzhi snang gi 'char tshul/ bzhi pa/ kun gzhi dang / chos sku'i khyad par/sems dang ye shes kyi khyad par skor bcas so/ /skabs nyi shu pa/ lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don gtan la phab par spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don brgya dang bdun cu don gcigaspyi don dang po/ gnas/ dus/ grogs/ yo byad spyir bshad pa/ gnyis pa/khyad par can gyi sngon 'gro mdor bstan pa/ gsum pa/ rtogs tshul gyi thabs rgyas par bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ rnam grangs du ma'i gdams pas nges shes bstan par bya ba bcas so/ /skabs nyer gcig pa/ rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i mkhregs tshad don dam gnas lugs sgom pas nyams su len pa'i skor la spyi don gsum dang / sgos don brgya dang bcu gnyis/spyi don dang po/ dbang po tha ma'i sgom pa'i rim pa spyir bstan pa/ gnyis pa/ dbang po 'bring gi sgom pa'i rim pa bye brag tu bstan pa/ gsum pa/dbang po rab kyi sgom pa'i rim pa rgyas par bstan pa'i skor bcas so/ /skabs nyer gnyis pa/ 'od gsal nyi zla dang mtshungs pa'i thod brgal sgom pas nyams su len pa'i skor la spyi don bzhi dang / sgos don brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/379

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/spyi don dang po/ rig pa'i ye shes gang nang bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog spyir bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ 'od gsal bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro bye brag tu bshad pa/ gsum pa/ dngos gzhi ye shes chen po'i snang ba khyad par du bshad pa/bzhi pa/ mtha' rten gnad kyi man ngag bsdus te bshad pa bcas so /skabs nyer gsum pa/ ri rgyal lhun po lta bu'i spyod pas bogs 'don pa'i le'ur spyi don gsum dang / sgos don brgya dang sum cu so drugaspyi don dang po/ sna tshogs spyod bogs 'don la yang ting 'dzin mi g.yo ba gsum spyir bstan/ spyod pa rgyun du byed pa bye brag tu bstan/ dpe don nges pa'i khyad par mdor bstan/ 'khrul tshul dang / ldog tshul brda'i sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa/ gnyis pa/ gnam gzer dang / ngo sprod gnad kyi gzer bu bsdus te bshad pa/ gsum pa/ rtags tshad dus kyi ngos 'dzin gsal bar bshad pa bcas so/ /skabs nyer bzhi pa/ mthong snang rgya che ba stong gsum dang mtshungs pa/'bring bar do/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du grol ba'i rim pa bstan par spyi don gnyis dang / sgos don bdun cu don brgyad/spyi don dang po/ bar do spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ tha ma'i tha ma rnams rang bzhin sprul par dbugs 'byin pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o/ /skabs nyer lnga pa/ thabs des gang du grub pa mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rim pa gtan la phab pa'i le'ur spyi don gsum dang / sgos don brgyad cu gya gcigaspyi don dang po/ grol ba'i ngo bo ngos gzung / ji ltar grol ba'i rang 380

(mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod〉 ces bya ba'i skor/bzhin so sor bshad pa/ sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi gtan la dbab pa/gnyis pa/ lhun grub 'od gsal gyi 'char gzhi las sku dang / ye shes kyi snang tshul bye brag tu bshad pa/ gsum pa/ sku gsung thags yon tan 'phrin las ༄lnga'i don bsdu ba rnams so/ /de lta bu'i bstan bcos khyad du 'phags pa 'di nyid dpe rgyun ches dkon pa dang bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag la zhib 'jug dang / slob sbyong bya rgyur phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi nang don ldan pas bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang(gra sgrig)nas dpe sgrig gis rim bzhin dngos su dpe skrun zhu rgyur 'bad brtson byed bzhin thog mi ring bar rtsa ba dang / bsdus don gnyis dngos su dpe skrun zhus nas klog pa po'i phyag tu son thub rgyu 'di ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol legs po byung ba'i mtshon rtags shig yin la bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob las don la yang bskyar thob pa'i grub 'bras shig kyang yin pa des 'byung 'gyur bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug la dpyad gzhi'i nus pa chen po thon rgyu yin pa ni gdon mi za'o/ /381

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/1983lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dpe rnying dpe skrun 'char 'god tshogs chung dang / rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpe rnying phyogs sgrig dang dpe skrun las ka'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du skong tshogs gnang ba dang / krung dbyang gis 1981lor‘‘dpe rnying phyogs sgrig byas te mes rgyal gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rig gnas rjes shul rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che ba pha tsha bu rgyud dang 'brel ba yod pa'i las don zhig red/ ces dang / 1984lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi yig ang sum cu pa'i nang du'angapha‘grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpe rnying ni mes rgyal gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rig gnas shul rgyun gyi cha shas yin pa de dag myur skyob dang phyogs sgrig bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che ba'i las ka zhig red ces tang dang rgyal khab kyis gal che'i mdzub ston gnang ba rnams ni dus bab dang yongs su mthun la/ mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun dang yongs su 'tshams pa/ kha tsha dgos gtugs dang shin tu gal che'i las don dus 'gyangs dang nem nur spu tsam byed mi rung ba bcas red/bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung nas krung dbyang gi gal che'i mdzub ston gzhir bzung 1985lo bod rang skyong ljongs bod yig dpe rnying 382

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/myur skyob dang / phyogs sgrig dpe skrun las ka bcas kyi 'go khrid tshogs chung dang / rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang bcas btsugs pa'i nang ljongs rim pa'i 'go khrid dang bod yig dpe rnying dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa'i sde tshan khag gi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur ba yang zhugs shing / 'go khrid tshogs chung dang rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rgyun gtan gyi las don sgrub pa'i gzhung las khang ste bod rang skyong ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang bod yig dpe rnying rtsom sgrig khang yang btsugs pa ma zad/ da phan lo 'khor gcig la nye ba'i ring bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob dang / phyogs sgrig dpe skrun bya rgyu'i las don hur brtson chen pos bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin yod/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ bod ljongs ni gna' rabs rig gzhung gi 'byung gnas yin zhes bshad kyang ngo gnong mi dgos pa 'dzam gling nang skad grags yod pa zhig yin la/ mes rgyal rig gzhung bang mdzod kyi mdzes rgyan rmad du byung ba zhig kyang yin/ de lta bu'i bod kyi gna' rabs rig gzhung rnam grangs rgya che la gting zab pa/ nang don ches phun sum tshogs pa/ gsar gtod mkhan rang re'i mes po rnams kyis rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod rgyun mar byas pa brgyud rang byung khams kyi gsang ba rtogs pa dang / rang byung khams dbang du bsdus te mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs gong 'phel gtong bar sman pa'i zhabs 'deg sa dang / phyi rabs kyi mig rgyan du che ba'i gna' rdzas rig gnas mang po da lta yang skye bo rnams kyi gathugs 'dzin dbang po'i dga' ston du gyur pa 'di dag gi lo rgyus la zhibajor dpyod skabs rang re'i mes po rnams kyi phul du byung ba'i blo gros dang / zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs/mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan yid la lhang nger mi dran 383

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa ci la srid/ lhag par rig pa'i gnas lngar gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa re res brtsams pa dang bsgyur ba'i bka' bstan bcos kyi glegs bam shin tu mang po yod pa ni ha las dgos pa zhig yin/ dper na dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i(spyi lo 1374 1451)bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal lam/ bo dong 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom la mtshon na pod brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gsum yod par cha snyoms dma' tshad pod rer yig 'bru khri sum cu skor la cha bzhag na khong gi gsung rtsom la khyon bsdoms yig 'bru khri bzhi stong sum brgya skor zin pa khong dgung lo bdun cu don bdun 'tsho bzhugs ring ste 'khrungs nas ma 'das bar lo ltar gsung rtsom yig 'bru khri lnga bcu nga lnga lhag tsam zin pa de nyin(lo gcig la nyin 360la cha bzhag pa)rer cha snyoms gsung rtsom yig 'bru chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam 'bri gnang dgos shing / khong 'khrungs pa nas gzhon nu'i dus skabs dang / gsan bsam gnang ring / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'du bas 'chad rtsod gnyis la dgos pa'i dus tshod sogs phud na nyin ltar dkrig car bka' rtsom gnang dgos pa'i yig 'bru'i grangs 'bor ni ha las dgos pa dang 'dzam gling nang mkhas pa gcig gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom 'bor chen de lta bu yod pa ni shin tu mthong dkon pa'i rang bzhin yang / bod la ltos na de lta bu nyung nyung rang min pas bod kyi mkhas pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bus brtsams pa'i gsung rab kyi glegs bam ni dngos 'brel bgrangs kyis mi lang bas bod 'di rig gzhung gi rgya mtsho yin zhes pa ni don la gnas pa zhig rang yin/ 'on kyang lo bcu'i nang zing skabs bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang lhag par gsung rab la god chags tshab chen snying la na tsha gtong dgos pa'i gnas tshul byung ba ni sus kyang 384

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/brjed mi srid pa dang brjed kyang mi rung ba'i bslab cha gting zab po zhig yin/tang gis zing bcos yo bsrangs kyi las don nang mi rigs rig gnas kyi shul rgyun nyams pa sor 'chud mi nyams gong 'phel gtong rgyu de gal che'i gros rim nang bzhag thog lhag par mi rigs rig gnas myur skyob byed pa'i mdzad phyogs srid jus rab dang rim pa gtan la phab pa des mi rigs rig gnas dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad la nye ba'i skabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i dbugs dbyung thob par mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis tang gi mdzad phyogs bzang por bcos ma ma yin pa'i bsngags brjod zhu bzhin yod/ rgyal yongs la ltos na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs sa khul la ltos na'ang 'dra lag len ni bden don zhib bsher byed pa'i tshad gzhi 'ba' zhig yin stabs 'das zin pa'i bya ba dang bskyod myong ba'i lam bur yang bskyar phyi mig bltas te lag len dngos kyi nang thob pa'i grub 'bras sra brtan dang de dag dar spel gtong ba/ pham nyes ni brjed mi rung ba'i bslab byar rtsis te pham nyes de'i ldog phyogs nas rgyal kha'i thabs lam 'tshol dgos pa bcas rang rang gi 'khur du babs pa'i las ka'i nang lo rgyus kyis phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i kha phyogs yang dag pa brgyud mdun bskyod byed dgos pa las the tshom dang ne+em nur ci yang byed mi nyan/ lhag par bod kyi dpal yon gnyis kyi 'dzugs skrun gegs med lam lhongs yong dang mi yong gi 'gag rtsa'i gnad don gal che ba'i gras te mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas 'tshud pa'i tshan rig dang rig gzhung slob gso'i bya gzhag gong 'phel gtong rgyu der thug stabs deng skabs ljongs tang ud nas thugs 'khur che bzhegoganang dang gnang bzhin par tshang mas gong bkur yi rangs dang gna' rabs rig gzhung gi rgya mtshor brtsi ba'i 385

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bod 'di deng dus kyi tshan rig lag rtsal dang / deng dus kyi rig gzhung bcas dang ldan la dpal 'byor gra rgyas kyi bod ljongs gsar pa zhig nga tsho'i mdun du 'char rgyur tshang mas re ba chen po byed bzhin yod/nga tshos mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong dgos na/ dang thog phul du byung ba'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi shul rgyun rnams nar 'gyangs phra mo tsam ma song ba myur skyob kyis mi rigs kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i 'og rig gnas de dag 'phel rgyas btang ba kho nas da gzod deng dus dang mthun la gsar gtod rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong thub/ gal srid phul du byung ba'i gna' rabs rig gnas kyi shul rgyun myur skyob ma byas pa yin na de ni tang gi gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rtsa don dang 'gal ba zhig yin/rgyu mtshan der brten bod rigs kyi phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu'i nang nas gal che ba zhig ni bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob byed pa de ni kha tsha dgos gtugs dang nga tsho mi rabs 'di'i mdun du lhags pa'i las 'gan gzi brjid che la dka' tshegs che ba zhig yin stabs nga tsho bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang dpe rnying rtsom sgrig khang gi blo mthun tshos ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob 'go khrid tshogs chung bcas kyi 'go khrid dang / lhag par bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob kyi las ka dam 'dzin gyis lo 'khor gcig la nye ba'i ring dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa'i bod yig dpe rnying khag gcig myur skyob bsdu rub byas pa ste dpe rnying yod khungs sde tshan dang sger khag nas ma dper g.yar po zhus te de dag par slog gam yang na gtsang bshu byed 386

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/pa/ phyogs sgrig ste dpe rnying gi nang don ji ma ji bzhin sor bzhag las rgyas bsdus ye mi byed pa'i rtsa don nan tan du bzung ste lag bris ma sogs ma dpe'i nang gi yig nor ma dag rgyun 'byams su mi 'gro ba dag bcos bya 'os tsam las gzhan nang don yi ge na gcig la'ang 'gyur ldog mi gtong ba/ klog pa pos gzigs bde'i ched nang don sa bcad dang / dkar chag zhib tsam 'god pa/ dpe rnying gang dang gang gi rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus dang / nang don mdor bsdus bcas sgrig pa po'i gleng gzhi'i tshul du mtshams sbyor bcas kyi las ka'i go rim brgyud 'di lo nas bzung nang don phun sum tshogs la dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa'i dpe rnying khag rim bzhin phyogs sgrig gis dpe bskrun thub pa bya rgyu ni nga tsho'i las 'gan kho na yin pa bcas re zhig bod yig dpe rnying mtshams sbyor gyi skor zhu mtshams 'dir 'jog rgyu'o/ /brjod don dngos gzhi/gong du ji ltar 'phros pa bzhin ring min rtsom sgrig gis dpe bskrun thub pa bya rgyu'i khongs su khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa(rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long paṇa chen bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkral ba dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho legs bshad nor bu'i 'byung khungs〉 zhes bya ba'am bsdus ming〈rgyan gyi bstan bcos dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho〉 zhes dang /〈khams pa'i snyan 'grel chen mo〉 zhes grags pa don ldan gyi bstan bcos de skabs 'di'i brjod don dngos gzhir bzung ste klog pa por rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus rags pas skabs phye nas bstan bcos de'i gtso che ba'i khyad chos mngon 387

snye nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsal du bton te nang don rags pa zhig zhu rgyu gsham gsal/rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ khams sprul sku phreng bzhi pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'am/ mtshan gzhan sgra dbyangs zla ba bdud rtsi'i lang tshor grags pa mchog ni rab nyi lcags khyi lor(spyi lo 1730)rdza stod dpon tshang zhes pa'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi pa chu glang lor(spyi lo 1733)mdo khams lha thog rgyal po'i mnga' khongs kha stag dkar mo'i ri khug khams pa dgon zhes bya ba mdo khams khul gyi 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi rtsa ba'i gdan sa dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi sprul skur ngos 'dzin zhus/dpal spungs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / bde chen chos 'khor gyi yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs mkhas grub du ma bla mar bsten nas phyi nang gi rigs gzhung rgya mtsho lta bur thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang /rang lugs gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms med du spyad de gzhung bka' pod sogs kyi 'grel chen mang du mdzad/ lhag par si tu'i drung nas snyan ngag me long dang / sgra tsan+d+ra pa/ sdeb sbyor sogs thun mong rig pa'i gnas rnams gsan bsam legs par gnang ste dgung lo nyer lnga rab 'dod shing khyi lor(spyi lo 175susnyan ngag me long gi 'grel chen(dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho〉brtsams pa dang / de nas lo ngo bcu drug ring mdzad seng dang bstun yang nas yang du dbri snon dag bcos legs par mdzad de mthar dgung lo zhe gcig rab 'dod lcags stag spyi lo 1770lor yongs su grub par mdzad pas mtshon thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag rang dbang du mdzad de 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ lhag tu bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i bya 388

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/gzhag la mi nub pa'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog pa gnang / khong dgung lo bcu drug pa'i shing glang lor(spyi lo 1745)kha stag dkar mo'i ri khug nas phyis kyi gdan sa gnas yul phun tshogs chos 'khor gling du gnas spo mdzad nas rten brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / rgyun bzhugs dge 'dun sum brgya tsam yod pa/ de'i rjes gying phu dpal gyi yang dben du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par thos bsam gtso bor mdzad pa'i mkhas pa rab 'byams pa dang / bka' bcu pa'i mtshan thob pa dge 'dun brgya phrag brgal ba bzhugs pa'i mtshan nyid dgon rnam rgyal chos 'khor gling / sga nyag dkar mo'i ri'i yang gong du sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i sgrub sde gsang chen mthong grol gling bcas bshad sgrub sngags gsum gyi chos sde gsum rim par btab ste lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin cing spel bar mdzad/mkhas grub bsod nams rab 'phel dang / rab 'byams pa blo gros bstan pa/ 'dzi sgar rdo rje grags pa sogs mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid kyi slob ma'i tshogs mang po bskyangs te mthar dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i rab 'dod sa mo phag lor(spyi lo 1779)phun tshogs chos 'khor gling du sku gshegs/khams sprul zhes bya ba'i mtshan thogs stangs ni rab phyogs sa mo sbrul lor(spyi lo 1548)khams kho tsha rin chen sgang du 'khrungs pa/ khams pa grub chen karma bstan 'phel zhes bya bas stag lung thang pa'i dbon rgyud gsum pa sangs rgyas dbon gyis btab pa mar thang ri bo che'i dgon du grwa sar zhugs te mar thang khri pa rje drung mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs bsten nas dbang lung man ngag 389

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nod/ phyis karma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje las bsnyen par rdzogs/lhag par 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mnyam med lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po dang bla slob tu gyur te 'brug pa'i gdams skor cha tshang gsan cing / bla mas khyod kyi 'gro don khams su yod pas der song la sgrub pa gyis shig ces pa'i bkas bskul ba ltar khams su byon te mi zhig rdo rje'i yang rdzong dang ḍa ki gsang phug sogs su sgrub pa mthar bskyal/ 'dzi sgar bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs rgya mtsho rnam dgus mtshon slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas gnas dang gang zag gi mtshan gcig tu 'dres te rgyal ba mdo khams pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan de byung / de rjes khams sprul sku phreng gsum pa 'gro 'dul ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyi sku che'i smad la khams lha thog rgyal po nas sbyin bdag zhus te kha stag dkar mo'i ri khug tu dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi gdan sa btab pas mdo khams su 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi rtsa ba'i gdan sar gyur pa bcas khams sprul zhes bya ba'i mtshan dang gnas phun tshogs chos 'khor gling btab pa'i lo rgyus rags pa de tsam mo/ /skabs 'dir khams sprul 'khrungs lor dogs sel dgos pa zhig yod de/bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo'i gsham du bkod pa'i lo tshigs re'u mig nang‘‘rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1745lor khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma 'khrungs’’zhes dang / ‘‘rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags stag khams sprul chos kyi nyi mas snyan ngag 'grel pa brtsams ’zhes byung ba dang / 'dir bshad pa'i 'khrungs lo'i dbar lo bco lnga'i khyad par yod pa de yin/ lo tshigs 'di mtha' dpyod legs par yong ched yig lam gyi khungs dang bcas cung zad gleng na/ snyan 'grel 'di'i gsham du bkod pa khams sprul gyi bka' 390

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/rtsom(shis brjod〉kyi mjug byang du/ ‘ ces pa chu bya gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dga' ston rang nyid gang du skyes pa'i yul du sdod skabs dang 'grig pas/ spun zla sa skyong sku mched la phan par gdams pa'i gtam bzang 'khor lo rin po che 'di yang bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas rang lo nyer bzhi pa'i thog mar slebs pa'i tshe shis pa brjod pa ’zhes gsungs pa'i rab 'dod chu bya lo ni spyi lo 1753yin/ snyan 'grel chen mo'i mjug byang du‘ ces pa 'di yang bla ma'i gdan sa bde ba chen po'i chos 'khor du rang lo nyer lnga'i rtser son pa na rdzogs par bris pa la/ slar yang 'jam mgon paṇa chen bla ma'i spyan sngar 'dris gtugs dang dogs gcod yang nas yang du zhus te/ ji ltar bka' bstsal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin pa nyid rang blos ci nus su bzung nas/ dbri bsnan dang bcos sgyur dag par byas te drung yig mi pham chos 'phel gyis yi ge pa byas nas rang gnas dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por lcags pho stag gi lo tha skar can gyi yar tshes la grub par bgyis pa ’zhes gsungs pas snyan 'grel gyi ma zin thog ma grub pa'i dus ni khams sprul dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng son pa ste shing khyi lor(spyi lo 175suyin pa dang mthar grub pa'i dus ni khams sprul dgung lo zhe gcig pa lcags stag lor(spyi lo 1770)yin pa bstan/ gzhan yang si tu'i rang rnam(tā'i si tur 'bod pa karma bstan pa'i nyin byed(chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs)kyi rang tshul drang por brjod pa dri bral shel gyi me long〉nang‘ khams pa sprul sku phebs par bsam 'phel phebs bsur song /khams sprul dang mjal dar rtse sprod mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten gser zho lnga/dngul srang lnga sogs gnang byung / thog ma 'i rten 'byung du tshe dpag dkar 391

nor brang yo rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/po'i dbang dang / mtshan dang zhabs brtan tshiḍa bcad phul (sde dge shing par 93ba 4la gsal)zhes pas si tu'i bla ma khams sprul sku phreng gsum pa'i yang srid dang si tu thog mar mjal skabs mjal dar rtse sprod gnang ba dang khong sku tshe yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du tshe dbang dang / zhabs brtan phul bas mtshon 'di'i dus ni rab 'dod sa lug(spyi lo 1739)zla 7pa'i tshes 3yas mas kyi skabs yin/yang rang rnam de'i nang‘‘ khams sprul phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad bgyis/ gsol ston zhus/ 'bul nod rgya chen gnang / khams sprul tsan+d+ra pa'i ri mo dang / 'chi med mdzod kyi bshad pa dang ka chen gyi zhabs phyi zhus nas/ bdud mo sku skye/ mkhar dbon sogs bcas la bsdus ra phul ’(155na4)zhes pa'i dus ni lcags lug(spyi lo 1751)zla 2pa'i nang yin/yang rang rnam de'i nang‘‘ nyer brgyad nyin khams sprul dpon slob rnams phebs phyi nyin nas khams sprul/ kun khyab/ sgra ram bcas par rgya 'grel gnyis kyi rgya dpe'i steng nas snyan ngag gi dogs bsal bgyis shing / rgyal nya'i tshes gsum nyin nas supa mtha' rin 'byung gi dogs gcod dang / nyi shu nyin mdzod 'grel gsar 'gyur gyi bshad pa tshugs ’(164na2)'di'i lo zla ni chu bya(spyi lo 1753)zla bcu gcig pa yin/yang rang rnam nangapha‘ khams sprul nas 'ba' ra ba'i yig char brten grub rgyal tshe khrid zhus/ sdeb sbyor gyi dogs gcod dang / nged kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung byas ’’(164na 7) zhes pa'i dus ni shing khyi(spyi lo 175suzla ba dang po'i nang yin/ gong gsal gsung phyi ma dum bu gsum po'i nang don nas khams sprul gyis 392

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/snyan 'grel gyi thog ma'i ma zin ma grub gong si tu'i drung nas thun mong gi rig gnas khag gsan bsam legs par grub pas ma tshad/ sngon du snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor sogs gsan zin par mtha' dpyod kyi rim pa'ang lam tsam grub pa mtshon/gong gsal khams sprul nyid dang si tu'i gsung nas dpog nus pa ni/khams sprul rab nyi shing glang lor(spyi lo 1745)'khrungs par rtsis na khams sprul gyis thun mong rig gnas gsan bsam legs par gnang rjes gzhi nas brtsams pa snyan 'grel gyi ma zin thog ma grub pa'i dus spyi lo 1754la babs pa de'i dus su khams sprul dgung lo dgu las son mi thub pas de lta bu sku byis pa'i dus su kun gyis tshad mar 'jog pa'i snyan 'grel chen mo 'di lta bu'i ma zin grub pa ni 'byung dka' ba'i gnas bcas 'dir bkod pa'i 'khrungs lo sogs kyi lo tshigs la dogs pa skye ba'i rgyu med/snyan 'grel de'i khyad chos rags pa/ khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa(rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long ma paṇa chen bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkral ba dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho legs bshad nor bu'i 'byung khungs〉 zhes bya ba ni snyan ngag me long ma'i 'grel pa mang po'i nang nas dmigs bsal khyad chos du mas phyug pa'i snyan 'grel rgyas shos dang gsal shos kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa 'di la bod kyi snyan 'grel gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gtso bo'i khyad chos chen po bzhi yod/de yang bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas nges pa don gyi mkhas pa chen po si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi drung nas snyan ngag me long ma rgya 'grel gnyis kyi steng nas bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa dang / sgra'i ri mo dang / sdeb 393

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sbyor/ mngon brjod sogs thun mong rig gnas mtha' dag legs par gsan pa ma zad/ de dag gi mtha' dpyod kyang gang 'tshams grub pa'i rjes bstan bcos 'di'i thog ma'i ma zin brtsams grub pa nas yongs su ma grub bar lo ngo bcu drug ring snyan gzhung gi dka' gnad gtso che ba re re bzhin la rang gi bla ma'i gsung rgyun rgya 'grel gnyis dang shong 'gyur bcas la gzhi byas/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ snar thang pa sang gha shrī/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jig grags/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs kha che/ gung thang bde ba'i blo gros sogs bod kyi mkhas pa du mas mdzad pa'i snyan 'grel mang po'i legs cha bsdus pa dang / dka' gnad gtso che ba re re bzhin zhib bsdur thog rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' sogs phyogs ris log rtog gi dri ma dang yongs su bral bar chu 'go gangs dang chos rgyud bla ma'i dpe bzhin rtsa ba dang gzhung 'di rgya gar nas byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgya 'grel gyi 'dod tshul gang yin par gzhi bcol te dgag sgrub dgos pa'i gnad don gtso che'i rigs la ngo 'dzin zom 'jog dang /dka' gnad yal bar dor nas gnad don chung tsag la dgos med tshig ro'i stong bshad min par me long ma'i gzhung don ji lta ba bzhin dpyad gsum rnam par dag pas gtan la phab pa dper na/ dpe rgyan gyi skabs mnyam nyid dang /ngag don gyi skor/ gzugs can skabs khyad par gzugs can/ 'gog rgyan skabs byung ba 'gog pa/ de bzhin phra mo'i rgyan sogs dka' gnad mang po'i skor mtha' dpyod legs par mdzad pa phyis snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi lam ston sgron me dang mtshungs pa sus kyang bston du med pa bod khams mtha' dbus kun tu khams pa'i snyan 'grel chen mo zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog 394

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/'thor ba sogs dbyug pa can gyi dgongs pa bod du 'phel rgyas kyi tshad mthon por slebs pa'i mtshon rtags te bod kyi mkhas pa grangs las 'das pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi legs bshad nying khu gcig tu bsdus pa ni snyan 'grel 'di'i khyad chos thun mong min pa dang po'o/ /me long ma las/ snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi/ /chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod/ /de ni da lta'ang rnam rtog ste/ /de dag ma lus sus 'chad nus//'on kyang rnam rtog sa bon ni/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /de nyid rab tu legs sbyar phyir/ /yongs su ngal 'di bdag gi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin snyan ngag gi rgyan la mtha' med pa gzhung las dngos su ma bstan pa gang zhig blo dang ldan pas rjes su dpog dgos pa'i rigs kyang bod 'grel gzhan ltar rtsa ba'i go don bstan pa tsam mam/ yang na mtshon dpe cha shas tsam la cha ma bzhag par rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel nas bsgyur ba dang bcas pas kha skong gnang ba dper na/ dpe rgyan skabs‘gzugs can dpe yi rnam rtog rnams/ /mtha' yod ma yin ’’zhes gsungs pa'i dpe gzhan yang mtshon phyir sbyar rgyan gyi zla bo dngos po'i dper dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thams cad sgrol gyi yal 'dab tu/ /phul phyin khyad par grags pa ni/ /gnyis nyid bzang po'i skye ba la/ /sbyin pas lag brlan 'jig rten na/ khyod dang mtho brtan glang 'di'o/ /zhes pa lta bu/ mi mthun pa'i dper klu gzhon nu'i rtogs brjod yal 'dab tu/bzhin ras mdzes shing spyan yangs pa/ /zla ba nya dang pad rtsa dag /'grogs pa bzhin du bde ster ba'i/ /rgyal ba der ni mthong bar gyur/ /ces dang /yang nag shod pa chos dbang grags pas rje mi la'i bstod par/ 'phong skyen dga' byed mda' yis 'bod sgroḍa kyi/ /ri dwaḍa mchog de bzung bar ma nus 395

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/kyang / khyod kyi snying stobs mtshon chas nyon mongs kyi/ /dgra de skad cig gcig la thal bar brlag /ces dang / sngon med pa'i dper zur mkhar ba'i 'phrin yig mdza' bo'i rgyan du/ nags dang mtsho 'gram rnams su rgyu ba'i tshe/ /chu skyes mtha' dag kun tu rgyas byed pa/ /nyin mo sa la rgyu ba'i zla 'od 'dis/ /bdag gi lus kyang ke la sha bzhin byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/gzugs can gyi skabs/ ma brjod rjes su dpag pas rtogs par bya dgos pa mtshon don du rab brtags kyi gzugs can dper dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ nyin mo'i snang ba shin tu gzhon/ /mtshan mo'i srin mo'i bud med kyis/ /zos pa thod pa'i dum bu bzhin/ /ri bong can ni snang bar gyur/ /ces pa lta bu dang / don gzhan bkod pa'i gzugs can gyi dper gtsug na nor bu'i yal 'dab tu/ 'gro 'dir spros pa rmad byung rin chen tshogs/ /chu srin 'byung gnas dag las skye bar ldan/ /su zhig kyang ni rab tu gsal ba ru/ /bde bar 'gro ba skyes bu rin chen skyes/ /zhes pa lta bu/ sngon med gzugs can gyi dper bsngags 'os bsngags bstod du/ tshul khrims phung po sku che zhing / /ting 'dzin shing gis rnam par brgyan/ /ye shes 'bab chus khyab gyur ba/ /rgyu ba'i gangs can ri bo lags/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsal byed skabs/ lhag ma rnams rig pas dpag ste rtogs dgos pa mtshon don du rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel gyi dper brjod drangs pa/ dpe'i gsal byed/ lus phra khyod kyi mchu sgros la/ /chags pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong / /snying la chags pa nyid kyis 'dir/ /bdag srog phrogs pa min nam ci/ /zhes dang / rab brtags kyi gsal byed/ ri dwags mig can rnams kyi mig /chags pa'i sgeg pas 'phrog par byed/ /bdag la dkyus ring sgo gtan ni/ /396

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/'grol bar skye bos smra ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / 'gog ba'i gsal byed/ /rno zhing rno ba'i ral gri ni/ /'dzin pa nye bar mi gnas kyang / /ri dwags migakhyod rnam 'phrul gyis/ /bdag srog 'phrog par byed min nam/ /zhes pa lta bu/'gog rgyan skabs/ ma bshad pa dpog par nus pa mtshon don du rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel gyi dper brjod drangs pa/ phyin ci log gi 'gog pa ni/ su zhig bud med mchog 'di rnams/ /'di na ci phyir mthong bar 'gyur/ /mtho ris 'jig rten la brten par/ /'di rnams mig mi 'dzum par shes/ /zhes dang /nges pa 'gog pa/ /blo yis bcos pa'i bud med rnams/ /myos pa'i sgrub byed kyis 'di ltar/ /lha yi bu mo 'ga' zhig gis/ /lta ba gang phyir de tsam nyid/ /ces dang / rab tu dwangs pa 'gog pa/ srog gis kyang ni lus phra dang / /yang dag 'grogs par rab dwangs min/ /gang nyid ral gri rtsub pa ste/ /'di las mchog gang ci zhig thob/ /ces pa lta bu/phul byung gi skabs/ sogs khongs gzhung 'dir dper ma brjod pa rig pas dpog dgos pa'i mtshon don du/ rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel nas bsgyur ba/bzlog pa'i phul byung / chu shing kun las chu shing brla/ /'o ma 'dzin pas gzhan du byas/ /khyed kyi sked pa med ces pa/ /'di las bdag yid bzlog par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpe'i rjes su 'gro ba'i phul byung / mig ni sngon po'i mdangs 'phro zhing / /so ni dag pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /de dag tha dad ldan pa yis/ /gaṅgā ya mu na dpal 'dzin/ /zhes dang / gzugs can gyi rjes su 'gro ba'i phul byung / bzhin zla dgod pa'i zla 'od dag /'grogs pa khyod kyi mdzes pa ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dma' ba 'di/ /mtshan mo gsal phyir 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rab brtags kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i phul byung / khyod 397

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mig sngon mo g.yo ba na/ /mig gi 'od zer skyod pa yis/ /phyoḍa kun mjes par 'gongs byed pas/ /mtshan mo 'phrog par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu/rgyu rgyan skabs/ shugs bstan dngos med kyi 'bras bu can gsum/ rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel las kha bkang ba zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu dngos med kyi 'bras bu can/ mig med pas ni mdzes ma 'ga'/ /mthong ba de de rjes su dran/ /don med 'tsho bar bsam pa de/ /'dir ni lnga par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu dngos med kyi 'bras bu can/ pad ma can 'di lus phra min/ /pad ma 'di ni de gdong min/ /u t+pal 'di ni mig ma yin//de nyid med pas srog rnams so/ /zhes dang / spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu dngos med kyi 'bras bu can/ nam du yang ni lus phra de'i/ /yid gcug rnam 'phrul 'byung ma yin/ /zhes pa sems pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /gzhan phyir pha rol 'jig rten nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/bsnyon dor skabs/ dbye ba gzhan mtshon don du/ rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel nas drangs pa/ thams cad bsnyon dor/ 'gro 'di thams cad mdza' mo ste/ /'gro ba zhes bya ci yang med/ /de lta na yang sems dga' byed/ /dwangs pa ma yin mdza' mo min/ /zhes dang / rgyu la bsnyon dor/ mdza' mo nyid min 'gog byed nyid/ /de ni brtse ba med pa yi/ /'phro ba nyid ni rten byed cing / /gtum mo 'ga' zhig gsal bar byed/ /ces dang / snyan pa gtso bo'i bsnyon dor/ nu ma gnyis 'di khyod khur min/ /'dren par dka' ba 'di yis ci/ /ci phyir srog ldan lus phra ma/ /'di yi mtshar du 'dod ma yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/khyad par brjod pa'i skabs/ dbye ba mkhan rnams kyang brtags par bya dgos pa mtshon don du/ rat+na shrīs mdzad pa'i dper brjod nas drangs pa/ bya 398

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/ba mi 'gal ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ 'di la dug ni cung zad med/ /'di lta zhags par brjod min yang / /'gro rnams ri dwags mig can gyi/ /mig gis brgyal dang 'ching bar byed/ /ces dang / bya ba 'gal ba'i khyad par brjod pa//de 'dra mtshon rnon 'ga' yang min/ /bdud rtsi yang ni ma yin mod/ /bud med rnams kyi khro dga' yis/ /skad cig 'joms shing 'tsho bar byed/ /ces dang /snyan par smra ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ lus phra khyod kyi nu ma dag /ma dud 'jam pa'ang ma yin mod/ /'on kyang 'di dag nyid kyi ni/ /'gro 'di shin tu chags par gyur/ /ces pa lta bu/zol bstod skabs/ zol bstod rgyan mtha' dang bral ba gzhan rtogs dgos pa mtshon don du/ rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel nas drangs pa/ rang bzhin gyi zol bstod ni/ sa chen po ni ma lus pa/ /brang 'gro yis ni rnam par bzung / /rgyal po khyod kyi rgyal srid che/ /thob la mngon par nga rgyal ci/ /zhes dang / sbyar ba'i zol bstod/ sgyu ma'i dbang gi 'jig rten 'di/ khyod kyi rnam par brtul ba'i blo/ /nag po'i spyod ldan khyod kyis grags/ /smra bar byed la mtshar ci yod/ /ces dang / rab brtags kyi zol bstod/ mdzes ma khyod kyi rna ba la/ /u t+pal bzung ba'i rol pa yi/ /rtsal gyi mig ni dud gyur pas/ /cher snyems 'dzum par byed pa ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rgya 'grel gyi dper brjod kyi go don legs par dgrol ba dang / rgyan de rnams kyi mtshon dper dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs snyan ngag chen po'i bstan bcos nang gsal ba skabs dang sbyar ba ni bstan bcos 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos gnyis pa'o/ /rgyan 'di dang de'i mtshan nyid cha 'dra ba'i gnad don mi 'khrul ba'i ched rgyan so so'i skabs kyi rgyas bshad kho nar cha ma bzhag pa 'khrul sla ba'i rigs 399

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rgyan gnyis bsdur nas dpyad pa mdzad de yang bskyar 'di dang de'i khyad chos mngon gsal du bton te khyad par dbye ba dper na/ 'gog rgyan skabs 'gyod pas 'gog pa dang / rgyu rgyan gyi snga na med pa'i byed rgyu'i khyad par/ don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan dang / zla bo dngos po'i dpe'i khyad par/ rten gyi dbye ba'i ldog pa can dang / phul byung gi dpe'i khyad par sogs kyang snyan 'grel gzhan las ches gsal ba dang / zhib cha che ba/ mtha' chod pa/ khungs sgra la gtugs pa bcas ni bstan bcos 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos gsum pa'o/ /le'u gsum pa sgra rgyan skabs zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i dper brjod bod skad la bsgyur bas sgra rgyan zhig pas rgya skad kyi zung ldan bod la mi 'jug mod/ rtsa ba'i dper brjod kyi go ba zhib tu gleng ba dang chabs cig dper brjod de dag don rgyan gyi dbye bas skabs phye na gang dang gang yin spyi tsam mam/ nang gses zhib tu bstan pa dper na/ bar ma chod pa rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi thog mar yod pa'i zung ldan gyi dper brjod dpe rgyan dang / dang po dang gsum pa thog mar yod pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ dang po dang bzhi pa'i thog mar yod pa bar gyi gsal byed lta bu sogs snyan 'grel gzhan nang de lta'i dbye ba phye med pa ni bstan bcos 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan yang / rtsa ba'i dper brjod nang rig byed pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar ba rtogs dka' ba'am/ cher yongs su ma grags pa'i rigs kyang cung rgyas par gleng ba dper na/ khyad par gzugs can gyi skabs chu bo gaṅgā'i gtam rgyud dang / rgya che ba'i rgyan gyi skabs rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud/ rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i skabs tshangs pa'i dka' thub gzhom stangs kyi 400

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/gtam rgyud thor bu/ nyams rgyan skabs 'grel pa 'dod 'jo nas nyams 'gyur gyi dbye ba zhib tu phye ba rnams gsal bar mdzad pa sogs kyang snyan 'grel gzhan las zhib cha che ba bcas so/ /gong gsal gyi khyad chos de dag las mtshon thub pa ni/ snyan 'grel 'di nyid bod 'grel gzhan las ches khyad par 'phags pa dang / ches rgyas pa/ches gsal ba/ ches khungs dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos shig red ces kha tshon gcod nus pa de lags/bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi mtshan 'dzin yon krang bod ljongs slob grwa che mo'i dge rgan che mo mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis mdzad pa'i(snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed〉nang shong dpang sogs bod 'gyur bod 'grel skad grags che ba rnams kyi mtshan byang mtshams sbyor gnang ba'i mjug bsdoms su‘‘de dag gi nang nas khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i〈snyan 'grel dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho〉 ni rang nyid kyi bla ma si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis rgya 'grel rgya dpe ma gnyis kyi steng nas gsung bshad gnang ba'i zin bris gzhir bzung ste bris pa yin stabs/ snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa'i nang nas rgyas shos su 'dug par ma zad/ snga 'grel rnams las ches gsal zhing /legs bshad che bas blo gros che ba rnams kyis gzhung de nyid rang bltas na bzang ’zhes gsungs pa ni snyan 'grel 'di'i phyogs bsdoms gting zab po zhig red/gong du mtshams sbyor zhus pa'i bstan bcos de ni nga tshos rtsom zhus yongs su zin te mi ring bar dpe skrun zhus te klog pa po'i phyag tu son rgyu ma zad/ da 401

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dung lo rgyus dang rig gnas kyi dpe rnying khag gcig kyang rim bzhin klog pa po'i phyag tu son rgyu 'di nyid ni bod rigs spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas la do snang gnang mkhan tsho dgyes pa bskyed pa'i bkra shis pa'i bya ba zhig los yin/da phan dus thung gi las ka'i nang nga tshos gsal por mthong thub pa ni bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob yag po yong dang mi yong gi 'gag rtsa de tang gi 'go khrid dang / rim pa gong ma'i thugs 'khur dang rgyab skyor la rag las pa smos ci dgos/gzhan du na bod rigs mkhas pa spyi dang / lhag par mkhas dbang bgres gras rnams nas rin thang dang bral ba'i bod yig dpe rnying('ga' zhig rig gnas gsar brje'i nang srog dang bsdos te srung skyob gnang ba tshud)khong tsho'i phyag tu yod pa dang / thugs mnga'i babs kyi gzhan la rgyud skul gnang ba sogs dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa'i dpe rnying mang po nga tshor ma dper g.yar po gnang ba(da lam mtshams sbyor zhus pa'i snyan 'grel gyi ma dpe yang mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog nas nga tshor g.yar po gnang ba)dang / phyogs sgrig skabs 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal sel rogs bcas mkhas dbang rnams kyi thugs 'khur dang shugs che'i rgyab skyor dang yang kha 'bral thabs med/ nga tshos skabs 'di dang bstun nas khong tshor snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang chabs cig gal cher nan dpe bzhin slad ma'i char yang nang don phun sum tshogs la dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa myur skyob byed dgos nges kyi bod yig dpe rnying gang na ci mchis myur skyob ma dpe'i ched du nga tshor g.yar po yong ba zhu rgyu dang / nga tshos kyang spyi sger gang thad nas g.yar po 402

khams sprul snyan 'grel chen mo'i skor nas 'phros pa'i gtam/gnang son byung ba'i ma dper gces spras kyis bor brlag ltar bzhag tha na nag nog ral brdol gang yang mi 'byung ngos/ par slog dang gtsang bshu zin nyid phyir 'bul zhu rgyu ma zad/ 'os 'tshams kyi thob cha dang / lhag par dngos su dpe skrun skabs sus(sde tshan dang sger)dpe rnying srung skyob gnang ba'i gnas tshul klog pa por mtshams sbyor dang dpe rnying srung skyob las ka'i nang 'jog gnang gi mdzad rjes mtshon thabs bya rgyu bcas mdor na nga tshos bod kyi rig gnas la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang mkhan tsho'i thuḍa bzhed gang ba'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don khang gi nus pa gang legs 'don spel thub par 'bad brtson zhu rgyu lags so/ /403

snyan ngag gi bstan bcos bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i skor gleng ba/'dzam gling gi rtse mthor gnas shing sa mtho'i dge mtshan brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yul gru 'dir 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod mi rigs ni las la brtson zhing grung sha dod la/ blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa zhig yin pa dang / yangs shing rgya che ba'i yul khams 'dir lo rgyus yun ring ldan la brjid chags yid du 'ong zhing / ngo mtshar du mas phyug pa'i gna' bo'i 'dzugs skrun dang / rtsa che'i gna' rabs rig gzhung gi dngos po kun gsal sgeg mo'i brang khar skar tshogs nor bu'i do shal gyis spud pa'i mdzes pa blta bas mi ngom pa skye rgu'i yid dbang 'gug pa'i lcags kyu dang chos mtshungs pa yod pa'i nang nas kyang bod yig dpe rnying ni rtsa che'i nor bu rin thang gzhal bar dka' ba zhig yin la/ de ni krung hwa mi rigs kyi nor bu zhig dang / 'dzam gling mi rigs kyi nor bu zhig kyang red/ bod kyi lo rgyus ches ring ba'i gnas tshul ri mo'i gzugs su 'phos pa'i bod yig dpe rnying gis bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon yod pa ma zad/ deng dus bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag la thon dang thon bzhin pa'i nus pa yang shin tu che ba zhig yin/'on kyang b.ram‘skabs rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i ’’nang bod kyi gna' rabs rig gnas spyi dang / lhag par bod yig dpe rnying la gtor bshig tshabs chen phog pas dpe rnying myur skyob kyi bya ba dka' ngal can zhig srid 404

snyan ngag gi bstan bcos bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i skor gleng ba/gzhung gi nyin re'i gros rim nang mi 'jog mthu med byung ba ni tshang ma'i blo la gsal ba ltar lags/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes tang dang rgyal khab kyis dpe rnying myur skyob kyi bya ba dam 'dzin shugs chen gnang yod pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus don thog tu 'khyol ba'i mtshon rtags shig yin/grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpe rnying myur skyob dang / 'phel rgyas/ phyogs sgrig bcas byed dgos pa'i skor tang dang / rgyal khab kyis gal che'i mdzub ston rim par gnang ba gzhir bzung bar skabs bod rigs gnas sdod kyi sa khul khag nas rin thang ches che ba'i bod yig dpe rnying mang po myur skyob dang /dpe skrun gyis rgyal khab phyi nang du 'grems spel byas par mi tshos tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog dang / bsngags brjod byed bzhin yod/ lhag par du dpe rnying dpe skrun gyi bya gzhag de bod kyi rig gnas dang / lo rgyus la zhib 'jug bod kyi rig gnas shes rtogs yong ba byed mkhan rnams kyi re ba skong thub pa'i phyogs su 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod pas bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag la'ang zhabs 'degs kyi nus pa chen po thon bzhin yod na/ dga' ba skye 'os pa'i bya ba 'di dag bod la zhi ba'i bcings bgrol thob nas lo ngo bzhi bcu song ba'i nang thob pa'i grub 'bras gal chen zhig kyang yin/skabs 'dir kho bos bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus rags pa 'phros don du byas nas bod yig dpe rnying yang bskyar 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su gom stabs spo thub pa des bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag la nus pa chen po thon pa'i mtshon rtags snyan 405

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ngag gi bstan bcos bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i skor gleng bar 'dod pa de yin/dang po/ bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel ba dang dus mtshungs bod yig dpe rnying yang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba/spyir bod kyi yul dang / mi'i 'gro ba byung ba'i dus ni ches snga ba zhig yin/de yang paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas/ ‘‘bod kyi mi rnams thog mar chags tshul la spre'u dang brag srin mo gnyis 'dus pa las chags pa'i gtam’’zhes dang / ‘‘lung rnam 'byed dang dus kyi 'khor lo sogs su'ang bod ces mang du 'byung bas ngo bo bdag cag gi ston pa byon pa'i dus las yul dang mi gnyis ka ches snga bar chags(rgya gar dang dus mnyam du chags par byas na'ang 'gal ba med)pa zhig tu snang ’’(deb ther dmar po gsar ma deb ngos 15)zhes dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsholo‘stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs kyis kyang rgya bal sogs yul gru gzhan dang 'dra bar thog ma nas mi'i 'gro ba chags par bzhed’’(be+eḍūr+ya g.ya' sel shing dpar ma'i shog grangs 375)ces bod kyi sngon byon lo rgyus smra ba dang / rig pa smra ba'i mkhas dbang rnams kyi bod kyi lo rgyus dngos dang mthun pa'i bzhed tshul de dag yang dag pa yin pa deng dus chab mdo'i kha rub dang / lha sa'i dog sde sogs bod kyi sa 'og nas sngog 'don byas pa'i gna' bo'i rig rdzas mang po nas dngos ra sprod bzhin yod/ lhag par bod kyi mi rigs spre'u nas mched pa'i bzhed tshul de dag deng dus kun 406
