nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/par brten bod yig 'di ni 'dzam gling yi ge'i sngon thon gyi gral gnas su slebs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de tsho yin/ de lta bu'i khyad du 'phags pa'i yi ge la brten nas rang re'i sngon byon mes po rnams kyis mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs thog khyad du 'phags pa'i rlabs po che'i bya ba rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byas pa'i grub 'bras ngo mtshar can/ bod mi rigs kyi blo gros kyi snying bcud rnams ri mo'i gzugs su 'phos pa'i bod yig dpe rnying ni gna' bo'i dus nas bzung chu phran 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho ltar rim bzhin 'phel rgyas song bas mthar rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa dang / nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa yid bzhin nor bu dang mtshungs pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad ci dgar ster ba'i dge mtshan gzhal du med pa'i gnas lugs ni rtogs dka' ba min cing /bod yig dpe rnying ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi blo gros mtshon rtags bod kyi rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi nying khu gcig tu bsdus pa las grub pa de yin no/ /gnyis/ bod kyi gso ba rig par mtshon na/ sngar bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa dang dus mnyam par zhang zhung du gshen rab mi bo che zhes bya ba de'i gdung sras brgyad kyi bgres shos dpyad bu khri shes zhes bya ba zhig byung ba de'i skor bon gyi( legs bshad mdzod〉 las/‘‘bdud rgyal ram pa dug 'gyed kyis sems can rnams la nad kyi bskal ba dar bar byed pa la/ ston pas dpyad bu khri shes la bdud rtsi dpyad kyi mdo dgu sogs bstan nas sems can bde la bkod’’ces dang / (bstan pa gnyer gtad kyi mdo〉 las/ ‘‘dpyad rgyud nyi khrir gyur pa rnams/ /dpyad bu khri shes dag gis bsdus zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/ (shes bya spyi'i khog 'bug〉 nang / ‘‘tho tho ri snyan shal gyi ring la gso 456

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/dpyad kyi dbu brnyes zer ba de'ang ma nges te bon po la brten pa'i gso dbyad ji snyed cig yod la/ bon po ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa dang dus mtshungs su gshen rab mi bo che zhes bya ba spu rangs su byon par bshad pa'i phyir ro’’zhes dang / de rjes gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs bod kyi sman dpyad skor/ bon gyi bstan pa'i byung ba brjod pa(legs bshad skal bzang mgrin rgyan〉las/‘‘rgyu yi bon bzhi spyi las snga dar ba/ /shes pa can grangs bcu gnyis sngon rim ltar/ /khyad par rgyal po gnya' khri'i sku ring dar/ /de yang shes pa can zhes gang zhe na/ /phan shes sman dpyad bon zhes bya ba ni/ /bro nad gso bas tshe yi bar chad sel ’’zhes dang / blon po bka' thang las/ ‘‘bod rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yar lung btsan thang sgo bzhir byon dus yod pa drug ste/ rku yod/ sdang yod/ dgra yod/ g.yag yod/ dug yod/ byad sdems yod ces gsungs par/ rtsib lha skar ma yol sdes bod 'dir rku la lan yod/ sdang la byams yod/ dgra la gnyen yod/ g.yag la mtshon yod/ dug la sman yod/ byad stems la 'grol thabs yod ces ’yod pa drug gi so so'i gnyen po'i nang dug la sman yod ces bstan pas de'i dus su bod la sman dpyad phun sum tshogs pa yod pa mtshon pa dang / 'brong gnyan lde'u'i sras dmus long bkon pa bkra la yab kyi bka' ltar 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa gdan drangs te spyan phye ste skyid shod stag mo ri la gnyan 'gro ba gzigs pas mtshan la yang stag ri gnyan gzigs su thogs pa/ lhag par chos rgyal khri 457

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/srong lde btsan gyi sku dus sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog mgon pos bod kyi gso rig sman dpyad kyi phyag len rgya cher gnang ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog dang phul du gyur pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgyud bzhi 'chad nyan dar spel gnang ba dang / de rjes dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang sman bla gnyis pa g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po byon nas rgyud bzhi'i gzhung 'grel man ngag kha skong dang bcas pa mdzad nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs shin tu cha tshang bar mdzad pa bcas bod kyi gso ba rig pa 'di'i lo rgyus kyang shin tu ring la phyag len phun sum tshogs pas mi'i bde thang la dpag par dka' ba'i nus pa rlabs po che thon yod/gsum/ bod kyi skar rtsis rig par cha bzhag na/ da lta'i skar rtsis rig pa 'di dag ma dar ba'i lo ngo nyis stong lhag tsam gyi sngon nas bod rigs mi dmangs kyis gnam gyi skar ma la brtag pa'i rtsis dang / bar snang gi sprin dang rlung la brtag pa'i rtsis/ bya dang shing la brtag pa'i rtsis/ mtsho dang chab rom la brtag pa sogs dus rtags kyi rtsis rig sna tshogs pa nyams myong la brten nas rtsis kyi rig pa byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog rim gyis nyi zla skar gsum 'khor bgrod kyi chos nyid 'tshol zhib byed pa'i nang nyi ma'i 'gro phyogs dang /zla ba'i 'phel 'grib/ lho kha g.ya' bzang gi gam 'brog pa lha rgyal gyi sgrung deb nang / zla ba'i 'phel 'grib dang / dus tshigs kyi 'gyur ba/ dngos po dang gnam gshis kyi 'grel ba sogs bkod yod pa bcas bod la ches snga ba'i dus nas thun mong min pa'i skar rtsis rig pa'i myu gu 'bus pa dang / me tog shar ba/ 'bras bu 'dogs pa'i rgyud rim nges pa can byung yod pa/bzhi/ bzo rig par mtshon na/ 1 khang pa zo skrun gyi lag rtsal yang 458

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/bod la mi'i 'gro ba byung ba nas rim par brgyud de khang khyim bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar dus kyang ches snga ba zhig yin pa dus tshod 'di 'dra zhig nas khang khyim bzo skrun 'go tshugs pa red ces nges gtan brjod mi spobs kyang / da lta dus tshod nges bzung bya rgyu yod pa ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo nyis brgya'i gong ste gnya' khri btsan po'i dus mkhar la snga ba yum bu bla mkhar zhes rgyal po'i mkhar ram pho brang gi thog ma lho khar da lta yang de'i rjes shul sngon ma'i bzo bkod ji bzhin bskrun pa'i thog nas mtshon pa 'di gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su ar las 'dzugs skrun gyi lag rtsal tshad gzhi nges can du slebs pa mtshon/2 bod la lcags chas bzo bskrun gyi lag rtsal dar ba'i dus kyang ches snga ba zhig yin/ de yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/bod khams yul du rung bar gyur nas kyang //dang po mi ma yin gyi yul du gyur//gnod sbyin la sogs bcu yis dbang byas skad//yul gyi ming yang bzang yul rgyan med zer//mtshon cha mda' gzhu de yi dus su byung //de nas re re mgo yag bdud kyis byas//ming yang bdud yul kha rag rong dgur btags//sta re dgra sta de yi dus su byung //de nas srin po nag po dgu yul zer//srin mo rkang dang skyogs gnyis lag char byung //bzhi pa dmar 'jam lha yi dbang byas te//lha yul gung thang lag char chu gri byung //459

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ lnga pa rmu rgyal kho rje zhes byas bzung //da 'phrang gcan 'phrang lag par zhags pa 'then//drug pa dkrog dkrog 'dre yis dbang byas te//lang tang ling tang bar kha 'ur rdo 'then//bdun pa ma sangs rus dgus dbang byas te//yul gyi ming ni bod kha nya drug zer//lag char dong ral go cha phub chung byung //brgyad pa klus bzung bod khams gling dgu btags//dgu pa rgyal pos dbang byas ngam po che//bcu pa 'gong po spun dgus dbang byas te//yul gyi ming yang stong sde bco brgyad ces//zhes gsungs pa'i nang dang po mi ma yin gnod sbyin la sogs pa bcu yis dbang byas par skad pa ni bod du mi'i rigs kyi 'gro ba byung ba'i rjes su rim bzhin spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro ba'i gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nang rus tsho'i 'go pa tsho khag mi 'dra bas dbang sgyur byas pa'i gnas lugs bshad pa yin/gang yin zhe na/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig dang yul gru gang 'dra zhig gi gna' bo'i lo rgyus gleng skabs lha sgrung lta bu'i bshad tshul gyi nang nas don dngos 'tshol dgos pa zhig yong ba tshang ma'i mthong chod du grub pa de la ya mtshan skye ba'i rgyu med la/ de dag ni lha sgrung red ces 'dor bar bya ba ni dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi byed stangs yang dag pa zhig min/ rgyu mtshan der brten bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nang rus tsho phan tshun g.yul bkye ba'i skabs lag cha gtso bo gang spyod pa'i don dadzes de tsho'i thog nas bod la gri dang / sta re/460

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs sgrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/dgra sta sogs lcags chas can gyi mtshon cha bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar khyab byung ba de tsho'i thog nas bod la lcags chas bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar ba'i dus ni ches snga ba zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang mi ma yin skad pa'i dbang sgyur gyi rim pa bcu'i rjes su bod la rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang / sil ma bzhi bcu byung rjes gzhi nas gnya' khri btsan po byon pa'i lo rgyus gleng bas lcags chas dar ba'i dus ni ches snga ba yin par the tshom mi dgos/3 'jim bzo'i lag rtsal yang gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su shes pa can bcu gnyis kyi nang lding shes sha ba zer ba des 'jim pa la mi dang srog chags kyi gzugs brnyan bzos pa'i lo rgyus yod pa/4 lcags rdo bzhu btul gyi lag rtsal dar ba'i dus kyang ches snga ba yin/de yang 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 las/bod yul mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi//thog mar gyur pa ru las skyes 'di yin//mdzangs pa'i las su shing bsregs sol ba byung //shing la mig phug gshol dang gnya' shing byas//sa gzhi brkos nas phu chu yur du drangs/rmon pa dor sdebs spang thang zhing du byas//brgal bas mi thar chu la zam pa btsu gas//zhes 'khod pa ltar pu de gung rgyal gyi dus gter rdo bzhu btul gyi lag rtsal dang / gser dngul zags lcags kyi bzo rigs 'phel rgyas song ba/zhing las thad kyang klung thang tsam ma zad/ ri zhing gsar sbol byas pa 'di'i thog nas zhing las lag char lcags cha spyod pa'i dus su slebs zin pa mtshon pa/461

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chu la zam pa 'dzugs pa'i bya ba yang dar zin pa 'di dag gi dus tshod lo grangs nges gtan zhig brjod dka' yang spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus su yin pa ni gdon mi za/5 rtsom rig la mtshon na yang / pu de gung rgyal gyi mgur bzhes pa tun hong gi gter yig las/ ‘‘'a ba nyi nye pas nyid/ bya ro ro na mdung gi rtse rang nig yos ro ro na ltam gyi gong ra nig brla' brdungs/ spur btab/'ob de myed/ spu de myed’’ces gsungs pa'i mgur tshig gi don rags pa tsam ni/ a khu bas snying nye khyod/ bya re re ni mdung gi rtse la 'dzer yos re re za zhing kha mtshar gtam re gleng / dgra bcom/ bang so bzhengs/ nyen med 'khon med ces bya ba yin zhes mkhas pa'i gsung las thos pa dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ ‘‘mdo sde 'byung ba'i ltas su sgrung rnams dar/ ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang ma sangs kyi sgrung dang / mchil pa'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang / mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ltas lde'u sprod/ /srang la them gnyer lba ba che ci yin/ /por mgo mgo can skyed cing rgyags ci yin/ ’zhes 'dri ba sogs te bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyi tshul lha sa'i gdung rnams la bris nas yod skad ces gsungs pa'i mgur glu'i gnas tshul dang / sgrung nyan bshad kyi tshul 'di rnams kyang lo nyis stong gong gi bya ba sha stag yin pas de'i dus dngos po'i dpal yon dar rgyas che tsam yod pa smos ci/ bsam pa'i dpal yon la spyod pa'i tshad gzhi yang nges can ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su slebs par gsal bshad nus ldan thub pa bcas kha ba'i ljongs 'di'i mes po tsho'i gsar gtod bya gzhag de tsho'i thog nas ches snga ba'i dus nas bod la thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dar rgyas byung ba mtshon pa dang / de rjes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam 462

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/po'i skabs zhang zhung dang bcas pa'i bod khams gcig gyur byung rjes bod la da lta'i yi ge 'di nyid gsar du dar ba dang / khyim mtshes rgyal khab nas rig gnas nang 'dren bya rgyu yang chu tshad gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa nas bzung bod la rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang / chung ba lnga cha tshang bar gyur pas bod kyi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas bcas dngos po'i dpal yon dang / bsam pa'i dpal yon gnyis dar rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams ri mo'i gzugs su 'phos pa'i glegs bam dang / shog dril ji snyed yod pa rnams la bod yig dpe rnying zer bas bod yig dpe rnying ni bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag gsal ler 'char ba'i 'phrul gyi me long dang rig pa'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig rang rang la ji ltar mkho ba'i 'dod rgu'i dpal ma tshang ba med pa len chog pa'i mig skya'i mdzod/ bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag gcig tu 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho yang yin/ bod yig dpe rnying ni bod mi rigs kyi rigs gzhung nor bu'i bang mdzod cig yin la/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi nor bu zhig dang / 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi nor bu 'od stong 'phro ba zhig kyang yin/ de yang bod rigs mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing / shes rig bkra ba/ mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas la slob sbyong byed mkhas pa zhig kyang yi na pas bod yig dpe rnying nang rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur gyis mtshon pa'i bsgyur yig kyang ches mang po yod pa des bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas gong 'phel la nus pa chen po thon yod/ dper na/ rig gnas chen po lngar mtshon na/ sgra dang tshad ma bzo dang gso ba nang don rig pa lngar nges pa'i sgra la ka tsan dbyangs gsum gyi sgra mdo chen po rnams dang / de dag legs par 'grel ba'i rgya gzhung khag tshad 463

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ma rig par gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang / gyes pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi zhes tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa rtsa 'grel khag bzo rig par mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi cha tshad/ gso ba rig par rgya yig nas bsgyur ba'i sman gzhung dang / rgya gar nas dar ba'i sman gzhung khag nang don rig par rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' mdo rgyud dang / bstan bcos khag rig gnas chung ba lngar mtshon na/snyan ngag sdebs sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar/ skar rtsis bcas lngar nges pa'i snyan ngag la snyan ngag ji ltar rtsom pa'i gzhung / snyan ngag me long la rtsa ba dang 'grel pa/ snyan ngag gi gzhung chen po rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing / sdebs sbyor la sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung lugs rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel/ mngon brjod la mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ zlos gar la zlos gar gyi bstan bcos bod du bsgyur ba med kyang zlos gar gyi gzhung gi grangs su 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar lta bu/ skar rtsis la 'phags yul nas dar ba'i dus 'khor dang / ma hā tsi na'i yul nas dar ba'i 'byung rtsis skor sogs bsgyur yig bgrangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa nas mang po zhig bstan 'gyur gyi khrod du bzhugs pa bcas 'gyur yig rnams gcig tu bsdus shing / mchog dang phul du gyur pa ni 'dzam gling du yang skad grags yod pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur gnyis yin la de dag ni bod yig dpe rnying nor bu'i nang gi nor bu zhig kyang lags/skabs 'dir bka' dang bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba sogs kyi skor cung zad 'phros na/bka'i rnam gzhag dang / dbye ba ni/ bka'i mtshan nyid ni/ rgyud bla ma 464

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/las/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsungs/ /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya don ldan gyi chos dang 'brel zhing / byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba/ 'bras bu zhi ba myang 'das kyi phan yon ston pa/ rang gi bdag rkyen sangs rgyas la brten nas byung ba'i gsung de ni bka'i mtshan nyid du 'jog pa yin/de la dbye na/ dus kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ gdul bya'i sgo nas dbye ba bcas de dag re re la'ang dbye ba du ma yod pa thos chung blo dman bdag lta bus zhu bar mi spobs/ 'on kyang bka' spyi'i sdom tshig tsam zhig ni/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ston pa bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa dam pa'i chos ni lung gi chos dang / rtogs pa'i chos gnyis su 'du bar sems so/ /gnyis pa/ bstan bcos kyi rnam gzhag dang /nges tshig dbye ba las/bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang lung 'ba' zhig gi dbang du byas te/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med cing blo dang 465

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag gis brjod par byed pa ngag don phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas thar pa thob par byed pa'i lam gyis chos dang rjes su mthun par legs par bshad pa zhig la ngos 'dzin pa yin/nges tshig ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro'i srid las skyob pa gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te/ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud nyon mongs pa dug gsum las bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa dang / ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i phyir bstan bcos zhes bya ba ste phyi rol pa la med pa'i 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis la 'jog pa yin/bstan bcos kyi dbye ba la/ mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ 'chad bya bka'i sgo nas dbye ba/ bstan bcos kyi rigs bsdu ba dang lnga'o/ /mchog dman gyi dbye ba ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar don med pa'i bstan bcos/ don log pa'i bstan bcos/ don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos/ thos pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ sgrub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ ngan g.yo'i bstan bcos/ brtse ba bral ba'i bstan bcos/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i bstan bcos bcas dbye ba dgur gsungs pa'i nang nas don dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa lhur len pa/ sdug bsngal spong ba gsum gyi bstan bcos ni mchog gi bstan bcos yin la nang pa 466

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/sangs rgyas pa'i bstan bcos 'di gsum du bzhed cing / gzhan drug ni dman pa'i bstan bcos su 'dod pa yin/byed las kyi dbye ba ni/ rgya chen po gcig tu bsdu ba/ zab mo'i don rnam par 'grel ba/ 'khrugs pa go rim du bsdebs pa'i bstan bcos gsum yin/brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ shes bya ji snyed pa ston pa dang / ji lta ba ston pa/ thar pa nga/nga mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa'i bstan bcos gsum mo/shes bya ji snyed pa ston pa'i bstan bcos ni 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams dang / brtags pa sna tshogs ston pa'i bstan bcos rnams yin/shes bya ji lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang /chung ba lnga'i khongs su gtogs pa'i bstan bcos rnams yin/thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ byang sa dang / spyod 'jug la sogs pa'o/ /'chad bya bka'i sgo nas dbye ba ni/ bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel dang bka' so so'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rnams yin/bstan bcos kyi rigs ni/ bka' la mi brten pa dang / brten pa gnyis/brten pa la bka' nyid la 'grel pa btab pa dang / bka'i don rang rgyud du brtsams pa gnyis/dang po bka' la mi brten pa la'ang lnga yod pa ste/ tshig don gnyis ka rgya cher 'grel pa so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa lta bu rgya cher 'grel/tshig gi cha spros pa dang bcas nas 'chad pa ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa lta bu tshig gi 'grel pa/ go dka' ba'i don rnam par 'byed pa sdud 'grel gnyis lta bu dka' 'grel/ don gyi gtso bo bsdus nas ston pa sdud pa'i don 467

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ bsdus dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa lta bu bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ ngag gi don dril nas ston pa ngag don tsam gyi 'grel pa dang lnga'o/ /gnyis pa bka' la brten pa la bka' gcig gi don rdzogs par ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan nam mdo rtsa lta bu/ bka' thor bur ston pa dge tshul gyi kā ri lta bu/ bka' mang po'i don ston pa bslab btus sam bshes springs la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar bka' dang bstan bcos kyi rnam par bzhag pa dang / dbye ba la sogs pa rags pa tsam 'phros pa 'dis bod yig dpe rnying nang du bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur zhes bya ba rnam grangs chen po gnyis ni bod yig dpe rnying nang du gtso bo'i gnas bab bzung yod pa 'di ni bod mi rigs kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i nor bu zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i nor bu zhig red ces bshad na'ang yongs su 'grig pa'i rgyu mtshan mtshon phyir yin/ bka' bstan bod du 'gyur ba'i bya ba'i rim pa dang / rlabs po che'i bya ba der zhugs pa'i mkhas grub lo paṇa gang dang gang byon sogs kyi skor/bod la bka' thog mar bsgyur ba'i bdag rkyen thog mar gyur pa ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nyid yin la lo tsā ba'i thog ma ni thu mi sam bho ṭa yin/bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dbu brnyes pa'i dus ni lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan skabs yin pa de yang mdo sde za ma tog dang / dpang skong phyag brgya pa sogs bod la thog mar byung yod kyang de dag ni thu mi'i skabs gzhi nas bsgyur ba yin/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon ku sa ra nas 468

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/bud+dha gu ta'i bar rim par byon pa paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu don bdun byung yod cing /lo tsā ba thog ma thu mi sasto ṭa nas jo nang tā ra nā tha phan rim par byon pa nyis brgya dang bco lnga byung yod pa ma zad/ de rjes lo tsā ba'i mtshan thogs pa yang mi nyung tsam byon pa'i lo paṇa de rnams kyis bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel gtong ba'i ched du dka' ba du ma dang du bzhes yod/ dper na/ deng dus mkhas pas zhib rtsis gnang bar gzhigs na/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu brgal skor yod pa'i nang nas rgya gar dang / bal yul ka smir bcas kyi khul du slob sbyong la phebs mkhan lo tsā ba tshos dma' mthar slob gnyer la lo bdun bzhugs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis lo nyi shu tsam bzhugs myong ba de tsho tshang mas slob yon dang 'gro song bcas su lo re 'gro song gser srang brgyad cu tsam btang bar cha bzhag na khong tsho yul gru de tshor bzhugs yun lo dgur rtsis na gser srang chig 'bum chig khri dgu stong brgal ba song yod pa de ni grangs 'bor chung chung zhig min/ da dung lo tsā ba rig gnas don gnyer la phebs te sa chu ma 'phrod pas rgya gar sogs su 'das grongs kyis bod du phyir phebs ma thub pa yang ji snyed byung yod gnas tshul 'di tsho'i thog nas bod yig dpe rnying nang bzhugs pa'i 'gyur ma rnams ni las sla por byung ba zhig min pa de mtshon la bod rigs ni rig pa'i gnas don du gnyer bar blos gtong chen po byed thub pa'i snying stobs ldan la sems chung gis mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas la slob sbyong yang dag pa byas te rang rigs kyi shes rig 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i chod sems bla na med pa de yang mtshon pa yin/bod du bka' bstan 'gyur gyi glegs bam byung tshul la mtshon na thog mar bsgyur ba dang / 'thor bur gnas pa/ phyogs gcig tu sgrig ste dkar chag 469

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bkod pa/ lag bris mar bzhengs pa dang / par brkos te par mar bzhengs pa bcas kyi rim pa brgyud yod/sngon la bsgyur ba'i gnas tshul ni gong du zhus pa bzhin thu mi bka' drin can nas bzung lo paṇa rnams kyis rim par bsgyur ba dang / lhag par chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs grub rjes sgra bsgyur lo tsā gling du ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa lo tsā ba mang po byon pa rnams kyis bka' bstan bcos bsgyur rgyu de ched las can dang / rgyun gtan rang bzhin gyi bsgyur grwa chen po tshugs te bod du bka' bstan 'gyur bsgyur ba'i bya gzhag gi mtho rlabs 'phyur ba de nas bstan pa snga dar skabs glang dar bar rgyun chad myong med pa dang / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas khri srong lde btsan bar bka' bstan 'gyur bsgyur ma rnams la glegs bam gyi gzugs dang / yi ge che chung gi rim pa'i dbye ba gang yang yod par ma mngon/ de yang bka' chems bka' khol ma'i mjug bsdu'i skabs su/ ‘‘rgyal po chen po srong btsan sgam po'i sprul pa jo bo chen po rje lha cig de'i zhal nas/ rgyal po chen po srong btsan sgam po de'i bka' chems zhes bya ba/ lha sa bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge 'di bris pa dang klog pa dang / nyan pa la phan yon chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo gsungs so/ ’(bka' chems bka' khol ma deb ngos 315)zhes dang / gzhan yang jo bo chen po rje lha cig gi zhal nas/rgyal po'i bka' chems kyi yi ge shog dril 'di/ dar yug sngon po la shog bu byas/ gser gyi yi ge bris nas 'dug pa mthong nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du 'dug pa ltar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan te gtsug lag khang gi 470

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/nang nas gter nas phyung ste/ dus phyi ma'i mi rnams tshogs chen po gsog pa'i ched du glegs bam gyi nang du yi ger bris so/ bka' chems kyi yi ge 'di yang mthong bar dka' ba/ thos par dka' ba/ rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ de ji ltar dka' zhe na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa las/ gzhan gyis rnyed pa dang bstan par nus par dka' bas so/ phyi mo shog dril gsum(rgyal po'i bka' chems me tog phreng ba/ blon po rnams kyis mdzad pa zla ba 'dod 'jo/ btsun mo rnams kyis mdzad pa dar dka' gsal ba)po ni gter srung bka' gnyan sbrags nas shul du sbas so/ jo bo rjes bang ston la gnang / bang ston gyis stod lung pa la gnang zhes gsal bar gsungs pa nas gsal por rtogs thub pa ma zad/ gsung rab kyi rigs ma gtogs de snga srid gzhung gi yig cha(sa mi'i zhib gzhung dang / sprod deb/ khral rigs bsdu gzhung rigs phud)rnams kyang shog dril du gnas pa dang / bka' shog gcigs che'i rigs te she bam lta bu dar gos la yang 'bri srol rgyun chags su gnas yod pa dang / tun hong gi gter yig kyang shog dril yin pa lta bu'o/ /de rjes khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus‘bai ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad pa la sogs pas bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dar bar byas te 'brug gi lo(bu ston gyi bzhed pa ltar na shing 'brug spyi lo 82grul pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i ston sgra bsgyur gyi badhe dpal brtsegs dang badhe klu'i dbang po la sogs pas bod khams su dam pa'i chos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang dang bam po dang / sho lo ka'i grangs su mchis par gtan la phab nas dkar chag tu bris so zhes byung ngo /’ (mkhas dga' deb ngos 365)zhes mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang gsal ba ltar dam pa'i gsung rab sngar shog dril du yod pa rnams shog 471

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ldeb nang 'bri ba'i srol dar 'go tshugs 'dra ba dang glegs bam zhes bya ba'i ming yang 'di nas byung bar snang / glegs ni leb mo gru bzhi'i don te sgo glegs dang / glegs bu yin pas dam pa'i chos rnams shog ldeb gru nar gyi gzugs kyi shog bu'i ngos su 'bri ba dang de dag grangs tshad dam bam grangs nges can brtsegs te bzhugs pa de la glegs bam zer zhing / thog ma'i glegs bam rnams skud par brgyus pa'i shul sngar gyi dpe rnying mang po'i shog ldeb kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi dkyil ngos sgor gzugs bug pa can re yod pa de ni skud pa brgyu yul gyi rjes yul yin/ phyis glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs skabs dam pa'i chos mer bsregs chur dkyur bas ma zad/ khrims kyi rnam pas dam chos rnams rgyug pa'i dbar bcir nas thag pas bsdams te khrims btang ba phyis sri zhur song ste glegs shing gnyis kyi dbar gsung rab rnams bzhugs pa de dag 'thor gyar mi 'byung ched glegs thag ces sku rags 'bul ba'i srol dar ba red ces rgan rabs kyi gsung rgyun las thos/dam pa'i chos sam bod yig dpe rnying gi rnam grangs dang / bam tshad nges gsal 'khod pa'i dkar chag thog ma dkar chag ldan dkar ma zhes bya ba gong du zhus pa de dang de rjes btsan po'i skabs rang la bka' bstan 'gyur gyi bzhugs tshogs je cher song ba dang bstun te dkar chag mchims phu ma dang /'phang thang ma gsum rim par byung yod/bam grangs zhes pa'i bam ni sgril kha'i don te gos chen yug sgril la gos chen yug bam zer ba lta bu yin/ 'on kyang dam pa'i gsung rab kyi bam grangs ni thog ma khri srong lde btsan sku dus gsung rab rnam grangs re re'i tshad gzhi'i ngos bzung bde ba'i phyir bam po'i grangs gtan la phab pa ste tshigs bcad 472

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabes 'degs zhu ba/gcig la tshig rkang bzhi rer sho lo ka gcig dang / tshig lhug la tsheg khyim sum cu so gnyis la sho lo ka gcig bcad lhug so sor rtsis pa'i sho lo ka sum brgya'am sum brgya lnga bcu/ yang na bzhi brgya tham par cha bzhag pa sna tshogs yod pa de'i bam grangs gtan la 'khel ba des rnam grangs de'i grangs 'bor de che chung tsam ma zad/ gsung rab de dag la gzhan gyis rang dgar kha snon mi chog pa dang chad skyon mi 'byung ba'i dge mtshan ldan pa 'di ni gsung rab shog dril gyi rnam par gnas pa'i skabs de ltar dgos nges yin/ 'on kyang phyis kyi gsung rab rnams ni shog ldeb ngos bris pas shog ldeb rer yig phreng mang nyung gcig ltar yin pa'i grangs 'bor des rnam grangs de'i grangs 'bor tshod 'dzin thub pas bam grangs nges par dgos gal ma mchis pas de'i rgyun rang bzhin du med par gyur yod/'gyur gyi gnad don la mtshon na bod yig tu bsgyur ba'i bka' bstan bcos ni ma yig rgya gzhung ji ma ji bzhin bsgyur thub pa byung yod/ bsgyur zhus kyi gnad don skor bkas bcad rim pa gsum byung yod pa'i mtshon dper bkas bcad gnyis pa'i gnas tshul zhig zhu na/ btsan po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs kyi sku dus rta'i lo ste spyi lo 814shing rta lo sgra sbyor bam gnyis zhes yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skad grags can de gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i nang bsgyur yig rnams brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mthun dgos pa dang gcig ma dpe'i rtsa ba'i brjod don dang 'gal mi chog pa dang gnyis/yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin ldan pa dang gsum dang / da dung yig sgyur gyi thabs shes dang / do snang byed dgos pa'i bya ba mang po gsal por bstan yod pa ma zad/ da dung gsung rab so sor yi ge che chung ji ltar spyod pa'i gtan 'bebs 473

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/kyang gnang yod/zhu dag la mtshon na/ sngar btsan po'i dus bsgyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos gang yin la zhu dag snga rjes bzhi brgyud dgos pa ste/1 bsgyur pa po lo tsā ba dang / zhu dag pa paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis ma dpe dang zhu dag rags pa zhig gtong bar de la smar zhus zer/ 2 bsgyur zhus gnyis kyis yang bskyar sngar bas zhib cha che ba'i zhu dag btang ba der yang zhus zer/3 sngar gyi bsgyur zhus gnyis kyi khar ched mngags gdan zhus paṇ+ḍi ta dang bcas pas tshig don re rer zhib phra'i zhu dag nan tan gtong ba der bskyar zhus zer/ 4 bsgyur zhus lo paṇa khar bsgyur grwa'i paṇ+ḍi ta tshang 'dzoms sar tshig don re rer zhu dag btang bar tshang mas mos mthun byung ba'i zhu dag mtha' mjug der gtan la phab pa'i zhu dag zer ba bcas de lta bu'i zhu dag snga rjes bzhi brgyud pa'i mthar rgyal blon tshang 'dzoms sar bsgyur zhus kyi gnad don gsal po zhus rjes btsan pos de ltar chog pa'i bka' phab rjes gzhi nas bka' bstan bcos kyi grangs su brtsi ba'i srol yod lugs mkhas pa'i gsung las thos pa 'dir zur tsam drangs pa'i dgos pa yang nga tsho'i bod yig dpe rnying khrod bzhugs pa'i bsgyur ma rnams ni ma dpe dang gnyis su med pa'i khungs btsan po yong ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin pa ma zad/ deng skabs phyi phyogs kyi mi sna mang pos kyang bod yig gi dpe rnying la gcigs mthong chen po byed pa dang / bsgyur yig ni ches khungs ldan la brtsi ba yang bsgyur zhus nan tan che la yang dag pa'i srol rgyun 'di tshor thug yod/ skabs 'dir dpe mtshon tsam du/ 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan dge dbang yab sras kyis brtsams pa'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi snyan tshig shong los bod 474

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/skad du bsgyur gnang ba de ni 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan gyi brtsams chos— shig yin pa bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po zhig gis bris pa lta bu dang / rgya yig nas bsgyur ba'i mdo mdzangs blun la cha bzhag na'ang rgya yig nas bsgyur ba'i tshor snang gang yang mi skye ba bod rang gi mkhas pas zin bris btab pa zhig yin snyam pa'i tshor snang skye ba lta bu'o/ /bod yig dpe rnying gi 'phel rgyas kyi brgyud rim la mtshon na/ rnam grangs che ba'i gras su bka' bstan 'gyur thog mar byung ba dang / de rjes bstan pa phyi dar skabs sa skya bka' 'bum dang / bo dong bka' 'bum/ tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum sogs dbyar gyi chu gter rgyas pa ji bzhin dar rgyas song yod/ gsung rten de dag gi shing par ni spyi lo 1401ming yung los bod nas drangs pa'i bka' 'gyur shing par thog par skrun byas pa'i par phud bod du mtshur phu karma pa dang / rje tsong kha par 'tshams rten du phul ba de'i rjes su bod du shing par brko ba'i lag rtsal dar ba de nas bzung bod yig dpe rnying dar khyab je cher song bas da lta bod yig dpe rnying gi rnam grangs ji ltar yod pa dang / grangs ji tsam yod pa smra bar phur bu'i lce yang ngal bar mthong bas bod yig dpe rnying gi dkar chag cung cha tshang ba zhig phyogs sgrig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa ni bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug mkhan gyi kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi re bar gyur yod/ 'on kyang las don 'di mngon 'gyur yong bar dka' tshegs kyi bya ba mang po brgyud dgos/gnyis pa/ bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba'i 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/spyir mi rigasartsogang 'dra zhig yin rung rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel 475

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rgyas gtong bsam na thog mar mi rigs de rang gi gna' bo'i rig gnas rnams rgyun 'dzin dang / srung skyob byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i 'og gom pa rim bgrod kyis mi rigs de'i rig gnas 'phel rgyas legs po byung ba'i rjes gzhi nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rigs gzhung sogs kyi nang bya ba ngo mtshar can mang po sgrub thub pa ltar nga tshos bod ljongs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dang / dngos po'i dpal yon 'phel rgyas gtong bsam na bod kyi skad yig rgya khyab tu bed spyod gtong ba dang / lhag par skad yig gi khungs gtugs sa'i bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob dang / de dag 'tsho ba dngos nang zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i lag cha zhig tu 'gyur ba bya dgos/ gal srid dpe rnying gi ched du dpe rnying myur skyob dang / srung skyob byas pa yin na de ni mi rigs rig gnas gzhan la ngom pa lta bu'i dge mtshan zhig las bya ba ngo ma'i nang phan 'bras gang yang thon mi thub/skabs 'dir bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i phyogs ston lta bur dpe mtshon 'ga' zhig zhu na/slob gso'i las ka'i nang bod yig dpe rnying gi nus pa'i skor/ nga tsho mi rigs sa khul la bltas na slob gso'i las kar bod yig dpe rnying la ma brten pa'i 'gro lam gzhan ci yang med/ thog ma gzhon nu slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su bod yig 'bri klog nas bzung bod kyi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la slob sbyong byed pa'i gzhung rtsa 'grel tshang ma dpe rnying nang nas 'tshol dgos pa ni tshang mas shes gsal la brten 'dir re re bzhin 'bri bar mi bya zhing /mtshon dbe tsam bod kyi rtsom rig la ltos na bod yig dpe rnying nang nas snyan ngag ji ltar rtsom pa'i gzhung dang / snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dang / de min 476

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/gzhung mang por lta klog thos bsam ma byas par bod yig gi rtsom legs po zhig mi yong ba tshig thag gtsang mar bcad chog deng dus snyan ngag gi skor la snyan ngag gi gzhung me long mar ma brten pa'i bod rigs rang gis brtsams pa'i gzhung zhig byung na dge mtshan che ba'i bshad yams shig yod rung / de ni phyogs re ba'i lta stangs shig las don dam rig gnas kyi rgyun la phan pa'i lta stangs legs po zhig min/ gang yin zhe na snyan ngag me long ma'i nang gi dper brjod mang por gzhon nu pho mo'i tshul dang sbyar ba de ni spyir gzhung de phyi nang thun mong gi gzhung dang / lhag par blo gsar gzhon nu'i tshogs gzhung der 'jug bde ba'i ched du slob dpon daṇ+ḍis de ltar mdzad pa'i dgongs gzhi de ma rtogs par gzhung skyon can du rtsa ba nas rtsi mi rung la/ snyan pa'i ngag gis drangs pa'i brtsam bya'i don chos nor 'dod thar sde bzhi'i dbang du ma byas pa med pas gal srid gzhon nu pho mo'i gnas tshul dang rtsa ba nas ma 'dres pa'i gzhung zhig yin pa der sbyangs pa'i mis 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang gson nyams ldan pa'i rtsom yig legs po zhig 'bri thub bam/ spyir rig gnas ni mi su zhig gis kyang spyad chog pa las de la gral rim dang dbye ba'i rang bzhin byar med kyang / don gnyer can nam slob pa lam la zhugs pa'i mi so so'i ngos nas bshad na rang gi bsam blo dwangs gtsang yin min la ma ltos par gzhung rtsom pa po'i dgongs pa rtogs pa byas nas gzhung de legs par lob pa'i tshul la bsam blo gtong dgos pa las/ bgamed kyi spyod pa rgya yan du btang na 'grig pa lta bur ngos 'dzin na de ni mi rang nyid kyis 'gan gtsang mar khur dgos pa las snyan ngag gi gzhung rtsom pa por 'gan cha shas tsam dkri mi rung ba gzhung de 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i brgyud riske nas lanamigasal por btab yod/477

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa la sogs pa sngon byon mkhas grub mang pos snyan ngag me long mar sbyangs pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi nang nas gzhung chen po mang po snyan ngag gi gzhung la brten nas bka' rtsom mdzad pas khong tsho ni snyan ngag pa chen po dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen por 'gyur ba de ni gson nyams ldan pa'i ra sprod gzhi zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas kyang shes rig ldan dang mi ldan gyi mi tsho'i 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul tha dad pa yin pa bag med par spyod pa'i mi mang che ba ni shes rig med pa'i gras de yin pa yang ra sprod zhig yin/ 'on kyang deng dus snyan ngag me long mar ma bstun pa'i snyan ngag gsar dar lta bu'i sbyang bshad byed pa de dag la'ang snyan ngag me long ma las logs su gyur pa'i legs bshad ni gang yang yod par ma mngon/ snyan ngag me long ma'i le'u gnyis pa'i 'gor/ snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi/ /tshos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod/ /de ni da lta'ang rnam rtog ste/ /de dag ma lus sus 'chad nus/ /'on kyang rnam rtog sa bon ni/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /de nyid rab tu legs sbyar phyir/ /yongs su ngal 'di bdag gi 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis snyan ngag me long mar bstan pa'i dper brjod rnams ni rnam rtog gi sa bon tsam bstan pa yin zhes gsal por gsungs pas rnam par rtog par mtha' med pa des na snyan ngag gi rgyan yang mtha' med pa de'i phyir deng dus rgyan gsar par 'dod pa rnams kyang me long ma'i mtshams las brgal ba'i rgyan zhig min pa ni mngon sum tshad mas grub pa dang / gzhung de yang phyi nas yong ba'i gzhung yin rīpa der ma ltos pa bod rang gis brtsams 478

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/pa'i gzhung zhig yin pa de ni mchog tu brtsi ba'i tshul dang / yang na rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la mthong chung gis phyi nas dar ba'i gzhung la mchog tu brtsi ba'i lta tshul gnyis ka yang dag pa min/ gtso bo rig gnas de spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams na rgyun ring du gnas pa ma zad rim bzhin yar rgyas 'gro ba dang / ma mthun na spyi tshogs thog mu mthud gnas mi thub pa bya ba ngo ma'i nang nas gsal por mtshon gyi yod pa de ni mi che ge mo'i 'dod tshul la rag ma las pa don dngos la rag las pa de ni bden don dang tshan rig cig yin/ skabs 'dir kho bos 'di skor cung nan tan gyis smra ba'i dgos pa ni/ snyan ngag me long mar skyon 'dogs byed pa'i bshad yams des blo gsar gzhon nu'i kun spyod dang mi rigs rang nyid kyi snyan ngag gi rgyun la phan pa 'di yin zhes ston rgyu med khar rang re'i mes po tshos sku ngal tshad med spyad de gzhung bsgyur ba dang / 'grel pa gsar rtsom gyi snyan ngag me long ma de don dngos thog bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan gzhung 'gran pa'i do zla bral ba'i gzhung rtsa 'grel la yid gnyis kyi 'ching bas slob sbyong bya rgyur shugs rkyen thebs thog de las logs su gyur pa'i gzhung zhig la 'bad brtson byed khul gyis slob gnyer byed pa'i dus tshod 'phro brlag 'gro gzhi de dag mi 'byung ba'i ched du yin/snyan ngag la byang cha thon pa'i mi zhig gis brtsam bya spyir rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang / — lhag par gang zhig bris pa ni snyan pa'i nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pas mi sems la 'jug che ba/ rgyas bsdus gang la gang 'tshams spro bsdu byed thub pa/ brjod don tshang la go ba bde blag tu rtogs pa la sogs pa'i dge mtshan thon pa de yang bod yig dpe rnying gis 'tsho ba dngos la nus 479

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa mngon gsal thon pa'i dpe mtshon yin/de bzhin spyi tshogs tshan rig gi khyab khongs bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug la bod yig dpe rnying ni kha 'bral thabs med pa'i gtso bo'i lag cha zhig yin/lhag par lo rgyus zhib 'jug lta bur mtshon na bod yig dpe rnying gi nus pa ni de bas che/ spyir lo rgyus kyi yig lam ji 'dra zhig yin rung rtsom pa po'i lta ba'i rtags tham ma 'khel ba med pa ni lo rgyus kyi yig cha'i khyad chos lta bur snang ba des phyi rabs pa rnams la zhib 'jug yang bskor bskyar bskor byed dgos pa'i bya ba rnyog 'dzing can zhig thon gyi yod pas nga tshos gang thub ci thub kyis blo gzu bor gnas pa'i rtsa don 'og gang la gang 'dod bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed par gtso bo rgyal rabs chos 'byung khag gtso bo'i dpyad gzhir 'dzin dgos pa smos med thog lo tshigs kyi gnad don/ mi rabs sam dus rabs de'i don chen rnams la deb ther khag la lta tshul gcig gyur yin min/gcig gyur yin yang dus rabs de'i gnas tshul dngos dang 'tshams min bcas la zhib mor dpyod skabs mkhas grub mang po'i mdzad rnam dang / chab shog mgur glu/ bslab bya sogs kyi nang du don dngos mang po dngos shugs su gsal ba rnams la zhib mor dpyod dgos pa dang / yang mkhas grub cig gi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi lo rgyus 'tshol bar yang gsung rab kyi dkar chag dang / bla ma'i gsan yig chab shog mgur glu/ spyi dang bye brag shes bya'i skor gyi gsung rtsom khag dpyad gzhi gtso bor 'dzin dgos pa/ yang 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs kyi gnas tshul dang / yul lung gi thun mong min pa'i thon zog dang rang byung khams kyi gnas tshul sogs la zhib 'jug dgos tshe gnas yig dang / gnas bstod/ 'dzugs skrun sogs kyi 480

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/dkar chag dpyad gzhi'i gtso bor 'dzin dgos pa/ dpal 'byor gyi gnad don gyi zhib 'jug la srid gzhung gi yig cha'i gras nas khral rigs dang khral rigs dngul bsgyur/ 'bab deb/ khrims deb/ rdzong gzhis rtsis rgyag gi gzhung phra gtong deb bcas su zhib par gsal ba phud/ bod yig dpe rnying nang dpal 'byor gyi skor kha gsal bkod pa cher med mod/ rin thang rtsis rgyag skor sku gsung thugs rten dang gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag dang / bla ma'i rnam thar nang thor bur gnas pa rnams la dngos dang shugs nas dpyad gzhir 'dzin te rigs 'ded byed pa/mi'i kun spyod kyi gnad don la zhib 'jug skabs rgyal rabs chos 'byung nang gsal ba'i drang phyogs dang / ldog phyogs mi sna'i lo rgyus/ lugs kyi bstan bcos khag bla ma'i nyams mgur sogs dpyad gzhi gtso bor 'dzin dgos pa/khrims lugs skor khrims deb khag dang / dgon pa'i bca' khrims/'dul ba'i gleng 'bum/ yig skur rnam gzhag nang gsal ba'i khrims lugs skor gyi zhu ba zhu lan dang dpyad khra/ ja chang lha mo'i bstan bcos lta bu don dngos khrims kyi dpyad khra sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thog nas mtshon pa lta bu dpyad gzhir 'dzin dgos pa/ lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul gang zhig yin min brdar sha bcad de sdom tshig 'jog par nges par ches khungs ldan gyi yig lam dang /dus rabs de rang la btsugs pa'i rdo ring ngam gcigs kyi yi ge zhib mo/ srid gzhung gi yig rnying bcas byung na de bas yid rton rung ba bcas skabs 'dir blo gsar gzhon nu rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i ched du cung zad 'phros pa las/bod kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa po zhig yin phyin rig gnas kyi chu tshad 481

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang / spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong nges can ldan pa'am/ yang na thos pa rgya cher song ba'i mi zhig yin dgos pas bcom ldan 'das la ka kha'i lo rgyus zhu ma dgos/de min bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang bye brag la slob sbyong byed skabs nges par du bod yig dpe rnying nang nas rig gnas de dang de'i gzhung don cha tshang bar slob sbyong byed dgos pa las/ gzhung gi dum bu re zung dang / stabs bde'i 'grel par bltas te slob sbyong byas na phan 'bras chen po thon mi thub pa dper na/ snyan ngag skabs le'u gnyis pa kho nas tshims te le'u dang gsum gnyis 'dor ba/ sum rtags skabs si tu'i zhal lung tsam la brten nas sum rtags gzhung dang si tu'i 'grel chen lta bur mi brten pa/gal srid snyan ngag gi le'u gnyis pas chog par brtsis na le'u dang po'i nang gsungs pa'i snyan ngag gi spyi 'gros dang / lho shar lam gyi dbye ba mi shes pa/ le'u gsum pa'i nang gsungs pa'i sgra rgyan dang gab tshig snyan ngag gi skyon gang yin bcas mi shes pa/ lhag par deng dus gzhon nu'i khrod du snyan ngag brtsams par ngos 'dzin gyis zung ldan gyi rgyan ldan pa'i rtsom rgyag rgyur dang dod byed pa'i mi tshor mtshon na de bas kyang le'u gsum pa ma shes na zung ldan sbyor tshul tshul bzhin mi shes pa lta bu yin/sum rtags la mtshon na'ang sum rtags gzhung dngos la ma sbyangs par si tu'i zhal lung tsam gyis tshogs par brtsis na bdag gzhan dus gsum dang /bya byed las gsum sogs kyi gnas lugs phra mo rnams shes dka' bas sum rtags gzhung rtsa bar bzung thog si tu'i 'grel chen lta bur brten nas dka' gnad mang po rang bzhin du rtogs thub pa yong ba lta bu yang zhor la 'phros 482

bod yig dpe rnying gis bod ljongs gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba/pa'i gtam lags so/ /bsdoms na nang don ches phun sum tshogs pa dang / rnam grangs ches mang ba'i bod yig dpe rnying nang nas rang la dgos pa'i shes bya slob shes thub pa bya rgyu dang dus mtshungs gsar dar rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams kyang khong du chud thub pa byas nas thun mong min pa'i bod kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i dngos po'i dpal yon dang / bsam pa'i dpal yon gnyis dar yong ba byas te/ sgo kun nas pha yul gyi 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du 'bad brtson byed dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam par mthong ba bcas so —/483

ming gi mngon brjod mdor bsdus pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig gi dpe skrun gsal bshad/(ming gi mngon brjod mdor bsdus pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉ces bya ba'i rtsom pa po ni/ sngar 'das pa'i dus su mdo khams sde dge sa khul du dbu bla dgon sde lnga zhes sde dge sa spyod pas mchod cing bkur ba'i chos sde chen po lnga yod pa'i nang tshan zhe chen dgon bstan nyi dar rgyas gling gi chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa zhe chen rab 'byams pa gnyis pa 'gyur med kun bzang rnam rgyal blo gsal rgyal mtsho'i dngos slob bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan nam yongs su grags par zhe drung pad+ma rnam dag ces mtshan mchog don ldan mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid lags shing / khong gis zhe chen dgon du rig pa dang grol ba'i 'dus pa'i sde'i nang du zhugs shing / zhe chen rab 'byams gnyis pa dang / mdo khams zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen sogs rang gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod nas thun mong dang / thun mong min pa'i rig pa'i gnas la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i go sar bsnyegs zin na'ang /rang nyid mkhas par rlom zhing chen po'i go sa brtson len mi mdzad pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur len mdzad pas khong gi mdzad rnam sogs phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i yig cha ltar bzhag khong gis mchod cing bkur ba'i bla ma'i rnam thar nang du yang bla slob kyi 'grel ba tsam las gzhan gyi mdzad pa ma mngon pas da lam khong gi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang 484

〈ming gi mngon brjod legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉gi dpe skrun gsal bshad/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'phrin las gang dang gang bskyangs zhib tu zhu ba'i spobs pa dben yang / khong gi gsung rtsom gyi mdzad byang sogs la brtag na khong byon pa'i dus ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang yin pa kha tshon gcod thub/ rgyu mtshan ni zhu chen byon pa'i dus dang / lhag par khong gis(legs par sbyar ba sgra'i bstan bcos chen po ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor dang /ming le'i lag len gnad bsdus legs bshad snying po〉zhes bya ba rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1759lo dang / (legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad dang / gangs can pa'i brda shan sbyar dri bral nor bu'i me long〉zhes bya ba yang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1771lo so sor mdzad pa ma zad/mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'di yang bstan bcos de tsho brtsams grub pa nas mu mthud du mdzad pa mjug byang nas shes thub pas so /khong gi bka' rtsom la mtshon na/ brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa gong du smos pa rnams dang / gzhan yang grangs kyi sgra rnams rtags sum dang sbyar ba'i dper brjod/ mi zad pa'i sde tshan gzhung du ma las btus pa sogs da lta yang sde dger shing dpar pradz+nyā shes rab kyi mtshan dang ldan pa gcig dang / de min dus sbyor gyi re'u mig dang skar rtsis kyi bstan bcos sogs skar rtsis skor cha tshang tsam yang yod/khong gi slob mar gyur pa yang kaḥthog mchog sprul 'gyur med tshe dbang mchog grub la sogs pa mkhas pa du ma mchis pa bcas rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhu mtshams 'dir byas te da lam skabs su babs pa dngos su dpe skrun bya rgyu'i(ming gi mngon brjod mdor bsdus pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉 ces bya ba 'di'i skor cung zad zhu na/ 485

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/spyir rig pa'i gnas khong du chud pa dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba dngos la 'jug par thog mar klog pa thos bsam gyi bya ba 'di shin tu gal che/thos pa de yang yi ge 'bri klog dang / brda dag gi gzhung la thos bsam bya rgyu nas 'go btsugs te gang gang don du gnyer ba'i gzhung lugs kyi tshig don ji lta ba shes dgos pa sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen med du mi rung ba zhig yin lags/ yi ge las ming dang / ming las tshig tshig las brjod pa rtogs dgos pas tshig don gnyis ni ming du ma 'dus pa las byung ba zhig yin pas ming gi gnad don dpyis phyin pa rtogs dgos pa de bas gal che gshis/ de yang don gcig ming mang la 'jug pa dang / ming mang pos don gcig mtshon pa'i ming de la'ang 'dod rgyal gyi ming dang rjes grub kyi ming gi khyad par yod pa/ rjes grub kyi ming de yang 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa dang 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas te grub pa'i ming de la mngon par brjod pa zhes bya zhing / de ni tha snyad rig gnas lnga'i nang nas kyang shes bya spyi la 'jug pa'i skas kyi gdang bu lta bu'i rig gnas shig yin stabs sngar kha ba'i ljongs 'dir byon pa'i mkhas dbang mang pos mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos ci rigs pa rtsom gnang mdzad pas bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon yod/ lhag par dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug zhe drung pad+ma rnam dag ces bya ba mtshan mchog don ldan mkhas pa'i dbang po gang des mdzad pa'i(ming gi mngon brjod mdor bsdus pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉 ces bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di la mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge mtshan gtso che ba khag bzhi yod/dang po/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'di ni ches rgyas pa min la de 486

〈ming gi mngon brjod legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉 gi dpe skrun gsal bshad/tsam gyi bsdus pa'ang min pa gzhung rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing / sde tshan so so'i ming gi dbye mtshams gsal ba/ lhag par rang cag kha ba ri pa rnams kyi klog pa thos bsam gyi dgos 'dun ngo mar gzhigs na/ bod kyi brda dag dang snyan ngag la sogs pa'i gzhung tshang ma blo la 'dzin te ngag skyor byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i 'og gzhi nas tshad ldan gyi dge rgan la bsten nas gzhung don 'khrid sbyong byed dgos pa lags na/ mngon brjod kyi gzhung ni de bas kyang blo la 'dzin dgos pa'i gzhung zhig yin pas/ de ltar du mi bgyi ba yin na rgyun du tshig mdzod dang 'grogs dgos pa'am yang na/ rig pa glegs bam la gnas dang / /ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang / /brjed ngas can gyi bslab pa rnams/ /dgos pa'i tshe na bslu ba mang / /zhes pa ltar du 'gyur ba gdon mi za bas gsar bu ba tshos mngon brjod kyi gzhung 'di nyid ngag skyor bde ba'i ched gzhung tshig shin tu 'grel chags pa dang / gzhung rgyas bsdus 'tshams par mdzad pas blo la 'dzin bde la bstan bya'i nang don rgya che ba'o/ /gnyis pa/ legs sbyar gyi skad dod sde tshan ma 'dres pa/ skad gnyis shan sbyar nor bu'i me long zur du brtsams grub pas skabs 'dir bla ma yi dam gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs su legs sbyar gyi skad dod cha shas las rtsa ba'i gzhung 'go nas mjug bar bod skad kyi thog nas sbyar ba'i mngon brjod yin stabs klog pa po dang slob gnyer ba rig gnas kyi chu tshad cung dman pa dang gzhung lugs chen por 'jug mi thub pa'i blo gsar tshor bltos na go ba len bde zhing /lhag par 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag ste deng dus kyi 'tsho ba dngos su spyod bde ba dang spyod go de bas che ba'o /gsum pa/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos gzhan du legs sbyar gyi skad 487

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang bod skad bcas skad rigs gnyis kyi mngon brjod cig car ram yang na legs sbyar gyi skad dod gtso bor gsungs pas rtsa ba'i gzhung tshogs che yang skad gnyis kyi tshod 'dzin gyis bod skad rang gi thog nas ming gi rnam grangs cung zhib cha mi che ba/ skabs 'dir bod skad nyid la brten nas mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos gzhan du ma 'khod pa bka' dang bstan bcos rnams nas byung ba dang / tha na yul skad nas byung ba la sogs pa bod skad rang gi ming gi rnam grangs mang po zhig 'khod yod do/ /bzhi pa/ klog pa po'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang rgyun gtan phrad che ba dang bod kyi rig gnas slob sbyong la med du mi rung ba'i rigs la brgyud rim ldan la zhib cha che ba yong rgyur thugs snang de bas chen po mdzad yod pa ma zad/dgos pa che ba'i mtshams la mchan bus gsal bar mdzad yod pa dper na/zla ba'i ming gi mngon brjod kyi mjug gi mchan bur/ ‘‘de ltar zla ba'i ming 'di rnams bstan bcos chen po'i sbyar byang lta bur bkod tshe dper na nag zlas(hor zla gsum pa)mtshon na/ ma hā ṭī ṇa'i skad du mā yol(paṃ()du 'bod pa 'byung rtsis lugs kyi dbyar 'bring po rta'i zla ba/ rten 'brel ming gzugs la dbang ba/ chen po hor gyi yul du gsan yol(co7)zhes hor zla gsum pa dpyid tha mar 'dod pa legs sbyar gyi skad du tsi tra ste nag pa can rags par nyi ma lug khyim du spyod pa gdan bzhi'i rgyud las bṛṣa bha zhes khyu mchog can 'bod pa myos byed zla ba'i zhes sogs zla ba gzhan la yang / de'i rigs 'gre ba la gzhan phrin yig sogs kyi mjug tu mtshar 'dod sbyar tshe de tsam mi rgyas par rgya dkar nag hor bod gang rung lugs ka gcig gnyis tsam rgyas bsdus skabs bstun 'phrul shes bya'o’’zhes gsungs pa 'di'i thog nas 488

〈ming gi mngon brjod legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉gi dpe skrun gsal bshad/gal che'i ming gi rnam grangs la de bas thugs snang gnang ba mtshon thub pa phyi rabs pa rnams la blo gros kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i gser gyi lde mig gi byed las dngos su thon pa/de lta bu'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can 'di nyid bod kyi rig gnas la slob sbyong byed pa'i blo gsar gzhon nu'i tshogs dang / bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug mkhan sogs kyi dgos mkho/ bod kyi skad yig sogs rig gnas gong 'phel gtong bar sman pa bcas kyi slad du da lam bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dngos su dpe skrun gnang skabs gleng gzhi zhig 'bri dgos phebs pa'i bka' ngo ldog med du bris pa lags/ /mtshams 'dir/gang gang rig pa'i mdzod brgya phye ba la//legs legs gser gyi lde mig 'di 'o zhes//yang yang rtse dga'i dpal du 'dzin byas nas//mang mang mkhas pa'i bya bar 'jug 'tshal lo//zab don tshar du dngar ba'i rnal ma'i ngos//mngon brjod spun gyi tshon mdangs legs spel ba//nyams 'gyur rtsom rigs rnam bkra'i za 'og gi//ngo mtshar blta la dbang pos mig stong bgrad//rmad byung gzhung bzang dga' ston 'gyed pa'i slad//'phrul par nam mkha'i nor bu 'gug pa'i mgron//mtshams sprin gsar pa'i rtsol ba lhur len pa//shes brjod dbyangs can rgyud mangs 'di skad do//489

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal ni/ mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha shar tsong kha zhes bya bar grags pa'i yul du mal gyi rigs las byung ba/ yab da ra kha che klu 'bum dge zhes bya ba dang / yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung drug pa'i me bya lor(spyi lo 1357)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams shing yab yum gnyis la sras drug 'khrungs pa'i bzhi pa yin no/ /dgung lo gsum par chos rje karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan kun dga' snying po zhes bya bar gsol zhing / de'i rjes yab kyis chos rje don grub rin chen pa khyim du gdan drangs pa'i skabs/chos rje don grub rin chen gyis yab la rta dang lug la sogs pa zang zing gi gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad nas khyod kyi bu 'di nga la phul cig ces bka' gnang ba yab kyis kyang dang du bzhes te spro ba dang bcas pas phul ba ltar dgung lo bdun par phebs la nye ba'i tshe chos rje don grub rin chen gyi zhabs drung du phebs te rab tu ma byung ba'i snga rol nyid du chos rje nyid kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor smin par mdzad cing / bcom ldan 'khor lo 490

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bde mchog dril bu pa dang / kye rdo rje dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur/ gsang mtshan don yod rdo rje zhes bya bar btags/dgung lo bdun pa'i skabs chos rje don grub rin chen pas mkhan po dang / ta dben gzhon nu seng ge'i slob ma gzhon nu byang chub kyis slob dpon mdzad de tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan du blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes bya bar gsol to/ /chos rje don grub rin chen pas rje bdag nyid chen po 'di bstan pa rin po che'i bdag por 'gyur ba'i thugs res/ sku byis pa'i dus nas bdag gir mdzad de skyed bsrings pa dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma la sogs pa'i sgo nas shes rab 'phel ba'i thabs du ma dang / rab tu byung ba dang rdo rje theg pa'i sgor smin par mdzad pa sogs ji ltar sman gyi ljon shing chen po mngon par 'grub pa'i myu gu ltar legs par bskyangs shing / phyis dbus gtsang du 'byon pa'i rdzong bda' dang do dam sogs kyang shin tu che bar mdzad par bka' drin lhag par che ba yin zhes gsungs te dus phyis kyang bla ma de'i mtshan brjod pa tsam la'ang phyag thal mo sbyar zhing spyan chab bsil ba dang /mya ngan las 'das rjes dus mchod ma chag par mdzad/de yang dgung lo bcu drug pa chu byi(1372)lor dbus gtsang phyogs su 'byon par brtsams pa'i tshe chos rje don grub rin chen pas dang por thos bsam ji ltar bya ba dang / de dag gi don nyams su len tshul/ gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad dgos tshul tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas 'doms par mdzad/491

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dgung lo bcu bdun pa spyi lo 1373chu glang lor chos rje de nyid nas dngos po'i mthun rkyen sbyar te 'bri gung pa'i 'bul dpon ldan ma rin chen dpal gyis shar tsong kha'i yul nas dbus gtsang du gdan drangs te ston dus 'bri gung mthil du phyag phebs/ 'bri gung gi spyan snga chos kyi grags pa dang mjal te theg chen sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang / phyag chen lnga ldan sogs zab chos mang du gsan pa 'di nas bsnyen rdzogs ma bzhes bar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul ni/tshal gyi sman pa dkon cog skyabs las gso dpyad gsan cing rgyud bzhi thugs 'dzin gnang / snye thang bde ba can du mkhan po bkra shis seng ge dang /ye shes seng ge gnyis las chos 'brel gsan/ bde ba can gyi bla ma 'jam rin pa las byams chos rnams gsan cing thugs su chud/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen rin po che rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen ma ti pa rnams las 'jam dbyangs bde mchog sogs 'ga' zhig sa bzang pa'i drung du chos bka' dang sgra bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal las sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ snar thang lo tsā ba don bzang las mdzod dang tshad ma'i ṭik+kashangs lugs kyi phyag drug pa bka' bcu gsum nas rjes gnang bar chad kun sel rnams gsan cing / gnyags dbon kun dga' dpal las phar phyin/red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros las mdzod rang 'grel/ dbu tshad/ sngags sogs ji snyed gsan cing bla ma'i gtso bor 'dzin/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo las mngon pa kun btus/ skyor lung mkhan po blo gsal ba las 'dul mdzod/mal gro lha lung bla ma bsod grags las chos lung mang ba/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po las snyan ngag me long la bshad rgyugs/ rje btsun pa las dbu tshad 492

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dang / mngon pa/ snar thang mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan las kyang dbu tshad sogs gsan cing / sa skya/ la steng / snar thang sogs su grwa skor mdzad pa sogs rgyu'i theg pa mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i rtse mor son/dgung lo nyi shu lhag tsam la phebs skabs yar klung rnam rgyal sgang du phebs nas kha che paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun 'dzin pa bka' bzhi pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis mkhan po dang / bye rdzing tshogs pa'i mkhan po shar mgon pas slob dpon/ bye rdzing pa'i dbu mdzad bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ston mdzad de tshigs phyi ma bsnyen par rdzogs pa de nas dar yul ba las gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor gyi slob dpon chen po'i snying gtam shog dril ma sogs shog ser dang /tshe sgrub/ rta mgrin gyi skor sogs gsan/ bde chen 'jam rin pa/ bla ma rje btsun pa/ bla ma mchog shes rnams las lung kha yar gsan/ gdan sa thel spyan snga chos grags pa las nā ro chos drug sogs dang sgra gsan/ bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan las dus 'khor rtsa ba 'grel chen sogs zhib par gsan cing rgyu mtshan gyi skar rtsis la yang mkhas par mdzad/ bu ston rin po che'i dngos slob bla ma bde chen chos dpal las kyang dus 'khor dang rdo rje snying 'grel/gsang 'dus lugs gnyis/ bu ston gyi yig cha sogs du ma gsan/ khyung po lhas pa las yo ga'i skor gyis thog drangs rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi bka' dang dbang gi chu bo rgyun ma chad par yod pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis bzhes/ sde snod 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan grags par yo ga'i gar dbyangs dag ther mdzad/ grub chen dpa' bo rdo rje'am bla ma dbu ma pas lo tsā mdzad nas dbu ma'i lta ba sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par sngags bla med lam gyi gnad dang rim pa lnga'i go rim drang nges sogs dri dogs legs par gcod pa gnang / lho 493

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje las snyan brgyud dang lam rim gyi khrid sogs mang du gsan/ spyan snga rin po che chos kyi rgyal po las nā ro chos drug gsan pa bcas 'bras bu'i theg pa mtha' dag la mkhas par mdzad cing / bsdoms na bshes gnyen bcu phrag bzhi skor bsten cing mdo sngags kyi gdul bya mang po la smin grol gyi dbang lung rgyud bshad sdom 'bog sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu gsan bsam gnang ba'i nang nas gtso bor yongs su 'dzin pa chen po gang dang gang nas zab chos gang dang gang bzhes skor zhu na/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor smin pa dang / dge tshul sogs chos rje don grub rin chen/ phar phyin gnyags dbon kun dga' dpal/ dbu tshad kyis mtshon mang ba red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ sgra sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ snyan ngag lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ sngags rnying ma'i skor dgas yul ba/ bka' gdams skor spyi lhas pa dang / lho brag grub chen/ bka' brgyud skor 'bri gung spyan snga chos rgyal dang / thel gyi spyan snga chos grags/ dus kyi 'khor lo phyi rol rtsis dang bcas rtag pa dang ldan pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/tshogs mkhan po tshul rin par so thar gyi bslab sdom/ gso ba rig pa sman pa dkon mchog skyabs/ dbu ma'i lta ba sogs bla ma dbu ma pa/ grub chen las kyi rdo rjer lam gyi rim pa dang / snyan brgyud sogs mtha' klas pa gsan pas bla ma bcu bzhi po 'di rnams bka' drin che zhing / de'i nang nas kyang gtso bo ni/chos rje don grub rin chen pa dang / red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ grub chen dpa' bo rdo rje dang / las kyi rdo rje bzhi ni 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dbu bla yin no/ /494

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad jes kyi dpyad brjod/bshes gnyen dam pa de dag bsten gnang mdzad pas mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la gsan rgya che ba dang / nges don rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos su ma zad/ thun mong ba'i snang ngor yang nyin re thos bsam gzhan gyi zhor la shog bu mda' tshad ma bcu gsum thugs la nges pa'i tshad de dus byon pa'i mkhas pa phyag dpe thugs 'dzin bzang bar grags pa las kyang ches cher brgal ba yin/ de yang rnam thar thub bstan rgyan gcig nang / dgung lo so gnyis la bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad chen mo(legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba〉 bka' rtsom mdzad/ ‘‘de'i tshe thugs 'dzin bzang bar grags pa gling mtshungs med pa dang / mdo smad pa 'jam dpal bkra shis/ shākya grub ces pa gsum dang / rje 'dis nyi ma ri rtser shar ba nas tshal dbus gling gi gtsug lag khang gi gser tog gi rtse la nyi ma shar ba dang dus mnyam du sngar gzigs ma myong ba'i mda' tshad phreng dgu ma zhig gi shog bu bzhi shin tu dag par thugs la chud cing /gling mtshungs med pas shog bu phyed dang gsum thor re ba zhig dang / gzhan gnyis kyis re re las ma gzigs par grags’’zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de bzhin skal ldan gdul bya mang po'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i dbang lung man ngag gis rgyud smin par mdzad cing / lhag par yang rje 'di nyid ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i snyan grags sogs la brten slob ma'i tshogs ji ltar pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang mo 'du ba bzhin phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun nas 'du ba ltar dgung lo so lnga pa'i skabs shig mon bkra shis gdong du bzhugs pa'i nub mo zhig bzhugs mal la bzhugs nas bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ci rigs pa gsungs pa las 'phros nas/ sngar 495

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bka' bzhi ba sher seng gis chos thog gcig la po ti bcu gcig gsungs 'dug dus phyis bod du po ti dus gcig tu gsungs pa la de mang shos su byung 'dug ces gsungs par/ dge bshes sha ston la sogs pas/ 'o na 'di nas kyang de tsam zhig dus gcig tu 'tshal zhus pas/ rtsol ba byas na de tsam zhig 'chad thub pa 'dra gsungs par/ des na ci nas kyang gsungs 'tshal zhes nan gyis gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu nas gnam gang bar sku mtshams bcad nas phyag dpe gzigs rtog mdzad/gnam gang nyin phyag dpe thams cad kyi sku rags bcings/ tshes gcig nas gsung chos 'dzugs par bzhed pa la/ gsang phu sogs nas sde snod 'dzin pa mang po zhig 'byor rgyu'i snyan gsan phul bar brten/ zhag 'ga' 'then tsam mdzad nas nyin gsum gyi bar du mar pa dang mi la sogs kyi gsung rgyun thor bu ba 'ga' gsungs/ tshes lnga nas nyi ma gcig la rgya gar skad du bco lnga'i dbu dus gcig tu btsugs nas/ nyin re bzhin tho rangs nas srod kyi bar la chos thun bco lnga re ma chag pa'i thugs bshad mdzad/ de'i nang nas po ti chung ba gnyis rdzogs par gsungs tshar ba na de'i dod du slar yang chung ba gnyis btsugs pa dang bcas yongs su bsgril bar/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/phar phyin/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs lnga/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ spyod 'jug ste bstan bcos gzhung chen bcu bdun gyi gsung bshad mdzad/ de'i tshe na yang gzhung chen dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig la bod kyi ṭīk+ka che mo re gzhir bzhag pa'i thog tu 'grel pa gzhan gyi 'chad tshul du ma dgag sgrub dang bcas pas gtan la phab cing / gzhung gzhan rnams phal che ba rang rang gi 'grel pa'i 496

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/steng nas gzhung phra rags ma lus pa la bshad pa zhib par mdzad de zla ba gsum la rdzogs par mdzad ces dang / ‘‘zang zang ne ring pas mdzad pa'i rje'i rnam thar du nyin gcig la rgya gar skad nas brtsams te phar tshad gnyis sogs rgya gzhung nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bshad pa nyi ma gcig la grol bar mdzad’’ces gsungs pa ni dus skabs 'di rang min pa'i gnas skabs gzhan zhig tu gsungs pa 'dra ste/ der ma zad rnam thar legs bshad kun 'dus las/red mda' pas 'chad nyan la skul nas bde ba can la sogs par lo bdun tsam 'chad nyan mdzad/ po ti bcu tsam gung bsgrigs nas rang rang gi bzhed gzhung bzhin po ti re re la 'grel pa gnyis gsum dang stel nas gsungs pa lan mang du mdzad/ khyad par bya bral la 'byon khar po ti nyer dgu sbrel nas gsungs pas kun ngo mtshar bar gyur to zhes 'byung bas 'di ltar bshad pa lan du ma mdzad par mngon no zhes gsal ba'i mdzad pa 'di rnams ni tha mal ba'i snang ngor ngo mtshar bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/rje bdag nyid chen po'i thugs dgongs la kha ba can na da lta yod pa'i bka' bstan bcos man ngag dang bcas pa legs par nyan zhing khong du chud nas/da dung the tshom som nyi la sogs pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / khyad par du dbu ma dang sngags kyi skor/ bye brag gsang 'dus dang bde mchog skor rnams la gtan la 'bebs pa'i ched du rgya gar du byon nas o t+tan nā len+d+ra la sogs rnams su klu'i byang chub sogs la gtugs par dgongs te dpon slob bcu gsum tsam rtags dang rmi lam sogs la dpyad nas smon lam dang rten 'brel gcig tu bsgrigs te dgung lo so dgu pa shing phag lo gnyal nas lho brag la lam btod/ rgya gar shing gi ri nas lam byas grub chen mi tra dzo ki dang mjal 497

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nas ma gha dhar 'byon dgongs te lho brag tu phebs te lho brag grub chen phyag rdor ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang mjal nas de'i gnas lugs gsungs par rgya gar du byon na rje nyid rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po byed pa zhig tu 'gyur na'ang sku tshe thung pas slob ma rnams la phan dka'/ de bas bod dzodu bzhugs nas 'jam dbyangs la gsol ba thobs dang / myur du rjes su 'dzin pa 'dug ces lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas bshol 'debs mdzad pas rgya gar la mi 'byon pa'i thugs thag bcad/ 'on kyang dam chos 'tshol ba la thugs tshim pa med pa'i brtson 'grus dang snying stobs ni ches bsngags par 'os pa zhig yin no/ /dgung lo nyi shu pa sa rta lo'i ston dus 'khrungs yul nas rkyen du babs pa'i 'tshog chas ci rigs pa 'grul pa'i mdun 'bul rgyu bskur yod tshul gsan pas de dag bzhes pa la sogs pa'i slad du ngam ring nas sa skya brgyud de dbus su byon nas bskur mo rnams bzhes/ de'i skabs grogs dang slob 'brel mang pos bskul cing / mdo smad nas yum gyis kyang zhu ba nan cher byung ba'i rkyen byas nas lan cig mdo smad la 'byon par bzhed de mal gro lha lung du byon pa dang / mdo smad phyogs su mkho ba'i man ngag lag len 'ga' zhig la thugs sbyong yang mdzad par brtsams pa las/ mtshams shig nas ci byed de 'dra ba la dgos pa mi 'dug da ni mdo khams dang yul gyi phyogs la gtan nas mi 'gro ba'i yi dam 'cha' bar bya'o snyam du dgongs pa shugs drag po skyo shas dang bcas pa zhig 'khrungs nas de 'phral du 'khrungs yul du mi 'byon pa'i thugs thag bcad pa 'di ni yum la rjes su chags pa la sogs kyang 'khor ba'i 'ching zhags lta bur gzigs nas 'dor bar mdzad pa ni chags bral gyi 498

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mdzad pa rjes su yi rangs zhu 'os pa'i gnas yin no/ /dgung lo so drug pa sa sprel lo dngos slob 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad phyag phyir khrid de skyor mo lung nas 'ol khar bya bral la phebs te sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor mdzad pa de yang lo de'i dgun dpyid rnams 'ol kha chos lung du bzhugs nas thog mar bsag sbyang gnad che bar dgongs te dpon slob rnams kyis stobs bzhi'i bsag sbyang la shin tu 'grus par mdzad cing / rje bdag nyid chen pos ltung bshags brgya phrag dang bcas pa/ phyag sor gyi rtse mo rnams ser kar ma song gi bar du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs la dpag par dka' ba'i brtson pa drag po mdzad/lo der 'ol kha rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang sngar gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis bzhengs pa'i jo bo byams pa'i sku 'dra mi tshad lhag tsam shin tu byin rlabs che zhing ngo mtshar ba bzhugs pa bar skabs sri zhu med pa rdul khrod na 'o brgyal zhing / sku la bya thal sogs mi gtsang ba gos pa dang / gtsug lag khang la'ang nyams chag che ba gzigs pa de'i zhig gsos mdzad par dgongs nas rtsig pa dang / thog zhal ba nyams gso dgos rigs rnams sbyin bdag 'ol kha stag rtse la zhal ta gnang ba bzhin legs par bsgrubs shing / de'i mtshon gsol gyi chas rkyen rnams dpon slob rnams kyi phyag rdzas gtor chas sogs gang yod la rin btab par zho bcu gnyis las ma byung bas bsgrub dka' ba'i thugs khral chen po byung ste rnam sras la 'phrin bcol gnang dgos byung ba bcas mthar legs par grub pa'i mdzad pa 'di ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal gcig yin/dgung lo so dgu par gnyal smad seng ge rdzong du bzhugs skabs gser phye 499

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'bum pa la mchod pa rgya chen phul/ der 'dul ba'i chos mang du gsungs shing /ltung byed nyes byas dang bcas par bshags sdom mdzad pa dang slob ma rnams kyang tshul de nyid la sbyor ba mdzad/ dpyid gnyal gyi sgang chung du bzhugs ring dge 'dun rnams la zab chos ci rigs gsungs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang bsnyen gnas dang skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa la sbyar zhing / rje nyid kyis phyag bstar nas ser skya'i tshogs thams cad bskul nas tsha tsha 'bum ther mang po btab cing / phyis kyang tshul de nyid sgrub pa la sbyar bar mdzad pa 'di ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal gcig yin/de nas gnyal stod ra grong du byon nas dbyar bzhugs mdzad pa'i skabs rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dbus su byon te chos sde rnams su grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab bzhin pa'i skabs der rje tsong kha pa chen po'i snyan grags gsan nas mjal bar phebs pa 'di'i skor gsung tshul 'dra min cung zad yod kyang skabs 'dir brag g.yab blo bzang bstan pas mdzad pa'i (rgyal tshab kyi rnam thar yon tan chu gter ma〉 lalo‘rgyal tshab rin po ches g.yag rong gnyis lung rigs kyis pham par nus pas thugs rgyal nas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang rtsod pa'i bsam pas phebs/ de'i dus rje rin po ches chos gsungs pa dang thug pas thog mar rtsod pa'i skabs dbye dgos pas brnyas thabs mdzad par dgongs nas dbu zhwa yang ma phud par chos grwar byon pa rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos gzigs te/ chos gsungs 'phro ma bcad bzhin du khri las gzhol nas bzhugs par/ slob dpon rin po che yang thugs rgyal ba'i tshul gyis rje'i bzhugs khri'i steng du dbu zhwa mnab bzhin par bzhugs nas rje tsong kha pa chen pos gsung bshad mdzad pa gsan pas/ sngon chad 500

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mkhas pa gzhan las ma thos pa'i legs bshad sha stag snyan gyi bu gar son pas khengs pa'i ri bo bsnyil te/ dbu zhwa zul gyis phud nas khri las babs te slob ma'i khrod du byon/ de nas rtsod pa'i re ba dang bral te slob ma mdzad pa yin la/de'i tshe rje'i bzhugs khrir phebs pa de phyis su gdan sa'i khrir phebs pa'i rten 'brel yang 'grig ces gsungs so//’’zhes 'khod pa ltar rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen ni dbus gtsang gnyis kar rtsod pa bzang ba'i snyan grags ldan la/ sa skya pa'i mkhas pa chen po g.yag rong gnyis kyang rtsod pas pham par byed nus pa'i thugs rgyal gyis rje tsong kha pa chen po dang rtsod pa gnang bar phebs na'ang rtsod pa dang / yun ring po'i dpyad pa ma dgos par rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba 'ga' zhig tsam gyis 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i yid ches brtan po rnyed/ dus de nas bzung sras kyi thu bor gyur pa 'di ni mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mdzes gsungs pa ltar rje tsong kha pa chen po byon pa'i dus ni bod du chos lugs kyi mkhas pa gcig las gcig lhag pa mang po byon pa'i dus skabs de lta bu la'ang rje tsong kha pa chen po ni gser ri'i dbus na lhun po lta bu dang / rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun las mngon par 'phags pa grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa'o/ /dgung lo zhe lnga pa lcags sbrul lo red mda' pa chen po dang tsong kha pa chen po 'bri khung nas rwa sgreng du byon pa dang / de nas rje btsun yab sras gnyis dang / lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal dang bcas pa chos rje rnam pa gsum gnam rtse lding du ar chen po byang chub ye shes kyi gtsug lag khang du zhal mngon par 'dzoms shing / dbyar gnas pa zhal gyis bzhes pa de'i tshe rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang / the tshom dang /501

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gya tshom gyi bsam pas 'jug pa sogs kyi dri ma ngan pa mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa'i dag ther rnam dag cig mdzad de 'dul ba'i bstan pa mi nyams pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar dgongs nas 'dul ba'i mdo rtsa ba'i bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa re gsungs pa dang chabs cig 'dul ba'i phyag len rnam par dag pa'i srol legs par btsugs/ de'i dus su rje tsong kha pa chen pos rje btsun red mda' ba chen po la/ dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /tshad med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan red mda' pa/ /gzhon nu blo gros zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /thar 'dod bung ba bdag kyang bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes bstod pa phul ba la rje red mda' pas/ de la tshig zur spos te/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'bul bar mdzad pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i gsol 'debs 'di da lta grags che zhing kun tu khyab che ba yin la/ dben sa snyan brgyud lugs su de'i khar/ /bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /ces snon par mdzad pa ste/ 'di dag la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ches shin tu zab mo rnams dus 'di dag gi snga phyi nas byung ba yin no/ /zhes rnam thar du gsal ba yang dmigs brtse ma thog ma'i 'byung stangs ci zhe na tshang mas shes pa yang dka' bar mthong nas de'i 'byung khungs rags pa tsam smos pa lags/dgung lo zhe drug spyi lo 1462chu rta lo rwa sgreng gi dben gnas yang dgon du bzhugs pa'i tshe lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang / mkhas 502

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/chen zur phu ba dkon mchog bzang po/ 'bri gung chos rje sogs dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa dang / che rgu du mas lam rim chen mo bka' rtsom mdzad par gsol ba nan gyis btab pa bzhin bka' rtsom mdzad/dgung lo nga gcig pa me phag lo se ra chos sdings su dbyar gnas la bzhugs pa'i tshe mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po dbus phyogs su dka' bcu'i grwa skor dang / rje btsun red mda' pa chen pos rje tsong kha pa dang dpon slob tu mtshams sbyor ba'i phyag rtags nan can yod pa 'bul ba dang bcas rje tsong kha pa chen po mjal bar phebs te mkhas grub rin po ches rje nyid la dka' gnad mang po dang / lhag par rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung gi rtsa ba'i dgongs pa la rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa dag gis kyang dpyis phyin pa'i dgongs 'grel du ma song ba 'ga' re snang na/ bod kyi blos byas kyi grub mtha' 'di rnams dgongs 'grel du ji 'dra mchis/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don ma lus pa nyams su len na ji lta bu sogs kyi dri ba dang /yang gzhung rnams kyi dka' ba'i gnad la sogs pa khong rang gi thugs la shar tshul rnams gus pa dang bcas te thogs pa med par zhu yin 'dug pa la/ rje nyid zhal shin tu 'dzum zhing bzhad chung dang sbrags nas da ci dga' zhes yang yang gsungs shing dgyes par gyur/ zhu ba rnams rdzogs pa dang / khyed kyis gzhung gi go ba 'di 'dra ba dang / dgos pa 'di lta bu 'char ba'i rgyu ci la 'bad pa yin ces bka' gnang ba la/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams la thos pa dang / bla ma yi dam dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs pa bcas la 'bad pa bgyis pa lags zhus pas 'o de ga rang yin/ nged la'ang de ga las byed rgyu med na'ang rje btsun gyi thugs rje las rnyed pa'i gdams pa rnams ston par 503

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/byed do gsungs pa sogs dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes te rjes su bzung bar mdzad do zhes de dus 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa rje'i drung na yod pa'i zhal las dngos su thos pa dag gleng ba sgro skur med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / gzhan du na mkhas grub rin po che yang thog ma rje tsong kha pa chen por rtsod pa gnang bar phebs pa sogs kyi bshad tshul rnams ni zer sgros tsam yin pa 'dis rtogs par nus so/ /lo der se ra chos sdings su sku mtshams dam por bzhugs pa'i gras kyi dngos slob gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs bgres pa ci rigs la zhal ta gnang nas/ rang re dpon slob rnams la bar chad kyi rnam pa cung zad cig snang bas/ de sel ba'i phyir du deng 'di nas gzhan du zla ba kha shas shig 'gro gsungs par gar byon zhus pas/ da res bshad na mi yong ba'i gnas gcig yod gsungs nas dpon slob gsum gyis mtshan mo zhig gzhan gyis ma tshor bar ra kha brag tu byon nas sku mtshams dam por mdzad pa'i tshe drang nges rnam 'byed kyi bstan bcos legs bshad snying po bka' rtsom mdzad/ de nas dus mi ring bar tā ming gong ma yung los rgya yul du spyan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa slar yang tā zhing bre bos gtso byas pa'i gser yig pa 'byor te gsang stabs kyis se ra chos sdings su rje tsong kha par gong ma'i lung dang gnang sbyin 'bul ba dang sbrags rgya nag tu 'byon pa'i snyan gsan 'bul bar phebs rung / rje tsong kha pa chen po se ra chos sdings su ma bzhugs pa gang phebs sus kyang mi shes pa/ dge 'dun mang po mtshams nas grol dgos pa/ gar bzhugs rtsad ma chod pa'i dpang po sne'u pas bya dgos pa/ mthar gser yig pa tshos ra kha brag tu bzhugs pa shes tshor gyis dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan ngo chen du sbran 504

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nas mchi ma 'don pa dang bcas rgya nag tu phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan gyis phul rung zhal gyis ma bzhes pa/ phyis tsong kha pa chen po'i sku tshab gong ma'i mchod gnas su byams chen chos rje nang sar phebs pa yin/dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa khyi lor ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang /khyams ra sogs kyi bris 'bur sku brnyan rnams la tshon gsol gyis mtshon nyams gso rgyas par gnang ba dang lha ldan smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs kyi gra sgrig mdzad/ de yang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi gsung las/‘‘se ra nas phyag mi 'degs pa'i gong tsam nas lha sar smon lam chen mo mdzad pa'i thugs kyi 'dun pa btang / dpon nam mkha' bzang po(sne'u pa)pa la'ang zhal ta byon/ khong pas kyang lha sa'i dkyil 'khor steng dang seng g.yab sogs kyi zhig gsos rlabs chen mdzad cing smon lam gyi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyi sta gon yang legs par mdzad/ gzhan yang grum bu lung du bzhugs pa'i ring la/ 'bri gung dang rwa sgreng tshun chod/ 'ol kha yan chad kyi sde dgon/mi chen yon bdag bu slob kyi tshogs la dad 'bul bskul ba sogs phyogs phyogs su mngags pa sogs kyi zhal ta dang / thugs rtsol cher mdzad cing / mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la'ang zhal ta zhib par byon zhes dang / de nas grum bu lung nas phyag mi 'degs pa'i gong tsam nas lha sar zhal ta mdzad de/lha bzo mang du bsags/ tshon rtsi gser shog sogs mtha' yas pa 'dzoms pas/ lha sa'i bris sku dang sku 'bur du dod pa thams cad dri mas sbags nas 'ga' zhig gi sku mdog tsam yang ji ltar yod nges dka' bar gyur pa rnams/dri bzang gi chu la sogs pas legs par bkrus shing / dag byed kyi rdzas kha na ma tho ba med pa rnams kyi legs par dag par bgyis te/ slar tshon bzang po 505
