nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rnams kyis legs par gsos shing / gser shog la sogs pas legs par spras te gsar du bzhengs pa lta bur mdzad/’’ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa glang(1409)lor lha sa'i smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i skor/ mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung las/ byi ba lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i smad la lha sar phyag phebs/ gnam gang nyin snyan gsan phebs pa'i mchod pa mdzad/ dge 'dun stong phrag brgyad tsam byung ba la/ dpon slob rnams rang rang gi sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ mi re la mar lha sa'i srang gi nyag bzhi ma re tsam dang / ja dkar zho drug cu rtsa grangs pa'i mang ja dang bcas pa'i tshugs ston drangs/ glang gi lo zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi mchod pa dngos gzhi mdzad pa la/jo bo rin po che'i drung du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs rnam pa lnga 'phrul las bton pa dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i dbu rgyan rgyu gser bzang po 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs pa/ rin po che nal dang / mu tig dang / g.yu la sogs pa'i phra bzang po bkod pas mdzes par byas pa dang / jo bo mi bskyod pa dang bcu gcig zhal la dngul bzang po las byas pa'i dbu rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa phul zhing / jo bo rin po che'i drung du dngul gyi lhung bzed che tshad longs pa/ de'i kha la 'tsham pa'i dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa dang / jo bo shāka zhal gnyis bcu gcig zhal dang bcas pa la cho 'phrul gyi ring nyin re bzhin zhal gser/ tshes brgyad dang bco lnga la sku yongs rdzogs kyi gser chab dang bcas pa phul zhing / jo shāka zhal gnyis dang thub pa gangs chen mtshos gtso mdzad sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi sku 'bur du btod pa thams cad la/ gos dar phun sum tshogs pa las byas pa'i bla gos dang / rnam sbyar dang / sems 506

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dpa' dang sems ma bcu drug la sogs pa dang / khro bo'i rnam par bzhugs pa sogs la ni dar chen dang / rgyan gos la sogs pa'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang / gzhan yang gtsug lag khang che chung rnams kyi tog dang bya 'dab la sogs pa'i rtse zur phan tshun du tha gus sbrel ba thams cad la ba dan dang rnga yab dang dril bu la sogs pas bar ma chad par mdzes par byas shing /phyi'i skor lam chen mo'i phyi rol nas shing chen po 'phang shin tu mtho ba rnams la gos dar sogs las byas pa'i ba dan chen po 'jigs su rung ba/ phyogs skyong de dang de'i skus tog la brgyan cing / de dang de'i sngags ba dan nyid la bris pa bco lnga phyogs skyong pa bco lnga po rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa rang rang gi phyogs su legs par btsugs nas nub re bzhin de dag gi rtsa ba'i gtor stegs khar phyogs gtor gtong ba dang / de dag gi bar bar du gdugs dkar la sogs pa'i rgyal mtshan rang rang gi cho ga bzhin du legs par btsugs shing / ba dan dang rgyal mtshan de dag gi shing rnams tha gus sbrel ba la 'phan dang rnga yab dang / dril bu la sogs pas bar ma chad par mdzes par byas pa ni 'ja' tshon kun nas bkra bas nam mkha'i lam khyab par byas pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang nyin par yang khyams nang ma yan chad la dkar me brgya phrag bzhi re tsam dang / bar skor la brgya phrag lhag pa dang / phyi skor la rdo ring gi 'gram jo bo rin po che'i zhal gyi drang thad du/ kong bu chen po gru bzhi pa phyogs re la 'dom tshad ma gsum gsum yod pa/ de nyid mar gyis legs nga ra bkang ba la 'tsham pa'i sdong bu las 'bar ba'i me lce ni gser gyi mchod sdong gis nam mkha'i lam 'gog par byed pa lta bus thog drangs/ rdza'i khog ma chen po mar gyis bkang ba'i sdong bu mi chen po'i lag pa'i sbom tshad tsam la 'phang 507

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mda' tshad lhag tsam gyi mar me bar thag 'tsham par bkod pas phyi skor gyi phyi rim 'khor ba dang / gzhan yang ra mo che/ klu phug po ta la/ gung thang rnams su'ang dkar me du ma dang / mtshan mo ni/ bar skor gyi rtsig 'gram 'khor ba dang / khyams grwa phyi ma'i ka tshar ji ltar yod pa bzhin du mar me'i phreng ba bkod pas mig gis blta ba tsam yang bzod dka' bar byas te/ ji ltar sa chen po la mngon par bris pa'i sgron me'i phreng bas lha'i lam la 'khrigs pa'i rgyu skar gyi tshogs la 'phya ba gsal bar byed pa'i so so'i 'od zer gyis mtshan gung la bab pa'i mun pa'i tshogs dpung dang bcas pa'ang rab tu zhum zhing ngo mtshar bas sa'i 'og tu song ste kun gyi mig lam du mi mngon par gyur to zhes dang / gzhan yang yon chab brgya phrag brgal ba nyin re zhing gsar ru mngon par bshams pa rnams la nyin re zhing kha che gur kum sbangs pa'i khu bas kha legs par bsgyur ba'i gur kum gyi ro ma ni nyin re la'ang bres gzhal dgos pa dang / gzhan yang spos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / spos snod tha dad du mngon par bsregs pa la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos phyi rol gyi khor yug thams cad du'ang nyin mtshan gnyis ka mngon par khyab cing / du ba rnams ni bar snang la sprin gyi sna ring po dag phan tshun mdud pa'i lda ldi bres pa lta bu/ tha na phyi'i skor lam rnams kyang spos kyi chus chag chag 'debs par byas na gzhan lta ci smos/ zhal zas mda' tshad lhag tsam la mar gyi rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i rgyan yid 'phrog pas brgyan pa brgya rtsa brgyad re nyin re zhing gsar pa gsar pa phul zhing / rkong bu chen po'i g.yas g.yon du sa stegs la/ rtsam pa khal bzhi brgya(rgya ma chig khri chig stong nyis brgya)re las byas pa'i lha bshos rgyan bzang po dpag tu med par spras pa/ 'phyar dar btsugs pa 508

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dang bcas pa mngon par bshams pa'i zhal zas rnying pa rnams ni bdag gir byed pa med par skye bo phongs pa sprang po'i tshogs la ltos pa med par byin pas/phongs pa dag kyang bkren pa'i 'du shes kyi 'ching ba las grol nas bza' btung gis tshim pa lhag par thob pas slar bza' ba yid la mi byed pa lta bur gyur to zhes dang / de'i tshe lha mchod mi mchod rnams kyi mthil len/ phyogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ mi dpon so so la sogs pa thams cad kyi sna len las ka sogs kyi mthil len/ dpon nam mkha' bzang po khu dbon gyis thugs dad pa gtong ba rgya chen pos gus pas bsgrubs shing / bdag po chen po mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas kyang mchod pa rnams kyi mthil len gyi thugs khur cher bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang 'bri gung sogs kyi dad 'bul dang / bsnyen bkur mang bas zhag bcu drug po'i ring la /dge 'dun khri rwa can tsam re'i tsha dro/ tsha ja/ dro ja dang bcas pa chag med byung zhing / tsha dro la dge 'dun tshogs pa'i tshe bsod nams che ba la dgongs nas/ gral du tsha dro mi bzhes par skor ba mdzad pa'i dge 'dun yang stong lhag tsam re yod par nges so/ /de bas kyang skye bo mi nag po'i tshogs 'dus pa shin tu mang ste khri phrag bgrang ba yod par mngon la thugs rje'i shugs kyis/ de tsam du tshogs pa'i skye bo thams cad kyang phan tshun tshig rtsub mos 'thab mo mngon tshan can byed pa ni gcig kyang ma mthong zhing / skor ba gzhan gyi skabs ltar glu gzhas dang rkang bro dang chang 'thung ba la sogs pa bag med pa dag kyang lhur mi byed kyi/ gzhan du na thams cad rang bzhin gyis rgyud 'jam pa dang dad pa dang dge ba la spro ba sogs kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas nyin mtshan khor yug tu chos nyan pa dang / phyag dang skor ba dang / smon lam 509

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'debs pa dang / gzungs kha ton du byed pa sogs 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar gyur cing / de yang mtshan phyed la babs pa'i dus rang na phyi skor byed pa nyin mo las cung zad nyung bar mngon pa tsam ma gtogs/ skor ba byed pa bar chad pa ni cung zad kyang ma byung ngo / /zhes dang de ltar lha mchod mi mchod kyi chas phyogs kyi dad 'bul dang bcas pa thams cad rags pa tsam zhig brtsis nas phyogs gcig tu dril ba la gser zho dgu brgya dang nyer gcig gser zho phyed dang lnga brgya'i dngul/ mar khal khri tsho sum stong phrag bdun dang drug cu tham pa(deng gi brtsi srol ltar na lha khal rer rgya ma drug dang srang bdun re brtsis na mar rgya ma khri tsho nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang brgyad stong sum brgya gnyis/) nas rtsam khal khri tsho gcig stong phrag brgyad dang nyis brgya dang bcu gcig(deng gi brtsi srol ltar na 'bru khal rer rgya ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad rer brtsis na rgya ma khri tsho lnga bcu dang dgu brgya brgyad/) ja dkar zho bzhi brgya dang bcu drug ja nag sig brgya drug cu re gsum/ bu ram ka ra ltang bco brgyad/ sha skam khog pa nyis stong dang brgya bdun cu don gnyis/ 'phan dang rgyal mtshan chen po so gsum/ na bza' dang gos btsems ma sum cu/ gos dar yug nyis brgya dang dgu bcu/ ras yug bdun brgya so gcig ka dan sgril ma lnga bcu lhag cig g.yu rnying rdog po che chung 'dres ma drug cu lhag tsam/ mdzo rta sogs kyi rin gong brtsis pa smar zho nyis stong dang don gsum/ sdong re la phul ba'i ja ther bcu bzhi/ spos dkar khal nyi shu rtsa gcig bla bre btsems ma gsum/ spos reng mda' tshad ma khri tsho gsum dang sum stong nyis brgya bdun cu/spang spos dang dri bzang bsres pa phad bu chen po nyer lnga/ gzhan 'dir ma brtsis pa'i phran tshegs mtha' yas mod/ 'di rang gi dkar chag chen mo 510

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/logs su mdzad par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes mkhas grub rin po ches dngos su gzigs pa rnams sgro skur spangs te gsungs pa ltar dang / 'di lta bu'i cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo de'i ring la tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar nyin re bzhin gyi sbyin pa'i bdag po'i rim pa ni/ tshes gcig nyin gyi sbyin bdag gtso bo rje tsong kha pa chen po dpon slob rnams kyis mdzad pa dang phag gru nas spyan snga rin po che bsod nams bzang pos kyang zhal 'debs rgya che phul ba/ tshes gnyis kyi sbyin bdag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ tshes gsum gyi sbyin bdag rgyan bu lhun grub rgyal mtshan sku mched yum sras dang bcas pa/ tshes bzhi'i sbyin bdag brag dkar nang so/ tshes lnga'i sbyin bdag dpon mdzes pa yab sras/ tshes drug gi sbyin bdag jo bo sa la yab sras/ tshes bdun gyi sbyin bdag bkra shis cha'u da'o/ tshes brgyad kyi sbyin bdag sne'u pa dpon nam mkha' bzang po yab yum/ tshes dgu'i sbyin bdag gzim g.yog rnams kyis byas pa/tshes bcu'i sbyin bdag yon bdag bsod nams 'phel gyis mgo byas pa'i gnyer pa rnams kyis byas pa/ tshes bcu gcig gi sbyin bdag gnyer chen dge 'dun 'phel/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi sbyin bdag skyor mo lung / tshes bcu gsum gyi sbyin bdag tre hor pa rnams nas byas pa/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin gyi sbyin bdag bu tshal ba dang / las chen rdor rgyal ba/ tshes bco lnga'i sbyin bdag thor bu ba rnams nas byas pa/de ltar cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i ring rje tsong kha pa chen pos sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde nas byung ba'i cho ga rnam par dag pas mngon par mchod cing / bstan pa rgyas pa dang sems can la phan bde 'byung ba'i smon lam rnam par dag pa nyin re 511

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzhin mdzad la dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la nyin re bzhin slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skye rabs kyi chos thun re gsungs/ grol ba'i nyin ma 'ongs byams pa'i bstan par 'dus pa dang por skye ba'i rten 'brel du byams pa mched bzhi'i ya gyal ngo mtshar can rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas te skor lam du spyan drangs pa bcas jo bo rin po cher dbu rgyan phul ba dang cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i dus mchod khyad par can 'di dang dus mtshungs par jo bo rin po che sprul sku'i cha byad nas longs sku'i cha byad nyid du bsgyur bar gsungs pa 'di la chos lugs thog nas dgongs gzhi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod pa ji lta ba bzhin zhu bar mi spobs kyang skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa'i gnas tshul la mtshon na cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs skabs lha mi'i sder mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i 'du longs shin tu rgya che la spam mtho ba dper na skabs de'i gser dngul gos dar la sogs pa'i rin thang can lta ci smos/mchod mar gcig pur mtshon na cho 'phrul nyin bco lnga'i ring mar rgya mar phab par rgya ma khri tsho nyi shu rtsa lngar nye ba'i grangs 'bor 'di ni ha las dgos pa zhig yin pa 'di yang gtong phod can rnams kyis dga' gus spro gsum gyis phul ba 'ba' zhig las cho 'phrul chen mo'i mdzad chen la brnyad de chab 'bangs mi ser nas bsdus pa min pa 'di'i thog nas mtshon pa ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i 'phrin las rgyas pa dang / de'i dus bod khams kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi nges can slebs pa yang mtshon/ da dung phyi skor rdo ring 'gram gyi rkong bu chen po gru bzhi pa phyogs re la 'dom tshad ma gsum gsum yod pa spyi khrer phab na spyir btang 'dom gang ma gcig la ha'o smis brgya dang bdun cu tsam 512

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/yod par cha bzhag tshe rkong bu de'i 'khor rgyar spyi khre gru bzhi ma nyi shu brgal tsam zin pa'i rkong bu de lta bu 'dzam gling du sngar dang da lta byung myong med pa'i rkong bu che shos su brtsi chog rkong bu de'i nang du mar khu gtams te phul ba'i thengs re'i mar khu'i rgyur mar ci tsam 'gro ba zhal gsal gsungs med kyang grangs 'bor ches che ba ni smos ci dgos/ dper na rkong bu de'i gsal sgron gyis gtsug lag khang la me skyon 'byung nyen gyi 'jigs skrag byung ba'i skor mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung las/ de'i tshe nyams snang bzang po rang yod pa'i thugs dam pa zhig gi mnal lam du/ bud med chen po zhig gis lag pa gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang la 'khyud 'dug ci byed byas pas me'i gnod pa bsrung ba yin zer ba zhig rmis 'dug de'i phyi de nub/ rkong bu chen mo'i mar phal che ba rdzogs/ mar gsar pa ma blugs pa'i mtshams shig tu/ rkong bu'i nang gi ras rdag rdog rnams dang mar lhag ma dang bcas pa thams cad la me 'bar shin tu che ba'i me'i phung por gyur te/ skye bo thams cad 'jigs skrag tu gyur pa la/ rje'i zhal snga nas de ma thag gzim khang du byon nas thugs dam la bzhugs pas/ rlung gcig kyang med cing thabs rnams kyis kyang bzlog shin tu sla bar byung nas de ma thag zhi zhing gnod pa cung zad kyang ma byung ngo / /zhes mkhas grub rin po ches dngos su gzigs pa'i tshul gsungs pa ltar dang /de bzhin rkong bu chen po'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su rtsam khal bzhi brgya ste rtsam pa rgya ma chig khri chig stong nyis brgya re las lha bshos rgyan mang gis spras pa de yang 'dzam gling gi lha bshos che shos shig yin par tshig thag bcad chog pa 'di dag ni skabs de'i mchod pa'i bye brag gi gras shig yin pa deng dus la mtshon na 'dzam gling du mtshar nyams su brtsi ba'i dpal 'bar chen po dang / zas 513

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rigs sna gcig rgyu cha gtos che bar 'bad pa du mas bskrun pa 'dzam gling na che shos su brtsis te ngo mtshar du byed pa 'di dag la mtshar snang byed rin med pa lta bur mngon pa dang / gzhan yang spos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar re re nas bgrang bar mi nus pa bcas cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa 'di yang rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin la/ skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / bod mi rigs kyi bla na med pa'i snying stobs dang / phul du byung ba'i blo gros kyi mtshon rtags 'gyur ba med pa zhig kyang yin no/ /lo der 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling phyag 'debs par mdzad/ dgon gnas de dag phyag ma btab gong rje tsong kha pa chen po gnas nges med du bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad pa gtso bor rje tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo mtho ba 'byon bzhud mang ba sku ngal gyi gzhi dang 'khor rnams kyang thugs sun nas bzhugs gnas gtan 'khel ba'i dben gnas phyag 'debs pa'i re ba snga mo nas yod pa dang bcas de'i tshe sde pa dang / yon bdag bu slob kyi tshogs nas rang rang la bdag pa'i dgon pa rnying ba 'bul ba dang /gsar pa 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen zhu ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa mang du byung ba ltar de rnams gang bzang jo bo'i rin po cher gsol ba btab nas brtag pa mdzad de 'brog ri bo che bzang bar byung ba bzhin smon lam grol ba dang rje tsong kha pa chen pos zhabs kyis bcags te dgon gnas 'brog ri bor 'debs par gtan 'khel mdzad pa yin no/ /dgung lo nga dgu pa shing lug lor rje tsong kha pa chen pos sgrub mchod sogs tshogs khang du byas na dbang ma thob pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor sogs 514

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mthong ba'i dgag bya che bar 'dug pas/ sngags kyi sgrub mchod khang pa 'gol ba zhig logs su byed dgos par snang zhes gsungs pa ltar yangs can gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs kyi dga' ldan dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa de ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin/de ltar bstan pa dang gdul bya'i don rgya cher mdzad nas sku dngos kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin pa la nye bar gyur pa/ dgung grangs drug cu re gsum pa spyi lo 1419rab byung brgyad pa'i sa phag lo'i ston kha stod lung gi chu tshan la byon na sku lus la shin tu 'phrod par 'gyur zhes gsol ba'i rkyen byas ri bo dge ldan nas phyag btegs te lha sar jo bo rin po che'i sku drung du sku phyag dang /mchod 'bul/ smon lam rnam par dag pa mdzad nas stod lung chab tshan khar byon/ 'on kyang chab tshan gyis ni zhabs la cung zad tsam 'dug pa las ma mdzad pa gtso bor stod lung phu mda'i skye bo'i tshogs la bka' chos bstsal/de nas 'bras spungs su spyan drangs/ de'i tshe lam rim gyi khrid/ nā ro chos drug dbu ma 'jug pa/ gsang 'dus 'dus rgyud la sogs pa gsungs shing / de yang sngon chad grong pa'i skye bo pho mo su la'ang cher mi gnang zhing /khyad par lam rim gyi khrid la 'tshog tu mi rung ba la sogs pa'i dam bzhag che bar yod pa la/ de dus grong pa'i skye bo ji tsam zhig 'ongs pa dang / dus nam zhig la 'ongs pa thams cad la khyad par med par tha na sprang po'i tshogs du ma 'dus pa yan chad thams cad la lam rim dang dbu ma la sogs pa'ang bkag pa med par gnang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngul sku chen mo bzheng ba'i zhal ta mdzad/ skabs der sngon chad dus 'khor ma 515

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtogs chos mtshams mdzad pa'i lugs med pa la/ der gsang 'dus le'u dgu pa'i skabs la chos mtshams mdzad par chos gsan pa rnams kyis da dung zla gcig gam phyed bzhugs nas chos 'phro rdzogs par gsung ba zhig gam/ tha na rgyud kyi 'phro bklags lung du mdzad pa tsam zhig kyang gnang 'tshal zhes gsol ba btab kyang gnang du ma bzhed pa rgyud dang lam rim 'phro la 'jog pa'i dgongs pa ni sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad rgyun rdzogs pa med par 'phro ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'i dgongs pa sngon du mdzad pa yin par grags/ de nas slar lha sar phebs te jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du phyi ma med pa'i phyag 'tshal mdzad/ de nas byams chen chos rjes se rar spyan drangs/ rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rkang tshugs pa'i grwa pa rnam par dag pa 'dzugs pa'i zhal bskos dang / chos dpon bsko ba/ rten 'brel khyad par can sgrig pa'i ched gnas der gso sbyong / rgyud kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi dbu nas thun re gsungs/ de nas ba lam bde chen rtser phebs/ brag dkar rdzong dpon po yab yum la zhal ta gnang nas bde chen du gsang sngags mkhar 'debs pa'i zhal ta mdzad/ de nas dga' ldan du phebs pa na thog mar yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs te 'dir da yang 'ong ba mi yong bas mchod gtor rgya cher shoms gsungs/ de nas 'du khang du dge 'dun tshogs dbur phebs te bde ba can gyi smon lam rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su shis brjod mdzad/ de nas gzim khang du phebs te bzhugs gdan la bzhugs pa na/ da ni rang re'i dgon pa rang dbang thob pa 'dir slebs byung bas blo bde'o zhes gsungs/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen la sogs par bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul gyi zhal ta snga mo nas zhib cha gnang zin pas 516

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/de'i tshe rgyas par ma gsungs kyang skabs 'dir dbu zhwa dang / na bza' ber thul zhig gnang ste rgyal tshab tu don gyis go bar mdzad pa bcas lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan pa lags so/ /rje tsong kha pa chen po sku gshegs pa'i phyi lo nas bzung lo ltar zla ba bcu pa'i nyi shu lnga nyin dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo zhes bya ba'i dus mchod gling me 'bul ba'i srol de bod ljongs yongs la dar nas da lta yang nyams pa med par gnas pa 'di'i thog nas kyang tsong kha pa chen pos zhwa ser ring lugs 'chang ba'i bstan pa rin po che srol gtod dar spel gnang ba la brten nas gdan sa chen po 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gtso bor gyur pa'i dbus gtsang mdo khams dang bcas par gdan sa chen po drug la sogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde til gyi gang bu ltar yangs pa'i yul gru kun la khyab ste mdo sngags zung 'brel bshad dang sgrub pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa dang / gdan sa chen po de dag nas byon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu rim par byon pa rnams kyis kyang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che dang / lhag par bod kyi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin spel ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs pa gang zhig ji srid mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma chad bar de srid skye bo'i yid la lham me lhan ne lhang nger gnas pa de legs par mtshon pa yin no/ /rje tsong kha pa chen por gsung rtsom pod chen bco brgyad yod cing khong gi dngos slob kyi grangs 'dren skor la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba cung tsam mchis pa'i 517

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nang nas skabs 'dir dga' ldan chos 'byung be+e ser gzhir bzung nas bkod na/ sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa gsum yin la/ chos 'brel gsan pa'i dbang gis bla ma yin la slob ma'ang yin pa bla ma dbu ma pa/ phyag rdor ba/ rje red mda' ba rnam pa gsum yang sras kyi thu bo'i khongs su gtogs/snga tshar bzhi ni/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa/ mdo stod pa ngag dbang grags pa/ ldongs ston dz+nyā na shrī/ dge bshes ston pa bcas bzhi'o/ /phyi tshar ram 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi dbus pa bzhi ni 'dzam dkar ba/ bzang skyong ba/ rin rgyal ba/ byang se ba bzhi dang / mdo khams pa bzhi ni/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ shes rab grags pa/ 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dpal skyong ba bzhi'o/ /'phrin las che ba lnga ni/ 'dul 'dzin pa/ 'jam dkar ba/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mtshungs med chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang po/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge bcas so//bstan pa'i sgron me bcu ni/ chos rje dkon cog tshul khrims/ mkhas pa rgyal dbang kha che/ gnyal rgod rin bsam/ mkhyen rab grags bzang ba/gnyal chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong / chos rje chos rgyal ba/ chos rje dpal seng ba/ snar thang rab mchog pa bcas so/ /byang sems gzhan don nus pa drug ni/ byang sems shākya bsod nams/byang sems kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang sems tshul khrims dpal bzang / byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ byang 518

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sems grags bzang bcas so/ /sa spyod ti shrir bkur ba gnyis ni/ byams chen shākya ye shes/ byang dar ma'o/ /mang thos dbon sras gnyis ni/ ma gcig dbon po nam mkha' dpal dang / ar rgyab dpon po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa gnyis ni/ zha lu ba bkra shis rgya mtsho dang /chos rje legs pa rgyal mtshan no/ /rnam dpyod phul du byung ba gnyis ni/ mus srad pa blo gros rin chen seng ge dang / zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pa'o/ /bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba drug ni/ stod sher bzang / smad sher bzang / gu ge ngag dbang grags pa/ lho pa rgyal mtshan seng ge/ bla ma dpal ldan shes rab/ ldan ma yon tan dpal ba'o/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba gnyis ni/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang /stag lung lo tsā ba'o/ /sde bdag gi chos rje drug ni/ rin chen dpal ldan bzang po/ rin po che bsod nams bzang po/ rin po che byang chub rdo rje/ rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung rin po che don grub rgyal po/ stag lung rin po che bkra shis dpal 'od do/ /gsung rab mang du mkhyen pa brgyad ni/ chos rje sher 'byung ba dang / rgyal ba rin bsam/ byang gling pa grags rin/ mnga' ris pa bsod rin/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ gu ge sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ rgyal sras bde 'byung ba'o/ /519

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mdo rong gi mkhas pa bzhi ni/ mdo smad pa 'od zer/ mdo smad pa legs bzang / mdo smad pa bsod she/ rong pa rtse nag bcas so/ /grub pa'i gdung gnyis ni/ kre zhing rin chen byang dpal ba dang / rin chen dpal lo/ /skyes bu ya mtshan can gnyis ni/ skyes mchog smon lam pa dang / ri mi 'bab pa bsod nams rin chen no/ /spyan snga brgyad ni/ kun blo ba dang gzhon nu 'od pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pa/ dpal bzang ba/ rnam rgyal ba/ bsod nams lhun grub/ rin rgyal ba/rin chen 'phel ba bcas so/ /khri la 'dzegs pa'i zla med bzhi ni/ gung thang pa chos rje mdzes pa dpal/bla chen nyan shag pa/ stag phu gu shrī dpal ldan don grub/ te'u ra pa chos rje ye shes dpal bcas so / mkhan chen bzhi ni/ chos rgyal dpal bzang / rgyal bzang pa/ kun rdor pa/ byang dpal ba bcas so/ /chen po lnga ni/ grags bzang / dwags po/ blo 'phel/ kun rgyal/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan bcas so/ /chos sgo ba gnyis ni/ gdan sa 'jam dbyangs kha che dang / 'bri gung bkra shis rin chen no/ /bka' bcu pa bzhi ni/ dar bzang / 'ba' ser pa/ co tsa ston rgyal mtshan/ hul pa brtas so/ /bka' bzhi bcu ni/ mthil chung don yod/ brag dgon rin chen dpal/rgyal ba rin chen chos rgyal/ gye re sangs rgyas dbang phyug stag phu sangs rgyas 520

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzang po/ g.yag sde bsod nams bzang po/ gros pa/ 'tshor bu ba/ chos seng / grags pa rgyal mtshan bcas so/ /jo stan bzhi ni/ zla ba blo gros/ bsod nams lhun grub/ legs rin pa/kong po ba bcas so/ /gnas brtan drug ni/ chos bzang po/ rgyal steng pa grub dpal/ rgya ma ba dge 'dun rgyal po/ 'od zer bkra shis/ gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ kun dga' 'bum bcas so /rtogs ldan lnga ni/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / nam mkha' shor re/grags pa 'byung gnas/ ral zhig pa/ bo le ba rnam rgyal bcas so/ /gzhan yang lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho/ drung gzhon nu dpal ba/mkhan po bsod nams rgyal ba/ bla ma gser thub pa/ yang steng rin po che/zhi blo dbon po/ drung nam mkha' ba/ bla ma dgon po byang chub/ bla ma bsod rin/ drung chos 'phags pa/ bla ma shāka rin pa/ bla ma zla ba bzang po/ bla ma chos rgyal mtshan/ rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes sogs mang po byung yod do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po ni/ dpal ldan sa skyu'i bya 'dabs srad kyi lung lag zhag dang /ban rnying gnyis kyi sa mtshams gung ru ba(yongs gragag la rgar ma zhes bya ba 521

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dang po khams kyi yul nas chad pa'i 'brog pa sa skya pa'i gur mgon gyi dkar me'i ru ba yin pas de ltar gleng zhes smra rung / rje dge 'dun grub kyis de ni gung ru ba zhes pa'i brda 'chugs pa yin zhes gsungs)zhes pa de la ngar pa'i tsho dang / mi sprug gi tsho/ tshang sprug pa'i tsho/ bsags tsho zhes rigs rus mi 'dra ba bzhi'i tsho pa yod pa las ngar pa'i tsho pa ste 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang sku rus gcig pa yab mgon po rdo rje dang / jo mo nam skyid gnyis la sras bzhi dang / lcam mo gcig bcas yod pa'i gsum par rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug(1391)lor sku bltams/ mtshan la pad+ma rdo rje gsol/ khong sku bltams pa'i mtshan mo khyim der dgra jag byung bas yum gyis rdo gseb tu sbas bzhag pa sang nyin ji byas blta bar 'gro skabs bya rog gcig gis srung ba de ni dpal mgon zhal yin par grags/dgung lo bdun pa me glang(1397)lo yab mgon po rdo rje sku gshegs pa dang / lo der khong snar thang gi gdan sa bcu bzhi pa grub pa shes rab las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / snar thang pa rgya ston tsan+d+ra pa la bod yig dang / lanya war/ hor yig sogs gsan sbyong mdzad pas slob dpon las kyang mkhas pa'i tshad du son pa bcas sku gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mdzad pa'i sdom du/khong gi dngos slob paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos mdzad pa〈rje thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rmad byung nor bu'i phreng ba〉zhes bya ba las/ring nas goms pa'i blo gros dpag dka' ba/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod grogs rnams kyis/ /gzhon nu nyid na'ang mdza' ba ma btang zhing / /522

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'bad med lhun gyis grub 'di e ma mtshar/ /ngur smrig thun mtshams gos kyis rab 'khyud cing / /yon tan cha shas bang rim rdzogs pa can/ /mkhas mang gser ri'i dbus na mngon mtho ba'i/ /khyod sku lhun po ltar brjid e ma mtshar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so//de nas dgung lo bco lnga pa shing mo bya(1405)lor snar thang pa grub pa shes rab pas mkhan po dang / byang pa'i chen po blo ldan pas slob dpon mdzad de tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par nos te mtshan yang dge 'dun grub pa dpal zhes bya bar gsol zhing / de'i mjug tu bzang po zhes pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa dang / phyis dgung lo zhe gcig pa lcags phag(1431)lor bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal mjal bar pad+ma chos sdings su ched phebs sgrol ma'i chos skor mang du zhu ba'i skabs bo dong pa chen pos chos kyi gnas lugs mang po dri ba mdzad par de de'i lan phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes te da phyin chad khyed la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub gyis zhes mtshan gyi gzengs bstod pa bcas rje 'di nyid kyi mtshan thogs stangs kyi rim pa yang de ltar lags/de rjes snar thang pa sat+ta shrī la snyan dngags me long dang / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ sgra mtshams sbyor lnga pa sogs dang / gtum po dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' du ma dang / a bha ya kitir tshad ma/ snar thang nyer 'dzin par kyai rdor lha dgu/ gur mgon sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan/gzhan yang byang chen bsod nams blo gros dang / dbon ston thub pa dpal bzang / ston pa dge ba dpal rnams bsten te klog pa thos bsam gyi sgo nas 523

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad/dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags stag(1410)lor tshigs snga ma'i myo/khan po grub pa shes rab kyis mkhan po dang / byang chen blo ldan pas las slob/ snar thang gi gdan sa ba grags pa shes rab kyis gsang ston mdzad thog dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi bslab pa yang dag par bzhes te lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'i chu bos thugs rgyud kyi bum bzang nye bar gtams pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pur gyur pa bcas rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa 'gro ba'i sman yon chen po rnam 'dren bzhi pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa lhur bzhes pa'i sdom du nor bu'i phreng ba las/dbang po rab zhi dul ba'i dpal gyis ni/ /tshangs spyod kyis rgan lha yi drang srong yang / /mi bsrun byis pa ltar mdzad gzhon nu de/ /'dir ni gangs can sa yi thig ler gyur/ /mkhan slob dge 'dun grangs tshang nam mkha' las/ /nges 'byung gis drangs rnam dag cho ga la/ /rlung gis bar chad sprin rum bsal ba las/ /bsnyen rdzogs zla ba khyod thugs mkha' la shar/ /de lta'i bslab gsum khrims kyi 'dzin ma la/ /byang chub sems mchog snying rje'i rtsa ba can/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i yal 'dab 'bras bus brjid/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam dbang po'ang khyod nyid lags/ /524

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/zhes gsungs so/ /dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing mo lug(1415)lor slob dpon rab mchog pa dang lhan du dbus phyogs su byon/ khra 'brug tu sems dpa' chen po kun bzang pa dang / thang po cher rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas phar phyin zhus/ de rjes tsong kha pa chen po mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bkra shis rdo khar spyan drangs pa'i drung du sems dpa' chen po kun bzang pa dang sdebs te byon nas tshad ma rnam nges/ drang nges rnam 'byed/ rtsa she/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad sogs chos mang du zhus/ rje bdag nyid chen po yang thugs shin tu dgyes te 'dul ba'i bslab khrims khyad par can spel ba sogs bstan pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'i ched du rje bdag nyid chen po'i mthang gos bzhes 'phro dgyes bzhin du bstsal/ rje'i bka' la brten nas thang chen bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / gsang phu ba shes rab seng ge gnyis la gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar sogs sngags dang tshad mas mtshon mang po gsan/ ston chos la ri bo dga' ldan du phebs/ rje rin po che dang rgyal tshab dar ma gnyis la byang chub lam rim chen mo/ tshad ma/ phar phyin/ mngon pa kun btus/ dus 'khor/ byams chos kyis gtsos zab cing rgyas pa'i chos bka' dpag tu med pa gsan/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan la drang nges rnam 'byed/ gro sa ba dpal ldan rin chen dang / rgya mtsho rin chen gnyis la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i lung sogs chos du ma gsan/ gsang phu gling stod mthong smon gyi gdan sa lo kha yar mdzad/ shing lug lo nas me rta bar dbus su lo bcu gnyis ring gsan bsam dang gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che mdzad/525

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de nas gtsang du phebs te snar thang / byang chen/ ri khud sogs su bzhugs/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal brtsams/gnas snying du mkhas grub rje la chos 'brel tsam dang / rgyal tshab rje dang mjal te chos mang po zhus/ la stod phyogs su byon nas chos sdings g.yul rgyal ba yon 'byung la dbyangs 'char skor gsan cing legs par sbyangs/ bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa'am phyogs las rnam rgyal ba dang mjal/ sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / bcu bdun pa/ dkar sngo/ dbyangs can ma sogs kyi chos dpag med gsan/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi ṭīka brtsams/ shangs pa kun mkhyen dang sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal bzang la chos bka' mang du gsan/chu glang lo ri khud chos sde'i gdan sa mdzad de rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku bzhengs pa dang gtsug lag khang la rdo gcal 'ding ba sogs chos sde la phan pa rgya cher bsgrubs pa ma zad smon lam yang btsugs/ rta nag chos rje anan+ta par gdong bzhi pa'i bka' lung gsan/ sngar dpal mgon dang las gshin mi mthun par byed kyang la stod kyi lam bar 'phrog bcom byung nub mnal lam du dpal mgon gyis nga'i grogs la chos rgyal thong gsungs pa nas mthun par gyur ces grags/ rta nag phu'i bla ma don yod pa zhes mngon shes mnga' ba zhig yod pa'i lung bzhin sgrol ma ba 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rjer lcags ral can gyi rjes gnang dang phur pa gsan/ lha mo dmag zor ma skye ba mang po'i chos skyong yin pas bo dong chos bzang par gsan pa'i snyan gsan mdzad nub khong la spyan ltas bzang ba byung zhing / man ngag sgrub skor rdzogs par gnang /dbon ston thub pa dpal la mgon po bzhi sbrags dang phyag drug pa'i skor gsan/ me 'brug lo byang chen du chos bar 'dra dang skabs skabs su thugs 526

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dam gnang sa'i khang pa zhig dgos par dgongs te sbyin bdag shākya dpal bas mthun rkyen sbyar te byang chen theg chen pho brang btab/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos chen mo rig pa'i rgyan zhes pa brtsams/ sa pho rta(1438)lor slar yang dbus phyogs phebs te byang rtse chos rje nam mkha' dpal ba la dus 'khor sogs chos shin tu mang ba gsan/ gzhan yang zur khang pa bsod nams lhun grub dang / spyan snga rin chen 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs la chos du ma zhus/ lcags pho spre'u(1440)lor slar gtsang du phyir phebs te snar thang du 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum dang / so thar gyi ṭik+ka brtsams/rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa dang /'jigs byed dang / phyag drug pa/ dpal mgon sogs lha srung mang pos zhal bstan cing gsung gi gnang ba bstsal bar grags/ lo chen thugs rje dpal la sgra dang / glegs bam rin po che'i lung / kun mkhyen chos rjer gshin rje gshed skor gyis mtshon kha shas/ lha zur khang pa bsod nams lhun grub la blo sbyong /spyan snga rin chen 'phel la bka' gdams skor/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan par dus 'khor gyi rgyud dbang / rjes gnang / le lag skar rtsis/ lhun rtse kun mkhyen par gshin rje gshed kyi 'phrul 'khor sogs mang po gsan/de ltar dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing mo lug(1415)lor dbus su phebs pa nas dgung lo nga drug pa me pho stag(1446)bar lo ngo so gcig ring dbus gtsang gnas nges med lta bur mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mang po'i bdud rtsi rang thugs kyi bum bzang du bskyil ba sogs gtso bor 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i gsos su smin pa'i mdzad pa 527

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sdom du nor bu'i phreng ba las/rab yangs shes bya'i mkha' la rab 'phags shing / /yon tan 'od dkar bye bas mdzes pa can/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal rab tu rgyas pa'i slad/ /bshes gnyen khyod ni nyin byed dbang po lags/ /mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs gyur cing / /nyon mongs tsha gdung skyob pa'i bsil zer can/ /ma rig pad 'dab zum par byed pa'i phyir/ /bshes gnyen khyod ni rgyu skar bdag po bzhin/ /mkha' la lus med ci zhes dris pas khyod kyi yon tan phung po rnams/ /mi shong snyam du dogs par gyur nas kho bos lus ni ma bzung la/ /nyi zla 'khor ba ci zhes dris pas khyod kyi bsod nams gzi brjid ni/ /ma bzod pa la 'dug pa 'phags te mkha' la 'khor ba yin zhes grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgung lo nga bdun pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me mo yos(1447)lorarje 'di nyid la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma snar thang pa rje btsun shes rab seng ge sngon du sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang / sku drin gsob pa'i ched chos phyogs nas bshad nyan gyi 'phrin las chu bo'i rgyun bzhin skyong ba dang / 'jig rten zang zing gi longs spyod phyogs nas nang rten sku bzhengs mdzad rgyu thugs la brnag ste rten de'i bzhugs yul snar thang dang / dpal sdings sam gangs can sogs su rkyen sna tshogs kyis stabs ma 'grig pa'i khar rje shes rab seng ge 'tsho bzhugs skabs bsam grub rtse(gzhis chen bsam grub rtse ste gzhis ka rtse)528

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzod rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nas snar thang la byon rim bzhin bkra shis lhun po'i gnas yul de'i phyogs la phyag mdzub gtad de sa phyogs 'di na dge 'dun grub mgo bo skya yer yer chos 'chad kyin 'dug pa zhig sems la dus rgyun snang zhes yang yang gsungs kyi yod pa dang / de bzhin sngar ri bo dge 'phel du sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i nub gcig mnal lam la da lta bkra shis lhun po gnas pa'i rgyab ri'i rnam pa can gyi ri de'i rtser rje tsong kha pa dang / sked pa na 'dul 'dzin/ de'i smad tsam na rang nyid bzhugs pa dang / sa phyogs der tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan/ bo dong du bzhugs skabs lha mos dgon pa'i gnas dang / ming bstan sa de yang 'di ga yin srid pa bcas tshang ma rten bzhugs yul dgon pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan du dgongs nas bsam grub rtse'i mi drag rnams la dge skul mdzad par phyug gzhung dar rgyas pas gtsos rdo ring pa dang /brang tshal pa sogs kyis gser gyi ga'us sne drangs gser dang / zangs kyi 'bul ba gtos che ba dang / nas khal stong ra can byung ba rnams mthun rkyen du mdzad de me yos hor zla gnyis pa'i nang gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i brag dmar bla brang du bzo bo mkhas pa snar thang pa chos skyong dar gyis nang rten thub pa bdud 'dul ba'i sku brnyan lugs thog mar btang ba ma 'thebs par rje nyid kyis thub pa'i bstod pa bdud dpung phye 'thag ma gsung rtsom dang /de'i gegs sel du rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan zhig lugs phud du bzhengs te slar lugs btang bas ston pa'i sku brnyan rgyab mtho nyer lnga pa byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha 'bar ba zhig byon pa'i gzungs gzhugs su rje shes rab seng ge'i dbu thod rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba dang / rgyal ba tsong kha chen pos thog drangs rtsa rgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi ring bsrel mang pos 529

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtams pa'i dngul gyi rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi sku dang 'dul ba'i gsung rab kyi glegs bam du ma/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos rje nyid la bstsal ba'i mthang gos sogs bzhugs su gsol ba bcas 'brug lo zla ba gsum pa yan la legs par grub/ rten de gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas kyi skor sbyin bdag phyug gzhung dar rgyas pa dpon bsod nams dpal bzang la bka' gros mdzad par/ khyed kyis dkon cog la gsol ba btab nas bstan pa dang / sems can la gang du bzhugs na phan pa che bar lung bstan pa de bzhin du gnang 'tshal/ gal srid yas mas gang du bzhugs par khyad par med na 'di phyogs la bzhugs pa zhig yong ba dang / bzhugs yul gtsug lag khang gi zhabs tog bdag gis bgyi ba lags zhus pa ltar me yos lo'i smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por rje nyid kyis gtsug lag khang bskrun yul du zhabs kyis bcag ste sa brtag pa dang / sa chog rgyas par mdzad nas glegs bam rin po cher/chos dge ba bcu yi khyad 'phags pa/ /gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /sgos nyang shab sa yi lte ba yin/ /sa de yi nang na khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i 'dabs/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bur 'dun/ /zhes dge 'dun gyi mtshan sgra dang / bkra shis lhun po zhes gnas dang gang zag cig car du lung bstan pa mkhas mang bye ba'i bste gnas bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes yangs pa'i khyon du grags pa'i ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo ba gdan sa chen po chu 530

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/gter grangs ldan gyi ya gyal gtsang ljongs nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i mig rgyan/mkhas shing grub pa thob pa'i skyes chen dam pa du ma dang / lhag par snang mtha'i mgon po paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas bzung sku phreng mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin rim par byon pa rnams kyi gsang gsum 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa skyong ba'i gdan sa de nyid phyag btab/ mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan lugs ma sku tshad shin tu che bas mtshon gser dngul dang / 'jim pa bcas las grub pa'i sku brnyan/ gos sku/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rdzas dang bcas pa dngos gtsang zhing / rnam grangs mang ba legs par bskrun thog dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas rab gnas rgyas par mdzad pa bcas de ltar bkra shis lhun po phyag btab pas mtshon rje 'di nyid kyis sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs las brtsams pa'i mdzad pa'i sdom du nor bu'i phreng ba las/dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rmad byung mdzad pa phyogs kyi mthar khyab pa/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dge 'dun grub/ /khyod ni bdag sogs mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rgyun chad med pa'i bshad nyan gser gyi gzhir/ /tshad med 'gro la thugs rje'i rgya mtsho las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs nor bu'i phreng / /skal bzang 'byor ldan skye bo'i rgyan du mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /—gdan sa chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang dus 531

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mtshungs rje tsong kha pa chen pos lha sar glang lo zla ba dang po la btsugs pa'i smon lam chen mo dang mtshungs par shing rta lo gnas rnying rin po ches thog drangs phyogs kyi bu slob bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyang spyan drangs tshogs pa chig stong drug brgya tsam 'dus pa'i smon lam chen mo 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa/gos sku gsar bzhengs kyi rgyu cha lhag ma dang / phyag tu gang 'byor gyi gos dar rnams gdan sa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang / lha sar jo shākya rnam gnyis/dga' ldan/ snar thang sogs kyi rten gsum la 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla bre sogs gsar bzhengs la rje nyid kyis mdzad byang mdzad de phul ba/ spyir mchod pa'i yul dkon mtshog gsum dang / khyad par dge 'dun yin par dgongs nas dge 'dun gyi thug tshul snga mo nas 'dzugs gnang khar/ chu sbrul lo'i dgun chos gnyis la dge 'dun chig stong drug brgya tsam la gsol phogs bzang po dang / gsol thug sogs kyi zhabs tog bsgrubs te chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ de phan chad dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog la dmigs te tha na rje nyid la gzhan gyis gsol bar zhus pa'i 'thud 'theb tsam nas bsags te dge 'dun gyi bzhes rdor rgyun ma chad pa mdzad/rje 'di nyid kyis mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag lnga bsten pa rnams kyi nang nas sku tshe 'dir bka' drin che ba mkhan chen grub pa shes rab dang / rje btsun shes rab seng ge gnyis/ tshe rabs thams cad du bka' drin che ba rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po yin zhes gsungs pa dang /khong gis sems dpa' chen po blo gros sbas pa dang / dpal ldan bzang po/nor bzang rgya mtsho/ rang gi rgyal tshab bzhi par dbang bskur ba paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo sogs mkhas grub kyi slob ma'i tshogs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa 532

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bskyangs/rje 'di nyid kyis gsung rab rtsom pa'i mdzad pa ji lta bu yin zhe na/'dul ba'i gleng 'bum che mo/ mdo rtsa'i ṭīk+ka/ so thar gyi ṭīk+ka/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka/ spyi don rig pa'i rgyan/ rtsa 'jug gnyis kyi ṭīk+ka lung kun las btus pa/thub pa'i bstod pa bdud dpung phye 'thag ma sogs bstod tshogs ji snyed pa/rje btsun ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs dang / mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs sogs sgrub thabs sna tshogs/ 'dus pa la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga sna tshogs/ shar gangs ri ma sogs nyams mgur sna tshogs/ dkon brtsegs nas 'byung ba'i smon lam sogs tshad ma dang / 'dul ba/ dbu ma gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung 'bum pod lnga bzhugs pa'i nang don zab cing rgya che ba ni smos ci dgos/ rjod byed tshig gi sbyor bar mtshon na'ang gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i snyan 'jebs ldan zhing / bstan bya gang yin pa gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i spyod yul du mngon sum 'char rgyu yod pa'i nyams 'gyur gyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po dge ba'i dbang po ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa lta bu yin/ spyir dge 'dun grub 'tsho gzhes kyi dus de'i tshe bod du rje tsong kha pa yab sras dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ snar thang pa sadha shrī/ gtsang smyon te ru ka sogs chos lugs grub mtha' so so'i nang thun mong dang / thun mong min pa'i rig pa'i gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa/ rig pa'i dpa' bo ji snyed cig byon pa rnams kyi 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dus de lta bur yang rje dge 'dun grub pa'i mtshan snyan gyi ba dan dkar po phyogs kyi bu mo'i bla mthor lhab lhub tu g.yo ba bcas gtso bor dkon mchog 533

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsum gyi mchod pa las brtsams pa'i mdzad pa'i sdom du nor bu'i phreng ba las/byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe rabs kun tu yang / /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /gcig tu bsdus nas tshul bzhin 'doms par shog / ces gsungs don dang ldan pa'i bla ma ni/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam bsgrubs pa yis/ /rlabs chen spyod pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / /ma lus 'gro ba'i don la brtson par mdzad/ /mkhas mang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun kun gyi gtso/ /grub pa mchog brnyes sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad/ /dpal ldan phrin las bzang po gdul bya'i dpal/ /bka' drin zla med bdag gi bla ma'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sngar lcags pho rta(1450)lo'i dgun kha zhig ri bo dge ldan gyi mkhan po la gdan 'dren par bla ma dka' bcu pa sbyin pa dpal ba dang dge bskos dpal ldan rin chen pa gnyis kyis thog drangs dpon slob thogs gcig sku mdun du bcar te zhu ba phul bar rje 'di nyid kyis bdag der mi 'gro de'i rgyu mtshan yang dgon pa 'di btab ma thag tu song bas rgyun brtan pa zhig ma byung dogs kyis yin/ khyad par sngar byas pa thams cad kyang bstan pa spyi sgos 'ba' zhig la bsams te 'di gar bsdad pa yin zhes mi 'byon par thag bcad pa'i g.yar dam ji lta ba bzhin gdan sa skyong ba'i phrin las mi g.yel ba lhur bzhes pa sogs 'gro ba kun gyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa las re zhig sku 'di'i mdzad pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul bstan te dgung lo gya bzhi pa shing pho rta(147grulo'i rgyal zla'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rengs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por gzims mal mtha' can gyi tshul bstan to/ /534

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/de yang bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ni dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i nang byon pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan zhig yin pas khong gis thun mong dang /thun mong min pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gi nying khu gcig tu bsdus pa'i gsung rtsom dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa rin po ches mtshon phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur dang / shes bya phun sum tshogs pa/ glegs bam gyi grangs mang ba sogs rtsom rig kho na'i mdzad rjes la mtshon na bod tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam bu'i gling chen po 'dir sngar 'das pa'i dus su byon pa'i skyes bu su gcig gis kyang 'gran pa'i zla dang yongs su bral ba yin zhes skad gsang mthon pos sgrogs par byed pa la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che mnga' ba rang cag bod mi rigs kyi spobs pa dang / krung go'i mi rigs kyi spobs pa zhig kyang yin pas skyes mchog 'di nyid kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis bod rigs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi snyim pa'i pad+mo snying gar mi zum pa med mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho dang skal ba mnyam pa/ lhag par blo gsar gzhon nu'i tshogs kyis nga tsho'i mes po bka' drin can 'di'i mdzad rjes ji lta ba shes par dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung rtsom thor bu nyung shas las mang che ba par gyi phyi mo bsgrub ma thub par brten deng skabs dpe rgyun ha cang dkon pa srid mtha' tsam gyi tshad la slebs pas skabs 'dir mi rabs rjes ma tshos rang re'i mes po tsho'i mdzad pa che long tsam rtogs pa'i 535

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ched da lam khong gi dngos slob shākya'i dge bsnyen 'jigs med 'bangs kyis bdag nyid chen po sku 'das nas lo gsum song ba'i tshe brtsams pa'i〈dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa zhes bya ba〉 mdzad cing / de las gtso bo rnam par phye ba bcu gnyis su bsdu ba mdzad pa'i 'gros ji lta ba bzhin du rnam thar de'i nang nas thun mong gi mdzad pa so so'i nang gi gal che ba rnams yig tshogs la ma 'dzems par cung cha tshang tsam 'bri bar bya ba la/de yang mdzad pa spyi'i sdom ni/ /bltams dang khyim zhugs rab byung mdo rgyud gsan/ /mkhas btsun bzang po bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /'khor lo'i bdag mnyes mya ngan 'da' tshul te/ /mdzad pa 'di dag ngo mtshar bshad bya'i gtso/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dang po/ bltams pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mdzad pa/ khong gi yab ni zha ma'i rigs las byung ba ston pa chos dbyings rgyal mtshan dang / yum byang chub sgron gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i me 'brug (1376)lor gtsang gi la stod lho phyogs dbyig gu zhes bya ba'i 'brog gnas su 'khrungs shing / srid srung rig byed mkhan gyis 'khrungs pa'i dus kyi ltas dang bcas mtshan la g.yung drung sangs rgyas skyid ces btags so/ /gnyis pa/ khyim du bzhugs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mdzad pa/ khong gzhon nu'i skabs kyi rol rtsed ni gzhon nu gzhan dang mi 'dra bar nga ni sgom la 'jug pa yin gsungs te dben pa nas dben pa'i gnas su bza' ba dang 536

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/btung ba gang la yang ltos pa med par mnyam par bzhag pa/ mtshams re nyin zhag gsum tsam thun gcig la 'da' ba dang / mi gzhan gyis rang gi lus la yod pa'i shig ci dgar thor ba dang / shig mang po rdo leb kyi steng bzhag nas slar de dang 'tshams pa'i rdo bas bsnun te gsod pa dag gzigs pa na/ de dag la snying rje chen po 'khrungs te spyan chab bsil ba dang / gzhan gyis bor ba'i shig rnams sgrug ste rang gi sku lus la 'byar te srog blu bar mdzad pas mi gzhan gyis dbon po'i shig gso ba zhes 'bod par yang grags/gsum pa/ rab tu byung ba gartso bor gyur pa'i mdzad pa/ dgung lo lnga par gyam bsam gtan gling du yi ge'i mkhan po bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog gsan sbyong mdzad pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ dgung lo bdun par gyam bsam gtan gling du gang gi zhang po paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa bzhes pas mtshan la sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gsol/ de nas mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang lhan du bo dong e'i chos sde chen por phebs nas mkhan po nyid las tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes pa'i mtshan yang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gsol to/ /bzhi pa/ mdo la thos pa btsal ba'i mdzad pa/ de nas e chos sde'i mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chos kyi rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs nas thog mar tshad ma rig pa la blo sbyangs shing / de yang rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma sde bdun gyi gtso bo lus lta bu rgyas pa'i bstan bcos rnam 'grel la gzigs te dpang lo dang / lo chen grags pa'i ṭika chen yongs rdzogs thugs su chud/dgung lo bcu drug par sa skyar rnam 'grel gyi grwa skor la phebs shing /537

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de'i dus snyan dngags la ched du sbyangs pa ma gnang yang shin tu mkhas par gyur nas thub pa'i dbang por mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa dang /'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa brgya pa/ gzhon nu nor bzang gi rtogs brjod la sogs bka' rtsom du ma mdzad pa de la gang gi gsung las/‘‘don gyi rgyan gyi gzugs ni rab snang bskal bzang mkhas pa 'jigs med grags pa zhes pa 'dir/ /yod de gang gi mdun du phur bu'i lce yang ri bo brgya yi non pa nyer thob drang srong rkang mig de dag kyang / /rkang pa'i 'og tu lo brgyar nyal byed brgya byin gyis gang thal mo sbyar nas yun ring lon/ /dbyangs can nga yi lugs brgya ldan pa'i snyan dngags gtam tshe dpa' bo zhes bya'i snyan dngags mkhan de bros nas song / /’’zhes rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston las gsal ba ltar gsungs pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur dang don gyis brjid pa de dag gi thog nas snyan ngag smra ba'i dbang po zhig yin pa'ang tshegs med par rtogs nus/da dung dgung lo bcu drug pa'i skabs tsam nas bzung phyag dpe thugs 'dzin la thogs pa med pa byung ba'i skor rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston las‘‘bla ma bsam rin pas blo gros chen po 'dis ni nangs re bzhin du gzhung re gzigs na'ang zin pa nyid do zhes pas rkyen byas te khong pa dang gzhan pa zhig gis/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis nam gcig la mngon pa mdzod kyi gzhung rdzogs zin mi zin gyi rgyal byas pas/ zhogs pa phyag dpe gzigs mi gzigs nas mgo brtsam te sku rags 'ching ba'i bar la'ang shog bu phyed dang gnyis 538

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/tsam dang / tsha ba cung zad phyi ba tsam yan la mdzod kyi gzhung yongs su rdzogs par thugs la gzigs nas/ bla ma bsam rin par rgyal thob par gyur te/yang nangs shig phar phyin gyi grags ṭika gi rtog pa'i skabs nas bzung ste/mda' tshad shog bu bco lnga zin nas bla ma bsam rin pa la sprad cing / yang nyin gcig mngon pa kun las btus kyi gzhung yongs su rdzogs pa lan gsum gyi bar du bklags pas thugs la zin te/ bka' bzhi pa chos bzang la sprod par mdzad do/’’zhes 'khod pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo nyer gcig par e chos sde'i lcags ri'i byang shar lcog cig tu sku mtshams dam par bcad de dbyangs can ma bsgrub pas zhal bstan pa dang /chos kyi rnam grangs du ma'i lung bstsal bar grags shing / de skabs dbyangs can lha mo'i bstod pa bung ba'i glu dbyangs la sogs pa mang du mdzad/ de nas bzung ste bstan bcos kyi sbyar byang du dbyangs can dga' ba'i paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar zhes pa'i mtshan yang 'bri bar mdzad do/ /de nas e chos sder dpang lo tsā ba chen po'i gzim khang du sku mtshams dam par bcad nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnas la dpyad pa zhib tu mdzad pa'i thog mar dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi shog bu dang po gnyis la nyi ma brgyad kyi bar du gzigs shing / de nas gzhung gi 'bru rnyed de go yul rim gyis ded nas gzhung yongs su rdzogs pa nyi ma bco lnga'i bar du gzigs pas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba thugs su chud/ de nas mgon po klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa sangs rgyas bskyangs dang dpal ldan zla ba rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas 'grel bar mdzad pa dbu ma thal 'gyur dang /slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang / ye shes snying po rjes 'brangs dang bcas 539

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud kyi 'grel pa mtha' dag la zhag bzhi bcu lhag tsam gzigs pas shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs par gyur cing / de nas tshad ma'i bstan bcos mtha' dag la dpyad pa zab mos de dag la 'dris shing byang chub par mdzad/de nas mkhan chen dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs drung du byon te bdag dbus phyogs su glegs bam bcu gsum gyi grwa skor la 'gro ba la gnang ba stsol cig zhus pas/ mkhan chen gyi thugs dgongs la gzhung de dag la sngon du sbyangs pa mthar ma phyin pas rigs pa ma yin par dgongs te nyid gang gi grwa skor 'gro zhes gnang ba ma thob par slar nan gyis zhus mthar e'i gtsug lag khang du yab sras gnyis zhag bdun gyi bar sku mtshams dam par bcad de gzhung chen de dag gi dka' ba'i gnad la mkhan pos 'dri ba dang zhib tu dpyad pas/ mkhan chen gyi thugs 'phrog pa dang ngo mtshar du gyur nas kho bo'i gzhon nu 'di ni bod dag gi bsod nams kyi skal bas thob pa'i rgya gar kha spu can gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dbyig gnyen dang / tsan+d+ra go mi ltar thub pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag 'dis ni slob dpon gyi kha las ma sdob par rang nyid kyis zab rgyas kyi bshad pa lhur byed pa 'di 'dra ba dag ni sngon chad bod 'dir ma byung ngo zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad de dbus phyogs legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'gyed par rings par byos zhes bka'i gnang ba thob/ de nas shel dkar du phebs te zla ba gsum sku mtshams bcad nas phar phyin dang / 'dul ba/ mngon pa gong 'og la sogs pa'i rgya 'grel rnams la zhib tu gzigs/ slar yang gyam bsam gtan gling du zla ba bdun gyi bar sku mtshams bcad nas rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs thams cad dang / khyad par mtshan nyid theg pa gtso bor mdzad 540

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/pa'i rgya bod kyi dgongs 'grel ji snyed pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du thugs su chud par mdzad/dgung lo nyer gsum par blo gsal gyi 'khor bco lnga tsam dang bcas dbus phyogs grwa skor la phebs pa'i lam bar snyan ngag gi bstan bcos yid kyi shing rta bka' rtsom mdzad/de nas grwa skor gyi thog mar dge 'dun stong phrag lnga tshogs pa'i sde dpal rtsed thang gi chos sde chen por phebs te tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / phar phyin/'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon pa kun btus/ mdo sde rgyan/ dbus mtha'/ rgyud bla ma/ rtsa she/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ snying po/ bden gnyis rang 'grel/ spyod 'jug bcas thog ma'i grwa skor mdzad rtsis kyi gzhung bcu gsum khar/ rigs gter/ dbu ma rgyan gnyis skabs de nyid du bsnan nas gzhung bco lnga'i bshad pa mdzad pa'i thog mar rnam 'grel gyi khas blangs rang gi tshig sogs zhes pa'i gzhung kho nar bshad pa nyin gang mdzad pas chen po jo stan pa yon tan rin chen sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu rnam 'grel gyi gzhung zhig la 'di las dka' ba med/ rang re'i grwa sa chen po 'dir de ring phan slob dpon dbon po dka' bcu ba 'di las lhag pa ma byung zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog lan brgyar 'thor/de nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sne gdong du spyan drangs nayo bkur ste phun sum tshogs pa zhus shing / khyed ni snyan ngag rtsom pa la thogs pa med pa zhig yin 'dug pas yul 'di'i pho brang 'khor dang bcas la bsngags pa zhig mdzod ces bskul ba ltar bstod pa(ngang pa rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs kyi 'jug pa〉zhes bya ba le'u lnga yod pa de ma thag tu brtsams nas phul 541

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bas/ gang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal la thugs phrogs te gus pa chen po mdzad/de nas gsang phu ne'u thog tu phebs nas g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpa' ba dang mjal te grwa skor gyi gzhung gi gras su rigs gter yang yod dam zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar yod lags zhus pas thal mo dang bcas pa'i phyag gis gus pa dang bcas shin tu ngo mtshar che/ ‘‘lo chen yab sras kyi dbon po mkhas pa chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig byung 'dug dang po sa skyar rnam 'grel gyi grwa skor la byon tsa na 'di tsam zhig 'ong ba'i shoms gcig yod/ slob dpon dka' bcu ba dar mas dka' bcu'i grwa skor mdzad pa la thams cad ha las par gyur zer te da ni slob dpon dbon po 'di yis dgung lo dang po ti grangs mnyam zer ba byas chog pa 'dug nged dpal ldan sa skya pa la 'di lta bu'i dge bshes 'ong ba yin/’mi zhes rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston nang gsal ba ltar bsngags brjod mdzad/ de nas gsang phu ne'u thog tu gzhung chen rnams kyi grwa skor mdzad cing gsang phu'i bstod tshig kyang phu re ba dge bshes grags pa dpal gyis skul ngor myur du brtsams nas gnang /de nas bde ba can dang / chos 'khor gling rnams su gzhung bshad mdzad cing / gsang phu nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyag phyir 'brangs pa rnams gzhan dag gis ched du chos gsungs pa las/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis gzhung gsungs pa blo skyed che bar 'dug ces gleng /de nas stag lung thang du byon te chos rje bkra shis dpal brtsegs dang mjal te do ha skor gsum gdams pa dang / stag lung lo tsā ba shākya bzang po las rnam sras kyi rjes gnang la sogs pa'i chos skor mang du gsan/ de dag gi bar du snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos(pad dkar chun po ngang pa'i bu mo yid 542

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/la dga' ba 'phel ba〉 zhes bya ba'i le'u dang po stag mo lus sbyin gyi skyes rabs dang / 〈rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod don rgyan gsal ba'i me long〉 zhes bya ba de gnyis po brtsam par mdzad/de nas gtsang du phebs te bdag nyid chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang / red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis las slob/ bla ma bsam rin pas gsang ston mdzad de dpal shel dkar gyi chos sder bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yang dag par bzhes pa dang /mkhan chen nyid las rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras dang / jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i smon pa dang / 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod nas rgyal sras rnams kyi bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' bar mdzad/de nas mkhan chen grags pa'i drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos grags che zhing gtso bor gyur pa phal che ba dang / lo chen nam mkha' bzang po dang / lo tsā ba shes rab dpal las sgra ka lā pa dang / tsan+d+ra pa la sogs pa cha lag yongs rdzogs/ rgya ma pa yon tan 'od las theg chen blo sbyong gi nyams khrid bcas rim par gsan/de nas bdag nyid chen po grags pa'i skabs kyi rjes su e chos sde'i gdan sa mdzad nas dam pa'i chos mngon pa la sogs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pa dang / mngon pa kun las btus dang / phar phyin/ rnam 'grel la sogs pa'i gzhung chen mang po'i 'grel pa dang / e'i gnas bstod/ rgyal ba shākya'i dbang por khyad par 'phags bstod la sogs pa lo gsum ring e chos sder star chags su bzhugs 543

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/te bka' rtsom mdzad/lnga pa/ rgyud spre rin po che la thos pa mdzad pa/ rje grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas rgyud kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa gang bzhugs pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du zhus shing / gzhan yang 'khon rigs bsod nams yon tan las sa phur gyi dbang dang / lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mo las kye rdor man ngag lugs/ ḍom bhi lugs sogs dang / snyag phu pa byang chub mgon po las don zhags dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po las 'od zer can dang gzungs chen grwa lnga sogs/ rgya ma yon tan 'od las gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ mkhan chen grags pa'i drung nas gsang chen bla na med pa'i man ngag gi rim pa dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga la sogs pa gsan/gsung ngag rin po che ni sngar rje rtse btsun grags pa'i drung nas lam 'bras gsan na'ang / slar se mkhar chung zhes pa'i ri la bdag nyid chen po ye shes dpal zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa'i thugs sras de las nyin nyi shu rtsa gsum la cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ snyag phu pa byang chub mgon po las shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi chos drug cha lag dang bcas pa/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal brtsegs las nā ro chos drug do ha skor gsum la sogs pa gsan/de nas dus re zhig lho bdag ta'i si tu lha btsan skyabs kyis gsol ba btab nas rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa ding ri glang 'khor gyi dgon par phebs nas zhi byed kyi glegs bam rnams la gzigs pas/ de'i bshad srol rnams yongs su grags pa'i mdo sngags kyi gsung rab kun gyi brda chad dang mi mthun pa lta bur gzigs nas/ 'di dag rje dam pa rgya gar bas 544

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzhed pa'i skabs mi srid kyi gzhan zhig gis rang dgar byas so dgongs te bstan pa'i byi dor mdzad par bzhed nas zhi byed 'gog pa la zhugs te/dgag yig shog bu kha yar gyi dbu tshugs pa na mtshan ma ngan pa dang / sku'i mgrin pa snyel ba sogs byung bas dgag yig 'bri ba bshol te zhi byed kyi glegs bam mtha' dag la gzigs shing dpyad pas gzod mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mo rnams kyi shugs bstan gyi dgongs pa zab mo ches mchog tu gyur pa/ mgon po mi pham nyid kyis tha snyad kyi char dbang brtul rjes su bzung ba la dgongs te rtogs sla zhing / don gyi cha dbang rnon rjes su bzung ba'i zab mo mchog tu dgongs nas dam pa rgya gar ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba rnyed pas dgag yig gi 'phro bshol ba tsam gyis snyung ba las grol zhing / thugs dogs dbang gis dgag yig 'bri ba'i 'go brtsams pa bzod par gsol ba'i slad du glang 'khor phyi mchod kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra'i drung du sku sa la brdabs te phyag dang / spyan chab bsil bzhin du bshags pa mdzad de chos 'di nyid la tshad mar gyur pa'i bla ma dka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer la zhi byed kyi chos 'khor yongs rdzogs gsan/ gzhan yang theg chen chos rje las sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag mang du gsan pa yin no//drug pa/ mkhas pa'i mdzad pa/ rta'i bang dang / seng ge'i mchongs sogs lus kyi sgyu rtsal la mkhas shing / yig rigs sna tshogs 'bri ba la phul du gyur pas gzhon nu'i dus su bod kyi sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos mdzad cing / ltas sna tshogs brtag pa dang sgra'i gzhung lugs kun la nang byan chub ste mkhas pa'i rtse mor son nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po'i 'gyur legs par 'chos shing / dka' ba'i gnad gzhi 'gyur yang 545

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mang po mdzad pa ni 'gyur khungs dag la ches myur ba zhig yod/ dper na/phyis nyang stod du phebs dus rtse chen chos rjes phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sngags ring 'di bod skad du 'gyur ba byung na snyam/ sngar rgya gar lho phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta sha ri pu tra dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gnyis la sgyur bar zhus kyang ma bsgyur ba drung pa lo chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin pas 'di la sgyur cig mdzad dgos zhus pa bzhin gsol ja'i gral de nyid du ja yun gnyis tsam gyi bar la legs par bsgyur bar mdzad pas rgya gar shar lho'i paṇa chen gyis kyang re ba ma grub pa cung zad tsam gyis skal ba mchog tu mdzad do zhes bsngags brjod kyang mdzad/gzhan yang phyi rol rig byed pa'i gzhung rnams kyang mkhas par mkhyen cing / gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i gnas bzo rig pa la yang mkhas pa zhig ste/de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku cha tshad mdo rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams legs par thugs su chud de rang gis phyag bstar nas rgyal yum sras dang bcas pa'i lder sku ji snyed dngos su byon pa lta bu bzhengs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang / dbyangs can ma la sogs pa'i bris sku 'phags yul gyi lugs su 'bri ba dang / srin po mi sha za ba dang / drang srong bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pa la spre'u rtsed mo byed pa dang / ljon shing gi yal ga'i khrod nas rma byas skad 'byin pa dang / phug ron lhag pas nyen nas bar snang la 'gro ba'i tshul sogs rgya nag gi ri mo'i lugs su 'bri ba de dag kyang tshe gang ri mo sbyangs pa'i ri mo mkhan gyis kyang bsgrub dka' ba lta bur mdzad/gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag la gzigs pa dpyis phyin pa 546

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mdzad de de dag nas bshad pa'i sman gyi rnam pa dang / shing dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / khu ba dang / srog chags las gyur pa ji snyed pa dag la re re bzhin gyi ming gi rnam grangs/ phan gnod kyi bye brag yul so sor yod pa'i rab 'bring gi khyad par sogs ches gsal ba'i legs bshad kyang lhur mdzad/nang don rig par rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi glegs bam phyogs gcig tu dbu sngas su mdzad nas gzigs pa dang / gzhan yang gsung rab kun gyi don ji lta ba thugs su mnga' zhing gzhan la rgya cher 'chad par mdzad pas mtshan la yang 'bum phrag brgya pa zhes bya bar 'bod pa yang zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /de bzhin sdeb sbyor dang snyan dngags la ches mkhas pa zhig yin te byang bdag rnam rgyal grags pas bskul ma zhus pa bzhin sprin gyi pho nya la rnam par gsal ba'i mchan bu yang mdzad/ ming gi rnam grangs dang / zlos gar la yang shin tu mkhas pa zhig ste rol rnyed ma'i zlos gar gyi bstan bcos kyang bka' rtsom mdzad/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las byung ba'i skar rtsis la yang nang byan chud pa zhig ste phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi tshul ji lta ba mkhyen nas phyi'i rtsis mdzad pa yang sa ris la ma brten par thugs kyi ri mo'i 'jug pas 'bras bu shin tu gsal bar mdzad/bdun pa/ btsun pa'i mdzad pa/ bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo tshun chad la nan tan tu mdzad de gser dngul la sogs pa'i yol go dor te snod kyi dam pa lhung bzed bsnams shing / gos dar gyi na bza' spangs nas bla gos dang /547

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mthang gos/ snam sbyar sogs 'ba' zhig bzhes pa/ stan rnam par bkra bar mi bzhugs par chos gos kyi lding ba la bzhugs pa/ sku lus la tshul khrims kyi dri bsung mngar mos drung na mchis pa'i skye bo'i dri 'dzin la dga' ston zad mi shes pa rtag tu 'gyed par grags shing / phyi ru nyan thos kyi spyod pa la gtso bor mdzad cing / nang du gsang sngags mchog gi spyod pa lhur bzhes par 'dod nas shel dkar sogs su gzhan la yang de ltar gnang dgos bskul ma mdzad par skur ba 'debs mkhan yang byung ba〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 las/‘‘de dag gis 'di skad du gsol te/ sa yi khyon 'di shin tu grang zhing / chang gi btung ba la lha'i bdud rtsi lta bur 'dzin pas ched du bcos ma 'ba' zhig gi bslab tshugs su mthong bar 'gyur la/ de la blo kha kun tu phyogs par dka' na theg pa chen po pa bya ba phyi rol gyi kun spyod mdzes pa las kyang nang gi sems 'dul ba la mchog tu blta zhes gleng na/ gsung rab thams cad la tshad mar gyur pa khyod kyis tshul 'di nyid kyi sgo nas gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ste/rin po che nyid kyang gser dngul la sogs pa'i snod du krums dang phud cung zad re bzhes pa gnang na phyogs 'dir 'khod pa'i skye bo thams cad la thugs rjes bzung zhing phan pa 'gyur ro zhes zhu bar byed la/ phal che ba dag sngon du byon pa'i yab sras mkhas pa la grub pas khyad par du byas pa de dag ni na bza' ber thul gyi sbubs nas gser dngul gyi yo byad la longs spyod bzhin du grol ba thob pa sha stag yin la/ bdag cag gi mkhan po chen po ni na bza' mjug bsdum pa dang / snod 'phru ba kha bcad pa 'di lta bu nas phal pa'i zas kyis tshim par mdzad pa zhes skur ba 'debs pa yang mang du byung’’zhes byung bar grags/548

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/brgyad pa/ bzang ba'am sku che ba'i mdzad pa/ rnyed dang ma rnyed/bde dang mi bde/ snyan dang mi snyan/ bstod dang smad pa chos brgyad 'go snyoms kyi mdzad pa yang / rnam mang thos sras kyi 'byor pa lta bu thob na'ang dgyes par mi mdzad pa/ de las gzhan du gyur pa la'ang mi dgyes pa mi mdzad/dper na/ bo dong / glang 'khor/ shel dkar/ gung thang / gyam/ phu re rnams kyi gdan sar yun ring du bzhugs nas 'du 'god ci rung ba mdzad na phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal thob pa kun gyi mthong snang du grub pa de lta na yang / de dag las rgyab kyis phyogs te rnam par g.yeng ba mtha' dag bsrings nas bas mtha'i 'jug ngogs dpal thang du dgon pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes tshogs chen pa'i mkhan chen don grub dpal bas bka' 'dri zhus par/‘‘sa'i dkyil 'khor gang na yang sbyin bdag chen po rnams la brten pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang bla ma so sos mngon par gang zhing / de dag tu kho bo 'dug pa'i tshe na/ kun gyi gdul bya'i gegs su 'gyur bar mthong nas de rnams las bzur te/ mi'i 'gro bas spangs pa'i sa gsar pa la brten pa tsam yin gsungs so’’ zhes(rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 nang gsal ba ltar 'di ni gnas kyi khyad par las brtsams pa'i rnyed pa dang mi rnyed pa mgo snyom par mdzad pa yin/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi khyad par gyi mgo snyom dang / phyag rdzas phra rags gang la'ang bdag gir mi mdzad pa/ kun dang thun mong lta bur gyur pas sku drung du lhags shing nye bar gnas pa bag yangs la gus pa lhod pa dag gis rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i phyag rdzas rang dgar len pa la kun tu mi 'jigs pa/ bsrung sdom gyi rnam pa phra mo tsam med pa gser dang bong ba mnyam par gzigs pas rnyed dang ma rnyed mgo snyom par mdzad/ bde ba dang 549

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mi bde ba mgo snyom par mdzad pa'i tshul yang / sku lus bde ba dang mi bde ba ji ltar byung yang nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thugs dam gyi gegs su mi 'gro ba mdzad pa/ thengs gcig stod byang du bzhugs pa'i tshe shangs khrag mang po byon nas rlung stobs su 'khel nas sku shin tu 'o brgyal bar gyur pa'i tshe yang snga dro'i dus kyi sku phyag sngar rgyun bzhin mang po mdzad par sku drung na gnas pa rnams kyis sku stobs shin tu chung bas phyag thugs kyis mdzad par zhu zhes gsol bar yang ji mi snyam par sku phyag mu mthud mdzad pas sku lus sa la brdab dum gcig gsung sgros kyang gnang ma thub pa lta bu'i bde ba mgo snyom mdzad/gzhan yang de'i dus kyi mi drag chen po sne gdong nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang dbang grags pa 'byung gnas sogs kyis ched du bstod pa'i chab shog dang bcas gdan 'dren zhus par yang / dgon gnas gsar 'debs so ma zin lugs dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa'i 'phro skyong ba sogs kyis re zhig phebs mi thub par dgongs 'gal med pa zhes bya ba'i zhu yig phul te dgongs zhu gnang ba/ bde dang mi bde/ bstod dang smad mgo snyom gyi mdzad pa'i tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas so/ /dgu pa/ bstan pa la lhag par bya ba mdzad pa/ dus nam zhig gi tshe na bdag nyid chen po 'jigs bral gyi zhal snga nas shel dkar las ha cang mi ring ba'i dben pa zhig na paṇ+ḍi ta'i mdzad pa la gcig tu gzhol ba de'i tshe lho bdag rgyal po lha btsan skyabs kyis‘‘bdag gi khab 'dir kai la shas mtshan pa'i byang phyogs kyi ljongs 'di'i rig pa smra ba kun gyi mgon po g.yag nyid mngon par lhag par gyur cing / de'i tshig gis 'di ltar du smra ste/ khyed kyi mkhan chen 550

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/pa dang bdag ni rtsod par 'dod la/ de'i las su bgyi ba rnams khyod kyis byos shig ces smra na/ 'di dag la khyod kyis rngo thogs par nus sam/ dpal khyod kyis 'di nyid kyi mdun sa brten par byed na ni bdag la 'os par 'gyur ba'i mchog sbyin pa yin zhing / brgal bar bgyid na bdag gi dge mtshan gyi dpal du gyur ro’mizhes bskul ma zhus te g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang rtsod pa mdzad pa dang / yang skabs shig gi tshe bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid g.yas ru byang pa'i sa gnas su zhabs sen bkod pa'i dus byang bdag rab tu byung ba'i tshul 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs shes bya ba des ltar snang gus 'dud lhur len pa'i zol la brten nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis rje sa paṇa la rnam pa kun tu 'gog par mdzad do zhes ma brtags pa'i bab col gyi rjes su 'brangs nas bdag nyid chen po 'di la rnam pa kun tu smod par brtson pa des bskul te dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams skyabs dang rtsod pa mdzad/ des kyang 'gran par ma nus pas de rjes smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhas grub dge legs dpal dang rtsod pa mdzad pa/ yang rgyal po paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshul 'dzin pa byang bdag rnam rgyal grags pa bzang pos ngam ring gi pho brang bkra shis rtser spyan drangs pa de'i gong tsam la rong ston shes bya kun rig kyang ngam ring du phebs te rnam rgyal grags pa dang mjal/ de'i dus su dbus gtsang du dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i 'phros byung nas dpal thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam par thar par dag snang mi mdzad pas rkyen byas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi mkhyen pa'i rtsal rong ston gyis gzigs na ci ma rung snyam ste bskul ma zhus pa ltar rong ston dang rtsod pa mdzad pa bcas skabs de'i mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rnams rtsod par bskul ba'i byed po rnams kyi 551

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsam pa'i khyad par ni ches tha dad pa zhig ste dper na/ lho bdag lha btsan skyabs dang / byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang gnyis kyi dgongs pa ni/bstan pa la byi dor dang / mkhas pa phan tshun dag snang sbyong ba'i ched du yin te/ bo dong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang / g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal gnyis rtsod pa mdzad nye'i mtshams lho bdag lha skyabs zhes bya ba‘rgyal po des mkhas pa'i dbang po gnyis la spyi bos btud cing thal mo sbyar te/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bur rnam par grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnyis 'di ltar zhal mngon par 'dzom nas bstan pa la byi dor bgyid pa ni smon pa'i gnas yin na'ang /da ni bdag nyid chen po rnam pa gnyis kyi rtsod pa don gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing bstan pa la phan pa/ blo gsal mtha' dag gi re ba yongs su rdzogs pa cig mkhyen zhes zhus par/ dpal ldan 'jigs med zhabs kyis de ltar ci na'ang yin zhes gsungs pa yin no/’’zhes〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉las gsal ba ltar dang / byang bdag rab byung gi tshul 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs shes kyi re ba ni de las yongs su ldog pa ste bsod nams skyabs kyis rje phyogs las rnam rgyal dang rtsod pa ma thub pa'i skabs/ ‘‘kye ma kha sang bsod nams skyabs kyis pho ma byas/ da dung 'di dma' phebs pa'i thabs shig bya dgos pa 'dug bsam nas dpal ngam ring gi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la 'di skad brjod do/ /khyed rnams kyis shel dkar ba'i mkhan shob de la pu shud ze sgro btog pa 'dra zhig 'chos dgos par 'dug pas/ legs par gros bgyis la po ti mang po'i kha ya ma byed/ rnam 'grel gcig pu la kha bsgril gyis la bgro gleng rgyal ba'i thabs 'dra 'tshol/ de ltar du byed ma nus na nga'i gzhis 'dir ma sdod/’’ces(rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 nang bskul ba po'i nang gi bsam pa'i 552

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/khyad par tha dad kyang thog ma'i char rig pa'i dbang phyug rnams ni gang na yang bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba rig pa'i rtsal ngom pa'i dgongs pa mi 'dra ba so sor yod du chug kyang / gzhung lugs chen po rnams la bgro gleng ji tsam gnang ba de tsam gyis bstan pa la byi dor dang phan tshun dag snang sbyong ba'i thugs dgongs chu la 'o ma 'dres pa lta bu'i rnam thar ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /dgung lo sum cu bzhes pa tsam nas 'di snyam du dgongs te‘‘bod 'dir yongs su grags pa'i dbang skur ba phal mo che dang / khyad par du thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che gnyis kyi dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las gsan te/ rgyud rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing / rgyud rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang kun yongs su rdzogs pa thob ste/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho bshad pa dang sgrub pa la yang dag pa'i nges pa gzigs nas/ mkhas mchog rnams kyis rgyud rnams 'gyur ba'i dgos pa bsgrub pa'i phyir dang / de dag kun gyi dbang bskur ba dang /sgrub thabs dang / sbyin sreg dang / bdun tshigs dang / rab gnas dang / de dag gi rnam par nges pa dang / rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / zab mo'i man ngag la sogs pa thams cad la rgyal ba rang nyid dpang du byed cing / gzhan yang mkhas pa dang grub pa dag gis mdzad pa'i sngags gzhung rnams kyang mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa dang / ma tshang ba kha bskang bar bya ba dang / 'khrugs pa rnams kyang legs par bsdebs nas gang la 'dod pa'i gdul bya de dang de'i re ba mtha' dag skong ba'i slad du/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung lugs chen po mdo rgyud blta ba'i sgron chen rtsom par 'dun pa'i spro ba dam pas shes rab mchog tu sgrub par mdzad pa na/ bcom ldan 553

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'das ma zhal rnam gnyis(dbyangs can ma dang phag dkar)kyis byin gyis brlabs pa chen po mdzad pa'i tshul ni thog ma nyid nas brjod zin to// zhes (rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 las gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i bka' rtsom la 'jug par bzhed nas shes bya kun la gzigs pa'i tshe nyams snang ci rigs byung ste rdo rje theg pa la sogs pa'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i 'grel pa dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa legs par rtsoms shig ces pa'i gnang ba dang /de nas mtshan gyi rnam grangs su dpal gsang ba byin zhes 'doms par mdzad par grags pa de dag nas‘‘yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams kyi rjes thog tu rtsom par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ yi ge pa nyi shu tsam la rang rang gi gnas mi 'chol bar chu bo chen po dal gyis 'bab pa bzhin du kun tu rtsom pa mdzad pa ni 'jig rten dag na dper bya ba las 'das pa'i rnam par thar pa dpag par dka' ba yin te/ gzhan gyis phal pa'i gnas dag kha ton du byas te bri bar 'tshal ba na yang / yig mkhan gsum tsam la dpod par nus na ni byings ha las pa lta bur bsngags par byed par 'gyur na/tshul 'di ni mchog tu ngo mtshar ba yin no/ ’zhes dang yang‘‘dus zhig gi tshe dben gnas chos ldings su nyid kyi rtsom yig pa dpon yig dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la bka' gnang nas/ rang re yig mkhan dpon g.yog gnyis yi ge su mgyogs shig byed pa yin pas/ khyod rang yang shog bu'i las mang bar gyis/ngas kyang glegs shing gad byas pa mang du bsags yod gsungs/ de nas sang dpon yig dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis nam langs te yi ge mthong 'phral nas sa srod kyi bar la brtson par bris pas gdong ston phyed dang bcu dgu tshar/rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas thugs dam nyi ma shar ba phan la grol bar mdzad nas 554

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/phyag bris kyi dbu btsugs te bar skabs su gsol ba mdzad/de nas dgong mchod kyi tshogs 'khor gyi bar du thugs rtsom dang bstun nas bri bar mdzad pas bde mchog rim pa lnga'i khrid yig chen mo'i gsang ba'i rim pa'i skabs nas glegs shing mda' tshad bcu bzhi'i logs re la yig phreng bco brgyad dang bcu dgu byas pa dang / gdong ston drug gi logs re la yig phreng bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis byas pa nyi shu bri bar tshar te/ de nyid rjes su rtsis btang bas brgyad phreng yod pa'i gdong ston sum cu so phyed dang drug byung ste de'i dgong mo rang re gnyis 'gran pa yin/ gang bris rnams khyer shog gsungs/ dpon yig gis de ltar khyer te gzigs phul bas/ yig mkhan chen mos ni cung mi do bar 'dug ste/ 'on kyang mgyogs po rang yin gsungs bzhad pa dang bcas pas mnyes par snang ngo/ ’zhes(rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 nang gsal ba ltar rje bdag nyid chen po 'dis bka' rtsom dang / rtsom yig 'bri ba'i bya ba dngos la'ang zhugs pa dang bcas bka' rtsom gnang ba'i dpal de nyid 'dus pa zhes bya ba bstan bcos thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po de nyid kyi brjod bya'i gnas dang / gzhung gi tshig ji lta bu snyam na/ (rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉las/ 'di lta ste/'jug pa'i sgo bzhi/ de la yang byis pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ mdo la 'jug pa'i sgo/ sngags la 'jug pa'i sgo/gcig byis pa 'jug pa'i sgo la/ lus kyi bslab pa/ ngag gi bslab pa/yid kyi bslab pa gsum mo/ /lus kyi bslab pa la/ ma la gnas pa'i bslab pa dang / lus btsas pa'i bslab pa'o/ /555
