nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ngag gi bslab pa la/ yi ge klog pa'i bslab pa dang / yi ge 'bri ba'i bslab pa'o/ /yid kyi bslab pa la/ 'jig rten lus kyi bstan bcos dang / brtag pa'i bstan bcos so /lugs kyi bstan bcos la/ rgyal po dang / blon po dang / phal pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos so/ /brtag pa'i bstan bcos la/ nang sems can gyis brtag pa'o/ /gnyis/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo la/ bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/sgra rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ nang rig pa'o/ 'di la bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad do/ /gsum/ mdo la 'jug pa'i sgo la/ bstan pa spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang / khyad par gyi rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /khyad par gyi rnam par bzhag pa la bzhi ste/ bye brag tu smra ba'i de nyid dang / mdo sde pa'i de nyid dang / sems tsam pa'i de nyid dang / dbu ma pa'i de nyid bzhi'o/ 'di rnams la gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas 'chad do//bzhi/ sngags la 'jug pa'i sgo la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang /khyad par gyi rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /khyad par gyi rnam par bzhag pa la bzhi ste/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi de nyid rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi cho ga dang / de'i rnam par nges pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa dang / de'i rnam par nges pa dang / so so'i rgyud bshad pa dang / phyi'i las tshogs dang nang gi sgom rim gyi man ngag rnam 556

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/par bzhag pa rnams kyis 'chad do/ /bstan bcos 'di— la phyi nang gi sgo bzhi/ phyi nang gi gnas lnga/ bshad sgrub rin po che'i gling gi yan lag dang / nye ba'i yan lag brgya phrag can/ phyi rol gyi lo'i zhag gi tshogs rnam par dag pas rim par phye ba sum brgya drug cu/yon tan gyi sgo nas lhag par 'phel ba'i bdag nyid can nang gi rlung nyis khri chig stong drug brgya/ rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi le'u nyis khri chig stong drug brgya pa/ nang gi gnas rtsa sbubs stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi man ngag gi nges par bdun khri nyis stong pa dang /chos kyi phung po thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi chos tshoms brgyad khri bzhi stong pa ste/ glegs bam re re la ldeb lnga mar byas pa'i 'dus pa rgyas pa la glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ 'dus pa 'bring po la glegs bam nyi shu/ 'dus pa bsdus pa la glegs bam gnyis/ shin tu bsdus pa'i snying po la glegs bam chung ngu gcig ste/ 'di dag ni gzhan gyis rtsom pa lta ci smos/ tshar gcig klog par byed pa la yang dka' ba brgya phrag 'dzin par byed do/’’zhes dang / ‘‘de ltar lha'i drin gyis rtsom pa'i thog ma la 'jug pa nyid nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du nag po'i rtsa lag gis bar chad kyi rnam pa ji snyed pa brtsam par gyur kyang /kun tu brdzi bar ma nus nas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pas bla na med pa'i mdzad pa chen po grub pa na/ lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtang rag gi mchod pa chen po'i slad du rgyud sde rin po che 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho ji snyed pa'i bstod chen 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po mdzad de rgyud sde rin po che las ji skad gsungs pa'i lha'i grangs/mtshan/ zhal phyag sogs thams cad gsal bar skye bo thams cad kyis nges 557

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ par 'gyur ba'i gnas mchog tu ya mtshan pa chen po yang yun mi ring ba nyid du grub par mdzad de/ tshul 'di tsam gyis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /’’zhes dang /'dus pa rgya mtshor thos bsam byas pa ste/ /mchog gi gnas la bgrod pa'i gsang ba'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sbas don gsal ba ni/ /rgyud sde rnams kyi nang nas snying por phyung / /zhes bya ba ni/ dpal de kho na nyid 'dus par sbas don na bzhugs pa'i don de dag shin tu bzhugs med/ de ltar na'ang 'dus pa rgya mtshor thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa de ni gcig pu nags kyi nang du glegs bam chung ngu zhig gis tshim par byas te mnyam par dgongs nas/rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi thigs pa sbas don gsal ba zhes bya ba gang gi ming tsam gyis kyang mchog la gzhol ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi lus kyi ba spu g.yo bar nus pa'i gsung gi snying po yang mdzad pa yin no/ /’’zhes〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston na〉 gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos 'chad pa'i tshe na yang / slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba'i sgo nas/ gdul bya rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa/ slob ma dbang po zhi zhing shes rab che ba rnams la tshig brling zhing 'grel legs la don zab cing rgya che ba dang / dbang po brtul zhing blo chung ba rnams la ni tshig bzung sla zhing go bde ba dang rtogs sla zhing rna bar snyan pa/ rgyas par 'dod pa rnams la dka' ba'i gnad gcig la yang bshad pa'i tshul mtha' klas par mdzad pas/ nyin zhag mang po'i bar du gsungs kyang legs 558

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/par bshad pa mi zad pa'i gter du gyur nas/ sngon mnga' ris gung thang du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs pa zhig gi tshe na/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i bshad srol gyi sgo na oṃ ā hūṃ gsum po kho na'i bshad pa la zla ba phyed tsam gyi yun song bar snang zhing / bsdus te 'dod pa dag la ni yun cung zad tsam re'i bar gyi chos thun gcig gis kyang brjod bya'i gnas de'i lus yongs su rdzogs par go nas the tshom gyi dra ba chod par mdzad pa yin te/ sna dkar rtse'i rgyal sa'i gzhi ga la ba der chos kyi bdud rtsi spro ba na/ nyi 'od dbus kyi rgyal khams kyi mkhas pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba(byams gling pa)bdag nyid chen po'i gsung gi bgo skal bzhes pa la phebs te/ dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i lam gyi rim pa las brtsams pa'i gsung chos zab cing rgya che ba du ma gsan/rgyal ba'i gsung rab phyogs mtha' dag gi 'bel ba'i bka' mchid rgya cher spel te bstan pa rin po che la byi dor rgya cher mdzad cing / de dag gi skabs su ja dkar po sbyor gcig gi ring la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa dpal mngon dga'i chos grwar/ de'i sngon tsam du bshad pa mdzad pa la zhag bcu tsam 'gor ba de yongs su rdzogs par tshang ba bde blag tu gsungs shing / mkhas pa chen po de'i thugs la smin par mdzad de/byams pa gling pa chen po'i zhal nas/ bdag la de ring gi bshad pa de ni shin tu yid 'phrog pa byung / ja sbyor gcig gi yun gyi nom pa shin tu che ba yin’’zhes〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉nang gsungs pa dang / thog mar zin bris kyang mdzad pa la dpal de nyid 'dus pa'i nang yod pa mkhyen pas da zin bris kyi dgos pa mi 'dug gsungs nas ma mdzad/559

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dbus gtsang du phebs pa'i dus su dad can rnams kyis phul ba'i dngos po chud mi za ba dang / lhag par ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' drin gsab pa'i slad du sku rten du gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje yab yum zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa mi tshad tsam phra rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / gsung rten du mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dpal yongs su 'dus pa yongs su rdzogs par grub pa/ thugs rten du tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa po ji snyed byung ba'i mthun rkyen na mar sbyar ba dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa'i ye shes kyi mchod rten chen po thig tshad phyed dang lnga tsam pa'i bre dang /bum ril/ thog tshad so so dang bcas par rgyud sde bzhi'i bla rgyud dang / kyai rdor/dus 'khor/ bde mchog sogs rgyud sde'i lha tshogs/ mdo sde las bshad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sogs mdor na dpal kyai rdo rje nas gzhi bdag srung ma'i bar gyi sku rnams kun tu rnam par bkra ba'i tshon bzang zhing gser gyis brgyan pa/ mgur chu rnams dang / gdugs dang rdo rje rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa gser zangs can dang / dpal de nyid 'dus par gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad ri mor 'bri bar dgongs nas sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs rim bzhin bzhengs pa'i thang sku lnga brgya tsam dang rgyud so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi blos bslangs du ma dang / de dag gi nang du ji ltar 'dod pa'i sgrub mchod byed dus spyan drangs chog pa'i de nyid 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad sku par du btab nas rnam par bkra ba'i tshon gyis brgyan te yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'bur du dod pa shin tu mang ba blo'i yul las 'das pa legs par bzhengs shing /bdag nyid chen pos phyag gnas mdzad pa bcas sku gsung thugs rten gsar 560

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzhengs kyi mdzad pa yang shin tu rgya che ba mdzad pa nyid do/ /bcu pa/ dge ba'i bathes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba'i skor/kun tu dul ba'i tshul khrims phung po'i sku/ /zab rgyas smra la rtag par dgyes pa'i gsung / / zhi ba mchog la mnyam par gzhag pa'i thugs/ /'di ni thar 'dod rnams kyi bsten bya'i mgon/ /zhes gsungs pa ni gong du zhus pa'i rnam par thar pa nas kyang mtshon par nus so/ /bcu gcig pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i skor/dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon gyi/ /skyon rnams ma lus yongs su spangs gyur zhing / /yon tan thams cad kun tu nyid la rdzogs/ /mchog tu grub pa'i ngo mtshar spyod par ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mchog tu grub pa'i ngo mtshar gyi spyod pa lhur bzhes pa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba thun mong gi spyod yul min pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag pa zhib par mkhyen 'dod na〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 la gzigs par 'tshal/bcu gnyis pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i mdzad pa/ mya ngan las ma 'da' ba'i lo bzhi'i gong stag lung thang pa ngag dbang grags pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'jam dpal grags/ h+yeng du chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la 561

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sogs pa'i dbus kyi zhal slob rnams kyis dbus phyogs 'dus pa rin po che'i chos skor bskor bar spyan 'dren pa'i rtsol ba yang nas yang du lhur len par mdzad par/ ‘ da ni lang tsho'i dpal thams cad nub/ nad drag pos gzir/lo'i rtse mor son/ nam 'chi kha ma 'di lta bu la dbus phyogs su phyin kyang dgos pa cher med/’ces(rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 nang gsungs pa ltar zhal gyis ma bzhes par sku gsung thugs rten bzheng ma grub pa rnams bzhengs pa dang / gsung rtsom ma grub pa rnams rtsol ba chen pos mdzad pa dang / gdul bya de dang de dag gi mos blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos char ci dgar 'bebs pa'i mur dgung lo bdun cu don drug pa lcags lug 1451zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu'i tho rengs sngar tshor ma myong ba'i bya'i skad snyan pa sgrogs par gyur pa na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gis dge bshes 'od bzang la/ 'od bzang khyod kyis bya'i skad de e tshor gsungs thos la zhus pas/da myur du 'gro/ 'od bzang dbang med mig nas mchi ma blags te/ de spyan gyis gzigs nas 'di ni ngu bar bya ba'i gnas ma yin gyi/ spro ba dam pas mdzad pa thams cad kyi rtse mor son pa yin no gsungs/ de nas gsung gi tha ma ni/ gnam gang gi nyin thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gis/ bla ma gzhan dag 'od gsal zhes 'dod pa de ni zhi gnas la gtan pa cung zad thob pa'i gang zag gis/ rlung sems dbu mar bsdus nas bde snang cung zad cig la sems chags pa brag phug 'od gsal zer bas/ 'od gsal rnal mar mi 'dod/ kho bo 'gro dus ni skad cig gcig la lam rim sngon du byed pa yin gsungs/ de nas nga'i rus pa lcog phur 'jog pa'i ni mi rigs/ kho bo de ring thegs pa'i nangs par snga dro rus pa la me chug cig mer sbyangs pa'i dud pa 562

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/tsam gyis kyang sems can tshad med pa la phan pa yin gsungs te/ nam du yang sems can gyi don las ma g.yos bzhin du gsung gi tha ma de gnang zhes(rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 nang gsal ba ltar sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ /gang gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang ba de dag re res kyang bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel ba'i bya bar mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod pa re re bzhin bri bar mi langs bas thog mar slob ma'i tshogs kyi sdom tshig dang / mtshan la ji ltar zhu ba tsam 'bri bar bya ba la/bzo rig nas bzung yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar/ /de dang de yi bka' babs nyi shu gsum/ /'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ /rnam dag 'khon gyi gdung rgyud rnam pa gsum/ /rigs sngags 'chang gi khyu mchog chen po gcig /nyi ma zla ba ltar grags mkhas grub gnyis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig lo chen gsum/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen drug /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs mkhas pa bcu gsum dang / /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdan sa gnyis/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan bcu drug dang / /mtshan nyid rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen bzhi/ /sngags gzhung rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa gnyis/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /563

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/drag po'i brtul zhugs rdzogs pa'i sngags 'chang gnyis/ /bka' bcu legs par smra ba stong phrag gcig /bka' bzhi kun tu smra ba stong phrag zung / /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma khri phrag brgal/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub chen lnga bcur ldan/ /lhag par rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /sa la dge slong ma yis rab grags pa/ /sprul pa'i gar gyi gsang ba 'dzin par mdzad/ /ces〈rnam thar ngo mtshar dga' ston〉 las gsungs pa ltar gyi slob ma'i mtshan ni/bka' babs nyi shu rtsa gsum ni/ ri mo khyad par gyi bka' babs pir thog rgyal po bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ gso ba rig pa'i bka' babs byang bdag rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po/ snyan dngags kyi bka' babs ngam ring bka' bcu pa dpal ldan bzang po/ tha snyad gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i bka' babs e'i bka' bcu pa chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang / tshad ma'i rig gnas kyi bka' babs stag lung ka bzhi pa bla chen mañju shrī/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bka' babs gung thang dpal ldan seng ge/ mngon pa kun btus kyi bka' babs gsang phu ba bzod pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ phar phyin gyi bka' babs gung thang pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog mi pham gzhung lnga'i bka' babs sa skya bka' bcu pa mchog gi blo gros/ dbu ma'i bka' babs ka bzhi pa shes rab mgon po/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bka' babs sa skya pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'chad pas thub pa'i 564

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bka' rbebs dmar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ rtsod pa'i bka' babs shel dkar thugs rje dpal/ rtsom pa'i bka' babs rtsed thang pa paṇa chen bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba/ mchog tu btsun pa'i bka' babs khab gung thang pa ma ti bi dza ya/ 'byor pa'i phung por sred pa cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad pa'i bka' babs rgyal khams kyi spong ba pa chen po yon tan seng ge/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i bka' babs rtsed thang pa thel gyi mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sgeg pa rdo rje'i gar gyi bka' babs bo dong pa dar ma seng ge sde snod gsum gyi bka' babs shel dkar ba sde snod gsum pa dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bka' babs stag lung thang pa chen po ka drug pa ngag dbang grags pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs nyid kyi dbon po glang 'khor rin po che ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/de nyid 'dus pa'i bka' babs shel dkar ba bdag nyid chen po grags pa rnams so/ /'khon gyi gdung rgyud gsum ni/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ de'i sras slob dpon chen po grags pa rdo rje/ theg chen chos rje'i dbon po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'o/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba gcig pu ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/nyi zla ltar grags pa'i mkhas pa gnyis ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po/ dpang lo'i sku skye blo gros brtan pa'o/ /'jig rten mig gsum ni/ e'i lo tsā ba chen po bsod nams bzang po/lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba chen po thugs rje dpal lo/ /565

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyog—sa btus/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mkhas pa drug ni/ bo dong stag sde'i chen po dol pa rgyal mtshan/ spyi bo lhas kyi mkhan po bshes gnyen nyi ma/ rtsed thang pa chos kyi grags pa/ gsang phu bka' bcu pa pad+ma bzang po/ bstan pa'i nyi ma snar thang pa dge 'dun grub/ chos 'khor sgang pa'i mkhan chen bka' bcu pa shes rab rin chen no/ / mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa bcu gsum ni/ bo dong rta ra'i chen po rin po che chos bzang pa/ dol pa rgyal bzang / bo dong grang mo che'i chen po rgyal grags pa/ grang mo che'i chen po shes rab grags/ stag sde pa shes rab dpal/ sgro mon can gyi bla ma kun dpal/ bo dong rta ra ba'i chen po 'jam dkar/ bo dong grang mo chen po seng ge rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon chos kyi nyi ma/gsang phu ba chos rje rong chung shes rab dpal/ dka' bcu pa rat+na shrī/ rje nyid kyi dbon po shel dkar mkhan chen rje btsun pa/ ngam ring rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge rnams so/ /shākya shrī'i gdan sa pa gnyis ni/ tshogs chen pa'i mkhan chen don grub dpal 'byor/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen mkhas pa chen po seng ge dpal lo/ /gtsug rgyan bcu drug ni/ glang 'khor chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa ba mkhan chen nam mkha' rin chen/ de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po mkhan chen 'jigs med grags pa/ yang de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po mkhan chen bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ngam ring pa mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs/ yang de'i mkhan po dkon khang pa nyi ma/ mngon dga'i chos dpon 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs pa dang / de'i 566

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mkhan chen rgyal mtshan blo gros/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po dkon mchog bzang po/ byams chen mkhan po'i sku skye/ 'jims kyi mkhan po bkra shis rin chen/ mkhan chen lha'i rgyal po/ mthu stobs dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i gdan sa ba 'phags pa nam snying /'dar mkhan chen bde legs rgyal mtshan/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i gzhi'i mkhan po byang chub ldan rnams so/ /mtshan nyid rab 'byams smra ba bzhi ni/ gsang phu ba go bo rab 'byams/shel dkar ba gzhon rgyal/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/mnga' ris pa nam mkha' bsod nams bcas so/ /sngags rab 'byams pa gnyis ni/ shab lhun rtse ba kun mkhyen 'phags 'od dang / rmog lcogs gdan sa ba mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'o//sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bzhi ni/ shrī jo gdan pa ras chen gzhon nu dpal/ chos rje brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ la phyi ba chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ yar 'brog rgya mtsho'i gling gi ma grub pa'i rgyal mo bsod nams 'dzoms bcas so /sngags 'chang drag po gnyis ni/ ngam ring gi a n+tan dang / gung thang gi bla chen chos dpal bzang pa'o/ /bka' bcu pa stong phrag gcig ni/ dpal ldan sa skya bsod nams blo gros dang / ngam ring zangs phug dbon po la sogs pa'o/ /bka' bzhi pa stong phrag zung ni/ 'bras spungs pa bla ma mus drad bka' bzhi pa/ tshogs chen bka' bzhi pa byang chub seng ge sogs so/ /phar tshad shes pa khri phrag brgal ba ni/ bod kyi bshes gnyen phal mo che'o//567

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/grub chen lnga bcu ni/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag thams cad las phul du gyur pa gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa ni/gangs ri'i khrod kyi dge slong ma thams cad kyi dpyid kyi dpal du gyur cing /sngon dpal phag mo gru pa chen po'i 'phrin las skong ba la phag ces bya ba'i lung par skye ba bzhes shing / deng gi tshe na dpal thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las skyong ba la dgyes pas/ btsan po lha sras kyi khab tu sku 'khrungs pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo a ce chos kyi sgron me bya ba/ sngon o rgyan sprul pa'i gnas su dpal in+d+ra bhu ti'i lcam mo dpal mo dang / slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha ba'i rigs ma lha lcam mar+ghaṃ ra ba dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di'i zhabs pad brten pa la ni chos kyi sgron me zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor dbang mo dpal rdo rje phag mo nyid yin no/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang /gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs 'dir bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi srol rgyun bzang po cha tshang ba dar zhing rgyas pa'i byed po gangs can mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug skyes rtse mor zhabs sen yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od rab phyogs brgyar 'phro ba/ snyan pa'i grags pa'i ba dan dkar po rab yangs nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i rgyan mchog dam par gyur pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba mtshan mchog don ldan gyi bdag nyid kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rlabs po che'i mdzad pa dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang /568

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa zab cing yangs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po rang blo'i 'jug pa spyil chung gi rgya las 'da' mi phod pa nyams zhan mchil pa'i gshog rlabs kyis ji bzhin min na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus la sogs pa lo rgyus kyi yig tshang du 'khod pa dag las mkhyen par 'tshal zhes zhu ba las 'os ci yod/ 'on kyang da lam bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bod kyi rig gnas la sman pa'i ched tshad ma rigs gter dpe skrun gnang skabs kho bor dpe sgrig zhu dgos pa'i gsung nan bzhin dpe sgrig zhu ba dang chabs cig mdzad pa po'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus shig bstan bcos mdzad pa po'i che ba mtshon pa dang /bstan bcos 'di dag shin tu gal che ba'i nges pa 'dren slad ji ltar rgya mtsho che las chu thigs bzhin bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mdzad pa las 'khrungs 'das sogs mdzad pa'i lo tshigs dang / bod du tshad ma rig pa sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi srol rgyun bzang po cha tshang ba gsar du btod pa'i mdzad pa mdor bsdus shig mtshams sbyor zhu rgyur/dang po/ 'khrungs 'das sogs kyi lo tshigs/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ 'khon zhes bya ba'i gdung rgyud thog mar ji ltar byung ba'i skor la lo rgyus shin tu rgyas pa gleng du yod pa bod rje mi bu gdung drug gi nang tshan sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud yab dpal chen 'od po dang / yum ma gcig gar phu ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag(1182)lor ngo mtshar ba'i bltas dang bcas sku bltams shing / gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mtshan la dpal ldan don grub dang / de rjes rang gi khu bo sa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' 569

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gsol/dgung lo nyer lnga pa me stag(1206)lor kha che paṇa chen shākya shrīs mkhan po dang / spyi bo lhas pas slob dpon/ zhu phrang pas gsang ston mdzad de zha lu rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs cig car du mdzad/dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa 'brug(1208)lor tshad ma'i bstan bcos chen po tshad ma rigs pa'i gter dang / de'i 'grel pa 'di dag rim par mdzad/dgung lo sum cu so lnga me byi(1216)lo nas dgung lo re dgu pa lcags phag(1251)lo bar lo ngo sum cu so lnga'i ring sa skya'i gdan sa dngos su skyong ba dang / mtshan 'dzin mdzad/dgung lo lnga bcu nga dgu rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags byi(1240)lor mang yul gyi 'phags pa wa ti'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dab rol gyi tshong 'dus su 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs mu stegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rtsod pas pham par mdzad pa dang / de'i dus kyi yas mas su legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i skad grags can gyi legs bshad de yang mdzad/dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug(124sulor hor go dan rgyal pos gdan zhus ltar ma hā tsi na'i yul grur chibs bsgyur skabs phebs lam la lo gsum 'gor te dgung lo drug cu re drug pa me lug(1247)lor byang ngos su go dan dang mjal 'dzoms byung /dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag(1251)lor byang ngos sprul pa'i sder gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa bcas so/ /570

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/gnyis pa/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la gsan bsam dang / de dag rgya cher spel ba'i skor/ thog mar rang gi yab dpal chen 'od po las kyai rdor gyi dbang nod pa de nas paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / paṇ+ḍi ta saṅga shrī/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ slob dpon thar pa'i 'byung gnas la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te yi ge'i bye brag du ma dang /sgra dang / tshad ma la sogs pa nas rim par rig pa'i gnas spyi dang bye brag la thos pa rgya cher mdzad de rang nyid mkhas pa'i rtse mor son pa'i tshul yang / rje nyid kyi gsung las/sgra pa nga yin rtog ge pa dang smra ba ngan 'jom nga 'dra med//sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga //dus sbyor ngas shes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga //'di 'dra gang yin sa skya pa ste mkhas pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/zhes phyis 'byung gi mkhas pa'i ming 'dzin pa dag kyang don dam pa'i mkhas pa'i bya bar 'jug pa dang / blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs kyang 'di lta bu'i mkhas pa chen por gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i spro ba 'phel ba'i slad du thugs brtse bas gsungs pa ltar yin/de yang / sgra rig par gsan bsam dang / de dag rgya cher spel ba'i skor/sa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas sgra'i gnas brgyad smra sgo la sogs pa dang / kha che paṇa chen nas sgra ka tsan gyi snying po bsdu ba la sogs pa'i sgra mdo/nub phyogs a ti wa nar sku 'khrungs pa'i bram ze'i slob dpon su ga ta shrī dpal ldan sa skyar spyan drangs nas lo gnyis kyi bar du sgra ka lā pa dang / de'i 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po saṅga shrī la tsan+d+ra pa la sogs pa 571

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gsan bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad de sgra la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad/ smra sgo'i don bsdu/ yi ge'i sbyor ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang po bka' rtsom gnang nas bod du sgra rig pa'i srol legs par btod pa'i tshul la bdag nyid chen po 'di'i slob rgyud dpal khang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bstod par/in+d+ra pā ni byā kar cha bsags sogs/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho de nyid skad cig la/ /gzigs tshe brda sprod byed pa sarba dzha/ /skabs gsum bla ma'i stan las babs sam snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/tshad ma rig pa'i skor/ phya pa chos seng gi dngos slob seng ge'i mtshan can brgyad kyi nang tshan rma bya rtsod pa'i seng ge dang / slob dpon thar pa'i 'byung gnas/ kha che paṇa chen sogs las sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa/gzegs zan gyis sbyar ba'i rtog ge'i bstan bcos rig pa la sogs pa phyi nang tshad ma'i gzhung lugs mang po thugs su chud pa'i gsan bsam mdzad de tshad ma'i bstan bcos chen po sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa 'grel 'di gnyis bka' rtsom dang / de dag gi 'chad nyan rgya cher spel ba'i tshul la/ bstod par/tshad ma gsum gyis gnas gsum gzhal bya'i don/ /ma lus rtogs pas sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom tshar gcod par/ /sde bdun mdzad pa'i blo bdun khyod kyi mtshan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/572

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzo rig pa'i skor/ 'phags bod mkhas grub du ma'i gsung bcud legs par myangs te ri mo dang sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang / cha tshad la sogs pa mdo rgyud kyi lus dang mthun pa dang / brtag pa rnam pa brgyad kyang ji bzhin thugs su chud de sku gzugs kyi bstan bcos dang / sa brtag pa'i rab byed sogs gsung rtsom mang po mdzad pa ma zad/ phyag len dngos la'ang sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku gzugs bdag nyid chen po 'dis phyag bstar nas bskrun pa bzo rig pa'i mkhas pa'i sor rtses kyang bskrun mi nus pa'i ngo mtshar can la sogs pa skye bo rnams kyi mig gi longs spyod kyi yul du gyur pa la sogs pa bzo rig pa dang rgya cher spel ba'i tshul la/ bstod par/ lus ngag yid kyi bzo dang mchog phal gyi/ /gzugs brnyan bskrun la tshad dang 'phrul gyi dbyibs/ /sna tshogs byed po las tshul mtshar sdug gi/ /tshon brgya 'dren pa dpyod ldan dga' ba'i gnyen/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/gso ba rig pa'i skor/ phyi nang gi gzhung lugs du ma dang / lhag par yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po 'grel pa zla zer dang bcas pa gsan bsam gyis legs par thugs su chud nas de dag gi don legs par ston pa ste/ dang po nad mi 'byung bar bya ba dang / byung ba phyir bcos pa/ bcos nas slar mi ldog pa'i thabs ston pa'i gzhung bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa'i don bsdu bka' rtsom mdzad de 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi nad zhi bar byed pa la sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos slar gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 573

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa lta bu'i mdzad pa bstan par/ bstod pa las/ma rig rtsa ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i gnyen po tshe'i rig byed/ /thar pa'i 'tsho srog bsrung ba'i thabs tshul ston/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa de 'dra gzhan gyis min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/nang rig pa'i skor/ 'phags bod kyi bla ma du ma bsten te sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde'i skor la thos pa rgya cher mdzad de nang rig pa'i bstan bcos kyang thub pa dgongs gsal/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ sems bskyed chen mo lung sbyor dang bcas pa/ grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag la sogs pa'i gsung rtsom ches mang po mdzad de mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya cher spel ba'i mdzad par/ bstod pa las/yongs 'du'i tshal du kurdzi da ra dang / /'od ldan tshogs pa'i nang na nyin byed ltar/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i khrod na thams cad mkhyen/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa sngon dang phyi mthar su/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/de bzhin rig gnas chung ba lnga'i skor/ snyan ngag la/ sa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan la skyes rabs so bzhi pa la sogs pa'i skyes rabs du ma dang /paṇ+ḍi ta saṅgashrī la snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dang / rgyan gyi bstan bcos sogs mang po gsan cing / lhag par daṇ+ḍi'i tshig rgyan la mkhas par mdzad nas mkhas pa'i kha rgyan dang / tshig rgyan gyi brjod don bsdus pa'i tshul gyi mkhas pa 574

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'jug pa'i sgo la sogs pa'i gsung rtsom mang po mdzad de snyan ngag gi srol rgya cher spel ba'i mdzad par/ bstod pa las/dbyangs can lang tsho zag zad ye shes kyi/ /rtse dgas thugs yid gcugs pa'i seng ge rtsen/ /tshig rgyan bal la ki ste sna'i rol sgras/ /yid bsgyur khams gsum dbugs 'byin snyan ngag mkhan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/mngon brjod skor/ mkhas pa chen po dge 'dun dpal las mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod dang / sna tshogs gsal ba'i 'grel pa sogs kyi yi ge re re'i mngon par brjod pa'i don rnams zhib cing phra bar gsan bsam gyis sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i ming gi tshogs mtha' yas pa dang / de dag kyang 'dod rgyal dang / rjes sgrub kyi dbye ba gsal por phye zhing /bkas bcad thog mtha' bar gsum las byung ba'i brda gsar rnying gi bye brag dang / rtags gsum gyi rnam dbye legs par phye ba'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos chen po tshig gi gter bka' rtsom mdzad de rig pa'i gnas 'di'i srol ches cher btod pa'i mdzad par/ bstod pa las/ting sub mtha' dang rtags kyi rnam dbye sogs/ /so sor ma 'dres sna tshogs mngon brjod dag /'chad mkhas mtha' yas ming la ma rmongs pas /'chi med seng ge'i khengs pa thung ngur mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags/sdeb sbyor gyi skor/ paṇ+ḍi ta saṅga shrī'i la dmar ser dang rgyal ba'i lhas 575

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung dang / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa gsan bsam legs par gnang ste sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po bka' rtsom gyis sdeb sbyor gyi srol rgya cher btod pa'i mdzad par/ bstod pa las/dmar ser rgyal lha'i lugs las khyad par du/ /yon tan brgyad kyis 'phags pa'i sdeb sbyor gzhung / /brit+ta dzā ti'i ngo mtshar rtogs byed la/ /zhi ba'i zhabs dang khyod blo thun mong gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags/skar rtsis skor/ sa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs las dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor yang nas yang du gsan sbyongs kyis rtsis kyi lo zla dag pa/ lnga bsdus/sgra gcan/ gza' lnga/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin/ du mjug 'char nub dang /dbyangs 'char la sogs pa rtsis kyi cha lag tshang ba thugs su chud nas gzhan la rgya cher spel ba'i mdzad par/ bstod pa las/rtsis grangs rig pa kun rdzob rten 'brel che/ /za 'og ltar gzigs srid pa'i ā dar+sha/ /dkar nag rtsis la byang ba'i rnam rig gi /gtsug lag rgya mtsho ri byi'i khyor chu bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/zlos gar gyi skor/ paṇ+ḍi ta saṅga shrī las gzugs kyi nyi ma'i bstan bcos dang / bha ra ta la sogs pa mthar phyin pa gsan bsam gyis zlos gar rab dga'i 'jug pa dang / de'i rol mo dbyangs 'dren pa'i phyogs tsam ston pa rol mo'i bstan bcoh+phu bka' rtsom gnang ste de dag rgya cher spel ba'i mdzad 576

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/par/ bstod pa las/sngon byung zlos pa'i gar de skad rigs bzhi/ /brda sbyor la byang rgya mtsho'i mtha' la sogs/ /mthar phyin thugs chud zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /sgra skad kun gyis khyod la lung du ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so/ /de ltar rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i skor gsan bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad de de dag rgya cher spel ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che las gsal por mthong thub pa ni bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa ma byon gong bod du rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol cha tshang ba ma dar ba bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thugs rjer brten nas cha tshang dar thub pa'i bka' drin ni nam yang gzhal dka'i yul du mchis pas nga tshos khong gi mdzad rjes la ches cher bstod pa dang / khong gi thugs bcud las byung ba'i gzhung lugs rgya mtshor thos bsam mthar phyin pa byas te bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas phul du byung ba rnams ji srid bar mi nub par de dag rgya cher 'phel ba'i thabs la 'bad brtson gnang dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam par sems so/ /kun gzigs lnga pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs/sngon tshe za hor yangs pa'i sa/ /stobs 'byor dpung pas dbang sgyur ba/ /577

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtsug lag 'dzin zhes grags pa'i rnga/ /srid pa'i bla nas brdung ba byung / /de rigs ma dros mtsho chen las/ /gyes pa za hor rgyal po'i rgyud/ /legs byas gser gyi yur ba las /skye rgu'i zhing sar rim par drangs/ /mthar ni bdud 'dul rab brtan zhes/ /'phyongs rgyas phying bar stag rtse'i bdag /gang des skye bo kun dga' zhing / /lha las mdzes pa'i dpal mor rtsen/ /yab yum bsod nams 'bum phrag gis/ /bskrun pa skye rgu'i 'dren pa mchog /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /me mo sbrul (1617)lor mtshan dpe bzhad/ /'khrungs tsam nyid nas chos ston gyi/ /phyag rgya la sogs chen po'i tshul/ /'gro ba'i 'dren byed dga' ston du/ /mngon par thob la cis mi dad/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mchog sprul du/ /snang mtha'i mgon pos(blo bzang chos rgyan)dbang bskur tshe/ /jo bo rje sogs lha bla ma/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug por grol/ /578

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/de tshe dbus gtsang 'thab mo'i me/ /sku yi nyer 'tsher gyur dogs nas/ /snang mtha'i mgon po'i bka'i dbyu gus/ /gtsang pa'i rnga chen bskul byas nas/ /dgung grangs drug pa chu pho khyir/ /dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa yi/ /dga' ba brgya ldan pho brang gi /gser khrir zhabs sen re kha bkod/ /sngon gyi dam bca' mi 'gyur rdo ba yi/ /ri mo'i mdzes pa slar yang gsal ba'i slad/ /snang mtha'i mgon po rigs kyi cod pan du/ /bkur nas rab byung dngos po lhur bzhes mdzad/ /de nas mkhas grub du ma yi/ /zhabs rdul spyi bor bkod mdzad nas/ /mdo sngags chos tshul dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /thugs mchog rgya mtsho'i klong du bskyil/ /gnyis lhag nyi shu'i bgrang gzhi'i lor/ /rgyal ba nyi ma'i mdun sa cher/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa bdag gir bzung / /re zhig sa gzhi skyong ba yi/ /dregs pa lhun po'i rtser 'dzeg pa/ /579

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtsang stod rgyal po'i mnga' thang kun/ /yud kyis stong pa'i dbyings su thim/ /de tshe gu shrī'i dar dkar gyis/ /bod khams gnam sa kun bcings pa'i/ /gzi brjid ma bzod brgya byin yang / /sa blar bros sam 'phyang mo nyug /mang mang dpung gis phas rgol 'joms yang nyung nyung gtso bo kho na tshar gcod las la brtson/ /chem chem 'od 'phro rno dbal mtshon gyis nag nag mgo bo dum bur bcad pas phas rgol 'gems/ /brjid brjid che rgu'i phyag gi yul yang gus gus dang bas zhabs pad spyi bor bkod dang lhan/ /dkar dkar gangs ris bskor ba'i zhing bcas snum snum snyim pas rnam 'dren mchog gi phyag char phul/ /de tshe pho brang bsam grub rtser/ /mnyan yod grong du gsal rgyal gyis/ /thub mchog bsnyen pa'i tshems shing 'bras/ /phan bde'i nyer 'tshor thob bzhin gyur/ /ring nas thugs bskyed nor bu'i yu ba can/ /'phrin las gser gdugs bla na 'khor ba yi/ /grib bsil snum por spyod pa'i skye 'gro rnams/ /lha bas lhag ces skabs gsum pa rnams gleng / /580

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/de nas dus kyi 'khor lo ches /zla ba'i phreng ba bcu bskor rjes/ /dal 'gro'i bu mos yid 'ong 'brug /khab tu bsu ba'i lo de la/ /gnam bskos gong ma hrun kri yi/ /spyan 'dren rta bdun gyis bskul bas/ /pe cin gser gyi rgyal khab cher/ /mgon po'i zhabs sen mngon par bkod/ /de tshe gong ma'i nyi ma dang / /lnga pa'i zla ba gdan 'dzoms pa/ /gcig la gcig 'phro'i 'od zer ni/ /phan tshun dgyes pa'i 'dzum bzhin gsal/ /gong nas nub kyi lha gnas ches dge ba/ /bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' yi lung / /gnam 'og skye 'gro'i bstan pa gcig tu gyur/ /'gyur med rdo rje 'chang dbang rgya mtsho'i bla/ /zhes pa rgya bod hor gsum gyi/ /yi ger bris pa'i gser tham bcas/ /'jam dbyangs gong mas nub phyogs kyi/ /'dren pa chen por mnga' gsol te/ /dga' ba brgya ldan pho brang pa'i/ /srid 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / /581

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ris med bstan 'gro'i don chen gyi/ /mdzad pa nam mkha'i mtha' la bcas/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i sa chen po/ /gzhal la khyab 'jug gom chen yang / /'phye bo'i 'gros ltar gzigs pa des/ /bstan bcos gaṅgā'i rdul ltar mdzad/ /lhag par gser mdog cod pan gyi/ /ring lugs bla mthor 'degs pa'i slad/ /gling chen bcu gsum chos kyi grwa / bstod pas khyad par 'phags pa mdzad/ /de ltar bstan 'gro'i don chen gyi/ /mdzad pas sku ni ngal gyur pa/ / re zhig zhi ba'i dbyings nyid du/ /mnal ba'i dgongs pa la zhugs te/ /sras kyi thu bo sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gang dang dbyer med lugs zung byed por dbang bskur ba'i/ / 'od 'bar phyag rgya bka' yi glegs bu yongs la dril bsgrags de yi grags pa gsal ba dang / /re zhig zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i don gang ci ltar gsang rgya'i blang dor ma lus nyer bstan nas/ /drug lhag drug cu'i dgung ldan chu khyir(1682)'dren pa mchog de'i gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus/ /582

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/de yi tshul mthong lha mi gdung ba'i khur/ /rab lcis 'dzin ma rgya mtshor bying dogs nas/ /re zhig gsang rgyas mi dbang mthon po'i lha/ /yan lag lnga par gyur pa gcig pus blangs/ /mgon po mchog kyang sngar gyi dam bca'i don/ /slar yang dran nas mchog sprul srid pa'i mig /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /skal bzang shar ri'i spo la mngon par 'phags/ /de tshe skyes bus ma bgros mgrin gcig gis/ /nyin byed chu lhar mnal ba ma mthong bar/ /slar yang shar ri'i rtse la rab shar ba/ /mngon par mthong zhes mi dbang de la bstod/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig mchod sdong che/'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du bskrun pa dang /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur po ta la/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du rdzogs par bskrun/ /legs par smras so gangs can mgon/ /lnga pa chen po'i rlabs chen gyi/ /mdzad pa'i nang nas cha shas tsam/ /gang gi bka' drin gso phyir ro/ /zhes pa yang gus pa chen pos sbyar ba 'o/ /smras pa/583

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rab dkar gangs ris bskor ba'i zhing mchog 'di'i/ /rab mang bgrang bya'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar can/ /rab gsal nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i don/ /rab 'byams cig car ston pa'i deb ther che/ /rnam kun mchog ldan blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /rnam 'dren dgongs pa'i 'o mtshor 'khrungs pa yi/ /rnam bkra'i lang tshor dbang 'byor dpal mo 'di/ /rnam kun dga' mar thob pa'i ngo mtshar rmad/ /de phyir bgrang bya'i khur gyis lci yang blo gros shes bya'i lang tsho phra/ /nor bu'i khang pa gsar par gnas kyang rig pa'i nor gyis ma phyug pa/ /o rgyan chos 'phel ming gis mtshan yang 'jig rten srog las gces 'dzin pas/ /yang yang dpyad pa sngon du btang nas rgya cher 'grel la gcig tu brtson//de ltar 'bad pa'i ngo mtshar snang ba'i zla ba 'di la ra ri'i cha/ /gal te 'di ni nyi ma yin na 'dren pa'i shing rta mi mnyam skyon/gal te 'di ni pad+ma yin na 'dam las skyes pa'i 'byung khungs dman/ /gal te 'di ni sa snying yin na btso yis ma sbyangs g.ya' yi dri/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa yi/ /nyes pa gang mchis mkhas rnams spyan sngar bshags/ /cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dge ba 'di/ /gangs can rig pa'i gsos su smin gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang nor brang o rgyan zhes bgyi bas dad pa'i spu long g.yo 584

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzhin du〈bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi 'grel pa yid kyi dga' ston〉 brtsams pa'i mjug byang smon tshig tu bris pa dge legs 'phel/mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus ngo mtshar gzigs mo/gzhung lugs mang thos klu sgrub dgongs pa'i bcud/ /thugs kyi rgya mtshor bskyil las nyer thon pa/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i zegs mas gangs can gyi/ /rig pa'i sa mos bzhad mdzad des skyongs shig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis skabs phye nas gleng bar bya ba 'di lta ste/de yang mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ni/yab rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa gnyag gi rigs las byung zhing / la stod byang pa bdag po'i gser dpon gyi 'khur bzhes pa lnga dar dang / yum sems ma rgyal 'dzom gnyis la sras snga bu lnga dang / phyis bu gcig yod pa'i snga bu lnga'i tha chung du rab byung dgu pa'i chu bo lug(1523)lo zang zang byang brgyud 'brong zhes bya ba'i yul gru'i nang tshan shel lung du sku bltams shing / lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs yum gyi mnal lam du sbrul dkar po chung ngu zhig mal du zhugs pa rmis pas phu bo rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig yod pa des mtshan la yum gyi mnal ltas dang bcas klu rgyal nor bu zhes bya bar gsol/gzhon nu'i rol rtsed kyi skabs sho dang / mig mangs sogs la mi dgyes pa 'phongs skyen rol rtsed kyi 'jug par spro bas rang gi phu bos kyang 'phong rtsal 585

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/skyen pa'i gras su 'dren pa dang / yab kyi 'phong skyen lta bu yong zhes gleng ba/gzhan yang chos la 'dun pa che ba'i rnam pa sku rtsed kyi skabs gnas khang lcog bu dang / glegs bam chung ngu dngos sam/ tha na g.yam pa srab po la glegs bam bcos nas 'chang ba dang / phur ba sogs mdzad/chos la 'jug pa'i sad skyen ni/ thengs gcig dkar gur yangs po zhig gi dbus su rten dang / mchod pa mchod me bshams pa'i g.yon phyogs su yab dang / g.yas phyogs su sku mched bzhi rim bzhin gzim pa'i dgong gcig khong dang dkar me thag ring yang spyi gtsug gi dbu skra la dkar me lhab 'bar byung ba yab kyis gzigs nas bu 'di skra gcod pa 'thad pa 'dug ces gsungs pa nye ba'i rkyen du snang /dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i skabs/ khong sku mched bzhi 'brog sa nas bod sar phebs te gcung mdo spe chos sder zla ba bzhi tsam bzhugs nas de khul gyi dgon gnas khag la mchod mjal sogs mdzad rjes gcen po gsum rang yul 'brog sar phebs rung / khong sku rkyang ma mi zug pa dang / thugs phreng ba'i rnam pa med pa der mu mthud bzhugs shing / lo phyi ma'i dpyid ka shar skabs chos 'khor gling nas 'jam mgon phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis chibs bsu dang bcas chos 'khor gling du gdan drangs te 'jam mgon bla ma dang mjal ba yongs 'dzin du bsten nas bshad gsar gyi gzhung 'dzin dang / sa gzhung ngo sprod sbyor ba sogs kyi dbu tshugs shing / de skabs tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi snga gzhung phyi gzhung kun thugs 'dzin grub/dgung lo bco lnga pa me bya(1537)lo lcags thang rab 'byams pa byams pa bsod nams kyis mkhan po dang / paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis kyis slob 586

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dpon mdzad de mnyan yod bya gshongs su snga ma rab tu byung zhing / mtshan skya bo'i skabs klu rgyal nor bu zhu ba'i klu de chad na mi 'grig ces klu sgrub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gsol/dgung lo nyi shu lon gyi bar/ chos 'khor gling du 'jam mgon bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal pa'i drung du gtso bor rnam rigs gsan sbyong gis mtshon legs bshad chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa thugs kyi ro bcud du bzungs thog rnam 'grel le'u bzhi la zin bris gnang ba kho nar shog grangs phyed sum brgya tsam byung bas bla ma mnyes shing / khyod ni dus gsum khebs pa'i yon tan yong ba 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad/dgung lo nyer gsum par/ bo dong phyogs na 'brum nad yod pas 'brum g.yol du 'dar sogs su zla gnyis tsam bzhugs pa de'i skabs sdom gsum rab dbye sogs gzhung mang po thugs 'dzin gnang zhing / de skabs tshar chen dang mjal te tshar chen nas mdo phyogs kyi dri ba mang po mdzad par lan rim par gnang bas thugs dgyes/ tshar chen la'ang chos 'dra zhu 'dod yod pas rjes su gzung dgos zhus par ngas mthu min pa mi shes/ mthu ni khyod kyis mi slob ces zhal kur gsungs par/ bdag gis mthu dang mthu min pa yang slob ces zhus pas dgyes bzhin du gsung ngag sogs chos ci rigs pa bstsal/dgung lo nyer drug pa sa sprel(1548)lo/ 'jam mgon phyogs las rnam rgyal dang lhan du jo nang kun dga' grol mchog gi drung du chos zhur phebs te thog mar bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang zhu gnang skabs gsang mtshan la lī ta badz+ra ste rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba sa paṇa gyi gsang mtshan yin zhes 'dogs gnang dang / rnal 'byor ma'i sichura'i byin rlabs/ rgyud sde lnga dang /587

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang / ni gu'i byin rlabs nyer lnga/ grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang sogs dbang lung man ngag mang po zhu gnang mdzad cing / jo nang pa 'di'i sku rus kyang gnyag yin pas nga tsho rus khungs gcig red ces dgyes pa'i rnam pa bstan/dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa bya(1549)lo/ 'jam mgon bla mas bya gshong gi gdan sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gtad nas khyi phag byi ba lo gsum ring dben pa bsten te thugs dam la gzhol skabs mkhas grub 'di nyid kyang phyag phyir phebs nas ra pa mtshal gung mkhas grub dpal 'bar rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas bde mchog lha lnga dang / rgyud sde lnga/ sgyu lus dbang mo che sogs dbang bka' mang po zhus te dwags shang bka' brgyud gdams pa'i nying khu rnams thugs kyi bum bzang du bskyil zhing / skabs der dpon slob rnams kyis lo gsum ring 'dar gyi brag khung / rmu brag shod/ mu gu lung sogs dben gsum bdud rtsi'i dpal la rol pa'i skabs thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi rim pa dang /lhag par sems 'dzin 'phrul 'khor bslab sbyang shin tu 'phel ba byung zhing /thengs shig dpon slob gzhan tsho gzhung la gdan zhus ltar phebs ring khong sku rkyang mas rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing bzhugs pas gad phug gi nang thams cad du 'tshub kyis khengs par thab tshang nang go me mched pa min nam dgongs te sku sked la sku gzan dkris nas gzigs par phebs kyang thab kha ni skam krog ger 'dug tshur phebs dus da dung du 'tshub ma sangs pa zhig byung ba de ni phyi rol gyi du ba min par nang nas 'od gsal du ba lta bu'i nyams shar ba yin pa dang / de rjes rlung bzung res bzhin 'od gsal du ba lta bu'i nyams de rgyun du 'char ba zhig byung ba dang / yang thengs shig rlung 'dzin pa'i skabs 588

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rtsig logs sa paṇa gyi sku thang phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa zhig yod pa gzhan mi 'gul bar phyag chos 'chad kyi phyag sor rnams 'gul ba'i nyams snang mngon sum du byung ba lta bu gzhan yang mang po byung gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu pa chu byi(1552)lo 'dar rnam rgyal stag rtse dang chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla brang du mtshungs med tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i drung nas gsung ngag lam 'bras cha tshang zhu gnang thog de rnams la zin bris gnang ba'i dpe cha bla mar spyan bstar zhus pas thugs dgyes/ khyed la tshe rabs snga ma rnams su gsang sngags la sbyangs pa'i las 'phro las tshe 'di gcig pur go ba 'di 'dra chags mi thub gsungs shing / gzhan yang shes rab bskyed pa'i lha dkar po bzhi'i rjes gnang gis mtshon rjes gnang dang / gser chos bcu gsum sogs 'khrid bka' ches mang po zhu gnang mdzad cing / skabs der rje blo gsal rgya mtshos khyed ni lam 'bras pa 'di rnams kyi nang nas lam 'bras 'chad mkhan zhig yong ba 'dug ces bsngags pa brjod/lo der/ byang bdag nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rjes 'jam mgon bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal ngam ring chos sde'i dbu mdzad gnang bzhin pa nas ya ga chos sdings kyi mkhan por gdan zhu gnang ste phebs bzhed skabs kho bo cag sngar yin na srol 'byed gnyis sogs gzhung lugs chen po la yin min gyi 'gro ldog byed pa tsam byas/ rang gi khu bo gnyis kyang bka' brgyud pa yin/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar la zhugs/ bka' brgyud kyi nyams len byas/ ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byed bsam pa kho na yod kyang / rje tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas gsung ngag thob phyin chad 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa la phan pa zhig byed na dpal 589

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ldan sa skya pa'i chos lugs 'di yang ha cang bzang po zhig 'dug gsungs/de nas rje blo gsal rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar mkhas grub 'di nyid grang mo cher sku rkyang ma zla ba bdun ring yab yum gnyis kyi gzhi bsnyen sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gnang skabs thun mong min pa'i nyams snang khyad par can mang po byung /dgung lo sum cu pa chu glang(1553)lor byang bdag nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rjes bskul ba ltar chos gling gi slob dpon gnang bas 'chad nyan 'phel po byung /lo der/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i drung nas gsung ngag spros med ngor nas brgyud pa dang / theg chen nas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ka bzhugs pa las thog mar gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang / spros med rang rkang sogs rgyas par zhu gnang la zin bris kyang skabs de gar mdzad/lo de'i ngam ring chos sde'i dgun chos steng mkhan chen bzang po bkra shis kyis mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis las slob mdzad/ mdo rtsa bar‘‘skal ba dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin can la bar chad ma bris par yang ngo ’zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang ston med pa/ grib tshod kha skong dang bcas te ngam ring chos sde'i bla brang du tshigs phyi ma bsnyen par rdzogs/dgung lo so gsum pa me 'brug(1556)lor/ byang bdag gi gsung bzhin ya ga chos sdings kyi slob dpon mdzad pa de nas dgung lo nga gcig pa chu byi(1573)lo bar lo bco brgyad slob dpon mdzad ring phar tshad gnyis dang / 'dul mdzod gnyis/ dbu sdom gnyis/ byams chos rigs gter rnams la 'chad nyan rus thon pa mdzad/590

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/de yang slob gnyer ba grwa pa brgya skor byung ba'i nyin re'i slob gnyer gyi rim pa yang / tho rangs chos rnga snga bar btang ste thor skyong la sku ngo mas bskor ba byed cing bzhugs/ zur chos zhu ba la chos gsungs/ nam langs nas dpe 'dzin gyi tshe grwa pa slob gnyer ba grwa khang du nyal chog pa rnams kyang dpe 'dzin la bsdus/ tsha ba'i gaṇ+ḍi btang btang sku ngo ma yang bzhugs tsha ba grol nas snga chos tshar gnyis/ de nas gung seng cung zad byas/ de mtshams dgong chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdung ste dgong chos tshar gnyis/ de nas chos spyod rigs lung de grol mtshams brang bdag ma yin pa'i slob gnyer ba rnams 'du khang du nyal dgos pas srod skyong rgyun ring po'i bar la yang sku ngo ma bzhugs/ chos khrims pas snang gsal dang bcas skor ba byed lam de lta bu chag med du dpyid chos stod bcu tshigs bzhi'am lnga/ smad bcu tshigs bzhi/ ston cag stod bcu tshigs gnyis/ smad bcu tshigs gnyis/ ston chos bcu tshigs gnyis sam bco lnga tshigs/ de dag gi gong du gser chos bcu tshigs gnyis sam bco lnga tshigs re chag med gnang lam yod par sku ngo ma rgyun bskyangs te phebs pas slob gnyer ba rnams kyang rgyun 'khyongs nas chag med du yong / chos khrims pa 'ga' res sku nyid de lta bu'i 'o brgyal ma dgos pa nged chos khrims pas zhus chog zhus rung / nged rang ma phyin na btsun chung re re gnyis gnyis chos grwa se ther ba re las mi yong gsungs te lo bco brgyad rgyun 'khyongs gnang ba ni bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin/ da dung rab byung dang / bsnyen rdzogs mang po bsgrubs pa/ gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi bka' chos rgya cher bstsal zhing / skabs der mdzod kyi spyi don che mo dang / rigs gter gyi dka' 'grel/ phar phyin zur bkol sogs 591

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bka' rtsom yang mang po mdzad/yang de'i skabs sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun de yas mas gang du yang chad la nye bar gzigs nas dgon pa lu phu'i mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer la sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun bzhugs pa blon po chu tshan du mkhan po de'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs zhu gnang mdzad cing / sdom ro rnying pa la 'bul tshag ma byas na sdom pa blangs kyang mi chags pa 'dul ba'i lugs yin/ mdo rtsa ba las‘‘blangs pa la slar blang ba med pa'i phyir ro’ gsung pa ltar sngar gyi dge slong bslab pa de phul/dge tshul dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa lcags thang pa las thob pas ma phul ba de'i tsho bsnyen rdzogs kyi slob dpon dang / gsang ston gyi 'os su gyur pa gzhan ma rnyed pas mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'od zer gyis mkhan slob gsang ston sbrags ma mdzad/dgung lo nga gnyis shing khyi( 157grulor/ chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen dang / gdan sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi phyag rtags dang / grwa dmangs kyi 'os thus byas pa'i yi ge phul don bzhin gnyan yod bya gshongs kyi khri pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan bshol tshab tu chos khrir phebs pa nas dgung lo re bzhi pa me khyi(1586)lo bar lo hril po bcu gnyis gdan sa bskyangs/thog mar gdan sa rtsis bzhes gnang grub 'phral shar gyi sbyin bdag (gdan sa'i sbyin bdag)so so la mjal 'phrad gnang bar phebs shing /skabs der mjal 'phrad gnang yul sde pa mi drag ni/ shel dkar du shel dkar rgyal chen pa/ snar thang du snar thang sde pa/ gzhis rtser zhing shag rdo rje bsam grub ma bzhugs pas shangs sreg shing du zhing shag rdo rje bsam grub/rin spungs su sde pa rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig grags/ rgyal mkhar rtser 592

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyal mkhar sde pa sku mched/ rtse chen du rtse chen kun bzang yab sras/ 'brong rtser hor rtse'i sras bsod nams dpal 'phel/ myang stod stag rtser sde pa stag rtse chos mdzad/ tshong 'dus khri khang du gra lnga nyin byed dbang po sogs sde pa mi chen rnams mjal 'phrad thog rang rang la 'phral yun dge ba'i gsung mchid dang / 'dod chos ci rigs pa bstsal te slar bya gshongs su phebs pa dang /yang g.yas ru byang gi sbyin bdag byang pa sde nyid rnams ngam ring na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ gzhan yang bya mchu nang / chos gling / ya ga chos sdings sogs su phebs pa nas bya gshongs su 'khor ba de nas dgun chos dang po tshugs pa de'i ring gi nyin re'i gnang sgo ni/ tshes gcig la bsdus gra ba dang / mi snas chos gtor dgong chog rigs 'bring lung 'bring pa'i rigs lung tshes gnyis kyi snga dro rnam rgyal/ 'jam thon nas snga chos kyi rim pa la/ thog mar dpal gang drin ma/ rnam sras gtor chog de nas rigs 'bring yan la tshad ma'i ṭīkā/de rjes lung 'bring yan la phar phyin gyi ṭīkā de nas 'dul ba'i 'go nas gzhung 'grel dang brda chad dogs gcod/ de rjes rigs chen pa yan la tshad ma'i zin bris gnang dgos pa de yang thog mar rnam 'grel gzhung gi 'go nas gzhung 'grel dogs gcod dang bcas pa rang lugs kyi brda chad rnam gzhagarigs pa'i sgo nas dgag sgrub kyi mtha' gcod pa'i rigs pa'i phreng ba/ de nas lung chen pa yan la phar phyin zur bkol la thog mar gzhung 'grel rang lugs brda chad/ dgag sgrub kyi mtha' bcad pa'i rig pa/ de nas po ti phyi ma yan la mngon pa mdzod kyi gzhung gang yin pa'i gzhung 'grel/ rang lugs kyi brda chad/ dgag sgrub kyi thal 'gyur/ de nas rigs chen/ lung chen/ po ti phyi kho ba rnams gyes/ de nas rigs chung pa rnams/ de rjes lung chung pa rnams/593

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de rjes bsdus gra ba tsho bzhi/ de nas snga chos gnyis pa rigs chen pa nas bsdu gra'i bar/ de nas gung tshigs/ dgong chos la dpal gang drin pa dmag zor gtor bsngo/ de rjes tshad ma dang / phar phyin ṭīkā de nas 'dul ba'i spyir bstan gzhi smad sogs la sngar bzhin/ de rjes rigs che 'bring / de nas lung che 'bring / de rjes po ti phyi ma/ de rjes dbu ma la sngar bzhin/ de nas po ti phyi ma gyes/ de nas rigs chung / de nas lung chung / de nas bsdus gra ba rim pa bzhi/ de nas dgong chos gnyis pa la rigs che 'bring / lung che 'bring / de nas bsdus gra ba rim pa bzhi rnams rim bzhin/ de nas dgong mo'i chos spyod de grol nas rigs lung rnams kyi rim pa 'phyug med du yod pa yin/ de'i tshe slob gnyer ba dge 'dun rnams rig lam don gnyer la spro ba lhag par che bas rang la 'chad nyan byed rgyu yod phyin 'di lta bu ru 'chad nyan byed pa ni tshe don yod yin snyam pa'i spro ba 'phel zhes gsungs/lo lo'i dbyar chos chos grwa phyir chos khri lho zhes pa thog med pa zhig tu chos gsung dgos pa sku gzugs skyo ba'i rkyen gyis chos khri thog bcas dang / de'i mdun rdo gcal sogs me phag lo'i rjes su legs par grub cing / de'i skabs sngar rin spungs pa nas bkod ja gnang lam bar skabs ma byung ba de grwa sa'i gtong sgor gal che bas dge 'dun che bgres rnams kyis zhu bskul gnang dgos pa'i re 'dod bzhin snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu yig 'bul bar bang mi ched btang byas pa'i zhu yig snyan tshig la rin spungs pa thugs yid 'phrog ste bkod ja bkod yig dang bcas pa gnang thog mkhas grub 'di nyid rin spungs su ched mngags gdan zhu gnang ba de'i tshe sde pa rin spungs pa sa paṇa gyi rtogs brjod tshigs bcad ma rtsom pa'i skabs yin pas snyan ngag la 594

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dogs gcod dang / rin spungs pa/ yar 'brog stag lung pa/ gong ra lo tsā ba/mkhas grub 'di nyid bcas snyan ngag rtsom rtsal 'gran sdur gnang bar mkhas grub 'di nyid myur ba'i tshad dang / rin spungs pa bris bsub mang po dgos pa la rtsom shin tu legs pa byung / 'di skabs rin spungs pa'i sku 'gram na snar thang byang chen gyi mkhan po gser mdog can pa 'phags pa lha zer ba zhig bzhugs shing / sde srid nas sngar bod kha ba can du bstan pa dpang du btsugs pa'i rtsod pa byed mkhan rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis dpang po mdzad/ kapha‘mā’’‘‘sh+lau’ la dang / ha shang gnyis tsam dang / de rjes sa paṇa dang 'phrog byed dga' bo gnyis ma gtogs byung med/ da lam rnam gnyis kyang gzhung lugs rnam dag la 'bel ba'i gtam cung zad rigs pa 'dra gsung ba ltar byang chen pas dus 'khor la brten nas sangs rgya ba ma gtogs med gsungs par de ni rgyud kyi che ba brjod pa tsam yin gyi grub mthar khas len pa ma yin/ brtag pa gnyis pa las/ gang gis mi shes kye rdo rje/ /de yi ngal ba don med yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yang kye rdor gyi rgyud las/ bla med rgyud gzhan la brten na sangs rgya ba med zer ba min/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i thugs dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings de lta bu ni nges don gyi 'bras bu'i kye rdo rje yin pas de ma rtogs na 'tshang mi rgya ba'i don yin gsungs pa sogs chos kyi 'bel gtam mang po mdzad/ de skabs rin spungs pas bkur bzos bla na med pa zhus/— sbrul lo/ bya gshongs kyi 'du khang gsar bzhengs gnang zhing / thog ston la rong 'tsho ba mi'i dbang po nam mkha' dpal 'byor yab yum phebs te mang ja dang / 'bul ba rgya chen bstabs/dgung lo drug cu re gcig chu lug(1583)lor/ 'dar grang che chos 595

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'khor yang rtse'i chos khrir phebs te gdan sa nyis lcog lta bu gnang /dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi par bya gshongs kyi chos khrir rang gi dngos slob chos rje 'ga' rong pa bsko gzhag gnang zhing / khong gi thugs re ltar sbyin bdag rnams la sbyor sprod gnang bar phyogs phebs gnang ste phun tshogs gling du snar thang sde srid/ bsam grub rtser sde pa kun spangs pa dang / mthu stobs drung / tshong 'dus su sde pa lhun chen/ rin spungs su sde srid yab yum sogs mjal zhing / khong tshos thugs re gnang ba'i dbang bka' lung sogs ci rigs bstsal zhing / lhag par rin spungs su las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnang dgos zhus par las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg dang / zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sdog gnang / skabs der rin spungs zhal ngo zhabs drung nor bu bzang pos deng sang phyag srol 'ga' zhig la mchod rdzas dang / dar gos gser dngul mang po sbyin bdag ngo ma smon lam gdab tu bcug ste me nang bskyur gyin 'dug pa khyed kyang de ltar gnang ngam zhus pas/ lugs de 'dra ni sreg rdzas dang / mchod rdzas kyi shan ma phye ba 'dra/ khyad par zhal zas dang gtor ma rnams gong du me lha la phul zin pas ro ma me nang bskyur bar dgos pa ci yod/gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs sreg rdzas la dgos pa'i skabs yod kyang rnam pa thams cad du ni min/ sbyin bdag sbyin sreg gi skabs spyan 'dren pa bla med dbang gis smin pa 'dra yod na 'gal ba med kyang / ma smin pa la gsang sgrog gi rgyur 'gro bas phan yon med ces gsungs/de nas bya gshongs su phebs te bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed stobs pa dang /sprod rnying gi khar sprod gsar shag lo dang / gnyan phug gi gzhis/ 'du khang bkra shis gser khang / chos grwa phyi nang sogs gtsug lag khang rten brten par 596

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bcas pa dang / rje nyid kyis bka' rtsom gnang ba'i bstan bcos mang po sogs gdan sa'i rgyan du che bar mdzad/phag lo 'dar grang che chos 'khor yang rtser phebs te der phal che ba rgyun bzhugs thog lo der gsung ngag zhus pa bzhin lam 'bras dang / sems bskyed rgyu dbang sogs dang / lo mjug gzhis pa rnams dang / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i slob ma'i tshogs pa dang bcas par lam 'bras slob bshad cha lag yongs rdzogs dang / spros med kyi dbang 'khrid yongs rdzogs bstsal/de nas rtse chen sde pas rtse chen du gdan zhu gnang ste myang stod sgrol ma lha khang du lam 'bras slob bshad dang / gser chos bcu gsum sogs kyi dbang bka' ches mang po gnang zhing / skabs der gtor ma dang / mtheb skyu sogs la myu gu sngon po skye ba dang / me tog shar ba sogs kyi ngo mtshar kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa ma zad/ de tshun chad kyang gtor ma la myu gu skye ba zhig byung bar lhun rtse zhabs drung bkra shis kyis gtor ma la spu nag skye ba 'di sbyong ma thub pa'i skyon dang / myu gu skyes pa mchog grub pa'i rtags su bshad ces gsungs par grags/dus de'i tshe gtsang du sde gzar zir bun che ba'i skabs yin pas rong pa/rtse chen pa/ gser ma sogs phyogs gcig dang / gtsang byang phyogs phyogs gcig yin pas byang phyogs kyi dpung nyang stod la 'byor te rtse chen gyi 'go ting ting rdzong du sgar rgyab rtsis kyang sa gnas de rtse chen pas snga sa nas zin te bsrung bya byas pas byang pa de nas bzlog dgos byung yang / zir bun gyi nyen kha da dung 'jags med pas rtse chen sde srid kyis mkhas grub 'di nyid la gzor 'phen gnang dgos zhus rung / de ltar byas pas mi 'grig ces gtor bskul 597

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'phrin bcol tsam gnang bas rang phyogs la phan pa'i rtags mngon sum du thon te skabs de'i zir bun 'jags thub pa byung bas skye bo mang po'i srog gi nyer 'tshe zhi zhing / rtse chen pa tsho rab tu dga' ba'i lha gsol yang byas/dgung lo re brgyad par/ dgon pa seng rdzong gi phyogs su thugs dam la bzhugs yul slob bshad nor bu'i gling bskrun te de gar dad 'dus slob ma'i tshogs la rang rang re ba'i zab chos ci rigs stsal/dgung lo bdun cu pa chu 'brug(1593)lor/ byang bdag gi dpon sa lha gcig phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal pos re bskul zhus pa ltar dpal ngam ring chos sde'i chos kyi gdan khrir phebs te dbyar chos dgun chos la ngam ring la phebs pa dang / rgyun gtan bzhugs yul slob bshad nor bu'i gling du mdzad/der thengs shig zla gcig tsam sku mtshams gnang ba'i gseng la klu sgrub bstod 'grel brtsams/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lta ba la mkhas pa mang po'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gnad zab mo khong du chud pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang rdzun du ma gyur tsam yod gsungs/mkhas grub 'di nyid kyis kun mkhyen lcags thang rab 'byams pa byams pa bsod nams/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam mgon bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ skyid gshong pa blo gros rnam rgyal/ jo nang pa kun dga' grol mchog sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma mang po spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur te mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son par mdzad de 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig lhur bzhes shing / gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i tshogs kyang chos rje 'ga' rong pa dang / chos rje 'bum pa sher blo ba/ chos 598

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rje cha lung pa sogs chos rje'i mtshan thob pa dang / rab 'byams smra ba/ dka' bcu pa sogs brgya phrag brgal ba byung yod/gsung rtsom la mtshon na/ sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs shing par la bskos pa phyag chen rtsod spong / phyag chen yang lan/ rgyud man ngag gi brgyud 'debs/klu sgrub kyi bstod pa dang / 'grel pa/ rab gnas kyi rtsa ba/ bzang drug gi lag len sogs le tshan brgya phrag brgal ba dang / par la ma 'khod pa yang ji snyed mchis pa khyon bsdoms pod chen bcu gsum yod par grags/mkhas grub 'di nyid ni sprul sku gang rtse bas khyung tshang brag nas spyan drangs pa'i lung bstan ltar na/ lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / sa skya pa rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo yang 'di'i sku skye'i rabs su grags pa bcas de ltar chu mo lug lo sku bltams pa nas dgung lo don gnyis pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing pho rta(159grulo bar gyi mdzad pa rnams(rang gi rnam par thar pa yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi myong ba'i gtam du byas pa zol zog rdzun gyis ma bslad pa sgeg mo'i me long〉zhes bya ba'i nang gsal ba las che long tsam zhig btus pa gong du zhus pa ltar lags shing / de nas nam 'tsho'i bar gyi mdzad pa 'phros dang / nam zhi bar gshegs pa'i skor yig cha khungs ldan zhig btsal 'tshol zhus kyang ma rnyed pas re zhig sgyug rtse'i zlos gar bsgyur mtshams 'dir byas so//kun nas drangs so skal ldan rgyal po'i sras/ /rtse dga'i yul gyur gnas lnga don gnyer blo/ /mtshar sdug 'bum gyis phyug pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ /dam pa'i rnam thar phul byung don zhags 'dis/ /599

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rje btsun mi la ras pa/rje btsun mi la ras pa ni yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug(1040)lor mang yul gung thang skya rnga rtsa ru sku bltams/chung ngu'i dus yab sku gshegs pas a khu dang a nes yab kyi zhal chems ras su bor nas pho nor rnams a khu dang / mo nor rnams a nes bdag tu bzung ste yum myang tsha dkar rgyan ma smad la rang khyim gyi nor rdzas dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i khar/ gnyen tshan de dag gi bran g.yog gnang dgos pa sogs sku ngal tshad med byung ba'i 'khon lan slog phyir yum gyi bkas bskul ba ltar mi la ras pa sku gzhon nu'i dus mthu bslabs nas pha rol po rdul du brlags pa'i sdig pa la thugs 'gyod chen po byung bas dka' ba du ma dang du blangs te mar pa chos kyi blo gros bla mar bsten nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas te dbang lung man ngag rdzogs par gsan pa dang / skyid grong dang /gnya' nang khul sogs su sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas mthar sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad de ras chung pa sogs snod rung gi slob ma rnams la gsang sngags kyi gdams pa ci rigs kyis bskyangs mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gsum par rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos(1123)lor dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan/rje btsun mi la ras pa'i nyams mgur gsung rtsom ni dpe 'jig rten gyi snang ba dang bstun cing / don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang sbyar ba mang du gsungs pa zhig yin te bstan bya'i don shin tu zab pa 'di nyid ston byed tshig 600

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/gi sbyor ba spros pa rgyas po min khar 'tsho ba dngos kyi nyams snang zab pas brjod don bde blag tu rtogs shing / yid la bag chags zab mo ster ba'i khyad par gyi yon tan du ma ldan gshis/ phyi rabs kyi mkhas pa mang pos rje btsun mi la ras pa'i nyams mgur gsung rtsom ni phyi'i rig gnas kyi shan zhugs med par bod kyi btsan po'i dus kyi rtsom gshis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog yar rgyas legs spel mdzad de bod sil bu'i dus kyi shes rig 'phel rgyas kyi rnam pa yongs su mtshon thub pa'i dpe mtshon yin par ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod/ der brten deng dus rgyal khab mang po'i yig rigs la bsgyur nas bod rig pa'i mkhas pa tshos gna' rabs bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig la zhib 'jug bya rgyur med du mi rung ba'i yig tshags shig tu rtsi yi yod pa de nas nyams mgur gsung rtsom 'di nyid kyi rtsa che'i rin thang mngon thub/ rje btsun— mi la ras pa'i nyams mgur gsung rtsom de ni bod kyi rtsom rig bya bar 'bungs pa'i rtsom pa po tshos nges par gzigs dgos pa'i dpe deb cig yin/ gang lags she na phyi nang yul gru kun la snyan grags ldan pa'i brtsam bya zhig yin dgos na brtsam bya de'i nang don dang rnam pa gnyis thad nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos chen po ldan dgos par ha lam bzhed pa gcig mthun yin srid/ gsung mgur ni bod du snyan ngag me long ma ma dar gong gi ljags rtsom rlabs po che zhig yin pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal lags/ de la bod mi rigs kyi rtsom gshis lhad med ldan yod pa'ang rgyu mtshan rang grub yin stabs gsung mgur gyi rtsom rtsal slob sbyong byas te gna' bzang deng spyod gnang thub na bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gong spel gtong rgyur phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon gyi red snyam mo/ /601

cho nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gtsang smyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can/gtsang smyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can ni/ yab myang ral pa can dang /myang nyi ma 'od zer gyi sku rgyud sngags 'chang sangs rgyas dpal ldan dang / yum sangs rgyas 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i chu sprel(1452)lor gtsang myang stod stag tshal du sku 'khrungs/dgung lo bdun par mkhan chen kun dga' sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung ste mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes gsol ba de nas rang yul du slob gnyer mdzad/dgung lo bco brgyad par tsa rir byon te rje btsun sha ha rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge dang mjal te ri chos skor gsum la sogs pa bka' rgyud kyi chos skor phal mo che'i lung gsan/ rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes gsol ba de nas g.yu lung ba yon tan rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po bsten nas zab chos mang po gsan cing / gangs te si dang / tsa ri sogs gnas nges med du byon nas sgrub pa mthar phyin mdzad/ de rjes dur khrod dang / grong gseb nges med du byon nas tha mal skye bo'i blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang smyon zhes su grags/khong gis bal yul gyi 'phags pa shing kun gyi mchod rten zhig gso dang /bod du sgrub gnas mang por bka' rgyud kyi sgrub sde btsugs pa/ lhag par rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / nyams mgur 602

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs shing par du bkod/ mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid kyi slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyangs mthar dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung dgu pa'i me yos(1507)lor ras chung phug tu sku gshegs so/ /gtsang smyon ho ru kas mdzad pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa'i gsung rnam dang nyams mgur ni rgyal khab phyi nang du skad grags chen po ldan yod/ lhag par rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar ni ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyis mos gus dang dag snang skye ba'i gsung rtsom zhig yin/ bod kyi rtsom rig nang rnam thar gyi brtsam bya'i 'bri srol sngar nas dar yod cing / brtsam bya yang mang po mthong rgyu yod pa zhig yin/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar ni de dag khrod du 'od snang ches cher 'tsher ba'i rnam thar gyi brtsam bya phul du byung ba zhig yin zhing / rnam thar nang 'bri bya'i mi sna 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus gsal po 'khod pa ma zad/ lo rgyus 'bri thabs kho na ma yin par rtsom rig gi gzugs snang zhib bkod kyi 'bri thabs spyad nas mi sna'i gshis rgyud dang / 'bri bya'i mi sna gtso bo dang 'brel ba'i mi sna'i bar gyi 'gal 'du'i 'brel ba zhib par bkod yod stabs brtsam bya hril po bklags rjes 'bri bya'i mi sna'i snang brnyan gson por thon thog yul gyi khor ra khor yug gi bkod pa gsal bas 'tsho ba'i nyams snang gson rjen zhig yid la ri mo brkos pa ltar gsal lhang nger 'jags kyi 'dug rtogs bzo ma yin pa'i rnam thar gyi brtsam bya zhig la gzugs snang gi tshor ba ches cher ster ba'i khyad par gyi yon tan 'di lta bu ldan pa 'di ni rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyis gtsos pa'i bod kyi phul byung rnam thar brtsam bya'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin gshis thugs snang zhib pa'i klog pa po tshos gzigs tshe myong tshor 'di 'dra zhig yong nges yin/603

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni la stod lho'i dpyad lung shar gyi bong ra zhes par sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung / go yul ba mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dus 'khor chags lugs/ bde kyai phreng ba skor gsum sogs mang du gsan cing / gar thig rtsis la mkhas par sbyangs/ gza' gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me sogs rtsis kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de nas tsha nar srag bde ba'i drung du phar tshad mngon gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ dus skor gyi skor shog ldebs bzhi bcu tsam phyag bris su bris pa yon du phul te 'phro lugs kyi dbang rgyud bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po cher bstod pa tshigs bcad du ma phul nas bdag lo tsā slob tu 'gro bas rdzong bar zhu zhus pas/ de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang / mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe nged la chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dgongs pa skong dgos kyi 'gyur 'dra yang dgos pa yod de rjes su byed do zhes gser dang / dar gos rnams gnang ste 'phags pa rin po che'i gzim g.yog pa mdo smad pa blo gros rgyal po dang 'grogs te bal yul du brdzangs pa bzhin byon te paṇ+ḍi ta sa bzang gi drung nas sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor zlos gar mngon brjod la mkhas par bslabs nas sa skyar 'phags pa rin po che'i drung du phebs par thugs dgyes pa chen pos nged kyi chos rje pa byang phyogs sprul pa'i sder sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshe tha ma'i gsung du bka' bstsal pa la/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang mchog tu dar bar byas/ brgal brtags kyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i srol bzang po 604

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dod/ tha snyad rig gnas kyi tshul 'di la yang lag rjes chen po byung bas sems la 'phreng ba cher med/ 'on kyang 'phags pa bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang /rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'a khri shing ma 'gyur ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad bzhin ma 'gyur ba gsum tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa zhig yod na'ang nga ni bsnyen par rdzogs zin/ 'gyur gnyis sngar ma byung ba da khyed kyis gyis shig de'i grogs dpon chen shākya bzang pos kyang byed pa yod do zhes dgyes bzhin bka' bstsal ba ltar sa skyar dus 'khor rgyud 'grel bsgyur gnang mdzad/ slar rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon nas mahā bo dhi la mchod pa dang bskor ba mdzad pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta lasmi ka ra bod du gdan drangs nas dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/snyan ngag me long / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa bṛ ta ma la/ tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo sbyor ba'i rtsa 'grel/ bzlog pa bsdus pa rtsa 'grel/ slob dpon su pa rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i smra ba kun la 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam dbye'i le'ur byas pa la sogs pa sngon ma 'gyur ba mang po bsgyur/ 'chi med mdzod la 'gyur mchan mdzad nas sgra snyan ngag gi bshad rgyun spel/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas kyang sde snod 'dzin pa shong lo tsā ba'i snyan du gsol zhes pa'i bkur gzos chen po'i 'phrin yig gnang ba'i nang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya che la zab cing gting dpag par dka' ba/ tshig brling zhing sdeb sbyor byings che bas chen po rnams kyis kyang nyams su len dka' bas sngon byung gi lo tsā ba dag gis kyang ma 'gyur ba dang / log par bsgyur ba/rnam grangs gzhan dang phyogs re ba dang / thal bar bsgyur ba la sogs pa de 605

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dag khyed kyis legs par khong du chud cing nges te/ zhu chen mdzad pa'i glegs bam dang / klu rnams kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar mthong bas/ dge ba dang rjes su yi rangs ba khyad par can skyes byung zhes bsngags brjod tshad med pa gnang ba ni khong gi mdzad rjes rlabs po che dang / mkhyen rlabs gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i phyogs sdom don dang ldan pa zhig yin pa bcas khong ni bod kyi sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa yin no/ /shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang dpang lo blo gros brtan pa gnyis ni bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bod la bcu phrag rig pa'i srol cha tshang ba gtod pa'i rjes sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gna' rabs rgya gar gyi rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung phal mo che bsgyur ba dang / bshad pa'i rgyun ches cher dar bar mdzad pa po yin pas khong rnam pas bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyal la 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni brjod kyis mi lang bas skabs 'dir shong lo chen po'i sgra bsgyur gyi mdzad rjes cha shas snyan ngag skor dmigs su bkar nas zhu na/bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la thad kar 'brel ba yod pa snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung dang / rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing bod du bsgyur ba de nas bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag la 'phel rgyas gsar pa byung yod/ khong gis bsgyur gnang mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig sbyor gyi 'gros ni 'gyur ma yin pa'i tshor snang mi skye ba bod kyi mkhas pa rang gis brtsams pa lta bu 'gyur ma'i ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ba ni 'dzam gling nang mthong dkon pa 'di'i thog nas bod mi rigs kyi blo gros kyi 'jug pa shin tu yangs pa de mtshon par mdzad yod/dpag bsam 'khri shing gi rtsom pa po chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po ni gna' rabs rgya gar gyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po snyan grags can zhig yin pas snyan 606

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/ngag gi gzhung 'dir skad grags chen po ldan pa smos ma dgos pa'i thog bod du bsgyur skabs shong lo chen po'i mkhyen pa'i rtsal las snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur legs thog legs brtsegs byung yod pa 'di lta bu'i sgra bsgyur mkhas pa ni 'dzam gling nang ches dkon pa yin zhes spobs pa chen pos bshad chogagand don 'di'i thad zhib 'jug mkhan tsho'i dpyad gzhi'i ched shong 'gyur dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'phags skyes po'i yal 'dab las/ dpyid dus la bsngags pa'i snyan ngag dum bu zhig drangs na 'di lta ste/de nas yid bsrubs longs spyod grogs/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung ba rnams kyi gnyen/ /skal bzang 'khri shing 'khyud byed pa/ /legs ldan dpyid ni mthong bar gyur/ /mdzes ma'i nga rgyal gnyis 'thung dgra /dpyid ni ral pa ldan pa dag/glal bar byed pa'i lce bzhin du/ /mya ngan med pa'i dog pa mdzes/ /gzhon nu'i 'gram pa mdzes pa yi/ /rkun po tsam pa ka yi tshogs/ /mig bzang ma yi skra zhags la/ /bcings par 'os pa nyid du gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bod kyi mkhas pa si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi gsung rtsom dpyid dus la bsngags pa'i snyan ngag dum bu gcig drangs na 'di lta ste/607

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/king shu ka yi ljon shing la/ /khu byug pho mo sgra 'byin pa'i/ /ge sar rgyas ldan dpyid kyi dpal/ /ngo mtshar dus kyi dang po la/ /ci yang dga' bar byed pa yi/ /chu khur can gyi phreng bres shing / /ji zhig ltar na char rgyun gyis/ /nyon mongs lta bu'i gdung ba bcil/ /ti ra'i tshogs kyang dga' byed na/ /thu bo mkhas pa lta ci smos/ /de 'dra'i ya mtshan mthong ba'i dus/ /nongs pa'i bzhin ras 'phyar mi 'tshal/ /pi ṇa bya sogs rnam par rgyas/ /phu chu lhung lhung snyan sgrogs shing / /be ta sa rnams ral pa gsigs/ /mog por byed pa'i rdul rnams dang / /'i 'i 'bod pa bung ba'i glus/ /tshur rol mthong ba dga' skyes pa/ /dze ta'i tshal mtshungs mdzes pa 'di/ /wo dzi hwas kyang smra nus min/ /zhi ba rnams kyang yid bsrubs kyis/ /zur mig lhung bas rmongs byed na/ /608

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'e zhes bos nas grogs mo la/ /yo dza na sems smos ci dgos/ /ri dwags lta bur bag yangs su/ /lu gu rgyud kyi 'ching ba btang / /shes pas 'dod pa der spyad na/ /sos ka 'dis kyang byang chub ster/ /he he'i bgad mo 'byin bzhin du/ /o ḍa'i bdud rtsi 'thungs pa'i dus/ /he ru ka gnas dpal spungs su/ /o rgyan mkhan po'i 'bangs des bris/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gong gsal gyi snyan ngag dum bu gnyis bsdur na/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi dum bur don rgyan dang / si tus sgra rgyan gtso cher spyad pa rgyan gyi khyad par tsam las de gnyis ka rtsom pa po bod kyi mkhas pas brtsams pa mtshungs pa las 'gyur ma dang / 'gyur ma min pa'i dbye ba gcod dka' ba 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar la phyis 'byung skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i brtsam sgrung sogs bsgyur skabs 'gyur gyi tshad gzhi de lta bu yong bar 'bad brtson bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che ba yin/ gal srid sngon byon mes po rnams kyis nga tshor bzhag pa'i gcigs che'i nor bu 'di tshor mnyam 'jog ma byas na yig rigs gzhan gyi brtsam sgrung dngos snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ji ltar mtho yang bsgyur zin pa'i rjes su nang don ngo sprod thub tsam las snyan ngag nyams 'gyur gyi thog nas klog pa po'i yid dbang 'phrog mi thub pa nga tsho'i 609

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mthong chos su gyur pa'i don zhig red ces bshad na'ang thal cha med do/ /dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/dpang lo blo gros brtan pa ni/ rab byung lnga pa'i me byi(1276)lor dpang gi gdung rgyud du 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga pa la rgod tshang pa'i gdan sa byang gling pa las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la blo gros brtan pa gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa la mkhan chen gser khang pa dang / mes ston 'dul 'dzin pa las rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu pa la mdo rtsa 'grel sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu gsum tar tsha nar rtag bde ba'i drung du byon nas lo drug ring phar tshad mngon gsum/ dbu ma dus 'khor bcas bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bsam gnang bas mkhas par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la mang mkhar khra tshang du lo mchog pa las dus 'khor shong lugs/ka tsan me long / rong pa shes rab seng ge la dus 'khor rwa lugs/ sa skyar 'jam skya ba la brtag gnyis/ rnam 'grel/ rigs gter bcas gsan/dgung lo nyi shu pa la gser khang pas mkhan po/ mes ston pas las slob gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs/dgung lo nyer gcig par bal yul du byon nas ra ma ā tsar+ya dang / ma tha na ā tsar+ya la tsan+d+ra pa gsan rjes sa skyar byon te ka lā pa'i 'grel pa gnyis rags rim bsgyur/ yang bal yul du byon te bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta snga ma gnyis dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi tsu ṭa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams bsten nas ka lā pa sogs rig gnas mang po gsan/ slar sa skyar phebs dus 'jam skya bas gtso mdzad 610
