bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/pas ser sbreng dang / bkur bste chen po mdzad/ snga rjes su bal yul du lan bdun phebs nas bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta phal che ba las man snye dang dgongs rgyan sogs gsan pa dang / sa skyar bzhi thog pa dang 'jam skya ba las lam 'bras sogs mang du gsan/dgung lo so gnyis pa la gung thang gnas po cher chos gzhis btsugs te gung thang pa bde blo sogs slob ma'i mchog rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus pa la dbyar ka dus 'khor dang / dgun kha phar tshad mngon gsum gyi dus chos gsungs/ snyan pa'i grags pa rgya gar dang hor yul tshun khyab/de'i dus su bo dong e'i mkhan por gsol ba btab pa bzhin khri thog tu phebs nas bstan pa'i bya ba yun ring du mdzad/de nas dbus su phebs nas zla ba bcu drug ring bzhugs te lha sa/bsam yas/ gung thang / stag lung / rwa sgreng / gsang ne'u thog rnams su dus 'khor dang / dgongs rgyan/ phar tshad mngon gsum/ dbu ma rgyan/ sgra snyan ngag zab mo'i mdo lnga sogs chos mang du gsungs/de nas snar thang du mchims blo bzang grags pa sogs la dgongs rgyan dang / snyan ngag sogs gnang / de nas e dang sa skyar byon nas si sogs kyi mtha' dpyad 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa sogs gzhi 'gyur dang zhu chen mang du mdzad cing / dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi bstod 'grel/ ka lā pa/ snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa/ tshogs gsum gsal ba sogs bstan bcos mang po bka' rtsom mdzad nas mthar dgung lo re bdun pa rab byung drug pa'i chu rta (1342)lor sku gshegs/dpang lo chen po yang shong lo'i rjes su byung ba'i bod kyi rig gnas 611

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig yin/ khong gis mdzad pa'i tshogs gsum gsal ba'i bstan bcos nang saṃskyi tas 'brel ba'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs gsum gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan cing / de'i zhar la bod kyi ming sbyor dang mthun pa'i rnam dbye brgyad dang / rnam dbye bsdus pa'i tshig sdud rnam pa drug dang / tshig phrad yin pa dang / ma yin pa'i khyad par/ bod kyi dag yig gi 'khrul gzhi 'ga' zhig sun dbyung ba sogs ston pa'i sgra'i yan lag tu nye bar mkho ba'i brda sbyor ba'i bstan bcos ches legs pa zhig yin pa des kyang bod kyi rtsom rig bya ba 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon pa bcas so/ /bu ston rin chen grub/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub ni/ yab brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga pa'i lcags stag(1290)lor shab smad sgom gnas su sku 'khrungs/dgung lo drug tsam la yum gyis klog slob pa'i dbu tshugs pa nas mi ring bar sbyor klog legs par mkhyen cing / dbon rgyal seng nas rtsis dang yi ge'i rig pa bslabs/dgung lo bdun par khro phu bsod nams seng ge'i drung nas theg chen sems bskyed gsan/dgung lo brgyad par yum gyi khu bo bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang gi spyan sngar gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos skor gsan thog de'i nyams bzhes kyi rim pa 612

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dang / gzhan la dbang bskur sogs kyang mdzad/ gzhan yang bzo dang / gso ba rig pa sbyong ba'i dbu tshugs/dgung lo bco brgyad par khro phu ba rin chen seng ge'i drung nas dgi tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa la sogs pa thugs 'dzin dang / slob dpon bsod mgon las phar phyin thugs sbyong mdzad pas lo gnyis tsam gyi ring nyin mo gsol ba dal lhod kyi bzhes long dang / na bza' ral ba'ang tshems long med par mtshan mo dkar me'i 'og tu dpe gzigs mdzad pa sogs dka' ba du ma lhur bzhes pas zhal ras gnyer mas khengs shing / sku lus rid par gyur/ de rjes phar phyin gyi bshad pa mdzad cing / 'dul ba dang /tshad ma'i gzhung rnams gsan sbyong gis mkhas par gyur te dgung lo nyer gcig par dbus gtsang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su grwa skor mdzad skabs mkhas pa'i khrod du pha ston pa la bu'ang ston pa byung 'dug ces bu ston zhes pa'i mtshan yang de nas thogs pa yin/dgung lo nyer gsum par mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu'i drung nas khro phur bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/de rjes thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan nas sgra gzhung tsan+d+ra pa dang / ka lā pa sogs kyi mdo 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ snyan dngags dang / sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ yig rigs sna tshogs sogs thun mong rig gnas la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad de skad gnyis smrartsoba'i dbang por gyur/gzhan yang bla ma dam pa dpal ldan seng ge la sogs pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma bsten nas mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son/dgung lo so gcig pa lcags sprel(1320)lor sku zhang grags pa rgyal 613

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mtshan gyis zha lu'i gdan sar gdan 'dren zhus pa de nas dgung grangs re bdun bar zha lu'i gdan sa lo ngo sum cu so drug mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don bla na med pa mdzad nas mthar dgung lo don lnga ste/ rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug(136grulor zha lu ri phug tu zhi bar gshegs/ bu ston gyi gsung rtsom la mtshon na sgra rig pa'i gzhung 'grel dang / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i bka' bstan bcos mang po bsgyur ba dang / hor kong bsab pa/ bsgyur zin la zhus dag gzhan yang chos 'byung dang / rtsis kyi gzhung lugs/gzhung chen lnga dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i skor sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gsung rtsom pod chen nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa rnams bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug bya rgyur gzhi 'dzin sa dang / dpyad gzhi'i rin thang shin tu che ba ma zad/ grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba/ bu lugs zhes pa'i grub mtha'i srol yang gsar du gtod cing /lhag par dus 'khor dang / skar rtsis rig pa'i skor de bas phyag rjes che ba 'jog gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas la yang phyag rjes chen po 'jog gnang mdzad yod/skabs 'dir dmigs su bkar nas bod kyi snyan ngag gi rig par phyag rjes rlabs chen bzhag pa'i dpe mtshon du snar thang gi bstan 'gyur la zhu dag mdzad de bkod pa dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba'am yongs su grags par bu ston chos 'byung zhu ba'i gsung rtsom gyi mchod brjod skabs 'grel mdzad lo paṇa la mchod pa brjod par/rgyal ba sdichog gis snachog tu lung bstan bstan pa ༷ra mdzod mdzad pa 614

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dri med mnga'/ /mnga' bdag 0dam pa'i0 dam pa'i choX kuspu kun tu gzung phyir theg pa gsum gyi tshul/ /tshul bzhin rab ston sgoston pa'i gsuḍi raḍi rab tu gsal byed blo mchog mnga' ba'i thugs/ /thugs rjes dgongs ༷grel ༷grel bshad bshad pa ma nor ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs la'ang 'dud/ /ces bstod yul mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang /gsang ba gsum gyi mdzad pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad pa sogs kyi yon tan rgya cher bsngags pa'i brjod bya phan sam tshogs pa rjod byed ༄ ra kyang snyan ngag le'u gsum pa'i sgra rgyan nyams 'gyur ches che ba'i sgo nas bstan pazhigaste deyangartags( )'disaskabasaphyebadangapoganyisalachodapa'iX zung ldan dang / rtags( )'dis skabs phye ba bzhi ka'i dkyil la yod pa ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang / dang po dang / gsum pa bzhi par ma chod pa'i zung ldan nyis gshib can dang / rtags( )'dis skabs phye ba mtha' thog zung ldan bcas sho lo ka 'di kho na'i nang du yang sgra rgyan gyi rgyan gsum gyi rang bzhin ldan pa 'dis rigs bsgre ba khong gis gsang rtsom ci mdzad kyang nang ༄don zab la/ rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor ches legs pa/ snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur 615

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ches mtho ba bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa ni bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa'i gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan zhig kyang yin no/ /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ yab zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / yum ma gcig kun dga' skyid kyi sras su rab byung bzhi pa'i shing lug(1235)lor sa skyar sku bltams/ dgung lo chung dus nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga la gsan bsam mdzad par dka' tshegs chen po ma dgos par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu pa shing 'brug (124sulor khu bo sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan hor yul du hor gyi rgyal po go dan gyis gdan drangs pa ltar lang cu sde bzhir phebs skabs phyag phyir phebs/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags phag(1251)lor sa paṇa sku gshegs khar rang nyid kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bdag por bskos/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu glang(1253)lor hu pi li se chen han gyis gdan drangs te hor gyi bla mchod mdzad/ lo der sa paṇa gyi sku gdung ngo mtshar can mthong bas rgyal po hu pi li sogs dad nas 'phags pa la dbang zhus par thog mar rgyal pos gtso bo byas pa'i mi nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsang sngags kyi dbang thengs dang po gnang ba'i dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum dang / ti shrī'i go gnas/g.yang ṭi las byas pa'i tham ga bcas phul/ de rjes gsang sngags kyi dbang thengs gnyis pa gnang ba'i dbang yon du bod chol kha gsum gyi srid dbang 616

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/phul nas bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag por bskos/ gsang sngags dbang thengs gsum pa gnang ba'i dbang yon du chos dung dkar po rgyang grags dang rgya yi mi yur chen mo phul/ de nas gong mas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la bod kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag por bskos pa'i 'ja' sa mu tig ma phul/ de nas bod du phebs te lo ngo gsum bzhugs ring la kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ta thā ga da bha dra dang / glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ snar thang mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma nyi shu lhag tsam bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ de nas slar rgya nag tu phebs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing yos lor snye thang mkhan chen grags pa seng ge'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung lnga pa'i sa sbrul(1269)lor hor yig gsar bzos kyis gong mar phul bas rjes su tham ga'i thog bed spyod byed srol byung / dgung lo so drug pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcags rta(1270)lor slar yang rgyal pos gsang sngags kyi dbang gnang ba'i dbang yon du shel dam gling drug ma dang / gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng na rgya gar lha'i sras po/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/ yi ge rtsom mi/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug pa po/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa ti shrī zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang go gnas phul/ me byi(1276)lor slar bod du phebs nas gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la bsnyen bkur zab cing rgyas pa dang bcas te chu mig chos 'khor du grags pa'i mdzad pa bskyangs/ dgung lo zhe drug pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'brug(1280)lor sa skya'i lha khang bla brang du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'apags pa ni/ rig pa'i gnas kun la mkhyen pa'i 617

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dpal 'bar zhing / lugs zung gi mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs pa bod kyi mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan zhig yin/ skabs 'dir khong gis bod kyi thun mong rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong gnang mdzad pa'i rlabs po che'i mdzad pa'i nang nas cha shas shig dpe mtshon du zhus na/dang po/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi rig pa 'phel rgyas gtong bar mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa shong dpang rnam gnyis kyi lo rgyus skabs rags tsam zhus pa ltar snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing bod skad du bsgyur rgyu'i thad sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa ltar shong ston chen por tshad med pa'i bdag rkyen dang bcas bskul ma dang / phyogs gang thad nas rgyab bskyor shugs chen gnang bas rtogs brjod rin po che dang / snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung sogs rgya gzhung mang po bod 'gyur gyi las 'gan rlabs po che grub pa ni khong gi tshad med pa'i thugs 'khur dang kha 'bral thabs med la las don de dag gis bod kyi snyan ngag gi rig lam 'phel rgyas la dpag par dka' ba'i nus pa thon pa nga tsho tshang ma'i blo la mnga' ba de ltar yin/gnyis pa/ khong gis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i klong du chud par mdzad nas bod kyi rig pa'i gnas sgo kun nas 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang ba ma zad/ spun zla mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod/dper na/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas sog yig gsar gtod mdzad pas sog rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon pa 'di'i thad gong du zhus pa ltar yon gong mas 'bul gnang mdzad pa'i shel dam gling drug ma'i nang‘‘yi ge rtsom mi’’zhes pa la sogs pa'i nang don des gsal por rtogs 618

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad jes kyi dpyad brjod/nus shing / da lta sog po'i yul gru kun gyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang rgyun mar spyod pa'i sog yig brtsegs ma can 'di dag 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas gsar bzo gnang ba'i sog yig gam hor yig gi rmang gzhi de'i thog nas rim pas 'phel rgyas song ba da lta sog yig brtsegs mar 'bri ba'i 'gros 'dis rtogs thub pa 'di'i thog nas bod rigs kyi blo gros ni kho lag yangs por grol ba gang dag legs par mtshon thub cing / bod yig yig gzugs kyi rnam grangs mang po'i nang du yang rgyun spyod dbu chen dbu med phud pa'i tham ga'i kha ris dang / mdzes ris sogs la spyod go che shos su gyur yod/gsum pa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang gi bka' rtsom gyi mdzad pa kho nar mtshon na'ang mchog dman bar mar gnang ba'i chab shog snyan ngag gi lam du spel gnang mdzad pas mtshon/ chos srid lugs zung gi mdzad pa gang zhig gi gsung rtsom mtha' dag tshig don phun sum tshogs shing / snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ches mtho ba dang ldan pas bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la dngos shugs nas nus pa dpag par dka' ba thon yod/ skabs 'dir mdzad pa 'di'i dpe mtshon du gsung rtsom dum bu gnyis drangs pa 'di lta ste/khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po bla ma bde bar gshegs pa(sa paṇa gyi sku gdung)la/ chos gos rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya bas mchod par byed pa'i rab tu bsngags pa/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes pa'i nang sa paṇa gyi mdzad par bsngags pa/yon tan pha rol phyin pa bzhi/ /619

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/brnyes pa khyod kyis dam pa'i don/ /'gro 'ong med par thugs chud slad/ /mi g.yo bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi cho 'phrul gsum gyis rnam par 'phrul khyod bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / /gzhan du gzhan la mos pa ji bzhin kun tu sprul pa'i sku yi rnam 'phrul gang / /skad cig nyid la'ang bgrang ba las 'das nye bar ston mdzad yid ltar mgyogs pa ste/ /mdzad pa de dag rmad du byung ba'i 'bras bu mchog gis brgyan par smos ci 'tshal /bsam gyis mi khyab dam pa'i don/ /gzigs pa khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings/ /brjod du med par thugs chud slad/ /mi gsung bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi mi 'jigs bzhi yis brnyengs pa dang bral zhing / /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi la kun nas dbang 'byor khyod/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi sgo yis sna tshogs rab bkra'i dngos/ /nye bar mtshon phyir gzhan don chos kyi char chen 'bebs mdzad lags/ /dag pa gnyis kyis rnam dag pas/ /dbyings dang kun tu ro gcig phyir/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma rab zhi'i slad/ /620

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mi rtog par yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi mgon po khyod kyis bskal pa rgya mtshor shes bya kun la kun nas legs sbyangs shing / /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor rnam par bying ba'i sems can rgya mtsho grangs mtha' yas la rab tu brtse ba yi/ /thugs rje chen pos rnam par brlan pa'i yang dag thabs la rab tu brtson mdzad smon lam rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /legs par grub pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed mkhyen phyir mkhyen pa'ang shes bya ji bzhin bkra ba lags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gsung rtsom 'dir mtshon na rkang pa thung ngu dang / ring po dang / shin tu ring po rnams spel zhing 'byung bas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi phreng ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yin pa dang / gsung rtsom gcig shos ni/rgyal po yab sras kyis mchod rten bzhengs pa la bsngags pa sdeb sbyor daṇ+ḍa ka zhes bya ba'i nang gi dum bu gcig ste/ de yang hor jing ger rgyal po yab sras btsun mo dang bcas par bsngags pa brjod pa sngon du btang nas mchod rten bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i skor/ mdzad pa rmad byung rnam par bkra ba'i khang bzang nyid bzhin pho brang gzhal med rnam par bkra ba'i ngos bzhi dag na rnam par bkra ba'i grong khyer rgya chen lha yi grong khyer blta na sdug ltar kun nas dkrigs pa rnam par 'khrigs pas sa yi dkyil 'khor rgyas par khyab gyur de dang rjes 'brel dge 'dun 'dun pa rnam par bkram dbus rnam par brtsegs pa'i kun dga' ra bar tshogs gnyis rang bzhin lhun po brtsegs steng dag gsal ngo bo pad zla'i gdan la bsdu dngos rang bzhin sgo bzhis nyer 621

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mdzes rtogs pa'i bum bzang bum pa'i ngang tshul yon tan sna tshogs rim bzhin brtsegs pa'i bre dang gdugs bcas thugs rje'i char skyob tog gis rab mdzes mdzes pa'i rten la brten pa gang zhig ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbyings la rdo rjer bsgrub pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi lha yi tshogs ni khro rgyal chos skyong nor sbyin bcas dang bla na med pa'i bla ma dam pa bla ma'i bla ma bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas rnam rgyal ba'i ring bsrel snying po can gyur mchod sprin dang bcas kun nas gnas pa'i mchod rten rin chen bzo bo'i mchog gyur bal po'i rigs byung ma gu zhes bya rgya yi bzo bo'i tshogs dang bcas shing mod su dang ni ce'u zho sogs rkyen gyis legs bsgrubs brtsegs pa'i khang par ri mo'i rang bzhin thub dbang 'jam dbyangs bla ma mchog dang chos dbyings ngag dbang rdo rje dbyings dang khams gsum rnam rgyal 'gro ba 'dul ba don kun grub pa tshe dpag med dang gtsug tor dgur bcas ngan song sbyong ba'i 'khor lo'i tshogs ni bla ma'i rim pas rim par mdzes byas dge 'dun zhes bya grogs dang bcas pas kun nas legs bris rgya chen bkod pa de dag mchod dang bstan pa 'dzin byed tshogs kyi gtso bo sdom brtson tshogs bcas sna tshogs rig byed rig pa'i tshogs dang sna tshogs gzhung lugs smra ba'i tshogs rnams bkur sti'i tshogs kyis bkur bar byas dang sna tshogs yul dang skad kyis phye ba'i skye dgu sna tshogs rnam par 'dres pas 'dres pa'i tshal bzhin rnam par bkra zhing 'byor pa gnyis kyis kun nas legs 'byor nyid kyi dpal las rnam par byung ba'i dpal 'byor 'di 'dra srid pa ji srid brtan par gyur zhes gsungs pa'i rtsom tshul 'di'i mjug bsdoms su/'di yi ming ni daṇ+ḍa ka zhes bgyi/ /622

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/yi ge chig stong sum brgya don dgu mchis/ /brjod bya 'di don gzhan la ma mchis pas /rjod byed 'di yang de 'drar yosmo par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba yang mgo nas mjug ma rdzogs bar dbugs thengs gcig la bshar mar gsungs pa bar du tshig mtshams shad kyis bcad med pa 'di dang gong gi rtsom tshul bcas nas gsal por mthong ba'i bod kyi snyan ngag rtsom tshul la mtha' med pa'i ngo mtshar 'di lta bu yang mkhyen par mdzod cig /karma rang byung rdo rje/karma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje ni/ yab chos dpal dang / yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel(128grulor gtsang stod skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti'i lha khang gi lho phyogs gangs khur mo zhes par sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga par grub chen o rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / mtshan rang byung rdo rjer gsol/ dgung lo bdun par khro phu shes rab kyis mkhan po mdzad de dge tshul bsgrubs/dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags glang lor gnas brtan gzhon nu 'byung bas mkhan po dang / dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po'i drung nas 'dul ba yongs rdzogs gsan/ de nas slob dpon shes rab dpal dang / rgya sgom ye shes/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub sogs las bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal ma lus pa gsan te karma'i gdan 623

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sar byon/ shing glang lor kong por gdan drangs te sgrub sde 'ga' btab/ de nas mdo khams su byon/ sog chur lcags zam btsugs/ rab byung drug pa'i chu sprel(1332)lor gong mas rgya nag tu gdan drangs skabs rgyal po rat+na bī sogs kyis bsu ba rgya chen zhus/ de rjes rgyal po tho gan the mur gyis/ sman rtse'i yul du gdan drangs te rgyal po dang btsun mo blon po sogs la dbang bskur mdzad/ shing khyi lor bod du phebs/ rgyal pos gnang ba'i 'ja' sa bsgrags shing dngul gyi bstan 'gyur bzhengs/ me glang(1337)lor slar yang rgya nag pho brang chen por phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal/ dgung lo nga drug pa sa yos (1339)lor rgya nag tu sku gshegs/karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung rtsom ston pa'i skyes rabs kyis mtshon pod gsum lhag tsam bzhugs pa'i nang nas ston pa'i skyes rabs brgya pa zhes pa 'di ni sngon rgya gar gyi mkhas mchog slob dpon dpa' bos ston pa'i skyes rabs sum cu rtsa bzhi mdzad cing / karma pa rang byung rdo rje de nas mthud de ston pa'i skyes rabs drug cu rtsa bdun mdzad pa bsdoms pas skyes rabs brgya dang gcig yod pas de'i mtshan la skyes rabs brgya par grags pa yin no/ /skye rabs brgya pa'i mtshan byang la/ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i skyes rabs phreng / /bcu phrag gsum dang bzhi ni dpa' bo'i ste/ /phyi nas rang byung rdo rjes bdun lhag pa'i/ /drug cu skyes rabs brgya rtsa rdzogs par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdo sde las byung ba'i rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rnams rtsom gzhir mdzad de skyes rabs so lnga pa seṅge'i rgyal 624

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/po yi dam brtan pa'i skyes pa'i rabs nas skyes rabs brgya dang rtsa gcig pa byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa'i skyes pa'i rabs bar mdzad/skabs 'dir skyes rabs brgyad cu pa dpal gyi sde'i sbyin pa'i brtan pa brtag pa'i slad du brgya byin gyis bram ze sked pa chad pa nyam thag pa'i tshul du sprul nas rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i sku smad sbyin par re ba'i nang don dum bu gcig dpe mtshon du drangs pa 'di lta ste/de yang 'di ltar snying rje ba'i gnas su gyur pa skyes pa dang bud med rnams kyis mthong nas snying rjes gdungs pa'i yid kyis gcig la gcig smra ba/grogs po dag bram ze 'di sked pa chad cing 'di'i dbang po'ang ma 'khrugs pa ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ 'di mi ma yin sha za mi'i cha byad kyis bdag cag rnams bza' ba'i phyir 'dir 'ongs kyis mi sked pa chad pa ni 'tsho ba med do/ /de skad ces thos pa dang skyes bu snga ma rnams ni 'jigs pas 'bros par brtsams so/ /skyes bu dpa' bo gzhan zhig 'di snyam du 'di ni sha za zhig ste de lta na'ang tshor bas nyen bzhin du 'di ltar dbang po rnams bde bar snang na de ci lta bu yin/ bdag gis 'di la dri bar byas na 'dis tshig thon par dka' mod kyis gal te tshig thon na ni ngo mtshar du 'gyur ro snyam nas smras pa/ bram ze khyod ci mi yin nam 'on te sha za yin/ de nas brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs 'dug pa des sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pos nyen par ston cing smras pa/skyes bu khyod ni ma 'jigs shig /bram ze nga yin srin po min/ /sngon gyi las kyi nyes pa yis/ /625

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnas skabs 'di 'dra thob par gyur/ /'di nyid du ni kun bshad na/ /dus ni kun tu 'da' bar 'gyur/ /'chi bdag myur du 'ongs nas ni/ /srog ni 'phrog par 'gyur du 'ong / /chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar ni/ /'di dag kun kyang bshad par bya/ /sngon gyi las kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /da rung nga la 'bras bcas 'gyur/ /yon tan kun gyi rnam mdzes las/ /zla ba lta bur zhi ba dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims la dga' ba/ /gtso bo gang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du zab gyur cing / /ri rab lta bur mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi gtso gyur pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po gang na bzhugs/ /'jigs shing skrag pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /slong ba rnams kyi bgrod bya'i mchog /snyan smra sbyin dang tshul khrims ldan/ / —bdag nyid che de gang na bzhugs/ /bdag mdun 'chi bdag nyer 'ongs kyi/ /626

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/shi ba'i pha rnams myur du smyos/ /thugs rje can de ma gtogs par/ /nga la lus phyed su zhig ster/ /de ltar rgyal po'i rna lam nas snying rje ba dang/ dman pa dang / zhum pa'i tshig smra zhing / rim gyis rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i pho brang sgor song ba dang / srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyang ngo mtshar skyes nas rjes bzhin 'brangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gsung rtsom 'di ni snyan ngag chen po'i mtshan nyid ldan pa bcad lhug spel ma'i bdag nyid can zhig yin no/ /klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer/klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer ram/ mtshan gzhan tshul khrims blo gros ni/ yab bstan pa srung dang / yum 'brog bza' bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i sa spre(1308)lor dbus lho g.yo ru gra'i cha stod grong du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga nas slob gnyer gnang 'go tshugs te karma pa rang byung rdo rje dang / sa skya bdag chen/ rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza sogs mkhas grub mang po bsten pa dang / g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi mdun du rig lam mang por dogs dpyod kyang mdzad pa bcas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa thugs su chud de mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas phal mo che dang / lhag par du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dpal chu bo ri dang / o rgyan gyi yul sogs su phebs/ khong la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba dang / (1362)lor chos 627

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'byung rin po che'i gter mdzod gsung rtsom mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung drug pa'i chu yos(1363)lor dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu ru dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/klong chen rab 'byams pa chen po'i gsung rtsom la mtshon na khams pa chos grags bzang pos mdzad pa'i(kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi rnam thar mthong ba don ldan〉zhes bya ba'i nang bstan par/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rtsom la phyi'i gnas thun mong gi skor bstan bcos dgu bcu go lnga dang / nang gi gnas rgya cher bshad pa'i bstan bcos chig brgya nyer brgyad/ gsang ba'i gnas de kho na nyid ston pa'i bstan bcos sum cu ste khyon bsdoms bstan bcos nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs par grags pa'i nang nas rtsom rigs gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon lta bur〈po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam〉gyi dum bu zhig drangs na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po gnas pa'i yul gyi mi legs pa'i tshul la skyo ba skye ba'i dus nam zhig gi tshe na ri bo gangs can nas 'ongs pa'i lha'i bu kha cig nam mkha'i lam nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba mthong ba rnams la khyed cag gang du bzhud ces dris pa'i lan du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bzhugs pa'i gnas po ta lar song nas chos nyan du 'gro ba yin zhes dang /po ta la'i gnas de'i yon tan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan pas yid phrogs nas ngang pa'i rgyal po 'khor bzhin bzang dang bcas pa yang shar phyogs su po ta lar song nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la chos zhu ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i lam du grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yin nam snyam par slebs pa'i skabs grong khyer de'i snod bcud bkod pa gleng ba 'di lta ste/628

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/skye bo dam pa'i mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /legs smon bsod nams stobs kyang bsam mi khyab/ /mchog la bsten pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge dang mi dge'i rnam smin bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar bgrod pa'i shar phyogs na yid du 'ong ba'i gnas skye shing sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i dbus na grong dang gtsug lag khang mang po phyed tsam gsal ba dag mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa/'khri shing ra bas bskor ba yi/ /grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni/ /phyed tsam 'dzum pas blta ba bzhin/ /mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci zhig kye/ /ngang pa'i rgyal pos smras pa/skye shing phreng bas bskor ba'i grong khyer dbus/ /gzhal med khang mthong yid 'ong mdzes pa ni/ /nor bu'i chun 'phyang gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs/ /grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yin nam snyam/ /zhes brjod de mthar gyis de'i nye 'khor du phyin pa na/ tsan+dan 'khri shing gis bskor ba'i 'obs chus yongs su gang bar me tog sna tshogs kyis khebs shing / chu bya sna tshogs rtse zhing lding ba mthong nas bzhin bzang gis smras pa/me tog 'dzum pa'i na chung dag /mdzes pa'i bya dang lhan cig tu/ /rdzing bu'i nang na gsar du rgyas/ /629

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'di ni lha yi pad mtsho'am ci/ /ngang pa'i rgyal pos smras pa/'obs kyi chu dag g.yo ba dag /'khri shing gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa yi/ /lbu ba phreng ba'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /dpag bsam rnams la 'gongs pa bzhin/ /zhes brjod de grong khyer gyi gzhir song ba na/ skye bo mang pos gang ba'i grong dang gtsug lag khang de dag rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang nye ba'i phyir dgun gyi dus su nyi ma'i 'od zer ha cang mi tsha zhing / zla ba'i 'od zer chu'i mdangs dang 'dres pa tsan+dan sa mchog gi tshal ltar shin tu bsil la/ sos ka dang /dbyar dang / ston rnams ni zla ba'i 'od zer mchog tu mi bsil zhing / nyi ma'i 'od zer rgya mtshor lhung ba'i stobs kyis nor bu me shel dwangs pa'i phung po nye bar gnas pa bzhin du rab tu tsha zhing / phal cher rmugs pa'i do shal dang /mtsho rlangs 'khyil ba'i khrod nas chu'i zegs ma phra mo dag char zims bu ltar 'bab cing sbrang ma'i sgra skad sna tshogs su grags pa de'i phyir/ sbrang skyabs dang /bsil khang dang / 'phyang khang dang / phyed phib dang / skar khung drwa ba can dang / sgyug ma'i bsil khang la sogs pa bkod pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing /tshong 'dus dang / bzhi mdo rnams su rin po che dang / sman dang / kha zas dang / bzhon pa dang / btung ba dang / gos sna tshogs kyis bkram pa'i tshong khang yid du 'ong bar skye bo mang pos gang zhing / srang dang / sum mdo rnams su yul dang phyogs tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i mgron po du ma lang long du gyur cing / gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / bsam gtan spyod pa'i rab tu 630

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/byung ba mang pos gang bar mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa/yid 'ong grogs dag 'od rgus rab 'byor cing / /phyogs kyi skye bo mang po nye bar 'dud / /gtsug lag khang rnams mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing / /bsam gtan spyod pa dag gi skye bos gang / /zhes gsungs pa ni bcad lhug spel ma'i rang bzhin gyi rtsom rig ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa 'di lta bu'i rtsom rtsal la nang byan chud pa zhig byung tshe deng dus la mtshon na'ang lha sa'i rnam pa gsar pa lta bu grong dang grong brdal gyi 'tsho ba gsar pa'i snod bcud kyi dge mtshan bzang po bde blag tu ri mo'i lam du spel bar yang dka' ba yod re skan/spyan snga pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/spyan snga pa blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ yab dgyer dpon chos skyabs dang /yum jo mo bla ma 'bum zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i chu rta (1402)lor yul dbus stod lhas lung ba chos grwa grwa dgon gyi zhol grwa rnam khang zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/dgung lo gsum bzhi nas yi ge sbyor klog sbyangs/ dgung lo bdun pa sa byi(1408)lor khu bo kun dga' blo gros kyi drung du rab tu byung / mtshan blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol/de nas grwa dgon du mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab pa'i drung du phar tshad mthar phyin par sbyangs/ skyor mo lung du mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal 631

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bzang po dang / slob dpon shes rab bzang po gnyis kyi drung du mdo rtsa gsan sbyong mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa sa khyi(1428)lor gtsang phyogs su byon/ri bo mdangs can du mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang / chos rje blo gros pa gnyis kyi drung du rtsa 'jug gnyis dang / mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang po gsan sbyong mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par zha lu dang gnas snying rnams su phar tshad dang / mdo rtsa/ rtsa 'jug sogs kyi grwa skor mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa lcags byi(1420)lor mkhan po yon tan rin chen dang / las slob slob dpon nor bzang / gsang ston rnam par dag pa rnams kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas snga gzhug te rje tsong kha pa chen po dang / rgyal tshab rje/mkhas grub rje/ chos rje blo gros pa bcas dga' ldan gyi khri thog phebs pa bzhi dang / gzhan rje btsun 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun bzang skyong ba/ gnas brtan chen po chos skyong ba/ dgyer kun dga' blo gros/ rin po che gzhon nu 'od sogs bcu phrag gnyis la nye ba'i mkhas grub dam pa rnams legs par bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung kun la mkhas par gyur cing / bstan pa rin po che'i gtsug rgyan du gyur pa de nas dus yun ring por 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas mal gyo rin chen sgang dang skam dgon du bzhugs te sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ phag lo zla ba gnyis par rin chen sgang gi gdan sar phebs te khri thog bzhugs/ rje 'di nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa bstan pa 'dzin pa mang du byon pa'i nang nas gtso bo rab byams pa smon lam dpal/ chos rje kun legs pa/ chos rje rab byams blo bzang sogs ni khyad du 'phags pa yin/ de ltar bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad nas mthar dgung lo don gcig pa rab byung brgyad pa'i chu 'brug(1472)lor sku gshegs/632

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rje 'di nyid kyi snyan ngag gsung rtsom kyi dpe mtshon du spyan snga rin chen dpal la phul ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa tshangs pa'i cod pan zhes bya ba/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlabs chen bsod nams mngon mtho'i byed po yis/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal po dbang bskur te/ /skal bzang 'gro la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dpal gyis bajid/ /sku gnyis mngon gyur 'phrin las bzang po yis/ /'gro ba ma lus bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla mas rtag tu dge legs stsol/ /'phags pa'i yul du rgyud sde rgya mtsho sbyangs/ /sum cu gsum du lha rnams bde la bkod/ /ma 'ongs zhing mchog dam par gshegs so zhes/ /mchog tu lung bstan khyod zhabs gus bsten gyi/ /bdag kyang khyod kyi zhing mchog dam par der/ /dam pa mnyes pa'i 'phrin las bgyid par shog /skye bo kun gyi mgo bo'i cod pan rnams/ /gang gi rin chen khri la rab 'dud pa'i/ /nyi ma'i gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i rigs brnyes pa'i/ /'khrungs tsam nyid nas 'gro ba'i skyabs su gyur/ /633

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/skyabs mchog khyod la rtag tu gsol 'debs kyi/ / bdag sogs sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba la/ /lam mchog gru snod rnams la rim gyis sbyangs/ /bar du rgyud sde rgya mtsho thugs su chud/ /tha mar gsung rab bdud rtsi rdzogs par gsol/ /thos bsam sgom gsum phyi nang theg pa rnams/ /rim gyis mthar phyin mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten blo gros chu rgyun kun sdoms kyang / /khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i chu gter dgang mi nus/ /mkhyen pa'i gter zhes snyan pa'i grags pa yis/ /'dzam gling 'od kyis bkang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi tshul khrims sa 'dzin dbang po la/ /yid kyi srubs shing 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /'phrin las 'jug pa'i go skabs yongs ma rnyed/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /bde gshegs dngos kyis 'dul dka' dmu rgod rnams/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis dkar po'i las lam la /legs par 'god mkhas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i chus bcus tshogs gnyis sdong po rgyus/ /pha rol phyin drug yal ga'i khyon yangs shing / /rnam grol 'bras bu yongs su smin pa yi/ /634

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rkang 'thung dbang po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod thugs rgyud sde'i bya lam yangs pa la/ /phra rags lha yi kyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /dga' ba rnam bzhi'i 'dod stong rab 'phro ba/ /nyin byed dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'od dkar rab rgyas shing / /lhag bsam cha shas bcu drug yongs su rdzogs/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i snyigs dus mtshan mo'i mgon/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la bstod pa yis/ /bshes gnyen bsten la mi mkhas sgrib pa yi/ /'dam du bying ba'i bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /byams dang snying rje'i phyag gis legs drangs nas/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gnas mchogathob par shog /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / /mi mnyes mi byed bka' bzhin bsgrub pa yis/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /brgya phrag nyams kyi gar gyi rnam 'gyur can/ /snyan ngag yid 'ong gzhon nu khyod nyid kyang / /pho nya'i dri bzhon rta la rab 'dzegs te/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i spyan sngar 'phur te song / /'dzum mdangs yid 'ong nor bu'i 'od 'khyug cing / /635

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/snyan pa'i gre 'gyur g.yo bas 'di skad gsol/ /gang sku nyin byed gza' yis ma bsgribs shing / /'phrin las 'od stong 'gyed par 'khums pa yis/ /yid kyi shing rta dga' ba'i 'khor lo bzhis/ /gsung rab rin chen gling du drangs gyur lags/ /slad mar phan bde kun gyi sgo gcig pu/ /thub bstan kun dga'i tshal rab rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'phrin las 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'gyed pa dang / /yab rje dam pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshe/ /bu yis dgos pa bgyi ba'i dus bab kyang / /'du 'dzi me yi 'obs la snying 'dar te/ /mtshams kyi dam pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings/ /gsung rab sbrang rtsi'i bde ba myang ba la /chags pas gang yang bsgul bskyod yong ma nus/ /der ni thub bstan pad+mo'i gnyen khyod kyis/ /thub bstan pad tshal sbrang rtsi myang 'dod la/ /'jigs med bde bar gnas pa'i mchog stsol zhes/ /gus pas thal mo lan brgyar btud de zhus/ /de ltar gsol slad bya btang tshul 'dzin la/ /'gro kun dga' ba skye ba'i nor ma mchis/ /gang gi bka' las bla med mchod pa ni/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa yin zhes bka' stsal phyir/ /636

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mchod pa 'di ni lhod pa med pa bgyi/ /'on kyang nyid la gus pa'i lhag bsam ni/ /snying nas mi 'dor mtshon phyir rgya lam na/ /bsod nams stobs kyis thob pa'i zhal skyems mchog /zho yi phyed la the'u'i ri mos mdzes/ /lto 'gro'i lo la 'od dkar can bzhi pa/ /rgyu skar bdag por gyur tshe legs par phul/ /slar yang gtam snyan nor bu'i skyes khyer nas/ /legs par 'ongs pas don rnams 'grub par byas /zhes pa 'di btsun pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis grwa dgon du jo bo'i sku tshad bzhengs pa'i dus su spyan snga'i drung du phul ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cigaces gzugs rgyan shas che ba'i chab shog 'bul gnang mdzad pa 'di'i nang don zab la snyan ngag gi nyams dang 'gyur ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung rtsom 'di lta bu khong gi gsung rtsom khrod shin tu mang ngo / /jo nang tā ra nā tha/jo nang rje btsun kun dga' snying po'am yongs grags su rje btsun tā ra nā tha mchog ni/ yab rwa lo'i gdung rgyud rnam rgyal phun tshogs dang / yum rdo rje bu dga' lha mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing phag(1575)lor chos 'khor sdings su sku bltams/ mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes su 637

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bzhi lon skabs sde pa sna dkar rtse bas bskul ma dang 'brel mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtshos jo nang du gdan drangs/ jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ yi ge 'bri klog rnams ched du yongs 'dzin ma bsten par rang stobs kyis mkhyen/ dgung lo brgyad bzhes skabs stag lung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung / mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ sprul pa'i bshes gnyen rgya gar ba dz+wa la nā tha mchog gis tā ra nā tha zhes su mtshan bstsal ba'i gzigs snang byung bas phyis su mtshan de yongs grags su gyur/ mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung du ma gsan/ rje rdo ring pa chen po las lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i sa skya'i chos skor mang po'i dbang dang gdams pa gsan/ rje brag stod pa chos sku lha dbang grags pa las phyag chen sogs kyi man ngag gsan/mkhan lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i byin rlabs don brgyud bcas bstsal/ bka' dang bstan bcos mang po'i lung gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang / ye shes dbang po sogs las sa skya dang / jo nang /shangs pa/ zha lu/ 'brug pa/ rka tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor du ma'i dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa na mkhan po 'dul 'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgya gar grub chen sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po las rgyud sde'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan te sngags bla med kyi gzhung la bod 'dir sngon med kyi blo 638

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/skyed lnga brgya tsam byung ba rje rang nyid kyis gsungs shing / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rba ṇa shrī dang / purna badz+ra sogs las zab chos mang po dang / sgra sogs phyi nang gi rig gnas mtha' yas pa gsan bsam mdzad de mkhas pa'i yang rtser son cing / mdo sngags zung gi nyams len gnad du sbyangs pas sa lam gyi yon tan mngon du brnyes te grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/dgung lo nyer gcig skabs jo nang ri khrod du gdan sa mdzad/ jo nang dus khrid chen mo btsugs te chos khrid rgyas par gnang /dgung grangs nyer drug bzhes skabs rwa sgrong sogs su phebs te rgya dpe gzigs pa na gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud skad gnyis kyis smra ba'i spobs pa che zhing shugs myur bas kun gyis ngo mtshar te bsngags brjod zhus/dgung lo zhe gcig par gtsang pa sde srid rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang lha 'bangs sogs phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi gsar bzhengs mdzad pa sogs bshad sgrub las gsum gyis bstan pa la phyag bzhes 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad/mthar dgung grangs re gcig rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (1635)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul mdzad/rje 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las skyong ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal sogs jo nang pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams dang /gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal yab sras dang / byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs bstan pa stobs kyis 'degs pa'i sa skyong sbyin bdag kyang 639

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mang du byung /rje btsun mchog gi gsung rtsom skor la/ ston pa'i mdzad brgya dang / rgya gar chos 'byung sogs paṇa grub mang po'i rnam thar dang / sher rnying / bzang spyod sogs dang / dus 'khor/ bde mchog gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung 'grel skor dang / lhag par theg mchog rgyas pa'i dbu ma sogs gzhan stong gi lta grub skor dang / rgyud sde'i cho ga du ma dang / bstod tshogs dang smon lam sogs yongs su rdzogs par glegs bam bzhi bcu lhag mdzad de mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par nges don dbu ma chen mo jo nang pa'i ring lugs tshang la ma nor ba'i sgo nas gsal bar mdzad cing /sbyor drug nyams len gyi rgyun spel te sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs par mdzad do/ /skabs 'dir rje 'di nyid kyis bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag la phyag rjes 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du jo nang gi gnas bshad las dum bu gcig drangs pa 'di ltar te/i susti/rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang / /zla bzang 'jam dpal grags pa pad dkar sogs/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / /dus 'khor zhabs dang zla ba mgon po dang / /rigs ldan rnam 'phrul chos rje yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag cag 'dir tshogs skal ldan gdul bya la/ /640

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'dir zhing khams mchog tu gyur pa mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ /gling khyad bar can bdun pa las kyi sa/ /dum bu bla na med pa 'dzam gling lho'i phyogs/ /rgyal khams ngo mtshar can pur rgyal bod kyi yul/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi zhing khams khud pa/ / rgyal sras byang sems kun gyi mdzod pa'i spyod yul/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun gyi gnas mchog dam pa/ /gangs can ljongs 'di'i lte ba sa'i thig le/ /ri bo stong phrag du ma'i dbus na mngon par 'phags pa/ /sa 'dzin dbang po nags rgyal dpal gyi ri/ /ru lag g.yas ru'i sa mtshams/ /phyi ltar na sangs rgyas kun gyi zab mo'i chos sgra sgrog pa'i gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri/ /nang ltar na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang dam pa ri bo po ta khukhu /gsang ba ltar na rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang 'byung zhing / /dar ba'i gnas byang phyogs shaṃ bha la/ /de kho na nyid ltar na dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor/ / don dam ye shes sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs e waṃ zung 'jug gi ngo bo/ / 641

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/sgrub gnas bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na lhun po ltar mngon par mtho zhing / /grags pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ /ri khrod chen po jo nang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i gnas kyi che ba'i dbang du byas na/ /sa gzhi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan dang / /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che ba dang / /sgrub brgyud chu bo ri gzhung ltar rgyun ma chad cing dar ba'i gzi brjid dpal ldan pa'o/ /dang po sa la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan ni/ /gangs can man+da ra dang lhun po sogs/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bgrang yas kyis/ /nye bar bsten pa'i ri yi rgyal po rnams/ /phyogs 'dir gcig tu 'dus pa lta bu yod/ /phyogs bzhi'i ri rnams rtse mo shin tu mtho/ /rtsa ba brtan cing dbyibs legs lhun stug chags/ /ngos rnams sman ljongs nyams dga' yangs pa dang / /zla ba chu shel in+d+ra nī la sogs/ /nor bu'i phung po brtsegs 'dra'i brag ri mdzes/ /ri bo'i sul rnams nags tshal sna tshogs dang / /ljon shing du mas rnam par brgyan pa yod/ /zla ba drug tu me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /642

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun sel byed pa/ /sman mchog rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yin/ /dri zhim ngad kyi phyogs kun khyab pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'bras bu chags pa ni/ /'chi med dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pa'am/ /mi'am ci yi rgyal po ljon pa ni/ /'khor bcas rol zhing rtse ba'i skyed tshal 'dra/ /ri bo'i mgul nas char sprin gsar pa 'khrigs/ /bdud rtsi'i char zim rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog thos na nyams dga' zhing / /bsdad pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin ngang gis skye/ /klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho'i rtse sa 'dra/ /'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgra 'byin cing / /ri dwags du ma bag yang bde bar rgyu/ /'dab chags sna tshogs snyan pa'i ca co sgrog /rta bdun dbang po lho yi khyim gnas pa'i/ /zla ba drug tu ri dang ri bo'i sul/ /ri drung ri yi shod kyi ngogs rnams su/ /rmad byung ya mtshan kha dog sna tshogs 'char/ /ston ni gser dang byu ru'i phreng ba spel/ /dgun dus ri dbang rgyas pa'i rtse mo rnams/ /bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas lta bur 'gyur/ /643

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab chu du ma can/ /ri mtho sa gtsang rig pa shin tu dwangs/ /lu ha ta zhes chu klung tshangs pa'i bu/ /'bab chu'i rgyal po byang gi phyogs su rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i zhal mthong grub pa'i dam la gnas/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa gces par skyong ba yi/ /lha mo mthu ldan nags sman rgyal mo ni/ /lha sman 'bum gyi tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /dga' bas rol zhing lha srin sde brgyad la/ /dbang sgyur rdzu 'phrul chen pos skyong ba'i gnas/ /ri rgyal 'di yi ri 'dabs khor yug na/ /grub pa'i gnas dang lha khang gtsug lag khang / /chos grwa brgya phrag du mas bskor te gnas/ /de las khyad par gnas mchog dam pa 'di/ /sa gzhi e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dra/ /mkha' la rang byung 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs/ /ri rnams pad+ma 'dab rab rgyas pa 'dra/ /nub byang dpal gyi ri bo sdong por rkyong / /mtho ring brjid chags ri brgyud du mas bskor/ /phyi rol rgyal khams gzhan nas bltas pa'i tshe /sa las rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur 'phags/ /khams 'di'i sa 'di gang nas bltas gyur kyang / /644

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'khor los bsgyur rgyal gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ /byang shar phyogs na rta mchog rin chen zung / /de yi drung na dmag dpon rin po che/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba 'dra ba yod/ / byang gi phyogs na nye bar brten pa ni/ /brag ri'i phreng ba 'khor lo rin chen 'dra/ /de 'og seng rdzong zhes grags brag ri ni/ /blon po rin chen gtso la gus pas 'dud/ /nor bu rin chen 'dra ba'i brag ri ni/ /nub byang phyogs gnas ri de'i ngos la ni/ /'dab chags dbang po du ma dga' bas rol/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog du mas brgyan pa yod/ /lho yi phyogs na yid 'ong ri yi dbyibs/ /btsun mo rin chen mngon du phyogs pa 'dra/ /nub phyogs ri ni glang chen nyal ba bzhin/ /mdun ri lhun chags sman ljongs rgyas pa ni/ /'bru yi phung po lta bur dbyibs legs shing / /gnod sbyin dbang po gser gyi bdag po'i gtso/ /'phags pa dzam+bha la yi dbyibs su yod/ /phu ni gzengs mtho lcags ri lta bus bskor/ /mda' ni ma shor phyag rgya lta bur bsnol/ /shar ri'i ngos la bkra shis dpal be'u dang / /645

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnas lugs mtshon pa e yig gsal bar dod/ /g.yon phyogs dngul gyi bye mas g.yogs 'dra ba'i/ /ri bo dar yol lta bus mdzes par byas/ /don dam e la waṃ yig bzhugs pa ltar/ /gnas kyi lte bar mthong grol chen mo ni/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan ni/ /rmang ni sa gzhi lta bur rgya che zhing / /rtse mo skyo med gnas la reg pa snyam/ /bkod legs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho zhes bya'i zhing khams dang / /'od dpag med kyi gnas mchog bde ba can/ /mi 'khrugs zhing khams mngon dga' la sogs dang / /'dod pa'i khams kyi mchog rab dga' ldan dang / /gzugs khams rtse mo dbang phyug chen po'i zhing / /mkha' khyab 'og min stug po bkod pa sogs/ /kun 'dus bdag nyid mchod rten dpal yon can/ /sku gzugs gzhal du med pas gsang ba bzhugs/ /mtha' skor khor ra khor yug phyogs kun tu/ /646

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas bgrang yas yod/ /dbus na he ru ka dpal dus 'khor sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /phyi rol phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor zab mo dang / /rgya che'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni sus bsdad kyang / /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs ngang gis sangs/ /dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gnyid rmugs sel zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /zhen chags sel zhing nges 'byung 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gnod sems bri zhing snying rje rgyas pa'i gnas/ /rnam g.yeng spangs shing zhi gnas brtan pa'i gnas/ /log rtog mi 'gyur lhag mthong ngang gis skye/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyis bsngags pa brjod pa dang / /the'u rang 'gong pos grags pa bsgrags pa dang / /dbang sdud nor sgrub la sogs rten 'brel gyis/ /'du 'tshog can dang grags pa che ba 'gar/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams chu ltar rgyug pa la/ /zhing mchog dam par 'khrul dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /gzhan du lo dang zla bar bsgoms pa bas/ /647

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ gnas mchog 'dir ni zhag dang za ma tsam/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon lhag par che ba yin/ /gzhan du dge sbyor 'bad de bsgoms pa bas/ /sdig pa'i las spangs chos dang bla ma la/ /mos gus byas nas gnas 'dir nyal ba yang / /bla med byang chub phyogs la nye ba yin/ /nya pa gdol pa ri dwags rngon pa dang / /mtshams med byed pa la sogs sdig can yang / /gnas 'di bskor cing sgrub chu 'thung ba dang / /khrus byas phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa phul/ /de yis sdig pa dag nas lha yul skye/ /skye bo gzhan dag rmos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /gnas mchog 'di ni mthong ba don ldan yin/ /zhes jo nang gi sa gzhi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan rgya cher bsngags pa dum bu 'di'i nang 'jig rten snod bcud kyi khyad par dang / yul gyi bkod pa/ dus bzhi'i rang byung khams kyi rnam pa sogs don dngos mang po snyan dngags kyi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa 'di ni rang cag rnams kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag dngos nang yul gyi bkod pa sogs sa gzhi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan rgya cher bsngags 'os pa'i snyan rtsom 'bri stangs kyi mig dpe phul byung zhig yin pa nges par mkhas pa'i dbang po 'di'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur dang / brjod don phun sum tshogs par zhib mo'i blo yis dpyad de rang rang gi blo gros kyi kho lag yangs por grol ba bya 648

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyu ni shin tu nas gal che bar mthong ngo / /mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ni/ yab se rigs sngags 'chang gi gdung rgyud ma nyams pa kun dga' bkra shis dpal bzang dang / yum bu 'dren rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i shing glang(1385)lor gtsang la stod chu 'og tu sku 'khrungs pa mkhas grub lha dbang blo'i sku skyer grags/khong sku na chung ngu'i dus nas bzung ngam ring dang / sa skya sogs su phebs te mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung mang por gsan bsam gnang ba tshegs med par mkhyen pas kun yid 'phrog pa byung /de nas mkhas chen seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung nas rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyi drung nas bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/dgung lo nyer gsum par rje tsong kha pa chen po dang mjal ba de nas dgung lo so lnga'i bar rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdun sku dang grib ma bzhin 'bral ba med par bcar bzhugs kyis mdo rgyud man ngag gi gdams pa ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa sdom brtson chen po dka' bcu pa dge dpal ba zhes pa'i bsngags brjod chen po mdzad/ cing / nang thugaso kyi sras gcig pur gyur/649

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gzhan yang rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin 'jam dkar ba sogs nas kyang zab chos mang du gsan/de rjes gtsang phyogs su phebs te rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags dang mchod yon du 'brel nas rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde btab pa dang / de nas ri bo mdastas can du byon te thugs dam nyams bzhes/ skal ldan gyi bu slob skyong ba/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang du rtsom pa gsum sbrel du mdzad/dgung lo zhe bdun par dga' ldan gser khrir mnga' gsol/ dgung lo lnga bcur phebs skabs dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od brtsams pa dang /dge ldan du mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs/ lnga mchod kyi srol btod/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngul gdung la gser gyi rgya phibs gsar bskrun gnang ba sogs bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad nas mthar dgung lo nga bzhi pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa rta(1438)lor dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rtsom la mtshon na/('grel pa don gsal gyi rnam bshad rtogs dka'i snang ba〉 〈dbu ma'i rnam bshad stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed〉 〈dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od〉sogs bstan bcos pod bcu gnyis bzhugs/ mkhas grub chen po'i dngos slob ni/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong dang / zha lu legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje shes rab seng ge/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa sogs mkhas grub grangs las 'das pa byon/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs kyi 650

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sras mchog gnyis kyi ya gyal dang / mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bshad pa'i srol 'byed kyi shing rta chen po yin la gangs can ljongs kyi snyan ngag smra ba'i mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan yang yin/ khong gi snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom gyi khyad chos ni/ bstan bya'i nang don gang dang gang yin rung / gzhung chen po dang 'brel ba dam por mdzad nas rtsom gnang mdzad pas nang don phun sum tshogs la gson nyams ldan pa/ snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal ches mtho ba ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyis bstan bya'i don gzugs su grub pa lta bu'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung bas klog pa po'i yid la spro ba ches cher 'phel ba sogs kyi dge mtshan brjod las 'das shing/ skabs 'dir mkhas grub chen po'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dga' ldan gser khrir mnga' gsol skabs khri 'don gyi sarga mi 'chol ba'i slad ched du bstod pa〈dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs〉zhes yongs grags su dpal ldan yon tan mar grags pa'i nang gi dum bu gcig drangs na/legs bshad 'od dkar rab rgyas shing / /lhag bsam cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /gya gyu'i ri bong mtshan ma dang / /bral ba zla ba khyod shar tshe/ /log smra 'byung po'i bya yi tshogs/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba'ang mtshan mo yi/ /long bas sdug bsngal thob pa dag /mun pa'i khung bu skyabs su 'dzin/ /khyod ni dbyangs can mgrin par byas/ /651

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/legs bshad bdud rtsi zhal la chags/ /phas rgol rgol ba ma lus kyi/kha la smra bcad rgya yang byin/ /mkhas pa gser ri'i phreng ba ni/ /gzi brjid rab rgyas nyi ma yi/ /drung na mar me'i rtse mo dang / /mtshungs pa'i gnas la khyod kyis bkod/ /ces rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi sku che ba'i yon tan gyis skabs de'i mkhas pa'i nang gi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa'i gzi bajid mtshungs pa med pa gsal por rtogs nus pa 'di'i rgyan ni gzugs rgyan la dpa' ba'i nyams 'dres pa 'di kho nas kyang snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom gzhan gyi nyams 'gyur ngo mtshar yang smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa ni gsal por rtogs nus so/ /zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa ni/ yab yum rigs rus cho 'brang bzang po'i rgyud du rab byung bdun pa'i shing spre(140grulor mnga' ris skor gsum gyi char gtogs pa'i zhang zhung du sku 'khrungs/ khong chung ngu'i dus yi ge'i phyi mo slob pa nas bzung rig pa'i gnas la gsan bsam lhur bzhes kyis tshegs me par mkhyen/de rjes dbus su phebs te rje tsong kha pa yab sras gsum dang / mtshungs 652

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/med chos rje dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa dang / sgra tshad snyan ngag sogs thun mong rig gnas la yang sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas pa'i yang rtser gyur/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob rnam dpyod phul du byung ba zung gi ya gyal du grags/dgung lo so lnga par(rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉bka' rtsom mdzad/ de nas nags shod sbus mda'i gdan sar phebs/ dgung lo nga lnga par chab mdo byams pa gling gi khri la phebs nas phar phyin dang / rgyud rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba dang / dgon sde chen po gu ru dpal 'khor gyi khri pa'ang mdzad/dgung lo re drug pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang(1469)lor nags shod spus mda' rnam rgyal dpal 'bar du sku gshegs/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i gsung rtsom la mtshon na/ rnam nges 'thad ldan gyi 'grel bshad dang / dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs skor/ mkhas grub rin po che'i dus 'khor 'grel chen rtsom 'phro'i mjug rdzogs par mdzad pa/gzhan yang snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa rje btsun bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs lha dang bla ma'i bstod pa mang po dang / 〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉sogs snyan ngag gi bka' rtsom mang po dang bcas par pod gcig bzhugs/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa ni/ rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob mkhas grub rgyu skar lta bu'i khrod du snyan ngag smra la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba snyan ngag smra bar mkhas pa'i khyu mchog tu grags shing / khong gis rtsom gnang mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi khyad chos ni tshig sbyor ches brling ba dang / ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyi nang don gting zab tu 'gro ba/ mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed 653

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba/ lhag par khong gis snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i(rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉 bka' rtsom gnang ba 'di ni sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa'i nang du rig byed pa'i gtam rgyud rtsom gzhir mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos phal cher thog ma lta bur mngon/skabs 'dir zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i bka' rtsom〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉 kyi nang nas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa srin pos sprul pa'i ri dwags kha sha gser gyi pags pa can 'ded du song ba'i shul du srin pos sī ta gnas pa'i sa gzhi dang bcas pa srin yul du 'khyer te sī ta srin po'i rgyal po'i dga' mar re ba'i 'dod pa bsgrub mi 'dod pa rang gi bdag po rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang bral ba'i skyo gnas dum bu zhig drangs na/srin po'i ba mos ma reg pa'i/ /sngon du bdag srog pad+ma'i tshal/ /yud kyis nyams byed mtshon dang ni/ /g.yang sa nam zhig rnyed par 'gyur/ /de yi snying gi me dugs kyis/ /skyed mos tshal de bcom byas te/ /ā di'i bu yang tsha ba de/ /ma bzod rgya mtsho 'thung phyir rgyugs/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams kyis ni/ /rigs kyi lha bzhin de mchod kyang / /bye'u'i tshogs la khra dag gis/ /bsnyen bkur byas pa bzhin du'o/ /654

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/zhes gsungs pa'i sho lo ka dang po'i rgyan ni cha shas can gzugs la mya ngan gyi nyams 'dres pa dang/ gnyis pa sems med rab rtog gsum pa ngag don bzhin sgra du ma'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /skabs 'dir snyan tshig dum bu 'di dag phal skad du bshad na/ a tsi/ ci rang drag srin po sdug shi thebs rgyu 'dis nga'i lus la ma reg pa'i gong du nga rang shi rgyu byung na ci ma rung /ske gcod yas kyi gri rnon po dang / mchong sa'i g.yang zhig nga la rnyed na dga' ba la/sī ta btson la 'jug yul srin po'i skyed mos tshal/ sī ta'i snying nad kyi me dugs shin tu tsha ba des skam par byas pa mthong nas ā di'i bu nyi ma yang /sī ta'i snying nad kyi tsha ba shugs chen des kha skom pa ma bzod nas/ nub kyi rgya mtsho'i chu 'thung ba'i phyir du mgyogs par rgyugs song ngo / /ltas ngan ston mkhan srin po de rnams kyis/ sī ta ni rang gi skyes lha dang /rang gi yul lha nang bzhin lha gsol klu gsol byed pa/ de ni bye'u'i tshogs la khra yis mgo skor gtong ba nang bzhin kho'i gdug sems kyi dmigs yul sgrub byed yin pa las lhag bsam rnam dag min no zhes pa lta bu phal skad du bshad na don de gsal po shes pa lta bur snang yang / brtsam sgrung la mtshon na go bde ba gtso bo yin mod/ de bas gal che ba ni grong pa'i tshig snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur dang mi ldan pa'i rtsom yig gis klog pa po'i yid la dga' skyo'i 'char snang zab mo 'jog mi thub pas nges par skad yig gang dang gang gis brtsams pa de dang de'i khyad chos dang bstun te rjod byed tshig sbyor gang legs yong bar do snang byed dgos pa ni shin tu gal che ba des na tshigs bcad du sbyar ba gong 655

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/du bkod pa lta bu'am/ yang na snyan ngag la bcad lhug spel ma gsum du gsungs pa dum bu chung chung 'di lta bu spel mar spel mi 'os kyang lhug mar spel na 'di lta ste/ma rungs pa'i bya ba byed par goms pa srin po'i lus kyi ba mo'i reg pas ma gos pa'i sngon du bdag lus rnam par bkra ba pad ma'i tshal lta bu 'di yud kyis nyams par byed pa'i mtshon rnon po dang / yang na brag g.yang gzar po 'jigs su rung ba zhig nam zhig rnyed par 'gyur ram/ da lta rang rnyed na ci ma rung / gal srid de ltar rnyed na rang lus mtshon gyis phug pa'am/ yang na g.yang sa zab mor mchongs nas de ma thag 'chi ba las 'jig rten 'dir sdod pa'i gnas ga la yod/bdag po dang bral ba sī ta de yi sems sdug mi bzad pa'i me dugs shin tu tsha ba des sī ta btson du bzung ba'i srin po'i skyed mos tshal de yang myur ba myur bar skam par byas pa de'i tshe ā di'i bu tsha zer can du grags pa nyi ma de yang rang gi lus las 'phros pa'i tsha zer de las ldab brgya stong gis lhag pa sī ta'i sems sdug me dugs kyi tsha ba'i ngad kyis kha skom pa ma bzod nas rings pa rings pa'i 'gros kyis nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i chu 'thung bar nyi ma nub rir bzhud 'gro ba la sdod pa'i gnas ni skad cig kyang mi 'dug go /gzigs shig srin po 'di rnams kyis sī ta dga' mar thob pa'i ched du rang gi rigs rgyud kyi skyes lha dang / yul lha/ rang la thun mong gi dngos grub ster ba dang/ 'go ba'i lha la gsol mchod byed pa nang bzhin sī tar bza' btung bzang po bshams nas mchod pa de yang bye'u'i tshogs la khras zas kyis skyong ba lta bu rang 'dod sgrub byed kyi g.yo zol yin pa las/ lhag 656

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bsam bzang po'i bsnyen bkur min pa sī tas legs par rtogs nas nyin mtshan dbye ba med pa rang gi bdag po rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang nam zhig 'grogs pa'i bsam pa de la g.yo ba yong mi srid la/ rtag tu bdag po dran pa'i gdung ba'i ngang la srin po'i btson ra skyed mos tshal der rang dbang dang bral bar gnas so/ /zhes pa lta bu tshig lhug gi sgo nas bshad na'ang klog pa po'i yid la skyo shas kyi snang ba zab mo 'jog pa gdon mi za ba bcas bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi ngo mtshar gleng ba dang chabs cig phal skad dang snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i tshig dum bu chabs cig bkod pa 'di ni bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom gyi dge mtshan gsal por rtogs pa'i ched du lags so/ /657

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ yab tshe ring dpal 'byor dang / yum mtsho rgyal gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu pa'i lcags rta(1570)lor gtsang lhan drug rgya ba'i spe'u zhes par sku bltams/ mtshan chos rgyal dpal ldan bzang po zhes gsol/ sku na chung ngu'i dus su mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyis dben sa pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo bcu gsum par dben dgon du mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang / khri pa dam chos yar 'phel gyi drung du rab tu byung nas mtshan blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa me khyi lor bkra shis lhun por phebs te gzhung chen dka' pod lnga'i mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer dbu tshugs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par bkra shis lhun po'i khri thog bcu bzhi pa dam chos yar 'phel las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo nyer dgu par gangs can chos 'phel gyi khrir phebs/ dgung lo so gnyis par bkra shis lhun po'i khrir phebs/ de rjes bkra shis lhun por rgyud pa grwa tshang btsugs/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa chu glang ( 1613)lo nas bzung lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbu lo drug mdzad/dgung lo zhe drug par bkra shis lhun por li ma lha khang sogs lha khang khag bco lnga'i nang bzhugs rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar du bzhengs/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa me sbrul(1617)lor se 'bras gnyis kyi khrir phebs/ lcags sprel(1620)lor lha ldan lcags po ri'i mtshams su bod sog dmag 'khrug gi zhi chings mdzad pas dmag 'phro chad/ chu khyi(1622)lor 'phyongs rgyas phying 658

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/ba stag rtser 'khrungs pa lnga pa chen po tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du gdan zhu sa/nang ba dang / rab byung dge tshul slong gi bslab sdom dang / mdo sngags kyi zab chos du ma bcas rim par 'bul bzhes mdzad/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sbrul (1629)lor dga' ldan gser thog bzhengs/ shing sprel(164grulorase chen chos rje rgya nag tu ched gtong mdzad nas ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dang dge lugs pa'i dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba thog mar chags/ gong ma shun ṭis bla na med pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'bul bar gser yig pa ched gtong gis tham ga skyes dang bcas phul bar chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas phyir rdzongs mdzad/ gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang 'bog to zhes pa ste blo gros stobs ldan zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/rje 'di nyid lo ngo drug cu lhag tsam gyi ring dbus gtsang / mnga' ris/mdo stod smad/ lho mon/ rgya nag khal kha/ o rod kyi bla dpon che dgu la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ 'khor gsum gyi mdzad bzang mtha' yas pa/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal bstan nyin mo ltar dar bar mdzad cing /chos lugs grub mtha' ris med kyi gtsug tu bkur bzhin pa'i ngang nas mthar dgung lo go gsum pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu stag(1662)lor pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzims chung bka' gdams pho brang du gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rtsom la mtshon na gsang 'dus rim lnga'i 'grel pa dang / bla mchod phyag len rtsa 'grel sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyi bstan bcos rmad du byung ba pod lnga bzhugs pa las 659

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/skabs 'dir bod kyi rtsom rig la phyag rjes 'jog gnang mdzad pa snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs brjod dri za'i glu dbyangs kyi nang nas sa paṇa gyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa dang / lhag par mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo rtsod pas pham par mdzad pa'i dum bu zhig drangs na/zab rgyas chos kyi bang mdzod de/ /'chad pa'i rin chen khrir bzhugs nas/ /legs bshad 'od dkar 'bum spros te/ /mkhas mang kun da'i tshal rab spel/ /mdo rgyud lus stobs rab rgyas shing / /rigs pa'i mche lder mi bzad pas/ /rgol ngan glang chen ma lus pa'i/ /spobs pa'i myos bum cig car dral/ /rnam dpyod lag pa'i sor mo yis/ /mtho ris byang grol lam mtshon pa'i//rnam mang legs bshad phreng spel te/ /blo gsal mgul pa'i rgyan du stsal/ /chos dbyangs las 'ongs sgyu ma yi/ /srin bu khros pa ltar brdzu ba/ /dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyis kyang / /srog snying phul zhing bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /de phyir snyan grags gsar pa yis/ /ba dan srid gsum khongs las brgal/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i yul kun tu/ yongs rdzogs gnas lnga mkhyen pa yi/ /paṇa chen chos rje rang nyid kyis/ /mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mchod brjod du/ /shes bya kun la blta ba'i spyan yangs pa/ /'gro kun dge legs bsgrub pa'i thugs rje can/ /bsam yas 'phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs mnga' ba/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i ut+pal gsar pa yis/ /gzur gnas 'byung po mtha' dag gi /rna lung mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur kyang / /skyon bral lugs las phyir phyogs pa/ /kun gyi snying gi tsher mar gyur/ /de tshe tshangs dang dbang phyug gi /rjes zhugs rtog ge'i dug chu yis/ /cher myos nga rgyal ri 660

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bo mtho/ /zhe sdang dus mtha'i me 'bar zhing / phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pa yi/ /'phrog byed dga' bo gtsor gyur pa'i/ /ral pa 'chang ba drug phrag gcig/rtsod par 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i drung lhags te/ /dbang phyug tshangs pa'i yon tan gyi/ /'ching bu'i rin chen bang bkram nas/ /rtsod pa'i g.yul gyi sbyor ba bshams/ /bcu gsum gdugs la bstan pa dag /dpang btsugs bcu gnyis nyi ma'i bar/ /chos kyi rje pham zhabs 'bring ba/ /'od yug bzang ring la sogs pa'i/ /smra ba'i seng ge de dag kyang / /'phrog byed 'bar ba'i me mthong bas/ /skrag pa'i yid kyis bros shing byer/ /sems dpa' mchog des bla ma dang / /lhag pa'i lha la yid ches kyi/ /gdung bas rtse gcig gsol btab pas/ /'phrin las lha mos lung bstan cing / /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis tshogs mdzad pas/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbyar skyes khang bzang las/ /rigs tshul rdo rje'i me char gyis/ /mu stegs brag ri rab mtho ba/ /rdul phran lta bur phyer brlags te/ /bcu gsum nyi mar rgyal rnga brdungs/ /'khor gyi ral pa can dag kyang / /'jigs pas snying dang tsha ba'i dbugs/ /lhan cig mgrin pa'i gnas song ste/ /'dar 'dar 'khor ba'i 'gros kyis bros/ /'phrog byed dga' bos 'di skad smras/ /khyod min khyod kyi phrag pa g.yas pa na/ /dmar ser ral gri can de ngas ma thub/ /de slad khyod rgyal nga ni pham par gyur/ /de skad smras nas chos rje'i zhabs la btud/ /'on kyang rtags mtshan ma spangs pas/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i/ bka' bzhin bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis/ /dam las 'da' ba med par byas/ /de ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs kyis/ /thub bstan nor gyi blo gros ma/ /yangs pa'i khyon la 'dod dgur spyod/661

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ces gsungs pa lta bu khong gi gsung rtsom ni snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ches mtho ba'i sgo nas bstan bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs pa gson nyams ldan pas bstan yod pa 'di lta bu'i gsung rtsom gyis phyis rabs pa rnams la rig rtsom gyi las la ji ltar 'jug pa'i mig dpe bzang po zhig bstan yod/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan ni dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang byon pa'i mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan zhig yin pas khong gi gsung rtsom gyi ngo mtshar ji lta ba rtogs thub pa byung na dus rabs bcu drug pa dang / bcu bdun pa'i nang bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi mthon por son pa bde blag tu rtogs nus pa yin no/ /paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes ni/ yab thang lha dang / yum nyi zla dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta(1738)lor gtsang gi shangs gram bkra shis rtser sku 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ dgung lo bdun par dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes zhes gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu pa me glang(1757)lor yongs 'dzin blo bzang chos 'phel las bsnyen par rdzogs/ me khyi(1766)lor ching gong ma chan lung gis 'ja' sa dang gser tham phul/ me sbrul(1776)lor chan lung gis pe cin du gdan 'dren zhu ba'i bka' yig 'byor/ me bya 662

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/(1777)lor dbus phebs kyis pho brang po ta lar rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang gser zhal lhan 'dzoms kyis 'jam dpal rgya mtshor bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'bul bzhes mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang dbang lung rjes gnang sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa 'bul bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa sa phag(1779)lor rgya nag tu chibs kha bsgyur te gong mas g.yang tri'i tham ga dang / 'ja' sa phul/ lcags byi(1780)lor pe cin ye hor bkra shis lhun por gong ma chan lung dang gser zhal lhan du 'dzoms/ lo de'i zla 10par pe cin du sku gshegs/paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi gsung rtsom pod dgu bzhugs pa las skabs 'dir snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtshor 'bul gnang mdzad pa'i chab shog bkod pa 'di lta ste/rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo rje btsun phyag na pad+mo'i zhabs kyi pad+ma srid zhi'i rgud pa yongs su 'phrog pa gang gi drung du/ rnam pa dang dngos po kun gyis btud de rab tu dang ba dri ma med pas zhu ba/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sher phyin kho lag khyon/ /yangs por grol ba'i sbar mo'i khyim gyi khams/ /bden 'dzin lag ldan myos bum bral ba yin/ /bden med ser skya'i brlan gyis kun tu sbags/ /lha yi rdzing gi khyon la rab 'gongs pa'i/ /zhing gi mthar spyod dpal stug seṅge'i dbyangs/ /gcig tu mgul bar smra ba'i dpa' bo che/ /lnga yi mche ba mun rdo'i dug can las/ /kun tu rgyal ba'i dpa' rtsal rab rdzogs pa/ /sngon med thugs rje'i 'dren byed dmar ba'i 'od/ /kha ba'i ljongs la rab mchog chags pa yis/ /mi yi gdong lnga khyod kyis deng gi dus/ /shākya'i mgon po ye shes kyis/ /sgyu 'phrul zla ris 'phos pa lta'i/ /663

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dbyibs kyi brtan rnams rdzogs pa yi/ /nye bar spyod pa'i rdzing bu'i ngogs/ /dhī yig 'od kyi kun bzang sprin/ /kun gsal dog por byed chas pa/ /glang chen stong thub rgyal ba yi/ /cho 'phrul gnyis pa bzhin du snang / /'das pa'i dus kyi ā dar+sha/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzugs shar ba'i/ /gangs kyi nga ro bsgrags pa las/ /'og min mthar thug snyan rnga grags/ /mgon khyod lang tsho'i rnam pa dang / /gsar pa'i zla ba 'gran mod kyi/ /khyod kyi blo gros legs bshad dang / /'gran 'dod mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin 'bod/ /khyod kyi snying stobs do ra na/ /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos/ /bre nang yungs 'bru'i tshul 'chang na/ /rgyu mtshan de la ci ngo mtshar/ /de bzhin gshegs sras bcas kun gyi/ /mdzad pa'i rin chen ma lus pa/ /khyod las gzhan gyi ji ltar 'chang / /des na de la su zhig rgod/ /rab gyi mthar son dpag bsam 'di'i/ /rnam 'gyur yal ga'i g.yab mo yis/ /bos pa'i ngo mtshar ldong ros kyis/ /byugs rnams dga' ba'i nyams rtsal 'gran/ /thugs rje'i me gha rgod pa'i skad/ /bskal pa'i 'ja' yis sgro ldan gyis/ /thos pa'i gar gyi kha ba gos/ /gyon pa'i nor 'dzin dog por byas/ /phyogs kyi brda yis 'byed pa'i zhing / /til gyi gang bu'i rnam 'gyur can/ /bde bar gshegs kun mgur dang phyag /bstod bsngags ched du 'di na spel/ /mgon po khyod kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'i snyan pa 'di thos pa'i tshe//nub kyi phyogs na gnas pa'i dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag e ma ho/ dus kyi mtha' 'di lta bur gyur pa'i dus su yang rgyal ba'i mdzad pa lta bu byung ba ni thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa ni srog shing dang bcas/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni mi nub pa'i mgon dang bcas/ chos kyi nyi ma ni sgrib pa'i sprin dang bral/ chos kyi lang tsho ni shin tu dar ba'i dbu brnyes so snyam du sems shing / dus kyi 664

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mthar skyes pa'i 'gro ba thams cad mgon dang bcas par mthong ste/ sor mo bcu sbyar ba spyi bor btud cing / ngag gis bstod pa'i dbyangs dang / yid kyis mos pa rab tu bskyed nas/ rjes su yi rangs ba'i bstod pa'i legs so rjod par byed pa lags na thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te spyan ras kyis ma phyung ba'i bka'i phebs tshogs kyang spyi bor 455 ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/gsol ba 'debs rten lha rdzas dri brag gser srang 'khor lnga/ dngul bre chen/gos yug chen gnyis/ ling sman yug re bcas gus pas phul/zhes gsungs pa'i gsung rtsom 'di dang 'di 'dra ba mang po mdzad yod pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur rmad du byung ba yod cing lhag par paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi snyan ngag la khyad du 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar ldan yod pa dper na chab shog 'di'i nang / thugs rje'i me gha rgod pa'i skad/ /bskal pa'i 'ja' ris sgro ldan gyis/ /thos pa'i gar gyi kha ba gos/ /gyon pa'i nor 'dzin dog por byas/ zhes gzugs rgyan gyi sgo nas 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa la brten nas gdul zhing snod bcud rnam pa bzang pos khyab pa sho lo ka gcig kho na bklags pa tsam gyis rtogs nus pa 'di lta bu'o/ /bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal/bod kyi snyan ngag pa chen po bod mkhas pa ni rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta (1618)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta(1678)lor snyan 'grel daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan brtsams/ de min 665

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nam 'das pa'i dus dang / mdzad pa gtso che ba ci bskyangs sogs kyi rnam thar sngon chad rang nyid kyi mig gi dga' ston du ma gyur pas re zhig zhib cha zhu ba'i rngo ma thogs/bod mkhas pa ni bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag thog mdzad rjes shin tu che ba'i snyan ngag mkhan po zhig yin zhing / khong gis snyan gzhung me long mar zhib 'jug dang 'grel pa bskyon te bod kyi rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi brtan po 'ding ba gnang yod cing / de dang 'brel bar le'u bar ma'i don rgyan so lngar dper brjod shin tu rgyas pa bskyon yod pa de dag gis bod kyi gsar rtsom bya gzhag 'di nyid dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mtshams su sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i yar rgyas gong 'phel shin tu chen po phyin yod cing / dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i skabs su gsar rtsom gyi chu tshad rtse mor bsnyegs pa la sra zhing brtan pa'i rmang gzhi bting yod pa de ni rig gnas don gnyer mkhan tshos bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus la gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen gsal lags/mkhas pa 'di nyid kyi sku tshe'i ring bod kyi rtsom rig thad brtson pa lhod med kyis zhib 'jug mdzad de phyag rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa de dag rjes rabs pa tsho'i snying dbus su rdo la ri mo brkos pa ltar gnas mus la deng gi dus su mkhas pa nyid kyi ljags rtsom la mu mthud zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i dgos pa ches ldan pas 'dir re 'bod tsam du lhang tsam zhu bar thal/kho bo'i mthong chos su gyur pa'i bod mkhas pa'i ljags rtsom gyi mtshan byang rob tsam bkod pa 'di ltar/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po me long la 'jug pa'i bshad sbyar daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan dang / snyan ngag me long gzhung gis bstan pa'i dper brjod 666

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/legs par bshad pa sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/ snyan ngag me long ma'i le'u gnyis pa'i dpe rgyan gyi rnam grangs mtshungs gsal gyi sgra drug cu rtsa lnga'i dper brjod rang byung dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin sgra/ gzhan yang snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom mang po bka' rtsom mdzad yod/bod mkhas pa'i snyan 'grel 'di ni me long ma'i 'grel pa mang po'i nang du rgyas bsdus 'tshams la gzhung don kha gsal ba/ gzhung don dper brjod rnams kyang nang don gson nyams ldan la rgyan gang yin gyi mtshan nyid dang ches mthun pa/ snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal rang bzhin ches mtho ba/ lhag par bod mkhas pa'i snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom ni go bde la gson nyams ldan pa/ me long ma'i gzhung nas gsungs pa rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i lugs dang / lho phyogs pa'i lugs gnyis su dbye ba las 'di ni go bde ba lho phyogs pa'i rtsom gshis su brtsi ba yin/ khong gi rtsom gshis lta bur zhib 'jug dang / slob sbyong bya rgyur dgos pa dmigs bsal ldan yod pas dgos pa de dag gi slad du khong gi gsung rtsom dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho yid kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen tshangs pa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba'i nang gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi 'gros spyad nas 'dul ba'i bcas pa las 'da' mi rung ba'i skor bstan par/sna tshogs las kyi shing rtar zhon pa'i sems/ /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bur mi 'jigs na/ /lang tshos rdzogs pa'i mngon 'dod yon tan rnams/ /mda' lnga'i cho gas rtsen la cis mi 'jug / gzhon nu'i na tshod 'dzin pa'i mtshar sdug lus/ /667

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rga dang 'chi ba'i gnod pas reg min na/ /mthing 'od ral pa'i zur phud mdzes chags pa/ /nyes med spu gris bsnyol ba ji ltar rigs/ /rin chen rna rgyan 'khrol ba'i 'od ris kyis/ /mun pa'i phyogs las rgyal byed nor bu'i phreng / /lus sems mdzes pa rtag par gtong min na/ /rgyan med sna zhags 'phyang ba ci la 'os/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bus rtogs par nus so/ /si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas/karma si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ni/ yab ngag dbang tshe ring dang / yum phra 'gu ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug( 1700)lor sde dge ding ring sgang du 'khrungs/mtshan mgon po drung du gsol/ dgung lo gsum par si tu sku thog bzhi pa'i sku phreng du ngos 'dzin zhus te karma zhwa dmar brgyad pa dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis chos kyi 'byung gnas 'phrin las kun khyab ye shes zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/dgung lo lnga par yab kyi drung nas sbyor klog bslabs/ dgung lo bdun pa nas mkhas chen dpal grub kyi mdun nas skar rtsis dang / sgra snyan ngag a lo bla ma kun mkhyen gyi drung nas nang don rig pa gsan/ dgung lo bcu gsum par dbus su phebs nas zhwa dmar brgyad pa dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyi mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos 668
