bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/kyi snang ba zhes gsol/ de nas karma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis kyi drung nas bka' rgyud pa'i chos skor dang / tre hor rin po che'i drung nas rnying ma'i chos skor gsan/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par slar dbus su phebs te karma pa zhwa dmar nag dang lhan du bal yul du phebs nas rgya gar dang / bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pradhusna dang / beḍū ba ti/ kā la nā ya na dza maṅga sogs dang bka' mdo rgyud kyi skor la bgro gleng yun ring mdzad cing / sgra dang / snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs kyi dogs gnad mang po bkrol/ bod na med pa'i rgya gzhung mang po mjal/ de nas bod du phebs te zhwa dmar brgyad pa'i mdun du dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mdun nas lam rim gyi 'khrid sogs dge lugs pa'i chos skor gsan/ me lug(1729)lor sde dge dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling phyag btab/ spyir rje 'dis snga rjes su bal yul du thengs gnyis dang / dbus su thengs lnga/ gtsang du thengs gnyis bcas phebs shing / mdo khams khul du yang rgyal mo tsha ba rong dang / yun nan 'jang yul sogs su phebs/ rje 'dis grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa du ma slob dpon du bsten nas thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ slob ma yang khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma dang / ri bo che ba tshe dbang kun khyab/ dbon nges legs bstan 'dzin sogs mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mang po gso skyong mdzad/ gsung rtsom yang sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag dang / sum rtags 'grel chen sogs pod bcu bzhi bzhugs shing / lhag par snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung la gsan bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad de sngon gyi gzhung 'grel khag la dpyad bsdur gting zab dang 'brel bar gzhung gi 669

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'khrid rgyun rgya cher spel ba phyis khong gi dngos slob khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long paṇa chen bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkral ba dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho legs bshad nor bu'i 'byung khungs zhes bya ba mdzad pa de ni snyan 'grel gzhan las rgyas pa dang / gsal ba/khungs dang ldan pa zhig yin pas snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung bshad sngar bas gting zab tu song bas bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa 'phel rgyas la tshod dpag byed thabs bral ba'i nus pa thon pa ni si tu paṇa chen gyis nga tsho bod kyi mi rabs phyi mar 'jog gnang gi mdzad rjes rlabs po che dang kha 'bral thabs med pa bcas de lta bu'i bstan pa dang / 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas mthar dgung lo don lnga pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing rta(177gyelor sku gshegs/ skabs 'dir si tu paṇa chen gyi bka' rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du/ rig 'dzin dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar snyan ngag gi lam du drangs pa'i bka' rtsom de'i nang nas rnal 'byor mchog la zhugs pa'i gnas skabs kyi ngo mtshar gleng ba'i nang mi rtag 'chi bas 'khor ba la yid rab phyung ba'i skor/gzar po'i chu bo ston ka'i dus/ /smag rum glog dang khab rtse'i 'bru/ /nub ri'i nyi ma tshe yi rgyun/ /myur du bskyod pa'i rang bzhin ldan/ /rnam rtog 'di 'dra sa steng na/ /dran nas glo snying mi 'gas pa/ /lcags gzer stong gis bsdams pa'am/ /670

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/zho 'thung rus pas byas sam ci/ /zhes sho lo ka dang po mang ba'i dpe dang / gnyis pa sems med rab rtog gi rgyan gyi thog nas gsungs pa 'dis mtshon thub pa khong gi gsungaldom ni snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing /lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig dang / shes bya kun la 'jug pa'i sgo gcig pu brda sprod pa'i gzhung la'ang si tu'i sum rtags 'grel chen zhes tshad mar bzung 'os pa'i bstan bcos phul du byung ba gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i mdzad rjes kyang bsam brjod las 'das pa bcas so /khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/khams sprul sku phreng bzhi pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags khyi(1730)lor dza stod dpon tshang zhes pa'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi par mdo khams lha thog rgyal po'i mnga' khongs kha stag dkar po'i ri khug khams pa dgon zhes bya ba mdo khams khul gyi 'brug pa bka' rgyud pa'i rtsa ba'i gdan sa dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi sprul skur ngos 'dzin zhus/ de rjes dpal spungs si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang /bde chen chos 'khor gyi yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bsam mdzad/ lhag par si tu'i drung nas snyan ngag me long ma dang / sgra tsan+d+rapa/ sdeb sbyor sogs legs par gsan te dgung lo nyer lnga par snyan ngag me long ma'i 'grel chen dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho zhes bya 671

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ba rtsom 'go btsugs te dgung lo zhe gcig par yongs su grub par mdzad/khong gis kha stag dkar mo'i ri khug nas phyis kyi gdan sa gnas yul du dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling spo gzhug gis rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / de rjes gying phu dpal gyi yang dben du mtshan nyid dgon rnam rgyal chos 'khor gling dang / sga nyag dkar mo'i ri'i yang gong du sgrub sde gsang chen mthong grol gling bcas rim par btab/khong gis slob ma yang mkhas grub bsod nams rab 'phel dang / rab 'byams pa blo gros brtan pa/ 'dzi sgar rdo rje grags pa sogs slob ma'i tshogs mang po bskyangs te mthar dgung lo lnga bcu pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa phag(1779)lor phun tshogs chos 'khor gling du sku gshegs/khong gis bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa 'phel rgyas la mi nub pa'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang skor cung zad zhu na/ de yang khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi drung nas snyan ngag me long ma rgya 'grel gnyis kyi steng nas gsan pa dang /de dag gi mtha' dpyod kyang gang 'tshams grub rjes me long ma'i 'grel chen dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho brtsam 'go tshugs pa nas yongs su ma grub bar lo ngo bcu drug ring mdzad seng dang bstun te gzhung don dka' gnad gtso che ba re re bzhin la si tu'i gsung rgyun dang / rgya 'grel gnyis/ shong 'gyur bcas la gzhi byas/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa dang / snar thang pa sar+sā shrī/rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags/ lnga pa chen po/ bod mkhas pa sogs kyi bod 'grel mang po'i legs cha btus pa dang / zhib dpyad legs par gnang ste dka' gnad gtso che ba'i rigs gzhung don ji bzhin gtan la phab pa'i 672

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/snyan 'grel chen mo rtsom gnang mdzad de bod kyi snyan ngag 'phel rgyas la dpag par dka' ba'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod/thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma ni/ pho rod 'byang gru'i phyogs phun tshogs lung par bra ste'i rigs su yab dpung skyabs rgyal dang / yum ba ri bza' chos mtsho skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul (1737)lor sku bltams/dgung lo drug pa chu khyi(1742)lor thu'u bkwan sku gong ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i khrir mnga' gsol/ de nas bde rgu ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge bsnyen sdom pa bzhes shing / dmar gtsang dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin las yi ge bslabs/dgung lo bcu gcig rab byung bcu gsum pa me yos(1747)lor sum pa mkhan chen ye shes dpal 'byor las rab tu byung ste dgon lung byams pa gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen rab thogs pa med pa'i steng du rtag gus sbyor ba'i brtson pa drag pos gsan sbyong lhur bzhes pas rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin gong du 'phel/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa sa sbrul(1749)lor lcang skya rin po che rol pa'i rdo rje las dge tshul bsgrubs/dgung lo bcu dgu pa shing phag(1755)lor dbus gtsang chos kyi 'dun sar phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ kun mkhyen 673

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'jigs med dbang po las lung chos man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ phur bu lcog byams pa rin po che las 'jam dbyangs zhal lung dang bde lam gyi zab khrid/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid res mos gnang ba gsan zhing / dgung lo nyer gcig pa me glang(1757)lor rje de nyid las bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ lo 'dir lcang skya rin po che dbus su phebs pa las bka' chos rgya che ba gsan/ gzhan yang paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang /stag phu bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ 'bru la mkhan chen ye shes bstan sgron/ ba ri ngag dbang don grub sogs skyes chen dam pa mang po las gsan pa phul phyin mdzad/dgung lo nyer gsum pa sa yos(1759)lor gzhung nas zha lu mkhan por bskos/ sa skya bdag chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' blo gros las zab chos mang du gsan/dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags sbrul(1761)lor mdo smad du phebs te sum pa mkhan chen sogs bla slob kyi thugs bzhed ltar dgon lung gi khrir phebs/me phag lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgya nag pe cin du phebs te bka' chos rgya che gnang / gong mas ho thog thu dang chan zhi'i lung las gnang /dgung lo so gnyis par dgon lung du phebs shing / chu sbrul lor slar yang gong ma'i bka' bzhin pe cin du phebs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po bsgrubs/dgung lo nga gsum pa sa bya(1789)lor sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khrir bzhugs nas chos srid kyi bka' drin tshad med bskyangs/dgung lo re drug ste rab byung bcu gsum pa chu khyi(1802)lor sku gshegs/674

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung rtsom pod bco lnga bzhugs pa'i nang rig rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la bstod pa ut+pal zeng mdzes kyi dum bu zhig drangs na/kun gyi mdzes sdug bsdus na bdag gir byas/ /drag po'i gtsug rgyan bsdus nas gdan du bting / /blo gsar gzhon nur 'grogs pa'i bag yangs can/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod la zhe nas khrel/ /chags bral rnams kyang dka' thub 'jigs byed pa'i/ /mchog gi lang tsho 'chang ba des chog gi /rgyud stong dbyangs dang bsdebs pa'i snyan 'jebs glu/ /'di yis lhag par ya mtshan gyur pa ci/ /rab rgyas dri med zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong ba tsam gyis kun yid 'phrog byed na/ /dkyus ring zur mig lcags kyus blo gsal gyi/ /snying la 'debs pa'i bslu 'brid 'dis ci bya/ /gtsang zhing dag pa'i dri med sku mchog ni/ /lang tsho gsar pa'i rgyan gyis spud bzhin du/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang dar zab na bza' yis/ /klubs 'dis mdzes chos khyad par gyur pa gang / /shel dkar lhun po'i dpal 'chang sku'i lang tshos /sa gsum kun dgar byed pa des chog gi /zla ba'i gdong la ut+pal mig bkod de/ /675

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/lhag par yid 'phrog brtul zhugs bsten ci dgos/ /zhes pa lta bu dbyangs can ma'i sku'i mdzes chos gzhan bas khyad par 'phags pa cha las smad pa dang / 'gog rgyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ches phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas brtsams pa'i bstan bya'i nang don gang zhig yin rung ches gson nyams ldan pa klog pa po'i yid dbang med du 'gug nus pa 'di lta bu'i rtsom rtsal khong du chud pa bya rgyu ni ches gal che ba dang / thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma ni rtsom rig kho na'i thog nas bshad kyang nga tsho'i mes po mkhas pa'i rtse mor son pa zhig yin no/ /gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me ni/ yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (1762)lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/dgung lo bdun pa sa byi(1768)lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sku skye ru ngos 'dzin zhus te bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs te kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i drung du dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing / mtshan dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen klog gi slob dpon du bsten nas sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs shing / rim gyis tshad ma dang phar phyin sogs gzhung rnams sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pa ma zad/ rgya dang sog po'i skad yig kyang thugs su chud/676

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dgung lo bdun cu pa sa khyi(1778)lor dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs te hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma/ mdzod/ 'dul ba gsan sbyong gtso bor mdzad nas gzhung dka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par gyur/dgung lo nyer gcig pa chu stag(1782)lor rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/dgung lo nyer gnyis pa chu yos(1783)lor dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes pa bcas dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing /dbus gtsang mkhas mang gi dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis bkur ba'i yul du gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga me rta(1786)lor rang yul mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu lcags phag(1791)lor chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan khrir 'khod/ de nas bzung mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang po bskyangs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad mthar dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu lug(1823)lor sku gshegs/gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung rtsom pod bcu gnyis bzhugs pa nas rig rtsom gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du shing gi bstan bcos 677

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/las 'jig rten tshul lugs skor gyi dum bu zhig drangs na 'di lta ste/chos ldan rgyal po'i gzi byin gyis/ /dgra sde rnams kyang dbang du 'du/ /ma la yar skyes dri bsung de/ /bung ba 'gugs pa'i pho nya yin/ /rgyal ngan chab 'bangs gzir ba der/ /nam zhig g.yog kyang 'khor mi 'gyur/ /sran phung dbyug pas gtor na yang / /dbyug pa'i ngos la 'byar mi srid/ /blon dang 'bangs kyis ma bkur na/ /rgyal po chen po ji ltar gnas/ /gdung ma ka bas ma btegs na/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gang las 'byung / /rje dpon bzang po'i bka' drin gyis/ /g.yog 'khor mnga' thang dar bar 'gyur/ /ljon pa che la brten pa yis/ /'khri shing rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs/ /tsher ma'i shing la rten byas na/ /gnad du zug pa'i sdug bsngal skye/ /skye bo ngan la rten byas kyang / /phyi phyir sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed/ /chab 'bangs bde skyid rgyas pa de/ /678

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rje dpon nyid kyi che ba'i rtags/ /rab rgyas yal ga'i khyon yangs pa/ /sdong po rtsa ba'i mdzes rgyan yin/ /g.yog 'khor sgud pa'i sde dpon ni/ /rang nyid 'byor yang ngo tsha'i rgyu/ /sdong po ci tsam sbom na yang / /yal 'dab med na gcer bu yin/ /sdong rul rtsa bar gnas pa'i mi/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bag phebs bral/ /gtso bo ngan pa'i g.yog 'khor yang / /rtag tu sems khral gdung bas gzir/ /dpon ngan g.yog 'khor 'bros na yang / /sde dpon bzang pos bskrad kyang 'du/ /tsher shing bor ba'i bha ma ra/ /tsu ta'i shing las bskrad kyang 'khor/ /rje dpon gsar tshe byams byed kyang / /phyi nas bsgrub dka'i dpya khral 'bebs/ /shing la char skyob byed mod kyang / /rjes su thigs phreng lci bar 'bab/ /ljon pa'i grib bsil kun la snyoms/ /nyi zla'i snang ba kun la snyoms/ /sprin gyi chu char kun la snyoms/ /679

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rgyal po'i bka' khrims kun la snyoms/ /zhes 'jig rten lugs las rgyal po dang 'bangs kyi gnas lugs shing gi khyad chos kho nar sbyar ba bsdus brjod dang / zla bo dngos po'i dpe rgyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa 'di lta bu'i rig rtsal gyi gsung rtsom nang don zab la snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ches mtho ba ji snyed rtsom gnang mdzad yod/ khong yang nga tsho'i sngon byon mes po'i nang nas rig rtsom la yang mdzad rjes ngo mtshar can 'jog gnang mdzad pa mkhas pa'i yang rtse zhig yin no/ /lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i char 'bebs/rgya bod yul gru kun la snyan pa'i grags pas khyab cing / mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag nyid lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'am/ ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po ni/ mdo smad tsong kha'i byang phyogs kyi sa'i cha lang gru'u sde bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan nub pad+mo'i sder gtogs pa'i 'brog gnas su hor gyi rigs las byung ba yul der sngags pa'i ming la tshangs par 'bod pa ltar yab chi skya tshangs pa gu ru bstan 'dzin dang / yum bu skyid ces bya ba gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me mo bya( 1717)lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams shing / gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mtshan la grags pa bsod nams zhes bya ba gsol/dgung lo bzhi pa lcags byi(1720)lor lcang skya sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mdo smad kyi chos 680

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling lcang skya bla brang du gdan drangs nas chu bzang rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dbu phud bzhes te mtshan ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba btags/de nas re zhig gi bar du lcang skya sku gong ma'i slob ma a rtse chos rje blo bzang chos 'dzin pa sku drung du bcar bzhugs kyis gzab gshar gyi yi ge 'bri klog dang / chos spyod gsol 'debs kyi rim pa/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs sogs 'phral mkho'i chos tshan phal che ba thugs 'dzin mdzad/dgung lo bdun pa chu yos(1723)lor rje blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / bar ma'i tshul khrims legs par bzhes/dgung lo brgyad pa shing 'brug(1720lor man ju gong ma yung ṭing dang lcang skya sku gong ma mchod yon gyi 'brel bar brten nas mtsho sngon gyi dpon po bstan 'dzin ching wang sogs kyis bslangs pa'i dus gzir gyis gser khog dgon dang / dgon lung sogs mdo smad khul gyi dgon sde che chung mang por yang gong ma'i dmag gi dpung 'jug nyams nyes chen po btang ba'i nang rje 'di nyid kyi sku la nyams nyes 'byung dogs yung ṭing gong ma'i bkas pe cin du gdan drangs shing / skabs der dmar tshang nang so dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin nas rgyud skul zhus pa ltar gong mar ngo chen zhu gnang gis mdo smad kyi dgon sde mang po'i nang sor gong ma'i chad pa phog ste khrims mun du yod pa rnams btson ra las thar te rang rang gi gnas mal bdag gir byas chog pa'i dbugs dbyung thob cing / yung ṭing gong ma'i bkas thu'u bkwan ngag dbang 681

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chos kyi rgya mtshor rje 'di nyid la sku yon 'bul dgos pa dang / de nas gong ma dang mjal phrad bya rgyu yin zhes phebs pa ltar thog mar tsan+dan jo bo'i lha khang du phebs nas rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i bla brang du bzhugs shing / de rjes yung ṭing gong ma dang mjal 'dzoms thog yung ṭing gis bzhengs pa'i zung gru dgon gyi khrir mnga' gsol/'di skabs mdo smad du dgon lung dang / gser khog dgon gnyis la dus gzir skabs nyams chag chen po byung ba slar gso yong thabs skor thu'u bkwan rin po che dang / rje 'di nyid nas gong mar zhu mkhas mdzad pas dgon lung pa rnams ri khrod gsum dang / gser khog pa rnams phun tshogs lung pa'i khrod du bsdad chog pa byung ba dang / de rjes dgon gnas gnyis kyi gnas gzhi rang rang gis bdag gir byas chog pa'i thog gtsug lag khang dang / grwa shag rnams slar gso thub/de nas dgung lo bco brgyad la phebs kyi bar thu'u bkwan ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / bzang shu dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas sam ngag dbang chos ldan/ a rtse chos rje blo bzang chos 'dzin bcas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsum gyi drung nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung chen rnams la sbyangs pa gtso bor mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang / bde mchog dril bu lugs bcas kyi dbang gzhi yongs rdzogs gsan bzhes bcas mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi rim pa yang rgya che ba zhig gsan/skyes mchog dam pa 'dis dgung na shin tu phra ba'i skabs nas mkhas pa'i 682

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa lhur bzhes pa yin te/ de yang 'chad pa'i skor/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i dus su dad ldan mang pos zhus ngor skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang / lam gtso rnam gsum gyi bshad pa shin tu rno ba zhig mdzad pas chos zhu ba po rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog ste dad pa'i sa la bkod pa de nas bzung dbang chen gyi rigs ma gtogs 'dod chos gang zhus ci dgar bstsal bas thams cad kyi yid tshim par mdzad/rtsod pa yang dgung lo bcu bdun gyi skabs gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i spobs pa mchog tu dge ba u cu mu chen gu shrī bzod pa zhes bya bas nyams sad kyi tshul du rtsa shes kyi rab byed dang po'i sho lo ka kha shas las brtsams pa'i rtsod yig phul bar lung rigs dri ma med pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i rtsod lan dang yang lan gnang bas rgol ba'i spobs pa rmeg med du 'joms par mdzad de khong dad pa'i sa la bkod thog phyis rje nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa/rtsom pa yang / dgung lo dgu pa'i skabs byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs rnam gsol 'debs tshigs bcad ma ljags rtsom gyi thog mar mdzad pa dang / dgung lo bco lnga'i dus rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho las gsan pa'i lta khrid la zin bris gnang ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang sku gzhon nu'i dus lha dang bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ lha'i sgrub thabs mngon rtogs la sogs pa mang po mdzad/'di'i dus gong ma yung ṭing nas gzigs skyong chen po gnang ba dang /gong ma rang gi sras bzhi pa phyis gong ma'i khri la phebs pa chan lung dang mnyam du slob gnyer mdzad bcug pa bcas kyi rgya sog man ju rnams kyi skad yig kyang zhar la thugs su chud/ de skabs hwa shang mang po rje 'di'i snyan grags la brten 683

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nas lta ba rtsad gcod byed par yong mkhan rnams la thog mar hwa shang gi 'dod tshul ltar dang rim gyis dbu ma'i lta ba la khrid par mdzad pas nyams rtogs skyes pa yang mi nyung tsam byung 'dug phyis thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas bdag nyid chen po 'di la hwa shang gi lta ba ci lta bu zhig yin zhus par/ sngon 'phags yul nas klu sgrub yab sras kyi rjes 'brang gi paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig rgya yul du byon pa dang / rgya'i hwa shang 'ga' zhig kyang rgya gar du song nas dbu ma pa'i paṇa grub rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs pas dbu ma'i lta ba rgya yul du cung zad dar yang rgyud 'dzin mang du ma 'phel/ rgya skad du tā mo tsu shi bya ba slob dpon bho rnyi dha rmot+ta ra rgya yul du byon nas lta ba'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa dar che ba byung 'dug pa'i slob dpon de 'ga' zhig gis pha dam pa sangs rgyas yin yang zer la gang ltar bod kyi zhi byed kyi lta ba dang gnad gcig tu 'dug deng sang dar che ba ni sems tsam pa'i lta ba dang shin tu mthun zhing / sngar bod du byung ba'i hwa shang mahā ya na'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan deng sang rgya yul du gcig kyang mi 'dug ces gsungs/yang 'di skabs gong ma'i lung dang 'brel bar dga' ldan khri chen blo gros rgya mtsho'i sku skye blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma pe cin du gdan drangs nas rang gi rigs kyi cod pan du bsten te gsung chos kyi thog mar tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang gsan bzhes nas 'go brtsams te mdo sngags chos tshul mtha' yas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/yang dus 'di'i yas mas shig la gong ma yung ṭing gis rje 'di nyid la lcang skya sku gong ma'i lam bzhin bkwan ting phu'u shan bkwang chi tā kau shrī zhes bod kyi skad du byams brtses 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i kun 684

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mkhyen bla ma chen po zhes pa'i mtshan dang / gser srang brgyad cu las grub pa'i tham ka bsngags brjod kyi gser yig bcas bstsal/dgung lo bco brgyad pa shing pho stag(173grulor gong ma'i lung gis bod du phebs te shing yos lo mgar thar nas rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho lha ldan chos kyi zhing sar spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya mdzad pa dang / skabs der rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho nas bde mchog lū i pa'i lugs lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang gis gtsos pa'i zab chos mang po dang / rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin ngag dbang mchog ldan pa nas byang chub lam rim bde lam gyi dmar khrid sogs mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/de ltar lam gyi rim pa'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams nas bka' khrid mang po gsan pa dang / de dag gi skor la 'bel gtam yang mang du mdzad par brten dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag zab mo/ dpal lha gcig dī paṃ ka ra'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad zla med pa/ che ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gnad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas te/ sngar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung chen mo rnams la thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad pa de thams cad byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len du 'du ba'i tshul la nges pa gting tshugs pa thugs la 'khrungs te bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis khyer shes pa zhes bya ba dang / gzhung lugs ma lus gdams ngag tu shar ba zhes jo bo bka' gdams 685

nor brang zho rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/pa rnams kyis rgya cher bsngags pa'i nges don mkhas pa'i go 'phang la mnga' 'byor pa byung yod/dgung lo nyi shu pa me 'brug(1936)lor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhu ba dang / mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang po zhu ba'i ched bkra shis lhun por phebs te zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin paṇa chen rin po che nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nas bzung ste dge tshul bar gyi sdom pa zhus pa'i mtshan la ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po zhes bya ba bstsal ba dang / tshes bcu bdun nyin bstan pa'i snying po so thar sdom pa'i mchog dge slong gi sdom pa dang / de rjes gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring gi rjes gnang zhu gnang mdzad pa nas mu mthud chos bka' mang po zhu 'dun gnang yang / gong ma yung ṭing gnam du gshegs pas glo bur lha sar phebs dgos kyi rkyen pas stabs ma 'grigade ltar mgar thar dang dbus gtsang du lo gsum gyi bar bzhugs te shing 'brug lo pe cin du phyir phebs gong ma chan lung khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo grub rjes gong ma'i bkas tham ka bla mar mnga' gsol/'di'i dus kyi yas mas shig la skar rtsis la shin tu mkhas pa'i rtsis rams pa zhig dang / dpal bzang chos rje las skar rtsis dang / spor thang rdel 'grem/ dbyangs 'char dang / sgra'i sa ris/ sdeb sbyor rin 'byung sogs zhib par gsan/dgung lo nyer gsum pa lcags bya(1741)lor gong ma chan lung gi bkas/ deng dus sog yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / gong ma shing tsu bde skyid rgyal po'i bkas bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog yig tu bsgyur te 686

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/par du bsgrubs kyang bstan 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog yig tu bsgyur ba sngar phan med 'dug pa lcang skya hu thog thu khyod kyis thugs khur mdzad nas bstan 'gyur yongs rdzogs hor gyi skad du sgyur cig zhes phebs pa ltar bstan 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog yig tu bsgyur ba'i bya ba chen por zhugs gnang gis thog mar bsgyur yig so so'i tha snyad mi mthun pa byung tshe thos bsam byed pa rnams kyis rtogs dka' bar dgongs/ gsung rab kyi tha snyad gcig gyur yong ched dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bod sog skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi bstan bcos shig kyang ljags rtsom mdzad pa bcas rje 'di nyid dang / khri chen sprul sku rnam gnyis sgyur byed gtso bo dang / gzhan yang gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang po dang bcas pas lcags bya(1741)lo'i hor zla bcu par dbu btsugs te chu khyi(1742)lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa bar lo 'khor gcig lhag tsam nang 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa grub ste gong ma'i mdzod nas de dag par du bsgrubs nas chen po hor gyi yul gru thams cad la khyab par mdzad pas phyogs der bstan pa rin po che'i gsos su smin pa byung /dgung lo nyer bdun pa shing byi(174rgyalor gong ma'i bkas de snga gong ma'i yab yung ṭing gi bzhugs gnas su dgon sde gsar bskrun gyi mtshan la dga' ldan byin chags gling zhes pa phyag 'debs pa'i bya bar thugs brtson lhod med mdzad/de nas skabs shig gong ma'i bkas dbyar dus tsha ba shin tu che bas pho brang nang du bzhugs na thugs mi spro ba yong bas pho brang dang thag mi ring ba'i sa shang shan zer ba bod skad du ri bo spos ngad ldan zhes bya ba'i ri ni 'du 687

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'dzis dben cing / sa mtho bas dbyar dus bsil ba dang bcas dam chos dga' tshal zhes bya ba'i dben dgon zhig gsar bskrun mdzad de rje 'di'i bzhugs gnas su 'bul gnang mdzad pa der bzhugs skabs grub mtha'i rnam gzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba skad grags can de ljags rtsom mdzad/de rjes gong ma chan lung gis gsang stabs kyis rje 'di nas bka' chos ci rigs gsan bzhed yod lugs phebs pa ltar thog mar skyabs 'gro'i khrid mdor bsdus tsam dang / bod yig gzab gshar 'bri klog dang / dag yigabyang chub lam rim bcas rim par 'bul gnang dang / de rjes shing glang lo gong mar bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang 'bul gnang mdzad/dgung lo sum cu so gcig pa sa sbrul(1749)lor rang gi gdan sa dgon lung byams pa gling nas gdan zhu dang / yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub pa bcas su mdo smad du phebs te dgon gnas mang por gnas gzigs dang mchod 'bul/ dgon lung byams pa gling du phebs nas tshogs pa yongs la mjal phyag dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed/ spyi 'jog tu gos sku shin tu che zhing spus gtsang ba zhig dang / gser srang brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs 'bul gnang mdzad pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa'i skur bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs te mtshan dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po zhes pa bstsal/'di skabs dgon lung du zla gnyis tsam bzhugs nas pe cin du phyir phebs gong ma chen po mjal phrad mdzad par phebs pas gong ma rang nyid gzim khang gi sgo'i phyi rol du phebs te sngon la tshur kha btags gtong gnang 688

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dang 'tshams 'dri gnang ba sogs bkur bzos tshad med mdzad/ de nas skabs shig gong mas/ nged cag man ju'i rgyud 'di la pog to han mug run du bzhugs skabs nas bzung da lta'i bar dam pa'i chos dar yang rab byung byed pa'i srol ma byung 'dug pas/ da cha pho brang chen po'i nub kyi ri zhol du gtsug lag khang bzhengs te der man ju gsar du rab byung byas pa 'ba' zhig sdod pa'i grwa tshang zhig btsus/sa na ci 'dra yong zhes rje 'di nyid la bka' 'dri phebs par snga phyi'i lo rgyus las 'phros te de de bzhin du mdzad na legs pa'i lan 'bul gnang ltar chos sde dga' ldan byin chags gling dang cha 'dra ba gsar bskrun mdzad pa'i nang chos gzhug man ju rab byung bsgrub pa rnams kyi mkhan po mdzad pa dang / chos sde de'i tshogs 'don thams cad man ju'i skad du bsgyur ba/ man ju'i skad kyis chos 'don pa la bod kyi rta dbyangs mi 'grig pas rta dbyangs 'dur ma rnams kyang gsar du bzo gnang mdzad/lcags rta(1750)lor bod du wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi don rkyen byung skor gong mar dgongs sel dang / bod yul gyi sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams dmas par mi 'gyur ba thugs la btags pa'i bka' drin skyong ba zhig cis kyang yong ba zhes zhu mkhas mdzad par gong ma mchog nas kyang 'byung 'gyur bod kyi bstan srid thams cad kyi 'gan dbang tā la'i bla mar phul na zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dang / chab srid chen por phan sleb che ba yong lugs skor rje 'di nyid la bka' bsdur dang 'brel de don gyi bka' lung yang bsgrags/ de rjes gong ma'i bkas pe cin mkhar nang ma'i g.yas zur du rgyud sde bzhi'i lhan tshogs bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / pe cin zhe hor skyed mos tshal gyi nye 'dabs su bod kyi bsam yas la dpe blangs pa'i gtsugasalag khang gnyug mar 689

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde rten brten par bcas pa gong mas gsar bskrun gnang ba'i zhib cha'i ljags bkod thams cad rje 'di nyid nas mdzad pa dang /dge 'dun gyi sde de dag 'ga' zhig tu mdo sngags rig gnas kyi slob gnyer dang / 'ga' zhig tu bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ kun rig la sogs pa'i cho ga 'ga' zhig tu mdo sde gsung sgrog 'ga' zhig tu chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso gtong ba sogs mdor na dbus gtsang gi ljongs su gang yod ci yod thams cad ma tshang ba med pa lta bu 'dzugs gnang gi ljags bkod gnang mkhan gyi gtso bo yang rje 'di nyid yin pa dang / de bzhin srid skyong gi bya ba byed pa'i yā mun gyi khrodatwa yang bod kyi slob grwa btsugs par dpon rgyud gzhon nu mang po bod chos slob gnyer byed pa dang / de dag gi khrod nas rig pa bzang gras 'ga' zhig dbus dang mdo khams su bod chos slob par gtong ba/ yā mun du chos bsgyur ba dang / bod kyi yi ge 'bri ba sogs rgyun gtan byed pa de rnams kyi 'go 'khrid kyang rje 'di nyid dang am ban gcig gis byed pa'i srol yang btsugs/dgung lo sum cu so gsum pa me glang(1757)lo ste rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba nas dus ring po ma song ba na gong ma'i bkas/ tā la'i bla ma ni bod kyi bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pu yin pas zhi bar gzhol ba shin tu ma legs kyang bya thabs bral/ da ni tā la'i bla ma'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'khrul med ngos zin pa gal che bas/ ho thog thu nyid bod du phebs te sprul sku rtsad bcad nas thag chod pa byed dgos phebs pa ltar bod du phebs te lha ldan du jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / gdan sa gsum la sogs pa'i rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang / dge 'dun gyi sder bsnyen 690

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bkur rgya che stobs pa/ dad ldan rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba/sa stag(spyi lo 1758)lor paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang mjal 'dzom ched bkra shis lhun por phebs pa/ sa yos(spyi lo 1759)lor rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul thag gcod pa dang / gser gdung gsar bzhengs la rab gnas gnang ba bcas su paṇa chen rin po che lha ldan du spyan drangs pa bcas skabs der rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rtsad gcod skor lha dang bla ma'i brtag lung mang po rtse bsdur byas pa'i dogs gnas de dag gtan la phab pa yong ched bka' blon rnams nas paṇa chen rin po che'i drung du chos skyong rnams phyogs gcig tu sku 'bebs kyis zhal 'dzom thog lung bstan gyis thag chod pa yong zhes zhus pa ltar nyin gcig po ta la'i tshoms chen gyi rgya mthong khar/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje 'di nyid/ rgyal tshab de mo/ am ban/ bka' blon rnams dang bcas bzhugs pa'i sar chos skyong sku 'bebs zhus pa'i lung bstan rtse mthun ma byung stabs rje 'di nyid nas da ni paṇa chen rin po cher gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas bka' gang phebs la cha bzhag byed pa las 'os mi 'dug gsungs par tshang mas de ltar bya rgyur thugs rtse gcig mthun byung ste paṇa chen rin po cher gsol ba btab par gtsang phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa de nyid yang srid 'khrul med yin pa'i bka' lung bstsal ba de de bzhin du snga mo rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtshos paṇa chen rin po cher dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang skabs gtsang phyag mdzod kyi mi lam du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa da lta'i sprul sku 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i khyim der phebs nas bzhugs pa rmis pa phyi nyin rgyal dbang mchog la zhus pas 'di yin gyi gsal kha ma gnang bar da res rmi lam de 'dra byung tshul gyi yi ge tham ka can 691

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gnyis gyis la gcig phyag mdzod la sprod/ gcig gzhung gi yig tshang du nyar 'jog gyis zhes phebs pa'i yig cha gzhung gi yig tshang du yod pa/ rje 'di nyid kyis yang srid skor thugs dam brtag pa gnang ba la yang rgyal ba'i yang srid shaṅgā pā la gtso zer ba byung ba'i shaṅgā pā ni dung skyong bya ba yin pas la mo chos skyong tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can du grags pa'i lung la nub phyogs su byon pa der thag bcad pa/ paṇa chen rin po che dang / la mo chos skyong rnam gnyis kyi phyag tham yang dung gi re kha can du yod pas de dag gi bka' lung gtso zer ba'i brda yin 'dug pa bcas gang ci nas phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i yid ches kyi nges pa brtan pos mchog gi sprul sku ngos 'dzin mdzad thub pa dang / 'di'i skabs rgyal tshab de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshos gtso mdzad pa'i gzhung gnas nas bskul ma zhus pa bzhin rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar(rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa dpag bsam rin po che'i snye ma〉 zhes bya ba 'di nyid ljags rtsom mdzad pa bcas me mo glang bod du phebs pa nas 'brug lo'i bar lo ngo bzhi bod du bzhugs ring paṇa chen rin po che nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / stag phu pa chen po blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rwa sgreng yang dgon du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sngags ram pa blo bzang don grub la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma las zab chos ci rigs gsan pa/ dbus gtsang gi gdan sa chen po bzhi dang / gsang chen rgyud grwa stod smad kyis mtshon dge 'dun gyi sde mang por rang rang re ba'i chos bka' ci dang ci rigs pas dad ldan rnams kyi re ba 'bras ldan du mdzad/ de nas pe cin du phyir phebs gong ma dang mjal/ bod dang 692

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/khams phyogs nas dad 'bul byung ba'i gser gyis gdugs bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa rin po che'i phra tshom gyis spa ba zhig tsan+dan jo bo'i dbu thog tu phul zhing / de dang mnyam du gong ma chan lung nas kyang jo bo la gser gyi dbu rgyan rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa zhig 'bul gnang mdzad 'dugadagung lo zhe lnga pa chu lug(1763)lor yab dgongs pa rdzogs pa gsan ma thag zhag bdun gyi bar jo bo mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga mdzad cing / sgrib sbyong du gser gyis bris pa'i thar mdo dang / mdo sde pad dkar phral du bzhengs/gong mar yab kyi dgongs rdzogs bsgrub par mdo khams su 'khyug tsam phebs chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus thob bzhin sog yul rgyud a mdor phebs te yab kyi sgrib sbyong dang dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/dgung lo zhe drug pa shing spre(171grulor dgon lung khri pa 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku khri las bshol te dgon lung gi khri zur gzhan rnams dang gros dbang pa rnams kyis nan gyis zhus ngor dgon lung gi khri pa mdzad thog nged rang tshad ma rnam 'grel la shin tu mos pa yod pas chos sde zhig tu rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan zhig 'dzugs rgyu byung na bsam pa snga mo nas yod gshis da lam nged rang chos sde 'di nyid kyi khri la sdod pa dang chabs cig rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan 'dzugs dgos phebs pa ltar dgon lung khri zur 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i skus khur bzhes kyis 'dzin grwa gong 'og nas rigs pa smra ba mang tsam bsdus te rnam 'grel gyi 'dzin grwa gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad cing / rnam 'grel 'chad nyan gyi yig cha gang legs skor paṇa chen rin po cher dgongs skor zhus pa'i phebs sgo bzhin se ra rje btsun pa'i yig cha par gsar du brkos te 'dzin grwar 'grem gnang mdzad pa 693

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bcas dgon lung gi khri pa'i mtshan khur mdzad pa de nas dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig bar lo lnga'i ring khri pa'i mtshan 'dzin gnang zhing / de nas 'di snyam du dgongs te rang gis khri pa'i ming 'dzin te gdan sar ma bsdad pa khri tshab gzhan 'jog rgyu 'di rigs gzhung 'chad nyan dang / sgrig lam ngan rkyen 'gro gzhi las dge ba'i mtshan mar ma gzigs pas khri pa dgongs pa gtsang zhu gnang thog 'byung 'gyur sngon gyi srol rnying bzhin thams cad 'dod bstun gyis khri pa bsko gzhag byas na legs pa'i slob ston yang mdzad/ bar skabs shig nas gong ma chen por dgongs pa gtsang zhus kyis mdo smad du phebs te dben par gcig du gzhol 'dun gyis dgon lung gi phur gsang sngags bde chen pho brang gi gzim spyil bskrun pa bcas rtsa ba'i dgongs gzhi de ltar yang /pe cin du po ta la dang 'dra ba gsar bzhengs dang / man ju'i skad du bka' 'gyur bsgyur ba sogs mdzad brel gcig rjes gnyis mthud byung ba dang /de'i skabs lo kha shas kyi bar du rgya nag gi lho phyogs dus gzir ma zhi bas gong ma thugs bag phebs pa'i gseng dbar ma thon pa bcas kyis sa thag ring por phebs pa'i dgongs pa zhu gnang ma bde bas ri bo rtse lnga ni gnas mchog khyad par can dang / sa chu sogs kyang sku la 'phrod che ba pho brang dang thag mi ring ba'i stabs kyis der bzhugs pa la gong nas kyang mi bzhed pa med pa bcas dgung lo zhe brgyad pa nas sku ma gshegs bar lo ltar dbyar kha'i ring ri bo rtse lngar phebs bzhugs thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi rim par rtse gcig tu gzhol/dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum pa lcags yos(1771)lor gong ma chan lung gis zhe hor du bod yul gyi pho brang chen po po ta la dang dbyibs mtshungs pa'i gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i zhabs 'gyur lhod med mdzad pa dang /694

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku dbang phyug 'jigs med rgya mtsho dge tshul sdom bzhes kyi mkhan po mdzad/dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi sa chu 'brug(1772)lor gong ma chan lung gis/rang gi rigs gtogs man ju 'di sde rgya che zhing chos la dad pa thob pa mang na'ang / yi ge dang skad rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / snga ma man ju rang skad du chos bsgyur ba cher med pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog man ju'i skad du bsgyur ba zhig byung na phyi rabs la phan che ba des na lcang skya hu thog nas man ju'i skad du bka' 'gyur bsgyur dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa ltar slob grwa'i mi bzang rnams dang pe cin gyi bla ma'i khrod nas skad rigs dang yi ge la mkhas pa rnams dang / hwa shang yon tan ldan pa kha shas bcas kyis bka' 'gyur bsgyur ba'i 'go btsugs/ po ti re re tsam bsgyur zin pa dang rje 'dis zhus chen gnang ste gong mar spyan bstar zhu ba bcas bka' 'gyur cha tshang bsgyur grub pa la lo mang po zhig 'gor 'dugadagung lo drug cu re gcig pa sa phag(1779)lor gong ma chan lung dgung lo bdun cu phebs pa'i dga' ston du paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes pe cin du gdan zhu gnang dang / zhe hor du paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs gnas bkra shis lhun po la dpe blangs ba'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim khang dang / pe cin du lha khang ser po nub mar bzhugs gnas gsar bskrun gnang ba de'i skabs rje 'di nyid nas zhabs 'bring kha shas mtsho sngon gyi bar phebs bsur gtong gnang dang / de'i phyi lo lcags byi(1780)lor paṇa chen rin po che mdo smad nas phyag btegs sog yul brgyud pe cin du phebs rgyu'i phebs bsur gong ma'i bka' bzhin mtsho bdun gyi dgon par phebs/ skabs 'dir 695

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/paṇa chen rin po ches gong ma dgung grangs bdun bcur phebs pa'i dga' ston zhu gnang dang / gong mar bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang dang / mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang 'bul gnang gis mi ring ba paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa gzhan don la gtad cing / lcags glang(1781)lor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser gdung rin po che bod la spyan 'dren pa'i phebs skyel la ching ha'i phu bar byon/ gzhan yang bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po bskyangs pa dang / dus rgyun par yang dgong myur spre'u'i tshod la slebs pa na 'di snang gi mdzad brel ji ltar che yang mtshams 'jog gis sang nyin nyi ma rdzogs par ma 'char gyi bar du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pa de'i bar du gal che re gnyis ma gtogs drag zhan su la yang mjal kha mi gnang zhing / gsol gzim ma gtogs zhabs 'bring gzhan su yang sku drung du 'gro sa med pa shin tu dben cing 'gol bar bzhugs pa/ byes phebs kyi tshe yang phebs byams dang /shing rta sogs la bzhugs pa nas tsha zhag gi sar ma phebs bar gal che re gnyis ma gtogs gzhan su la'ang mjal kha mi gnang bar zhal 'don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa/ gong mar mjal phrad kyi ched pho brang du byon nas cung zad sgug gnang dgos pa'i tshe yang gong ma'i nang 'khor sogs sku drung du 'ong ba rnams la gsung bgros cher mi gnang ba thugs dam 'ba' zhig mdzad pa/ ston mo dang / gzigs mo sogs mi tshogs che ba'i nang bzhugs dgos pa'i tshe yang bzang spyod dang / smon lam bdun cu pa sogs zhal 'don kho na gnang ba/rgyun gyi thugs dam gyi rim pa yang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i skyes bu chung 'bring gi dmigs rnam sngon du 'gro ba'i byang 696

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/chub sems sbyong la nan tan dang / smon 'jug cho gas 'dzin pa dang bcas pa gsang bde 'jigs gsum phyag rdor 'khor chen rnams dang / khyad par du bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad cing /bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor/ bstan srung gi gtor chog gcod stan thog gcig ma/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam/ bzang spyod/ smon lam bdun cu pa sogs dang / mdo sdud pa dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u kha shas re bcas chag med 'don gnang mdzad pa dang / de bzhin ma ṇi zhal 'don gnang ba kho nar mtshon na dung phyur gnyis gsum song yod 'dugade bzhin zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi tshes grangs nges pa can la dbyu gu 'bul ba/bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ rten drung mchod pa dang / phyag dang bskor ba/ sa tsha 'debs pa/ su ru pa dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sogs chos spyod thor bu'i rigs kyang mang po phyag len mdzad pa/ gong ma khri thog gnyis kyi dbu bla gnang nas gong ma'i chos srid kyi bzhed pa bskong ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs dang phyag mchod bsnyen bkur rgya che ba/ skye bo mgon med pa dang /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rnams la sbyin pa'i sgo 'phang rgya cher phye ba/ nad kyis nyen pa la sman dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa la skyabs mdzad pa/ nor rdzas la 'dzin chags gtan nas mi mdzad pa lo ltar phyag rdzas gang byung rnams nas 'phral chas 'dang tsam ma gtogs lhag po gang yod dge ba'i phyogs su gtong ba/ sku snga phyi gnyis kyi ring chod pa'i mi ser mi nyung tsam yod pa rnams la rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs sna gcig kyang mi 'gel ba ma zad/ mi ser gyi 'tsho tshis la gzigs skyong che ba/ gong ma'i sku drung du phebs pa sogs mdzad sgo 697

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gal che'i rigs ma gtogs rgyun du skyi chags pa'i na bza' rnying pa 'ba' zhig gsol ba bcas skyes bu dam pa'i rnam par thar pa bzang po skyong bzhin du mthar dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung gsum pa'i me rta(1786)lo'i hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis nyin pe cin du gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten gnang mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gnas tshul rags pa ni gong du zhus pa ltar lags shing / phan tshun bla slob tu gyur pa dang / gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i tshogs skor/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis rje 'di nyid las chos bka' rgya cher gsan bzhed yod kyang ma grub pas ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid gsan pa dang / rje 'di nyid kyi yongs 'dzin du gyur cing phar yang chos phul bas phan tshun bla slob tu gyur pa ni/ phur lcog byams mgon rje btsun ngag dbang byams pa/ rje bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa khri blo gros rgya tsho'i sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ rje'i dngos slob stag phu gu shrī dpal ldan don grub kyi sku skye stag phu sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba sngags ram par grags pa rwa sgreng yang dgon pa blo bzang don grub/ bde 'byor mkhan po ngag dbang don grub rnams so/ /gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma 'gro 'dren sprul sku che ba'i khrod du/ thugs kyi sras mchog thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ thugs kyi sras mchog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ ye shes brtson 'grus grags pa'i sde/ de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho/rta tshag rje drung sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po/ brag g.yab sprul sku 698

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug lho brag grub chen gyi skye rgyud 'ol dga' rje drung sprul sku 'phrin las lhun grub/ byang sems bde mo thang pa'i skye rgyud sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i skye rgyud rgyal sras sprul sku thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i skye rgyud mnga' ris sprul sku/ dga' ldan khri pa dwags po ba'i yang srid bskal bzang yon tan lhun grub/ 'bru la mkhan chen sprul sku ye shes bstan sgron/ tre bo lha mgon sprul sku blo bzang rnam rgyal/ sgrub khangaljul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal/ mkhar rdo sprul sku blo bzang rin chen/ nyi ma thang zhabs drung ngag dbang chos ldan/ rje sher 'byung blo gros kyi skye rgyud chu bzang sprul sku ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyugaspyan snga pa'i skye brgyud cha han no mon han gyi sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan dge legs rgyal mtshan/ khri rgya nag pa'i sprul sku ngag dbang thub bstan 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi skye ba smin grol no mon han gyi sprul sku ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i skye ba rong po no mon han gyi sprul sku dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas/ mi la'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa g.yer gshong sngags ram pa 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi sprul sku dge 'dun zla ba grags pa/ rje'i dngos slob rong po lce nag pa'i skye brgyud girti sprul sku/ stong 'khor zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi skye brgyud stong 'khor sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ gzhan yang stag lung sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung zhabs drung dkon mchog 'phrin las/ hor grub chen zhabs drung byams pa bstan 'dzin/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / de'i yang sprul dbang phyug 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ 'jam dpal rdo rje no mon han/ yi la gug san no mon han/ gtsang pa 699

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/no mon han/ erte ni paṇ+ḍi ta no mon han blo bzang dbang chen dpal 'bar/dza ya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sprul sku blo bzang snyan grags dge legs rnam rgyal/ mañju shrī no mon han blo bzang 'jam dpal dang / de'i sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mkhar sngon nes chi tho yon dang shi re thu gnyis kyi sprul sku/ tham ka bla ma chos skyabs sku skye/ mtsho bdun gyi tham ka bla ma bi lig thu no mon han gyi sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa rab rgyas/ rwa kho ho thog thu ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang de'i sprul sku/ bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang tshul khrims kyi sku skye/cha har yo ga tsa ri blo bzang thub bstan rgyal mtshan dang / slob dpon bla ma'i sku skye/ a lag sha'i dwags po sprul sku kun grol no mon han/ mong gol jin cha han das yan chi'i sku skye bskal bzang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs bcas dang /chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa'i bla chen yang / rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongasa'adzin du gyur pa khri chen bya khyung ba ngag dbang chos grags dang / co ne ba ngag dbang tshul khrims gnyis/ khri pa spom bor ba blo bzang dri med/ phag mo chos sde pa bsam gtan phun tshogs/ stod lung pa ngag dbang chos grags/khams tsha ba blo bzang bstan pa/ rgyal rong pa blo bzang smon lam rnams dang /gzhan yang / paṇa chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin mnga' ris pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ 'bras spungs sgo mang bla ma rigs pa'i dbang phyug cung gar ba blo bzang chos grags/ gnas brtan chen po sog po sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dbus pa bstan pa yar 'phel/ bra nye ba ngag dbang dge legs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub/ a mdo ka ring ba blo bzang chos dar/ blo gsal gling bla ma go bo 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs/ mi nyag sbyin pa don grub/ nyag ri ngag dbang grags pa/nyag ri pu to ba/ tre hor blo bzang dge legs/ bde yangs bla ma zhabs drung /700

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sngags pa bla ma blo bzang shes rab/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ ser byes pa bla ma e pa blo bzang mkhas mchog lha sa pa byams pa smon lam/ dbus stod pa rin chen skal bzang/ smad pa bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan/ blo bzang rin chen/ grags pa 'phrin las/ sbyin pa chos bzang / dgon lung chos sde'i khri pa sum pa zhabs drung ye shes dpal 'byor/ bde rgu zhabs drung ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho/rgya tig smon lam pa blo bzang don grub/ gzhung brgya smra ba skal bzang lha dbang / wang zhabs drung skal bzang ye shes dar rgyas/ bde dgu dar rgyas rgya mtsho/ sku 'bum mkhan po ra kho dpon slob shes rab chos 'byor/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po dge 'dun don grub/ gser tog no min han blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ mi nyag zhabs drung ngag dbang blo gros dar rgyas/ stag mtsher zhabs drung ye shes skal bzang / gro tshang mkhan blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ bya khyung mkhan po rtsa ba blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ bde khang pa blo bzang rab brtan/bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri pa sde pa zhabs drung 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho/bsod nams grags pa/ bsod nams dbang rgyal/ pho brang chen por phu'u yin bla ma dpal 'byor ho thog dang / sgo mang ho thog thu/ chos sde chen po yung he gung gi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas 'od zer/ mtshan sgrog mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas/ zhabs drung skal bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ zhe ho bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan po gtsang pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ gdung nag zhabs drung / lha btsun no mon han ngag dbang lhun grub dar rgyas sam ngag dbang rdo rje/ or du sur no yon blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ u cu mu chin zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis/ pad dkar chos gling 'debs mkhan dus 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ har chin lha btsun bkra shis dar rgyas/ thor god dge 701

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bshes snyan grags/ thu med mong mol cin dgon pa'i mkhan smon ram pa bstan dar/ zhabs drung ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ gsung rab mang po hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba sogs kyi phyag rjes can a pa ga tas gu shrī ngag dbang bstan 'phel dang / bzod pa gu shrī/ thu med lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos dpal/ a ro hor chin ming ge thu gu shrī/ ja ro gu shrī/ dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa ser byes bla zur brag ri zhal snga nas ngag dbang don grub/chos 'phags kyi rnam 'phrul du grags shing nyag ri chos grags kyi sku skye klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang / prad rin chen brag gi bla ma brag rgyab sngags ram blo bzang chos 'phel/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhang zhung dge slong ye shes mtha' yas/ byang rtse dpon slob sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ bya bral mnga' ris pa thogs med/ bya bral dge bshes 'od zer/ 'bras spungs dka' bcu dngos grub/ dge 'phel bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan/ bkra shis sgo mang gi khri pa lha btsun smon ram pa mthu stobs nyi ma/ mdo smad 'brug tshang pa chos grags dar rgyas/ rje nyid kyi zhabs 'bring ba'i khrod du dza sag bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel/sku mdun chos rje bstan pa rin chen/ nye gnas dge legs nam mkha'/ hwa shang gi slob dpon chan zhi ta then hwa shang dang / yung hwa shang / lo hwa shang /shes hwa shang / gzhan yang gong ma bde skyid rgyal po'i sras bcu gnyis pa dang /gong ma chan lung gi sras lnga pa dang drug pa brgyad pa/ bod nas kyang stag lung ga zi'i gdung rgyud zhabs drung mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal/ dga' bzhi gung paṇ+ḍi ta/ thon mi'i gdung rgyud zhabs drung srid chod tshe brtan/ rgya ma khri khang pa dza sag dbang 'dus sogs mi chen mang po zhig kyang rje 'di'i slob mar gyur pa bcas de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma/702

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dam pa'i skyes rabs 'dzin pa'i sprul sku/ chos kyi gdan khri la bzhugs pa'i bla chen/ bka' pod mang por sbyangs pa'i dge bshes/ sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i spong ba pa/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde la mkhas pa'i hwa shang / dad pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i khyim bdag sogs kyis mtha' dbus nor 'dzin gyi khyon thams cad gang bar mdzad do/ /legs bshad kyi gsung rtsom yang / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dpag bsam rin po che'i snye ma/ gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi sgo nas bstod par thugs rje'i nyin phyed 'dren pa'i skya rengs/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi rnam thar mkha' spyod grub pa'i gtam snyan lha'i rnga bo che/ grub mtha'i rnam par gzhag pa thub bstan lhun po'i mjos rgyan/dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad sems bskyed dang po rtsom 'phro can/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod/ bzang spyod smon lam gyi rnam bshad kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i rnam bshad mkhas pa dga' bskyed tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangs/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i sa bcad byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul bshad pa theg chen 'jug sgo/ dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa'i sgron me/ lha khrid mdor bsdus gnyis/ theg chen blo sbyong gi gtam gyi sbyor ba pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ dge legs su byed pa'i gtam drang srong sngon par dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor la brten nas lam gyi rim pa'i dge sbyor skyong tshul/ bla ma mchog gsum spyi'i cho ga yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ rje bdag nyid chen po gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs lhag pa'i lha sna tshogs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rna la 703

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'byor gyi rim pa/ thub dbang la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa/'jigs byed/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can ma rnams kyis bstod pa/ spyan ras gzigs la gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa/ byang chub lam rim dang sbyar ba'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang nges 'byung skyo shas kyi shugs glu gzhan yang bla ma mang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi skor/ mgur ma dang zhal gdams bslab bya mang po/ sngags kyi skor la bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi gsol 'debs rnam bshad gtan bde'i bsil ba ster byed zla zer/ gsang 'dus bsnyen yig dngos grub bdud rtsi'i bum bzang/ 'khor lo sdom pa lū dril gnyis kyi bsnyen pa byed tshul mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil bum chog dang bdag 'jug ngag 'don/ dril bu lha lnga'i smon lam shis brjod/ bde mchog gi zas mchod dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya tshul 'dod pa 'jo ba/ de'i sgo nas lho sgo'i cho ga bya tshul sdig sgrib sbyong byed zla ba'i 'od zer/ bde mchog lū i pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab dkar bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bstod pa dpa' bo dgyes pa bskyed ched bde ba chen po'i sgra dbyangs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal snying po kye rdo rje'i lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i rgya mtsho/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje lhun po brtsegs pa/ 'khor chen lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba/ de'i mngon rtogs mdor bsdus/ 'khor lo chen po'i ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul srid gsum bgegs dpung 'joms byed rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor chen gyi sbyin sreg bya 704

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/tshul dngos grub gter mdzod/ tshem bu dmar khrid kyi man ngag bdud rtsi yang zhun/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod/ de'i shis brjod smon lam dam tshig gsum bkod gyi sgrub thabs sgyung gnas cho ga dang bcas pa las sgrib dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg gshin po rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa mngon dga'i zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas/ de'i smon lam shis brjod/ bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga dgos 'dod re ba kun skong / gza' yum gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga bkra shis rab rgyas/ bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs 'chi bdag 'dzoms pa'i mtshon cha/ de'i sgo nas tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul gyi cho ga dgos 'dod re ba kun skong / bde mchog dkar po yab yum la tshe'i dngos sgrub zhu ba'i gsol 'debs bde chen bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bde mchog dkar po dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs gter mdzod/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying po/ de'i tshe khrid dngos grub bang mdzod/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med dga' ston/ de'i bstod pa tshe'i dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ 'chi ltas brtag pa dang tshe sgrub bya tshul/ rdor sems bla med lugs kyi rjes gnang gi tho yig rdor sems yab yum gyi bum sgrub bya tshul gaṅga'i chu rgyan/ gdugs dkar gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga bkra shis rab rgyas/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs ā ra pa tsa na dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs che chung / mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi blab thabs/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub 705

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/thabs/ dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs tshul 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i bstod pa/ bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ rdo rje srung ma rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul las bzhi lhun grub/ yang chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul tshul/ rnam sras kyi gtor chog dam can gyi gtor chog dpa' bo'i gad rgyang / 'phrin las drag po gnyer du gtad pa'i tshigs bcad/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog zhi ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ rgyal po sku lnga'i gsol mchod/ rma chen gyi gsol mchod/ pho lha dung skyong dkar po'i gsol mchod/ bsangs chog gi yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ mahā na so'i gsol mchod/dgon lung gi gnas bdag 'od ldan rgya mtsho'i gsol kha sogs mdo sngags kyi gsung gi skor rnams dang / dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas/ sum rtags kyi don nyung ngur bshad pa blo ldan dga' bskyed/ tsan+dan jo bo'i lo rgyus dang skor tshad rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgyal khab chen po'i nub sgo'i mchod rten dkar po'i dkar chag dad pa rgyas byed/ ri bo rtse lnga'i dkar chag rgyas pa rtsom 'phro can rnams dang dris lan dang chab shog skor mang po yod/gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor/ bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rim dmar khrid zhal shes bde chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen sgrub kyi rnam gzhag gsang chen bcud kyi thig le/gtum mo'i khrid yig bde ba chen po'i rgya mtsho/ shin tu gsang ba'i mgur dbyangs mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying gi thig le bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs/ phag mo'i 'phreng sngags kyi mchan 'grel/ kyai rdor gyi rdo rje'i glu'i 'grel pa/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag dus 'khor gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag lam zab 706

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul/ snyan brgyud thun mong ma/ yin pa las tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs nang sgrub dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa bde chen rgyas pa'i dga' ston/ bde mchog lus dkyil dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor snyan brgyud ma/ bde mchog mkha' spyod ma mgon po gsum 'brel gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug tu bgrod pa'i them skas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim sgom tshul shin tu zab pa/ mgon po snying zhugs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du chag med bya tshul/bklag chog dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ lha gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i tshe sgrub rgyun 'khyer tshe srog brtan byed rdo rje'i go cha/ tshe bdag mgon po'i tshe sgrub bya tshul/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngagagator sgrub kyi skabs su mkho ba'i gshen rje gshed dkar ser dmar gsum gyi bstod pa 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa bcas gsung rtsom snga phyi thams cad bsdoms na po ti dgu tsam yod/mjug bsdu ba/ da lam bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos su dpe skrun mdzad skabs rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ci rigs shig 'bri dgos gsung nan ltar rje 'di nyid kyi rnam thar dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dang yang rgyan mu tig chun po las btus pa'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus mtshams sbyor zhu mtshams 'dir byas so/ /707

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol/ zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol ni/ yum bkra shis brtsegs pa zhes pa'i sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags glang(1781)lor mdo smad reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi char gtogs zho 'ong gnyan rgya zhes par sku bltams/mtshan la ngag dbang bkra shis zhes gsol/ dgung lo brgyad par a mes ngag dbang gi mdun du yi ge'i sbyor klog sogs sbyangs pa tshegs med par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu par zho 'ong sngags mang chos thog gi gral du zhugs/dgung lo bcu bdun par gling rgya'i lha bzo bstan pa dar rgyas las lha bris bslabs pa yang tshegs med par mkhyen/ de nas 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang /o rgyan 'phrin las rnam gnyis kyi zhabs pad bsten nas mdo sngags chos kyi gdams pa gang mang gsan/ dgung lo nyer gcig par a rig dge bshes byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang / rgyal mkhan chen gyis gsang ston mdzad de rab byung dang / bsnyen rdzogs chig bsgrubs mdzad cing /mtshan byams pa chos dar zhes gsol/ de nas rgyal mkhan chen dang lhan du rtse gzhung du phebs te ching wang ngag dbang dar rgyas(mkhas dbang chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po)las mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur thos bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad pas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang mthon por son/ dgung lo nyer drug pa nas rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims te sgrub pa lhur len snying por mdzad nas bod kyi gnas chen yod do cog la zhabs kyis bcags/ stod kyi gnas chen gangs 708

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dkar te se dang / la phyi sogs dang / smad kyi gnas chen rma chen dang / mtsho snying / brag dkar sprel rdzong sogs dben gnas brgya phrag la lo ngo sum cu'i ring sgrub pa lhur len mdzad cing 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ pad+ma rang grol dang / skal ldan rang grol/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ lcang lung sprul pa'i sku sogs mtshan snyan can gyi bu slob mang po bskyangs pa bcas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad mthar dgung lo don gcig pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags phag(1851)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus/zhabs dkar pa'i gsung rtsom la rang rnam gyis mtshon pa'i pod nyer lnga yod par grags pa'i nang gi mgur 'bum las dum bu zhig dpe mtshon du drangs na/ 'ga' res khyed kyi mgur dbyangs klong nas brdol ba rer gzhan ltar 'bad rtsol mi dgos par nam 'dod dus la thogs pa med par 'then chog pa ya mtshan che zer ba'i lam bu yid la shar ba ltar dbyangs 'di blangs so /drang srong thang dkar rgod po de/ /tshang gi nang nas gshog sgro rgyas/ /g.yang sa chod dus nam mkhar 'phur/ /da lta nam 'phang ches cher bstod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i slob bu ngas/ /bla ma'i drung nas thos bsam byas/ /sgro 'dogs chod dus ri khrod 'grims/ / da lta bsgom la ches cher brtson/ /lha bya yid 'ong gong mo yis/ /709

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/g.ya' spang khrod nas rtswa chu btsal/ /da lta gangs g.ya'i mtshams na bsdad/ /na bun khrod na skad snyan bsgyur/ /gangs can bod yul glu pa ngas/ /rong dang 'brog nas lto gos btsal/ /da lta dben pa'i ri na bsdad/ /bu slob khrod na glu dbyangs len/ /rwa bcu rgyas pa'i sha ba yis/ /ri bo'i rtse nas rgyang so bltas/ /shod du 'ong nas dkyus rtsed byas/ /slar yang rdza ri mthon por bsnyegs/ /rig pa rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /ri khrod dben par phan sems sbyangs/ /grong du song nas chos bshad byas/ /slar yang dben pa'i ri khrod bsnyegs/ /btung ba 'bab chu bsil ma de/ /'bad cing rtsol ba mi dgos par/ /rnal 'byor mgrin las rang rdol byung / /sus thos nyon mongs gdung ba sel /zhes blangs so gsungs pa'i mgur dbyangs ni rnal 'byor pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i ngang tshul klong nas brdol ba'i rtsom gshis ni ched ngo mtshar ldan pa zhig yin/ khong dang 710

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mtshungs pa'i bod kyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan mang pos nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs pa dang / blang dor gsal bar ston pa'i gdams pa rgya chen po gzhan la mgur dbyangs su gsungs pa'i nang don ni rgya che la phun sum tshogs pa smos ci dgos/ tshig sbyor gyi ngo mtshar yang gcig las gcig lhag pa mang po mchis pa'i khrod du khong gi gsung mgur yang gal che ba'i gnas babs bzung yod/ khong gis khengs skyungs ngang mgur 'bum gyi gleng gzhi'i nang 'di ltar gsungs pa ste/de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / de nyid thun mong gi gdul bya la shākya thub pa'i skur bzhengs te/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas zhi ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rgya gar chu bo gang gā phan chad du grub thob brgyad cu la sogs dpag tu med pa bzhengs shing / khyad par dpal sa ra ha chen pos do ha rdo rje'i glu mdzad pa dang / bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na bsam yas mchims phur grub chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/lha sa dang / yer pa grub chen brgya rtsa/ lho brag mkhar chur grub chen nyi shu rtsa gcig dpal chen chu bo rir grub chen sum cu so lnga sogs byon pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i mgur brazhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bstan pa bar dar dang /phyi dar gyi dus su yang bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la grub pa brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar pa/ mi la ras pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dwags po gling ras pa/ 'khrul zhig rgya ras pa/ grub chen me long rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 711

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/klong chen rab 'byams pa/ rgod tshang pa/ yang dgon pa/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho la sogs pa rnams kyis ri khrod phyogs med 'grims/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ dka' spyad dang du blangs/ rang don mngon du gyur nas gzhan don du rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bdag kyang mkha' lding dbang po bgrod pa'i lha lam yangs por bung ba bgrod pa'i rtsal stobs zhan yang 'phur lding g.yo zhing dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa bzhin du/ grub thob gong ma rnams ltar nyams rtogs yon tan med rung / rnam thar dri ma med pa'i rjes su kha mig yar yar bltas nas dben par sgrub pa la gzhol bzhin du rang gzhan chos la bskul phyir lhag bsam rnam par dag pas mgur dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa 'di skal bzang blo ldan rnams la dga' ston du 'bul lo zhes gsungs pa 'dis rtogs nus so/ /dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/rdza dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa 'brug(1808)lor byang rdza chu khar sku 'khrungs/ dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi yang sprul du ngos 'dzin byas nas mtshan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang por gsol/ khong gi sku tshe hril por bya bral gyi mdzad pa bskyangs /gsung rtsom la khrid yig〈kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung〉 sogs nyams len dang zhal gdams kyi skor dang / byams chos kyi 'grel pa sogs gzhung bshad kyi skor/ (gtam pad+ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar〉 sogs gtam tshogs skor bcas pod bdun tsam mdzad cing / mthar rab byung bco lnga pa'i me phag(1887)lor 712

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sku gshegs/khong gi gsung rtsom nas mtshon pa mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod pas bod kyi mkhas pa'i nang du snyan par grags pa'i gdugs dkar bla nar 'khor zhing / lhag par bod kyi zlos gar rig pa'i thad gzhan las phul du byung ba'i mdzad rjes bzhag pa(gtam pad+ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar〉 zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos des gsal por rtogs nus/ dpe mtshon du/ zlos gar de'i nang gi gser gyi sbrang chung pad+ma'i 'dab yangs dang /g.yu'i sbrang chung pad+ma'i ngag snyan zhes bya ba khyo shug gnyis gnas pa'i yul pad+ma spungs pa'i skyed tshal gyi khor yug skor gsungs pa 'di lta ste/pad+ma spungs pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba ljon shing gi ra bas bskor ba'i spang ljongs me long gi ngos ltar mnyam pa na pad+ma rgyas pa'i tshal yod pa ste/ de yang khengs pa'i pad+ma rnams sdong bu ring ba/ rgyas pa'i pad+ma rnams 'dab ma yangs pa/ smin pa'i pad ma rnams zil mngar mang ba/ bkod pa'i pad ma rnams lo ma che ba/ ma smin pa'i pad+ma rnams myu gu bkra ba/ zum pa'i pad+ma rnams thal mo sbyar ba/ god pa'i pad+ma rnams ge sar bral ba/ zag pa'i pad+ma rnams rtsi bcud kyis stongs pa/ rnyings pa'i pad+ma rnams 'dab ma lhung ba/ dgod pa'i pad+ma rnams ge sar ngom pa/ sbas pa'i pad+ma rnams sbubs na gnas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i pad+ma rnams kyang skye bar rung ba zhig yod do zhes pad+ma spungs pa'i skyed mos tshal gyi gnas lugs ches gson nyams ldan pa 'dis zlos gar gyi nang don gzhan ma rnams kyang sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ches mtho ba smos ma dgos so/ /713

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'drug pa pad+ma dkar po/'brug pa pad+ma dkar po ni/ yab jo sras klu'i dbang po dang / yum chos skyong sgrol ma rnam gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dgu pa'i me phag(1527)lor mchims yul dgon gyi grong du sku bltams/ dgung lo gsum par 'brug pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po dang mjal/ dgung lo dgu par sngon gyi gnas lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams su phebs/ de nas ring por ma lon pa me sprel lo chos kyi gdan khri chen por mnga' gsol/ de nas bzung ste slob dpon shes rab go cha las yi ge'i phyi mo 'bri ba dang klog pa tshul bzhin du bslabs/ slob dpon chos grags bstan 'phel ba dang / kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam pa sogs mkhas pa mang po bsten nas thun mong dang / thun mong min pa'i rig pa'i gnas la mkhas par sbyangs/ bstan pa'i bdag po kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang por gtsug phud phul/ yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ dbang lung rjes gnang mang po gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun par chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen du kun dga' bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos mkhan po mdzad de dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa chig rdzogs su mnos te mtshan ngag dbang kun‘ dga' rnam rgyal nor bu dpal bzang por gsol zhing / byang chub sems bskyed kyi mtshan ni mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'o/ /kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa dang /gsung rtsom la mtshon na phyi nang rig pa'i gnas kyi gsung rtsom pod bcu bzhi 714

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzhugs/ mthar dgung lo drug cu re dgu pa rab byung bcu pa'i me sprel (1596)lor dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus/kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas la bka' drin che ba'i gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du/ rgyal sras gcung rin po che'i rnam thar nang nas dum bu zhig drangs pa 'di lta ste/ ya rabs rnams ni gzhan gyi ched du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po sgrub pa la zhugs nas/ dam pa'i yon tan 'tshol ba la ngoms pa med do zhes thos te/ de yang ma ga dha las rgyang ring pos byang du phyin pa'i yul kha ba can gyi lte ba/ nor sbyin gyi tshogs kyi gtso bo gang ba bzang po'i pho brang gangs kyi ri bo dpal gyi dum bus brgyan pa lhun dang mtho tshad kyis nor 'dzin gyi dbus na 'khor lo'i lte ba lta bur 'phags pa/'char ka'i 'od kyi reg pas rtse mo 'dzam bu na dā'i mdog tu snang ba/ chu dang ldan pa'i sprin 'brug gi sgra dal bu dal bur sgrogs pa mgul du 'khrigs pa/dbang po'i gzhu do shal bzhin du bzung ba/ ri bo'i sul sul nas sgra snyan pa snyan par sgrogs pa'i 'bab chu dang / bkod ma dang / chu mig dang / nor lhas dang / ngang pa'i sdes gang ba'i mtsho in+d+ra nī la bcag pa'i 'phro ltar sngo ba/ ne'u gsing nor bu mthon ka'i me long phyis pa lta bus brgyan nas kha dog gi bye brag tha dad du ston pa'i ri bo phran du ma 'khor du bskor te rgyu skar rnams kyi bdag po la 'gran pa bzhin du 'dug go /nye 'od gser gyi cod pan rab bcings na bun ras bal do ker can/ /dbang po'i gzhu yi do shal rab bkra zla ba chu shel mdangs 'dzin cing / /'bab chu rab dwangs ska rags yid 'ong ne'u gsing gsar pas smad dkris pa/ / 715

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gang ba bzang po'i ri bo ya mtshan thams cad 'dus pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gangs ri'i bu mo sos ka'i nyi gzhon gyis/ /rtse dgas dub pa'i thul ris bkru ba la/ /dbyar ka'i drod kyis sprin 'phreng bzhu ba'i rgyun/ /bar snang lam las de ru phab pa bzhin/ /rab dkar ngang pa'i sde rnams rol pa'i mtsho /an+da rnyil ltar sngo zhing rab dwangs pa/ /rgyu skar phreng ba mang pos lus mdzes pa'i/ /sngo bsang nam mkha'i bu mo'i rjes su 'gro/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i mdangs 'dra sa 'dzin rnams/ /mi yi 'jig rten lus kyis gang byas nas/ /nam mkhar 'phags te skabs gsum rtsed 'jo la/ /blta 'dod mgrin pa gyen du btegs pa bzhin/ /de lta bu'i rmugs 'dzin gyi 'dun sa chen po'i mdun na 'phral du rnam pa srid dang / 'byor pa dang / bkra shis pa'i rtags du ma yun du gshin par gyur pa'i sman gyi ljongs yangs pa dang / nyams bde ba dang / rtswa ljang ser bser bus bskyod pa'i ri mo chu'i gnyer ma lta bu ni 'khrigs/ me tog sna tshogs pa 'dab 'bras ma'i mchu phye nas ge sar gyi 'dzum ston pas ni brgyan/ gdung ba'i khyad par ma lus pa sel ba'i rtsa bas/ lo ma dang / yal ga dang / sdong bu dang / 'bras bu'i rnam pa mang po'i sman gyis ni gang / sbrang rtsis myos pa'i bung ba glu len pa rnams lang long du 'du/ bya dus su mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs snyan 716

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/par brdung ba ni mod/ spu sdug pa'i ri dwags rtsed 'jo la mkhas pas ni gtams/ rba rlabs kyi lag pa brkyangs nas chu thogs kyi mu tig 'thor ba'i chu klung gi bu mo yid chags pa ni yod/brag ri'i dum bu brtsegs pa'i bya skyibs dbang po'i gzhu rengs pa lta bu rnams dka' thub pas ni gang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa rnams kyi bzi gnas su ni gyur pa de na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs kyi mthu mtshungs pa med pa 'ba' zhig bzhugs pa'i kun nas grub pa'i gtsug lag khache chen po/ dpal ra lung thel zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rdo rje gdan/ sa la 'og min gyi zhing 'phos pa lta bu 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa der 'dug par gyur to/ /bser bus bskyod pa'i rtswa sngo'i ri mo 'khrigs pa rba rlabs yol ba'i gnyer ma dang / /me tog mgo lcogs ldem pa de dag chu bya phan tshun rtse ba'i rol pa dang / /yal 'dab 'bras phyug sman ljon 'dab brgya'i sdong po ge sar can du 'khrul nas su/ /bung ba'i na chung myos pa rnams ni pad+ma can sems ci yang rab gar bsgyur/ /mchu yi yal 'dab rnam par phye nas ge sar so phreng 'dzum pa ston pa'i chu skyes na chung bzhin mdzes la /dal 'gro'i grogs mos lbu ba'i shel phreng ci yang thogs pa'i rba rlabs lag pas chu thigs rna rgyan 'god byed pa'i/ /717

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dga' ston la spro 'dab chags mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs brdung ba'i sgra snyan gyis ni sbrang rtsi'i bu rnams bkug mthong nas/ /mthon mthing mig 'bras ya mtshan phyogs der lhung bas yid 'ong ri dwags rnams ni mgrin pa 'khyogs par gyur pa bzhin/ /chu ldan sprin gyi bla bres phub gyur cing / /sgra bcas glog gi yol ba'i 'dzum chags pa/ /ri bo'i bya skyibs de dag dka' thub pas/ /gang ba mig gsum gnas pa'i gangs can bzhin/ /rin chen rtsig pa rab brtan btsug lag khang / /legs byas 'od kyis phyogs rnams 'gengs byed pa/ /lhun po gzugs gzhan 'dra ste 'jig rten na/ /dpal ldan ra lung thel zhes grags pa 'dzin/ /sgrub pa mang pos byang chub brnyes pas na/ /rdo rje gdan dang 'og min gang yin zhes/ /dpyod ldan drang por gnas pa'i yid rnams la/ /som nyi'i kun rtog ci yang de yis sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di'i thog nas kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po ni 'brug pa'i skyes chen dam pa'i nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa gang gis bstan 'gro'i don du mdzad pa rlabs po che bstan pa rnams smos ci dgos/ bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas la mdzad pa rlabs po che bstan pa 'di kho na'i bka' drin yang gzhal bar dka' ba skabs 'dir drangs pa dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdan sa ra lung thel gyi snod bcud kyi ngo mtshar bcad lhug spel ma'i lam 718

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nas bstan bya'i nang don rgya che la rjod byed tshig sbyor snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur 'bum dang ldan pa 'di dang 'di lta bu ni nga tsho phyi rabs pa rnams la lam ston gyi sgron me dang / myang na bde ba'i dpal ster ba dpag bsam gyi snye ma dang kun nas mtshungs pa lags so/ /dngul chu dharma bha dra/dngul chu dharma bha dra'am bla ma chos bzang ni/ yab bkra shis dpal 'byor dang / yum mkha' 'gro dpal skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu 'brug(1772)lor gtsang g.yas ru'i cha rung stod phyug mo'i yul du sku 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu gcig par sku zhang rgan po lha bu zhes pa las yi ge 'bri klog sbyong ba'i dbu tshugs te khong gi khyim tshang dbul bas ra lug 'tsho zhor la yi ge sbyong gnang mdzad pas dus ring po ma thogs par 'bri klog legs par mkhyen/dgung lo bcu bzhi pa shing sbrul lor bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel gling du slob dpon blo bzang rgyal mtshan la skra phud phul te chos sgor zhugs/ mtshan la blo bzang tshe ring zhes gsol zhing / lo der mkhan chen ngag dbang rdo rje'i drung du dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa rim bzhin bzhes/ dgung lo bcu dgu par yum dang sru mo dus gcig tu 'das pas thugs skyo ste/ dben gnas dngul chu ri khrod du phebs te sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa lcags khyi lor slob dpon ye shes dpal grub kyi drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa chu byi lor blo bzang skal bzang chos rgyal 719

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsten nas zab chos du ma gsan bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gnyis nas so gnyis bar lo bcu'i ring bkra shis lhun por thengs mang phebs te 'brong rtse blo bzang tshul khrims dang / gu ge yongs 'dzin blo bzang tshul khrims/ grub dbang skal bzang chos rgyal sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas bka' chos mang po zhus pa dang / lhag par rje drung blo bzang dge 'dun las sgra dang / snyan ngag sum rtags/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor bcas legs par sbyangs te mkhas pa'i yar rtser son pa'i grags pa mtha' gru kun la khyab cing / dgung lo so lnga pa me stag lo gangs can skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam bshad mkhas mchog si tu'i zhal lung zhes bya ba rang cag phyi rabs pa rnams kyi rnam par dpyod pa'i mig rab 'byed pa'i gser gyi thur ma brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi legs bshad kun go gcig chod rmad du byung ba'i bstan bcos grags pa gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon la 'bar ba de nyid mdzad pa ma zad/ dgung lo so lnga nas bzung sgrub pa nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher spel ba dang / legs bshad rmad du byung ba'i brtsams chos pod drug bka' rtsom gnang ba/ gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang mkhan chen ngag dbang snyan grags dang / ri sbug sprul sku blo gsal bstan skyong / bde chen sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims sogs mkhas grub mang po byung ba bcas de lta bu'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bskyangs te mthar dgung lo brgyad cur phebs pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags phag(1851)lor dngul chu ri khrod du sku gshegs/mkhas pa'i dbang po dngul chu dharma bha dra'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom nang nas dpe mtshon du snyan ngag le tshan nas dum bu gcig drangs pa 'di lta ste/720
