bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/swaste/ lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo mchog /dpal ldan bla ma la btud nas//rang la nyams myong med kyang 'dir/ /phan pa'i gros 'debs cung zad bya//ka ba lta bur rgyud bsrangs na/ /kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pas na//kha zhe mi mthun spyod pa rnams/ /spangs nas drangs po'i ngang tshul zungs//ga dar sems la bgyis na ni/ /'di phyi gtan du bde bas na//nga rgyal phrag dog 'gran sems sogs/ /sems kyi dri ma 'bad pas sol//ca co'i smra ba sgro zur can/ /mi bzad ngan 'gro'i 'bab stegs yin//cha med long gtam mang po la/ /dga' bar ma byed gre bar bskyil//ja chang zas skom longs spyod tsam/ /kla klo blun po la yang yod//nya lto ba bzhin tshe 'di blos/ /btang nas dal 'byor don yod 'tshal//ta la'i shing sdong ltar gyong ba'i/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs dug gsum 'di//tha rgod zhing rengs rmon pa bzhin/ /'dul la kun tu brtson pa bsten//da gdod bya zhes phyi shol gyi/ /le lo'i dbang du song gyur na//na rga 'chi ba'i pho nya des/ /glo bur khrid na ci tshug byed//pa tra gzhan gyi lad mo dang / /g.yam la rgyug pa tsam min par//pha rol ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa la/ /'jigs pas snying nas lha chos mdzod//ba mo lta bur ches dkar ba'i/ /lhag bsam snying stobs chen po yis//ma lus 'gro 'di ngas sgrol zhes/ /dam bca'i khur chen khrag tu longs//tsa ra bda' 'ded ma byas na/ /gces 'dzin gcong nad mi thon pas//tsha grang ngal dub khyad bsad nas/ /bdag pas gzhan gces sgom par bya//dza lang can gyi bdag 'dzin 'di/ /bdag med lta bas ma bcom na//wa kha'i chu bzhin ngan song du/ /'bab pa nyid las 'os ci yod//721

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zha ltar bla ma gus bsten nas//bsaṭa sbyang gsol 'debs byas pa'i mthar//zwa tshod spu ltar rno ba'i blos/ /bdag 'dzin zhen yul grub min brtag/'a 'ur shab shob tsam min par/ /gting nas bdag med rtogs na ni//ya ri ma ri gzhan med par/ /rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag nas khyongs//rwa can zla ba'i dpe bzhin du/ /rjes thob 'khrul snang ci shar yang //la 'ur gnyug ma'i don dran nas/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bskyang bar bya//sha rus gdod bcas phung po 'di/ /bde stong chos kyi zur sbyangs nas//sa las sha mo rdol ba ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha skur ldang bar bya//ha cang bsgrims dang glod min par//dag pa'i snang zhen rgyun bskyangs nas//a 'thas 'khrul pa'i snang zhen 'di/ /mtha' dag drungs nas dbyung bar mdzod//'di ni dge slong bhu su ku/ /dbang phyug chos bzang zhes bya bas//dge tshul ye shes chos grags kyi/ /'dod pa ji bzhin bris pa yin//dge'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bka' rtsom 'di ni sho lo ka re'i nang gsal byed gnyis re byas pa'i ka bshad rtsom tshul thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin pa dpe rgyan dang /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas nang don gsal bar bstan pa 'dis mtshon snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom mang pos kyang bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas nang nus pa rlabs chen thon yod do/ /dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje/dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje ni/ yab dharma bha dra'i gcung po 722

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bkra shis dang / yum tshe ring sri chod gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa sbrul(1809)lor gtsang g.yas ru'i bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel yi nye 'dabs su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par khu bo dharma bha dra'i drung du klog bslabs nas sbyor klog blo 'dzin sogs la thogs pa med pa byung / dgung lo bcu gcig pa sa yos lor bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs te dka' chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi mdun du skra phud phul ba dang / mtshan la blo bzang chos 'phel btags/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa lcags 'brug lor dka' chen dkon mchog chos 'phel las dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa nas bzung thos bsam gyi dbu tshugs/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa me phag lor dharma bha dra'i zhabs zhu mdzad de tha snyad kyi rig gnas dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya chen por gsan bsam mdzad/ dgung lo so bzhi par dharma bha dra'i mdun du snyan ngag dang / sgra kā la pa'i rgyugs phul bar bla mas thugs dgyes chen pos legs so dang kun bshad kyi mtshan dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje gsol ba phyis yongs grags kyi mtshan du gyur/ lo de'i zla ba bzhi par dharma bha dra'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa mnos shing / de nas bzung dge slong gi bslab bya'i 'khrid sogs 'dul ba'i skor gyi zab khrid rgya mtsho lta bu gsan bsam gnang bas mtshon bla ma'i thugs la bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos tshul bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis zhus shing / rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/dgung lo zhe gsum rang gi bla ma ste khu bo dharma bha dra zhing gzhan la phebs rjes dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba legs par bsgrubs/ de nas bla ma'i rjes 'dzin nas gdan sa rgya bskyed dang sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs mdzad/ bla ma'i gsung 'bum par du brkos/ dgung lo re gcig par dbus su phebs te 723

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dgon gnas dang rten khyad par 'phags pa rnams la phyag mchod dang / bla chen dpon chen mang por dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi phul/ dgung lo re gnyis par gdan sar phyir phebs te bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas dge ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs shing / gangs can mkhas pa yongs kyis gtsug gi tog ltar bskur/ mkhas grub kyi slob ma grags chen ngag dbang tshul khrims/ sgo mang lha rams pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bla ma ye shes chos 'phel/smin grol no mon han/ chab mdo 'phags pa lha/ chu bzang ho thog thu/ blo bzang 'jigs med sogs mang po bskyangs pa dang / bstan 'gro'i don bla na med pa mdzad de mthar dgung lo don dgu pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i me phag (1887)lor sku gshegs/mkhas mchog dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rtsom gsang sngags kyi skor dang / thun mong rig gnas kyi skor sogs pod gsum bzhugs pa'i nang sum cu pa'i snying po legs bshad ljon dbang dang / rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long gnyis ni sum rtags kyi gzhung rgyas pa tshig nyung ngus gsal por bstan pa'i bstan bcos 'di dag gis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim nang nus pa dpag par dka' ba thon cing / deng gi dus la cha bzhag na'ang slob chung slob ma yan bod kyi rig gnas don gnyer mkhan mchis so cog gis bstan bcos 'di gnyis ngag skyor byang chub pa dang 'brel bar sum rtags kyi gzhung don dpyis phyin pa shes thabs byed pa nas sgo btsugs te bod kyi spyi dang bye brag gi rig gnas khong du chud par byed pa'i thabs mchog bla na med pa bstsal ba'i mdzad rjes ni rang cag tshang ma'i yid la rdo ba'i ri mo ltar gnas pa ma zad/ snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom gyis kyang bod kyi 724

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus nang nus pa rlabs chen thon pa'i gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du skabs 'dir snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom dbyangs chung tshan pa gnyis las dang po drangs pa 'di lta ste/dbyangs chung tshan pa gnyis las dang po/i swaste sir+ghaṃ/ mi mjed zhing gi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras po/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma blo bzang gi grags pa/ /dbyer med drin can bla ma dharma yi bha dra/ /gus ldan bu yi spyi bo'i rgyan mchog tu bzhugs shig /dbyar dus mkha' las 'brug sgra lhod pa ru bsgrags tshe/ /rma bya'i tshogs rnams dga' ba'i gar stabs shig bsgyur byung / /de tshe bdag kyang 'gram pa lag pa yis skyor nas/ /lus kyi 'gying bag rnam 'gyur dbang med du thon song / /dpyid dus rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i sman ljongs kyi ngogs nas/ /bya yi rgyal po khu byug gsung snyan zhig bsgyur byung / /de tshe bdag gi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi gnas nas/ /ngag gi glu dbyangs rnam 'gyur dbang med du thon song / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba gtsang phyogs kyi nang tshan/ /yul gyi dge bcu tshang ba bzhad gzhung gi khra mor/ /zla med drin can bla ma'i dbon rigs su skyes 'dug /a la 'o na skyes gnas phun sum rang tshogs byung / /rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus gsang ba yi bdag po/ /gsum ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gzugs sku ru bzhengs skabs/ /sa sbrul lo la a ma'i mngal nang nas btsas 'dug /a la 'o na skyes dus phun sum rang tshogs byung / /dal brgyad yon tan ldan pa'i mi lus kyi sa gzhir/ /phyogs lhung ba tshwa mi 725

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/ 'dug don gnyer gyi drod gsher/ /legs par 'dzoms shing shes rab me tog dang ldan 'dug /a la 'o na bdag rang phun sum rang tshogs byung / /phyi ru 'dul ba'i kun spyod nyes ltung gis ma gos/ /nang du byams dang snying rje'i sems mchog dang ldan zhing / /gsang ba rim gnyis zab mo'i gdengs tshod dang ldan 'dug /a la 'o na ston pa phun sum rang tshogs byung /mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying po dang yang snying / /dri med rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad kyis brgyan nas/ /bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis bdag rang la bstsal 'dug /a la 'o na dam chos phun sum rang tshogs byung / /phun tshogs lnga dang ldan pa'i mi lus 'dir bsam tshe/ /tshe sngon skye ba de la lha phyag cig 'tshal 'dod/ /'dod rgu 'dzoms dus 'bungs sum chos la rang thon a/ /dga' ba'i gsan mchog shel rtse dkar po yi mgul du/ /dga' ba bskyed pa'i bsam mno gru bzhi ru btang tshe/ /dga' bas rab tu myos pa'i ban chung gi kha nas/ /dga' ba'i glu 'di dbang med lhug pa ru shor song / /'di yis dge bas byang chen ma thob kyi bar du/ /rje btsun bla ma'i sras kyi thu bo ru gyur nas/ /zab rgyas gdams ngag skal ldan 'gro ba la 'dom par/ /lha gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs dang mtshungs pa rang shog cig /ces rang nyid sku bltams pa dang / 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i dus ni phun tshogs lnga dang ldan pa nyams mtshar gyi ched du sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba la sogs pa'i nyams kyi sgo nas gsungs pa zhig yin pa 'di dang 'di 'dra'i snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom ni ches mang ngo / /726

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni yab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang yum ma gcig kun dga' dpal mo'i sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug(1475)lor gtsang rta nag tu sku bltams/dgung lo bcu gcig pa me rta(1486)lor bkra shis lhun por phebs te paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal du gsol/dgung lo bcu dgu pa shing stag lor 'bras spungs su phebs/dgung lo nyi shu pa shing yos(1495)lor gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa yongs su gsan nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa bla nas bla mthor 'phel/dgung lo so bzhi pa rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul(1509)lor chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang gi chos grwa btab/dgung lo zhe gsum pa sa stag(1518)lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbu mdzad/ lo 'di nas se 'bras dge gsum slar yang sngar rgyun ltar smon lam chen mo tshugs thub pa byung / sne gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon mo dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gnas su phul rjes ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur/ snga phyir bkras lhun dang / 'bras spungs/727

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/se ra bcas so so'i mkhan po mdzad pa dang / gsung rtsom mtshan brjod/ drang nges rnam 'byed/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ bstod tshogs sogs pod chen lnga bzhugs shing / rgya gar gyi chu bo gang gā'i tshun chad snyan ngag la mkhas par grags pa bcas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad mthar dgung lo re brgyad pa chu stag(1542)lor zhi bar gshegs/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du skabs 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdus par bsngags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba cha tshang drangs pa 'di lta ste/khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdus par bsngags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs/ /na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ dze rje btsun bla ma dam pa de'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang dri med 'dren byed stong gis rgya chen shes bya'i gzugs kun rnam gsal 'chi med sgeg mo'i me long bzhin/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rnga dbyangs 'bum phrag phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin par rnam bsgrags dbyar dus skyes pa'i rnga sgra bzhin/ /grong 'joms dbang po mda' lnga pa dang gtsug na zla ba mgrin sngon can sogs ral pa'i thod la gtsug rgyan bzhin/ /ngal gso nyer mdzad zhabs sen 'char ka'i 'od 'phreng dag gis gtsug rgyan rab mdzes bdag blo pad+mo'i dpal gyur cig /blo chen ldan gang bye bas bskal pa brgyar/ /728

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/snyan ngag chu klong stong gis drangs gyur kyang / /zad med yon tan yid bzhin mtsho chen po/ /bdag blo'i skra rtses dpag par ji ltar nus/ /de lta na yang dad pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ /bdag blo'i ljon shing rnam par bskyod pa las/ /ngo mtshar dri bsung g.yo ba'i me tog phreng / /mgrin par bzung ste dga' ba'i gar byed do/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /sa gsum skye rgu yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du/ /gcig tu bsdus nas gzugs can bzhin gyur pa/ /'jam dpal snying pos rtag tu skyong gyur cig /cha shas yongs rdzogs khyed sku'i ri bong can/ /chos dbyings kun gsal mdzes ma'i lang tsho las/ /gsal bar shar tshe skal bzang ku mud tshogs/ /mdzes sdug ze'u 'bru'i so phreng bzhad pa dang / /mnyam du thub bstan nor 'dzin bu mo'i lus/ /stod g.yogs gos dkar g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug 'dzin/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i sa chen ma lus pa/ /blo gros gom pa gcig gis rab 'gongs te/ /kun mkhyen thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin mkhas pa/ /gang khyod rgyal ba kun gyi gdung 'tshob lags/ /mang thos lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog ces/ /729

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/chen por mngon rlom bye ba phrag brgya yi/ /spobs pa'i myos bum ma lus dral mdzad pa/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i dbang po khyod nyid lags/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i 'od phreng g.yo ba can/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa kun gyi cod pan la/ /zhabs sen gsal bar 'god pa'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /kun mkhyen thub pa chen po khyod nyid lags/ /dge legs ku mud zum par mi byed cing / /mdo sngags gzhung lugs pad tshal stong 'byed pa'i/ /lung rigs 'od kyis sa gsum snang byed pa/ /kun mkhyen nyin mo'i dbang phyug khyod shar tshe/ /smra ba'i nyi ma gzhan dag khyod drung na/ /dman pa'i rgyu skar phreng ba lta bur spyod/ /snyan grags ma la ya yi dri bzhon gyis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i dri 'dzin sim pa'i dpal/ /legs bshad ga pur 'thul ba'i dpag bsam khyod/ /nyon mongs tsha ba'i srog len gshin rje lags/ /thabs shes gshog rlabs g.yo ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ /mtha' gnyis g.yang sar nam yang mi lhung zhing / /bdag lta'i klu dbang tshogs kyi srog 'phrog pa/ /mkhas mchog gnyis skyes kun gyi rgyal po lags/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs stong 'khrug pa'i/ / 730

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mi bzad 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /'gro kun thabs mkhas gru yis sgrol mkhas pa/ /mkhas mchog ded dpon kun gyi dam pa lags/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i pho nya bye ba yis/ /'gro 'di thar pa'i grong du khrid gyur te/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di nges par stongs 'gyur zhes/ /rab dgyes rgyal rnams zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i chu klung 'bum/ /nyin bzhin sdud byed rol mtsho'i dbang po ste/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gru char stong 'bebs pa'i/ /sngon med dbyar skyes chu 'dzin dbang po lags/ /mdzes sdug 'od 'bar rab tu brjid pa yi/ /khyod kyi mdzes sku 'chi med ri bo 'dra/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan phreng g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug la/ /ri dbang mchog gis 'gran par nus lags sam/ /snyan cing yid 'bab chos kun sgrog pa'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu'i dril chen 'khrol ba na/ /mes po'i dbyangs kyis 'gran par ma bzod nas/ /smra bcad bsam gtan ngang du zhugs lags snyam/ /rab yangs khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i pha mtha' la/ /'gran 'dod nam mkha' 'di yis 'ongs lags sam/ /'on te lha yi lam yangs skyel slad du/ /731

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/khyod kyi mkhyen pa bsam bzhin bkod dam ci/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa rab yangs chu gter bzhin/ /klung brgyas drangs kyang cung zad bri ba med/ /'gro la 'dod rgu sbyin pa'i dpag bsam ste/ /sgrib mun kun sel sngon med snang byed lags/ /gdul bya'i gling kun 'os par 'bab pa yi/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ /'char nub bral zhing sprin gyis mi sgrib pas/ /nyi zla'ang de yi dpe ru 'os ma lags/ /gzhan gyi blo yi yul du'ang shong min pa'i/ /yon tan phung po'i khur chen mtha' yas pa/ /'degs byed nor 'dzin bu mo mdzes sdug ma/ /da dung ngal ba med pa e ma mtshar/ /phyogs bcu'i phun tshogs ma lus gros byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la 'dus pa na/ /mi bzad skyon kun 'khor ba 'dir lus pas/ /'gro 'di rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur min nam/ /khyod kyi yon tan yid bzhin mtsho chen por/ /ring nas zhugs pa'i dad pa'i gnyis 'thung 'di/ /mkhas grub gzhan gyi yon tan rdzing bu la/ /dga' bar 'dzin pa'i blo de dor bar gyur/ /ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /732

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rdzogs ldan bzhin du nyid kyis mdzad pa na/ /e ma snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes/ /phyogs kyi bu mos srid rtse'i bar du bsgrags/ /phyogs kyi bdag po kun gyi ral pa la/ /zhabs rdul nor bus mdzes pa'i dpal ster ba/ /sngon med rgyal ba'i nyi ma gcig gis kyang / /rgyal ba'i nyi ma ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /de phyir lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /mgon khyod lhag par bsngags pa'i bzlas brjod la/ /ngal ba med pa'i dka' thub lhur blangs pas/ /bya ba gzhan la 'jug pa'i go skabs phrogs/ /skal bzang kun da'i gnyen gcig ri bong can/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyas mdzad nyin mo'i mgon/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub sbyin mdzad dpag bsam shing / /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /legs bshad bye bas khengs kyang khengs dang bral/ /gzhan don khur gyis ngal kyang ngal ba med/ /ring nas 'khor ba spangs kyang 'khor bar spyod/ /ngo mtshar kun gyi gter chen e ma mtshar/ /pad tshal dbus na pad+ma dkar po dang / /rgyu skar dbus na rgyu skar bdag po bzhin/ /rgyal sras dbus na rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod/ /733

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/'jigs bral 'jigs med chos 'khor bskor la 'dud/ /legs bshad nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i khyon kun la/ /lung rigs dpung gis 'dod dgur dbang sgyur zhing / /lus med bdag po'i g.yul ngo pham mdzad pa/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras kun gyi yab/ /dag dang ma dag 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba kun gyi gtso/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod la 'dud/ /snying gi me long dbus su khyod kyi sku/ /byed po'i pir gyis gsal bar bris pa bzhin/ /bkod nas rtag tu gus pas mchod pa'i mthus/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi mthu las rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /khyod zhal pad+mo'i sgo las legs 'ongs pa /snying gi bum par rtse gcig bsten pa las/ /nyon mongs nad kun 'joms par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i blo spangs nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub pa la/ /rgyal ba khyod dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems kyi gnyis 'thung dad pa'i lcags kyu yi/ /734

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dbang du gyur nas khyod zhabs rtag mchod cing / /myur du rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur nas/ /'gro kun thar par 'khrid par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba dpag med dang / /gzhan yang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /khyod kyi lugs bzang rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bsngags pa/ lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni rje nyid la skyes tsam nyid nas dad pa mchog tu thob pa'i kha ba ri pa'i snyan ngag mkhan/ rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa cung zad mtho ba'i btsun pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos lo bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe gtsang rta nag gis sa cha grub pa'i dbang phyug a mo gha dh+ra tsha la sogs pa dam pa mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas rdo rje gdan zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o/ /zhes rje tsong kha pa chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba phul byung dang / rab rtag la sogs pa'i rgyan gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas legs par mtshon par mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom 'dis mtshon khong gi snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom mtha' dag la gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa skye bo kun gyis rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni chu bo gaṅgā tshun gyi snyan ngag smra ba'i khyu mchog tu bsngags pa don la gnas pas 735

nor brang zho rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/nga tshos khong gi gsung rtsom khag la legs par slob sbyong gis rang rang skabs su babs pa'i brtsam bya gang zhig ming don mtshungs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig yong bar 'bad brtson byed dgos pa ci nas gal che'o/ /rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho ni/ yab rje gung bsod nams dar rgyas sam dge 'dun dar rgyas dang / yum blo bzang chos mtsho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa byi(1708)lor mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha chos sde chen po li thang thub chen byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ dgung lo dgu pa me sprel(1716)lor mdo smad tsong kha sku 'bum byams pa gling du phebs/ chu bzang no min han ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa lcags byi( 1720)lor gong ma khang shi'i lha sras cang jun dang /thu'u bkwan ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ gser khog tā bla ma bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang 'phrin las/ sngon gyi dpon rigs bstan 'dzin ching wang / e te ni tā la'i bo shog thu sogs kyis dbus su gdan drangs te po ta la'i gser khri mngon par mtho bar zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po blo bzang ye shes mchog gis dge tshul gyi sdom pa phul/ de nas khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas las phar phyin/ zha lu rin po che ngag dbang yon tan 'byung gnas las snyan ngag legs par gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa shing 'brug (172grulor gong ma g.yung ṭing nas gser srang sum brgya yod pa'i 'ja' 736

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/sa dang / nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pa'i gser tham phul ba'i zhal ris su nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badz+wa dha ra tā la'i bla ma zhes 'khod/ yongs 'dzin dam pa khri rin po che dpal ldan grags pa yongs 'dzin du bsten te dbu ma'i skor legs par gsan/dgung lo nyi shu pa me lug(1737)lor paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes/skabs 'dir jun gar ba'i 'khrugs 'jigs la dogs nas mgar thar du phebs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad shing yos(1735)lor gong ma'i bka' bzhin phyir bod du phebs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi ste rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug(1751)lor rje nyid nas srid dbang bzhes/ gong mas 'ja' sa dang gser tham gnang / bka' blon bzhi bskos nas bka' shag thog mar btsugs pa sogs bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang /gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang / lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ de mo sprul sku bde legs rgya mtsho sogs mkhas dang grub pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa mang du byung / bka' rtsom la yang rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang don de nyid yang gsal snang ba rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal ludza gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags kyi legs bshad pod bdun bka' rtsom mdzad pa bcas de lta bu'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs mthar dgung lo lnga bcu pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me glang(1757)lor pho brang chen po po ta lar dgongasi pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/skabs 'dir rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom gyi nang nas snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi 737

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dpe mtshon du rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa cha tshang drangs pa 'di lta ste/ne'u gsing spang la skyes pa'i/ /spang rgyan me tog bkra yang //dgun gyi kha rlung 'tshub dus/ /rdul phran tsam du 'thor bas//da lta mdangs bkrag mtshar dus/ /dkon mchog drung du phul dang //sngon bsags sbyin pa'i 'bras bu/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'byor yang //nam zhig gang zag gzhan gyi//bdag bzung rdzas su 'gyur bas//da lta rang dbang yod dus/ /sbyin pa'i zhing la phul cig/rtsal gsum dar la rdzogs pa'i/ /g.yu 'brug skad gseng mtho yang //dbyar gsum nam zla'i tha mar/ /sgra skad nyams par 'gyur bas//da lta mkha' la 'phyo dus/ /dbyar rnga dal bur sgrogs dang //mthun 'jug 'jig rten las la/ /gsung snyan 'gyur khug 'khrol yang //nam zhig mgrin pa'i lam la/ /dbugs kyang chad par 'gyur bas//da lta smra lce bde dus/ /grags stong zlo bar 'bungs shig/mkha' la rgyan du chags pa'i/ /sprin dkar lang tsho gsar yang //drag po'i rlung dang phrad nas/ /phyogs bcur 'thor bar nges so/da lta lang long 'khrigs dus/ /sbrang char bcud du phobs dang //khu khrag gzhan gyi rdzas la/ /bdag bzung lus 'di mchor yang //nam zhig mi gtsang rdzas bzhin/ /'brel med 'dor bar 'gyur bas//da lta rtsal stobs ldan dus/ /dge ba'i bran du khol cig/dwangs bsil yid la 'thad pa'i/ /nyal 'gro lhung lhung 'bab kyang //mi ring thigs pa tsam yang / /lus med skem par 'gyur gyi//738

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/da lta rgyun bzang 'bab dus/ /rtsi thog gsos su drongs dang //rang bde gzhan la gnod pa'i/ /thabs tshul sna dgu 'gyur yang //nam zhig ming don tsam yang / /'char med rmongs par 'gyur gyi//da lta blo rig gsal dus/ /zab rgyas gdams ngag sgoms shig/tshong 'dus sa yi lte bar/ /lho byang tshong phrug 'dzom yang /zhag gsum nangs par dus su/ /so sor 'gyes par 'gyur bas//da lta yud tsam tshogs dus/ /'khon dang mthun 'grogs spongs dang //tshe sngon las kyis bkug pa'i/ /dgra gnyen byams sdang che yang //mi ring rigs drug gnas su/ /so sor 'gro bar 'gyur bas//da lta ris su bcad nas/ /dgos med chags sdang spongs shig/ston dus mkha' la shar ba'i/ /nya rgyas nam 'phang mtho yang // 'dzam gling sa 'dir gnas pa'i/ /skye bo tsha gdung can la//lus sems dga' bde skyed pa'i/ /shugs 'byung 'od dkar 'gyed do//gzhan la phan bde 'dod pa/ /rang sems kho na gnas kyang //phyogs dus skye bo kun gyi/ /don gnyis dpal du 'gyur bas//lus ngag tshul 'chos spangs te/ /lhag bsam bzang po skyed cig/klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu/ /phyogs lhung rtog pa med kyang //mchod dang bkur ste chen pos/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab la//gang bsam re ba'i 'bras bu/ /lag rtser stsol bar nges so//bla ma sku gsum dbang phyug /'gro la nye ring spangs kyang //mos gus ltem rkyang med pas/ /rtse gcig dran pa de las//'di dang phyi ma kun gyi/ /legs tshogs 'grub par nges so//739

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dbang po bslad pa'i mthu yis/ /mkha' la snang bkrag mtshar yang //gso dpyad mig sman rnon pos/ /sbyangs pa'i de ma thag tu//rab rib snang ba log pa'i/ /stong gsal rjen par 'char ro//dngos 'dzin gdon gyis dkrugs pas/ /kun rdzob ci yang 'char mod//'khrul pa'i rang mtshang gcod pa'i/ /rig shes lta ba'i ngo na//blo brid snang ba log pa'i/ /gnas lugs ltad mo ltos shig/stong gsal mkha' yi ngos na/ /tshugs thub bden par med kyang //rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po/ /tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon ri mo//gtad med ci yang 'char ba'i/ /ngo mtshar 'di la ltos dang //dpyad na 'di zhes bya ba'i/ /ngos bzung ci yang med kyang //rgyu rkyen cha shas mang por/ /gdags yod ming tsam 'di la//bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'i/ /sgyu ma 'di la gzigs dang / /bden dngos bslu ba med pa'i/ /dmigs gtad gang yang med kyang //khog yangs brag gi phug par/ /sgra brnyan brag ca'i dbyangs kyis//rang 'dzin shes pa bskyed pa'i/ /nus pa thogs med bzhin du//bslu med don la grub pa'i/ /snying po cha tsam med kyang //don ldan tshig gi phreng ba/ /'di ltar spel ba'i gtam gyis//kun rdzob 'gro ba mang por/ /phan pa rgya chen gyur cig/ces gsungs pa ni brjod don zab la rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba yang 'gal rgyan gyi nang gses gzhi gcig gi yon tan 'gal ba'am/ yang na bsdus brjod dang rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan shas che ba'i sgo nas bstan pa'i mtshon byed kyi dpe rnams kyang nam zla'i 'gyur ldog lta bu spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i 740

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nang 'phrad pa'i dpe sha stag spyod gnang mdzad pas mtshon bya'i nang don mi sems la shin tu zug pa dper na gsung mgur nang mi rtag pa'i snang tshul dang / dge sdig gi blang dor ji skad gsungs pa de de bzhin no snyam pa klog pa po'i sems nang 'char ba 'di lta bu ni bod snga rabs kyi snyan ngag gi rtsom gshis dang thag nye ba go bde ba gson nyams ldan pa bod kyi thun mong min pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'tsho ba dngos kyi gnas tshul dang sbyar te blang dor gyi gnad phyin ci ma log par ston thub pa byung na brtsam chos de'i rin thang dang / phan nus chen po yong rgyu gdon mi za'o snyam lags/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/mkhyen brtse 'od zer 'jigs med gling pa ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya(1729)lor dbus g.yon ru bkra shis srong btsan bang so dang nye ba'i yul 'phyongs rgyas su sku 'khrungs shing / rang bzhin du grags pa'i mtshan klong chen sprul sku rang byung rdo rjer 'bod/ dgung lo drug pa shing stag lor dam pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs/ sku na gzhon dus nas mkhyen rlabs mchog tu yangs pas slob dpon rgya cher ma bsten cing / slob gnyer la dka' ba mang po ma spyad par mdo rgyud kyi zab chos dang / rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i rtser son/ dgung lo nyer lnga nas so lnga'i bar dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ de nas bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad de dbus gtsang khams gsum dang mon sogs su slob ma mang du spel/ rdzogs chen snying tig dang yon 741

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/tan mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs rdo rje theg pa skor bcas kyi bstan bcos bcu phrag lhag tsam mdzad pas rgyal ba yab sras sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog phyogs kun tu 'thor nas mkhas grub kun gyis gtsug gi cod pan ltar bkur ba bcas de lta bu'i mdzad pa rlabs chen bskyangs mthar dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta(1798)lor zhi dbyings su gshegs/skabs 'dir snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du bstod pa snyan tshig dpyid kyi rgyal glu zhes bya ba klong chen par bstod pa'i nang nas dum bu zhig drangs pa 'di lta ste/thal 'gyur rtsa rgyud rma bya'i rum nas 'byung 'gyur lung gi lnga ldan sgo nga brdol ba las/ /ru bzhi'i cha las g.yor po'i 'dzin mar 'brom ston mchog dbyangs rigs rus drod kyis bskyed bsrings pa/ /dus kyi pho nya'i nus pa rdzogs tshe rabs lnga'i phur bu dbo zla yar ngo'i tshes bcu nyin/ /thub dbang mchog gi sprul skur co 'dri'i dge mtshan gshog rlabs g.yo bzhin bltams pa klong chen pa/ /(mtshungs par ston pa'i gsal byed kyi sgras shan sbyar ba'i dpe rgyan)de tshe 'dod khams dbang mo nam gru mas/ /phyag gis blangs shing 'phral rkyen mi bsrun bcom/ /skye bas thob pa'i mkhyen rab phul byung dang / /snying rje'i rlabs chen zla bral klong chen pa/ /(yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa)gzhon nu nyid nas rdo rje'i theg par gom pa'i 'degs 'jog bsgyur zin yang / /bstan pa'i gzhi rten sde snod gsum gyi tshul khrims bslab pas rgyud bsdams shing / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis khyim nang bden gnyis zung 742

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'jug nyi zla'i 'gros/ /rtag par bsgyur bas lam lnga sa bcu'i spangs rtogs mngon gyur klong chen pa/ /(nang shes byed kyi rgyu la ldan gzugs kyis spud pa)ka tsan pā ṇi dbyangs can ma la sogs/ /legs sbyar kun bshad sgra mdo rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /'thungs pas byings rkyen rnam dbye'i mtshams sbyor gyi/ /brda sprod rgyang glu len mkhas klong chen pa/ /(cha shas gzugs can)mngon gsum rjes dpag 'gal grub brgal brtag gi /rtsod pa'i 'khor los log smra'i gnyis 'thung dbang / /klad pa 'gems phyir gdong pa lnga pa'i zol/ /tshad ma'i ston pa kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ /(ldan gzugs)lha dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i bzo rig sa srung dbang po'i steng //sde snod gsum dang gsang sngags zab don nang gi rig pa'i mig stong bgrad/ /skyes pa bud med ri shing rgya mtsho gos nor rta dang glang chen sogs/ /brtag pa brgyad kyi skyed mos tshal du rtsed 'jor rol pa klong chen pa/ /(ldan gzugs)rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung rtsa ba ma rig pa yi sa bon la/ /nyon mongs gsum gyi myu gu nar son bro nad yal 'dab rgyas pa'i tshe/ /ro nus zhu rjes sdeb pa'i sman dang gtar bsreg dpyad kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /zug rngu tshar gcod gso rig smra la g.yu thog gnyis pa klong chen pa/ /(rigs mtha' gsal la ldan gzugs 'dres pa)bcu phrag rig par bslab tshe mi g.yo ba/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /gsal stong sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor la zhugs pas/ /zhal gzigs lung bstan mngon gyur klong chen pa/ /(rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can)e dbyings shes rab gan+da'i tshal du thabs mchog bde gsal waṃ yig gsar pa'i le kha nis/ /bsgyur bgod phri bsnan rnam 'gyur brgya yis ri mo'i 743

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gar stabs rnam dag grub pas bsgyur ba las/ /go la'i ngos kyi drang srong rgyu skar bcu gnyis khyim du dus bzhi'i ltad mor rtse ba mthong / /dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig bzlums so klong chen pa/ /(bskyed byed grub pa'i rgyu)sa mtho'i grub mtha' gangs ri'i spo la sngon nas snyogs pas longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud rgyas/ /cig car grol bas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor blo gros rab rgyas lung rigs g.yu ral lan bu g.yo/ /brgal brtag rigs pa'i sder mo'i shugs kyis log smra'i gnyis 'thung klad pa 'gems shing thal 'gyur gyi/ /mgrin rnga ldir ba'i rig grwa kun tu 'gran gyi zla med mi yi seng ge klong chen pa/ /(rab dwangs la phul byung gi nyams 'dres pa)zhes klong chen pa sku bltams pa nas rig gnas la gsan bsam gyis mkhas rgu'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa'i skor gyi mdzad pa cha shas snyan ngag gi rgyan gang la de 'os kyi sgo nas bstod pa nang don zab la rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba ches brling la nyams dod pa 'di lta bu'i rtsom rtsal la yang nga tshos don gnyer chen pos slob sbyong gis bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas la legs skyes sngar las che ba 'bul thub par brtson len byed dgos pa ni shin tu gal che bar mthong ngo /'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho/'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho ni/ yab mgon po dar rgyas dang / yum sring chung gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me rta(1846)744

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/lor sde dge'i nye 'dabs ya chu ding chung gi sa char sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo drug pa nas yab dang zhang po'i drung du yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs/dgung lo bcu gnyis par gsang sngags chos gling dgon du phebs te grwa sar zhugs pa de nas lo gcig ring lha ldan du gnas skor la phebs/ de rjes bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang / dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje/dpal sprul 'jigs med chos dbang / dge bshes ngag dbang 'byung gnas/blo gter dbang po sogs mkhas chen du ma slob dpon du bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad nas mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/dgung lo nga gcig lor rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / dgung lo re gnyis par dus 'khor 'grel chen/ dgung lo re gsum par snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rol mtsho bcas snga phyir bka' rtsom gnang ba sogs mi pham dka' 'bum zhes gsung rtsom pod sum cu lhag bzhugs/sku tshe hril por 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya bas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad cing / lhag par bzo dang gso ba/ rtsis rig sogs bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag par ris med mkhas pa yongs kyis bstod tshig gi me tog phyogs kun tu 'thor ba dang / mdo dbus khams gsum du mkhas pa'i grags pa bar med khyab/ khong gi gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i slob ma grags che ba rdo sprul rdo rje dang / gter ston bsod rgyal/ ka thog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdzogs sprul lnga pa/ dpal spungs si tu sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dam pa mang du bskyangs pa bstan 'gro'i don chen rgya che mdzad pa'i mthar dgung lo re bdun pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi(1912)lor dgongs pa 745

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gzhan don du gtad pa'i tshul bstan to/ /skabs 'dir khong gi snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du glu bro sgyu ma'i rol mo zhes pa las dum bu zhig drangs pa 'di lta ste/glu bro sgyu ma'i rol mo/sna tshogs sgyu mar 'char ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul//brtse ba'i shugs kyis bskyod cing bskyod pa las//srid pa kun na kun dga'i ro ster ba//gar gyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal gzhon nus skyongs//mchog tu byi dor byas pa'i lus la ni//rgyan mang spras pa 'gying zhing 'gying tshul du/ /stangs stabs sna tshogs 'khrugs bzhin 'gyur khugs glu//gser gyi dril chung 'khrol ba'i sgra 'dra zhing //ldem ldem g.yo ba'i ske skabs 'khri shing la//nor bu'i dra phyed 'phyang ba'i rtse mo nas//ngang rgyal sgra 'dra gser gyi dril g.yer 'khrol//yid 'ong srid pa 'phel ba'i rmi lam mthong //thun mtshams dbus na mdzes pa'i zla ba ltar//dkar dmar rab tu sdug pa'i bzhin ras can//skra yi lan bu shig shig por g.yo zhing //tsasmru ga pur li shi'i dri bsung 'phro//snga mthong phyi mar lhag pa'i ngang tshul gyis//bzhi phrag brgyad kyi khye'u bu mo rnams//746

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/spel ma'i tshul du lag pa sbrel nas 'khrab//gos rgyan nyams 'gyur mi gcig du mas rtse//der ni rtog chen blo gros gsal ba'i mig /pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bur rnam yangs pa//de yis de dag rnams kyi gnas tshul rnams//phan tshun lan gyi tshul du smra bar byed//dang po bro pa khye'u rnams kyi ngag lha'i rnga dbyangs lta bu la drangs nas blta ba'i dga' ba brjod pa 'di skad du/'jig rten rtse dga'i rol mo dga' ba'i mchog /mya ngan yid la 'thad pa sbrang rtsi 'dra//'thung ma thag tu snying gi dbus su 'ju//ci tsam spyad kyang 'di la sun pa med//khyad par na chung mdzes pa'i lang tsho yi//ro mchog phan tshun myong ba gsal ston pa//zur gyis 'dzum bzhin stangs stabs bskyod pa'i glus//gzugs med yid kyang bzhu ba bzhin du byed//nyi ma'i snang ba bral ba'i pad+ma bzhin// blo ngan rnams ni rtag tu ngo zum gnag/zla ba'i 'od kyis phog pa'i ku mud bzhin//bsod nams ldan pa rtag tu dga' bas 'dzum//'o ma'i mtsho la ut+pal sngon po bzhin//mdzes pa'i gdong la 'khor ba'i 'dren byed zung //747

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/cung zad zum pa'i lta stangs glog gi zer//phan tshun snying la zhags pa bzhin du brkyangs//brlan te lta ba'i mig dkyus pad+ma'i 'dab//chags pa'i dmar 'od sbrang rtsi'i rdul dmar can//'thung 'dod bung ba gzhon nu'i mdun bltas pa//'di na phan tshun 'gran pa lta bur gnas// zhes zer/de'i tshe na rtog chen pa de 'dzum mul gyis phyungs nas bung ba rnam par rol pa'i dbyangs la drangs nas/ rang gi gong ba'i thad nas thos tsam du mi rtag pa'i gtam 'di skad du/kye ma phan tshun lta bas brel ba yi//sprin mthong rma bya bzhin du 'di na dga'//'chi bdag 'jigs pa'i khar ni gnas bzhin du//dogs pa med par rtse 'jo'i glu gar 'khrabs//skad cig mi sdod gar gyi rnam 'gyur 'dis//dpe zhig skyes bu'i snying la bstan mod kyi//mi shes bzhin du da rung gar la blta//tshe srog gar dang mtshungs pa mi sems sam//yang yang g.yo zhing bskyod pa'i lhu tshigs rnams//rdo bzhin g.yo med thang la nyal ba'i mthar//sha dang bral ba rus pa'i dum bu ni//phyogs dang phyogs su bkram pa bzhin du 'thor//'di na phan tshun gcig la gcig brtse bas//748

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba 'di dag kyang //las kyi dbang gis 'jig rten pha rol du//gnas ris mi gcig nyid du so sor 'gro//nam zhig so dkar ze'u 'bru 'thor ba bzhin//'dzum na 'dam rdzing rlung gis 'khrugs 'dra ba//'khar ba la brten dal bus bskyod na yang //'chi bdag 'jigs pa dran pa bzhin du 'dar//nyi 'od kyis rgyas ut+pal gzhon nu bzhin//rtag tu dga' bas 'dzum par 'dod na yang //bu yug rlung gis pad+ma rnyid pa ltar//dus kyis dbang med rga ba shes par gyis//zhes zer/de nas gzhon nu rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu lha yi sil snyan gyi sgra lta bu'i dbyangs kyis dgod pa'i rtse dga' rjes su mtshon pa'i glu 'di 'dra ba len to//gdong bzang zla ba'i gdong can mthong ma thag/zla 'od kyis phye zla dga'i ge sar ltar//rab dkar so yi ze'u 'bru nyer mjes pa//mchu sgros pad+ma dmar po'i dbus na ngoms//snying dbus dga' ba'i 'o mtsho phyur ba'i rlabs//mgul gyi bum pa bzang por legs 'khyil ba//nye bar mtshon pa yid du 'ong ba'i sgra//dgod pa zhes su 'jig rten dag na grags//749

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gang na lha yi sil snyan lta bu ni//thos na dga' bas dgod pa zhes bya'i sgra//gnas pa de na 'jigs pa chen po dang //mya ngan zug rngus mnar ba nges par med//gzhon nu tshogs pa'i dga' ba 'di yi ro//ma myong gyi nar bzhag pa'i skye bo des//mtho ris dka' ba gzhan dang gzhan myong yang //ro med de yis bde ba mi shes so// zhes zer/de nas dpyod rab pas gzhon nu ma rnams kyi tshig bde kha bde thos nas mig bgrad de bltas nas/ khu byug rtse ba'i rta la drangs nas phyed thos phyed mi thos su sdug bsngal ba'i tshul mtshon pa'i glu 'di blangs so//sha la khrag gis brlan pa'i mchu sgros dbus//sha med rus pa dkar po'i rang mdog gang //shin tu gtsang ba'i me tog rnams dang bsgrun/ /kye ma 'dod ldan rnams kyi tshul la ltos//'dod pas drangs te rnam par g.yeng ba'i rlung //snying gi nags tshal mthug por zhugs gyur pas//dran pa'i shing bal dbang med bskyod pa dag/mgrin pa'i gcong rong dog por 'khri shing dgod//gang na na chung phan tshun dgod pa'i sgra//gnas pa de na 'dod pa'i me chen 'bar//des ni lce bdun drag tu dgod pa ltar//750

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'khrugs pa'i dbus na gar mkhan bzhin du 'phro//rmi lam rmis pa'i chu 'thung ji bzhin du//ngoms pa med par 'dod pa'i ro myong ba//des na srid pa'i myong bya ji mi shes//'bar ba'i khro chu 'thung ba'i ro yang shes/ /phan tshun gcig tu 'du la ji dga' ba//de lta de ltar 'phral ba'i sdug bsngal che//mi 'dod par yang rga dang 'chi ba yis//lag nas drangs pa bzhin du nye bar 'khrid//bdag nyid rga ba'i zil gyis non pa'i tshe//na chung tshogs pa'i rtse dga' snying la gzan//kye ma gzhon rnams bgres por mi 'gyur dang //gzhon ma myong ba'i rgan pa su zhig go//zhes zer bas kun gyis rtog chen pa de la cung zad bltas na yang gzhon nu de dag gis ni glu ma rnams dang lag pa sbrel ba bzhin du gling bu rnam par 'gyur ba'i glu rta la drangs nas lag bcing gi dga' ba rjes su myong ba'i dbyangs brjod pa/lang tsho dar la babs pa'i lag pa yi//pad+ma'i 'dab ma phan tshun 'thab byas pa'i//reg pa las skyes gur kum gsar pa'i chab//skom pa'i rims nad sel ba'i sman mchog yin//'char kha'i dmar 'od chags pa'i zla ba ltar//751

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dkar dmar yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gyi khyim//mthong bas snying gi rnyogs pa dwangs nus na//gtsang ma'i lus la reg pas smos ci 'tshal//mthong ma thag tu skye bo bye ba brgya//mi mthong lcags kyu rno po'i 'phrul thabs kyis//brtan pa'i ngang tshul 'phrogs nas bkug pa rnams//kha las babs pa bdud rtsi bzhin du 'thung //chags dang bral ba rnams kyis mthong gyur na'ang //chags pa'i sa bon myur du bskyed nus pa//chags dang bcas pa de yis gang gi lus//ma mthong gyi nar bzhag pa snying rje'i yul//snying la chags pa mi bzad me 'bar yang //lus kyi chu rnyogs 'khrugs pas non gyur pas//'dod pa'i spyod yul mi shes de dag rnams//'dod la g.yeng ba spangs pa'i zol gyis rgyu//bde ba'i me chen snying la sbar ba yi//'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal cho ga mi mkhas na//mtho ris skye bas thob pa'i blo gros ni//ri mor bris pa'i mar me nyid dang mtshungs//zhes zer/zhes gsungs pa'i gsung rtsom dum bu 'di'i nang spyir btang gi mi so so'i sems khams kyi khyad par ji lta ba mtshon par mdzad pa/ dper na gzhon nu pho 752

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/mo ni rtse dga'i dpal la 'jug par spro ba dang / rtog ldan pas 'khor ba la yid 'byung gis mi rtag pa dran pa/ don dam 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag la rtog dpyod mkhas pas gzhon nu pho mo'i lta tshul sun 'byin byas na'ang / re zhig gzhon nu pho mos rang 'dod 'dor mi 'dod pa a 'thas kyi rnam pa ston pa lta bu ni spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos nang yod pa'i don dngos de dag snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i tshe klog pa por sngar med pa'i tshor snang gting zab 'jog pa 'dis mtshon snyan ngag gi gsung rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur ches che ba dang / nang don ches phun sum tshogs pa bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi bya gzhag la 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i mdzad rjes kyang rlabs po che yin pa'i bka' drin nga tshos dus nam yang brjed mi rung ba yin no/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje ni/ yab dbal shu dpal 'bum rgyal dang / yum thar mo byams gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi( 1648)lor bsang gi rdo ger lhas khra ting zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/dgung lo bdun nas khu bo dge slong bsod nams lhun grub kyi mdun du ye ge 'bri klog sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par khyu mchog ye shes rgya mtsho ba la rab byung dang dpal gcig gi rjes gnang zhus pa sogs zab chos mang du gsan/dgung lo nyer gcig pa sa sprel lor dbus su byon nas 'bras spungs sgo mang chos grwar slob dpon blo gros rgya mtsho las mdo phyogs kyi chos phal cher gsan/dgung lo nyer lnga pa la gsang phur dka' bcu pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/753

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/de'i phyi lor chos khri ser por grwa skor mdzad/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa shing stag lor kun gzigs lnga pa chen po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sngags kyi gzhung 'ga' zhig dang sgra snyan ngag zhor chos su bslabs/ sngags pa dpon slob tshul khrims mtshan can/ pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rgyal sras me rgan rin po che/ grub chen sha bo ba/ grags pa bla ma bsod nams bcas las zab chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo nga gsum pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug(1700)lor rgyal dbang drug pa'i bka' bzhin 'bras spungs sgo mang gi mkhan por phebs nas chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher bstsal ba sogs thub bstan bshad sgrub zung sbrel gyis mdzad pa rgya chen bskyangs te me phag lo 'bras spungs sgo mang gi mkhan po nas zur bzhugs kyis pha bong kha'i gdan sa bskyangs/ sa glang(1709)lor mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te rkang tsha'i dka' bcu sogs kyis dgon sa phul bas bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan sa phyag btab/skabs 'dir gong ma khang shi rgyal pos bstan pa 'dzin cing skyong bar byed pa paṇ+ḍi ta er ti ni no mon han zhes bsngags shing / tham ga dang cho lo gnang /lcags stag lor dgon lung nas 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung gnang ste rgyud grwa btsugs pa sogs mdzad pa rlabs chen bskyangs shing / snga phyir mdzad pa'i bka' rtsom yang(drang nges rnam 'byed〉dang / (sems gzugs mtha' dpyod chen mo〉 〈grub mtha' rtsa 'grel〉 〈snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dbyangs can zhal lung〉 〈phar phyin skyabs bdun〉 〈dbu ma'i bden gnyis kyi mtha' dpyod〉 (rnam 'grel ṭik+ka〉 ('jigs byed chos 'byung〉〈bstan rtsis tshigs bcad ma〉sogs mang po mdzad/ mthar dgung lo don lnga pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu stag(1722)lor dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings 754

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/skabs 'dir snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du bla ma dkon mchog mtshan can gyi bstod pa'i nang nas dum bu gcig drangs pa 'di lta ste/mkhas dang btsun dang bzang po'i pha mthar phyin//zhi dang dul dang des dang shin tu dul//dam pa dag gi dngos po ma lus pa//rgyal bas khyod nyid kho nar byin nam ci//ma zlos mi dman zab dang shin tu brling //brjod bya rjod byed phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung //thub dbang mtshan bzang mgur las 'ong ba dag/ma bslad brtse ba'i 'dzum bcas 'gro la 'doms//shes bya'i pha mtha' zos khyod blo yi ltor//'gran pa'i spobs ldan kun mkhyen 'jam mthong bar//skrag ldan rgyu skar gzhon nu de dag gis//bcu gnyis bdag por skyabs bcas mkha' la sim//srid sgrub sgro ldan rjes 'gro rig shes kyis//kun rdzob dngos po'i 'ben dag bsil ba'i cha//ma btab 'phyar ba tsam gyi grib ma yis/gcod pa grib ma'i gri gug mchu lam mchis//'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i//bshad dang sgrub pa'i chos kyi rnga bo che//rnam dpyod dbyu gus drag tu brdung ba'i sgras//755

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rab mkhregs 'khor ba rdo rje'i mtha' yang ral/sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum rgya mtsho che//dam pa'i gzugs su 'khyil ba'i zlos gar gyi//zhal lung snyan brgyud ma nyams 'ongs pa 'dis//rdo rje'i theg pa'i gsang ba las che gsang //snyan brgyud snying po can gyi nyams myong khrid//ma thob tshig spyi tsam gyis khengs ldan pa'i//bshes gnyen dag kyang snyan brgyud 'di lta bu//mthong tshe khron pa'i nang gi ka mi tha//mkhas grub gzhan gyi yol gor thub min pa'i//bla med rgyud sde seng ge'i 'o ma gang //khyod gsung rin chen snod du 'khril ba 'dis//rin chen gdul bya yongs kyi re ba skong //sngon byon drang srong gzhan gyi longs spyod du//ma thob mdo rgyud man ngag lam gsum 'bab//bzang po skal ldan shing rtas cher phab pa//mkhyen yangs ral par 'dzin pa'i legs byas gter//nam yang rgyun mi 'chad pa'i thos bsam rgyun//che cher babs kyang tshims min chu gter che//rin chen 'byung yang gdug par 'grogs min na//rtag phan gyen mthor ri mo'i 'jug pa mtshar//zhes gzugs can gyi rgyan gtso che ba'i sgo nas bstan pa 'dis mtshon snyan 756

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/ngag gi gsung rtsom ches mang po mdzad pa rnams ni snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs shing bstan bya'i nang don zab la rgya che ba ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyis bklag 'dod pa bcas rje 'di nyid kyis bod kyi thun mong rig gnas la 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i mdzad rjes kyang shin tu dpag par dka' ba'i drin nga tshos ji srid mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma chad bar de srid du dran dgos pa yin no//a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar/a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar lha rams pa ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa yos(1759)lor sog yul a lag sha zhes pa'i sa char sku 'khrungs/sku na chung dus khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste grwa btsun gnang / rje klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang slob dpon du bsten nas bka' chos zab mo dang rig gnas la sbyangs pa rgya chen mdzad cing / lha sa'i chos grwar zhugs te lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/ phyis su mdo smad sku 'bum byams pa gling du yun ring bzhugs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/khong gi brtsams pa'i gsung rtsem la(lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum 'grel pa〉dang / (snyan ngag gi dper brjod/〉 (sum rtags 'grel pa〉 sogs mang du bzhugs/ mthar dgung lo don gsum pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags yos(1831)lor gshegs skad/skabs 'dir khong gi gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du rtsom pa'i rnam gzhag cha tshang bkod pa 'di lta ste/757

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rtsom pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ rtsom pa'i rnam gzhag la gsum ste/rtsom pa po'i yon tan dang / brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi dbye ba dang / bstan bcos ji ltar rtsom pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po la/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po yon tan gang dang ldan dgos she na/de yang sgra shes na don la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/snyan ngag shes na tshig gi rgyan la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes grags pa ltar/ sgra dang sdeb sbyor gnyis rgya skad kyi bstan bcos rtsom pa la nye bar mkho zhing /snyan ngag dang mngon brjod gnyis bod skad kyi bstan bcos rtsom pa la med du mi rung ba min yang byung na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin la/ rgya bod hor sogs gang du gang gi skad du bstan bcos gang rtsom pa la de dang de'i skad rigs dang yig rigs mthar phyin par shes pa med du mi rung ba dang /khyad par bod skad la brda gsar rnying dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam gzhag dang sgyug thogs pa'i las la'ang cung zad blo kha phyogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa gzhir bcas kyi steng du gang brtsam rgyu'i chos kyi tshig don la mkhas pa dang /lha'i gnang ba thob pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa gang rung ngam/ yang na/ rin chen gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ rigs lam phra mo 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod chodang / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang / /tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang / /zhes pa ltar gyi yon tan gsum po gang rung gis rung tsam yin yang kun slong ma dag na gzhan phan chung bas bsam pa bzang ba gal che ste/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu'i 758

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/kun slong drug dang / rtsom pa po yon tan bzhi ldan dgos par bshad pa bzhin du chos kyi don kun tu rgyas par 'gyur te snyam pa dang / sems can rnams khams dang mos pa sna tshogs pa'i phyir kha cig gi don du 'gyur ro snyam pa dang /don rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i phyir ro snyam pa dang / don 'thor ba rnams bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir ro snyam pa dang / don zab mo rnams gsal bar bya ba'i phyir ro snyam pa dang / tshig 'bru mdzes pas mdzes pa bskyed par bya'o snyam pa'am/ bdag dang 'dra ba'am bdag las yon tan chung ba dag gis kyang bstan bcos brtsam rung na bdag gis ci'i phyir rtsom mi nus snyam pa lta bu nga rgyal med pa dang / sems can rnams kyis don gang la rmongs pa de bsal bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang sems can rnams kyi don bde blag tu shes par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang / bdag la gzhan dag gis mkhas pa yin par yid ches na ci ma rung snyam du bdag nyid mi sgrog pa ste bzhi po de dag gal che ba'i phyir/mdor na nga rgyal med pa dang / gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsal bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang / gzhan la phan 'dod kyi byams pa dang / rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir du bstan bcos brtsam mo /gnyis pa la/ brtsam pa'i bstan bcos kyi dbye ba/ byed las kyi sgo nas rgya chen sdud pa mdo sde rgyan dang / zab mo 'byed pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang /'khrugs pa bsdebs pa bslab btus lta bu gsum dang / brjod bya'i sgo nas bden pa gnyis ston pa gnyis dang / bshad bya'i sgo nas bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel dang / so so'i dgongs 'grel gnyis/ dang po la thun mong ma yin pa dang / 'di la yang log rtog yin pa dang / thun mong ba gnyis/ 'di la yang log rtog tshar gcod pa dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis/ dang po la/759

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rjod byed gtan la dbab pa dang / brjod bya gtan la dbab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtso bo sgra'i bstan bcos te/ rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur gsum brjod byar byas nas ston pa'i gzhung ka lā pa dang / tsan+d+ra pa sogs dang / de'i yan lag lci yang dang pratra 'god tshul ston pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas dang / ming gi rnam grangs dang / rtags gsum gyi dbye ba dang /sgra gcig don mang po la 'jug tshul ston pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod dang / slob dpon shar pa dang / lho pa'i lam gyi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba tshig don gnyis ka'i rgyan dang / don gyi rgyan so lnga dang / bya dka' ba dang /gab tshig sogs tshig gi rgyan te rgyan gsum gtan la dbab nas ston pa snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long dang / de dag skad rigs dang sbyar nas ston pa zlos gar gyi bstan bcos klu kun tu dga' ba dang / 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba sogs so/ brjod bya gtan la dbab pa la ni gtan tshigs rigs pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma mdo sogs so/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos la bzo dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ gser 'gyur dang spos sbyor sogs ston pa lta bu phal pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten gyi cha tshad ston pa lta bu khyad par can gnyis so/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/nad kyi ngo bo dang / nad gzhi dang / nad kyi gnyen po sman dang / des gso ba'i spyod lam bzhi'am/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro tsa/ /zhes pa ltar gyi sman gzhung yan lag brgyad pa lta bu'o/ 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dag kyang 'dor bar bya ba ma yin te/ shes rab brgya pa las/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug ces pa ltar 760

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/nyams su len shes na thar pa 'thob pa'i thabs su 'gro ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i bka' tshad mar gyur pa la rang gi dgongs 'grel bstan bcos tshad ma la rag las pa'i phyir rtsa ba snga ma snga ma'i tshig don brling zhing rtogs dka' ba rnams la 'grel pa mdzad pa po phyi ma phyi mas tshig 'grel spyi don mtha' dpyod reg zig sogs rang bzo'i bslad ma zhugs par rang rang gi blo ngor khungs dang 'brel ba'i dpang po dang gtugs nas mdzad pa sha stag yin no/ /gsum pa la/ bstan bcos ji ltar rtsom pa'i tshul gsum/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i sngon 'gro dang / rtsom tshul dngos dang / brtsams pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po snyan ngag me long las/ shis brjod phyag bya ngo bo ni/ /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo/ /zhes bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar shis brjod kyi tshig gis sngun bsus te phyag bya ba dang ngo bo nges par bstan pa ste lus mdor bstan sogs kyis gzhung rtsom par bshad la/ tshul 'di ni phyi nang gnyis thun mong du 'dod do/ de'i steng du mtha' mar dge ba bsngo ba ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni/ /sems can rnams la yongs bsngo ba/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis gang gsungs pa/ /de gzhan bstan bcos las ma bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ de la shis brjod kyi dgos pa ni rang la dngos grub 'byung ba'i ched dang / phyag bya ba'i dgos pa ni bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched du'o/ phyag bya ba'i yul ni gnyis te/ chos la yid ches pa la brten nas rtsa ba chos gsung ba po ston pa dang don la yid ches pa la brten nas chos kyi don ston pa'i slob dpon dag la phyag bya bar gtan la dbab pa bsdus pa las bshad pa ltar dang por thub pa sangs rgyas dang / de'i 'og tu dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la 761

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/phyag 'bul dgos so/ mchod brjod ma byas pa yang yod de/ dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal du bshes springs la mchod brjod med cing bshad par dam bca' ba yod par gsungs pa lta bu dang / gzhan de 'dra yang mang ngo / de bzhin du phyag bya ba'i go rim bshad ma thag pa yang nges can ma yin te/thog mar rang gi lhag pa'i lha la phyag mdzad pa rje rin po che'i gsung las mang du byung ba bzhin dang / der ma zad thams cad kyi dang por gang las chos kyi bka' drin nod pa'i bla ma la phyag byed par yang rigs te/ lung gzhi las/rgan pa dang ni gzhon yang rung / /gang las chos ni rnam shes pa/ /de la thog mar phyag bya ste/ /zla ba tshes la bram ze bzhin/ /zhes byung ba ltar 'bad pa'i phyir/ 'o na rab byung skabs kyi lung gzhi dang / karma sha tam las/ dang por/ston pa la phyag 'tshal du gzhug de'i 'og tu mkhan po la phyag 'tshal du bcug ces gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'di ni dmigs bsal yin par mtsho sna ba chen pos gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang shes rab sdong bu las/ dam pa mang po khas 'che mi byed la/ /gal te dka' bas khas ni blangs 'gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bur ni/ /shi yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom par dam bca' ba'i dgos pa yod de/rtsom pa mthar phyin par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ khengs bskyung ba'i sgo nas rtsom par dam bca' ba la yang dgos pa yod de/ rtsom pa po rmad du byung bar go ba'i ched du'o/ snod rung mnyan par bskul ba'i srol kyang yod la de'i dgongs pa ni rtsom pa por brtse bas 'doms pa dang / bstan bcos kyis dgos don mthong ba'i ched du'o/ / gnyis pa rtsom tshul dngos la genyis/ rtsom pa legs pa'i yon tan dang /762

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rtsom pa nyes pa'i skyon no/ dang po ni/ rtsom pa po gang gis gang brtsam rgyu'i gzhung gi spyi khog tu bzung ste/ gzhung gzhan gyi lung gis zur nas brgyan cing /de dag phan tshun gung bsgrigs nas lung rigs kyis brdar sha legs par bcad de 'gal 'du nod 'khrugs kyi dri mas ma gos par bya ba gal che zhing /de yang brjod bya'i don brling yang rtogs sla ba/ rjod byed tshig snyan ngag gis brgyan pa/ tshig gi sbyor ba 'brel chags shing snyan ngag gis bcings pa'am 'bel rtsom gyis go bde ba ming rnams ni mngon brjod kyis brgyan pas ngo mtshar ba tshig gong 'og zlos shing phyi ma snga ma'i sgrub byed du 'gro ba/ sdud rgyu med pa'i sogs sgras dbyen zhing brjod bya zab par rtsom na ches phun sum tshogs par gyur cing mkhas pa mgu ba'i skyes su 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa ni/ rang lugs dang gzhan lugs 'byed dka' ba/ 'dul ba'i las chog chen mo gser mdog rnam rgyal lta bu dang / sa bcad ha cang mang drags pa tshad ma rigs thigs dang / rnam nges dar ṭika lta bu ma yin pa dang / spyir bod kyi sa bcad lugs dang po la gnyis/ gnyis pa la gsum/ gsum pa la bzhi zer ba lta bu sogs las dang po ba la phan pa'i rkyen du mi 'gyur ba'i mgo rmongs par 'gyur ba'ang srid pas de bas rgya nag gi yi ge rnams su sa bcad ci tsam dgos pa de dag bstan bcos kyi mgor sdebs gcig tu bkram nas/ bshad pa la dngos gzhi'i skabs su de dag go rim ma 'khrugs par bshad pa lta bur byas na yang mi rung ba med cing / gzhan yang tshig gi gcod mtshams shad kyis ma bcad pa dang / kun la ma grags pa'i mngon brjod dang gab tshig gi rgyan 'ba' zhig gis bcings pa dang / yul dus de dang der grags pa'i yul phyogs dang mi rnams kyi ming bod skad du bsgyur nas bris pa dang / rgya nag gi ming bod skad 763

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/du bris pa sogs skyon te/ dper na sde dge si tu paṇa chen gyi gsung 'bum du rgya nag gi sman 'ga' zhig gi ming bod skad rang du bris pa deng sang rgya bod su la bstan kyang mi go bas sman bzang yang gsos su mi 'gyur ba lta bu dang /yang bstan bcos rtsom pa pos mdzad byang du rang ming gsal bar mi smos pa'am/ rang ming dngos sbas nas gzhan la ma grags pa'i ming gzhan bcug pa sogs skyon che shos yin te byed pa po'i ming mi gsal ba'i dbang gis bstan bcos 'ga' zhig legs bshad du snang yang the tshom can du gyur nas/ mkhas pa dag gis shes byed du drangs ma nus pa yang des lan 'dug pas skyon de dag dor te ming rus yul sogs gsal bar smos pa'i sgo nas bod spyi yongs la grags pa'i brda gsar rnying gis gzhi bzung nas yig 'bru rnams ni sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa ma nor bar thob pa'i tshul gyis brtsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcos brtsam5 pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe 'dir bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i sgo nas mkhas pa rnams mgu zhing rjes su bzung ba dang / ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog mnyes pa'i mchod par 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang / slob dpon daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung las/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob/ /de ni de dag mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe 'di'i 'du byed btang ba'i 'og tu'ang bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan dang bka' drin gyi ming tsam lhag mar lus pa'i phyir kun gyis thos sgrogs su gleng ba'i mtha' mi mngon pa'i ngos nas mkhas ming gi grags pa mi nub par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par du mdo las/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar rjod mdzad kyang / /tha mar phyin par gyur 764

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/ma lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams tshad med pa thob pa'i stobs kyis ma 'ongs pa na'ang bcu phrag drug gis ri mos mtshan pa'i phyag rgyas mngon par bkra ba'i bka' khrims dri ma med pas skal ldan yongs kyi srid la dbang bsgyur cing mi 'jigs seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i khri 'phang mthon por stobs bcu'i rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /a lag sha bstan dar lha rams pa gangs can dag pa'i zhing sar phebs nas blo gros nor bu'i bum bzang legs bshad bdud rtsis byur bur gtams nas slar bod kyi rig gnas lo tog spel ba'i gsos su drangs pa'i mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pa gong gi gsung rtsom khag nas mtshon zhing / lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig gi thad la yang skabs 'dir drangs pa'i rtsom pa'i rnam gzhag 'di la mtshon na'ang gzhung tshogs chung yang nang don khyab rgya che bas spyi dang bye brag gi legs bshad rtsom par blo sgo 'byed pa'i rnam gzhag rmad du byung ba zhig yin pas spyir btang gi brtsams sgrung la mtshon na'ang bed spyod btang na 'tshams pa'i dge mtshan mang po ldan pa dper na/ rtsom pa legs pa'i yon tan 'di dag brtsam bya'i gzhung chen por smos ci/ rtsom thung rtsag li la yang yon tan 'di dag dang kha 'bral thabs med pa lta bu yin snyam pa blo gsar gzhon nu rnams kyi blo gros kyi pad+mo bzhad pa'i legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba'i dpal la ci gar longs spyod cig765

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/zhu chen mkhan po tshul khrims rin chen ni/ khams sde dge'i mnga' khongs ldan khog gser ldan sa dkar gyi yul du yab kun dga' 'phel lam ming gzhan lha bzo ngag dbang chos 'phel dang / yum bu chog ces pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me glang(1697)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par khu bo'i mdun nas ka mad 'dogs 'brel bcas sbyangs/ de nas me dgon du grwa par zhugs/ khro bo lha mgon zhes pa nas sbyor klog legs par sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gcig par drung pa kun dga' rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan kun dga' bsod nams zhes btags/ che r+ghaṃ dgon du karma mthu stobs kyi drung nas sgra snyan ngag dang / dge bshes sangs rgyas chos 'phel las rtsis/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams bstan pa las tshad ma bcas thun mong gi rig gnas kun legs par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa shing sbrul(paṃ725)lor gtsang ngor gyi gdan sar phebs/ ngor bla brang mkhan po tshul khrims lhun grub kyis khong la tshul khrims rin chen zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ de nas mi ring bar ngor dgon khang gsar bla brang gi drung yig mdzad nas dgon der lo bzhi lhag tsam bzhugs/ dgung lo so bzhi pa lcags khyi(1730)lor mkhan po bkra shis lhun grub dang mnyam du sde dger phebs/sde dge'i rgyal po zhe gnyis pa chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gis sde dge'i par khang che mo'i zhu dag mkhan por bskos/ de nas bzung ste sa skya phyogs kyi dpe cha tshang ma legs sgrig dang bstan 'gyur la zhu dag gang legs mdzad/ bar 766

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/khom rnams su 'chad nyan nyams len dang lha ris sogs kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad de dgung lo don brgyad pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing rta (177'byelor sku gshegs/rje 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / kun dga' bsod nams/ zhu chen lo tsā ba/ zhu chen mkhan po/ tshul khrims rin chen sogs du ma yod/ gsung rtsom la bstod tshogs gsum 'phar ma dang / rnam thar gyi skor/ dkar chag chab shog gi sde tshan sogs snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur phan sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa po ti bcu gsum bzhugs pa las skabs 'dir snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du dpal sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par phul ba'i zhu yigakun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang gi go sar skye ba 'dir/ /gnon pa'i mthu chen thob kyang bstan la rjes chags sku/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i gar gyis dpyod ldan sku/ /dga' rab bskyed pa'i blo gros rmad byung rgyal gyur cig /theg gsum bstan pa'i brjod bya mtha' dag rgyan gsum lam/ /song ba'i legs bshad gsar pa'i ngo mtshar blta ba'i ched/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rin chen rgyud mangs brdung ba yi/ /zol gyis bsgribs te longs spyod 'khor lor lhags so snyam/ /ma bris chos kun rnam gsal mkhyen klong yangs par bkra/ /bos min 'khor bar dbang med 'phyan pa'i lus can don/ /gzhan gyis ma bskul brtse dang byang chub sems mchog ni/ /gzhar yang mi gtong rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob spyod pa brling / /767

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bsam kun rdzogs byed grags pa'i rkang pas 'thung mchog gis/ /'gro khams mkhyen dang brtse bas mi gtong sdug bsngal dang / /kun 'byung 'jigs la skyob pa'i nus pa rdzogs gyur na/ /skyabs mchog 'gro ba'i re skong khyod kyi mtshungs dper bsngags/ /mu med phyogs kyi nang na 'thib bu 'phrog pa 'di/ /mkhas tshul gsum gyi legs mdzad zhig gam nyin mo'i dpal/ /lus can lus dang nyon mongs sgrib pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa'i snang byed khyod kyi 'phrin las nges par khums//zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od rdul su zhig gtsug lhung ba/ /don chen byed 'di gyi nar 'jog tu mi thung zhes/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po chu bdag grangs kyis rings par lhags/ /bskal par 'degs pa'i g.yar dam bcas kyi chos kyi khrir/ /dad grol mchog gi thugs rje byin rlabs 'khrigs pa'i sprin/ /legs gsungs dbyar gyi rnga gsang dal bur ldir ba'i phyogs/ /mngon 'ga'i spu sdug rnam bkra'i sems kyi ma yu rī/ /tshogs pa gsum ldan mgrin pa bteg nas 'di skad gsol/ /kha pa ri pa'i lus can bsod nams skya rengs mas/ /yon tan 'od snang mi zad skyabs kyi me sbyin skyes/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i legs bris lam du gling byas tshe/ /srid zhi'i dge legs 'dab brgya'i tshal rab cis mi bzhad/ /tsher snon gzengs pa'i g.yang khar 'khyog por skyes pa yi/ /shing rtser chags pa'i 'bras bur re ba cher byed na/ /ci 'dod rtag par 'jo ba'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i phyogs/ /bsam don lag pa'i yal ga su zhig skyong mi byed//mngon 'dod gsol btab snying po'i gzugs dang gzugs brnyan dag/768

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/dug gsum mkhyen pa'i ha nu man+d+ras dpyad pa'i 'phral/ /blang dor 'doms pa'i bka' lung dga' byed nyag phran gyis/ /'gal rkyen bar chad 'bod sgrogs mgo bo breg pa dang / /lhan cig sgo gsum srung bar byin rlabs sngags mdud dang / /sngags btab gu gul dam tshig rdzas mchog sku brnyan lnga/ /rgyu bzang yol go dbus phrug ther snam bubs re dang / /bkra shis lha dar dkar po'i skyes bcas spyi bor phebs /gang tshe rab dga' khong nas rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /dper 'os lam gsum khongs su rig pa'i pho nya 'dis/ /btsal yang ma rnyed gang phyir bsod nams brgya pa yi/ /sku nyid bskal par brtan pa'i dga' ba mtshungs dper brjod/ /slad du'ang dpyad gsum rnam dag bstan dang 'gro phan gzhi/ /bslu med skyabs mchog rigs sras zung bcas gsang ba gsum/ /nges pa lnga ldan mgon po ji bzhin brtan bzhugs kyi/ /bsrung bzlog las kyi mthar thug mi bskyung brtun par 'tshal/ /'dir 'khod dge slong brtul zhugs gtsor 'dzin gyi na ba/ /byin rlabs bcud len thob pa'i bde dgar spyod pa'i skabs/ /'on te da dung dal rten ring 'tsho'i bslab bya dag /bka' lung mi 'gyur phreng ba rim stsol gsol ba 'debs/ /de skad snyan dngags gar+ghaṃrba yi glu len mas/ /stong 'khun ngang dkar gos bzang gis ba/klubs lcags mchog srang / /mdog bzang 'degs zho bcu phrag rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /spyan lam 'chi med dga' tshal zlos pa'i gar gyis 769

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/rtsen/ /gang 'di lan gcig min par thugs rje'i gdugs dkar gyi/ /grib bsil yangs par bde dga'i zil dngar dga' ston la/ /dgyes rgur spyod thob dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs pa'i ming / /tshul khrims rin chen zhes byar thogs pa'i gus ldan pas/ /mdo smad nor 'dzin lus phra sde bzhi'i dpal gyis 'byor/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyis sa 'bangs skyong ba'i sa phyogs kyi/ /rgyal khab dbang po'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas la bris bgrang ba'i gzhi/ /thams cad 'dul gyi zla tshes dag par bteg ste thal/ /ces dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par phul ba'i zhu yig gar+ghaṃrba'i glu ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang / ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba ma ṅgalo bha wa ru/zhes gsungs pa'i bka' rtsom ni snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa dang / brjod don ches rgya che ba 'di dang 'di lta bu'i gsung rtsom ni shin tu mang zhing / rje 'di nyid kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par sde dge sa spyod bstan pa tshe ring mchog gis rgyal ba'i bka' bstan bcos sogs gsung rab shin tu mang po par bskrun gnang skabs kyi zhu chen mdzad pa dang / bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mdzad pa la sogs pa bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel gyi bya bar mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang mdzad pa ni nga tshos brjed mi rung ba dang / khong gi gsung rab kyi zhu dag mdzad skabs ngo 'dzin zom 'jog rigs dor te bstan rgyun kho nar dgongs nas zhu dag nan tan chen pos mdzad yod/ dper na/770

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bstan 'gyur par brko'i skabs rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing skad gnyis shan sbyar ma'i mjug byang du khong gis/'di'i legs sbyar skad la yi ge pas bslad pa'i 'bru nor mang du mchis pa par du 'khod skabs kho bos dbu nas yig ldeb bzhi bcu skor tsam bcos zin mtshams/ sa skyong bstan pa tshe ring dpon blon dag snang ha cang 'byams ches bas po ta la'i phyi mo 'di mkhas pa mang pos zhus dag byas pa'i par yig yid ches yin pas ma dag pa yod pa mi srid pas bzo bcos ma byed ces bka' lung lan gnyis kyang stsal bas 'chos dbang ma byung bar rang sor bzhag pa yin pas slan chad blo gros ldan pa dag gis zhu dag byed pa byung na bstan pa'i byi dor byas par 'gyur bas dgongs par 'jog mdzod/ ces pa'ang tshul rin gyis gleng ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gsung mol dum bu 'di'i thog nas khong gi mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang / bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel la thugs rtse gcig tu bsgrims pa mtshon pas nga tshos khong gi bka' drin nam yang chud bzos su ma song bar bod kyi spyi bye brag gi rig gnas gong 'phel gyi bya bar 'bad brtson shin tu chen po byed dgos pa ni gal shin tu che'o/ /yongs 'dzin gu ge ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/yongs 'dzin gu ge ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni/ yab tshe ring dpal 'byor dang / yum 'dzom chog gnyis kyi sras su gtsang g.yas ru bde rgyas bye ma gling gi gtsug lag khang dang nye bar chu bo lu ha ti'i nye 'dabs brgya 771

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mkhar zhes par rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug(1748)lor sku 'khrungs shing / mtshan la bkra shis don grub ces gsol/dgung lo dgu pa shing khyi lor kha ba blo bzang brtson grus kyi mdun du rab tu byung / mtshan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ bkra shis lhun por chos spyod sogs kyi rgyugs legs par phul/ dgung lo bcu pa me glang lor mkhan chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ tshogs chen ngag 'don gyi rim pa dang grwa tshang chos spyod rnams la sbyang brtson dang /dkyil khang grwa tshang du tshad ma'i skor sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad de dka' bcu'i ming btags bzhes/ slob dpon rin chen dge slong chos rje'i mdun sgra dang sdeb sbyor legs par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa shing lug lor paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas lo ngo bcu bzhi tsam gyi ring dpal 'byor lhun po'i ri khrod sogs dben gnas su sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor mdzad/ dgung lo zhe lnga pa chu byi lor dkyil khang grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bskos pa dang / zhe brgyad pa shing yos lor rgyud pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon du phebs te dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa tshad med bstsal/ dgung lo zhe dgu par paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i yongs 'dzin mdzad pa de nas yongs 'dzin gu ge ba zhes pa'i mtshan yongs grags su gyur pa yin no/ /rje 'di nyid kyi gsung rtsom gyi nang nas snyan ngag gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba cha tshang drangs pa 'di lta ste/blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/772

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyal tshab dam pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni rta nag gi yul gru khro brgya tsho ba zhes bya ba'i sde dpon zhig gi rigs su gzhon nu dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing / mgo bo gdugs lta bu/ smin ma 'dzar zhing / sna'i gzengs mtho ba la sogs pa mtshan dpe'i yon tan rjes mthun dang ldan pa zhig btsas so /gser mngal las ni tshangs pa bzhin/ /u ma las ni gdong drug bzhin/ /sgyu 'phrul las ni don grub bzhin/ /gzhon nu de bzhin bde bar btsas/ /gzhan la bran ltar gus pa yis/ /dman sa 'dzin pa'i dam pa rnams/ /mthon po'i rigs su skye 'gyur gyi/ /rigs ngan bu ru skye mi srid/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge'i bu/ /rang rigs seng ge las skye zhing / /wa skyes la ni seng ge'i bu/ /skye ba 'jig rten 'di na med/ /gzhon nu de btsas ma thag tu lce la snyi wang gis dhī 'bri ba sogs blo rno ba'i thabs rnams bsgrubs shing / chu 'jam pos khrus byas/ zas snyod pa/ skra mtshams dbye ba/ gtsug phud 'jog pa sogs skyes pa'i bya ba rnams byas te rdzing na gnas pa'i pad+mo bzhin du bskyed bsrings/ nar son pa na slob dpon mkhas pa las yi ge 'bri klog la sbyangs pa'i tshe 'bri klog gnyis ka tshegs med rmer mkhyen te byis pa'i dus na'ang tha mal gyi spyod pa las 'das shing / tshe sna rabs du mar goms pa'i bag chags kyis glu gar thams cad chos la rtse ba zhig yod ces grags so/ /legs byas gzugs grub ngo 'dzin lto/ /mi pham snang brnyan dpal gyis mdzes/ /dga' ldan zhing la co 'dri bas/ /'dod dgu 'khyil ba sa'i thig ler//shes bya'i 'jug pa sa gsum khyon/ /rnam dpyod gom gcig gis 'jal 773

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bas/ /blo ldan gzhon nu mi'u thungs/ /'khrungs tshe chos min stobs ldan bcom/ /rigs rus cho 'brang dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /thabs shes nyi zla'i bgrod pa zung / /lhan cig tshogs pa'i dga' ston 'bras/ /'jig rten mun sel cho ga rdzogs/ /de khyim gyi lo rgyus tshad med pa dang / 'bangs 'khor g.yog rgya che ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal du ma dang ldan na yang / tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad dbang po'i gzhu ltar g.yo zhing / mtha' rgud pas sdud pa sogs gsod sar khrid pa la rgyan btags pa bzhin du blo khrid kyi gnas 'ba' zhig tu mthong nas/ khyim gyi 'du 'dzi lang long ni nyon mongs pa du ma skye ba'i rkyen du rig ste ngan skyugs kyi bum pa bzhin du dor te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhing / bkra shis lhun por jo rdzong bkra shis chos sdings pa'i mi tshan grwa gras su zhugs te bsdus sbyor yid kyi mun sel nas bzung rig pa'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig phyogs glang yab sras kyi gzhung lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i dbu phar 'dul mdzod kyis bsdus pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung lugs la 'ol spyi dang 'khol 'don phyogs re ba tsam gyis ma tshims par phyi'i go rgya gcod pa'i bshad pa dang / snying po'i don gzhung lugs rab 'byams de dag gi nying khu gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du khyer shes pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag la 'dris par mdzad nas dmigs skor so sor yid 'gyur gyi myong ba thon pa'i theg pa thun mong ba'i lam la blo legs par sbyangs/ dka' rab 'byams kyi mtshan btags kyang rim gyis bzhes te mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis thugs rgyud phyug par mdzad nas sangs 774

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i gdams pa zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad srol dang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan te rang nyid kyis nyams su bzhes shing / skal ldan gyi gdul bya gzhan la'ang rgya cher spel ba la brten nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis grwa 'dir mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la rab 'byams pa jo mo rdzong pa 'di rang mkhas zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad do/ / chos bzhin bsgrub la mi khom pa'i/ /btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim spangs te/ /sil sil rgyan dang lcang lo'i khur/ /dor nas de ni rab tu byung / /dpyad gsum dag pa'i gnam ru'i rgyud/ /rnam dpyod sor mos bkug pa'i mdas/ /log rtog mgrin pa bcu pa'i snying / /'bigs byed dga' byed dbang phyug mtshar/ /mkhas la mkhas pa'i grags pa ni/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa bzhin du mdzes/ /rmongs la rmongs pas bsgrags pa yi/ /grags pa grags ngan bzhin du smad/ /de ltar mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la mkhas pas snyan grags kyi ut+pala'i chun po phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung yangs por bsgrags pa las paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bku' bzhin 'jam dbyangs mi'i gzugs brnyan paṇa chen mkhas pa'i dbang po shārnyi pa blo gros rgya la mtshan gyi chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa'i go sar bsko bzhag mdzad de dka' pod chen po lnga'i bshad srol dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i mu nas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma du ma la dbang lung man ngag gi rim pa mtha' yas pas so so'i yid kyi re ba skong bar mdzad do/ /de'i tshe sde dpon khro brgya tsho ba'i rigs rgyud chad pa la thug pa na nang mi rnams nas dam pa 'di nyid la rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i thabs gnang dgos 775

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/zhes nan tan chen po'i sgo nas zhus pa'i tshe/ bzhad chab tshan la phebs pa'i zhor khro brgya tsho ba'i nang du zhag gcig bzhugs nas nang mi rnams kyis mthong thos kyi sar gzim mal bcas te thur sel gyi rlung 'go sgo nas phyir phyung ba'i sgra che chung gnyis bsgrags pa las dang po'i tshe bu dang / gnyis pa'i tshe dgos med kyi bu mo zhig kyang 'byung ba yod ces lkog gyur gyi don mngon sum du gzigs pa'i lung bstan cing / ji ltar lung bstan pa ltar khro brgya tsho ba'i rus rgyud chad la thug pa'i tshe rigs kyi sras bu gcig dang / bu mo gcig kyang rim gyis btsas so/ /'og rlung sgra yis rigs kyi sras/ /sras mo dang bcas bskrun par gnas/ /nus mthu chen po 'jig rten 'dir/ /'di 'dra 'byung ba'i gtam yang dkon/ /de nas paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud pa grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan gnang ba'i mu nyid nas rje 'di pa gsang sngags rgyud pa grwa tshang gi rdo rje slob dpon du bsko gzhag mdzad de gsung rab kun gyi yang rtse dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi 'chad nyan gtso bor gyur pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi man ngag rgyud 'grel gyi 'chad nyan/ bstan la log par 'khu ba'i gdug pa can bsad bskrad rmongs rengs ji ltar byas pa'i tshul gtor chen drug cu pa'i phyag len/ dpa' bo'i gar 'cham dang bcas pa zhi rgyas dbang drag pa'i las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i rim pa rnams paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du dar bar mdzad cing sku na shin tu smin par gyur pa'i tshe tshogs la phebs pa'i lam bar du dri chu mi thub pa'i tshul bzhes par blo rmongs 'ga' zhig nas sgro skur gyi gzhir byed kyang / ma 'ongs pa na 776
