bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyud grwa 'di nyid du 'tsho ba'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs par mdzad pa las/ dam pa 'di nyid rang gi lus kyi kun spyod la rang dbang mi 'dus pa zhig min pa gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis gong gi rnam par thar pa la brtags na shes nus so/ /sku mya ngan las 'da' bar nye bar slebs pa'i dus la stod byang pa'i dka' chen mgon po rgyal mtshan sku gam du bcar ba'i skabs shig nged kyi rjes su sngags khang khri thog tu dge bshes pa khyod 'byon mi dgos pa'i nges pa mi 'dug pas gal srid 'byon dgos byung tshe 'grel pa gnyis kyi 'chad nyan dang /cho ga phyag len gyi rim pa yang da dung zhib par rtsad gcod dgos pa mang du 'dug pas skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po cher zhu ma thub pa'i rigs dge ba'i bshes gnyen khungs thub la 'dri rtsad byas ngos/ rgyud grwa'i cho ga phyag len ma nyams pa mdzad dgos zhes ma 'ongs mngon sum gyis gzigs pa'i zhal ta yang yang du mdzad do/ /brtse ba'i blta stangs dag pa'i 'khor la gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa tha ma'i gsung gis bstan/ /'gro kun thog mtha' bar du dge la bkod/ /khyed kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag skyon dang bral/ /de ltar rgyud grwa'i khri thog tu lo bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs nas dgung lo bdun cu pa'i mthar slebs pa na tshong pa khe spogs thob pa dang ded dpon rin chen lon pa dang / zhing pa lo tog lon pa bzhin du sprul pa'i sku de nyid dang po gang nas byon pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i thugs kar gshegs so/ /rlabs chen smon lam rta ljang stobs kyis drangs/ /phun tshogs dge mtshan lha yi lam na mjes/ /'phrin las lhun grub 'od stong dra ba can/ /'dren mchog 777

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/bla ma'i nyin byed 'gro la sman/ / zhes gsang sngags rgyud pa grwa tshang gi rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam ljon pa zhes bya ba las/ blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab dang po'o/zhes gsungs pa'i gsung rtsom ni bcad lhug spel ma'i rtogs brjod ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa 'dis mtshon khong gi snyan ngag gsung rtsom mtha' dag snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur 'bum dang ldan pa sha stag mdzad pas bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rim nang khong gis kyang mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod cing / rje 'di nyid ni gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i mkhas grub bye ba'i nang gi gtsug gi rgyan gyur mkhas dang grub pa'i snyan grags bla nar 'bar ba zhig go /rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags/sde pa rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs grags ni yab rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi sras tha chung du rab byung brgyad pa'i chu stag(1482)lor 'khrungs/ khong gis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la thugs brtson chen pos sbyangs pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i yar rtser son/ rin spungs su hor gos bzang po'i rgyu las grub pa'i rigs ldan yol bar grags pa'i mchod rdzas bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa bzhengs/ chos srid lugs gnyis la rnam dpyod sgo 'phang mchog tu yangs/khong gis daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung las drangs pa'i〈sa paṇa gyi rtogs brjod bskal 778

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/bzang legs lam〉dang(snyan 'grel mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro〉 〈mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan〉sogs khyad par 'phags pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ khong nam 'das kyi lo tshigs nges gsal ma rnyed pa bcas so/ /rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags 'di nyid ni khyim pa'i rten la gnas pa mkhas pa'i nang du gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen pa'i dpal 'bar ba zhig yin pa khong gi gsung rtsom khag nas mtshon zhing / lhag par snyan ngag smra la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i snyan ngag gi rtsom gshis ni go dka' ba shar phyogs go ḍa pa'i lugs su bzhed pa'i dpe mtshon du/ (sa paṇa gyi rtogs brjod bskal bzang legs lam〉nang nas sho lo ka gcig drangs pa ste/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i bkod pa'i skor/iṇ+ḍa rnyil gyi khams la snyoms zhugs pa'i/ /nam mkha' mtshan bral skye ba ltar sngo ba/ /chu yi phun tshogs pha rol med pa yi/ /kho ra khor yug yar 'brog g.yu yi mtsho/ /zhes so/ /shel dkar gling pa mi 'gyur lhan grub/bka' blon shel gling mi 'gyur lhun grub ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me byi (1876)lor gtsang shab shel gling gzhis su 'khrungs/ de nas mi ring bar yab yum sku tshe ma zin pa dang / ston 'bras lam du ma lhongs pa sogs khyim gyi 'byor 'khos zhan par gyur te rang khongs mi ser drag gras kyi rogs ram 'og lha sar rtsis khang du zhugs thub/ de nas mi ring bar zhabs sdod zhus nas shing gnyer gyi 'gan 'khur dang / rdzong dga' rdzong dpon sogs mdzad pa'i skabs 779

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gzhung 'bangs gnyis dge'i mdzad spyod bzang po'i grags pa 'phel/khong gis gzhon nu'i dus tsam nas mkhas dbang du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas rig gnas la sbyangs pa phul phyin mdzad pa'i mkhyen stobs la rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos gzigs bskyangs kyis dmigs bsal ming 'don mdzad de bka' drung du bsko gzhag bstsal/ de rjes sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rgya gar la chibs zhal bsgyur skabs chibs zhabs su bcar nas ka lon spug dang / rdo rje gling du lo gsum bzhugs pa'i skabs dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa dran glu dang / de rjes khong gi rang tshul brjod pa'i 'bel gtam/ yod 'don drang thig mthong ba 'dzum shor/ rang tshul brjod pa'i ka bshad sogs rim par rtsom 'bri gnang /de rjes sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos bka' blon bsko gzhag bstsal ba nas ring por ma song ba dgung grangs so brgyad pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu glang(1913)lor 'das/shel dkar gling pa mi 'gyur lhun grub ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug byon pa bod kyi thun mong rig pa'i gnas la mkhyen rlabs gzhan dring mi 'jog pa khyim pa'i rten la gnas pa'i mkhas pa'i gras shig yin/ khong gis rang tshul brjod pa'i 'bel gtam dang / ka bshad sogs brtsam bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs shing gson nyams dod pos bstan pa'i 'bol rtsom mang po spel gnang mdzad par klog pa pos gdeng 'jog nan po byed pa'i rtsom gshis kyi dpe mtshon du skabs 'dir lha sa dran glu'i dum bu zhig drangs pa 'di lta ste/gsal gsal mar me la sogs mchod tshogs dbus/ /780

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/brjid brjid mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar jo shaka gnyis/ /gus gus mchod mjal zhu grogs dang bcas te/ / shob shob smon lam 'debs gnas lha sa dran/ /la la dpal lha zhi drag bste gnas su/ /ki ki swo swo'i nga ros ri rab kyang / /sber sber g.yo ba'i skad dang dar 'phyar zhing / /'phyur 'phyur bsang dud gtong ba'i lha sa dran/ /yod yod ltos shig gru 'dzin gzhal med khang / /mer mer rten gyis khengs pa mjal ma thag /hrig hrig mig nas dad pa'i mchi ma ni/ /nyil nyil dbang med 'bab pa'i lha sa dran/ /che che bzang bzang bla ma khrir bzhugs na/ /zab zab theg chen chos char dbab pa'i tshe/ /mang mang skye bo'i lag pa zum bzhin par/ /sim sim nyan pa'i chos ra lha sa dran/ /pa pa a ma rgan rgon mang po zhig /'dar 'dar rkang pas lus po theg dka' rung / /sgur sgur phyag dang bskor bas gling skor lam/ /rong rong bskyod pas yongs gang lha sa dran/ /zhes bzhi ka'i thog mar yod pa bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan spyad nas khong gzhan yul du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs rang yul dran pa'i skyo glu 'di'i thog nas bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa byang chub pa zhig yin pa gsal 781

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/po mthong thub/ dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje/dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje'am/ o rgyan rdo rje ni rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa rta(1858)lor gtsang la stod ding ri rdzong khongs sku rar 'khrungs/ dkar lebs zhes pa ni dkar lebs dgon gyi drung yig gi las khur mdzad myong bas yongs grags su dkar lebs drung yig ces su grags/khong gzhon nu'i skabs mthong brag rin po che dang / stag tshang bla ma rin po che/ rdzogs chen gang ra rang grol sogs kyi drung nas bod kyi yig rigs dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung sogs rig pa'i gnas la slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa thon/ de rjes dkar lebs dgon gyi drung yig gi las khur dgongs zhu gnang ste la stod khul phyir log phebs rjes dbus gtsang dang /la stod khul sogs kyi slob gnyer bar sum rtags gtso bor gyur pa'i rig gnas kyi slob khrid rgya cher mdzad pas 'brog chu bzang rin po che sku mched dang / pa rnam khams brag sprul pa'i sku sogs slob ma du ma bskyangs/khong gis snga rjes su thon mi'i dgongs rgyan dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' gnad snying po rab gsal/ mtha' dpyod dwangs shel me long sogs rtsom 'bri mdzad pa ma zad/ 'bras ljongs bla ma o rgyan dang / khu nu bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis brda sprod pa'i skor gnang ba'i rtsod yig gi rtsod lan dang /yang lan/ khams brag sprul pa'i sku'i bzhed tshul dang / khum bu ba ngag dbang tshul khrims kyi sum rtags dris lan/ snyan ngag ngag rol le'u gnyis pa'i dpe 782

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/rgyan bcu bzhi pa dang / bco lnga pa'i dogs dpyod sogs snyan sum skor dpyad yig mang po rtsom 'bri gnang ba phyis par skrun byas par dpe thung pod gcig yod/ mdor na bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi bya gzhag la mdzad rjes mi dman pa bzhag cing / sku tshe yang dgung lo brgyad cu la nye ba bzhugs 'dra ba bcas so dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje ni bod kyi brda sprod rig pa dang / snyan ngag sogs rig pa'i gnas la mkhyen rlabs kyi dpal 'bar ba zhig yin pas bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i dka' gnad 'ga' zhig skor skabs de'i mkhas pa'i bzhed pa mthun min phan tshun bgro gleng gnang ba'i nang rang lugs 'thad ldan sgrub byed gsal por bkod pa'i rtsod lan yang lan gyis gzhan lugs bsun 'byin dang / rang lugs 'thad ldan du bsgrubs pa de'i thog nas bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i 'chad nyan la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag pa mtshon cing / skabs de'i rtsod gzhi'i gnad don gang zhig yang dag pa dang /gang zhig yang ma dag pa'i dpyad brjod seng ge'i g.yu ral la spre'u'i lag rtsed lta bu zhu mi spobs kyang / skabs de'i rtsod yig dang / rtsod lan/ yang lan gyis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po thon pa dang / bod kyi rtsom rigs kyi bya ba 'phel rgyas la'ang shugs nas nus pa chen po thon pa ni nga tshos brjed du mi rung ba'i mdzad rjes shig yin/ skabs 'dir khong gis bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag la mdzad rjes bzhag pa'i gsung rtsom gyi dpe mtshon du dpon ngan za rngam can la zur za'i ka bshad rtsom gnang gi dum bu zhig drangs na/tsa tser ming btags sdug bsngal dar gos kyis bstums pa/ /783

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/tsha grang dbye ba mi chod ltogs 'tshub kyi rgyal 'gong / /dza dzor nor bltas bka' khrims chu bsgyur gyi dpon po/ /wa bzhin 'jol 'jol de dag snang ba rang ma song / /zhwa mo zur gyon rta lcags nam mkha' la 'phyar ba'i/ /za 'dre skar ma rkub skyog mi ser gyi seg rdar/ /'a lad de tshor yon tan dri ma tsam med kyang / /ya med mig log rdzig rdzig gad mo rang shor byung / /zhes dpon ngan rgyug khyi dang bcas pa'i spyod tshul ngan pa ther 'don gyi zur za'i ka bshad 'di lta bur rgyan gyi khyad par ni rang bzhin brjod par dpe rgyan gyi nyams cung zad 'dres pa zhig tu mngon yang / rtsom pa po rig pa'i gnas lo mkhyen pa'i rtsal rgyas shing / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong ches phun sum tshogs pas skabs de'i dpon ngan za rngam can gyi spyod tshul ngan pa ji ma ji bzhin mtshon pa ma zad/deng dus la bltos na'ang las byed pa nyung shas kyi lkog za rul sungs kyi spyod tshul ngan pa'i rigs kyang cha lugs dang / rnam pa mi 'dra ba tsam las lkog za rul sungs kyi spyod ngan ni khyad par med pa lta bur mthong ba sngar 'di lta bu'i rtsom gshis la brten pa'i snyan rtsom yang mang po mchis pa de dag la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang / dmigs bsal gyi dge mtshan ldan pa yang bod kyi snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal thun mong ma yin pa zhig tu rtsis na 'grig pa bcas so/ /dge 'dun chos 'phel/dge 'dun chos 'phel ni/ yab sngags 'chang rdo rje'i mtshan can nam/784

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/a lags rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / yum pad+ma skyid ces bya ba'isras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu mo yos(1903)lor mdo smad reb gong zho 'ong dpyi bya ba'i grong tshor 'khrungs/ rdor grags sprul pa'i sku'i skye srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad pas rdor grags sprul sku zhes kyang grags/ gzhon nu'i dus su g.ya' ma bkra shis 'khyil dgon par bzhugs shing / dgon pa de dang shel dgon sogs su sum rtags snyan ngag sogs la sbyangs pa mthil phyin mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgur rab tu byung ba'i mtshan la dge 'dun chos 'phel zhes bya bar gsol/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me sbrul(1917)nas lo bcu'i ring bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du bsdus grwa phar phyin 'og ma'i bar slob gnyer dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ yin na'ang de'i ring 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig char dogs slong mdzad pas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du bzhugs bzos mi bde ba byung bas lha sar phebs dgos byung ste 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho sogs dge rgan du bsten nas slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/ 'on kyang 'bras spungs su 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig char dogs slong mdzad stabs sog po dge bshes tsho zhig gis khong la dngos shugs gang rung nas tshig mtshon btab pas 'bras spungs su yang bzhugs bzos bde ba zhig ma byung bas(1933)lor rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ra hu la zhes bya bas gdan zhus ltar rgya gar du phebs nas wa ra ṇa si sogs su legs sbyar gyi skad sbyong ba dang / de nas sing ga lar phebs nas saṃskṛ ta'i slob grwa chen mor lo gcig dang zla ba bzhi skor slob gnyer gnang ste mkhas pa'i yang rtser son cing / 〈sing ga la'i gnas brtan sde pa'i mdo〉 dang (legs sbyar bang 785

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mdzod〉 snga phyir bka' rtsom gnang / de nas u ru su'i ri mo mkhas pa ra'o ris zhes pas rgya gar ku mar gdan drangs/ (deb sngon〉 dbyin yig tu bsgyur rogs mdzad/ de nas slar yang rgya gar du phebs te lo gsum bzhugs/(1945)lor bod du phyir phebs/ me khyi(1946)nas me phag(1947)lo'i bar〈deb ther dkar po〉rtsom gnang mdzad/ (1947)nas(1949)bar de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung gis btson 'jug byas te do dam 'og bzhugs dgos byung ba nas btson grol byung rjes(1951)lor lha sar sku gshegs/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom rub bsdus thub pa kho nar pod gsum bzhugs shing / skabs 'dir rig rtsom gyi rang bzhin mtshon pa'i gsung rtsom mi rtag dran pa'i gsung mgur zhes bya ba drangs na 'di lta ste/mi rtag dran pa'i gsung mgur/ rgya chen don gnyis grub pa'i dga' ston la rol pa'i/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i rtsa lag zas gtsang gi sras po/ /mtha' dang zad du med pa'i byin rlabs kyi sbrang char/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas phob cig /thang chen pha mtha' bral ba'i dud sprin gyi spris ma/ /rkang gling skad brda bsgyur ba'i rgyus med kyi grogs po/ kha dog sna lnga shar ba'i zhing chen gyi re mig /snang yul ngag la bltas kyang skyo nyams shig 'dug pa/ /nye 'brel 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa tshong 'dus kyi mgron po/ /stobs 'byor khengs dregs dar ba rmi lam gyi longs spyod/ /skyid sdug spel ba'i nyams myong dbyar dgun gyi 'gyur ldog /bsam zhing ma bcos shugs pa'i glu dbyangs shig shor song / /med na ltogs kyis dogs pa'i bza' btung gi rtsol sgrub/ /yod na zad kyis dogs pa'i khe tshong gi 'du 'god/ /don chung las la 786

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/'bad pa'i phreng gog de bgrang nas/ /yun thung mi tshe phra mo'i phreng thag de chad song / /byas kyang 'dzad dus med pa'i 'jig rtenagyi bya gzhag /byas byas las kyi mtha' la yi chad kyi snon pa/ /byas nas grub par rloms pa'i bde 'byor kun bsags kyang / /sdug bsngal phung po 'di yi bcu cha las mi 'dugakhram dang g.yo sgyu'i rtsed mo dgu sgrig tu byas te/ /'bad pa brgya yis sgrub pa'i 'jig rten gyi mdun mas/ /yun ring bsgugs pa'i mtha' la stong bslus su byas las/ /lo gsum sdug las byas pa'i a thang ni chad song / /'byor tshe nye ba'i drung na zhud zhud du 'gro zhing / /rgud tshe ring po'i sa nas mdzub ker gyis 'phya ba/ /drin byas drin du mi go grogs ngan gyi gshis la/ /bsam zhing ngu ma rgod kyi snang ba zhig shar song / /shes brtson thos pa can gyi nyam chung gi kha stabs/ /blun po nor rgyal khur ba'i dbang med kyis bcom ste/ /chos mthun bkur bste'i bzhugs gral go log tu bsdebs nas/ /seng ge khri yi g.yog tu gyur tshul 'di skyo ba/ /zin med dbyar dgun dus bzhi'i so tshis la 'bad nas/ /na med rnam g.yeng ngang du mi tshe byed zad kyang / /da dung snang med gzhon pa'i 'byor nyams de che ba/ /lus rgas sems ma rgas pa'i snang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /tshogs drug snang ba yul gyi me tog gi thang du/ /gtad med rig pa'i bu chung phar phar la 'khyams pas/ /don chen gnas la sems pa'i dran 'dun gyi lam srol/ /da lta rjes med bor ba'i snang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /ri bo sgang drug ljongs nas ri dwags bzhin 'khyams te/ /thag ring rgyus med mi yi rgyal khams su slebs nas/ /mdo med 'phyor mo'i phyogs la sems kyi gshis shor te/ /drin can pha ma brjed pa'i bu rul nga skyo ba/ /ma rig rnam rtog 'dre mo'i gar stabs kyi rjes su/ /mi bden 'khrul pa'i chos 'di yom yom du g.yos pas/ /de ring 787

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mthong ba'i snang ba sang nyin ni brjed de/ /gang la gtad so med pa'i ngang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /bltas na skyid skyid 'dra ba'i 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs/ /thos na rang rang skabs kyi sdug bsngal re 'dug pa/ /'phral snang bde ba'i gnas skabs rmi lam tsam song rjes/ /cis kyang rang sems skyo ba'i rkyen sna re 'dug pa/ /re dogs 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi/ /shugs 'byung dga' ba'i nyams kyi 'o ma dang 'dres pas/ /bza' btung longs spyod phyi yi skyid chas tsam 'grigs kyang / /blo bde gu yangs nang gi skyid nyams de mi 'dug /che 'dod re ba'i gzhi ma me nang du bsregs shing / /mi 'dod khral gyi btsun gzugs thal dong du bskyur te/ /gang dran sems rjes 'byung ba smyon pa yi spyod pas/ /ljongs dang ljongs su rgyu ba'i gu yangs shig byung na/ /tshul gsum rtags kyi rdzong gog meg med de bshig cing / /mtha' brgyad dam bca'i mdud pa rang sa ru chad de/ /gang shar snang ba gzhi med rtsa bral du go nas/ /zhe blong gting nas bde ba'i dga' spro zhig byung na/ /stong pa mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal gyi dbyings su/ /'dzin med sems kyi ngo bo ro gcig tu thim ste/ /rang myong brjod du med pa'i zag med kyi bde bar/ /nyin dang mtshan du spyod pa'i skal bzang zhig byung na/ /snang ba mi rtag a ma'i ngo 'dzum gyi dkar nag /res skyid res sdug rang nyams rjes dran gyi skyo glu/ /rgyus med phyi ma'i thang chen r+ghaṃ ga la'i yul du/ /mdo smad 'khyams po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis blangs so/ /shar phyogs r+ghaṃ ga la'i yul du ri'i bu mo'i grong dang nye bar dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bris pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'i gsung mgur 'di'i thog nas mthong thub pa ni/ dge 'dun 788

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos rmad du byung ba zhig yod pa de yin/ de yang khong gis gsung rtsom ci 'dra zhig mdzad kyang skye bo'i mthun snang du grub pa rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan shas che ba dang / 'khyog brjod kyi skabs su yang rig byed pa'i gtam rgyus sogs las byung ba spyir btang mis rtogs dka' ba'i rigs ma yin pa thun mong skye bo'i mthun snang grub pa gson nyams ldan pa'i dpe mang po bed spyod gnang bas khong gi gsung rtsom ni klog pa po shes tshad mtho dma' sus kyang rtogs thub pa dang / rang rang gi shes bya dang / thos rgya che chung la gzhigs pa'i mtshon byed dpe'i thog nas mtshon bya don gyi dngos po rgya che chung rang gi shes tshad la gzhigs pa gsal por rtogs thub pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba 'di lta bu ni rang cag kha ba'i ljongs kyi sngon byon mes po tsho'i mkhyen pa'i rtsal las byung ba'i rig rtsal gyi me tog 'bum phrag bzhad pa'i nang gi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig dang bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig kyang yin/tshe tan zhabs drung /tshe tan zhabs drung ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags khyi(1910)lor mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun hwa rdzong du sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo bdun par rab tu byung ste mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sbrul(1953)lor mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom sgyur u yon lhan khang gi 'gan bzhes pa dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs u yon lhan 789

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/khang gzhung las khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan/ kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ kan su'u zhing chen srid gros u yon lha khang gi u yon/ krung go mi rigs skad rigs slob tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa/ krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa bcas kyi go gnas sogs rim par 'gan bzhes gnang bas mtshon bod kyi rig gzhung 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang ba dang / bod rigs kyi blo gsar gzhon nu mang po gso skyong gi mdzad pa rgya chen bskyangs mthar rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang(1985)lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du bka' 'gyur gyi lung gsung bzhin du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/mkhas pa'i dbang po tshe tan zhabs drung gi gsung rtsom la mtshon na bla ma'i rnam thar dang / lo rgyus/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gsung rtsom rnam grangs lnga bcu brgal skor gnang ba'i nang nas skabs 'dir rig rtsom gyi khongs su gtogs pa gnas bstod dbyangs can sgeg mo'i glu dbyangs drangs pa 'di lta ste/gnas bstod dbyangs can sgeg mo'i glu dbyangs/ rab snyan gsung gi rol mo 'phos pa'i rgyud/ /stong ldan pi wang be+eḍū'i rang bzhin can/ /yun thung zhig la bdag gi phang pa ru/ /g.yar bar 'tshal lo bcom ldan ma gcig kye/ /de yi slad du tshangs sras ma khyod ltar/ /yid 'phrog tsog pu'i 'dug stangs sngon btang gis/ /snyim pad sbyar ba'i thal mo mthor btegs te/ /gus pas len par chas so dbyangs ldan ma/ /de yi mod la phang 'gro'i rgyud stong can/ /reg pa tsam gyis 'jig rten myos pa'i dbyangs/ /dbang med 'byin par rtsom 790

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyad brjod/pa thob pa dang lhan/ /lag sor dal ba'i go skabs ring du dben/ /e ma mtshar sdug rna ba'i bcud 'phrog cing / /don bzang sgra snyan rgya mtsho'i snying pos phyug /skal bzang rna ba don dang ldan slad du/ /yud tsam gsan par rigs so shes ldan dag /yan lag brgyad ldan dal gyis 'bab pa'i klong / /rma g.yang phyug mo'i 'brog thang gzhung brgyud de/ /dus bzhir ngal gso med par rtag 'bab pa/ /gang la rma chu zhes bya'i grags pa 'bar/ /nyi nub chu lha'i zhing nas dbang phyogs su/ /lhung lhung rgyu lam tsong la ring mo'i mdor/ /grong dang grong khyer skabs gsum las 'phos pa/ /ci ste ma yin snyam pa'i ngo mtshar bkra/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo nam mkha'i sprin klong du/ /bag med gar gyis rnam rtsen ngal ba'i mthar/ /sa la nyal ba'i brtul zhugs blangs pa na/ /rab mtho lhun po'i zol gyis rdzu bag bsten/ /lhun po srid du ring ba de yi ltor/ /klu dbang 'khor tshogs mched lnga'i bang mdzod las/ /rims nad drungs nas 'byin pa'i bdud rtsi'i chab/ /sil 'khrol sgra ldan chu bo'i gter du smin/ /de yi phang par lan gcig mthong tsam gyis/ /yul gru gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i/ /phun tshogs ltad mo'i slad du rgyu skar gyi/ /bu mo mtha' dag sa la babs par nges/ khang pa khang brtsegs rin thang gzhal med khang / /tshong zog cham mer brdal ba'i srang gi khrom/ /bzo dang 'phrul gyi khang chen bgrang yas pa/ /sa gzhir btsugs pa'i tshang tshing mched por snyems/ /byang gi phyogs na sa 'dzin mthon po'i rtser/khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten byin rlabs can/ /sa paṇa yab sras legs mdzad 'phrin las kyis/ /rnam par bzhengs pa'i legs tshogs zhing du brjid/ /lho ri'i phang par chu mig lnga ldan gyi/ kho ra khor yug yid 'ong skyed mos tshal/ /tshangs chen blo gros pir gyis bris 'dra bar/ /skye bo 'di kun dga' bde dpal 791

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/gyis myos/ /dpag tshad stong gis chod pa'i lam thag kyang / /skad cig nyid la bde blag phyin pa'i 'phrul/ /me shugs stobs kyis 'khor ba'i bgrod pa mchoganyin mtshan dal bar mi sdod 'gros kyis brel/ /lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer las lhag pa'i/ /snying po'i snying por yongs 'phags nub byang gi/ /mi rigs yongs kyi slob grwa chen mo de/ /yon tan nor bu'i gter kha mchog tu bsngags/ /de na lo 'dab stug po'i ljon shing dang / /ne tso'i sgro thul gyon pa'i a sho ka /dri bsung ring du 'phro ba'i a gar sogs/ /mtho ris skyed tshal gnyis pa lhun gyis grub/ /ma rgad khu bas lan brgyar tshon byugs pa'i/ /rgya phibs mthong byed bcud len khang bzang tshogs/ /gcig las gcig lhag ri rab lhun po la/ /gser ris bskor ba'ang 'di las lhag re skan/ /mi shigs shel brag gyen du bslangs 'dra ba'i/ /mthor brtsegs khang mig brgya phrag tshom bu ru/ /mkho dgu ma tshang med pa'i longs spyod gang / /'jig rten mdzes pa gcig tu spungs par nges/ /chos dang srid kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gter/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad rmad byung don bzang can/ bris dang dpar ma'i glegs bam bye ba phrag /brag ri brtsegs 'dra'i dpe mdzod rmad du byung / /khyad par rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /gsal byed sde snod gsum gyi bcud bsdus pa/ /bka' bstan glegs bam glang chen rab brtan gyis/ /'khur bar 'os pa gcig min du ma bzhugs/ /skad dang yi ge'i rnam grangs tha dad pa'i/ /blo ldan slob tshogs rig pa'i bang mdzod la/ /don gnyer gcig las gcig lhag ngang pa'i khyu/ /rol mtshor rtsen pa'i dpal gyis 'gran nus min/ /rlung mkhris bad kan gyis bskyed bzhi brgya'i nad/ /rtsa 'joms srog gi ka ba rab brtan cing / /lus khams bder 'tsho'i gso rig sman gyi grwar/ /sbyangs brtson go cha bgos pa'i 792

bod kyi mkhas pa'i rtsom rig mdzad rjes kyi dpyagabarjod/'tsho byed mang / /bris dang 'bur gyi bzo bkod lhur blangs pa'i/ /bi shwa karma'i blo gros rgya khyon can/ /de des bskrun pa'i gzugs brnyan gang la yang / /dngos dang khyad par 'byed nus srid pa tsam/ /gangs can bho ṭa'i rig gnas gcig pur yang / /'jam mgon thon mi a nus gtan phab pa'i/ /sum rtags dag gsum mu tig dkar po'i phreng / /mgul du mdzes pa'i blo gsal pa 'di'i rgyan/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i tshig gi phreng ba la/ /snyan 'jebs dri za'i rol mo lhur blangs pas/ /skye bo kun gyi rna ba'i bcud len gang / /rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng bzhin 'dzad du med/ /ming gi mngon brjod grangs kyi rtsis rig dang / /sgra rig dbyangs can dza ti yi/ /sdeb sbyor pad+ma'i do shal phreng bstar ba/ /rgyan du 'dzin pa'i dran dbang gral du bsgrigs/ /gzhan yang khungs ldan lo rgyus gtam gyi rgyun/ /'bel gtam gling rje'i rnam thar sgrung gis gtsos/ /gang la gang mos yon tan me tog gi /yid 'ong rgyan phreng stong ldan bgrang las 'das/ /sbyangs pa'i mthar son rig pa'i gshog rlabs can/ /gnam 'phang gcod pa'i khyung chen mkha' la lding / /khyon yangs yul gru nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i mtha' ma rig /'di snang bde dga'i longs spyod sdig bral ba/ /mngon mtho'i ba gam 'dzegs pa'i rkang stegs te/ /bstan la mdza' ba'i drang srong dag gis kyang / /bcos min bsngags brjod dbyangs kyis mtshan yang brel/ /de skad dbyangs ldan phang 'gro'i rgyud stong las/ /legs thon rig pa'i sgra snyan rnar 'jebs pa/ /bgrang bya'i khur po lci ba'i rgan po des/ /kun dga'i gsos su 'dod pa 'jo bar brtson/ /'di yi dge bas slob grwa chen mo gang / /'gran zla med pa'i rtse la mngon 'phags te/ /rnam mang skye 'gro'i phan dang bde ba'i dpyid/ /srid pa'i 793

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/mthar yang nyams pa med par smon/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gnas bstod 'di ni lan gru grong khyer nang gnas pa'i nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i snod bcud kyi dge mtshan tshar du dngar bar bstod pa zhig yin pas gnas bstod 'di bklags pa tsam gyis lan gru grong khyer dang / lhag par nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i khor yug gi bkod pa dang / slob grwa de'i nang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la slob gnyer gyi bya ba bla na ma mchis pa'i sgo kun gyi cha rkyen dang ngo mtshar skye bo rnams kyi kun rtog me long gtsang ma'i ngos su rmad byung ri mo ci yang 'char thub pa ni rtsom pa po'i mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang / bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi ngo mtshar do zla med pa mtshon pa 'dis mtshon gsung rtsom gzhan yang 'di dang 'di lta bu'i tshig gzhi brling la don rgya che ba/ snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ches phun sum tshogs pa ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyis bklag 'dod skye ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gsung rtsom nas mtshon pas tshe tan zhabs drung mchog ni deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag smra ba'i khyu mchog mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig yin pa dang /khong gis bod kyi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i bya gzhag la mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa ni nga tshos dus nam yin yang brjed du mi rung ba zhig yin no/ /794

rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/rang nyid ni gzhis rtse grong khyer gdong dkar grong tsho'i zhing pa 'bring pa'i khyim tshang zangs lung pa'i pha dgra lha dang / ma spen pa sgrol ma gnyis kyi bur spyi lo 1933lor skyes shing / ming du o rgyan chos 'phel btags/rang lo bdun par (1940)pha mas bkras lhun nor bu brang khang du dge phrug la bskyal te bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang mdangs chen mi tshan gyi sgrig grwar chos zhugs byas pa'i chos ming la blo bzang dbyig gnyen du grags/de nas rang shag nor brang du sger gyi bod yig slob grwa 'dzugs gnyer gnang ba'i slob phrug grwas su bod yig dang / bod kyi rdel rtsis/ brda dag gi dpe cha 'dzin skyor/ hor yig sogs lo bcu'i ring ( 1940—1950)sbyangs brtson byas/de nas bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang gi dka' chen chos grwa ba (rjes sor paṇa chen rin po che'i mtshan zhabs pa gnang ba'i mtshan la mtshan zhabs rdo gdan pa )dka' chen ngag dbang lags dang / dka' chen bzod pa lags/ dka' chen pad+ma lags bcas mkhas pa'i dbang po gsum bsten nas sum rtags dang dag yig ngag sgron sogs lo gsum ( 1950—1953)ring rim par sbyangs/de nas bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang gi mkhan chen dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa mchog gi drung nas lnga pa chen po'i snyan 'grel dbyangadī ༵na

nor brang o rgyan gyi gsung rtsom phyogs btus/dgyes glur brten nas snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung khrid dang / mngon brjod bcas rgyas par zhus te snyan ngag gi dper brjod kyang dbyangs can lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kho nar sbyar ba nyung mthar rgyan so sor dper brjod gsum re bris pa dang / skabs de dus rang nyid la skar khung gi nyi ma lta bu'i bag chags snyan ngag sbyong rgyur dka' zhen 'grus brtson shin tu che ba zhig yod/ de rjes snyan ngag dang mngon brjod slob gnyer lam tsam zin par cha bzhag rang gi bsam blor thun mong rig gnas 'di tsam gyis shes bya dmigs phug pa zhig yong dka' bas bsdus ra nas 'go brtsam ste gzhung chen khag la sbyang brtson bya rgyu byung na rang la shin tu phan che bar bsams nas mkhan chen de nyid la brten nas bsdus ra slob khrid zhu rgyu'i 'go brtsams kyang rang la gzhung de dag sbyong ba'i skal ba med pa lta bu rang nyid 'khrul 'khor slob grwa'i slob spyi'i gras kyi las 'gan khyer dgos byung bas 'khrul 'khor slob grwar rtag sdod bya dgos la brten bsdus ra 'khrid mtshams mi 'jog ka med byung ba phyis 'gyod pa'i gnas su gyar ba bcas mkhan chen de nyid kyi drung nas snyan ngag dang / mngon brjod bcas kyi gzhung khrid lo bzhi'i ring ( 1954 1958)zhus/de nas rang lo nyer lnga'i lor ( 1958)rang nyid bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs sdod gsar mjal zhu dgos pa paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i bka' spyi bor phebs pas skabs der rang nyid shag tshang gi khu bo chen po nor brang drung che tā bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan mchog gdong dkar mdangs chen dgon du dbyar dus spro seng la bzhugs mus rang nyid sku mdun du ched bcar zhabs zhu dgos pa'i bka' 'gyur phebs pa'i gnas tshul snyan seng zhus par dgyes 796

rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/pa chen pos de ni bkra shis pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig red/ khyod rang gzhung yig 'bri rgyu nga las mkhas pa 'dug ces brjod mi nus kyang / rtsom rgyag rgyu ni nga las mkhas pa yod/ 'byung 'gyur dbyings sa sman ri ba lta bu yong gi red ces shod mi spobs kyang / gsol dpon dpal shes lags dang 'dra ba zhig yong nges yin zhes gsungs pa ni rang nyid la skul lcag gi ched du gsungs pa zhig las khu bo chen po'i mkhyen rlabs la cha shas tsam yang do ga la thub/ 'on kyang de lta bu'i skul lcag dang 'byung 'gyur zhabs zhu byas rjes ji ltar bya dgos pa'i slob ston mang po gnang byung / khu bo gnyer chen tshe ring nor bu lags mchog la rang nyid zhabs zhu bya dgos pa'i skor snyan seng zhu skabs da krad sgo la mgo brgyus tshar ba red ces de tsam thugs snang mi gnang ba khu bo gnyis kyis rang nyid gso skyong gnang stangs thad kyi dgongs gzhi ni yongs su tha dad pa yin/ khu bo tā bla ma'i dgongs gzhi ni bla brang gi zhabs 'bring legs po zhig yong thub par 'bad brtson bya rgyu de yin pa dang / khu bo gnyer chen gyi dgongs gzhi ni zhabs 'bring zhus na shag tshang gi bya ba byed khom ma byung dogs la dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod/ khu bo gnyer chen rang nyid kyang bkras lhun gyi zhabs 'bring nang zhugs med cing / rgyun gtan rang nyid nas snyan gsum sogs sbyong rgyur de tsam thugs snang mi gnang yang bod kyi rdel rtsis sbyong rgyur skul lcag dang / khong gi sku mdun du rtag par rdel rtsis gtong du 'jug gnang gi yod/ dper na rang nyid lo bcu bdun skabs khu bo gnyer chen ngam ring yong bzhes pa'i khral bsdur phebs pa'i phyag phyir rang nyid khrid gnang gis ngam ring rdzong gi 'du khongs rtsis rgyag ces rdzong 'go de'i khongs lo 'khor gcig ring lam dos rta khal mi gsum rkang 'gro'i khral rigs gang thon lam 797
